text:
Baqarah ki aakhri aayat aur un ki fazeelat. In dono aayaton ki hadeesein suniye, Sahih Bukhari mein hai jo shakhs in dono aayaton ko raat ko parh le use yeh dono kaafi hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya Surah Baqarah ki aakhri aayatein Arsh-e-talay ke khazane se diya gaya hoon, mujh se pehle kisi Nabi ko yeh nahin di gayin. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ ko Me'raj karayi gayi aur aap Sidratul Muntaha tak pohanche jo saatwein aasman mein hai, jo cheez aasman ki taraf charhti hai woh yahin tak hi pohanchti hai aur yahan se hi le jayi jaati hai aur jo cheez oopar se nazil hoti hai woh bhi yahin tak pohanchti hai, phir yahan se aage le jayi jaati hai aur ise sone ki tiddiyan dhake hue thin, wahan Huzoor ﷺ ko teen cheezein di gayin. Paanch waqt ki namazein, Surah Baqarah ke khatma ki aayatein aur Tauheed walon ke tamam gunahon ki bakhshish. Musnad mein hai ke Hazrat Uqba bin Aamir R.A se Rasool-e-Akram ﷺ ne farmaya Surah Baqarah ki in dono aakhri aayaton ko parhte raha karo, main inhe Arsh ke neeche ke khazanon se diya gaya hoon, Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke hamein logon par teen fazeelatein di gayi hain, main Surah Baqarah ki yeh aakhri aayatein Arsh-e-talay ke khazanon se diya gaya hoon jo na mere pehle kisi ko di gayin na mere baad kisi ko di jayengi, Ibn Marduyah mein hai Hazrat Ali R.A farmate hain main nahin jaanta ke Islam ke jaanne walon mein se koi shakhs Ayat-ul-Kursi aur Surah Baqarah ki aakhri aayatein parhe baghair so jaye, yeh woh khazana hai jo tumhare Nabi ﷺ Arsh-e-talay ke khazane se diye gaye hain, aur Hadees-e-Tirmidhi mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ke paida karne se do hazaar baras pehle tak ek kitab likhi jis mein se do aayatein utaar kar Surah Baqarah khatam ki, jis ghar mein yeh teen raaton tak parhi jayein us ghar ke qareeb bhi Shaitan nahin ja sakta. Imam Tirmidhi R.H ise ghareeb batate hain lekin Hakim R.H apni Mustadrak mein ise Sahih kehte hain, Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ Surah Baqarah ka khatma aur Ayat-ul-Kursi parhte to hans dete aur farmate yeh dono Rahman ke Arsh-e-talay ka khazana hain aur jab aayat (Wa man ya'mal soo'an au yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafooran Raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) aur aayat (Wa an laisa lil-insani illa ma sa'a. Wa anna sa'yahu saufa yura. Thumma yujzahul jaza'al aufa) (Surah An-Najm: 39-41) parhte to zabaan se Inna lillahi nikal jaata aur sust ho jaate, Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke mujhe Surah Fatiha aur Surah Baqarah ki aakhri aayatein Arsh ke neeche se di gayi hain, aur mazeed mufassal ki suratein bhi wahan se hi di gayi hain.

Ek aur hadith mein hai ke hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas baithe hue thay jahan Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) bhi thay ke achanak ek dehshat-naak bahut bade dhamake ki aawaz ke saath aasman ka woh darwaza khula jo aaj tak kabhi nahin khula tha, us se ek farishta utra, us ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha aap ko khushi mubarak ho, aap ko woh do noor diye jaate hain jo aap se pehle kisi Nabi ko nahin diye gaye, Surah Fatiha aur Surah Baqarah ki aakhri aayatein. In ke ek-ek harf par aap ko noor diya jayega (Muslim). Pas yeh das hadeesein in mubarak aayaton ki fazeelat hain. Matlab aayat ka yeh hai ke Rasool yani Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is par imaan laye jo un ki taraf se un ke Rabb ki janib se nazil hua, ise sun kar aap ne farmaya woh imaan lane ka poora mustahiq hai, aur dusre imaan-dar bhi imaan laye, in sab ne maan liya ke Allah ek hai, woh wahdaniyat ka maalik hai, woh tanha hai, woh be-niyaz hai, us ke siwa koi ibadat ke laiq nahin, na us ke siwa koi paalne wala hai, yeh (imaan wale) tamam Anbiya ki tasdeeq karte hain, tamam Rasoolon par imaan rakhte hain, aasmani kitabon ko Anbiya-e-Kiram par jo utri hain sachi jaante hain. Woh Nabiyon mein farq nahin samajhte ke ek ko maanein dusre ko na maanein balkay sab ko sacha jaante hain aur imaan rakhte hain ke woh paak-baaz tabqa rushd-o-hidayat wala aur logon ki khair ki taraf rahbari karne wala hai, go baaz ahkaam har Nabi ke zamane mein tabdeel hote rahe yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shariat sab ki naasikh thehri, Khatam-ul-Anbiya-o-Mursaleen aap thay, Qayamat tak aap ki shariat baqi rahegi aur ek jamaat is ki itteba bhi karti rahegi. Unhon ne iqrar bhi kiya ke hum ne Allah ka kalaam suna aur ahkaam-e-Ilahi hamein tasleem hain, unhon ne kaha ke hamare Rabb hamein maghfirat, rahmat aur lutf inayat farma, teri hi taraf hamein lautna hai yani hisab wale din. Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne farmaya ae Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ki aur aap ki tabe-dar ummat ki yahan sana-o-sifat bayan ho rahi hai, aap is mauqe par dua kijiye qubool ki jayegi, mangiye ke Allah kisi ko us ki taqat se zyada takleef na de. Phir farmaya Allah kisi ko us ki taqat se zyada takleef nahin deta yeh us ka lutf-o-karam aur ehsan-o-inaam hai. Sahaba ko jo khatka hua tha aur un par jo yeh farman garan guzra tha ke dil ke khatraat par bhi hisab liya jayega woh dhadka is aayat se uth gaya. Matlab yeh ke go hisab ho, sawal ho lekin jo cheez taqat se bahar hai us par azab nahin kyunke dil mein kisi khayal ka dafatan aa jana roke ruk nahin sakta balkay hadith se yeh bhi maloom ho chuka hai ke aise waswason ko bura jaanna daleel-e-imaan hai, balkay apni apni karni apni apni bharni, aamal-e-saliha karoge jaza paoge, bure aamal karoge to saza bhugtoge.

Phir dua ki taleem di aur us ki qabooliyat ka wada farmaya, ke aye Allah bhoole chooke jo ahkaam hum se chhoot gaye hon ya jo bure kaam ho gaye hon ya shar'i ahkaam mein ghalti kar ke jo khilaf-e-shar' kaam hum se hue hon woh maaf farma, pehle Sahih Muslim ke hawaley se hadith guzar chuki hai ke is dua ke jawab mein Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya, main ne ise qabool farmaya, hadith mein bhi hai ke main yaksooi wala aur aasaan deen de kar bheja gaya hoon. Aye Allah takleefain, balayein aur mushaqqatein hum par na daal jin ki bardasht ki taqat hum mein na ho, Hazrat Makhool R.H farmate hain is se murad fareb aur ghalba-e-shahwat hai, is ke jawab mein bhi qabooliyat ka elaan Rabb-e-Aalam ki taraf se kiya gaya. Aur hamari taqseeron ko maaf farma jo teri nafarmani ka koi kaam na ho, is liye buzurgon ka qaul hai ke gunahgar ko teen baaton ki zaroorat hai. Ek to Allah ki maafi taake azab se nijaat paye, dusre parda poshi taake ruswai se bache, teesre ismat ki taake dusri baar gunah mein mubtala na ho, is par bhi Janab-e-Bari ne qabooliyat ka elaan kiya. Tu hamara wali-o-nasir hai, tujhi par bharosa hai, tujhi se hum madad talab karte hain, tu hi hamara sahara hai, teri madad ke siwa na to hum kisi nafa ke hasil karne par qadir hain na kisi burai se bach sakte hain, tu hamari un logon par madad farma jo tere deen ke munkir hain teri wahdaniyat ko nahin maante, tere Nabi ki risalat ko tasleem nahin karte, tere saath dusron ki ibadat karte hain, mushrik hain aye Allah tu hamain un par ghalib kar dena aur deen mein hum hi un par faateh rahein, Allah Ta'ala ne is ke jawab mein bhi farmaya haan main ne yeh bhi dua qabool farmai. Hazrat Mu'az R.A jab is aayat ko khatam karte Aameen kehte. (Ibn-e-Jarir)

Ayat-ul-Kursi aur Ism-e-Azam. Ayat-ul-Kursi ki tafsir mein pehle bhi yeh hadith guzar chuki hai ke Ism-e-Azam is ayat aur Ayat-ul-Kursi mein hai aur Alif-Laam-Meem ki tafsir Surah Baqarah ke shuru mein bayan ho chuki hai jise dobara yahan likhne ki zaroorat nahin, Ayat (Allahu la ilaha illa huwal hayyul qayyum, la ta'khuzuhu sinatuw-wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man zallazi yashfa'u indahu illa bi-iznih, ya'lamu ma baina aidihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishai'im-min ilmihi illa bima sha'a, wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-aliyyul-azim) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 255) ki tafsir bhi Ayat-ul-Kursi ki tafsir mein hum likh aaye hain. Phir farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne tujh par ae Muhammad (ﷺ) Quran-e-Karim ko haq ke sath nazil farmaya hai jis mein koi shak nahin balkay yaqeenan woh Allah ki taraf se hai, jise us ne apne ilm ki wus'aton ke sath utara hai, farishtay is par gawah hain aur Allah ki shahadat kafi wafi hai. Yeh Quran apne se pehle ki tamam asmani kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wala hai aur woh kitabein bhi is Quran ki sachai par gawah hain, is liye ke un mein jo is Nabi (ﷺ) ke aane aur is kitab ke utarne ki khabar thi woh sachi sabit hui. Isi ne Hazrat Musa bin Imran par Taurat aur Isa bin Maryam par Injeel utari, woh dono kitabein bhi us zamane ke logon ke liye hidayat dene wali thin. Us ne Furqan utara jo haq-o-batil, hidayat-o-zalalat, gumrahi aur rah-e-rast mein farq karne wala hai, is ki wazeh roshan daleelein aur zabardast suboot har mu'tariz ke liye musbat jawab hain, Hazrat Qatadah, Hazrat Rabi bin Anas ka bayan hai ke Furqan se murad yahan Quran hai, go yeh masdar hai lekin chunke Quran ka zikr is se pehle guzar chuka hai is liye yahan Furqan farmaya, Abu Saleh se yeh bhi marwi hai ke murad is se Taurat hai magar yeh za'eef hai is liye ke Taurat ka zikr is se pehle guzar chuka hai wallahu a'lam. Qayamat ke din munkiron aur batil paraston ko sakht azab honge. Allah Ta'ala ghalib hai bari shan wala hai a'la saltanat wala hai, Anbiya-e-Kiram aur mohtaram Rasoolon ke mukhalifon se aur Allah Ta'ala ki ayaton ki takzeeb karne walon se Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala zabardast inteqam lega.

Khaliq-e-Kul Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke aasman-o-zameen ke ghaib ko woh bakhoobi jaanta hai, us par koi cheez makhfi nahin. Woh tumhein tumhari maa ke pait mein jis tarah ki chahta hai achi, buri, nek aur bad soortein inayat farmata hai. Us ke siwa ibadat ke laiq koi nahin, woh Ghalib hai, Hikmat wala hai. Jabke sirf usi ek ne tumhein banaya, paida kiya, phir tum dusre ki ibadat kyun karo? Woh la-zawaal izzaton wala, ghair-fani hikmaton wala, atal ahkaamon wala hai. Is mein ishara balkay tasreeh hai ke Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) bhi Allah Azza-wa-Jal hi ke paida kiye hue aur usi ki chaukhat par jhukne wale thay, jis tarah tamam insaan us ke paida karda hain, inhi insaanon mein se ek aap bhi hain. Woh bhi maa ke raham mein banaye gaye hain aur mere paida karne se paida hue, phir woh Allah kaise ban gaye? Jaisa ke us la'nati jamaat-e-Nasara ne samajh rakha hai, halankeh woh to ek halat se dusri halat ki taraf rag-o-resha ki surat idhar-udhar phirte phirate rahe, jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Yakhluqukum fi butooni ummahatikum khalqan mim ba'di khalqin fi zulumatin thalathin) (Surah Az-Zumar: 6). Woh Allah jo tumhein maaon ke paiton mein paida karta hai, har ek ki paidaish tarah-tarah ke marhalon se guzarti hai.

Hamari samajh se buland ayaat yahan yeh bayan ho raha hai ke Quran mein aisi ayatein bhi hain jin ka bayan bahut wazeh bilkul saaf aur seedha hai. Har shakhs is ke matlab ko samajh sakta hai, aur baaz ayatein aisi bhi hain jin ke matlab tak aam zehnon ki rasai nahin hosakti, ab jo log na samajh mein aane wali ayaton ke mafhoom ko pehli qisam ki ayaton ki roshni mein samajh lein yani jis masla ki sarahat jis ayat mein payein le lein, woh to rasti par hain aur jo saaf aur sareeh ayaton ko chhod kar aisi ayaton ko daleel banayein jo un ke fehm se balatar hain, un mein ulajh jayein to munh ke bal gir padein, Umm-ul-Kitab yani Kitabullah asal usoolon ki woh saaf aur wazeh ayatein hain, shak-o-shuba mein na pado aur khule ahkaam par amal karo inhi ko faisla karne wali mano aur jo na samajh mein aaye use bhi un se hi samjho, baaz aur ayatein aisi bhi hain ke ek maani to un ka aisa nikalta hai jo zahir ayaton ke mutabiq ho aur is ke siwa aur maani bhi nikalte hain, go woh harf lafz aur tarkeeb ke aitbar se waqai taur par na ho to un ghair zahir maanon mein na phanso, Muhkam aur Mutashabih ke bahut se maani aslaf se manqool hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A to farmate hain ke Muhkamat woh hain jo nasikh hon jin mein halal haram ahkaam hukm mamnooaat haddein aur aamaal ka bayan ho, isi tarah aap se yeh bhi marwi hai (Ayat: Qul ta'alau atlu ma harrama Rabbukum alaikum... al-kh), aur is ke baad ke ahkamaat wali aur (Ayat: Wa qada Rabbuka alla ta'budu... al-kh), aur is ke baad ki teen ayatein Muhkamat se hain, Hazrat Abu Fakhita farmate hain suraton ke shuru mein faraiz aur ahkaam aur rok tok aur halal-o-haram ki ayatein hain, Saeed bin Jubair kehte hain inhe Asl-e-Kitab is liye kaha jata hai ke yeh tamam kitabon mein hain, Hazrat Muqatil kehte hain is liye ke tamam mazhab wale inhe maante hain, Mutashabihat un ayaton ko kehte hain jo mansookh hain aur jo pehle aur baad ki hain aur jin mein misalein di gayi hain aur qasmein khayi gayi hain aur jin par sirf iman laya jata hai aur amal ke liye woh ahkaam nahin, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bhi yahi farman hai Hazrat Muqatil farmate hain is se murad suraton ke shuru ke Huroof-e-Muqatta'at hain. Hazrat Mujahid ka qaul yeh hai ke ek dusre ki tasdeeq karne wali hain, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Kitaban mutashabihan mathani) (Surah Az-Zumar: 23) aur Mathani woh hai jahan do muqabil ki cheezon ka zikr ho jaise jannat dozakh ki sifat, nekon aur badon ka haal waghera waghera. Is ayat mein Mutashabih Muhkam ke muqabla mein is liye theek matlab wahi hai jo hum ne pehle bayan kiya aur Hazrat Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar ka yahi farman hai, farmate hain yeh Rabb ki hujjat hai in mein bandon ka bachao hai, jhagron ka faisla hai, batil ka khatma hai, inhe un ke sahih aur asal matlab se koi ghuma nahin sakta na un ke maani mein her-pher karsakta hai. Mutashabihat ki sachai mein kalam nahin in mein tasarruf-o-taweel nahin karni chahiye.

In se Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke iman ko aazmata hai jaise halal haram se aazmata hai, unhein batil ki taraf le jana aur haq se pherna chahiye. Phir farmata hai ke jin ke dilon mein kaji, tedh-pan, gumrahi aur haq se batil ki taraf hi hai woh toh mutashabih aayaton ko le kar apne badtareen maqasid ko pura karna chahte hain aur lafzi ikhtilaf se najayaz faida utha kar apne mazmoom maqasid ki taraf mod lete hain aur jo muhkam aayatein hain un mein un ka woh maqsad pura nahin hota. Kyunke un ke alfaaz bilkul saaf aur khule hue hote hain na woh unhein hata sakte hain na un se apne liye koi daleel hasil kar sakte hain. Isi liye farman hai ke is se un ka maqsad fitna ki talash hoti hai taake apne manne walon ko behkayein, apni bid'aton ki mudafat karein jaisa ke Isaiyon ne Quran ke alfaaz 'Ruhullah' aur 'Kalimatullah' se Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke Allah ka ladka hone ki daleel li hai. Pas is mutashabih aayat ko le kar saaf aayat jis mein yeh lafz hain ke (Aayat: In huwa illa 'abdun..., yani Hazrat Isa Allah ke ghulam hain, jin par Allah ka in'am hai, aur jagah hai aayat: Inna masala 'Isa 'indallahi kamasali Adama) (3. Surah Al-Imran: 59) yani Hazrat Isa ki misaal Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki tarah hai ke unhein Allah ne mitti se paida kiya phir use kaha ke ho ja, woh ho gaya, chunancha isi tarah ki aur bhi bahut si sarih aayatein hain un sab ko chhod diya aur mutashabih aayaton se Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke Allah ka beta hone par daleel le li halanke aap Allah ki makhlooq hain, Allah ke bande hain, us ke Rasool hain. Phir farmata hai ke un ki dusri garz aayat ki tahrif hoti hai taake use apni jagah se hata kar mafhoom badal lein, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat padh kar farmaya ke jab tum un logon ko dekho jo mutashabih aayaton mein jhagadte hain toh unhein chhod do, aise hi log is aayat mein murad liye gaye hain. Yeh hadith mukhtalif tareeq se bahut si kitabon mein marwi hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein bhi yeh hadith is aayat ki tafsir mein marwi hai, mulahiza ho Kitab-ul-Qadr, ek aur hadith mein hai yeh log Khawarij hain (Musnad Ahmad). Pas is hadith ko zyada se zyada mauqoof samajh liya jaye taham is ka mazmoon sahih hai is liye ke pehle bid'at Khawarij ne hi phailayi hai, firqa mehez dunyawi ranj ki wajah se musalmanon se alag hua.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jis waqt Hunain ki ghanimat ka maal taqseem kiya us waqt un logon ne ise khilaf-e-adl samjha aur un mein se ek ne jise Zul-Khawaisara kaha jata hai us ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne aakar saaf kaha ke Hazrat adl kijiye, aap ne is taqseem mein insaaf nahin kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne ameen bana kar bheja tha, agar main bhi adl nahin karoon to phir barbad ho aur nuqsan uthaye, jab woh palta to Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne darkhwast ki ke mujhe ijazat di jaye ke main ise maar daloon, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chhod do, is ke hum-khayal ek aisi qoum paida hogi ke tum log apni namazon ko un ki namazon ke muqable aur apni Quran-khwani ko un ki Quran-khwani ke muqable mein haqeer samjhoge lekin darasal woh deen se is tarah nikal jayenge jis tarah teer kaman se nikal jata hai, tum jahan unhein paoge qatl karoge, unhein qatl karne wale ko bada sawab milega, Hazrat Ali (R.A) ki khilafat ke zamane mein un ka zuhoor hua aur aap ne unhein Nahrawan mein qatl kiya phir un mein phoot padi to un ke mukhtalif-ul-khayal firqe paida ho gaye, nayi nayi bid'atein deen mein jaari ho gayin aur Allah Ta'ala ki raah se bahut door chale gaye, un ke baad Qadriya firqe ka zuhoor hua, phir Mu'tazila phir Jahmiya waghera paida hue aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki peshingoi poori hui ke meri ummat mein anqareeb tehattar (73) firqe honge sab jahannami honge siwaye ek jamaat ke. Sahaba (R.A) ne poocha woh kaun log honge? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh jo is cheez par hon jis par main hoon aur mere as-haab (Mustadrak Hakim). Abu Ya'la ki hadith mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya meri ummat mein se ek qoum paida hogi jo Quran to padhegi lekin ise is tarah phenkegi jaise koi khajoor ki guthliyan phenkta ho, is ke ghalat matalib bayan karegi, phir farmaya is ki haqeeqi ta'weel aur waqai matlab Allah Ta'ala hi janta hai, lafz Allah par waqf hai ya nahin? Is mein ikhtilaf hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) to farmate hain tafseer chaar qisam ki hai, ek woh jis ke samajhne mein kisi ko mushkil nahin, ek woh jise Arab apne lughat se samajhte hain, ek woh jise jayyid ulama aur poore ilm wale hi jante hain aur ek woh jise bajuz Zaat-e-Ilahi ke aur koi nahin janta. Yeh riwayat pehle bhi guzar chuki hai, Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka bhi yahi qaul hai, Mu'jam-e-Kabeer mein hadith hai ke mujhe apni ummat par sirf teen baton ka dar hai. Maal ki kasrat ka jis se hasad-o-bughz paida hoga aur aapas ki ladai shuru hogi, doosra yeh ke Kitabullah ki ta'weel ka silsila shuru hoga halanke asli matlab un ka Allah Ta'ala hi janta hai aur ahl-e-ilm wale kahenge ke hamara is par imaan hai.

Teesre yeh ke ilm hasil karne ke baad use be-parwahi se zaya kar denge, yeh hadith bilkul ghareeb hai aur hadith mein hai ke Quran is liye nahin utra ke ek aayat dusri aayat ki mukhalif ho, jis ka tumhein ilm ho aur us par amal karo aur jo mutashabeh hon un par imaan lao (Ibn Marduyah). Ibn Abbas, Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz aur Hazrat Malik bin Anas se bhi yahi marwi hai ke bade se bade aalim bhi is ki haqeeqat se aagah nahin hote, haan is par imaan rakhte hain. Ibn Masood farmate hain ke pukhta ilm wale yahi kehte hain is ki taweel ka ilm Allah hi ko hai ke is par hamara imaan hai. Ubayy bin Ka'ab bhi yahi farmate hain, Imam Ibn Jareer bhi isi se ittefaq karte hain, yeh to thi woh jamaat jo 'Illallah' par waqf karti thi aur baad ke jumla ko is se alag karti thi, kuch log yahan nahin theherte aur 'fil-ilm' par waqf karte hain, aksar mufassireen aur ahl-e-usool bhi yahi kehte hain, un ki badi daleel yeh hai ke jo samajh mein na aaye us baat ka theek nahin, Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmaya karte the main un rasikh ulama mein hoon jo taweel jaante hain, Mujahid farmate hain rasikh ilm wale tafseer jaante hain, Hazrat Muhammad bin Jafar bin Zubair farmate hain ke asal tafseer aur muraad Allah hi jaanta hai aur mazboot ilm wale kehte hain ke hum is par imaan laye phir mutashabihat aayaton ki tafseer muhkamat ki roshni mein karte hain jin mein kisi ko baat karne ki gunjaish nahin rehti, Quran ke mazameen theek thaak samajh mein aate hain daleel wazeh hoti hai, uzr zahir hojata hai, baatil chhat jata hai aur kufr dafa hojata hai, hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas ke liye dua ki ke Aye Allah inhe deen ki samajh de aur tafseer ka ilm de. Baaz ulama ne tafseel se baat karte hue kaha hai, Quran-e-Kareem mein taweel do ma'ani mein aayi hai, ek ma'ani jin se mafhoom ki asli haqeeqat aur asliyat ki nishandahi hoti hai, jaise Quran mein hai (Yaa abati haaza ta'weelu ru'yaaya min qablu qad ja'alahaa Rabbee haqqaa) (Yusuf: 100) mere baap mere khwab ki yahi ta'beer hai, aur jagah hai aayat (Hal yanzuroona illaa ta'weelahu yawma ya'tee ta'weeluhu yaqoolul-lazeena nasoohu min qablu qad jaa'at rusulu Rabbinaa bil-haqq) (Al-A'raf: 53) kafiron ke intezar ki had haqeeqat ke zahir hone tak hai aur yeh din woh hoga jab haqeeqat sachai ki gawah ban kar namoodar hogi, pas in dono jagah par taweel se muraad haqeeqat hai, agar is aayat-e-mubaraka mein taweel se muraad yahi taweel li jaye to 'Illallah' par waqf zaroori hai is liye ke tamam kaamon ki haqeeqat aur asliyat bajuz zaat-e-paak ke aur koi nahin jaanta to 'Rasikhuna fil-ilm' mubtada hoga aur 'yaqooloona aamannaa bihi' khabar hogi aur yeh jumla bilkul alag hoga aur taweel ke dusre ma'ani tafseer aur bayan aur hai aur ek shai ki ta'beer dusri shai hai, jaise Quran mein hai aayat (Nabbi'naa bita'weelihee) (Yusuf: 36).

(Yusuf: 36) Hamein is ki ta'weel batao yani tafseer aur bayan, agar ayat-e-mazkoorah mein ta'weel se yeh murad li jaye toh 'fil-ilm' par waqf karna chahiye, is liye ke pukhta ilm wale ulama jante hain aur samajhte hain kyunke khitab unhi se hai, go haqaiq ka ilm unhein bhi nahin, toh is bina par 'amanna bihi' haal hoga aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke baghair ma'toof alaih ke ma'toof ho, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (LIL-FUQARA'IL-MUHAJIRINALLAZINA UKHRIJU MIN DIYARIHIM) (Al-Hashr: 8) se (YAQULUNA RABBANA-GHFIR LANA WA LI-IKHWANINALLAZINA SABAQUNA BIL-IMANI WA LA TAJ'AL FI QULUBINA GHILLAL-LILLAZINA AMANU RABBANA INNAKA RA'UFUR-RAHIM) (Al-Hashr: 10) tak. Dusri jagah hai ayat (WA JA'A RABBUKA WAL-MALAKU SAFFAN SAFFA) (Al-Fajr: 22) yani wa ja'al-mala'ikatu sufufan sufufa aur un ki taraf se yeh khabar ke hum is par iman laye is ke yeh ma'ni honge ke mutashabih par iman laye, phir iqrar karte hain ke yeh sab yani muhkam aur mutashabih haq aur sach hai aur yani har ek dusre ki tasdeeq karta hai aur gawahi deta hai ke yeh sab Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai is mein koi ikhtilaf aur tazad nahin, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (AFALA YATADABBARUNAL-QUR'ANA WALAW KANA MIN 'INDI GHAIRILLAHI LAWAJADU FIHI IKHTILAFAN KATHIRA) (An-Nisa: 82) yani kya yeh log Quran mein gaur-o-fikr nahin karte, agar yeh Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki taraf se hota toh is mein bahut sa ikhtilaf hota, isi liye yahan bhi farmaya ke ise sirf aqalmand hi samajhte hain jo is par gaur-o-tadabbur karein, jo sahih salim aqal wale hon jin ke dimagh durust hon. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hota hai ke pukhta ilm wale kaun hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ki qasam sachi ho, jis ki zaban rast-go ho, jis ka dil salamat ho, jis ka pet haram se bacha ho aur jis ki sharm-gah zinakari se mehfooz ho, woh mazboot ilm wale hain (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur hadith mein hai ke aap ne chand logon ko dekha ke woh Quran Sharif ke bare mein lad-jhagad rahe hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno tum se pehle log bhi isi mein halak hue ke unhon ne Kitabullah ki ayaton ko ek dusre ke khilaf bata kar ikhtilaf kiya halankeh Kitabullah ki har ayat ek dusre ki tasdeeq karti hai, tum un mein ikhtilaf paida karke ek ko dusri ke mutazad na kaho, jo jano wahi kaho aur jo nahin jano use janne walon ko saunp do (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur hadith mein hai ke Quran saat harfon par utra, Quran mein jhagadna kufr hai, Quran mein ikhtilaf aur tazad paida karna kufr hai, jo jano us par amal karo, jo na jano use janne wale ki taraf saunpo Jalla Jalaluhu (Abu Ya'la). Rasikh fil-ilm kaun? Nafi bin Yazeed kehte hain Rasikh fil-ilm woh log hain jo mutawazi hon jo aajizi karne wale hon, Rabb ki raza ke talib hon, apne se badon se mar'oob na hon, apne se chhote ko haqeer samajhne wale na hon.

Phir farmaya ke yeh sab dua karte hain ke hamare dilon ko hidayat par jamane ke baad unhein un logon ke dilon ki tarah na kar jo mutashabeh ke peeche par kar barbad ho jate hain, balkeh hamain apni Sirat-e-Mustaqeem par qaim rakh aur apne mazboot deen par da'im rakh, hum par apni rahmat nazil farma, hamare dilon ko qarar de, hum se gandagi ko door kar, hamare iman-o-yaqeen ko barha, tu bahut bada dene wala hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) dua manga karte the, hadith: (Ya Muqallibal Quloobi thabbit qalbi ala deenik) - Ae dilon ke pherne wale! Mere dil ko apne deen par jama hua rakh. Phir yeh dua "Rabbana la tuzigh" parhte aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) bakasrat yeh dua parhte the, hadith: (Allahumma Muqallibal Quloobi thabbit qalbi ala deenik). Hazrat Asma (R.A) ne ek din poocha, kya dil ulat-palat ho jata hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, haan, har insan ka dil Allah Ta'ala ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke darmiyan hai, agar chahe qaim rakhe, agar chahe pher de. Hamari dua hai hamara Rab dilon ko hidayat ke baad tedha na kar de aur hamain apne paas se rahmatain inayat farmaye, woh bahut zyada dene wala hai. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke main ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mujhe koi aisi dua sikhaiye ke main apne liye manga karoon, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh dua mang: (Hadith: Allahumma Rabba Muhammadin-Nabi, ighfirli dhanbi wa adhhib ghaiza qalbi wa ajirni min mudillatil fitan) - Ae Allah! Ae Muhammad (ﷺ) Nabi ke Rab! Mere gunah maaf farma, mere dil ka gussa aur ranj aur sakhti door kar aur mujhe gumrah karne wale fitnon se bacha le. Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa (R.A) ne bhi Aap (ﷺ) ki dua "Ya Muqallibal Quloob" sun kar Hazrat Asma (R.A) ki tarah main ne bhi yahi sawal kiya aur Aap (ﷺ) ne wahi jawab diya aur phir Quran ki yeh dua sunai. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai lekin Qurani ayat ki tilawat ke baghair yahi Bukhari Muslim mein bhi marwi hai. Aur Nasai mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) jab raat ko jagte to yeh dua parhte: (Hadith: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka astaghfiruka lidhanbi wa as'aluka rahmatan, Allahumma zidni ilma wala tuzigh ba'da idh hadaitani wahab li min ladunka rahmatan innaka antal Wahhab) - Ae Allah! Tere siwa koi mabood nahin, main tujh se apne gunahon ki bakhshish mangta hoon aur tujh se teri rahmat ka sawal karta hoon, Allah mere ilm mein ziyadati farma aur mere dil ko tu ne hidayat de di hai ise gumrah na karna aur mujhe apne paas ki rahmat bakhsh, tu bahut zyada dene wala hai. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne Maghrib ki namaz parhai, pehli do rakaton mein Alhamd-e-Sharif ke baad mufassal ki choti si do suratein parhin aur teesri rakat mein Surah Alhamd-e-Sharif ke baad yahi ayat parhi. Abu Abdullah Sabalji farmate hain main us waqt un ke qareeb chala gaya tha, yahan tak ke mere kapde un ke kapdon se mil gaye the aur main ne khud apne kaan se Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ko yeh parhte hue suna (Abdur Razzaq). Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne jab tak yeh hadith nahin suni thi, Aap (R.H) us rakat mein "Qul huwallahu" parha karte the lekin yeh hadith sunne ke baad Ameer-ul-Momineen ne bhi isi ko parhna shuru kiya aur kabhi tark nahin kiya.

Phir farmaya woh yeh bhi kehte hain ke Aye Allah! Tu Qayamat ke din apni tamam makhlooq ko jama karne wala hai aur un mein faisle aur hukm karne wala hai, un ke ikhtilafat ko sametne wala hai aur har ek ko bhale bure amal ka badla dene wala hai, us din ke aane mein aur Tere wadon ke sache hone mein koi shak nahin.

Hamari samajh se buland ayaat yahan yeh bayan ho raha hai ke Quran mein aisi ayatein bhi hain jin ka bayan bahut wazeh bilkul saaf aur seedha hai. Har shakhs is ke matlab ko samajh sakta hai, aur baaz ayatein aisi bhi hain jin ke matlab tak aam zehnon ki rasai nahin hosakti, ab jo log na samajh mein aane wali ayaton ke mafhoom ko pehli qisam ki ayaton ki roshni mein samajh lein yani jis masla ki sarahat jis ayat mein payein le lein, woh to rasti par hain aur jo saaf aur sareeh ayaton ko chhod kar aisi ayaton ko daleel banayein jo un ke fehm se balatar hain, un mein ulajh jayein to munh ke bal gir padein, Umm-ul-Kitab yani Kitabullah asal usoolon ki woh saaf aur wazeh ayatein hain, shak-o-shuba mein na pado aur khule ahkaam par amal karo inhi ko faisla karne wali mano aur jo na samajh mein aaye use bhi un se hi samjho, baaz aur ayatein aisi bhi hain ke ek maani to un ka aisa nikalta hai jo zahir ayaton ke mutabiq ho aur is ke siwa aur maani bhi nikalte hain, go woh harf lafz aur tarkeeb ke aitbar se waqai taur par na ho to un ghair zahir maanon mein na phanso, Muhkam aur Mutashabih ke bahut se maani aslaf se manqool hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A to farmate hain ke Muhkamat woh hain jo nasikh hon jin mein halal haram ahkaam hukm mamnooaat haddein aur aamaal ka bayan ho, isi tarah aap se yeh bhi marwi hai (Ayat: Qul ta'alau atlu ma harrama Rabbukum alaikum... al-kh), aur is ke baad ke ahkamaat wali aur (Ayat: Wa qada Rabbuka alla ta'budu... al-kh), aur is ke baad ki teen ayatein Muhkamat se hain, Hazrat Abu Fakhita farmate hain suraton ke shuru mein faraiz aur ahkaam aur rok tok aur halal-o-haram ki ayatein hain, Saeed bin Jubair kehte hain inhe Asl-e-Kitab is liye kaha jata hai ke yeh tamam kitabon mein hain, Hazrat Muqatil kehte hain is liye ke tamam mazhab wale inhe maante hain, Mutashabihat un ayaton ko kehte hain jo mansookh hain aur jo pehle aur baad ki hain aur jin mein misalein di gayi hain aur qasmein khayi gayi hain aur jin par sirf iman laya jata hai aur amal ke liye woh ahkaam nahin, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bhi yahi farman hai Hazrat Muqatil farmate hain is se murad suraton ke shuru ke Huroof-e-Muqatta'at hain. Hazrat Mujahid ka qaul yeh hai ke ek dusre ki tasdeeq karne wali hain, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Kitaban mutashabihan mathani) (Surah Az-Zumar: 23) aur Mathani woh hai jahan do muqabil ki cheezon ka zikr ho jaise jannat dozakh ki sifat, nekon aur badon ka haal waghera waghera. Is ayat mein Mutashabih Muhkam ke muqabla mein is liye theek matlab wahi hai jo hum ne pehle bayan kiya aur Hazrat Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar ka yahi farman hai, farmate hain yeh Rabb ki hujjat hai in mein bandon ka bachao hai, jhagron ka faisla hai, batil ka khatma hai, inhe un ke sahih aur asal matlab se koi ghuma nahin sakta na un ke maani mein her-pher karsakta hai. Mutashabihat ki sachai mein kalam nahin in mein tasarruf-o-taweel nahin karni chahiye.

In se Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke iman ko aazmata hai jaise halal haram se aazmata hai, unhein batil ki taraf le jana aur haq se pherna chahiye. Yeh hadith mukhtalif tareeq se bahut si kitabon mein marwi hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein bhi yeh hadith is aayat ki tafsir mein marwi hai, mulahiza ho Kitab-ul-Qadr, ek aur hadith mein hai yeh log Khawarij hain (Musnad Ahmad). Pas is hadith ko zyada se zyada mauqoof samajh liya jaye taham is ka mazmoon sahih hai is liye ke pehle bid'at Khawarij ne hi phailayi hai, firqa mehez dunyawi ranj ki wajah se musalmanon se alag hua.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jis waqt Hunain ki ghanimat ka maal taqseem kiya us waqt un logon ne ise khilaf-e-adl samjha aur un mein se ek ne jise Zul-Khawaisara kaha jata hai us ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne aakar saaf kaha ke Hazrat adl kijiye, aap ne is taqseem mein insaaf nahin kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe Allah Ta'ala ne ameen bana kar bheja tha, agar main bhi adl nahin karoon to phir barbad ho aur nuqsan uthaye, jab woh palta to Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne darkhwast ki ke mujhe ijazat di jaye ke main ise maar daloon, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chhod do, is ke hum-khayal ek aisi qoum paida hogi ke tum log apni namazon ko un ki namazon ke muqable aur apni Quran-khwani ko un ki Quran-khwani ke muqable mein haqeer samjhoge lekin darasal woh deen se is tarah nikal jayenge jis tarah teer kaman se nikal jata hai, tum jahan unhein paoge qatl karoge, unhein qatl karne wale ko bada sawab milega, Hazrat Ali (R.A) ki khilafat ke zamane mein un ka zuhoor hua aur aap ne unhein Nahrawan mein qatl kiya phir un mein phoot padi to un ke mukhtalif-ul-khayal firqe paida ho gaye, nayi nayi bid'atein deen mein jaari ho gayin aur Allah Ta'ala ki raah se bahut door chale gaye, un ke baad Qadriya firqe ka zuhoor hua, phir Mu'tazila phir Jahmiya waghera paida hue aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki peshingoi poori hui ke meri ummat mein anqareeb tehattar (73) firqe honge sab jahannami honge siwaye ek jamaat ke. Sahaba (R.A) ne poocha woh kaun log honge? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh jo is cheez par hon jis par main hoon aur mere as-haab (Mustadrak Hakim). Abu Ya'la ki hadith mein hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya meri ummat mein se ek qoum paida hogi jo Quran to padhegi lekin ise is tarah phenkegi jaise koi khajoor ki guthliyan phenkta ho, is ke ghalat matalib bayan karegi, phir farmaya is ki haqeeqi ta'weel aur waqai matlab Allah Ta'ala hi janta hai, lafz Allah par waqf hai ya nahin? Is mein ikhtilaf hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) to farmate hain tafseer chaar qisam ki hai, ek woh jis ke samajhne mein kisi ko mushkil nahin, ek woh jise Arab apne lughat se samajhte hain, ek woh jise jayyid ulama aur poore ilm wale hi jante hain aur ek woh jise bajuz Zaat-e-Ilahi ke aur koi nahin janta. Yeh riwayat pehle bhi guzar chuki hai, Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka bhi yahi qaul hai, Mu'jam-e-Kabeer mein hadith hai ke mujhe apni ummat par sirf teen baton ka dar hai. Maal ki kasrat ka jis se hasad-o-bughz paida hoga aur aapas ki ladai shuru hogi, doosra yeh ke Kitabullah ki ta'weel ka silsila shuru hoga halanke asli matlab un ka Allah Ta'ala hi janta hai aur ahl-e-ilm wale kahenge ke hamara is par imaan hai.

Teesre yeh ke ilm hasil karne ke baad use be-parwahi se zaya kar denge, yeh hadith bilkul ghareeb hai aur hadith mein hai ke Quran is liye nahin utra ke ek aayat dusri aayat ki mukhalif ho, jis ka tumhein ilm ho aur us par amal karo aur jo mutashabeh hon un par imaan lao (Ibn Marduyah). Ibn Abbas, Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz aur Hazrat Malik bin Anas se bhi yahi marwi hai ke bade se bade aalim bhi is ki haqeeqat se aagah nahin hote, haan is par imaan rakhte hain. Ibn Masood farmate hain ke pukhta ilm wale yahi kehte hain is ki taweel ka ilm Allah hi ko hai ke is par hamara imaan hai. Ubayy bin Ka'ab bhi yahi farmate hain, Imam Ibn Jareer bhi isi se ittefaq karte hain, yeh to thi woh jamaat jo 'Illallah' par waqf karti thi aur baad ke jumla ko is se alag karti thi, kuch log yahan nahin theherte aur 'fil-ilm' par waqf karte hain, aksar mufassireen aur ahl-e-usool bhi yahi kehte hain, un ki badi daleel yeh hai ke jo samajh mein na aaye us baat ka theek nahin, Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmaya karte the main un rasikh ulama mein hoon jo taweel jaante hain, Mujahid farmate hain rasikh ilm wale tafseer jaante hain, Hazrat Muhammad bin Jafar bin Zubair farmate hain ke asal tafseer aur muraad Allah hi jaanta hai aur mazboot ilm wale kehte hain ke hum is par imaan laye phir mutashabihat aayaton ki tafseer muhkamat ki roshni mein karte hain jin mein kisi ko baat karne ki gunjaish nahin rehti, Quran ke mazameen theek thaak samajh mein aate hain daleel wazeh hoti hai, uzr zahir hojata hai, baatil chhat jata hai aur kufr dafa hojata hai, hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas ke liye dua ki ke Aye Allah inhe deen ki samajh de aur tafseer ka ilm de. Baaz ulama ne tafseel se baat karte hue kaha hai, Quran-e-Kareem mein taweel do ma'ani mein aayi hai, ek ma'ani jin se mafhoom ki asli haqeeqat aur asliyat ki nishandahi hoti hai, jaise Quran mein hai (Yaa abati haaza ta'weelu ru'yaaya min qablu qad ja'alahaa Rabbee haqqaa) (Yusuf: 100) mere baap mere khwab ki yahi ta'beer hai, aur jagah hai aayat (Hal yanzuroona illaa ta'weelahu yawma ya'tee ta'weeluhu yaqoolul-lazeena nasoohu min qablu qad jaa'at rusulu Rabbinaa bil-haqq) (Al-A'raf: 53) kafiron ke intezar ki had haqeeqat ke zahir hone tak hai aur yeh din woh hoga jab haqeeqat sachai ki gawah ban kar namoodar hogi, pas in dono jagah par taweel se muraad haqeeqat hai, agar is aayat-e-mubaraka mein taweel se muraad yahi taweel li jaye to 'Illallah' par waqf zaroori hai is liye ke tamam kaamon ki haqeeqat aur asliyat bajuz zaat-e-paak ke aur koi nahin jaanta to 'Rasikhuna fil-ilm' mubtada hoga aur 'yaqooloona aamannaa bihi' khabar hogi aur yeh jumla bilkul alag hoga aur taweel ke dusre ma'ani tafseer aur bayan aur hai aur ek shai ki ta'beer dusri shai hai, jaise Quran mein hai aayat (Nabbi'naa bita'weelihee) (Yusuf: 36).

(Yusuf: 36) Hamein is ki ta'weel batao yani tafseer aur bayan, agar ayat-e-mazkoorah mein ta'weel se yeh murad li jaye toh 'fil-ilm' par waqf karna chahiye, is liye ke pukhta ilm wale ulama jante hain aur samajhte hain kyunke khitab unhi se hai, go haqaiq ka ilm unhein bhi nahin, toh is bina par 'amanna bihi' haal hoga aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke baghair ma'toof alaih ke ma'toof ho, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (LIL-FUQARA'IL-MUHAJIRINALLAZINA UKHRIJU MIN DIYARIHIM) (Al-Hashr: 8) se (YAQULUNA RABBANA-GHFIR LANA WA LI-IKHWANINALLAZINA SABAQUNA BIL-IMANI WA LA TAJ'AL FI QULUBINA GHILLAL-LILLAZINA AMANU RABBANA INNAKA RA'UFUR-RAHIM) (Al-Hashr: 10) tak. Dusri jagah hai ayat (WA JA'A RABBUKA WAL-MALAKU SAFFAN SAFFA) (Al-Fajr: 22) yani wa ja'al-mala'ikatu sufufan sufufa aur un ki taraf se yeh khabar ke hum is par iman laye is ke yeh ma'ni honge ke mutashabih par iman laye, phir iqrar karte hain ke yeh sab yani muhkam aur mutashabih haq aur sach hai aur yani har ek dusre ki tasdeeq karta hai aur gawahi deta hai ke yeh sab Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai is mein koi ikhtilaf aur tazad nahin, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (AFALA YATADABBARUNAL-QUR'ANA WALAW KANA MIN 'INDI GHAIRILLAHI LAWAJADU FIHI IKHTILAFAN KATHIRA) (An-Nisa: 82) yani kya yeh log Quran mein gaur-o-fikr nahin karte, agar yeh Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki taraf se hota toh is mein bahut sa ikhtilaf hota, isi liye yahan bhi farmaya ke ise sirf aqalmand hi samajhte hain jo is par gaur-o-tadabbur karein, jo sahih salim aqal wale hon jin ke dimagh durust hon. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hota hai ke pukhta ilm wale kaun hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ki qasam sachi ho, jis ki zaban rast-go ho, jis ka dil salamat ho, jis ka pet haram se bacha ho aur jis ki sharm-gah zinakari se mehfooz ho, woh mazboot ilm wale hain (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur hadith mein hai ke aap ne chand logon ko dekha ke woh Quran Sharif ke bare mein lad-jhagad rahe hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno tum se pehle log bhi isi mein halak hue ke unhon ne Kitabullah ki ayaton ko ek dusre ke khilaf bata kar ikhtilaf kiya halankeh Kitabullah ki har ayat ek dusre ki tasdeeq karti hai, tum un mein ikhtilaf paida karke ek ko dusri ke mutazad na kaho, jo jano wahi kaho aur jo nahin jano use janne walon ko saunp do (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur hadith mein hai ke Quran saat harfon par utra, Quran mein jhagadna kufr hai, Quran mein ikhtilaf aur tazad paida karna kufr hai, jo jano us par amal karo, jo na jano use janne wale ki taraf saunpo Jalla Jalaluhu (Abu Ya'la). Rasikh fil-ilm kaun? Nafi bin Yazeed kehte hain Rasikh fil-ilm woh log hain jo mutawazi hon jo aajizi karne wale hon, Rabb ki raza ke talib hon, apne se badon se mar'oob na hon, apne se chhote ko haqeer samajhne wale na hon.

Phir farmaya ke yeh sab dua karte hain ke hamare dilon ko hidayat par jamane ke baad unhein un logon ke dilon ki tarah na kar jo mutashabeh ke peeche par kar barbad ho jate hain, balkeh hamain apni Sirat-e-Mustaqeem par qaim rakh aur apne mazboot deen par da'im rakh, hum par apni rahmat nazil farma, hamare dilon ko qarar de, hum se gandagi ko door kar, hamare iman-o-yaqeen ko barha, tu bahut bada dene wala hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) dua manga karte the, hadith: (Ya Muqallibal Quloobi thabbit qalbi ala deenik) - Ae dilon ke pherne wale! Mere dil ko apne deen par jama hua rakh. Phir yeh dua "Rabbana la tuzigh" parhte aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) bakasrat yeh dua parhte the, hadith: (Allahumma Muqallibal Quloobi thabbit qalbi ala deenik). Hazrat Asma (R.A) ne ek din poocha, kya dil ulat-palat ho jata hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, haan, har insan ka dil Allah Ta'ala ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke darmiyan hai, agar chahe qaim rakhe, agar chahe pher de. Hamari dua hai hamara Rab dilon ko hidayat ke baad tedha na kar de aur hamain apne paas se rahmatain inayat farmaye, woh bahut zyada dene wala hai. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke main ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mujhe koi aisi dua sikhaiye ke main apne liye manga karoon, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh dua mang: (Hadith: Allahumma Rabba Muhammadin-Nabi, ighfirli dhanbi wa adhhib ghaiza qalbi wa ajirni min mudillatil fitan) - Ae Allah! Ae Muhammad (ﷺ) Nabi ke Rab! Mere gunah maaf farma, mere dil ka gussa aur ranj aur sakhti door kar aur mujhe gumrah karne wale fitnon se bacha le. Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa (R.A) ne bhi Aap (ﷺ) ki dua "Ya Muqallibal Quloob" sun kar Hazrat Asma (R.A) ki tarah main ne bhi yahi sawal kiya aur Aap (ﷺ) ne wahi jawab diya aur phir Quran ki yeh dua sunai. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai lekin Qurani ayat ki tilawat ke baghair yahi Bukhari Muslim mein bhi marwi hai. Aur Nasai mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) jab raat ko jagte to yeh dua parhte: (Hadith: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka astaghfiruka lidhanbi wa as'aluka rahmatan, Allahumma zidni ilma wala tuzigh ba'da idh hadaitani wahab li min ladunka rahmatan innaka antal Wahhab) - Ae Allah! Tere siwa koi mabood nahin, main tujh se apne gunahon ki bakhshish mangta hoon aur tujh se teri rahmat ka sawal karta hoon, Allah mere ilm mein ziyadati farma aur mere dil ko tu ne hidayat de di hai ise gumrah na karna aur mujhe apne paas ki rahmat bakhsh, tu bahut zyada dene wala hai. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne Maghrib ki namaz parhai, pehli do rakaton mein Alhamd-e-Sharif ke baad mufassal ki choti si do suratein parhin aur teesri rakat mein Surah Alhamd-e-Sharif ke baad yahi ayat parhi. Abu Abdullah Sabalji farmate hain main us waqt un ke qareeb chala gaya tha, yahan tak ke mere kapde un ke kapdon se mil gaye the aur main ne khud apne kaan se Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ko yeh parhte hue suna (Abdur Razzaq). Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne jab tak yeh hadith nahin suni thi, Aap (R.H) us rakat mein "Qul huwallahu" parha karte the lekin yeh hadith sunne ke baad Ameer-ul-Momineen ne bhi isi ko parhna shuru kiya aur kabhi tark nahin kiya.

Phir farmaya woh yeh bhi kehte hain ke Aye Allah! Tu Qayamat ke din apni tamam makhlooq ko jama karne wala hai aur un mein faisle aur hukm karne wala hai, un ke ikhtilafat ko sametne wala hai aur har ek ko bhale bure amal ka badla dene wala hai, us din ke aane mein aur Tere wadon ke sache hone mein koi shak nahin.

Hamari samajh se buland ayaat yahan yeh bayan ho raha hai ke Quran mein aisi ayatein bhi hain jin ka bayan bahut wazeh bilkul saaf aur seedha hai. Har shakhs is ke matlab ko samajh sakta hai, aur baaz ayatein aisi bhi hain jin ke matlab tak aam zehnon ki rasai nahin hosakti, ab jo log na samajh mein aane wali ayaton ke mafhoom ko pehli qisam ki ayaton ki roshni mein samajh lein yani jis masla ki sarahat jis ayat mein payein le lein, woh to rasti par hain aur jo saaf aur sareeh ayaton ko chhod kar aisi ayaton ko daleel banayein jo un ke fehm se balatar hain, un mein ulajh jayein to munh ke bal gir padein, Umm-ul-Kitab yani Kitabullah asal usoolon ki woh saaf aur wazeh ayatein hain, shak-o-shuba mein na pado aur khule ahkaam par amal karo inhi ko faisla karne wali mano aur jo na samajh mein aaye use bhi un se hi samjho, baaz aur ayatein aisi bhi hain ke ek maani to un ka aisa nikalta hai jo zahir ayaton ke mutabiq ho aur is ke siwa aur maani bhi nikalte hain, go woh harf lafz aur tarkeeb ke aitbar se waqai taur par na ho to un ghair zahir maanon mein na phanso, Muhkam aur Mutashabih ke bahut se maani aslaf se manqool hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A to farmate hain ke Muhkamat woh hain jo nasikh hon jin mein halal haram ahkaam hukm mamnooaat haddein aur aamaal ka bayan ho, isi tarah aap se yeh bhi marwi hai (Ayat: Qul ta'alau atlu ma harrama Rabbukum alaikum... al-kh), aur is ke baad ke ahkamaat wali aur (Ayat: Wa qada Rabbuka alla ta'budu... al-kh), aur is ke baad ki teen ayatein Muhkamat se hain, Hazrat Abu Fakhita farmate hain suraton ke shuru mein faraiz aur ahkaam aur rok tok aur halal-o-haram ki ayatein hain, Saeed bin Jubair kehte hain inhe Asl-e-Kitab is liye kaha jata hai ke yeh tamam kitabon mein hain, Hazrat Muqatil kehte hain is liye ke tamam mazhab wale inhe maante hain, Mutashabihat un ayaton ko kehte hain jo mansookh hain aur jo pehle aur baad ki hain aur jin mein misalein di gayi hain aur qasmein khayi gayi hain aur jin par sirf iman laya jata hai aur amal ke liye woh ahkaam nahin, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bhi yahi farman hai Hazrat Muqatil farmate hain is se murad suraton ke shuru ke Huroof-e-Muqatta'at hain. Hazrat Mujahid ka qaul yeh hai ke ek dusre ki tasdeeq karne wali hain, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Kitaban mutashabihan mathani) (Surah Az-Zumar: 23) aur Mathani woh hai jahan do muqabil ki cheezon ka zikr ho jaise jannat dozakh ki sifat, nekon aur badon ka haal waghera waghera. Is ayat mein Mutashabih Muhkam ke muqabla mein is liye theek matlab wahi hai jo hum ne pehle bayan kiya aur Hazrat Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar ka yahi farman hai, farmate hain yeh Rabb ki hujjat hai in mein bandon ka bachao hai, jhagron ka faisla hai, batil ka khatma hai, inhe un ke sahih aur asal matlab se koi ghuma nahin sakta na un ke maani mein her-pher karsakta hai. Mutashabihat ki sachai mein kalam nahin in mein tasarruf-o-taweel nahin karni chahiye.

In se Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke iman ko aazmata hai jaise halal haram se aazmata hai, unhein batil ki taraf le jana aur haq se pherna chahiye. Phir farmata hai ke jin ke dilon mein kaji, tedh-pan, gumrahi aur haq se batil ki taraf hi hai woh toh mutashabih aayaton ko le kar apne badtareen maqasid ko pura karna chahte hain aur lafzi ikhtilaf se najayaz faida utha kar apne mazmoom maqasid ki taraf mod lete hain aur jo muhkam aayatein hain un mein un ka woh maqsad pura nahin hota. Kyunke un ke alfaaz bilkul saaf aur khule hue hote hain na woh unhein hata sakte hain na un se apne liye koi daleel hasil kar sakte hain. Isi liye farman hai ke is se un ka maqsad fitna ki talash hoti hai taake apne manne walon ko behkayein, apni bid'aton ki mudafat karein jaisa ke Isaiyon ne Quran ke alfaaz 'Ruhullah' aur 'Kalimatullah' se Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke Allah ka ladka hone ki daleel li hai. Pas is mutashabih aayat ko le kar saaf aayat jis mein yeh lafz hain ke (Aayat: In huwa illa 'abdun..., yani Hazrat Isa Allah ke ghulam hain, jin par Allah ka in'am hai, aur jagah hai aayat: Inna masala 'Isa 'indallahi kamasali Adama) (3. Surah Al-Imran: 59) yani Hazrat Isa ki misaal Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki tarah hai ke unhein Allah ne mitti se paida kiya phir use kaha ke ho ja, woh ho gaya, chunancha isi tarah ki aur bhi bahut si sarih aayatein hain un sab ko chhod diya aur mutashabih aayaton se Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke Allah ka beta hone par daleel le li halanke aap Allah ki makhlooq hain, Allah ke bande hain, us ke Rasool hain. Phir farmata hai ke un ki dusri garz aayat ki tahrif hoti hai taake use apni jagah se hata kar mafhoom badal lein, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat padh kar farmaya ke jab tum un logon ko dekho jo mutashabih aayaton mein jhagadte hain toh unhein chhod do, aise hi log is aayat mein murad liye gaye hain. Is mein ikhtilaf hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) to farmate hain tafseer chaar qisam ki hai, ek woh jis ke samajhne mein kisi ko mushkil nahin, ek woh jise Arab apne lughat se samajhte hain, ek woh jise jayyid ulama aur poore ilm wale hi jante hain aur ek woh jise bajuz Zaat-e-Ilahi ke aur koi nahin janta. Yeh riwayat pehle bhi guzar chuki hai, Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ka bhi yahi qaul hai, Mu'jam-e-Kabeer mein hadith hai ke mujhe apni ummat par sirf teen baton ka dar hai. Maal ki kasrat ka jis se hasad-o-bughz paida hoga aur aapas ki ladai shuru hogi, doosra yeh ke Kitabullah ki ta'weel ka silsila shuru hoga halanke asli matlab un ka Allah Ta'ala hi janta hai aur ahl-e-ilm wale kahenge ke hamara is par imaan hai.

Teesre yeh ke ilm hasil karne ke baad use be-parwahi se zaya kar denge, yeh hadith bilkul ghareeb hai aur hadith mein hai ke Quran is liye nahin utra ke ek aayat dusri aayat ki mukhalif ho, jis ka tumhein ilm ho aur us par amal karo aur jo mutashabeh hon un par imaan lao (Ibn Marduyah). Ibn Abbas, Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz aur Hazrat Malik bin Anas se bhi yahi marwi hai ke bade se bade aalim bhi is ki haqeeqat se aagah nahin hote, haan is par imaan rakhte hain. Ibn Masood farmate hain ke pukhta ilm wale yahi kehte hain is ki taweel ka ilm Allah hi ko hai ke is par hamara imaan hai. Ubayy bin Ka'ab bhi yahi farmate hain, Imam Ibn Jareer bhi isi se ittefaq karte hain, yeh to thi woh jamaat jo 'Illallah' par waqf karti thi aur baad ke jumla ko is se alag karti thi, kuch log yahan nahin theherte aur 'fil-ilm' par waqf karte hain, aksar mufassireen aur ahl-e-usool bhi yahi kehte hain, un ki badi daleel yeh hai ke jo samajh mein na aaye us baat ka theek nahin, Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmaya karte the main un rasikh ulama mein hoon jo taweel jaante hain, Mujahid farmate hain rasikh ilm wale tafseer jaante hain, Hazrat Muhammad bin Jafar bin Zubair farmate hain ke asal tafseer aur muraad Allah hi jaanta hai aur mazboot ilm wale kehte hain ke hum is par imaan laye phir mutashabihat aayaton ki tafseer muhkamat ki roshni mein karte hain jin mein kisi ko baat karne ki gunjaish nahin rehti, Quran ke mazameen theek thaak samajh mein aate hain daleel wazeh hoti hai, uzr zahir hojata hai, baatil chhat jata hai aur kufr dafa hojata hai, hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas ke liye dua ki ke Aye Allah inhe deen ki samajh de aur tafseer ka ilm de. Baaz ulama ne tafseel se baat karte hue kaha hai, Quran-e-Kareem mein taweel do ma'ani mein aayi hai, ek ma'ani jin se mafhoom ki asli haqeeqat aur asliyat ki nishandahi hoti hai, jaise Quran mein hai (Yaa abati haaza ta'weelu ru'yaaya min qablu qad ja'alahaa Rabbee haqqaa) (Yusuf: 100) mere baap mere khwab ki yahi ta'beer hai, aur jagah hai aayat (Hal yanzuroona illaa ta'weelahu yawma ya'tee ta'weeluhu yaqoolul-lazeena nasoohu min qablu qad jaa'at rusulu Rabbinaa bil-haqq) (Al-A'raf: 53) kafiron ke intezar ki had haqeeqat ke zahir hone tak hai aur yeh din woh hoga jab haqeeqat sachai ki gawah ban kar namoodar hogi, pas in dono jagah par taweel se muraad haqeeqat hai, agar is aayat-e-mubaraka mein taweel se muraad yahi taweel li jaye to 'Illallah' par waqf zaroori hai is liye ke tamam kaamon ki haqeeqat aur asliyat bajuz zaat-e-paak ke aur koi nahin jaanta to 'Rasikhuna fil-ilm' mubtada hoga aur 'yaqooloona aamannaa bihi' khabar hogi aur yeh jumla bilkul alag hoga aur taweel ke dusre ma'ani tafseer aur bayan aur hai aur ek shai ki ta'beer dusri shai hai, jaise Quran mein hai aayat (Nabbi'naa bita'weelihee) (Yusuf: 36).

(Yusuf: 36) Hamein is ki ta'weel batao yani tafseer aur bayan, agar ayat-e-mazkoorah mein ta'weel se yeh murad li jaye toh 'fil-ilm' par waqf karna chahiye, is liye ke pukhta ilm wale ulama jante hain aur samajhte hain kyunke khitab unhi se hai, go haqaiq ka ilm unhein bhi nahin, toh is bina par 'amanna bihi' haal hoga aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke baghair ma'toof alaih ke ma'toof ho, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (LIL-FUQARA'IL-MUHAJIRINALLAZINA UKHRIJU MIN DIYARIHIM) (Al-Hashr: 8) se (YAQULUNA RABBANA-GHFIR LANA WA LI-IKHWANINALLAZINA SABAQUNA BIL-IMANI WA LA TAJ'AL FI QULUBINA GHILLAL-LILLAZINA AMANU RABBANA INNAKA RA'UFUR-RAHIM) (Al-Hashr: 10) tak. Dusri jagah hai ayat (WA JA'A RABBUKA WAL-MALAKU SAFFAN SAFFA) (Al-Fajr: 22) yani wa ja'al-mala'ikatu sufufan sufufa aur un ki taraf se yeh khabar ke hum is par iman laye is ke yeh ma'ni honge ke mutashabih par iman laye, phir iqrar karte hain ke yeh sab yani muhkam aur mutashabih haq aur sach hai aur yani har ek dusre ki tasdeeq karta hai aur gawahi deta hai ke yeh sab Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai is mein koi ikhtilaf aur tazad nahin, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (AFALA YATADABBARUNAL-QUR'ANA WALAW KANA MIN 'INDI GHAIRILLAHI LAWAJADU FIHI IKHTILAFAN KATHIRA) (An-Nisa: 82) yani kya yeh log Quran mein gaur-o-fikr nahin karte, agar yeh Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki taraf se hota toh is mein bahut sa ikhtilaf hota, isi liye yahan bhi farmaya ke ise sirf aqalmand hi samajhte hain jo is par gaur-o-tadabbur karein, jo sahih salim aqal wale hon jin ke dimagh durust hon. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hota hai ke pukhta ilm wale kaun hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ki qasam sachi ho, jis ki zaban rast-go ho, jis ka dil salamat ho, jis ka pet haram se bacha ho aur jis ki sharm-gah zinakari se mehfooz ho, woh mazboot ilm wale hain (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur hadith mein hai ke aap ne chand logon ko dekha ke woh Quran Sharif ke bare mein lad-jhagad rahe hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno tum se pehle log bhi isi mein halak hue ke unhon ne Kitabullah ki ayaton ko ek dusre ke khilaf bata kar ikhtilaf kiya halankeh Kitabullah ki har ayat ek dusre ki tasdeeq karti hai, tum un mein ikhtilaf paida karke ek ko dusri ke mutazad na kaho, jo jano wahi kaho aur jo nahin jano use janne walon ko saunp do (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur hadith mein hai ke Quran saat harfon par utra, Quran mein jhagadna kufr hai, Quran mein ikhtilaf aur tazad paida karna kufr hai, jo jano us par amal karo, jo na jano use janne wale ki taraf saunpo Jalla Jalaluhu (Abu Ya'la). Rasikh fil-ilm kaun? Nafi bin Yazeed kehte hain Rasikh fil-ilm woh log hain jo mutawazi hon jo aajizi karne wale hon, Rabb ki raza ke talib hon, apne se badon se mar'oob na hon, apne se chhote ko haqeer samajhne wale na hon.

Phir farmaya ke yeh sab dua karte hain ke hamare dilon ko hidayat par jamane ke baad unhein un logon ke dilon ki tarah na kar jo mutashabeh ke peeche par kar barbad ho jate hain, balkeh hamain apni Sirat-e-Mustaqeem par qaim rakh aur apne mazboot deen par da'im rakh, hum par apni rahmat nazil farma, hamare dilon ko qarar de, hum se gandagi ko door kar, hamare iman-o-yaqeen ko barha, tu bahut bada dene wala hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) dua manga karte the, hadith: (Ya Muqallibal Quloobi thabbit qalbi ala deenik) - Ae dilon ke pherne wale! Mere dil ko apne deen par jama hua rakh. Phir yeh dua "Rabbana la tuzigh" parhte aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) bakasrat yeh dua parhte the, hadith: (Allahumma Muqallibal Quloobi thabbit qalbi ala deenik). Hazrat Asma (R.A) ne ek din poocha, kya dil ulat-palat ho jata hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, haan, har insan ka dil Allah Ta'ala ki ungliyon mein se do ungliyon ke darmiyan hai, agar chahe qaim rakhe, agar chahe pher de. Hamari dua hai hamara Rab dilon ko hidayat ke baad tedha na kar de aur hamain apne paas se rahmatain inayat farmaye, woh bahut zyada dene wala hai. Ek riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke main ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mujhe koi aisi dua sikhaiye ke main apne liye manga karoon, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh dua mang: (Hadith: Allahumma Rabba Muhammadin-Nabi, ighfirli dhanbi wa adhhib ghaiza qalbi wa ajirni min mudillatil fitan) - Ae Allah! Ae Muhammad (ﷺ) Nabi ke Rab! Mere gunah maaf farma, mere dil ka gussa aur ranj aur sakhti door kar aur mujhe gumrah karne wale fitnon se bacha le. Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa (R.A) ne bhi Aap (ﷺ) ki dua "Ya Muqallibal Quloob" sun kar Hazrat Asma (R.A) ki tarah main ne bhi yahi sawal kiya aur Aap (ﷺ) ne wahi jawab diya aur phir Quran ki yeh dua sunai. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai lekin Qurani ayat ki tilawat ke baghair yahi Bukhari Muslim mein bhi marwi hai. Aur Nasai mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) jab raat ko jagte to yeh dua parhte: (Hadith: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka astaghfiruka lidhanbi wa as'aluka rahmatan, Allahumma zidni ilma wala tuzigh ba'da idh hadaitani wahab li min ladunka rahmatan innaka antal Wahhab) - Ae Allah! Tere siwa koi mabood nahin, main tujh se apne gunahon ki bakhshish mangta hoon aur tujh se teri rahmat ka sawal karta hoon, Allah mere ilm mein ziyadati farma aur mere dil ko tu ne hidayat de di hai ise gumrah na karna aur mujhe apne paas ki rahmat bakhsh, tu bahut zyada dene wala hai. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne Maghrib ki namaz parhai, pehli do rakaton mein Alhamd-e-Sharif ke baad mufassal ki choti si do suratein parhin aur teesri rakat mein Surah Alhamd-e-Sharif ke baad yahi ayat parhi. Abu Abdullah Sabalji farmate hain main us waqt un ke qareeb chala gaya tha, yahan tak ke mere kapde un ke kapdon se mil gaye the aur main ne khud apne kaan se Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ko yeh parhte hue suna (Abdur Razzaq). Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne jab tak yeh hadith nahin suni thi, Aap (R.H) us rakat mein "Qul huwallahu" parha karte the lekin yeh hadith sunne ke baad Ameer-ul-Momineen ne bhi isi ko parhna shuru kiya aur kabhi tark nahin kiya.

Phir farmaya woh yeh bhi kehte hain ke Aye Allah! Tu Qayamat ke din apni tamam makhlooq ko jama karne wala hai aur un mein faisle aur hukm karne wala hai, un ke ikhtilafat ko sametne wala hai aur har ek ko bhale bure amal ka badla dene wala hai, us din ke aane mein aur Tere wadon ke sache hone mein koi shak nahin.

Jahannam ka indhan kaun log? Farmata hai ke kafir jahannam ki bhattiyan aur is mein jalne wali lakriyan hain, in zalimon ko us din koi uzr-e-ma'zarat un ke kaam na aayegi, un par la'nat hai, aur un ke liye bura ghar hai, un ke maal un ki auladein bhi unhein kuch faida nahin pahuncha sakengi, Allah ke azab se nahin bacha sakengi, jaisa aur jagah farmaya aayat (Afala yatadabbarunal Qur'ana walau kana min 'indi ghairillahi lawajadu fihi ikhtilafan kathira) (Surah An-Nisa: 82) to un ke maal-o-aulad par ta'ajjub na karna is ki wajah se Allah ka irada unhein duniya mein bhi azab dena hai, un ki jaanein kufr mein hi niklengi, isi tarah irshad hai kafiron ka shahron mein ghoomna ghamna tujhe fareb mein na daal de, yeh to mukhtasar sa faida hai, phir un ki jagah jahannam hi hai jo badtareen bichhona hai, isi tarah yahan bhi farman hai ke Allah ki kitabon ko jhutlane wale us ke rasoolon ke munkir us ki kitab ke mukhalif us ki wahi ke nafarman apni aulad aur apne maal se koi bhalai ki tawaqqa na rakhein, yeh jahannam ki lakriyan hain jin se jahannam sulgai aur bharkai jayegi, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Innakum wa ma ta'buduna min dunillahi hasabu jahannam) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 98) tum aur tumhare mabood jahannam ki lakriyan ho, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ki walida sahiba Hazrat Umm-e-Fazl ka bayan hai ke Makkah Sharif mein ek raat Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khare ho gaye aur ba-awaz-e-buland farmane lage, logo! Kya main ne Allah ki baatein tum tak pahuncha dein? Logo! Kya main ne tabligh ka haq ada kar diya? Logo! Kya main wahdaniyat-o-risalat ka matlab tumhein samjha chuka? Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmane lage haan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) beshak aap ne Allah ka deen hamein pahunchaya phir jab subah hui to aap ne farmaya suno Allah ki qasam Islam ghalib hoga aur khoob phaile ga, yahan tak ke kufr apni jagah ja chhupe ga, musalman Islam apne qaul-o-amal mein liye samundaron ko cheerte pharte nikal jayenge aur Islam ki isha'at karenge, yaad rakho woh zamana bhi aane wala hai ke log Quran ko seekhenge parhenge (phir takabbur burai aur andhe pan ke taur par) kehne lagenge hum qari hain, aalim hain, kaun hai jo hum se barh charh kar ho? Kya in logon mein kuch bhi bhalai hogi? Logon ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh kaun log hain, aap ne farmaya woh tum hi musalmanon mein se honge lekin khayal rahe ke woh jahannam ka indhan hain, Ibn-e-Marduyah mein bhi yeh hadith hai, is mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne jawab mein kaha haan haan Allah ki qasam aap ne bari hirs aur chahat se tabligh ki, aap ne poori jaddo-jehad aur daur dhoop ki, aap ne hamari zabardast khair-khwahi ki aur behtari chahi.

Phir farmata hai jaisa haal Firaunon ka tha aur jaise kartoot un ke thay, lafz 'daab' hamza ke jazm se bhi aata hai aur hamza ke zabar se bhi aata hai, jaisa 'nahr' aur 'nahar', is ke ma'ani shaan, aadat, haal, tariqe ke aate hain, Imra-ul-Qais ke sheron mein bhi yeh lafz isi ma'ani mein aaya hai, matlab is aayat-e-sharifa ka yeh hai ke kuffar ka maal-o-aulad Allah ke haan kuch kaam na aayega jaise Firaunon aur un se agle kuffar ko kuch kaam na aaya, Allah ki pakad sakht hai us ka azaab dardnaak hai, koi kisi taqat se bhi us se bach nahin sakta na use rok sakta hai, woh Allah jo chahe karta hai, har cheez us ke saamne haqeer hai, na us ke siwa koi mabood na Rab.

Awwaleen ma'arka-e-Haq-o-Batil. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ) kafiron se keh dijiye ke tum duniya mein bhi zaleel-o-maghloob kiye jaoge, haroge, matahat banoge aur Qayamat ke din bhi haank kar Jahannam mein jama kiye jaoge jo badtareen bichhona hai. Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai ke jab Badr ki jang se Huzoor (ﷺ) muzaffar-o-mansoor wapas hue to Banu Qainuqa ke bazaar mein Yahudiyon ko jama kiya aur farmaya! Is se pehle ke Quraish ki tarah tumhein bhi zillat-o-pasti dekhna pade Islam qabool karlo, to is sarkash jamaat ne jawab diya ke chand Quraishiyon ko jo funoon-e-jang se na-ashna thay, aap ne unhein hara liya aur dimagh mein ghuroor sama gaya, agar hum se ladai hui to hum batadenge ke ladne wale aise hote hain, aap ko abhi tak hum se pala hi nahin pada. Is par yeh aayat utri aur farmaya gaya Fatah-e-Badr ne zahir kardiya hai ke Allah apne sachay achay aur pasandeeda deen ko aur is deen walon ko izzat-o-hurmat ata farmane wala hai, woh apne Rasool (ﷺ) ka aur aap ki itaat-guzar ummat ka khud madadgar hai. Woh apni baton ko zahir aur ghalib karne wala hai. Do jamaatein ladai mein ghutham-gutha ho gayi thin, ek Sahaba-e-Kiram ki aur dusri Mushrikeen-e-Quraish ki, yeh waqia jang-e-Badr ka hai, us din mushrikeen par is qadar ra'ab ghalib aaya aur Allah ne apne bandon ki is tarah madad ki go Musalman ginti mein mushrikeen se kahin kam thay lekin mushrikon ko apne se dugnay nazar aate thay, mushrikon ne ladai shuru hone se pehle hi jasusi ke liye Umair bin Sa'ad ko bheja tha jis ne aakar ittila di thi ke teen sau hain, kuch kam ya zaid hon aur waqia bhi yahi tha ke sirf teen sau das aur kuch thay lekin ladai ke shuru hote hi Allah Azzawajal ne apne khas aur chida farishtay ek hazar bheje. Ek ma'ani to yeh hain, dusra matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke Musalman dekhte thay aur jante thay ke kafir hum se duchand hain, phir bhi Allah Azzawajal ne inhi ki madad ki. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Badri Sahaba teen sau terah thay aur mushrikeen chhe sau solah thay. Lekin tawareekh ki kitabon mein mushrikeen ki tadaad nau sau se ek hazar tak bayan ki gayi hai, ho sakta hai Hazrat Abdullah ka Quran ke alfaaz se yeh istidlal ho ke Ibn-ul-Hajjaj Qabliya ka jo siyah-faam ghulam pakda hua aaya tha us se jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ne pucha ke Quraish ki tadaad kitni hai? Us ne kaha bahut hain, aap ne phir pucha achha roz kitne oont kat-te hain, us ne kaha ek din nau dusre din das, aap ne farmaya bas to un ki ginti nau sau aur ek hazar ke darmiyan hai. Pas mushrikeen Musalmanon se teen gunay thay wallahu a'alam, lekin yeh yaad rahe ke Arab keh diya karte hain ke mere paas ek hazar to hain lekin mujhe zaroorat aise hi dugna ki hai is se murad un ki teen hazar hoti hai.

Ab koi mushkil baqi na rahi, lekin ek aur sawal hai woh yeh ke Quran-e-Karim mein aur jagah hai aayat (Wa iz yureekumoohum iziltaqaitum fee a'yunikum qaleelan wa yuqallilukum fee a'yunihim liyaqdiyallahu amran kana maf'oola) (Surah Al-Anfal: 44) yani jab aamne samne aagaye toh Allah ne unhein tumhari nigahon ke samne kam karke dikhaya aur tumhein un ki nigahon mein zyada karke dikhaya taake jo kaam karne ka faisla Allah kar chuka tha woh hojaye. Pas is aayat se maloom hota hai ke asal tadaad se bhi kam nazar aaye aur mandaraja bala aayat se maloom hota hai ke zyada balkay dugne nazar aaye. Toh dono aayaton mein tatbeeq kya hogi? Is ka jawab yeh hai ke is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool aur tha aur is ka waqt aur tha, Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain ke Badr wale din hamein mushrikeen kuch zyada nahin lage, hum ne gaur se dekha phir bhi yahi maloom hua ke hum se un ki ginti zyada nahin, dusri riwayat mein hai ke mushrikeen ki tadaad is qadar kam maloom hui ke main ne apne paas ke ek shakhs se kaha ke yeh log toh koi sattar honge, us ne kaha nahin nahin sau honge, jab un mein se ek shakhs pakda gaya toh hum ne us se mushrikeen ki ginti poochhi, us ne kaha ek hazaar hain. Ab jabke dono fareeq ek dusre ke samne safein baandh kar khade hogaye toh musalmanon ko yeh maloom hone laga ke mushrikeen hum se dugne hain. Yeh is liye ke unhein apni kamzori ka yaqeen hojaye aur yeh Allah par poora bharosa kar lein aur tamam tar tawajjah Allah ki janib pher lein aur apne Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal se iaanat aur imdad ki duayein karne lagein, theek isi tarah mushrikeen ko musalmanon ki tadaad dugni maloom hone lagi taake un ke dilon mein ra'ab aur khauf baith jaye aur ghabrahat aur pareshani badh jaye, phir jab dono bhid gaye aur ladai hone lagi toh har fareeq dusre ko apni nisbat kam nazar aane laga taake ek dil khol kar hausla nikale aur Allah Ta'ala haq-o-batil ka saaf faisla karde, iman-o-kufr-o-tughyan par ghalib aajaye. Mominon ko izzat aur kafiron ko zillat mil jaye, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Walaqad nasarakumullahu bi-Badrin wa antum azillah) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 123) yani albatta Allah Ta'ala ne Badr wale din tumhari madad ki halanke tum us waqt kamzor thay. Isi liye yahan bhi farmaya Allah jise chahe apni madad se taqatwar bana de, phir farmata hai is mein ibrat-o-nasihat hai us shakhs ke liye jo aankhon wala ho jis ka dimagh sahih-o-salim ho, woh Allah ke ahkaam ki baja-awari mein lag jayega aur samajh lega ke Allah apne pasandeeda bandon ko is jahan mein bhi madad karta hai aur Qayamat ke din bhi un ka bachao karega.

Awwaleen ma'arka-e-Haq-o-Batil. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ) kafiron se keh dijiye ke tum duniya mein bhi zaleel-o-maghloob kiye jaoge, haroge, matahat banoge aur Qayamat ke din bhi haank kar Jahannam mein jama kiye jaoge jo badtareen bichhona hai. Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai ke jab Badr ki jang se Huzoor (ﷺ) muzaffar-o-mansoor wapas hue to Banu Qainuqa ke bazaar mein Yahudiyon ko jama kiya aur farmaya! Is se pehle ke Quraish ki tarah tumhein bhi zillat-o-pasti dekhna pade Islam qabool karlo, to is sarkash jamaat ne jawab diya ke chand Quraishiyon ko jo funoon-e-jang se na-ashna thay, aap ne unhein hara liya aur dimagh mein ghuroor sama gaya, agar hum se ladai hui to hum batadenge ke ladne wale aise hote hain, aap ko abhi tak hum se pala hi nahin pada. Is par yeh aayat utri aur farmaya gaya Fatah-e-Badr ne zahir kardiya hai ke Allah apne sachay achay aur pasandeeda deen ko aur is deen walon ko izzat-o-hurmat ata farmane wala hai, woh apne Rasool (ﷺ) ka aur aap ki itaat-guzar ummat ka khud madadgar hai. Woh apni baton ko zahir aur ghalib karne wala hai. Do jamaatein ladai mein ghutham-gutha ho gayi thin, ek Sahaba-e-Kiram ki aur dusri Mushrikeen-e-Quraish ki, yeh waqia jang-e-Badr ka hai, us din mushrikeen par is qadar ra'ab ghalib aaya aur Allah ne apne bandon ki is tarah madad ki go Musalman ginti mein mushrikeen se kahin kam thay lekin mushrikon ko apne se dugnay nazar aate thay, mushrikon ne ladai shuru hone se pehle hi jasusi ke liye Umair bin Sa'ad ko bheja tha jis ne aakar ittila di thi ke teen sau hain, kuch kam ya zaid hon aur waqia bhi yahi tha ke sirf teen sau das aur kuch thay lekin ladai ke shuru hote hi Allah Azzawajal ne apne khas aur chida farishtay ek hazar bheje. Ek ma'ani to yeh hain, dusra matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke Musalman dekhte thay aur jante thay ke kafir hum se duchand hain, phir bhi Allah Azzawajal ne inhi ki madad ki. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Badri Sahaba teen sau terah thay aur mushrikeen chhe sau solah thay. Lekin tawareekh ki kitabon mein mushrikeen ki tadaad nau sau se ek hazar tak bayan ki gayi hai, ho sakta hai Hazrat Abdullah ka Quran ke alfaaz se yeh istidlal ho ke Ibn-ul-Hajjaj Qabliya ka jo siyah-faam ghulam pakda hua aaya tha us se jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ne pucha ke Quraish ki tadaad kitni hai? Us ne kaha bahut hain, aap ne phir pucha achha roz kitne oont kat-te hain, us ne kaha ek din nau dusre din das, aap ne farmaya bas to un ki ginti nau sau aur ek hazar ke darmiyan hai. Duniya ke husn aur Aakhirat ke jamal ka taqabul. Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke duniya ki zindagi ko tarah tarah ki lazzaton se sajaya gaya hai. In sab cheezon mein sab se pehle aurton ko bayan farmaya, is liye ke un ka fitna bada zabardast hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Main ne apne baad mardon ke liye aurton se zyada nuqsan deh aur koi fitna nahin chhora. Haan jab kisi shakhs ki niyat nikah karke zina se bachne ki aur aulad ki kasrat se ho to beshak yeh nek kaam hai, is ki raghbat shariyat ne dilayi hai aur is ka hukum diya hai aur bahut si hadeesain nikah karne balkay kasrat-e-nikah karne ki fazeelat mein aayi hain aur is ummat mein sab se behtar woh hai jo sab se zyada biwiyon wala ho. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Duniya ka ek faida hai aur is ka behtareen faida nek biwi hai ke khawand agar is ki taraf dekhe to yeh use khush karde aur agar hukum de to baja laye aur agar kahin chala jaye to apne nafs ki aur khawand ke maal ki hifazat kare. Dusri hadith mein hai: Mujhe aurtain aur khushbu bahut pasand hai aur meri aankhon ki thandak namaz mein hai. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain: Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sab se zyada mehboob aurtain thin, haan ghore un se bhi zyada pasand thay, ek aur riwayat mein hai: Ghoron se zyada aap ki chahat ki cheez koi aur na thi haan sirf aurtain. Sabit hua aurton ki mohabbat bhali bhi hai aur buri bhi. Isi tarah aulad ki, agar un ki kasrat is liye chahta hai ke woh fakhr-o-ghuroor kare to buri cheez hai aur agar is liye un ki zyadati chahta hai ke nasl barhay aur muwahhid musalmanon ki ginti ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein zyada ho to beshak yeh bhalai ki cheez hai. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai: Mohabbat karne waliyon aur zyada aulad paida karne wali aurton se nikah karo, Qayamat ke din main tumhari zyadati se aur ummaton par fakhr karne wala hoon. Theek isi tarah maal bhi hai ke agar in ki mohabbat giray paray logon ko haqeer samajhne aur maskeenon ghareebon par fakhr karne ke liye hai to behad buri cheez hai, aur agar maal ki chahat apnon aur ghairon se sulook karne, nekiyan karne aur Allah ki raah mein kharch karne ke liye hai to har tarah woh shar'an achi aur bahut achi cheez hai. Qintar ki miqdar mein mufassireen ka ikhtilaf hai, mahasil yeh hai ke bahut zyada maal ko qintar kehte hain, jaise Hazrat Zahhak ka qaul hai, aur aqwal bhi mulahiza hon: Ek hazar dinar, barah hazar, chalees hazar, sath hazar, sattar hazar, assi hazar waghera waghera. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai: Ek qintar barah hazar oqiya ka hai aur har oqiya behtar hai zameen-o-aasman se, ghaliban yahan miqdar-e-sawab ki bayan hui hai jo ek qintar mile ga (Wallahu A'lam). Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se bhi aisi hi ek mauqoof riwayat bhi marwi hai aur yahi zyada sahih hai.

Isi tarah Ibn-e-Jarir mein Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar se bhi marwi hai, aur Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah aur Hazrat Abu Darda se marwi hai ke qintar barah sau auqiya hain, Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek marfu' hadith mein sau auqiya aaye hain lekin woh hadith bhi munkar hai, mumkin hai ke woh Hazrat Ubay bin Ka'ab ka qaul ho jaise aur sahaba ka bhi yahi farman hai. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo shakhs sau aayatein parh le ghafilon mein nahin likha jayega aur jis ne sau se hazar tak parh lein use Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se ek qintar ajar milega, aur qintar baray pahar ke barabar hai, Mustadrak Hakim mein hi is aayat ke is lafz ka matlab Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se pucha gaya to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya do hazar auqiya, Imam Hakim ise sahih aur shart-e-Shaikhain par batlate hain. Bukhari Muslim ne ise naqal nahin kiya, Tabrani waghaira mein hai ek hazar dinar, Hazrat Hasan Basri se mauqufan ya mursalan marwi hai ke barah sau dinar, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se bhi marwi hai, Zahhak farmate hain ba'az Arab qintar ko barah sau ka batate hain, ba'az barah hazar ka, Hazrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri farmate hain bail ki khaal ke bhar jaane ke barabar sone ko qintar kehte hain. Yeh marfu'an bhi marwi hai lekin zyada sahih mauqufan hai, ghoron ki mohabbat teen qisam ki hai, ek to woh log jo ghoron ko paalte hain aur Allah ki raah mein un par sawar ho kar jihad karne ke liye nikalte hain, un ke liye to yeh bahut hi ajar-o-sawab ka sabab hain. Dusre woh jo fakhr-o-ghuroor ke taur par paalte hain, un ke liye wabaal hai, teesre woh jo sawal se bachne aur un ki nasl ki hifazat ke liye paalte hain aur Allah ka haq nahin bhoolte, yeh na ajar na azab ke mustahiq hain. Isi mazmoon ki hadith aayat "Wa a'iddu lahum" al-kh, ki tafsir mein aayegi Insha'Allah. "Musawwamah" ke ma'ani charne wala aur panj-kaliyan (ya'ni peshani aur chaar qadmon par nishan) waghaira ke hain, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain har Arabi ghora fajr ke waqt Allah ki ijazat se do duayein karta hai, kehta hai Aye Allah jis ke qabze mein tu ne mujhe diya hai tu us ke dil mein us ke ahl-o-maal se zyada meri mohabbat de, an'aam se murad oont, gaayein, bakriyan hain. Hars se murad woh zameen hai jo kheti bone ya baagh lagane ke liye taiyar ki jaye, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai insan ka behtareen maal zyada nasl wala ghora hai aur zyada phal-dar darakht khajoor hai. Phir farmaya ke yeh sab dunyawi faide ki cheezein hain, yahan ki zeenat aur yahan hi ki dilkashi ke saman hain jo fani aur zawal paane wale hain, achi lautne ki jagah aur behtareen sawab ka markaz Allah ke paas hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jab yeh aayat nazil hui to Hazrat Umar bin Khattab ne farmaya Aye Allah jabke tu ne ise zeenat de di to is ke baad kya?

Is par is ke baad wali aayat utri ke ae Nabi (ﷺ) aap in se keh dijiye ke main tumhein is se behtareen cheezein batata hoon, yeh toh ek na ek roz zail hone wali hain aur main jin ki taraf tumhein bula raha hoon woh sirf derpa hi nahin balkay hamesha rehne wali hain, suno Allah se darne walon ke liye jannat hai jis ke kinare kinare aur jis ke darakhton ke darmiyan qisam qisam ki nehrein beh rahi hain, kahin shehad ki, kahin doodh ki, kahin paak sharab ki, kahin nafees paani ki, aur woh ne'matein hain jo na kisi kaan ne suni hon na kisi aankh ne dekhi hon na kisi dil mein khayal bhi guzra ho, in jannaton mein yeh muttaqi log abdal-aabad rahenge na yeh nikale jayenge na unhein di hui ne'matein gum hongi na fana hongi, phir wahan biwiyan milengi jo mail-kuchail se khabasat aur burai se haiz aur nifas se gandagi aur paleedi se paak hain, har tarah suthri aur pakeeza, in sab se barh kar yeh ke Allah ki razamandi unhein hasil hojayegi aur aisi ke is ke baad narazgi ka khatka hi nahin, isi liye Surah Bara'at ki aayat mein farmaya "Wa Ridwanum Minallahi Akbar" Allah ki thori si razamandi ka hasil hojana bhi sab se bari cheez hai, yani tamam ne'maton se aala ne'mat raza-e-Rabb aur marzi-e-Maula hai. Tamam banday Allah ki nigah mein hain woh bakhoobi jaanta hai ke kaun meherbani ka mustahiq hai.
