Phir farmaya ke yeh sab dunyawi faide ki cheezein hain, yahan ki zeenat aur yahan hi ki dilkashi ke saman hain jo fani aur zawal paane wale hain, achi lautne ki jagah aur behtareen sawab ka markaz Allah ke paas hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jab yeh aayat nazil hui to Hazrat Umar bin Khattab ne farmaya Aye Allah jabke tu ne ise zeenat de di to is ke baad kya?

Is par is ke baad wali aayat utri ke ae Nabi (ﷺ) aap in se keh dijiye ke main tumhein is se behtareen cheezein batata hoon, yeh toh ek na ek roz zail hone wali hain aur main jin ki taraf tumhein bula raha hoon woh sirf derpa hi nahin balkay hamesha rehne wali hain, suno Allah se darne walon ke liye jannat hai jis ke kinare kinare aur jis ke darakhton ke darmiyan qisam qisam ki nehrein beh rahi hain, kahin shehad ki, kahin doodh ki, kahin paak sharab ki, kahin nafees paani ki, aur woh ne'matein hain jo na kisi kaan ne suni hon na kisi aankh ne dekhi hon na kisi dil mein khayal bhi guzra ho, in jannaton mein yeh muttaqi log abdal-aabad rahenge na yeh nikale jayenge na unhein di hui ne'matein gum hongi na fana hongi, phir wahan biwiyan milengi jo mail-kuchail se khabasat aur burai se haiz aur nifas se gandagi aur paleedi se paak hain, har tarah suthri aur pakeeza, in sab se barh kar yeh ke Allah ki razamandi unhein hasil hojayegi aur aisi ke is ke baad narazgi ka khatka hi nahin, isi liye Surah Bara'at ki aayat mein farmaya "Wa Ridwanum Minallahi Akbar" Allah ki thori si razamandi ka hasil hojana bhi sab se bari cheez hai, yani tamam ne'maton se aala ne'mat raza-e-Rabb aur marzi-e-Maula hai. Tamam banday Allah ki nigah mein hain woh bakhoobi jaanta hai ke kaun meherbani ka mustahiq hai.

Muttaqiyon ka ta'aruf: Allah Ta'ala apne muttaqi bandon ke ausaf bayan farmata hai ke woh kehte hain, "Aye Parwardigar! Hum tujh par aur teri Kitab par aur tere Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman laye, hamare is iman ke ba'is jo teri zaat aur teri shariat par hai, tu hamare gunahon ko apne fazl-o-karam se maaf farma aur hamain jahannam ke azab se nijat de." Yeh muttaqi log Allah ki ita'at baja late hain aur haram cheezon se alag rehte hain, sabr ke sahare kaam lete hain aur apne iman ke da'we mein bhi sache hain, kul achhe a'maal baja late hain khwah woh un ke nafs ko kitne bhari paren, ita'at aur khushu-o-khuzu wale hain, apne maal Allah ki rah mein jahan jahan hukm hai kharch karte hain, sila-rehmi mein rishtedari ka paas rakhne mein, buraiyon ke rokne, aapas mein hamdardi aur khairkhwahi karne mein, hajat-mandon, maskeenon aur faqiron ke sath ehsan karne mein sakhawat se kaam lete hain aur sehri ke waqt pichli raat ko uth uth kar istighfar karte hain. Is se maloom hua ke is waqt istighfar afzal hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Quran-e-Kareem ki is aayat mein Hazrat Yaqub (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne apne beton se yahi farmaya tha ke aayat (سَوْفَ اَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّيْ) (Yusuf: 98) "Rab main abhi thodi der mein tumhare liye apne Rab se bakhshish talab karunga," is se murad bhi sehri ka waqt hai, apni aulad se farmate hain ke sehri ke waqt mein tumhare liye istighfar karunga. Bukhari-o-Muslim wagaira ki hadith mein jo bahut se sahabiyon (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhum) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman majood hai ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala har raat aakhri tihai baqi rehte hue aasman-e-duniya par utarta hai aur farmata hai ke, "Koi sail hai? Jise main doon, koi dua mangne wala hai ke main us ki dua qabool karoon, koi istighfar karne wala hai ke main use bakhshoon." Hafiz Abu-ul-Hasan Darqutni (R.H / Rahimahullah) ne to is masle par ek mustaqil kitab likhi hai aur is mein hadith ki tamam sanadon ko aur is ke kul alfaaz ko warid kiya hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Ayesha (R.A / Razi Allahu Anha) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne awwal raat, darmiyani aur aakhri raat mein witr padhe hain, sab se aakhri waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke witr padhne ka sehri tak tha. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) raat ko tahajjud padhte rehte aur apne ghulam Hazrat Nafi (R.H / Rahimahullah) se puchte, "Kya sahar ho gayi?" Jab woh kehte, "Haan," to aap subh-e-sadiq ke nikalne tak dua-o-istighfar mein mashghool rehte. Hazrat Hatib (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain, "Sehri ke waqt main ne suna ke koi shakhs masjid ke kisi gosha mein keh raha hai, 'Aye Allah! Tu ne mujhe hukm kiya main baja laya, yeh sahar ka waqt hai mujhe bakhsh de,' main ne dekha to woh Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) the." Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain, "Hamain hukm kiya jata tha ke hum jab tahajjud ki namaz padhein to sehri ke aakhri waqt sattar martaba istighfar karein, Allah se bakhshish ki dua karein."

Allah Wahdahu La-Sharika apni wahdat ka khud shahid. Allah Ta'ala khud shahadat deta hai, bas uski shahadat kafi hai, woh sab se zyada sacha gawah hai, sab se zyada sachi baat usi ki hai. Woh farmata hai ke tamam makhlooq uski ghulam hai aur usi ki paida ki hui hai aur usi ki taraf mohtaj hai, woh sab se beniyaaz hai, uluhiyat mein Allah hone mein woh yakta aur la-sharika hai, uske siwa koi pooje jaane ke laiq nahin, jaise farman hai aayat (LAKINILLAHU YASH-HADU BIMA ANZALA ILAIKA ANZALAHU BI-ILMIHI) (Surah An-Nisa: 166) yani lekin Allah Ta'ala bazariya is kitab ke jo woh teri taraf apne ilm se utaar raha hai, gawahi de raha hai aur farishtay bhi gawahi dete hain aur Allah Ta'ala ki shahadat kafi hai, phir apni shahadat ke sath farishton ki shahadat par ulama ki gawahi ko mila raha hai. Yahan se ulama ki bahut badi fazeelat sabit hoti hai, balkay khusoosi 'Qaima' ka nasb haal hone ki wajah se hai, woh Allah har waqt aur haal mein aisa hi hai, phir takeedan dobara irshad hota hai ke mabood-e-haqiqi sirf wahi hai, woh ghalib hai, azmat aur kibriyai wali uski bargah hai, woh apne aqwal, af'aal aur shariyat, qudrat-o-taqdeer mein hikmaton wala hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Arafat mein is aayat ki tilawat ki aur 'Al-Hakim' tak padh kar farmaya: "Wa ana 'ala dhalika minash-shahideen ya Rabb." Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai aap ne yun farmaya: "Wa ana ash-hadu ayya Rabb." Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Ghalib Qattan farmate hain main Koofay mein tijarati gharz se gaya aur Hazrat A'mash ke qareeb thehra, raat ko Hazrat A'mash tahajjud ke liye khade hue, padhte padhte jab is aayat tak pahunche aur aayat (INNAD-DEENA 'INDALLAHIL ISLAM) (Surah Al-Imran: 19) padha to farmaya: "Wa ana ash-hadu bima shahadallahu bihi wa astawdi'ullaha hadhihish-shahadata wa hiya li 'indallahi wadee'atun" yani main bhi shahadat deta hoon uski jis ki shahadat Allah ne di aur main is shahadat ko Allah ke supurd karta hoon, yeh meri amanat Allah ke paas hai, phir kai dafa aayat (INNAD-DEENA 'INDALLAHIL ISLAM) (Surah Al-Imran: 19) padha, main ne apne dil mein khayal kiya ke shayad is baare mein koi hadith suni hogi, subah hi subah main hazir-e-khidmat hua aur arz kiya ke Abu Muhammad kya baat thi jo aap is aayat ko baar baar padhte rahe? Kaha kya is ki fazeelat tumhein maloom nahin? Main ne kaha Hazrat main to mahina bhar se aap ki khidmat mein hoon lekin aap ne hadith bayan hi nahin ki, kehne lage Allah ki qasam main to saal bhar tak bayan na karunga, ab main is hadith ke sunne ki khatir saal bhar tak thehra raha aur un ke darwaze par pada raha, jab saal-e-kamil guzar chuka to main ne kaha ae Abu Muhammad saal guzar chuka hai, sun mujh se Abu Wa'il ne hadith bayan ki, us ne Abdullah se suna, woh farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is ke padhne wale ko Qayamat ke din laya jayega aur Allah Azza-wa-Jal farmayega mere is banday ne mera ahd liya hai aur main ahd ko poora karne mein sab se afzal-o-a'la hoon, mere is banday ko jannat mein le jao.

Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai woh sirf Islam hi ko qabool farmata hai, Islam har zamane ke paighambar ki wahi ki tabedari ka naam hai, aur sab se aakhir aur sab rasoolon ko khatam karne wale hamare paighambar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) hain, aap ki nabuwwat ke baad nabuwwat ke sab raaste band ho gaye ab jo shakhs aap ki shariat ke siwa kisi cheez par amal kare Allah ke nazdeek woh sahib-e-iman nahin jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa man yabtaghi ghairal Islami deenan falan yuqbala minhu) (Surah Al-Imran: 85) jo shakhs Islam ke siwa aur deen ki talash kare woh us se qabool nahin kiya jaye ga, isi tarah is aayat mein deen ka inhisar Islam mein kar diya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki qirat mein (aayat shahidallahu annahu) hai aur annal Islama hai, toh ma'ani yeh honge, khud Allah ki gawahi hai aur us ke farishton aur zi-ilm insanon ke nazdeek maqbool hone wala deen sirf Islam hi hai, jamhoor ki qirat mein in zer ke sath hai aur ma'ani ke lihaz se dono hi theek hain, lekin jamhoor ka qaul zyada zahir hai wallahu a'alam. Phir irshad hota hai ke pehli kitab walon ne apne pak Allah ke paighambaron ke aane aur Allah ki kitabein nazil hone ke baad bhi ikhtilaf kiya, jis ki wajah se sirf un ka aapas ka bughz-o-inad tha ke main us ke khilaf hi chaloon chahe woh haq par hi kyun na ho, phir irshad hai ke jab Allah ki aayatein utar chuki, ab jo un ka inkar kare unhein na maane toh Allah Ta'ala bhi us se us ki takzeeb ka bohat jald hisab le ga aur Kitabullah ki mukhalifat ki wajah se usay sakht azab de ga aur usay us ki is shararat ka lutf chakhaye ga. Phir farmaya agar yeh log tujh se tauheed-e-bari Ta'ala ke bare mein jhagrein toh keh do ke main toh khalis Allah hi ki ibadat karoon ga jis ka na koi shareek hai na us jaisa koi hai, na us ki aulad hai na biwi aur jo mere ummati hain mere deen par hain. Un sab ka qaul bhi yahi hai, jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Qul hazihi sabeeli ad'oo ilallahi 'ala baseeratin ana wa manittaba'ani wa subhanallahi wa ma ana minal mushrikeen) (Surah Yusuf: 108) ya'ni meri raah yahi hai main khoob soch samajh kar dekh bhaal kar tumhein Allah ki taraf bula raha hoon, main bhi aur mere tabedar bhi yahi da'way de rahe hain, phir hukm deta hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ) Yahood-o-Nasara jin ke hathon mein Allah ki kitab hai aur mushrikeen se jo an-parh hain keh do ke tum sab ki hidayat Islam mein hi hai aur agar yeh na maane toh koi baat nahin, aap apna farz-e-tableegh ada kar chuke, Allah khud un se samajh le ga, un sab ko laut kar usi ke paas jana hai woh jisay seedha rasta dikhaye jisay chahe gumrah kar de, apni hikmat ko wohi khoob janta hai us ki hujjat toh poori ho kar hi rehti hai, us ki apne bandon par nazar hai usay khoob maloom hai ke hidayat ka mustahiq kaun hai aur kaun zalalat ka mustahiq hai? Us se koi baz-purs nahin kar sakta.

Dusri aayaton mein bhi saaf sarahat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) tamam makhlooq ki taraf Allah ke Nabi ban kar aaye hain, aur khud aap ke deen ke ahkaam bhi is par dalalat karte hain aur Kitab-o-Sunnat mein bhi bahut si aayatein aur hadeesein isi mafhoom ki hain, Quran-e-Pak mein ek jagah hai aayat (Qul ya ayyuhan-nasu inni Rasoolullahi ilaikum jami'anillazi lahu mulkus-samawati wal-ard) (Surah Al-A'raf: 158) logo main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka Rasool hoon. Aur aayat mein hai aayat (Tabarakallazi nazzalal-furqana 'ala 'abdihi liyakoona lil-'alamina nazira) (Surah Al-Furqan: 1) babarakat hai woh Allah jis ne apne bandon par Quran nazil farmaya taake woh tamam duniya walon ke liye tanbeeh karne wala ban jaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein kayi kayi waqiat se tawatur ke sath sabit hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne Arab-o-Ajam ke tamam badshahon ko aur dusre atraf ke logon ko khatoot bhajwaye jin mein unhein Allah ki taraf aane ki dawat di khwah woh Arab hon Ajam hon Ahl-e-Kitab hon mazhab wale hon aur is tarah aap (ﷺ) ne tableegh ke farz ko tamam-o-kamal tak pahuncha diya. Musnad-e-Abdur-Razzaq mein Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, is ummat mein se jis ke kaan mein meri nisbat ki aawaz pahunche aur woh meri layi hui cheez par iman na laye khwah Yahudi ho khwah Nasrani ho magar mujh par iman laye baghair mar jayega to qatan jahannami hoga, Muslim Shareef mein bhi yeh hadees marwi hai aur An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ka yeh farman bhi hai ke main har ek surkh-o-siyah ki taraf Allah ka Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon, ek aur hadees mein hai har Nabi sirf apni qoum ki taraf bheja jata raha aur main tamam insanon ke liye Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Anas (R.A) se marwi hai ke ek Yahudi ladka jo Nabi (ﷺ) ke liye wazu ka pani rakha karta tha aur jotiyan la kar rakh deta tha, bimar pad gaya. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) us ki bimar pursi ke liye tashreef laye, us waqt us ka baap us ke sarhane baitha hua tha, aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ae fulan La ilaha illallah keh, us ne apne baap ki taraf dekha aur baap ko khamosh dekh kar khud bhi chupka ho gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne dobara yahi farmaya us ne phir apne baap ki taraf dekha baap ne kaha Abul Qasim ki maan le (ﷺ) pas us bache ne kaha Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa annaka Rasoolullah wahan se yeh farmate hue uthe ke Allah ka shukr hai jis ne meri wajah se ise jahannam se bacha liya, yahi hadees Sahih Bukhari mein Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) bhi laye hain, un ke siwa aur bhi bahut si sahih hadeesein bhi aur Quran-e-Kareem ki aayatein hain.

Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai woh sirf Islam hi ko qabool farmata hai, Islam har zamane ke paighambar ki wahi ki tabedari ka naam hai, aur sab se aakhir aur sab rasoolon ko khatam karne wale hamare paighambar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) hain, aap ki nabuwwat ke baad nabuwwat ke sab raaste band ho gaye ab jo shakhs aap ki shariat ke siwa kisi cheez par amal kare Allah ke nazdeek woh sahib-e-iman nahin jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa man yabtaghi ghairal Islami deenan falan yuqbala minhu) (Surah Al-Imran: 85) jo shakhs Islam ke siwa aur deen ki talash kare woh us se qabool nahin kiya jaye ga, isi tarah is aayat mein deen ka inhisar Islam mein kar diya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki qirat mein (aayat shahidallahu annahu) hai aur annal Islama hai, toh ma'ani yeh honge, khud Allah ki gawahi hai aur us ke farishton aur zi-ilm insanon ke nazdeek maqbool hone wala deen sirf Islam hi hai, jamhoor ki qirat mein in zer ke sath hai aur ma'ani ke lihaz se dono hi theek hain, lekin jamhoor ka qaul zyada zahir hai wallahu a'alam. Phir irshad hota hai ke pehli kitab walon ne apne pak Allah ke paighambaron ke aane aur Allah ki kitabein nazil hone ke baad bhi ikhtilaf kiya, jis ki wajah se sirf un ka aapas ka bughz-o-inad tha ke main us ke khilaf hi chaloon chahe woh haq par hi kyun na ho, phir irshad hai ke jab Allah ki aayatein utar chuki, ab jo un ka inkar kare unhein na maane toh Allah Ta'ala bhi us se us ki takzeeb ka bohat jald hisab le ga aur Kitabullah ki mukhalifat ki wajah se usay sakht azab de ga aur usay us ki is shararat ka lutf chakhaye ga. Phir farmaya agar yeh log tujh se tauheed-e-bari Ta'ala ke bare mein jhagrein toh keh do ke main toh khalis Allah hi ki ibadat karoon ga jis ka na koi shareek hai na us jaisa koi hai, na us ki aulad hai na biwi aur jo mere ummati hain mere deen par hain. Un sab ka qaul bhi yahi hai, jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Qul hazihi sabeeli ad'oo ilallahi 'ala baseeratin ana wa manittaba'ani wa subhanallahi wa ma ana minal mushrikeen) (Surah Yusuf: 108) ya'ni meri raah yahi hai main khoob soch samajh kar dekh bhaal kar tumhein Allah ki taraf bula raha hoon, main bhi aur mere tabedar bhi yahi da'way de rahe hain, phir hukm deta hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ) Yahood-o-Nasara jin ke hathon mein Allah ki kitab hai aur mushrikeen se jo an-parh hain keh do ke tum sab ki hidayat Islam mein hi hai aur agar yeh na maane toh koi baat nahin, aap apna farz-e-tableegh ada kar chuke, Allah khud un se samajh le ga, un sab ko laut kar usi ke paas jana hai woh jisay seedha rasta dikhaye jisay chahe gumrah kar de, apni hikmat ko wohi khoob janta hai us ki hujjat toh poori ho kar hi rehti hai, us ki apne bandon par nazar hai usay khoob maloom hai ke hidayat ka mustahiq kaun hai aur kaun zalalat ka mustahiq hai? Us se koi baz-purs nahin kar sakta.

Dusri aayaton mein bhi saaf sarahat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) tamam makhlooq ki taraf Allah ke Nabi ban kar aaye hain, aur khud aap ke deen ke ahkaam bhi is par dalalat karte hain aur Kitab-o-Sunnat mein bhi bahut si aayatein aur hadeesein isi mafhoom ki hain, Quran-e-Pak mein ek jagah hai aayat (Qul ya ayyuhan-nasu inni Rasoolullahi ilaikum jami'anillazi lahu mulkus-samawati wal-ard) (Surah Al-A'raf: 158) logo main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka Rasool hoon. Aur aayat mein hai aayat (Tabarakallazi nazzalal-furqana 'ala 'abdihi liyakoona lil-'alamina nazira) (Surah Al-Furqan: 1) babarakat hai woh Allah jis ne apne bandon par Quran nazil farmaya taake woh tamam duniya walon ke liye tanbeeh karne wala ban jaye. Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein kayi kayi waqiat se tawatur ke sath sabit hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne Arab-o-Ajam ke tamam badshahon ko aur dusre atraf ke logon ko khatoot bhajwaye jin mein unhein Allah ki taraf aane ki dawat di khwah woh Arab hon Ajam hon Ahl-e-Kitab hon mazhab wale hon aur is tarah aap (ﷺ) ne tableegh ke farz ko tamam-o-kamal tak pahuncha diya. Musnad-e-Abdur-Razzaq mein Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, is ummat mein se jis ke kaan mein meri nisbat ki aawaz pahunche aur woh meri layi hui cheez par iman na laye khwah Yahudi ho khwah Nasrani ho magar mujh par iman laye baghair mar jayega to qatan jahannami hoga, Muslim Shareef mein bhi yeh hadees marwi hai aur An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ka yeh farman bhi hai ke main har ek surkh-o-siyah ki taraf Allah ka Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon, ek aur hadees mein hai har Nabi sirf apni qoum ki taraf bheja jata raha aur main tamam insanon ke liye Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Anas (R.A) se marwi hai ke ek Yahudi ladka jo Nabi (ﷺ) ke liye wazu ka pani rakha karta tha aur jotiyan la kar rakh deta tha, bimar pad gaya. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) us ki bimar pursi ke liye tashreef laye, us waqt us ka baap us ke sarhane baitha hua tha, aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ae fulan La ilaha illallah keh, us ne apne baap ki taraf dekha aur baap ko khamosh dekh kar khud bhi chupka ho gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne dobara yahi farmaya us ne phir apne baap ki taraf dekha baap ne kaha Abul Qasim ki maan le (ﷺ) pas us bache ne kaha Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa annaka Rasoolullah wahan se yeh farmate hue uthe ke Allah ka shukr hai jis ne meri wajah se ise jahannam se bacha liya, yahi hadees Sahih Bukhari mein Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) bhi laye hain, un ke siwa aur bhi bahut si sahih hadeesein bhi aur Quran-e-Kareem ki aayatein hain.

Allah Wahdahu La-Sharika apni wahdat ka khud shahid. Allah Ta'ala khud shahadat deta hai, bas uski shahadat kafi hai, woh sab se zyada sacha gawah hai, sab se zyada sachi baat usi ki hai. Woh farmata hai ke tamam makhlooq uski ghulam hai aur usi ki paida ki hui hai aur usi ki taraf mohtaj hai, woh sab se beniyaaz hai, uluhiyat mein Allah hone mein woh yakta aur la-sharika hai, uske siwa koi pooje jaane ke laiq nahin, jaise farman hai aayat (LAKINILLAHU YASH-HADU BIMA ANZALA ILAIKA ANZALAHU BI-ILMIHI) (Surah An-Nisa: 166) yani lekin Allah Ta'ala bazariya is kitab ke jo woh teri taraf apne ilm se utaar raha hai, gawahi de raha hai aur farishtay bhi gawahi dete hain aur Allah Ta'ala ki shahadat kafi hai, phir apni shahadat ke sath farishton ki shahadat par ulama ki gawahi ko mila raha hai. Yahan se ulama ki bahut badi fazeelat sabit hoti hai, balkay khusoosi 'Qaima' ka nasb haal hone ki wajah se hai, woh Allah har waqt aur haal mein aisa hi hai, phir takeedan dobara irshad hota hai ke mabood-e-haqiqi sirf wahi hai, woh ghalib hai, azmat aur kibriyai wali uski bargah hai, woh apne aqwal, af'aal aur shariyat, qudrat-o-taqdeer mein hikmaton wala hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Arafat mein is aayat ki tilawat ki aur 'Al-Hakim' tak padh kar farmaya: "Wa ana 'ala dhalika minash-shahideen ya Rabb." Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai aap ne yun farmaya: "Wa ana ash-hadu ayya Rabb." Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Ghalib Qattan farmate hain main Koofay mein tijarati gharz se gaya aur Hazrat A'mash ke qareeb thehra, raat ko Hazrat A'mash tahajjud ke liye khade hue, padhte padhte jab is aayat tak pahunche aur aayat (INNAD-DEENA 'INDALLAHIL ISLAM) (Surah Al-Imran: 19) padha to farmaya: "Wa ana ash-hadu bima shahadallahu bihi wa astawdi'ullaha hadhihish-shahadata wa hiya li 'indallahi wadee'atun" yani main bhi shahadat deta hoon uski jis ki shahadat Allah ne di aur main is shahadat ko Allah ke supurd karta hoon, yeh meri amanat Allah ke paas hai, phir kai dafa aayat (INNAD-DEENA 'INDALLAHIL ISLAM) (Surah Al-Imran: 19) padha, main ne apne dil mein khayal kiya ke shayad is baare mein koi hadith suni hogi, subah hi subah main hazir-e-khidmat hua aur arz kiya ke Abu Muhammad kya baat thi jo aap is aayat ko baar baar padhte rahe? Anbiya ke qatil Bani Israel: Yahan un Ahl-e-Kitab ki muzammat bayan ho rahi hai jo gunah aur haram kaam karte rehte the aur Allah ki pehli aur baad ki baton ko jo usne apne Rasoolon ke zariye pahunchayin jhutlate rehte the, itna hi nahin balkeh paighambaron ko maar dalte balkeh is qadar sarkash the keh jo log unhein adl-o-insaf ki baat kahein unhein bedaregh teh-e-tegh kar diya karte the, hadith mein hai haq ko na manna aur haq walon ko zaleel janna yahi kibr-o-ghuroor hai, Musnad-e-Abu Hatim mein hai Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha keh sab se zyada sakht azab kise hoga? Jhoote Da'we: Yahan Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke yeh Yahood-o-Nasara apne is da'we mein bhi jhoote hain ke un ka Taurat-o-Injeel par imaan hai kyunke un kitabon ki hidayat ke mutabiq jab unhein is Nabi-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman ki ita'at ki taraf bulaya jata hai to yeh munh pher ke bhagte dikhayi dete hain, is se un ki aala darje ki sarkashi, takabbur aur inaad-o-mukhalifat zahir ho rahi hai, is mukhalifat-e-haq aur beja sarkashi par unhein is cheez ne daleer kar diya hai ke unhon ne Allah ki kitab mein na hone ke bawajood apni taraf se jhoot bana kar ke yeh baat bana li hai ke hum to sirf chand roz hi aag mein rahenge yani faqat saat roz, duniya ke hisab ke har hazar saal ke peeche ek din, is ki poori tafseer Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hai, isi wahi aur besaro-pa khayal ne unhein batil deen par jama diya hai balkeh yeh khud Allah ne aisi baat nahin kahi, na un ka khayal hai na is ki koi kitabi daleel un ke paas hai, phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala unhein daant-ta aur dhamkata hai aur farmata hai un ka Qayamat wale din badtar haal hoga? Ke unhon ne Allah par jhoot bandha, Rasoolon ko jhutlaya, Anbiya ko aur Ulema-e-Haq ko qatl kiya, ek ek baat ka Allah ko jawab dena parega aur ek ek gunah ki saza bhugatni paregi, is din ke aane mein koi shak-o-shuba nahin, us din har shakhs ko poora poora badla diya jayega aur kisi par bhi kisi tarah ka zulm rawa na rakha jayega.

Malik-ul-Mulk ki hamd-o-sana Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke aye Muhammad (ﷺ) apne Rab ki ta'zeem karne aur uska shukriya baja lane aur use apne tamam kaam sonpne aur uski zaat-e-pak par poore bharose ka izhaar karne ke liye in alfaaz mein uski a'ala sifaat bayan kijiye jo oopar bayan hui hain. Ya'ni aye Allah tu Malik-ul-Mulk hai, teri malkiyat mein tamam mulk hai, jise tu chahe hukumat de aur jis se chahe apna diya hua wapas le le, tu hi dene aur lene wala hai, tu jo chahta hai ho jata hai aur jo na chahe ho hi nahin sakta. Is aayat mein is baat ki bhi tanbeeh aur is ne'mat ke shukr ka bhi hukm hai jo Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) aur aap ki ummat ko marhamat farmayi gayi ke Bani Israel se hata kar nabuwwat Nabi-e-Arabi, Qurashi, Ummi, Makki Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) ko de di gayi aur aap ko mutlaqan nabiyon ke khatam karne wale aur tamam ins-o-jinn ki taraf Rasool ban kar aane wale bana kar bheja. Tamam sabqa ambiya ki khubiyan aap mein jama kar dein, balkay aisi fazilatein aap ko di gayin jin se aur tamam ambiya bhi mehroom rahe, khwah woh Allah ke ilm ki babat hon ya us Rab ki shariyat ke mamle mein hon ya guzishta aur aane wali khabron ke mutaliq hon. Aap par Allah Ta'ala ne aakhirat ke kul haqaiq khol diye, aap ki ummat ko mashriq-o-maghrib tak phaila diya, aap ne deen aur aap ki shariyat ko tamam deenon aur kul mazhabon par ghalib kar diya. Allah Ta'ala ka durood-o-salam aap par nazil ho ab se le kar Qayamat tak jab tak raat din ki gardish bhi rahe, Allah aap par apni rahmatein dawam ke sath nazil farmata rahe. Ameen. Pas farmaya kaho aye Allah tu hi apni khalq mein her-pher karta rehta hai, jo chahe kar guzarta hai. Jo log kehte the ke in do bastiyon mein se kisi bahut bade shakhs par Allah ne apna kalam kyun nazil na kiya, is ki tardeed karte hue Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya aayat (Ahum yaqsimuna rahmat-e-Rabbik) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 32) kya tere Rab ki rahmat ko baantne wale yeh log hain? Jab un ke rizq tak ke malik hum hain, jise chahein kam dein, jise chahein zyada dein, to phir hum par hukumat karne wale yeh kaun? Ke falan ko Nabi kyun na banaya? Nabuwwat bhi hamari malkiyat ki cheez hai, hum hi jaante hain ke is ke diye jaane ke qabil kaun hai? Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Allahu a'lamu haithu yaj'alu risalatahu) (Surah Al-An'am: 124) jahan kahin Allah Ta'ala apni risalat nazil farmata hai use wahi sab se behtar jaanta hai. Aur jagah farmaya (aayat: Unzur kaifa faddalna ba'dahum 'ala ba'd) dekh le ke hum ne kis tarah in mein aapas mein ek ko dusre par bartari de rakhi hai. Phir farmata hai ke tu hi raat ki zyadati ko din ke nuqsan mein badha kar din raat ko barabar kar deta hai, zameen-o-aasman par, suraj-chand par poora poora qabza aur tamam tar tasarruf tera hi hai. Isi tarah jaade ki garmi aur garmi ko jaade se badalna bhi teri qudrat mein hai, bahaar-o-khizaan par qadir tu hi hai.

Tu hi hai ke zinda se murda ko aur murda se zinda ko nikale, kheti se dane ugata hai aur dana se kheton ko lahlahata hai, khajoor guthli se aur guthli khajoor se, tu hi paida karta hai momin ko kafir ke yahan aur kafir ko momin ke yahan, tu hi paida karta hai, murghi ande se aur anda murghi se aur isi tarah ki tamam tar cheezein tere hi qabze mein hain, tu jise chahe itna maal de de jo na gina jaye na ihata kiya jaye aur jise chahe bhook ke barabar roti bhi na de, hum maante hain ke yeh kaam hikmat se pur hain aur tere irade aur teri chahat se hi hote hain, Tabrani ki hadith mein hai Allah ka Ism-e-Azam is (Aayat Qulillahumma, Al-Kh) mein hai ke jab is naam se us se dua ki jaye to woh qabool farma leta hai.

Tark-e-Muwalaat ki wazahat: Yahan Allah Ta'ala tark-e-muwalaat ka hukum dete hue farmata hai, musalmanon ko kuffar se dosti aur mehez mohabbat karna munasib nahin, balkeh unhein aapas mein imandaron se mel-milaap aur mohabbat rakhni chahiye. Phir unhein hukum sunata hai ke jo aisa karega us se Allah bilkul bezar ho jayega, jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Ya ayyuhallazina amanu la tattakhizu aduwwi wa aduwwakum awliya'a tulquna ilaihim bil-mawaddati wa qad kafaru bima ja'akum minal-haqqi yukhrijunar-rasula wa iyyakum an tu'minu billahi rabbikum) (Al-Mumtahanah: 1), yani musalmano mere aur apne dushmanon se dosti na kiya karo. Aur jagah farmaya, momino yeh Yahood-o-Nasara aapas mein ek dusre ke dost hain, tum mein se jo bhi un se dosti karega woh unhi mein se hai. Dusri jagah Parwardigar-e-Aalam ne Muhajir, Ansar aur dusre mominon ke bhai-chare ka zikr kar ke farmaya ke kafir aapas mein ek dusre ke khair-khwah aur dost hain, tum bhi aapas mein agar aisa na karoge to zameen mein fitna phail jayega aur zabardast fasad barpa hoga. Albata un logon ko rukhsat de di gayi jo kisi shehar mein kisi waqt un ki badi aur burai se dar kar daf'ul-waqti ke liye bazahir kuch mel-milaap zahir karein, lekin dil mein un ki taraf raghbat aur un se haqiqi mohabbat na ho. Jaise Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) se marwi hai ke hum ba'az qomon se kushada peshani se milte hain lekin hamare dil un par la'nat bhejte rehte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke sirf zaban se izhar kare lekin amal mein un ka sath aise waqt mein bhi hargiz na de, yahi baat aur mufassireen se bhi marwi hai aur isi ki ta'eed Allah Ta'ala ka yeh farman bhi karta hai. Aayat: (Man kafara billahi mim ba'di imanihi illa man ukriha wa qalbuhu mutma'innun bil-imani wa lakin man sharaha bil-kufri sadran fa'alaihim ghadabum minallahi wa lahum azabun azim) (An-Nahl: 106), jo shakhs apne iman ke baad Allah se kufr kare siwaye un musalmanon ke jin par zabardasti ki jaye magar un ka dil iman ke sath mutma'in ho. Bukhari mein hai Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain yeh hukum Qayamat tak ke liye hai. Phir farmaya Allah tumhein apne aap se darata hai, yani apne dabdabe aur apne azab se us shakhs ko khabardar kiye deta hai jo us ke farman ki mukhalifat kar ke us ke dushmanon se dosti rakhe aur us ke doston se dushmani kare. Phir farmaya Allah ki taraf lautna hai, har amal karne wale ko us ke amal ka badla wahin milega. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ne khade ho kar farmaya, "Aye Bani Aud! Main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka qasid ho kar tumhari taraf aaya hoon, jaan lo ke Allah ki taraf phir kar sab ko jana hai, phir ya to Jannat thikana hoga ya Jahannam."

Allah Ta'ala se dar hamare liye behtar hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai woh posheeda ko aur chupi hui baton ko aur zahir baton ko bakhoobi jaanta hai, koi choti se choti baat bhi us par posheeda nahin, us ka ilm sab cheezon ko har waqt aur har lahza ghere hue hai. Zameen ke goshon mein, paharon ke, samundaron mein, aasmanon mein, hawaon mein, surakhon mein, garaz jo kuch jahan kahin hai sab us ke ilm mein hai. Phir un sab par us ki qudrat hai, jis tarah chahe rakhe, jo chahe jaza saza de. Pas itne bare wasee ilm wale, itni bari zabardast qudrat wale se har shakhs ko darte hue rehna chahiye. Us ki farmanbardari mein mashghool rehna chahiye aur us ki nafarmaniyon se alaihida rehna chahiye. Woh aalim bhi hai aur qadir bhi hai, mumkin hai kisi ko dheel de de lekin jab pakre ga tab daboch le ga, phir na mohlat mile gi na rukhsat. Ek din aane wala hai jis din tamam umr ke bure bhale sab kaam samne rakh diye jayenge, nekiyon ko dekh kar khushi hogi aur buraiyon par nazrein daal kar daant peese ga aur hasrat-o-afsos kare ga aur chahe ga ke main in se koson door rehta aur pare hi pare rehta. Quran ne aur jagah farmaya: Ayat (YUNABBA-UL-INSANU YAUMA-IZIM-BIMA QADDAMA WA AKHKHAR) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 13). Sab guzri hui baatein us din pesh kar di jayengi. Shaitan jo us ke saath duniya mein rehta tha aur use buraiyon par uksata tha, us se bhi us din bezari kare ga aur kahe ga: Ayat (YA-LAITA BAINI WA BAINAKA BU'DAL MASHRIQAINI FABI'SAL QAREEN) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 38). Kya achha hota ke ae shaitan mere aur tere darmiyan mashriq-o-maghrib ka fasla hota, woh to bara bura saath hai. Phir farmaya Allah tumhein apne yani apne azab se dara dhamka raha hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala Jalla Jalaluhu apne nek bandon ko khushkhabri deta hai ke woh us ke lutf-o-karam se kabhi na-umeed na hon, woh nihayat hi meharban, bohat raham aur pyar rakhne wala hai. Imam Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain yeh bhi us ki sarasar meharbani-o-lutf-o-mohabbat hai ke us ne apne se nahin balkay apne azab se apne bandon ko daraya. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke Allah apne bandon par raheem hai, bandon ko bhi chahiye ke sirat-e-mustaqeem se qadam na hatayein, deen-e-pak ko na chhorein, Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki farmanbardari se munh na morein.

Jhoota Da'wa: Is aayat ne faisla kar diya jo shakhs Allah ki mohabbat ka da'wa kare aur uske a'maal, af'aal, aqaaid farman-e-Nabwi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke mutabiq na hon, tareeqa-e-Muhammadiya par woh kaar-band na ho toh woh apne is da'we mein jhoota hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs koi aisa amal kare jis par hamara hukm na ho woh mardood hai. Isi liye yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke agar tum Allah se mohabbat rakhne ke da'we mein sachay ho toh meri sunnaton par amal karo, us waqt tumhari chahat se zyada Allah tumhe dega, yani woh khud tumhara chahne wala ban jayega. Jaise ke ba'az hakeem ulama ne kaha hai ke tera chahna koi cheez nahin, lutf toh us waqt hai ke Allah tujhe chahne lag jaye. Gharz Allah ki mohabbat ki nishani yahi hai ke har kaam mein itteba-e-sunnat mad-e-nazar ho. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya deen sirf Allah ke liye mohabbat aur usi ke liye dushmani ka naam hai, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki, lekin yeh hadith sanadan munkar hai. Phir farmata hai ke hadith par chalne ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala tumhare tamam-tar gunahon ko bhi maaf farma dega. Phir har aam-o-khaas ko hukm milta hai ke sab Allah-o-Rasool ke farman-bardar rahein, jo nafarman ho jayein yani Allah-o-Rasool ki ita'at se hat jayein toh woh kafir hain aur Allah un se mohabbat nahin rakhta. Is se wazeh ho gaya ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke tareeqe ki mukhalifat kufr hai, aise log Allah ke dost nahin ho sakte go un ka da'wa ho, lekin jab tak Allah ke sachay Nabi, Ummi, Khatam-ur-Rusul, Rasool-e-Jinn-o-Bashar ki tabedari, pairwi aur itteba-e-sunnat na karein woh apne is da'we mein jhootay hain. Hazrat Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh woh hain ke agar aaj ambiya aur rasool balkeh behtareen aur Ulul-Azm paighambar bhi zinda hote toh unhein bhi aap ke maane baghair aur aap ki shariat par kaar-band huye baghair chara hi na tha, is ka bayan tafseel ke sath aayat (وَاِذْ اَخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِيْثَاق النَّبِيّٖنَ) (Aal-e-Imran: 81) ki tafseer mein aayega, Insha'Allah Ta'ala.

Jhoota Da'wa: Is aayat ne faisla kar diya jo shakhs Allah ki mohabbat ka da'wa kare aur uske a'maal, af'aal, aqaaid farman-e-Nabwi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke mutabiq na hon, tareeqa-e-Muhammadiya par woh kaar-band na ho toh woh apne is da'we mein jhoota hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs koi aisa amal kare jis par hamara hukm na ho woh mardood hai. Isi liye yahan bhi irshad hota hai ke agar tum Allah se mohabbat rakhne ke da'we mein sachay ho toh meri sunnaton par amal karo, us waqt tumhari chahat se zyada Allah tumhe dega, yani woh khud tumhara chahne wala ban jayega. Jaise ke ba'az hakeem ulama ne kaha hai ke tera chahna koi cheez nahin, lutf toh us waqt hai ke Allah tujhe chahne lag jaye. Gharz Allah ki mohabbat ki nishani yahi hai ke har kaam mein itteba-e-sunnat mad-e-nazar ho. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya deen sirf Allah ke liye mohabbat aur usi ke liye dushmani ka naam hai, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki, lekin yeh hadith sanadan munkar hai. Phir farmata hai ke hadith par chalne ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala tumhare tamam-tar gunahon ko bhi maaf farma dega. Phir har aam-o-khaas ko hukm milta hai ke sab Allah-o-Rasool ke farman-bardar rahein, jo nafarman ho jayein yani Allah-o-Rasool ki ita'at se hat jayein toh woh kafir hain aur Allah un se mohabbat nahin rakhta. Hazrat Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh woh hain ke agar aaj ambiya aur rasool balkeh behtareen aur Ulul-Azm paighambar bhi zinda hote toh unhein bhi aap ke maane baghair aur aap ki shariat par kaar-band huye baghair chara hi na tha, is ka bayan tafseel ke sath aayat (وَاِذْ اَخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِيْثَاق النَّبِيّٖنَ) (Aal-e-Imran: 81) ki tafseer mein aayega, Insha'Allah Ta'ala.

Sab se pehle Nabi yani Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne in buzurg hastiyon ko tamam jahan par fazeelat inayat farmayi, Hazrat Adam ko apne haath se paida kiya. Apni rooh in mein phonki, har cheez ke naam unhein batlaye, jannat mein unhein basaya phir apni hikmat ke izhaar ke liye zameen par utara, jab zameen par but-parasti qaim ho gayi toh Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ko sab se pehla Rasool bana kar bheja phir jab un ki qoum ne sarkashi ki, paighambar ki hidayat par amal na kiya, Hazrat Nuh ne din raat posheeda aur zahir Allah ki taraf dawat di lekin qoum ne ek na suni toh Nuh (A.S) ke farman-bardaron ke siwa baqi sab ko pani ke azaab yani mashhoor toofan-e-Nuh bhej kar dubo diya. Khandan-e-Khalilullah alaihis salawatullah ko Allah Ta'ala ne barguzidagi inayat farmayi, isi khandan mein se Sayyid-ul-Bashar Khatam-ul-Anbiya Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) hain, Imran ke khandan ko bhi us ne muntakhab kar liya, Imran naam hai Hazrat Maryam ke walid sahab ka jo Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki walida hain, un ka nasab-nama baqol Muhammad bin Ishaq yeh hai, Imran bin Hashim bin Meesa bin Kharqiya bin Aseeth bin Ayaz bin Rukhyam bin Sulaiman bin Dawood (Alaihimas Salam), pas Isa (A.S) bhi Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki nasl se hain is ka mufassal bayan Surah An'am ki tafseer mein aayega. Insha'Allah-ur-Rahman.

Sab se pehle Nabi yani Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne in buzurg hastiyon ko tamam jahan par fazeelat inayat farmayi, Hazrat Adam ko apne haath se paida kiya. Insha'Allah-ur-Rahman.

Maryam bint-e-Imran, Hazrat Imran ki biwi sahiba ka naam Hasna bint-e-Faquz tha, Hazrat Maryam (Alaihimas Salam) ki walida thin. Hazrat Muhammad Ishaq farmate hain unhein aulad nahin hoti thi, ek din ek chiriya ko dekha ke woh apne bachon ko chogha de rahi hai to unhein walwala utha aur Allah Ta'ala se usi waqt dua ki aur khuloos ke sath Allah ko pukara, Allah Ta'ala ne bhi un ki dua qabool farma li aur usi raat unhein hamal thehar gaya. Jab hamal ka yaqeen ho gaya to nazr mani ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe jo aulad dega use Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki khidmat ke liye Allah ke naam par azad kar doongi, phir Allah se dua ki ke Parwardigar tu meri is mukhlisana nazr ko qabool farma, tu meri dua ko sun raha hai aur tu meri niyat ko bhi khoob jaan raha hai. Ab yeh maloom na tha larka hoga ya larki, jab paida hua to dekha ke woh larki hai aur larki to is qabil nahin ke woh Masjid-e-Muqaddas ki khidmat anjam de sake, is ke liye to larka hona chahiye, to aajizi ke tor par apni majboori Janab-e-Bari mein zahir ki ke ae Allah main to ise tere naam par waqf kar chuki thi lekin mujhe to larki hui hai. Wallahu A'lamu bima wada'at bhi parha gaya, yani yeh qaul bhi Hazrat Hasna ka tha ke Allah khoob janta hai ke mere han larki hui aur "ta" ke jazm ke sath bhi aaya hai, yani Allah ka yeh farman hai ke Allah Ta'ala ko bakhoobi maloom hai ke kya aulad hui hai, aur farmati hai ke mard aurat barabar nahin, main is ka naam Maryam rakhti hoon. Is se sabit hota hai ke jis din bacha hua usi din naam rakhna bhi jaiz hai, kyunke hum se pehle logon ki shariat hamari shariat hai aur yahan yeh bayan kiya gaya aur tardeed nahin ki gayi balkay ise sabit aur muqarrar rakha gaya. Isi tarah Hadith-e-Sharif mein bhi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aaj raat mere han larka hua aur main ne is ka naam apne baap Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke naam par Ibrahim rakha, mulahiza ho Bukhari, Muslim. Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A) apne bhai ko jabke woh tawallud hue lekar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue, Aap ne unhein apne hath se ghutti di aur un ka naam Abdullah rakha, yeh hadith bhi Bukhari o Muslim mein mojood hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs ne aakar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere han raat ko bacha hua hai kya naam rakhun? Farmaya Abdur Rahman naam rakho (Bukhari). Ek aur sahih hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) ke han bacha hua jise lekar aap hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi hue taake aap apne dast-e-mubarak se is bache ko ghutti dein, aap aur taraf mutawajjeh ho gaye, bacha ka khayal na raha.

Hazrat Abu Usaid ne bachay ko wapas ghar bhej diya, jab aap farigh huay bachay ki taraf nazar dali toh usay na paya, ghabra kar poocha aur maloom kar ke kaha is ka naam Munzir rakho (ya'ni dara denay wala). Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Sunan mein aik aur hadith marwi hai jisay Imam Tirmidhi sahih kehtay hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har bacha apnay aqeeqay mein garwi hai, satween din aqeeqah karay ya'ni janwar zibah karay aur naam rakhay, aur bachay ka sar mundwaye. Aik riwayat mein hai aur khoon bahaya jaye aur yeh zyada suboot wali aur zyada hifz wali riwayat hai, Wallahu A'lam. Lekin Zubair bin Bakkar ki riwayat jis mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apnay sahibzaday Hazrat Ibrahim ka aqeeqah kiya aur naam Ibrahim rakha, yeh hadith sanadan sabit nahin aur sahih hadith is ke khilaf majood hai aur yeh tatbeeq bhi ho sakti hai ke is naam ki shohrat us din hui, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Maryam (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ki is dua ko qabool farmaya, chunancha Musnad-e-Abdur Razzaq mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain har bachay ko shaitan us ki paidaish ke waqt tahooka deta hai isi se woh cheekh kar ronay lagta hai lekin Hazrat Maryam aur Hazrat Isa is se bachay rahay. Is hadith ko bayan farma kar Hazrat Abu Huraira (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmatay hain agar tum chaho toh is ayat ko parh lo, ayat (Wa inni u'izuha bika wa zurriyataha minash shaitanir rajeem) (Al-Imran: 36). Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi majood hai, yeh hadith aur bhi bohat si kitabon mein mukhtalif alfaz se marwi hai, kisi mein hai aik ya do dhachkay marta hai, aik hadith mein sirf Isa ka hi zikr hai ke shaitan ne unhein bhi dhachka marna chaha lekin unhein diya hua tahooka parday mein lag kar reh gaya.

Zakariya A.S ka ta'aruf. Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke Hazrat Hafsa ki nazr ko Allah Ta'ala ne bakhushi qabool farma liya aur use behtareen taur se nashonuma bakhshi, zahiri khoobi bhi ata farmayi aur batini khoobi se bharpoor kardiya aur apne nek bandon mein unki parwarish karayi taake ilm aur khair aur deen seekh lein, Hazrat Zakariya ko unka kafeel banadiya. Ibn-e-Ishaq toh farmate hain yeh is liye ke Hazrat Maryam (Alaihimas Salam) yateem hogayi thin, lekin dusre buzurg farmate hain ke qahat-e-sali ki wajah se unki kafalat ka bojh Hazrat Zakariya ne apne zimme le liya tha, hosakta hai ke dono wajoohaat ittefaqan aapas mein mil gayi hon, Wallahu A'alam. Hazrat Ibn-e-Ishaq waghera ki riwayat se maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Zakariya A.S unke khalu the, aur baaz log kehte hain unke behnooi the, jaise Me'raj wali sahih hadith mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne Hazrat Yahya aur Hazrat Isa (Alaihimas Salam) se mulaqat ki jo dono khala-zad bhai hain, Ibn-e-Ishaq ke qaul par yeh hadith theek hai kyunke islah-e-Arab mein maa ki khala ke ladke ko bhi khala-zad bhai keh dete hain, pas sabit hua ke Hazrat Maryam apni khala ki parwarish mein thin. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Hamza R.A ki yateem sahabzadi Umara ko unki khala Hazrat Ja'far bin Abu Talib R.A ki biwi sahiba ke supurd kiya tha aur farmaya tha ke khala qaim-e-maqam maa ke hai. Ab Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Maryam ki buzurgi aur unki karamat bayan farmata hai ke Hazrat Zakariya A.S jab kabhi unke paas unke hujre mein jaate toh be-mausami meway unke paas paate, maslan jaadon mein garmiyon ke meway aur garmiyon mein jaade ke meway. Hazrat Mujahid, Hazrat Ikrama, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Abu Sha'sa, Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i, Hazrat Zahhak, Hazrat Qatada, Hazrat Rabee bin Anas, Hazrat Atiya Aufi, Hazrat Suddi is aayat ki tafsir mein yahi farmate hain. Hazrat Mujahid se yeh bhi marwi hai ke yahan rizq se murad ilm aur woh sahifay hain jin mein ilmi baatein hoti thin lekin awwal qaul hi zyada sahih hai, is aayat mein Auliya-e-Allah ki karamaat ki daleel hai aur iske suboot mein bahut si hadithein bhi aati hain. Hazrat Zakariya A.S ek din pooch baithe ke Maryam tumhare paas yeh rizq kahan se aata hai? Siddiqa ne jawab diya ke Allah ke paas se, woh jise chahe be-hisab rozi deta hai. Musnad-e-Hafiz Abu Ya'la mein hadith hai ke Huzoor ﷺ par kayi din baghair kuch khaye guzar gaye, bhook se Aap ﷺ ko takleef hone lagi, apni sab biwiyon ke ghar ho aaye lekin kahin bhi kuch na paya. Hazrat Fatima R.A ke paas aaye aur daryaft farmaya ke bachi tumhare paas kuch hai?

Ke main kha loon mujhe bahut bhook lag rahi hai, wahan se bhi yahi jawab mila ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par mere baap sadqe hon kuch bhi nahin, Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wahan se nikle hi thay ke Hazrat Fatima ki laundi ne do rotiyan aur tukda gosht Hazrat Fatima ke paas bheja aap ne use le kar bartan mein rakh liya aur farmane lagin go mujhe, mere khawand aur bachon ko bhook hai lekin hum sab faqe hi se guzar denge aur Allah ki qasam aaj toh yeh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi ko doongi, phir Hazrat Hasan ya Hussain ko aap ki khidmat mein bheja ke aap ko bula layein, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raaste hi mein mile aur saath ho liye, aap aaye toh kehne lagin mere maa baap aap par fida hon Allah ne kuch bhijwa diya hai jise main ne aap ke liye chupa kar rakh diya hai, aap ne farmaya meri pyari bachi le aao, ab jo tasht khola toh dekhti hai ke roti salan se ubal raha hai dekh kar hairan ho gayin lekin foran samajh gayin ke Allah ki taraf se is mein barkat nazil ho gayi hai, Allah ka shukar kiya Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah par durood padha aur aap ke paas la kar pesh kar diya aap ne bhi use dekh kar Allah ki tareef ki aur daryaft farmaya ke beti yeh kahan se aaya? Jawab diya ke abba jaan Allah ke paas se woh jise chahe besab rozi de, aap ne farmaya Allah ka shukar hai ke ae pyari bachi tujhe bhi Allah Ta'ala ne Bani Israel ki tamam aurton ki sardar jaisa kar diya, unhein jab kabhi Allah Ta'ala koi cheez ata farmata aur un se poocha jata toh yahi jawab diya karti thin ke Allah ke paas se hai Allah jise chahe besab rizq deta hai, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko bulaya aur aap ne Hazrat Ali ne aur Hazrat Fatima ne aur Hazrat Hussain ne aur aap ki sab azwaj-e-mutahharat aur Ahl-e-Bait ne khoob shikam-seer ho kar khaya phir bhi utna hi baqi raha jitna pehle tha jo aas paas ke padosiyon ke haan bheja gaya yeh khair-e-kaseer aur barkat Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se thi.

Hasil-e-Dua-e-Yahya A.S: Hazrat Zakariya A.S ne dekha ke Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Maryam (Alaihima-s-Salam) ko be-mausam mewa deta hai, jaaron mein garmiyon ke phal aur garmi mein jaaron ke meway un ke paas rakhe rehte hain, toh bawajood apne poore budhape ke aur bawajood apni biwi ke banjh hone ke ilm ke, aap bhi be-mausam mewa yani nek aulad talab karne lage. Aur chunke yeh talab bazahir ek namumkin cheez ki talab thi, is liye nihayat poshidgi se yeh dua mangi, jaise aur jagah hai 'nida-e-khafiya'. Yeh apne ibadat khane mein hi thay jo farishton ne unhein aawaz di aur unhein suna kar kaha ke aap ke haan ek ladka hoga jis ka naam Yahya rakhna, saath hi yeh bhi farma diya ke yeh basharat hamari taraf se nahin balki Allah ki taraf se hai. Teen Afzal Tareen Auratein: Yahan bayan ho raha hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke hukm se Maryam (Alaihima-s-Salam) ko farishton ne khabar pahunchayi ke Allah ne unhein unki kasrat-e-ibadat, unki duniya ki be-raghbati ki sharafat aur shaitani waswas se doori ki wajah se apne qurb-e-khas inayat farma diya hai, aur tamam jahan ki auraton par unhein khas fazilat de rakhi hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif waghera mein Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se riwayat hai, farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Jannati auratein oont par sawar hone waliyan hain, un mein se behtar auratein Quraish ki hain jo apne chote bachon par bahut hi shafqat aur pyar karne wali aur apne khawand ki cheezon ki poori hifazat karne wali hain. Hazrat Maryam bint-e-Imran oont par kabhi sawar nahin huin. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai: Auraton mein se behtar aurat Hazrat Maryam bint-e-Imran hain aur auraton mein se behtar aurat Hazrat Khadija bint-e-Khuwailid hain (R.A). Tirmidhi ki sahih hadith mein hai: Sari duniya ki auraton mein se tujhe Maryam bint-e-Imran, Khadija bint-e-Khuwailid, Fatima bint-e-Muhammad, Asiya Firaun ki biwi hain (R.A). Aur hadith mein hai: Yeh charon auratein tamam aalam ki auraton se afzal aur behtar hain. Aur hadith mein hai: Mardon mein se kamil mard bahut se hain lekin auraton mein kamal wali auratein sirf teen hain: Maryam bint-e-Imran, Asiya Firaun ki biwi aur Khadija bint-e-Khuwailid, aur Aisha ki fazilat auraton par aisi hai jaise Thareed yani gosht ke shorbe mein bhigoyi hui roti ki tamam khanon par. Yeh hadith Abu Dawood ke ilawa aur sab kitabon mein hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki is hadith mein Hazrat Khadija ka zikr nahin. Maine is hadith ki tamam sanadein aur har sanad ke alfaaz apni kitab Al-Bidaya wan-Nihaya mein Hazrat Isa ke zikr mein jama kar diye hain, wa lillahil hamd wal minnah.

Phir farishte farmate hain ke: Aye Maryam! Tu khushoo-o-khuzoo, rukoo-o-sujood mein raha kar, Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala tujhe apni qudrat ka ek azeem-ush-shan nishan banane wala hai, is liye tujhe Rab ki taraf poori raghbat rakhni chahiye. Qunoot ke ma'ani ita'at ke hain jo aajizi aur dil ki haziri ke sath ho, jaise irshad-e-Aayat: (Wa lahu man fis-samawati wal-ard, kullul-lahu qanitoon) (Surah Ar-Rum: 26), yani uski matahuti aur malkiyat mein zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez hai, sab ke sab uske mahkoom aur tabe-e-farman hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke Quran mein jahan kahin Qunoot ka lafz hai us se murad ita'at guzari hai, yahi hadith Ibn-e-Jarir mein bhi hai lekin sanad mein nakarat hai. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain ke Hazrat Maryam (Alaihima-s-Salam) namaz mein itna lamba qayam karti thin ke dono takhnon par warm aa jata tha. Qunoot se murad namaz mein lambe lambe rukoo karna hai. Hasan Basri (R.H) ka qaul hai ke is se yeh murad hai ke apne Rab ki ibadat mein mashghool reh aur rukoo sajda karne walon mein se ho ja. Hazrat Auza'i farmate hain ke Maryam Siddiqa apne ibadat khane mein is qadar bakasrat ba-khushoo aur lambi namazein padha karti thin ke dono pairon mein zard pani utar aaya. (R.A) wa rizaha.

Yeh ahem khabrein bayan kar ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in baaton ka ilm tumhein sirf meri wahi se hua warna tumhein kya khabar? Tum kuch us waqt un ke paas thode hi maujood thay jo in waqiyat ki khabar logon ko pohanchate? Lekin apni wahi se hum ne in waqiyat ko is tarah aap par khol diya goya aap us waqt khud maujood thay jabke Hazrat Maryam (A.S) ki parwarish ke bare mein har ek dusre par sabqat karta tha, sab ki chahat thi ke is daulat se maal-o-maal ho jaon aur yeh ajar mujhe mil jaye. Jab aap ki walida sahiba aap ko le kar Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki Masjid-e-Sulaimani mein tashreef layin aur wahan ke khadimon se jo Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke bhai aur Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ki nasl mein se thay kaha ke main inhe apni nazr ke mutabiq naam-e-Allah par azaad kar chuki hoon tum ise sambhalo. Yeh zahir hai ke ladki hai aur yeh bhi maloom hai ke haiz ki halat mein auratein masjid mein nahin aa saktin, ab tum jano tumhara kaam, main to ise ghar wapas nahin le ja sakti kyunke naam-e-Allah ise nazr kar chuki hoon. Hazrat Imran (R.H) yahan ke imam-e-namaz thay aur qurbaniyon ke mohtamim thay aur yeh un ki sahibzadi thin to har ek ne badi chahat se in ke liye haath phaila diye. Idhar se Hazrat Zakariya (A.S) ne apna ek haq aur jataya ke main rishta mein bhi in ka khalu hota hoon to yeh ladki mujh hi ko milni chahiye aur log raazi na hue. Aakhir qur'a dala gaya aur qur'a mein un sab ne apni woh qalmein dalin jin se Taurat likhte thay, to qur'a Hazrat Zakariya (A.S) ke naam nikla aur yahi is sa'adat se musharraf hue. Dusri mufassal riwayaton mein yeh bhi hai ke nehar-e-Jordan par ja kar yeh qalmein dali gayin ke pani ke bahao ke sath jo qalam nikal jaye woh nahin aur jis ka qalam thehar jaye woh Hazrat Maryam (A.S) ka kafeel bane. Chunancha sab ki qalmein to pani baha kar le gaya sirf Hazrat Zakariya (A.S) ka qalam thehar gaya balkay ulta upar ko charhne laga, to ek to qur'e mein un ka naam nikla dusre qareeb ke rishtedar thay, phir yeh khud in tamam ke sardar, imam, malik, nabi thay, salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihi, pas inhi ko Hazrat Maryam (A.S) sonp di gayin.

Teen Afzal Tareen Auratein: Yahan bayan ho raha hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke hukm se Maryam (Alaihima-s-Salam) ko farishton ne khabar pahunchayi ke Allah ne unhein unki kasrat-e-ibadat, unki duniya ki be-raghbati ki sharafat aur shaitani waswas se doori ki wajah se apne qurb-e-khas inayat farma diya hai, aur tamam jahan ki auraton par unhein khas fazilat de rakhi hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif waghera mein Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se riwayat hai, farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Jannati auratein oont par sawar hone waliyan hain, un mein se behtar auratein Quraish ki hain jo apne chote bachon par bahut hi shafqat aur pyar karne wali aur apne khawand ki cheezon ki poori hifazat karne wali hain. Hazrat Maryam bint-e-Imran oont par kabhi sawar nahin huin. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai: Auraton mein se behtar aurat Hazrat Maryam bint-e-Imran hain aur auraton mein se behtar aurat Hazrat Khadija bint-e-Khuwailid hain (R.A). Tirmidhi ki sahih hadith mein hai: Sari duniya ki auraton mein se tujhe Maryam bint-e-Imran, Khadija bint-e-Khuwailid, Fatima bint-e-Muhammad, Asiya Firaun ki biwi hain (R.A). Aur hadith mein hai: Yeh charon auratein tamam aalam ki auraton se afzal aur behtar hain. Aur hadith mein hai: Mardon mein se kamil mard bahut se hain lekin auraton mein kamal wali auratein sirf teen hain: Maryam bint-e-Imran, Asiya Firaun ki biwi aur Khadija bint-e-Khuwailid, aur Aisha ki fazilat auraton par aisi hai jaise Thareed yani gosht ke shorbe mein bhigoyi hui roti ki tamam khanon par. Yeh hadith Abu Dawood ke ilawa aur sab kitabon mein hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki is hadith mein Hazrat Khadija ka zikr nahin. Maine is hadith ki tamam sanadein aur har sanad ke alfaaz apni kitab Al-Bidaya wan-Nihaya mein Hazrat Isa ke zikr mein jama kar diye hain, wa lillahil hamd wal minnah.

Phir farishte farmate hain ke: Aye Maryam! Tu khushoo-o-khuzoo, rukoo-o-sujood mein raha kar, Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala tujhe apni qudrat ka ek azeem-ush-shan nishan banane wala hai, is liye tujhe Rab ki taraf poori raghbat rakhni chahiye. Qunoot ke ma'ani ita'at ke hain jo aajizi aur dil ki haziri ke sath ho, jaise irshad-e-Aayat: (Wa lahu man fis-samawati wal-ard, kullul-lahu qanitoon) (Surah Ar-Rum: 26), yani uski matahuti aur malkiyat mein zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez hai, sab ke sab uske mahkoom aur tabe-e-farman hain. Hasan Basri (R.H) ka qaul hai ke is se yeh murad hai ke apne Rab ki ibadat mein mashghool reh aur rukoo sajda karne walon mein se ho ja. Hazrat Auza'i farmate hain ke Maryam Siddiqa apne ibadat khane mein is qadar bakasrat ba-khushoo aur lambi namazein padha karti thin ke dono pairon mein zard pani utar aaya. (R.A) wa rizaha.

Jab aap ki walida sahiba aap ko le kar Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki Masjid-e-Sulaimani mein tashreef layin aur wahan ke khadimon se jo Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke bhai aur Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ki nasl mein se thay kaha ke main inhe apni nazr ke mutabiq naam-e-Allah par azaad kar chuki hoon tum ise sambhalo. Yeh zahir hai ke ladki hai aur yeh bhi maloom hai ke haiz ki halat mein auratein masjid mein nahin aa saktin, ab tum jano tumhara kaam, main to ise ghar wapas nahin le ja sakti kyunke naam-e-Allah ise nazr kar chuki hoon. Hazrat Imran (R.H) yahan ke imam-e-namaz thay aur qurbaniyon ke mohtamim thay aur yeh un ki sahibzadi thin to har ek ne badi chahat se in ke liye haath phaila diye. Idhar se Hazrat Zakariya (A.S) ne apna ek haq aur jataya ke main rishta mein bhi in ka khalu hota hoon to yeh ladki mujh hi ko milni chahiye aur log raazi na hue. Masih Ibn-e-Maryam (A.S) yeh khushkhabri Hazrat Maryam ko farishtay suna rahe hain ke un se ek larka hoga jo bari shaan wala aur sirf Allah ke kalma "Kun" ke kehnay se hoga. Yehi tafsir Allah Ta'ala ke farman aayat (مُصَدِّقًۢـا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَّحَصُوْرًا وَّنَبِيًّا مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Imran: 39) ki bhi hai, jaisay ke jamhoor ne zikr kiya aur jis ka bayan is se pehlay guzar chuka, is ka naam Masih hoga, Isa beta Maryam (A.S) ka, har momin usay isi naam se pehchanay ga, Masih naam honay ki wajah yeh hai ke zameen mein woh bakasrat sayahat karenge, maa ki taraf mansoob karnay ki wajah yeh hai ke un ka baap koi na tha. Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek woh dono jahan mein barguzida hain aur muqarraban-e-khas mein se hain, un par Allah Azzawajal ki shariat aur kitab utray gi aur bari bari meharbaniyan un par duniya mein nazil hongi aur aakhirat mein bhi aur Ulul-Azm paighambaron ki tarah Allah ke hukum se jis ke liye Allah chahay ga woh shafa'at karenge jo qabool ho jayengi, Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihi wa alaihim ajma'een. Woh apnay jhooley mein aur adher umar mein baatein karenge yani Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat ki logon ko bachpan hi mein dawat denge jo un ka mojiza hoga aur bari umar mein bhi jab Allah un ki taraf wahi kare ga, woh apnay qaul-o-fel mein ilm-e-sahih rakhnay walay aur amal-e-saleh karnay walay honge, ek hadith mein hai ke bachpan mein kalam sirf Hazrat Isa aur Juraij ke saathi ne kiya aur un ke ilawa hadith mein ek aur bachay ka kalam karna bhi marwi hai to yeh teen huay. Hazrat Maryam is basharat ko sun kar apni munajat mein kehnay lageen Allah mujhe bacha kaisay hoga? Main ne to nikah nahin kiya aur na mera irada nikah karnay ka hai aur na main aisi badkar aurat hoon Masha'Allah, Allah Azzawajal ki taraf se farishtay ne jawab mein kaha ke Allah ka amr bohat bara hai usay koi cheez aajiz nahin kar sakti woh jo chahay paida kar day, is nuktay ko khayal mein rakhna chahiye ke Hazrat Zakariya ke is sawal ke jawab mein is jagah lafz yaf'alu tha yahan lafz yakhluqu hai yani paida karta hai. Is liye ke kisi batil parast ko kisi shubhay ka mauqa baqi na rahay aur saaf lafzon mein Hazrat Isa ka Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki makhlooq hona maloom ho jaye. Phir is ki mazeed takeed ki aur farmaya woh jis kisi kaam ko jab kabhi karna chahta hai to sirf itna farma deta hai ke hoja, bas woh wahin ho jata hai us ke hukum ke baad dheel aur der nahin lagti, jaisay aur jagah hai aayat (وَمَآ اَمْرُنَآ اِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۢ بِالْبَصَرِ) (Surah Al-Qamar: 50) yani hamaray sirf ek martaba ke hukum se hi bila-takheer fil-faur aankh jhapaktay hi woh kaam ho jata hai hamain dobara usay kehna nahin parta.

Unhein Bani Israel ki taraf apna Rasool bana kar bheje ga, aur is baat ko kehne ke liye ke mera yeh mojiza dekho ke mitti li, us ka parinda banaya, phir phoonk maarte hi woh sach much ka jeeta jaagta parind ban kar sab ke samne urne laga. Yeh Allah ke hukum aur us ki zaban se nikle hue alfaaz ke sabab tha, Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki apni qudrat se nahin, yeh ek mojiza tha jo aap ki nabuwwat ka nishan tha. Akmah us andhay ko kehte hain jise din ke waqt dikhayi na de aur raat ko dikhayi de, baaz ne kaha Akmah us nabina ko kehte hain jise din ko dikhayi de aur raat ko dikhayi na de, baaz kehte hain bhenga aur tircha aur kana murad hai, baaz ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke jo maa ke pait se bilkul andha paida hua ho, yahan yahi tarjuma zyada munasib hai kyunke is mein mojizay ka kamaal yahi hai aur mukhalifeen ko aajiz karne ke liye is ki yeh surat aur suraton se aala hai. Abrash safed daane wale korhi ko kehte hain, aise bimar bhi Allah Jalla Shanahu ke hukum se Hazrat Isa (A.S) achay kar dete thay aur murdon ko bhi Allah Azzawajal ke hukum se aap zinda kar diya karte thay. Aksar ulama ka qaul hai ke har har zamanay ke Nabi ko us zamanay walon ki munasibat se khaas khaas mojizaat Hazrat-e-Bari Ta'ala ne ata farmaye hain. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke zamanay mein jaadu ka bara charcha tha aur jaadugaron ki bari qadr-o-tazeem thi, toh Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko woh mojiza diya jis se tamam jaadugaron ki aankhein khul gayin aur un par hairat tari ho gayi aur unhein kaamil yaqeen ho gaya ke yeh toh Ilah-e-Wahid-o-Qahhar ki taraf se atiya hai, jaadu hargiz nahin. Chunancha un ki gardanein jhuk gayin aur yak-lakht woh halqa-ba-gosh-e-Islam ho gaye aur bilakhir Allah ke muqarrab banday ban gaye. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke zamana mein tabibon aur hakimon ka daur-daura tha. Kaamil atibba aur mahir hakim ilm-e-tibb ke pooray aalim aur lajawab kaamil-ul-fan ustaad majood thay, pas aap ko woh mojizay diye gaye jis se woh sab aajiz thay. Bhala madar-zaad andhon ko bilkul beena kar dena aur korhiyon ko is mohlik bimari se achha kar dena, itna hi nahin balkay jamadaat jo mehez be-jaan cheez hai us mein rooh daal dena aur qabron mein se murdon ko zinda kar dena, yeh kisi ke bas ki baat nahin?

Sirf Allah Subhanahu ke hukm se bator-e-mojiza yeh baatein Aap se zahir huin, theek isi tarah jab hamare Nabi-e-Akram Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye us waqt fasahat-o-balaghat, nukta-rasi aur buland-khayali bol-chal mein nazakat-o-latafat ka zamana tha. Is fan mein buland-paya shairon ne woh kamal hasil kar liya tha ke duniya unke qadmon par jhukti thi. Pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Kitabullah aisi ata farmayi gayi ke un sab ki kondti hui bijliyan mand pad gayin aur Kalam-e-Allah ke noor ne unhein neecha dikhaya aur yaqeen-e-kamil ho gaya ke yeh insani kalam nahin. Tamam duniya se keh diya gaya aur jata jata kar, bata bata kar, suna suna kar, munadi kar ke baar baar elan kiya gaya ke hai koi? Jo is jaisa kalam keh sake? Akele akele nahin sab mil jao aur insan hi nahin jinnat ko bhi apne sath shamil kar lo, phir sare Quran ke barabar bhi nahin sirf das suraton ke barabar sahi, aur achha yeh bhi na sahi ek hi surat is ki manind to bana kar lao. Lekin sab kamrein toot gayin, himmatein past ho gayin, gale khushk ho gaye, zaban gung ho gayi aur aaj tak sari duniya se na ban pada aur na kabhi ho sake ga. Bhala kahan Allah Jalla Shanahu ka kalam aur kahan makhlooq? Pas is zamane ke aitbar se is mojize ne apna asar kiya aur mukhalifeen ko hathiyar dalte hi ban padi aur joq dar joq islami halqe badhte gaye.

Phir Hazrat-e-Masih ka aur mojiza bayan ho raha hai ke Aap ne farmaya bhi aur kar ke bhi dikhaya bhi, ke jo koi tum mein se aaj apne ghar se jo kuch kha kar aaya ho main use bhi Allah Ta'ala ki di hui ittila bata dunga. Yehi nahin balkeh kal ke liye bhi us ne jo tayyari ki hogi mujhe Allah Ta'ala ke maloom karane par maloom ho jata hai, yeh sab meri sachai ki daleel hai ke main jo taleem tumhein de raha hoon woh bar-haq hai. Haan agar tum mein iman hi nahin to phir kya? Main apne se pehli kitab Taurat ko bhi manne wala, us ki sachai ka duniya mein elan karne wala hoon, main tum par ba'az woh cheezein halal karne aaya hoon jo mujh se pehle tum par haram ki gayi hain. Is se sabit hua ke Hazrat-e-Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Taurat ke ba'az ahkam mansookh kiye hain, go is ke khilaf bhi mufassireen ka khayal hai, lekin durust baat yehi hai. Ba'az hazrat farmate hain ke Taurat ka koi hukm Aap ne mansookh nahin kiya, albatta ba'az halal cheezon mein jo ikhtilaf tha aur badhte badhte goya un ki hurmat par ijma ho chuka tha, Hazrat-e-Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne un ki haqeeqat bayan farma di aur un ke halal hone par mohar kar di, jaise Quran-e-Hakeem ne aur jagah farmaya: "Wa li-ubayyina lakum ba'dalladhi takhtalifuna fihi" (Main tumhare ba'az aapas ke ikhtilaf mein saaf faisla kar dunga), Wallahu A'lam. Pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Kitabullah aisi ata farmayi gayi ke un sab ki kondti hui bijliyan mand pad gayin aur Kalam-e-Allah ke noor ne unhein neecha dikhaya aur yaqeen-e-kamil ho gaya ke yeh insani kalam nahin. Tamam duniya se keh diya gaya aur jata jata kar, bata bata kar, suna suna kar, munadi kar ke baar baar elan kiya gaya ke hai koi? Jo is jaisa kalam keh sake? Akele akele nahin sab mil jao aur insan hi nahin jinnat ko bhi apne sath shamil kar lo, phir sare Quran ke barabar bhi nahin sirf das suraton ke barabar sahi, aur achha yeh bhi na sahi ek hi surat is ki manind to bana kar lao. Lekin sab kamrein toot gayin, himmatein past ho gayin, gale khushk ho gaye, zaban gung ho gayi aur aaj tak sari duniya se na ban pada aur na kabhi ho sake ga. Bhala kahan Allah Jalla Shanahu ka kalam aur kahan makhlooq? Pas is zamane ke aitbar se is mojize ne apna asar kiya aur mukhalifeen ko hathiyar dalte hi ban padi aur joq dar joq islami halqe badhte gaye.

Phir Hazrat-e-Masih ka aur mojiza bayan ho raha hai ke Aap ne farmaya bhi aur kar ke bhi dikhaya bhi, ke jo koi tum mein se aaj apne ghar se jo kuch kha kar aaya ho main use bhi Allah Ta'ala ki di hui ittila bata dunga. Yehi nahin balkeh kal ke liye bhi us ne jo tayyari ki hogi mujhe Allah Ta'ala ke maloom karane par maloom ho jata hai, yeh sab meri sachai ki daleel hai ke main jo taleem tumhein de raha hoon woh bar-haq hai. Haan agar tum mein iman hi nahin to phir kya? Main apne se pehli kitab Taurat ko bhi manne wala, us ki sachai ka duniya mein elan karne wala hoon, main tum par ba'az woh cheezein halal karne aaya hoon jo mujh se pehle tum par haram ki gayi hain. Is se sabit hua ke Hazrat-e-Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne Taurat ke ba'az ahkam mansookh kiye hain, go is ke khilaf bhi mufassireen ka khayal hai, lekin durust baat yehi hai. Ba'az hazrat farmate hain ke Taurat ka koi hukm Aap ne mansookh nahin kiya, albatta ba'az halal cheezon mein jo ikhtilaf tha aur badhte badhte goya un ki hurmat par ijma ho chuka tha, Hazrat-e-Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne un ki haqeeqat bayan farma di aur un ke halal hone par mohar kar di, jaise Quran-e-Hakeem ne aur jagah farmaya: "Wa li-ubayyina lakum ba'dalladhi takhtalifuna fihi" (Main tumhare ba'az aapas ke ikhtilaf mein saaf faisla kar dunga), Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmaya ke mere paas apni sachai ki Allah Jalla Shanahu ki daleelein majood hain, tum Allah se daro aur mera kaha mano, jis ka khulasa sirf isi qadar hai ke use poojo jo mera aur tumhara palnehar hai, seedhi aur sachi raah to sirf yehi hai.

Phansi kaun charha? Jab Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne un ki zid aur hat-dharmi ko dekh liya ke apni gumrahi, kaj-rawi aur kufr-o-inkaar se yeh log hat-te hi nahin, toh farmane lage ke koi aisa bhi hai? Jo Allah Ta'ala ki taraf pahunchne ke liye meri tabedari kare. Is ka yeh matlab bhi liya gaya hai ke koi hai jo Allah Jalla Shanahu ke sath mera madadgar bane? Lekin pehla qaul zyada qareeb hai, bazahir yeh maloom hota hai ke aap ne farmaya Allah Jalla Shanahu ki taraf pukarne mein mera hath batane wala kaun hai? Jaise ke Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Muhammad Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Makkah Sharif se hijrat karne ke pehle mausam-e-hajj ke mauqe par farmaya karte the ke koi hai jo mujhe Allah Jalla Shanahu ka kalam pahunchane ke liye jagah de? Quraish toh Kalam-e-Ilahi ki tabligh se mujhe rok rahe hain, yahan tak ke Madina Sharif ke bashinde Ansar-e-Kiram is khidmat ke liye kamar-basta hue, aap ko jagah bhi di, aap ki madad bhi ki aur jab aap un ke han tashreef le gaye toh poori khair-khwahi aur be-misal hamdardi ka muzahira kiya, sari duniya ke muqable mein apna seena-e-sipar kar diya aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ki hifazat, khair-khwahi aur aap ke maqasid ki kamyabi mein hama-tan masroof ho gaye (Razi Allahu Anhum wa Arzahum). Isi tarah Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki is aawaz par bhi chand Bani Israeliyon ne labbaik kahi, aap par iman laye, aap ki ta'eed ki, tasdeeq ki aur poori madad pahunchai aur us noor ki ita'at mein lag gaye jo Allah Zul-Jalal ne un par utara tha yani Injeel. Yeh log dhobi the aur Hawari unhein un ke kapron ki safedi ki wajah se kaha gaya hai, ba'az kehte hain yeh shikari the, sahih yeh hai ke Hawari kehte hain madadgar ko, jaise ke Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Jang-e-Khandaq ke mauqe par Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya hai koi jo seena-e-sipar ho jaye?

Is aawaz ko sunte hi Hazrat Zubair R.A tayyar hogaye, Aap ne dobara yahi farmaya, phir bhi Hazrat Zubair R.A ne hi qadam uthaya. Pas Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya har Nabi ke hawari hote hain aur mera hawari Zubair hai R.A. Phir yeh log apni dua mein kehte hain hamein shahidon mein likh le, is se murad Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ke nazdeek Ummat-e-Muhammad ﷺ mein likh lena hai. Is tafsir ki riwayat sanadan bahut umdah hai. Phir Bani Israel ke is napak giroh ka zikr ho raha hai jo Hazrat Isa A.S ki taraf se bhare the ke yeh shakhs logon ko behkata phirta hai, mulk mein baghawat phaila raha hai aur riyaya ko bigad raha hai, baap beton mein fasad barpa kar raha hai, balkeh apni khabasat, khayanat, kizb-o-jhoot (darogh) mein yahan tak badh gaye ke Aap ko zaniya ka beta kaha aur Aap par bade bade bohtan bandhe. Yahan tak ke badshah bhi dushman-e-jaan ban gaya aur apni fauj ko bheja taake ise giraftar kar ke sakht saza ke sath phansi de do. Chunancha yahan se fauj jati hai aur jis ghar mein Aap the use charon taraf se gher leti hai, nakabandi kar ke ghar mein ghusti hai, lekin Allah Ta'ala Aap ko in makkaron ke hath se saaf bacha leta hai. Is ghar ke rozan (roshan daan) se Aap ko aasman ki taraf utha leta hai aur Aap ki shabahat ek aur shakhs par daal di jati hai jo isi ghar mein tha. Yeh log raat ke andhere mein us ko Isa A.S samajh lete hain, giraftar kar ke le jate hain, sakht toheen karte hain aur sar par kanton ka taj rakh kar use saleeb par chadha dete hain. Yahi un ke sath Allah ka makr tha ke woh to apne nazdeek yeh samajhte rahe ke hum ne Allah ke Nabi ko phansi par latka diya, halankeh Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ko to nijat de di thi. Is badbakhti aur badniyati ka samra unhein yeh mila ke un ke dil hamesha ke liye sakht hogaye, batil par ad gaye aur duniya mein zaleel-o-khwar hogaye aur aakhir-e-duniya tak is zillat mein hi doobe rahe. Is ka bayan is aayat mein hai ke agar unhein khufiya tadbeerein karni aati hain to kya hum khufiya tadbeer karna nahin jante, balkeh hum to un se behtar khufiya tadbeerein karne wale hain.

Izhar-e-khud mukhtari: Qatada waghera ba'az mufassireen toh farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke main tujhe apni taraf utha loonga phir us ke baad tujhe faut karoon ga, Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain yani main tujhe maarne wala hoon, Wahb bin Munabbah farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ko uthate waqt din ke shuru mein teen sa'at tak faut kar diya tha, Ibn-e-Ishaq kehte hain Nasara ka khayal hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Aap ko saat sa'at tak faut rakha phir zinda kar diya, Wahb farmate hain teen din tak maut ke baad phir zinda kar ke utha liya, Matar Warraq farmate hain yani main tujhe duniya mein poora poora kar dene wala hoon yahan wafat se maut murad nahin, isi tarah Ibn-e-Jareer farmate hain tawaffi se yahan murad un ka raf'a hai aur aksar mufassireen ka qaul hai ke wafat se murad yahan neend hai, jaise aur jagah Quran-e-Hakeem mein hai aayat (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمْ بالَّيْلِ) (Al-An'am: 60) woh Allah Zul-minan jo tumhein raat ko faut kar deta hai yani sula deta hai aur jagah hai aayat (اَللّٰهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْاَنْفُسَ حِيْنَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِيْ لَمْ تَمُتْ فِيْ مَنَامِهَا) (Az-Zumar: 42) yani Allah Ta'ala un ki maut ke waqt jaano ko faut karta hai aur jo nahin martin unhein un ki neend ke waqt, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab neend se bedaar hote toh farmate (Hadees: Alhamdulillahil-lazi ahyana ba'dama amatana) yani Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka shukr hai jis ne hamein maar daalne ke baad phir zinda kar diya, aur jagah farman-e-Bari Ta'ala 'wa bi-kufrihim' se 'shahida' tak parho jahan farmaya gaya hai un ke kufr ki wajah se aur Hazrat Maryam par buhtan-e-azeem baandh lene ki bina par aur is ba'is ke woh kehte hain hum ne Maseeh Isa bin Maryam Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl kar diya halankeh na qatl kiya hai aur na saleeb di lekin un ko shubha mein daal diya gaya, mautahu ki zameer ka marja' Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) hain yani tamam Ahl-e-Kitab Hazrat Isa par imaan layenge jabkeh woh Qayamat se pehle zameen par utrenge is ka tafseeli bayan anqareeb aa raha hai, Insha'Allah, pas us waqt tamam Ahl-e-Kitab un par imaan layenge kyunkeh na woh jizya lenge na siwaye Islam ke aur koi baat qabool karenge, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Hasan se (aayat: Inni mutawaffika) ki tafseer yeh marwi hai ke un par neend daali gayi aur neend ki halat mein hi Allah Ta'ala ne unhein utha liya, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Yahudiyon se farmaya ke Hazrat Isa mare nahin woh tumhari taraf Qayamat se pehle lautne wale hain.

Phir farmata hai main tujhe apni taraf utha kar kafiron ki giraft se azad karne wala hoon, aur tere tabe-daron ko kafiron par ghalib rakhne wala hoon qayamat tak, chunancha aisa hi hua, jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko aasman par charha liya toh un ke baad un ke sathiyon ke kayi fareeq ho gaye. Ek firqa toh aap ki ba'asat par iman rakhne wala tha ke aap Allah ke banday aur us ke Rasool hain aur us ki ek bandi ke larkay hain. Ba'az woh thay jinhon ne ghulu se kaam liya aur barh gaye aur aap ko Allah Ta'ala ka beta kehne lage, auron ne aap ko Allah kaha, dusron ne teen mein ka ek aap ko bataya, Allah Ta'ala un ke in aqaaid ka zikr Quran Majeed mein farmata hai phir un ki tardeed bhi kar di hai. Teen sau saal tak toh yeh isi tarah rahe, phir Yunan ke badshahon mein se ek badshah jo bara philosopher tha jis ka naam Istafleen tha kaha jata hai ke sirf is deen ko bigarne ke liye munafiqana andaz se is deen mein dakhil hua ya jahalat se dakhil hua ho, bahar-surat us ne deen-e-Masih ko bilkul badal dala aur bari tehreef aur tafseer ki is deen mein aur kami zyada bhi kar dali, bohat se qanoon ijad kiye aur amanat-e-kubra bhi isi ki ijad hai jo darasal kamina pan ki khayanat hai, isi ne apne zamana mein soor ko halal kiya, isi ke hukum se Isai mashriq ki taraf namazein parhne lage, isi ne girjaon aur kaleesaon mein ibadat khanon aur khanqahon mein tasweerein banwayein aur apne ek gunah ke ba'is das rozay rozon mein barhwa diye, gharz us ke zamana se deen-e-Masih Masihi deen na raha balkay deen-e-Istafleen ho gaya. Us ne zahiri ronaq toh khoob di, barah hazar se zaid toh ibadat gahein banwa dein aur ek shehar apne naam se basaya, Malkiya giroh ne us ki tamam baatein maan lein lekin bawajood un sab siyah kariyon ke Yahudi un ke hath talay rahe aur darasal nisbatan haq se zyada qareeb yahi thay go fil-waqay saray ke saray kuffar thay, Allah Khaliq-e-Kul ki un par phatkar ho. Ab jabke hamaray Nabi Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) ko Allah Ta'ala ne apna barguzida bana kar duniya mein bheja toh aap par jo log iman laye un ka iman Allah Ta'ala ki zaat par bhi tha, us ke farishton par bhi tha, us ki kitabon par bhi tha aur us ke tamam Rasoolon par bhi tha, pas haqeeqat mein nabiyon ke sachay tabe-farman yahi log thay yani Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ), is liye ke yeh Nabi-e-Ummi Arabi Khatam-ur-Rasool Sayyid-e-Aulad-e-Adam ke manne wale thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ki taleem bar-haq taleem ko saccha manne ki thi, lehaza darasal har Nabi ke sachay tabe-dar aur sahih ma'ani mein ummati kehlane ke mustahiq yahi log thay kyunke un logon ne jo apne tayin Isa (A.S) ki ummat kehte thay toh deen-e-Isawi ko bilkul maskh aur faskh kar diya tha, alawa azeen Paighambar-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman ka deen bhi aur tamam agli shari'aton ka nasikh tha phir mehfooz rehne wala tha jis ka ek shosha bhi qayamat tak badalne wala nahin. Sab sachon ke sardar jin ki sachai par mohar-e-Ilahi lag chuki hai yani Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khabar de chuke hain jo atal hai na kaate kate na tode toote, na taale tale, farmate hain ke aap ki ummat ka aakhri giroh Qustuntuniya ko fath karega aur wahan ke tamam khazane apne qabze mein lega aur Romiyon se un ki ghamsan ki ladai hogi ke us ki nazeer se duniya khali ho (hamari dua hai ke har zamane mein Allah Qadir-e-Kul is ummat ka hami-o-nasir rahe aur roo-e-zameen ke kuffar par inhe ghalib rakhe aur inhe samajh de taake yeh Allah Ta'ala ke siwa kisi ki ibadat na karein na Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke siwa kisi aur ki itaat karein, yahi Islam ki asl hai aur yahi urooj-e-dinyawi ka gir hai main ne sab ko alaihda kitab mein jama kar diya hai, aage Allah Ta'ala ke qaul par nazar daliye ke Maseeh (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke sath kufr karne wale Yahood aur aap ki shaan mein badh chadh kar baatein bana kar behakne wale Nasraniyon ko qatl-o-qaid ki maar aur saltanat ke tabah ho jaane ki yahan bhi saza di aur aakhirat ka azab wahan dekh lenge jahan na koi bacha sake na madad kar sake ga lekin barkhilaf un ke imandaron ko poora ajar Allah Ta'ala ata farmaye ga duniya mein bhi fath aur nusrat izzat-o-hurmat ata hogi aur aakhirat mein bhi khaas rahmaten aur ne'maten milengi, Allah Ta'ala zalimon ko napasand rakhta hai. Phir farmaya ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh thi haqeeqat Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki ibtida-e-paidaish ki aur un ke amr ki jo Allah Ta'ala ne Lauh-e-Mahfooz se aap ki taraf bazariya apni khaas wahi ke utaar di jis mein koi shak-o-shuba nahin jaise Surah Maryam mein farmaya, Isa bin Maryam yahi hain yahi sachi haqeeqat hai jis mein tum shak-o-shuba mein pade ho, Allah Ta'ala ko to laiq hi nahin ke us ki aulad ho woh us se bilkul paak hai woh jo karna chahe keh deta hai hoja, bas woh hojata hai, ab yahan bhi us ke baad bayan ho raha hai.)
