Is mubahila ki ayat ko parh kar aap ne farmaya agar nahin maante toh aao mubahila ka niklo, yeh sun kar woh kehne lage ae Abul Qasim hamein mohlat dijiye ke hum aapas mein mashwara kar lein phir tumhein is ka jawab denge. Ab tanhai mein baith kar unhon ne Aaqib se mashwara liya jo bara dana aur aqalmand samjha jata tha, us ne apna hatmi faisla in alfaaz mein sunaya ke ae jamaat-e-Nasara! tum ne yaqeen ke sath itna toh maloom kar liya hai ke Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ke sachay Rasool hain aur yeh bhi tum jaante ho ke Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki haqeeqat wahi hai jo Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani tum sun chuke ho aur tumhein bakhoobi ilm hai ke jo qoum Nabi ke sath mula'ana karti hai na un ke baray baqi rehte hain na chotay baray hote hain balkay sab ke sab jar-e-bunyaad se ukher kar phenk diye jaate hain. Yaad rakho ke agar tum ne mubahila ke liye qadam barhaya toh tumhara satyanas ho jayega, pas ya toh tum isi deen ko qabool kar lo aur agar kisi tarah nahin manna chahte ho aur apne deen par aur Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke mutaliq apne hi khayalat par qaim rehna chahte ho toh aap se sulah kar lo aur apne watan ko laut jao. Chunancha yeh log salah mashwara kar ke phir darbar-e-Nabvi mein hazir hue aur kehne lage ae Abul Qasim (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum aap se mula'ana karne ke liye tayyar nahin, aap apne deen par rahiye aur hum apne khayalat par hain lekin aap hamare sath apne sahabiyon mein se kisi aise shakhs ko bhej dijiye jin se aap khush hon ke woh hamare maali jhagron ka hum mein faisla kar dein, aap log hamari nazron mein bohat hi pasandida hain.

An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya achha tum dopahar ko phir aana main tumhare saath kisi mazboot amanat-dar ko kar doon ga, Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) farmate hain main ne kisi din bhi sardar banne ki khwahish nahin ki lekin us din sirf is khayal se ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo tareef ki hai us ka tasdeeq karne wala Allah ke nazdeek main ban jaoon, isi liye main us roz sawere sawere Zohar ki namaz ke liye chal para, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye namaz-e-Zohar parhayi phir dayen bayen nazrein dorane lage main baar baar apni jagah ooncha hota tha taake aap ki nigahein mujh par paren, aap barabar baghaur dekhte hi rahe yahan tak ke nigahein Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) par paren unhein talab farmaya aur kaha ke in ke saath jao aur in ke ikhtilafat ka faisla haq se kar do chunancha Hazrat Abu Ubaidah (R.A) un ke saath tashreef le gaye Ibn Marduyah mein bhi yeh waqea isi tarah manqool hai lekin wahan sardaron ki ginti barah ki hai aur is waqea mein bhi qadre tawalut hai aur kuch zaid baatein bhi hain, Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein barwayat Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) marwi hai Najrani sardar Aaqib aur Sayyid mubahila ke irade se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye lekin ek ne dusre se kaha yeh na kar Allah ki qasam agar yeh Nabi hain aur hum ne in se mubahila kiya to hum apni auladon samet tabah ho jayenge chunancha phir dono ne muttafiq ho kar kaha Hazrat aap hum se jo talab farmate hain hum woh sab ada kar denge (yani jizya dena qabool kar liya) aap kisi ameen shakhs ko hamare saath kar dijiye aur ameen ko hi bhejna, aap ne farmaya behtar main tumhare saath kamil ameen ko hi karoon ga as-hab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek dusre ko takne lage yeh dekhein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kis ka intekhab karte hain aap ne farmaya ae Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah tum kharay ho jao jab yeh kharay huye to aap ne farmaya yeh hain is ummat ke ameen, Sahih Bukhari Shareef ki aur hadees mein hai har ummat ka ameen hota hai aur is ummat ka ameen Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah hai (R.A) Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Abu Jahl maloon ne kaha.

Agar main Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Ka'aba mein namaz parhte dekh loon ga toh us ki gardan kuchal doon ga. Farmate hain ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar woh aisa karta toh sab ke sab dekhte ke farishte usay daboch lete, aur Yahudiyon se jab Quran ne kaha tha ke aao jhooton ke liye maut mango agar woh mangte toh yaqeenan sab ke sab mar jaate aur apni jaghein Jahannam ki aag mein dekh lete aur jin Nasraniyon ko mubahila ki dawat di gayi thi agar woh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke muqable mein mubahile ke liye nikalte toh laut kar apne maalon ko aur apne baal bachon ko na paate, Sahih Bukhari, Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Imam Tirmidhi isay Hasan kehte hain, Imam Baihaqi ne apni kitab Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein bhi wafd-e-Najran ke qissay ko taweel-tar bayan kiya hai, hum isay yahan naqal karte hain kyunke is mein bohat se fawaid hain go is mein gharabat bhi hai aur is maqam se woh nihayat munasibat rakhta hai, Salama bin Abd-e-Yasu' apne dada se riwayat karte hain jo pehle Nasrani thay phir Musalman ho gaye ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Surah Ta-Sin Quran mein nazil hone se peshtar Ahl-e-Najran ko nama-e-mubarak likha jis ki ibarat yeh thi: Bism-e-Ilah-e-Ibrahim wa Ishaq wa Ya'qub, min Muhammad-in-Nabi Rasool-illah, ila usquf-e-Najran wa ahl-e-Najran, aslim antum, fa-inni ahmadu ilaikum Ilah-e-Ibrahim wa Ishaq wa Ya'qub. Amma ba'd, fa-inni ad'ukum ila ibadat-illah min ibadat-il-ibad, wa ad'ukum ila wilayat-illah min wilayat-il-ibad, fa-in abaytum fal-jizyah, fa-in abaytum faqad adhintukum bi-harb, was-salam. Yani is khat ko main shuru karta hoon Hazrat Ibrahim, Hazrat Ishaq aur Hazrat Ya'qub ke Allah Ta'ala ke naam se, yeh khat hai Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf se jo Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat ke Nabi aur Rasool hain, Najran ke sardar ki taraf, Allah Ta'ala ki tumhare samne hamd-o-sana bayan karta hoon jo Hazrat Ibrahim, Hazrat Ishaq aur Hazrat Ya'qub ka Mabood hai, phir main tumhein dawat deta hoon ke bandon ki ibadat ko chhor kar Allah ki ibadat ki taraf aao aur bandon ki wilayat ko chhor kar Allah ki wilayat ki taraf aa jao, agar tum isay na mano toh jizya do aur mat-huti ikhtiyar karo agar is se bhi inkar ho toh tumhein larai ka elan hai, was-salam. Jab yeh khat usquf ko pahuncha aur us ne isay parha toh bara sat-pataya ghabra gaya aur tharane laga, jhat se Sharhail bin Wada'a ko bulwaya jo Hamdan qabila ka tha, sab se bara musheer-e-saltanat yahi tha, jab kabhi koi ahem kaam aa parta toh sab se pehle yani Aiham aur Sayyid aur Aaqib se bhi peshtar is se mashwara hota, jab yeh aa gaya toh usquf ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khat usay diya, jab us ne parh liya toh usquf ne poocha batao kya khayal hai?

Shurahil ne kaha badshah ko khoob ilm hai ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki aulad mein se Allah ke ek Nabi ke aane ka wada Allah ki kitab mein hai, kya ajab ke woh Nabi yahi ho, Amr-e-Nabuwwat mein kya raye de sakta hoon? Haan agar umoor-e-saltanat ki koi baat hoti toh beshak main apne dimagh par zor daal kar koi baat nikal leta. Usquf ne unhein toh alag bitha diya aur Abdullah bin Shurahil ko bulaya, yeh bhi musheer-e-saltanat tha aur Humair ke qabeelay mein se tha, usay khat diya, parhaya, raye poochhi toh usne bhi theek wahi baat kahi jo pehla musheer keh chuka tha. Usay bhi badshah ne door bitha diya, phir Jabbar bin Faiz ko bulaya jo Banu Haris mein se tha, usne bhi yahi kaha jo un dono ne kaha tha. Badshah ne jab dekha ke un teenon ki raye muttafiq hai toh hukum diya gaya ke naqoos bajaye jayen, aag jala di jaye aur garjon mein jhanday buland kar diye jayen. Wahan ka yeh dastoor tha ke jab saltanat ka koi ahem kaam hota toh raat ko jama karna maqsood hota toh yahi karte aur agar din ka waqt hota toh garjon mein aag jala di jaati aur naqoos zor-zor se bajaye jaate. Is hukum ke hote hi charon taraf aag jala di gayi aur naqoos ki aawaz ne har ek ko hoshiyar kar diya aur jhanday oonchay dekh-dekh kar aas-paas ki wadi ke tamam log jama hogaye. Is wadi ka tool itna tha ke tez sawar subh se sham tak dusre kinare pahunchta tha, is mein tehattar (73) gaon aabad thay aur ek lakh bees hazar talwar chalane wale yahan aabad thay. Jab yeh sab log aagaye toh Usquf ne unhein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka namah-e-mubarak parh kar sunaya aur poochha batao tumhari kya raye hai?

Toh tamam aqalmandon ne kaha ke Sharjeel bin Wada'ah Hamdani, Abdullah bin Sharjeel Asbahi aur Jabbar bin Faiz Harisi ko bator-e-wafad ke bheja jaye, yeh wahan se pukhta khabar layein. Ab yahan se yeh wafad in teenon ki sardari ke matahat rawana hua. Madina pahunch kar unhon ne safri libas utaar dala aur naqsh bane hue reshmi lambe lambe hullay pehan liye aur sone ki angoothiyan ungliyon mein daal lein aur apni chadaron ke pallay thaame hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue, salam kiya lekin Aap (ﷺ) ne jawab na diya. Bahut der tak intezar kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) kuch baat karein lekin un reshmi hullon aur sone ki angoothiyon ki wajah se Aap (ﷺ) ne un se kalam bhi na kiya. Ab yeh log Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) aur Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf (R.A) ki talash mein nikle aur in dono buzurgon se in ki pehli mulaqat thi. Muhajireen aur Ansar ke ek majmay mein in dono hazrat ko pa liya, un se waqia bayan kiya, "Tumhare Nabi (ﷺ) ne hamein khat likha, hum us ka jawab dene ke liye khud hazir hue, Aap (ﷺ) ke paas gaye, salam kiya lekin jawab na diya, phir bahut der tak intezar mein baithe rahe ke Aap (ﷺ) se kuch baatein ho jatein lekin Aap (ﷺ) ne hum se koi baat na ki, aakhir hum log thak kar chale aaye. Ab Aap hazrat farmayein ke kya hum yunhi wapas chale jayein?" In dono ne Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) se kaha ke Aap hi inhe jawab dijiye. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne farmaya, "Mera khayal hai ke yeh log apne hullay aur apni angoothiyan utaar dein aur wahi safri mamooli libas pehan kar Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein dobara jayein." Chunancha unhon ne yahi kiya aur usi mamooli libas mein gaye, salam kiya, Aap (ﷺ) ne jawab diya. Phir farmaya, "Us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath bheja hai, yeh jab mere paas pehli martaba aaye the toh in ke sath Iblees tha." Ab sawal jawab baat cheet shuru hui, Huzoor (ﷺ) bhi poochte the aur woh jawab dete the, isi tarah woh bhi sawal karte aur jawab paate. Aakhir mein unhon ne poocha, "Aap Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki babat kya farmate hain? Taake hum apni qoum ke paas ja kar woh kahein, hamein is ki khushi hai ke agar Aap Nabi hain toh Aap ki zubanein sunen ke Aap ka un ki babat kya khayal hai?" Toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Mere paas is ka jawab aaj toh nahin, tum thehro toh mera Rab mujh se is ki babat jo farmaye ga woh main tumhein suna doon ga." Dusre din woh phir aaye toh Aap (ﷺ) ne usi waqt ki utri hui is aayat (Inna masala Isa indallahi kamasali Adama khalaqahu min turabin summa qala lahu kun fayakun. Alhaqqu mir rabbika fala takum minal mumtareen. Faman hajjaka fihi mim ba'di ma ja'aka minal ilmi faqul ta'alau nad'u abna'ana wa abna'akum wa nisa'ana wa nisa'akum wa anfusana wa anfusakum summa nabtahil fanaj'al la'natallahi alal kazibeen) (Surah Al-Imran: 59-61) ki tilawat farmayi.

Aal-e-Imran: 59, 60, 61) Tilawat kar sunayi unhon ne is baat ka iqrar karne se inkar kardiya, dusre din subh hi subh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mula'ana ke liye Hazrat Hasan (R.A) ko aur Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ko apni chadar mein liye hue tashreef laye, peeche peeche Hazrat Fatima (R.A) aa rahi thin. Us waqt aap (ﷺ) ki kayi ek biwiyan thin. Sharjeel yeh dekhte hi apne dono sathiyon se kehne laga tum jante ho ke Najran ki sari wadi meri baat ko manti hai aur meri raye par karband hoti hai, suno Allah ki qasam yeh mamla bada bhari hai agar yeh shakhs (ﷺ) mab'oos kiya gaya hai to sab se pehle is ki nigahon mein hum hi mat'oon honge aur sab se pehle is ki tardeed karne wale hum hi thehrenge, yeh baat is ke aur is ke sathiyon ke dilon mein nahin jayegi aur hum par koi na koi museebat-o-aafat aayegi. Arab bhar mein sab se zyada qareeb in se main hi hoon aur suno agar yeh shakhs Nabi-e-Mursal hai to mubahila karte hi roo-e-zameen par ek baal ya ek nakhun bhi hamara na rahega. Is ke dono sathiyon ne kaha phir ae Abu Waiham aap ki kya raye hai? Us ne kaha meri raye yeh hai ke isi ko hum hakim banadein jo kuch yeh hukm de hum ise manzoor karlein, yeh kabhi bhi khilaf-e-adl hukm na dega. Un dono ne is baat ko tasleem karliya. Ab Sharjeel ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se kaha ke main is mula'ana se behtar cheez janab ke samne pesh karta hoon. Aap (ﷺ) ne daryaft farmaya woh kya? Kaha aaj ka din, aane wali raat aur kal ki subh tak aap hamare bare mein jo hukm karein hamein manzoor hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya shayad aur log tumhare is faisle ko na maanein. Sharjeel ne kaha is ki babat mere in dono sathiyon se daryaft farma lijiye. Aap (ﷺ) ne un dono se poocha unhon ne jawab diya ke sari wadi ke log inhi ki raye par chalte hain, wahan ek bhi aisa nahin jo in ke faisle ko taal sake. Pas Huzoor (ﷺ) ne yeh darkhwast qabool farmayi, mubahila na kiya aur wapas laut gaye. Dusre din subh hi woh hazir-e-khidmat hue to aap (ﷺ) ne ek tehreer unhein likh di ke jis mein Bismillah ke baad yeh mazmoon tha ke "Tehreer Allah ke Nabi Muhammad Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki taraf se Najraniyon ke liye hai, un par Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka hukm jari tha har phal, har siyah-o-safeed aur har ghulam par lekin Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) yeh sab inhi ko dete hain, yeh har saal sirf do hazar hullay de diya karein, ek hazar Rajab mein aur ek hazar Safar mein waghera waghera." Poora ahd-nama unhein ata farmaya. Is se maloom hota hai ke un ka yeh wafd san 9 Hijri mein aaya tha is liye ke Hazrat Zuhri (R.H) farmate hain sab se pehle jizya inhi Ahl-e-Najran ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko ada kiya, aur jizya ki aayat Fatah-e-Makkah ke baad utri hai jo yeh hai (QATILUL-LADHINA LA YU'MINUNA BILLAHI WALA BIL-YAWMIL-AKHIRI WALA YUHARRIMUNA MA HARRAMALLAHU WA RASULUHU WALA YADINUNA DINAL-HAQQI MINAL-LADHINA UTUL-KITABA HATTA YU'TUL-JIZYATA 'ANY-YADIW-WA HUM SAGHIRUN) 9.

(At-Taubah: 29) Is aayat mein Ahl-e-Kitab se jizya lene ka hukum hua hai, Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke Aaqib aur Tayyib Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye, Aap (ﷺ) ne unhein mula'ana ke liye kaha aur subh ko Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur Hazrat Fatima (R.A) aur Hazrat Hasan (R.A) aur Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ko liye hue Aap (ﷺ) tashreef laye aur unhein kehla bheja, unhon ne qabool na kiya aur khiraj dena manzoor kar liya. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Uss ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke saath bheja hai, agar yeh dono "nahin" kehte toh in par yahi wadi aag barsati. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) farmate hain: "Nad'u abna'ana..." wali aayat inhi ke baare mein nazil hui hai. "Anfusana" se murad khud Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ), "Abna'ana" se murad Hasan (R.A) aur Hussain (R.A), "Nisa'ana" se murad Hazrat Fatima-tuz-Zahra (R.A). Mustadrak Hakim waghera mein bhi iss ma'ani ki hadith marwi hai. Phir Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hai: Yeh jo hum ne Isa (A.S) ki shaan farmayi hai, haq aur sach hai, iss mein baal barabar kami beshi nahin. Allah qabil-e-ibadat hai, koi aur nahin aur wahi ghalba wala aur hikmat wala hai. Ab bhi agar yeh munh pher lein aur dusri baaton mein padein toh Allah bhi aise batil pasandon ko aur mufsidon ko bakhoobi jaanta hai, unhein badtareen saza de ga. Iss mein poori qudrat hai, koi uss se na bhaag sake na uss ka muqabla kar sake. Woh paak hai aur tareefon wala hai, hum uss ke azaab se usi ki panah chahte hain.)

Ikhtiyarat ki wazahat aur Najrani wafd ki rudad. Hazrat-e-Bari Jalla Ismuhu wa 'Ala Qadruhu apni qudrat-e-kamilah ka bayan farma raha hai ke Hazrat-e-Isa A.S ka toh sirf baap na tha aur main ne unhein paida kar diya toh kya kaun si hairani ki baat hai? Main ne Hazrat-e-Adam A.S ko toh un se pehle paida kiya tha, un ka bhi baap na tha balkeh maa bhi na thi, mitti se putla banaya aur keh diya Adam ho ja, usi waqt ho gaya. Phir mere liye sirf maa se paida karna kaun sa mushkil ho sakta hai jabkeh baghair maa aur baap ke bhi main ne paida kar diya. Pas agar sirf baap na hone ki wajah se Hazrat-e-Isa A.S ko toh sab se pehle is martaba se hata dena chahiye, kyunke un ke da'we ka jhoota hona aur kharabi is se bhi zyada yahan zahir hai, yahan maa toh hai, wahan toh na maa thi na baap. Yeh sab kuch Allah Ta'ala Jalla Jalaluhu ki qudrat-e-kamilah ka zuhoor hai ke Adam A.S ko baghair mard-o-aurat ke paida kiya aur Hawwa R.A ko sirf mard se baghair aurat ke paida kiya, aur Isa A.S ko sirf aurat se baghair mard ke paida kar diya aur baqi makhlooq ko mard-o-aurat se paida kiya. Isi liye Surah Maryam mein farmaya: (Wa linaj'alahu ayatal linnasi wa rahmatam minna, wa kana amram maqdiyya) (Surah Maryam: 21). Hum ne Isa A.S ko logon ke liye apni qudrat ka nishan banaya aur yahan farmaya hai.

Isa A.S ke bare mein Allah ka sacha faisla yahi hai, is ke siwa aur kuch kisi kami ya ziyadati ki gunjaish hi nahin hai kyunke haq ke baad gumrahi hi hoti hai, pas tujhe ae Nabi har-giz in shaki logon mein na hona chahiye. Allah Rabbul Aalameen is ke baad apne Nabi ko hukum deta hai ke agar is qadar wazeh aur kamil bayan ke baad bhi koi shakhs tujh se Amr-e-Isa ke bare mein jhagde to tu unhein mubahila ki dawat de ke hum fareeqain ma' apne beton aur biwiyon ke mubahila ke liye niklein aur Allah Jalla Shanuhu se aajizi ke sath kahein ke ae Allah hum dono mein jo bhi jhoota ho us par tu apni la'nat nazil farma. Is mubahila ke nazil hone aur Surat ki ibtida se yahan tak ki in tamam aayaton ke nazil hone ka sabab Najran ke Nasara ka wafd tha. Yeh log yahan aakar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Hazrat Isa A.S ke bare mein guftagu kar rahe the, un ka aqeeda tha ke Hazrat Isa A.S hukmrani ke hissa-dar aur Allah Jalla Shanuhu ke bete hain, pas un ki tardeed aur un ke jawab mein yeh sab aayatein nazil huin. Ibn Ishaq apni mashhoor-e-aam Seerat mein likhte hain, in ke alawa dusre mu'arikheen ne bhi apni kitabon mein likha hai ke Najran ke Nasraniyon ne bator-e-wafd Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein apne sath aadmi bheje the jin mein chaudah shakhs un ke sardar the jin ke naam yeh hain: Aaqib jis ka naam Abdul Maseeh tha, Sayyid jis ka naam Aiham tha, Abu Harisa bin Alqama jo Bakr bin Wail ka bhai tha, aur Aus bin Haris, Zaid, Qais, Yazeed aur us ke dono ladke, aur Khuwailid aur Amr, Khalid, Abdullah aur Mohsin. Yeh sab chaudah sardar the lekin phir in mein bade sardar teen shakhs the: Aaqib jo ameer-e-qaum tha aur aqalmand samjha jata tha aur sahib-e-mashwara tha aur isi ki raye par yeh log mutma'in ho jate the, aur Sayyid jo un ka laat padri tha aur mudarris-e-aala tha, yeh Banu Bakr bin Wail ke Arab qabeelay mein se tha lekin Nasrani ban gaya tha aur Roomiyon ke yahan us ki badi aao-bhagat thi, us ke liye unhon ne bade bade garjay bana diye the aur us ke deen ki mazbooti dekh kar us ki bahut kuch khatir-o-madarat aur khidmat-o-izzat karte rehte the. Yeh shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifat-o-shaan se waqif tha aur agli kitabon mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifatein padh chuka tha, dil se Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nabuwwat ka qail tha lekin Nasraniyon mein jo us ki takreem-o-ta'zeem thi aur wahan jo jaah-o-mansab usay hasil tha us ke chhin jaane ke khauf se raah-e-haq ki taraf nahin aata tha. Garz yeh wafd Madina mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein Masjid-e-Nabvi mein hazir hua, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us waqt Asr ki namaz se farigh ho kar baithe hi the. Yeh log nafees poshakain pehne hue aur khubsurat naram chadrein odhe hue the, aisa maloom hota tha jaise Banu Haris bin Ka'ab ke khandan ke log hon. Sahaba R.A kehte hain in ke baad in jaisa ba-shaukat wafd koi nahin aaya. Un ki namaz ka waqt aa gaya to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ijazat se unhon ne mashriq ki taraf munh kar ke Masjid-e-Nabvi mein hi apne tareeq par namaz ada kar li.

Baad namaz ke Huzoor ﷺ se un ki guftagu hui. Idhar se bolne wale yeh teen shakhs thay: Haritha bin Alqama, Aaqib yani Abdul Masih aur Sayyid yani Aiham. Yeh go shahi mazhab par thay lekin kuch umoor mein ikhtilaf rakhte thay. Hazrat Masih ki nisbat un ke teenon khayal thay, yani woh khud Allah Jalla Shanuhu hai aur Allah ka larka hai aur teen mein ka teesra hai. Allah un ke is napak qaul se mubarra hai aur bahut hi buland-o-bala. Taqreeban tamam Nasara ka yahi aqeeda hai. Masih ke Allah hone ki daleel to un ke paas yeh thi ke woh murdon ko zinda kar deta tha aur andhon aur korhiyon aur bimaron ko shifa deta tha, ghaib ki khabrein deta tha aur mitti ki chiriya bana kar phoonk maar kar ura diya karta tha. Aur jawab is ka yeh hai ke yeh sari baatein us se Allah ke hukm se sarzad hoti thin, is liye ke Allah ki nishaniyan Allah ki baton ke sach hone par aur Hazrat Isa ki nabuwwat par musbat daleel ho jayen. Allah ka larka manne walon ki hujjat yeh thi ke un ka ba-zahir koi baap na tha aur gehwary mein hi bolne lage thay, yeh baatein bhi aisi hain ke un se pehle dekhne mein hi nahin aayi thin (is ka jawab yeh hai ke yeh bhi Allah ki qudrat ki nishaniyan thin taake log Allah ko asbab ka mehkoom aur aadat ka mohtaj na samjhein waghera. (Mutarjim). Aur teen mein teesra is liye kehte thay ke us ne apne kalam mein farmaya hai: "Hum ne kiya, hamara amr, hamari makhlooq, hum ne faisla kiya" waghera. Pas agar Allah akela ek hi hota to yun na farmata balkay farmata: "Main ne kiya, mera amr, meri makhlooq, main ne faisla kiya" waghera. Pas sabit hua ke Allah teen hain: khud Allah Rabb-e-Kaaba aur Isa aur Maryam (jis ka jawab yeh hai ke "hum" ka lafz sirf barai ke liye aur azmat ke liye hai. (Mutarjim). Allah Ta'ala in zalimon munkiron ke qaul se pak-o-buland hai. Un ke tamam aqaid ki tardeed Quran-e-Kareem mein nazil hui. Jab yeh dono padri Huzoor ﷺ se batchit kar chuke to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tum musalman ho jao." Unhon ne kaha: "Hum to manne wale hain hi." Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: "Nahin nahin, tumhein chahiye ke Islam qabool kar lo." Woh kehne lage: "Hum to Aap se pehle ke musalman hain." Farmaya: "Nahin, tumhara yeh Islam qabool nahin is liye ke tum Allah ki aulad mante ho, saleeb ki pooja karte ho, khanzeer khate ho." Unhon ne kaha: "Acha phir yeh to farmaye ke Hazrat Isa ka baap kaun tha?" Huzoor ﷺ to is par khamosh rahe aur Surah Al-Imran ki shuru se le kar upar tak ki aayatein un ke jawab mein nazil huin. Ibn Ishaq in sab ki mukhtasar si tafseer bayan kar ke phir likhte hain: Aap ﷺ ne yeh sab tilawat kar ke unhein samjha dein.

Is mubahila ki ayat ko parh kar aap ne farmaya agar nahin maante toh aao mubahila ka niklo, yeh sun kar woh kehne lage ae Abul Qasim hamein mohlat dijiye ke hum aapas mein mashwara kar lein phir tumhein is ka jawab denge. Ab tanhai mein baith kar unhon ne Aaqib se mashwara liya jo bara dana aur aqalmand samjha jata tha, us ne apna hatmi faisla in alfaaz mein sunaya ke ae jamaat-e-Nasara! tum ne yaqeen ke sath itna toh maloom kar liya hai ke Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ke sachay Rasool hain aur yeh bhi tum jaante ho ke Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki haqeeqat wahi hai jo Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani tum sun chuke ho aur tumhein bakhoobi ilm hai ke jo qoum Nabi ke sath mula'ana karti hai na un ke baray baqi rehte hain na chotay baray hote hain balkay sab ke sab jar-e-bunyaad se ukher kar phenk diye jaate hain. Yaad rakho ke agar tum ne mubahila ke liye qadam barhaya toh tumhara satyanas ho jayega, pas ya toh tum isi deen ko qabool kar lo aur agar kisi tarah nahin manna chahte ho aur apne deen par aur Hazrat Isa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke mutaliq apne hi khayalat par qaim rehna chahte ho toh aap se sulah kar lo aur apne watan ko laut jao. Chunancha yeh log salah mashwara kar ke phir darbar-e-Nabvi mein hazir hue aur kehne lage ae Abul Qasim (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum aap se mula'ana karne ke liye tayyar nahin, aap apne deen par rahiye aur hum apne khayalat par hain lekin aap hamare sath apne sahabiyon mein se kisi aise shakhs ko bhej dijiye jin se aap khush hon ke woh hamare maali jhagron ka hum mein faisla kar dein, aap log hamari nazron mein bohat hi pasandida hain.

An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya achha tum dopahar ko phir aana main tumhare saath kisi mazboot amanat-dar ko kar doon ga, Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) farmate hain main ne kisi din bhi sardar banne ki khwahish nahin ki lekin us din sirf is khayal se ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jo tareef ki hai us ka tasdeeq karne wala Allah ke nazdeek main ban jaoon, isi liye main us roz sawere sawere Zohar ki namaz ke liye chal para, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye namaz-e-Zohar parhayi phir dayen bayen nazrein dorane lage main baar baar apni jagah ooncha hota tha taake aap ki nigahein mujh par paren, aap barabar baghaur dekhte hi rahe yahan tak ke nigahein Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) par paren unhein talab farmaya aur kaha ke in ke saath jao aur in ke ikhtilafat ka faisla haq se kar do chunancha Hazrat Abu Ubaidah (R.A) un ke saath tashreef le gaye Ibn Marduyah mein bhi yeh waqea isi tarah manqool hai lekin wahan sardaron ki ginti barah ki hai aur is waqea mein bhi qadre tawalut hai aur kuch zaid baatein bhi hain, Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein barwayat Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) marwi hai Najrani sardar Aaqib aur Sayyid mubahila ke irade se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye lekin ek ne dusre se kaha yeh na kar Allah ki qasam agar yeh Nabi hain aur hum ne in se mubahila kiya to hum apni auladon samet tabah ho jayenge chunancha phir dono ne muttafiq ho kar kaha Hazrat aap hum se jo talab farmate hain hum woh sab ada kar denge (yani jizya dena qabool kar liya) aap kisi ameen shakhs ko hamare saath kar dijiye aur ameen ko hi bhejna, aap ne farmaya behtar main tumhare saath kamil ameen ko hi karoon ga as-hab-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek dusre ko takne lage yeh dekhein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kis ka intekhab karte hain aap ne farmaya ae Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah tum kharay ho jao jab yeh kharay huye to aap ne farmaya yeh hain is ummat ke ameen, Sahih Bukhari Shareef ki aur hadees mein hai har ummat ka ameen hota hai aur is ummat ka ameen Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah hai (R.A) Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Abu Jahl maloon ne kaha.

Agar main Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Ka'aba mein namaz parhte dekh loon ga toh us ki gardan kuchal doon ga. Farmate hain ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar woh aisa karta toh sab ke sab dekhte ke farishte usay daboch lete, aur Yahudiyon se jab Quran ne kaha tha ke aao jhooton ke liye maut mango agar woh mangte toh yaqeenan sab ke sab mar jaate aur apni jaghein Jahannam ki aag mein dekh lete aur jin Nasraniyon ko mubahila ki dawat di gayi thi agar woh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke muqable mein mubahile ke liye nikalte toh laut kar apne maalon ko aur apne baal bachon ko na paate, Sahih Bukhari, Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Imam Tirmidhi isay Hasan kehte hain, Imam Baihaqi ne apni kitab Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein bhi wafd-e-Najran ke qissay ko taweel-tar bayan kiya hai, hum isay yahan naqal karte hain kyunke is mein bohat se fawaid hain go is mein gharabat bhi hai aur is maqam se woh nihayat munasibat rakhta hai, Salama bin Abd-e-Yasu' apne dada se riwayat karte hain jo pehle Nasrani thay phir Musalman ho gaye ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Surah Ta-Sin Quran mein nazil hone se peshtar Ahl-e-Najran ko nama-e-mubarak likha jis ki ibarat yeh thi: Bism-e-Ilah-e-Ibrahim wa Ishaq wa Ya'qub, min Muhammad-in-Nabi Rasool-illah, ila usquf-e-Najran wa ahl-e-Najran, aslim antum, fa-inni ahmadu ilaikum Ilah-e-Ibrahim wa Ishaq wa Ya'qub. Amma ba'd, fa-inni ad'ukum ila ibadat-illah min ibadat-il-ibad, wa ad'ukum ila wilayat-illah min wilayat-il-ibad, fa-in abaytum fal-jizyah, fa-in abaytum faqad adhintukum bi-harb, was-salam. Yani is khat ko main shuru karta hoon Hazrat Ibrahim, Hazrat Ishaq aur Hazrat Ya'qub ke Allah Ta'ala ke naam se, yeh khat hai Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf se jo Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat ke Nabi aur Rasool hain, Najran ke sardar ki taraf, Allah Ta'ala ki tumhare samne hamd-o-sana bayan karta hoon jo Hazrat Ibrahim, Hazrat Ishaq aur Hazrat Ya'qub ka Mabood hai, phir main tumhein dawat deta hoon ke bandon ki ibadat ko chhor kar Allah ki ibadat ki taraf aao aur bandon ki wilayat ko chhor kar Allah ki wilayat ki taraf aa jao, agar tum isay na mano toh jizya do aur mat-huti ikhtiyar karo agar is se bhi inkar ho toh tumhein larai ka elan hai, was-salam. Jab yeh khat usquf ko pahuncha aur us ne isay parha toh bara sat-pataya ghabra gaya aur tharane laga, jhat se Sharhail bin Wada'a ko bulwaya jo Hamdan qabila ka tha, sab se bara musheer-e-saltanat yahi tha, jab kabhi koi ahem kaam aa parta toh sab se pehle yani Aiham aur Sayyid aur Aaqib se bhi peshtar is se mashwara hota, jab yeh aa gaya toh usquf ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khat usay diya, jab us ne parh liya toh usquf ne poocha batao kya khayal hai?

Shurahil ne kaha badshah ko khoob ilm hai ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki aulad mein se Allah ke ek Nabi ke aane ka wada Allah ki kitab mein hai, kya ajab ke woh Nabi yahi ho, Amr-e-Nabuwwat mein kya raye de sakta hoon? Haan agar umoor-e-saltanat ki koi baat hoti toh beshak main apne dimagh par zor daal kar koi baat nikal leta. Usquf ne unhein toh alag bitha diya aur Abdullah bin Shurahil ko bulaya, yeh bhi musheer-e-saltanat tha aur Humair ke qabeelay mein se tha, usay khat diya, parhaya, raye poochhi toh usne bhi theek wahi baat kahi jo pehla musheer keh chuka tha. Usay bhi badshah ne door bitha diya, phir Jabbar bin Faiz ko bulaya jo Banu Haris mein se tha, usne bhi yahi kaha jo un dono ne kaha tha. Badshah ne jab dekha ke un teenon ki raye muttafiq hai toh hukum diya gaya ke naqoos bajaye jayen, aag jala di jaye aur garjon mein jhanday buland kar diye jayen. Wahan ka yeh dastoor tha ke jab saltanat ka koi ahem kaam hota toh raat ko jama karna maqsood hota toh yahi karte aur agar din ka waqt hota toh garjon mein aag jala di jaati aur naqoos zor-zor se bajaye jaate. Is hukum ke hote hi charon taraf aag jala di gayi aur naqoos ki aawaz ne har ek ko hoshiyar kar diya aur jhanday oonchay dekh-dekh kar aas-paas ki wadi ke tamam log jama hogaye. Is wadi ka tool itna tha ke tez sawar subh se sham tak dusre kinare pahunchta tha, is mein tehattar (73) gaon aabad thay aur ek lakh bees hazar talwar chalane wale yahan aabad thay. Jab yeh sab log aagaye toh Usquf ne unhein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka namah-e-mubarak parh kar sunaya aur poochha batao tumhari kya raye hai?

Toh tamam aqalmandon ne kaha ke Sharjeel bin Wada'ah Hamdani, Abdullah bin Sharjeel Asbahi aur Jabbar bin Faiz Harisi ko bator-e-wafad ke bheja jaye, yeh wahan se pukhta khabar layein. Ab yahan se yeh wafad in teenon ki sardari ke matahat rawana hua. Madina pahunch kar unhon ne safri libas utaar dala aur naqsh bane hue reshmi lambe lambe hullay pehan liye aur sone ki angoothiyan ungliyon mein daal lein aur apni chadaron ke pallay thaame hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hue, salam kiya lekin Aap (ﷺ) ne jawab na diya. Bahut der tak intezar kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) kuch baat karein lekin un reshmi hullon aur sone ki angoothiyon ki wajah se Aap (ﷺ) ne un se kalam bhi na kiya. Ab yeh log Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) aur Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf (R.A) ki talash mein nikle aur in dono buzurgon se in ki pehli mulaqat thi. Muhajireen aur Ansar ke ek majmay mein in dono hazrat ko pa liya, un se waqia bayan kiya, "Tumhare Nabi (ﷺ) ne hamein khat likha, hum us ka jawab dene ke liye khud hazir hue, Aap (ﷺ) ke paas gaye, salam kiya lekin jawab na diya, phir bahut der tak intezar mein baithe rahe ke Aap (ﷺ) se kuch baatein ho jatein lekin Aap (ﷺ) ne hum se koi baat na ki, aakhir hum log thak kar chale aaye. Ab Aap hazrat farmayein ke kya hum yunhi wapas chale jayein?" In dono ne Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) se kaha ke Aap hi inhe jawab dijiye. Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne farmaya, "Mera khayal hai ke yeh log apne hullay aur apni angoothiyan utaar dein aur wahi safri mamooli libas pehan kar Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein dobara jayein." Chunancha unhon ne yahi kiya aur usi mamooli libas mein gaye, salam kiya, Aap (ﷺ) ne jawab diya. Phir farmaya, "Us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath bheja hai, yeh jab mere paas pehli martaba aaye the toh in ke sath Iblees tha." Ab sawal jawab baat cheet shuru hui, Huzoor (ﷺ) bhi poochte the aur woh jawab dete the, isi tarah woh bhi sawal karte aur jawab paate. Aakhir mein unhon ne poocha, "Aap Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki babat kya farmate hain? Taake hum apni qoum ke paas ja kar woh kahein, hamein is ki khushi hai ke agar Aap Nabi hain toh Aap ki zubanein sunen ke Aap ka un ki babat kya khayal hai?" Toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Mere paas is ka jawab aaj toh nahin, tum thehro toh mera Rab mujh se is ki babat jo farmaye ga woh main tumhein suna doon ga." Dusre din woh phir aaye toh Aap (ﷺ) ne usi waqt ki utri hui is aayat (Inna masala Isa indallahi kamasali Adama khalaqahu min turabin summa qala lahu kun fayakun. Alhaqqu mir rabbika fala takum minal mumtareen. Faman hajjaka fihi mim ba'di ma ja'aka minal ilmi faqul ta'alau nad'u abna'ana wa abna'akum wa nisa'ana wa nisa'akum wa anfusana wa anfusakum summa nabtahil fanaj'al la'natallahi alal kazibeen) (Surah Al-Imran: 59-61) ki tilawat farmayi.

Aal-e-Imran: 59, 60, 61) Tilawat kar sunayi unhon ne is baat ka iqrar karne se inkar kardiya, dusre din subh hi subh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mula'ana ke liye Hazrat Hasan (R.A) ko aur Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ko apni chadar mein liye hue tashreef laye, peeche peeche Hazrat Fatima (R.A) aa rahi thin. Us waqt aap (ﷺ) ki kayi ek biwiyan thin. Sharjeel yeh dekhte hi apne dono sathiyon se kehne laga tum jante ho ke Najran ki sari wadi meri baat ko manti hai aur meri raye par karband hoti hai, suno Allah ki qasam yeh mamla bada bhari hai agar yeh shakhs (ﷺ) mab'oos kiya gaya hai to sab se pehle is ki nigahon mein hum hi mat'oon honge aur sab se pehle is ki tardeed karne wale hum hi thehrenge, yeh baat is ke aur is ke sathiyon ke dilon mein nahin jayegi aur hum par koi na koi museebat-o-aafat aayegi. Arab bhar mein sab se zyada qareeb in se main hi hoon aur suno agar yeh shakhs Nabi-e-Mursal hai to mubahila karte hi roo-e-zameen par ek baal ya ek nakhun bhi hamara na rahega. Is ke dono sathiyon ne kaha phir ae Abu Waiham aap ki kya raye hai? Us ne kaha meri raye yeh hai ke isi ko hum hakim banadein jo kuch yeh hukm de hum ise manzoor karlein, yeh kabhi bhi khilaf-e-adl hukm na dega. Un dono ne is baat ko tasleem karliya. Ab Sharjeel ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se kaha ke main is mula'ana se behtar cheez janab ke samne pesh karta hoon. Aap (ﷺ) ne daryaft farmaya woh kya? Kaha aaj ka din, aane wali raat aur kal ki subh tak aap hamare bare mein jo hukm karein hamein manzoor hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya shayad aur log tumhare is faisle ko na maanein. Sharjeel ne kaha is ki babat mere in dono sathiyon se daryaft farma lijiye. Aap (ﷺ) ne un dono se poocha unhon ne jawab diya ke sari wadi ke log inhi ki raye par chalte hain, wahan ek bhi aisa nahin jo in ke faisle ko taal sake. Pas Huzoor (ﷺ) ne yeh darkhwast qabool farmayi, mubahila na kiya aur wapas laut gaye. Dusre din subh hi woh hazir-e-khidmat hue to aap (ﷺ) ne ek tehreer unhein likh di ke jis mein Bismillah ke baad yeh mazmoon tha ke "Tehreer Allah ke Nabi Muhammad Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki taraf se Najraniyon ke liye hai, un par Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka hukm jari tha har phal, har siyah-o-safeed aur har ghulam par lekin Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) yeh sab inhi ko dete hain, yeh har saal sirf do hazar hullay de diya karein, ek hazar Rajab mein aur ek hazar Safar mein waghera waghera." Poora ahd-nama unhein ata farmaya. Is se maloom hota hai ke un ka yeh wafd san 9 Hijri mein aaya tha is liye ke Hazrat Zuhri (R.H) farmate hain sab se pehle jizya inhi Ahl-e-Najran ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko ada kiya, aur jizya ki aayat Fatah-e-Makkah ke baad utri hai jo yeh hai (QATILUL-LADHINA LA YU'MINUNA BILLAHI WALA BIL-YAWMIL-AKHIRI WALA YUHARRIMUNA MA HARRAMALLAHU WA RASULUHU WALA YADINUNA DINAL-HAQQI MINAL-LADHINA UTUL-KITABA HATTA YU'TUL-JIZYATA 'ANY-YADIW-WA HUM SAGHIRUN) 9.

(At-Taubah: 29) Is aayat mein Ahl-e-Kitab se jizya lene ka hukum hua hai, Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke Aaqib aur Tayyib Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye, Aap (ﷺ) ne unhein mula'ana ke liye kaha aur subh ko Hazrat Ali (R.A) aur Hazrat Fatima (R.A) aur Hazrat Hasan (R.A) aur Hazrat Hussain (R.A) ko liye hue Aap (ﷺ) tashreef laye aur unhein kehla bheja, unhon ne qabool na kiya aur khiraj dena manzoor kar liya. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Uss ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke saath bheja hai, agar yeh dono "nahin" kehte toh in par yahi wadi aag barsati. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) farmate hain: "Nad'u abna'ana..." wali aayat inhi ke baare mein nazil hui hai. "Anfusana" se murad khud Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ), "Abna'ana" se murad Hasan (R.A) aur Hussain (R.A), "Nisa'ana" se murad Hazrat Fatima-tuz-Zahra (R.A). Mustadrak Hakim waghera mein bhi iss ma'ani ki hadith marwi hai. Phir Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hai: Yeh jo hum ne Isa (A.S) ki shaan farmayi hai, haq aur sach hai, iss mein baal barabar kami beshi nahin. Allah qabil-e-ibadat hai, koi aur nahin aur wahi ghalba wala aur hikmat wala hai. Ab bhi agar yeh munh pher lein aur dusri baaton mein padein toh Allah bhi aise batil pasandon ko aur mufsidon ko bakhoobi jaanta hai, unhein badtareen saza de ga. Iss mein poori qudrat hai, koi uss se na bhaag sake na uss ka muqabla kar sake. Woh paak hai aur tareefon wala hai, hum uss ke azaab se usi ki panah chahte hain.)

Yahudiyon aur Nasraniyon se khitab. Yahudiyon, Nasraniyon aur inhi jaise logon se yahan khitab ho raha hai, kalma ka itlaq mufeed jumle par hota hai, jaise yahan kalma keh kar phir sawa' al-kh ke sath is ki tareef yun ki gayi hai. Sawa ke ma'ni adl-o-insaf, jaise hum kahein hum tum barabar hain, phir is ki tafseer ki khas baat yeh hai ke hum ek Allah Ta'ala hi ki ibadat karein, us ke sath kisi but ko na poojein, saleeb, tasveer, Allah Ta'ala ke siwa kisi aur na aag ko na aur kisi cheez ko, balkeh tanha Allah Wahdahu La Sharika ki ibadat karein, yahi ibadat tamam Anbiya-e-Kiram ki thi, jaise farman hai aayat (Wa ma arsalna min qablika mir-rasulin illa noohi ilaihi annahu la ilaha illa ana fa'budoon) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 25), ya'ni tujh se pehle jis jis rasool ko hum ne bheja sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki mere siwa koi ibadat ke laiq nahin, pas tum sab meri hi ibadat kiya karo. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Wa laqad ba'athna fi kulli ummatir-rasoolan ani'budullaha wajtanibut-taghoot) (Surah An-Nahl: 36), ya'ni har ummat mein rasool bhej kar hum ne yeh elan karwaya ke sirf Allah ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa sab se bacho. Phir farmata hai ke aapas mein bhi hum Allah Jalla Jalaluhu ko chhod kar ek dusre ko rab na banayein, Ibn Juraij farmate hain ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani mein ek dusre ki ita'at na karein. Ikrama farmate hain kisi ko siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke sajda na karein, phir agar yeh log is haq aur adl dawat ko bhi qabool na karein to inhe tum apne musalman hone ka gawah bana lo. Hum ne Bukhari ki sharah mein is waqiye ka mufassal zikr kar diya hai jis mein hai ke Abu Sufyan jabkeh darbar-e-Qaisar mein bulwaye gaye aur Shah-e-Qaisar-e-Room ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke nasab ka haal pucha to unhein kafir aur dushman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hone ke bawajood aap ki khandani sharafat ka iqrar karna pada aur isi tarah har sawal ka saaf aur sacha jawab dena pada. Yeh waqiya Sulh-e-Hudaibiya ke baad ka aur Fatah-e-Makkah se pehle ka hai, isi ba'is Qaisar ke is sawal ke jawab mein ke kya woh (ya'ni Rasool Allah ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bad'ahdi karte hain? Abu Sufyan ne kaha nahin karte, lekin ab ek mu'ahida hamara un se hua hai nahin maloom is mein woh kya karein?

Yahan sirf yeh maqsad hai ke in tamam baaton ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka nama-e-mubarak pesh kiya jata hai jis mein Bismillah ke baad yeh likha hota hai ke yeh khat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf se hai jo Allah ke Rasool hain (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), Harqal ki taraf jo Room ka shah hai, Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se salam ho use jo hidayat ka tabe-dar ho, is ke baad Islam qabool kar salamat rahega, Islam qabool kar Allah Ta'ala tujhe dohra ajar dega aur agar tu ne munh moda to tamam raeeson ke gunahon ka bojh tujh par padega, phir yahi aayat likhi thi. Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) waghera ne likha hai ke is surat yani Surah Al-Imran ko shuru se lekar "Inni" se kuch oopar tak aayatein wafd-e-Najran ke bare mein nazil hui hain. Imam Zuhri (R.H) farmate hain sab se pehle jizya inhi logon ne ada kiya hai aur is baat mein bhi mutlaqan ikhtilaf nahin hai ke aayat-e-jizya Fatah-e-Makkah ke baad utri hai, pas yeh aitraz hota hai ke jab yeh aayat Fatah-e-Makkah ke baad nazil hui hai to phir fatah se pehle Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne khat mein Harqal ko yeh aayat kaise likhi? Is ke jawab kayi ho sakte hain, ek to yeh ke mumkin hai yeh aayat do martaba utri ho, awwal Hudaibiya se pehle aur Fatah-e-Makkah ke baad. Dusra jawab yeh hai ke mumkin hai shuru-e-surat se lekar is aayat tak wafd-e-Najran ke bare mein utri ho ya yeh aayat is se pehle utar chuki ho, is surat mein Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) ka yeh farmana ke isi ke oopar ki kuch aayatein isi wafd ke bare mein utri hain yeh mehfooz na ho kyunke Abu Sufyan (R.A) wala waqea sarasar is ke khilaf hai. Teesra jawab yeh hai ke mumkin hai wafd-e-Najran Hudaibiya se pehle aaya ho aur unhon ne jo kuch dena manzoor kiya ho yeh sirf mubahila se bachne ke liye bator-e-musalehat ke ho na ke jizya diya ho aur yeh ittefaq ki baat ho ke aayat-e-jizya is waqea ke baad utri jis se is ka ittefaqan ilhaq ho gaya. Jaise ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Jahsh (R.A) ne Badr se pehle ghazwe ke maal-e-ghaneemat ko paanch hisson mein taqseem kiya aur paanchwan hissa baqi rakh kar dusre hisse lashkar mein taqseem kar diye, phir is ke baad maal-e-ghaneemat ki taqseem ki aayatein bhi isi ke mutabiq utrin aur yahi hukum hua. Chautha jawab yeh hai ke ehtemal hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne khat mein jo Harqal ko bheja us mein yeh baat isi tarah bator-e-khud likhi ho phir Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke alfaaz hi mein wahi nazil hui ho, jaise ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ke parde ke hukum ke bare mein isi tarah aayat utri, aur badwi qaidiyon ke bare mein inhi ke hum-khayal farman-e-bari nazil hua, isi tarah munafiqon ka janaza padhne ki babat bhi inhi ki baat qaim rakhi gayi, chunancha Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke musalle banane se mutaliq bhi isi tarah wahi nazil hui aur aayat (عَسٰى رَبُّهٗٓ اِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ اَنْ يُّبْدِلَهٗٓ اَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِّنْكُنَّ مُسْلِمٰتٍ مُّؤْمِنٰتٍ قٰنِتٰتٍ تٰۗىِٕبٰتٍ عٰبِدٰتٍ سٰۗىِٕحٰتٍ ثَيِّبٰتٍ وَّاَبْكَارًا) (66-At-Tahrim: 5) bhi inhi ke khayal se mutaliq aayat utri, pas yeh aayat bhi isi tarah Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman ke mutabiq hi utri ho, yeh bohat mumkin hai.

Hazrat Ibrahim A.S se mutaliq Yahudi aur Nasrani da'we ki tardeed. Yahudi Hazrat Ibrahim ko apne mein se aur Nasrani bhi Hazrat Ibrahim ko apne mein se kehte thay aur aapas mein is par behas mubahise karte rehte thay. Allah Ta'ala in aayaton mein dono ke da'we ki tardeed karta hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke Najran ke Nasraniyon ke paas Yahudiyon ke ulama aaye aur Huzoor ﷺ ke samne un ka jhagda shuru ho gaya, har fareeq is baat ka mudda'i tha ke Hazrat Khalilullah hum mein se thay. Is par yeh aayat utri ke ae Yahudiyo tum Khalilullah ko apne mein se kaise batate ho? Halankeh un ke zamane mein na Musa thay na Taurat. Hazrat Musa A.S aur Kitab-e-Taurat Sharif to Khalilullah A.S ke baad aaye. Isi tarah ae Nasraniyo Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ko Nasrani kaise keh sakte ho? Halankeh Nasraniyat to un ke sadiyon baad zuhoor mein aayi. Kya tum itni moti baat ke samajhne ki aql bhi nahin rakhte? Phir in dono firqon ki is be-ilmi ke jhagde par Rabb-e-Do Aalam unhein malamat karta hai. Agar tum behas-o-mubahisa deeni umoor mein jo tumhare paas hain karte to bhi khair ek baat thi, tum to is bare mein guftagu karte ho jis ka dono ko mutlaq ilm hi nahin. Tumhein chahiye ke jis cheez ka ilm na ho use us Aleem Allah ke hawale karo jo har cheez ki haqeeqat ko janta hai aur chupi khuli tamam cheezon ka ilm rakhta hai. Isi liye farmaya Allah janta hai aur tum mehez be-khabar ho. Dar-asal Allah ke Khalilullah Hazrat Ibrahim A.S na to Yahudi thay na Nasrani thay, woh shirk se bezar, mushrikon se alag, sahih aur kamil iman ke malik thay aur hargiz mushrik na thay. Yeh aayat us aayat ki misl hai jo Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki aayat (Wa qalu kunu hudan au nasara tahtadu) (Al-Baqarah: 135) yani yeh log kehte hain Yahudi ya Nasrani banne mein hidayat hai. Phir farmaya ke sab se zyada Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki tabedari ke haqdar un ke deen par un ke zamane mein chalne wale thay aur ab yeh Nabi Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ hain aur aap ke sath ke imandaron ki jamaat jo Muhajireen-o-Ansar hain aur phir jo bhi un ki pairwi karte rahein Qayamat tak. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain har Nabi ke wali dost nabiyon mein se hote hain, mere wali dost ambiya mein se mere baap aur Allah ke Khalil Hazrat Ibrahim A.S As-Salatu Was-Salam hain, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi (Tirmidhi waghera). Phir farmaya jo bhi Allah ke Rasool par iman rakhe wahi un ka wali Allah hai.

Dar-asal Allah ke Khalilullah Hazrat Ibrahim A.S na to Yahudi thay na Nasrani thay, woh shirk se bezar, mushrikon se alag, sahih aur kamil iman ke malik thay aur hargiz mushrik na thay. Yeh aayat us aayat ki misl hai jo Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki aayat (Wa qalu kunu hudan au nasara tahtadu) (Al-Baqarah: 135) yani yeh log kehte hain Yahudi ya Nasrani banne mein hidayat hai. Phir farmaya ke sab se zyada Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki tabedari ke haqdar un ke deen par un ke zamane mein chalne wale thay aur ab yeh Nabi Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ hain aur aap ke sath ke imandaron ki jamaat jo Muhajireen-o-Ansar hain aur phir jo bhi un ki pairwi karte rahein Qayamat tak. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain har Nabi ke wali dost nabiyon mein se hote hain, mere wali dost ambiya mein se mere baap aur Allah ke Khalil Hazrat Ibrahim A.S As-Salatu Was-Salam hain, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi (Tirmidhi waghera). Phir farmaya jo bhi Allah ke Rasool par iman rakhe wahi un ka wali Allah hai.

Yahudi Hazrat Ibrahim ko apne mein se aur Nasrani bhi Hazrat Ibrahim ko apne mein se kehte thay aur aapas mein is par behas mubahise karte rehte thay. Allah Ta'ala in aayaton mein dono ke da'we ki tardeed karta hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke Najran ke Nasraniyon ke paas Yahudiyon ke ulama aaye aur Huzoor ﷺ ke samne un ka jhagda shuru ho gaya, har fareeq is baat ka mudda'i tha ke Hazrat Khalilullah hum mein se thay. Is par yeh aayat utri ke ae Yahudiyo tum Khalilullah ko apne mein se kaise batate ho? Halankeh un ke zamane mein na Musa thay na Taurat. Hazrat Musa A.S aur Kitab-e-Taurat Sharif to Khalilullah A.S ke baad aaye. Isi tarah ae Nasraniyo Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ko Nasrani kaise keh sakte ho? Halankeh Nasraniyat to un ke sadiyon baad zuhoor mein aayi. Kya tum itni moti baat ke samajhne ki aql bhi nahin rakhte? Phir in dono firqon ki is be-ilmi ke jhagde par Rabb-e-Do Aalam unhein malamat karta hai. Agar tum behas-o-mubahisa deeni umoor mein jo tumhare paas hain karte to bhi khair ek baat thi, tum to is bare mein guftagu karte ho jis ka dono ko mutlaq ilm hi nahin. Yahudiyon ka hasad yahan bayan ho raha hai ke in Yahudiyon ke hasad ko dekho ke Musalmanon se kaise jal bhun rahe hain. Inhein behkane ki kya kya posheeda tarkeebain kar rahe hain kaise kaise makr-o-fareb ke jaal bichhate hain, halankeh darasal in tamam cheezon ka wabaal khud in ki jaanon par hai lekin inhein is ka bhi shaoor nahin. Phir inhein in ki yeh zaleel harkat yaad dilayi ja rahi hai ke tum sachayi jante hue bhi haq ko pehchante hue Allah Ta'ala ki ayaat se yeh munkir ho rahe ho. Ilm ke bawajood yeh bad-khaslat bhi in mein hai, ke haq-o-batil ko mila dete hain, aur in ki kitabon mein jo sifatein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hain un ko chhupa lete hain. Behkane ki jo soortein banate hain in mein se ek yeh bhi hai ke aapas mein mashware karte hain ke subh ja kar iman le aao Musalmanon ke sath namazein padho aur sham ko phir murtad ban jao taake jahil logon ke dil mein bhi khayal guzre ke aakhir yeh log jo palat gaye to zahir hai ke unhon ne is deen mein koi kharabi ya burayi hi dekhi hogi to kya ajab ke in mein se koi hamari taraf toot aaye, garz yeh ek heela joi thi ke shayad is se koi kamzor iman wala laut jaye aur kuch samajh le ke yeh janne boojhne wale log jab is deen mein aaye namazein padhein is ke baad ise chhod diya to zaroor yahan koi kharabi aur nuqsan dekha hoga. Yeh log kehte hain ke bharosa apne walon par karo Musalmanon par na karo na apne bhed in par zahir hone do na apni kitabein inhein batao jis se yeh in par iman layein aur Allah Ta'ala ke han bhi in ke liye hum par hujjat ban jayein. To Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke to ae Nabi keh de ke hidayat to Allah hi ke hath hai woh mominon ke dilon ko har us cheez par iman lane ke liye amada kar deta hai jise Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmaya ho inhein in dalail par kamil iman naseeb hota hai chahe tum Nabi-e-Ummi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifatein chhupate phiro lekin phir bhi khush qismat log to aap ki nabuwat ke zahiri nishan ko ba-ek nigah pehchan lenge. Isi tarah kehte the ke tumhare paas jo ilm hai ise Musalmanon par zahir na karo ke woh ise seekh kar tum jaise ho jayein balkeh apni imani quwwat ki wajah se tum se bhi badh jayein, ya Allah ke samne in ki hujjat-o-daleel qaim ho jaye yani khud tumhari kitabon se woh tumhein ilzam dein, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke tum keh do fazl to Allah Azzawajal ke hath hai jise chahe de, sab kaam isi ke qabze mein hain wohi dene wala hai jise chahe iman amal aur ilm-o-fazl ki daulat se malamal kar de aur jise chahe rah-e-haq se andha aur kalma-e-Islam se behra aur sahi samajh se mehroom kar de is ke sab kaam hikmat se hi hote hain woh wasee ilm wala hai. Jise chahe apni rahmat ke sath khas kar de woh bade fazl wala hai, ae Musalmano! Us ne tum par be-payan ehsanat kiye hain tumhare Nabi ko tamam ambiya par fazeelat di aur bahut hi kamil aur har haisiyat se poori shariat us ne tumhein di.

Isi tarah kehte the ke tumhare paas jo ilm hai ise Musalmanon par zahir na karo ke woh ise seekh kar tum jaise ho jayein balkeh apni imani quwwat ki wajah se tum se bhi badh jayein, ya Allah ke samne in ki hujjat-o-daleel qaim ho jaye yani khud tumhari kitabon se woh tumhein ilzam dein, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke tum keh do fazl to Allah Azzawajal ke hath hai jise chahe de, sab kaam isi ke qabze mein hain wohi dene wala hai jise chahe iman amal aur ilm-o-fazl ki daulat se malamal kar de aur jise chahe rah-e-haq se andha aur kalma-e-Islam se behra aur sahi samajh se mehroom kar de is ke sab kaam hikmat se hi hote hain woh wasee ilm wala hai. Jise chahe apni rahmat ke sath khas kar de woh bade fazl wala hai, ae Musalmano! Us ne tum par be-payan ehsanat kiye hain tumhare Nabi ko tamam ambiya par fazeelat di aur bahut hi kamil aur har haisiyat se poori shariat us ne tumhein di.

Baddiyanat Yahudi: Allah Ta'ala mominon ko Yahudiyon ki khayanat par tanbeeh karta hai ke un ke dhoke mein na aa jayen. Un mein ba'az toh amanatdar hain aur ba'az bade khayin hain. Ba'az toh aise hain ke khazane ka khazana un ki amanat mein ho toh joon ka toon hawaley kar denge, phir chhoti moti cheez mein woh baddiyanati kaise karenge? Aur ba'az aise baddiyanat hain ke ek dinar bhi wapas na denge. Haan agar un ke sar ho jao, taqaza barabar jaari rakho aur haq talab karte raho toh shayad amanat nikal bhi aaye, warna hazam bhi kar jayen. Jab ek dinar toh mashhoor hi hai, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Malik bin Dinar R.H ka qaul marwi hai ke dinar ko is liye dinar kehte hain ke woh deen ya'ni imaan bhi hai aur naar ya'ni aag bhi hai. Matlab yeh hai ke haq ke sath lo toh deen, na-haq lo toh naar ya'ni aatish-e-dozakh. Is mauqe par is hadith ka bayan karna bhi munasib maloom hota hai jo Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein kayi jagah hai aur Kitab-ul-Kafala mein bahut poori hai.

Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya Bani Israel mein ek shakhs tha jis ne kisi aur shakhs se ek hazaar deenar qarz maange. Us ne kaha gawah lao, kaha Allah ki gawahi kaafi hai. Us ne kaha zaamin lao, us ne kaha zamaanat bhi Allah hi deta hoon. Woh is par raazi ho gaya aur waqt-e-adaigi muqarrar kar ke raqam de di. Woh apne daryai safar mein nikal gaya, jab kaam kaaj se nipt gaya toh darya kinare kisi jahaz ka intezar karne laga taake ja kar us ka qarz ada kar de, lekin sawari na mili. Toh us ne ek lakdi li aur use beech mein se khokhla kar ke us mein ek hazaar deenar rakh diye aur ek khat bhi us ke naam rakh diya, phir munh band kar ke use darya mein daal diya aur kaha: Aye Allah! Tu bakhoobi jaanta hai ke main ne falaan shakhs se ek hazaar deenar qarz liye teri shahadat par aur teri zamaanat par, aur us ne bhi is par khush ho kar mujhe de diye. Ab main ne har chand kashti dhoondi ke ja kar us ka haq muddat ke andar hi andar de doon lekin na mili. Pas ab aajiz aa kar tujh par bharosa kar ke main ise darya mein daal deta hoon, tu ise us tak pahuncha de. Yeh dua kar ke lakdi ko samundar mein daal kar chala aaya, lakdi paani mein doob gayi. Yeh phir bhi talash mein raha ke koi sawari mile toh jaye aur us ka haq ada kar aaye. Udhar qarz khwah shakhs darya ke kinare ya ke shayad maqrooz kisi kashti mein us ki raqam le kar aa raha ho, jab dekha ke koi kashti nahi aayi aur jaane laga toh ek lakdi ko jo kinare par padi hui thi yeh samajh kar utha liya ke jalane ke kaam aayegi. Ghar ja kar use cheera toh maal aur khat nikla. Kuch dinon baad qarz dene wala shakhs aaya aur kaha: Allah Ta'ala jaanta hai main ne har chand koshish ki ke koi sawari mile toh aap ke paas aaun aur muddat guzarne se pehle hi aap ka qarz ada kar doon lekin koi sawari na mili is liye der lag gayi. Us ne kaha: Tu ne jo raqam bhej di thi woh Allah ne mujhe pahuncha di hai, toh ab apni yeh raqam wapas le ja aur raazi khushi lauta ja. Yeh hadees Bukhari Shareef mein taleeq ke saath bhi hai lekin jazm ke seeghay ke saath aur baaz jagah asnaad ke hawalon ke saath bhi hai. Alawa azeen aur kitabon mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai. Phir farmata hai ke amaanat mein khayanat karne, haqdaar ke haq ko na ada karne par aamada karne wala sabab un ka yeh ghalat khayal hai ke in baddino, an-parhon ka maal kha jaane mein hamein koi harj nahin, hum par yeh maal halaal hai, jis par Allah farmata hai ke yeh Allah par ilzaam hai aur is ka ilm khud unhein bhi hai kyunke un ki kitabon mein bhi na-haq maal ko Allah ne haraam qarar diya hai.

Lekin yeh bewaqoof khud apni man-mani aur dil-pasand baatein ghad kar shariat ke rang mein unhein rang lete hain, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se log masala poochte hain ke zimmi ya kuffar ki murghi, bakri waghera kabhi ghazwe ki halat mein hamein mil jati hai to hum to samajhte hain ke ise lene mein koi harj nahin, to aap ne farmaya theek yahi Ahl-e-Kitab bhi kehte the ke ummatiyon ka maal lene mein koi harj nahin, suno jab woh jizya ada kar rahe hain to un ka koi maal tum par halal nahin, haan woh apni khushi se de dein to aur baat hai (Abdur Razzaq). Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain jab Ahl-e-Kitab se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh baat suni to farmaya dushmanan-e-Ilah jhoote hain, jahiliyat ki tamam rasmein mere qadmon tale mit gayin aur amanat to har fasiq-o-fajir ki bhi ada karni padegi. Phir irshad hota hai ke lekin jo shakhs apne ahd ko pura kare aur Ahl-e-Kitab ho kar darta rahe, phir apni kitab ki hidayat ke mutabiq Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman laye, us ahd ke mutabiq jo tamam ambiya se bhi ho chuka hai aur jis ahd ki pabandi un ki ummaton par bhi lazim hai, Allah ki haram karda cheezon se ijtinab kare, us ki shariat ki itaat kare, rasoolon ke khatam aur ambiya ke sardar Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki poori tabedari kare, woh muttaqi hai aur muttaqi Allah Ta'ala ke dost hain.

Jhooti qasam khane wale yani jo Ahl-e-Kitab Allah ke ahd ka paas nahin karte, na Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki itteba karte hain, na Aap ki sifat-on ka zikr logon se karte hain, na Aap ke mutaliq bayan karte hain aur isi tarah jhooti qasmein khate hain aur in badkariyon se woh is zaleel aur fani duniya ka faida hasil karte hain. In ke liye aakhirat mein koi hissa nahin, na in se Allah Ta'ala koi pyar mohabbat ki baat karega, na in par rahmat ki nazar daale ga, na unhein in ke gunahon se paak saaf karega, balkeh unhein jahannam mein dakhil karne ka hukum dega aur wahan woh dardnak sazayein bhugat-te rahenge. Is aayat ke mutaliq bahut si hadeesein bhi hain jin mein se kuch yahan bhi hum bayan karte hain. 001 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Teen qisam ke log hain jin se na Allah Jalla Shanuhu kalam karega aur na un ki taraf Qayamat ke din nazar-e-rahmat se dekhega, aur na unhein paak karega. Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne yeh sun kar kaha: Yeh kaun log hain ya Rasool Allah? Yeh to bade ghate aur nuqsan mein pade. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne teen martaba yahi farmaya, phir jawab diya keh: Takhnon se neeche kapda latkane wala, jhooti qasam se apna sauda bechne wala, de kar ehsan jatane wala. Muslim waghera mein bhi yeh hadees hai. 002 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Abu Ahmas farmate hain: Main Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) se mila aur un se kaha keh main ne suna hai keh aap Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek hadees bayan farmate hain? To farmaya suno, main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par jhoot to bol nahin sakta jabkeh main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sun liya ho. To kahiye woh hadees kya hai? Jawab diya yeh keh teen qisam ke logon ko Allah Zul-Karam dost rakhta hai aur teen qisam ke logon ko dushman. To farmane lage: Haan, yeh hadees main ne bayan ki hai aur main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni bhi hai. Main ne poocha kis kis ko dost rakhta hai? Farmaya: Ek to woh jo mardangi se dushmanan-e-Allah Subhanahu ke muqable mein maidan-e-jihad mein khada ho jaye, ya to apna seena chalni karwa le ya fath kar ke laute. Doosra woh shakhs jo kisi qafle ke sath safar mein hai, bahut raat gaye tak qafila chalta raha, jab thak kar choor ho gaye padao dala to sab so gaye aur yeh jaagta raha aur namaz mein mashghool raha yahan tak keh kooch ke waqt sab ko jaga diya.

Teesra woh shakhs jis ka parosi usay eeza pohanchata ho aur woh us par sabr-o-zabt karay yahan tak ke maut ya safar in dono mein judai karay, main ne kaha aur woh teen kaun hain jin se Allah Ta'ala na-khush hai? Farmaya: Bohat qasmein khanay wala tajir, aur takabbur karnay wala faqir aur woh bakheel jis se kabhi ehsan ho gaya ho to jatane baithay, yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb hai. 003 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Kunda qabeelay ke aik shakhs Amru-ul-Qais bin Aamir ka jhagda aik Hazrami shakhs se zameen ke baray mein tha jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samnay pesh hua to Aap ne farmaya ke Hazrami apna suboot pesh karay, us ke paas koi suboot na tha to Aap ne farmaya ab Kundi qasam kha lay, to Hazrami kehne laga Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab is ki qasam par hi faisla thehra to Rabb-e-Kaaba ki qasam yeh meri zameen le jaye ga, Aap ne farmaya jo shakhs jhooti qasam se kisi ka maal apna kar lay ga to jab woh Allah Ta'ala se milay ga Allah us se na-khush hoga, phir Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat farmayi, to Amru-ul-Qais ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah agar to koi chhor day to usay ajar kya milay ga? Aap ne farmaya Jannat, to kehne lagay Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) gawah rahiye ke main ne woh saari zameen us ke naam chhori, yeh hadith Nasai mein bhi hai. 004 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain jo shakhs jhooti qasam khaye taake is se kisi Musalman ka maal chheen lay to Allah Jal-e-Jalaluhu se jab milay ga to Allah Azza-wa-Jal us par sakht ghazab-naak hoga, Hazrat Ash'as farmatay hain Allah ki qasam meray hi baray mein yeh hai, aik Yahoodi aur meri shirkat mein aik zameen thi us ne meray hissay ki zameen ka inkaar kar diya, main usay khidmat-e-Nabwi mein laya, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujh se farmaya teray paas kuch suboot hai? Main ne kaha nahin, Aap ne Yahoodi se farmaya tu qasam kha lay, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh to qasam kha lay ga aur mera maal le jaye ga, pas Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne yeh aayat nazil farmayi, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. 005 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmatay hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai jo shakhs kisi mard-e-Muslim ka maal baghair haq ke le lay woh Allah Zul-Jalal se is haal mein milay ga ke Allah Ta'ala us se naraz hoga, wahin Hazrat Ash'as bin Qais (R.A) aagay aaye aur farmanay lagay Abu Abdur-Rahman aap koi si hadith bayan kartay hain?

Hum ne dohra di toh farmaya yeh hadith mere hi bare mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne irshad farmayi hai, mera apne chacha ke ladke se ek kunwein ke bare mein jhagda tha jo uske qabze mein tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas jab hum apna muqadma le gaye toh aap ne farmaya tu apni daleel aur suboot la ke yeh kunwan tera hai warna uski qasam par faisla hoga. Main ne kaha ya Hazrat mere paas toh koi daleel nahin aur agar is qasam par mamla raha toh yeh toh mera kunwan le jayega, mera muqabil toh fajir shakhs hai. Is waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh hadith bhi bayan farmayi aur is aayat ki bhi tilawat ki. 006 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ke kuch bande aise bhi hain jin se Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din baat na karega na unki taraf dekhega, poocha gaya ke ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh kaun hain? Farmaya apne maa baap se bezar hone wale aur un se beraghibti karne wali ladki aur apni aulad se bezar aur alag hone wala baap aur woh shakhs ke jis par kisi qaum ka ehsan hai woh us se inkar kar jaye aur aankhein pher le aur un se yaksooi kare. 007 Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abi Aufa (R.A) farmate hain ke ek shakhs ne apna sauda bazaar mein rakha aur qasam khayi ke woh itna bhau diya jata tha taake koi Musalman is mein phans jaye, pas yeh aayat nazil hui, Sahih Bukhari mein bhi yeh riwayat marwi hai. 008 Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain teen shakhson se Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala Qayamat wale din baat na karega na unki taraf dekhega na unhein paak karega aur unke liye dukh dard ke azab hain, ek woh jiske paas bacha hua pani hai phir woh kisi musafir ko nahin deta, doosra woh jo Asr ke baad jhooti qasam kha kar apna maal farokht karta hai, teesra woh badshah Musalman se bai'at karta hai uske baad agar woh use maal de toh poori karta hai agar nahin deta toh nahin karta hai, yeh hadith Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain.

Ghalat ta'weel aur tahreef karne wale log: Yahan bhi unhi mal'oon Yahudiyon ka zikr ho raha hai ke un ka ek giroh yeh bhi karta hai ke ibarat ko us ki asal jagah se hata deta hai, yani Allah ki kitab badal deta hai, asal matlab aur sahih ma'ni khabt kar deta hai aur jahilon ko is chakkar mein daal deta hai ke Kitabullah yahi hai, phir yeh khud apni zaban se bhi ise Kitabullah keh kar jahilon ke is khayal ko aur mazboot kar deta hai aur jaan boojh kar Allah Ta'ala par iftira karta hai aur jhoot bakta hai, zaban modne se matlab yahan tahreef karna hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein marwi hai ke yeh log tahreef aur izala kar dete thay, makhlooq mein aisa to koi nahin jo kisi Allah ki kitab ka lafz badal de magar yeh log tahreef aur be-ja ta'weel karte thay. Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) farmate hain ke Taurat-o-Injeel isi tarah hain jis tarah Allah Ta'ala ne utarein, ek harf bhi un mein se Allah ne nahin badla lekin yeh log tahreef aur ta'weel se logon ko gumrah karte hain aur jo kitabein unhon ne apni taraf se likh li hain aur jise woh Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se mashhoor kar rahe hain aur logon ko behkate hain halankeh darasal woh Allah ki taraf se nahin, Allah ki asli kitabein to mehfooz hain jo badalti nahin (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Hazrat Wahb (R.H) ke is farman ka agar yeh matlab ho ke un ke paas ab jo kitab hai to hum bil-yaqeen kehte hain ke woh badli hui hai aur muharraf hai aur ziyadati aur nuqsan se hargiz paak nahin aur phir jo Arabi zaban mein hamare hathon mein hai us mein to badi ghaltiyan hain, kahin mazmoon ko kam kar diya gaya hai kahin badha diya gaya hai aur saaf saaf ghaltiyan majood hain, balkeh darasal ise tarjuma kehna zeba hi nahin, woh to tafsir aur woh bhi be-aitibar tafsir hai aur phir un samajhdaron ki likhi hui tafsir hai jin mein aksar balkeh kul ke kul darasal mehez ulti samajh wale hain aur agar Hazrat Wahb (R.H) ke farman ka yeh matlab ho ke Allah Ta'ala ki kitab jo darhaqiqat Allah ki kitab hai pas woh beshak mehfooz-o-salim hai, us mein kami ziyadati namumkin hai.

Maqsad-e-Nabuwwat: Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ke paas jab Yahudiyon aur Najrani Nasraniyon ke ulama jama hue aur Aap (ﷺ) ne unhein Islam qabool karne ki dawat di thi to Abu Raqim Qurzi kehne laga ke kya Aap (ﷺ) yeh chahte hain ke jis tarah Nasraniyon ne Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ki ibadat ki hum bhi Aap (ﷺ) ki ibadat karein? To Najran ke ek Nasrani ne bhi jise "Aais" kaha jata tha yahi kaha ke kya Aap (ﷺ) ki yahi khwahish hai? Aur yahi dawat hai? To Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya Ma'az Allah, na hum khud Allah Wahdahu La Sharika ke siwa dusre ki puja karein, na kisi aur ko Allah ke siwa dusre ki ibadat ki taleem dein, na meri paighambari ka yeh maqsad, na mujhe Allah Hakim-e-Aala ka yeh hukum. Is par yeh aayatein nazil huin, ke kisi insaan ko Kitab-o-Hikmat aur Nabuwwat-o-Risalat pa lene ke baad yeh laiq hi nahin ke apni parastish ki taraf logon ko bulaye. Jab Anbiya-e-Kiram ka jo itni badi buzurgi, fazilat aur martabe wale hain yeh mansab nahin to kisi aur ko kab laiq hai ke apni puja paat karaye, aur apni bandagi ki talqeen logon ko kare. Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain adna momin se bhi yeh nahin ho sakta ke woh logon ko apni bandagi ki dawat de. Yahan yeh is liye farmaya ke yeh Yahud-o-Nasara aapas mein hi ek dusre ko pujte the, Quran shahid hai jo farmata hai (Aayat: Ittakhazu ahbarahum wa ruhbanahum arbaban min dunillahi... Al-Aayah), yani un logon ne Allah Ta'ala ko chhod apne aalimon aur darveshon ko apna Rabb bana liya hai. Musnad-e-Tirmidhi ki woh hadith bhi aa rahi hai ke Hazrat Adi bin Hatim (R.A) ne Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein arz kiya ke woh to un ki ibadat nahin karte the, to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya kyun nahin? Woh un par haram ko halal aur halal ko haram kar dete the aur yeh un ki maante chale jate the, yahi un ki ibadat thi. Pas jahil darvesh aur be-samajh ulama aur mashaikh is muzammat aur daant-dupat mein dakhil hain. Rasool (ﷺ) aur un ki itteba karne wale ulama-e-kiram is se yaksu hain, is liye ke woh to sirf Allah Ta'ala ke farman aur Kalam-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ki tabligh karte hain aur un kamon se rokte hain jin se Anbiya-e-Kiram rok gaye hain. Allah Ta'ala ke bheje hue Hazrat Anbiya (A.S) to Khaliq-o-Makhlooq ke darmiyan safeer hain, haq-e-risalat ada karte hain aur Allah ki amanat ehtiyat ke sath bandagan-e-Rabb-e-Aalam ko pahuncha dete hain. Nihayat bedari, mukammal hoshiyari, kamal-e-nigrani aur puri hifazat ke sath woh sari makhlooq ke khair-khwah hote hain, woh ahkam-e-Rabb-e-Rahman ke pehchanne wale hote hain. Rasoolon ki hidayat to logon ko Rabbani banne ki hoti hai ke woh hikmaton wale, ilm wale aur hilm wale ban jayen, samajhdar, aabid-o-zahid, muttaqi aur parsa hain. Hazrat Zahhak (R.H) farmate hain ke Quran seekhne walon par haq hai ke woh ba-samajh hon. Ta'lamuna aur Tu'allimuna dono qira'at hain, pehle ke ma'ne hain ma'ne samajhne ke, dusre ke ma'ne hain taleem hasil karne ke, Tadrusuna ke ma'ne hain alfaaz yaad karne ke.

Phir irshad hai ke woh yeh hukum nahin karte ke Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki ibadat karo khwah woh Nabi ho bheja hua khwah farishta ho qurb-e-Ilahi wala, yeh toh wohi kar sakta hai jo Allah ke siwa dusre ki ibadat ki dawat de aur jo aisa kare woh kafir ho aur kufr Nabiyon ka kaam nahin unka kaam toh imaan lana hai aur imaan naam hai Allah-e-Wahid ki ibadat aur parastish ka, aur yahi Nabiyon ki dawat hai, jaise khud Quran farmata hai (Aayat: Wa ma arsalna min qablika mir rasulin illa nuhi ilaihi annahu la ilaha illa ana fa'budun) yani tujh se pehle bhi hum ne jitne Rasool bheje sab par yahi wahi nazil ki ke mere siwa koi mabood hai hi nahin tum sab meri ibadat karte raho aur farmaya (Aayat: Wa laqad ba'athna fi kulli ummatir rasulan ani'budullaha wajtanibut taghut) yani hum ne har ummat mein Rasool bheja ke tum Allah ki ibadat karo aur Allah ke siwa har kisi ki ibadat se bacho, irshad hai tujh se pehle tamam Rasoolon se pooch lo kya hum ne apni zaat-e-Rahman ke siwa unki ibadat ke liye kisi aur ko muqarrar kiya tha? Farishton ki taraf se khabar deta hai ke (Aayat: Man yaqul minhum al-kh) un mein se agar koi keh de ke main mabood hoon bajuz Allah toh use bhi Jahannam ki saza dein aur isi tarah hum zalimon ko badla dete hain.

Anbiya se ahd-o-misaq: Yahan bayan ho raha hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S se lekar Hazrat Isa A.S tak ke tamam Anbiya-e-Kiram se Allah Ta'ala ne wada liya ke jab kabhi un mein se kisi ko bhi Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala Kitab-o-Hikmat de aur woh bade martabe tak pahunch jaye, phir us ke baad usi ke zamane mein Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aa jaye to us par iman lana aur us ki nusrat-o-imdad karna us ka farz hoga. Yeh na ho ke apne ilm-o-nabuwat ki wajah se apne baad wale Nabi ki itteba aur imdad se ruk jaye. Phir un se poocha ke kya tum iqrar karte ho? Aur isi ahd-o-misaq par mujhe zamin thahrate ho? Sab ne kaha haan hamara iqrar hai, to farmaya gawah raho aur main khud bhi gawah hoon. Ab is ahd-o-misaq se jo phir jaye woh qat'i fasiq, be-hukm aur badkar hai. Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (R.A) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne har Nabi se ahd liya ke us ki zindagi mein agar Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bheje to us par farz hai ke woh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman laye aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki imdad kare aur apni ummat ko bhi woh yahi talqeen kare ke woh bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par iman laye aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari mein lag jaye. Ta'oos, Hasan Basri aur Qatada farmate hain Nabiyon se Allah ne ahd liya ke ek dusre ki tasdeeq karein, koi yeh na samjhe ke yeh tafsir upar ki tafsir ke khilaf hai balkeh yeh us ki ta'eed hai, isi liye Hazrat Ta'oos (R.H) se un ke ladke ki riwayat misl riwayat Hazrat Ali aur Ibn Abbas ke bhi marwi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha: Ya Rasool Allah! Main ne ek dost Quraizi Yahudi se kaha tha ke woh Taurat ki jame baatein mujhe likh de, agar Aap farmayein to main unhein pesh karoon. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka chehra mutaghayyar ho gaya. Hazrat Abdullah bin Sabit ne kaha ke tum nahin dekhte ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chehra ka kya haal hai?

Toh Hazrat Umar R.A kehne lage main Allah ke Rabb hone par, Islam ke Deen hone par, Muhammad ﷺ ke Rasool hone par khush hoon. Is waqt Huzoor ﷺ ka gussa door hua aur farmaya, qasam hai us Allah Ta'ala ki jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, ke agar Hazrat Musa A.S tum mein aa jayen aur tum un ki tabedari mein lag jao aur mujhe chhor do toh tum sab gumrah ho jao. Tamam ummaton mein se mere hisse ki ummat tum ho aur tamam nabiyon mein se tumhare hisse ka Nabi main hoon. Musnad Abu Ya'la mein likha hai, Ahl-e-Kitab se kuch na pucho, woh khud gumrah hain toh tumhein rah-e-rast kaise dikhayenge? Balkeh mumkin hai tum kisi batil ki tasdeeq kar lo ya haq ki takzeeb kar baitho. Allah ki qasam agar Musa A.S bhi tum mein zinda majood hote toh unhein bhi bajuz meri tabedari ke aur kuch halal na tha. Ba'az ahadees mein hai, agar Musa A.S aur Isa A.S zinda hote toh unhein bhi meri itteba ke siwa chara na tha. Pas sabit hua ke hamare Rasool Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain aur Imam-e-Azam hain. Jis zamane mein bhi aap ki nabuwat hoti aap wajib-ul-ita'at thay aur tamam anbiya ki tabedari par jo us waqt hon aap ki farmanbardari muqaddam rehti. Yehi wajah thi ke Meraj wali raat Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein tamam anbiya ke Imam aap hi banaye gaye. Isi tarah maidan-e-mahshar mein bhi Allah Ta'ala ke faislon ko anjam tak pahunchane mein aap hi shafee honge. Yehi woh Maqam-e-Mahmood hai jo aap ke siwa aur ko hasil nahin. Tamam anbiya aur kul rasool us din is kaam se munh pher lenge, bilakhir aap hi khusoosiyat ke sath is maqam mein khade honge. Allah Ta'ala apne durood-o-salam aap par hamesha hamesha bhejta rahe Qayamat ke din tak, Ameen.

Islami usool aur Roz-e-Jaza Allah Ta'ala ke sachay deen ke siwa jo us ne apni kitabon mein apne rasoolon ki ma'rifat nazil farmaya hai yani sirf Allah wahdahu la sharik hi ki ibadat karna koi shakhs kisi aur deen ki talash kare aur usay maane us ki tardeed yahan bayan ho rahi hai phir farmaya ke aasman-o-zameen ki tamam cheezein us ki muti hain khwah khushi se hon ya na-khushi se jaise ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai aayat (Wa lillahi yasjudu man fis-samawati wal-ardi taw'an wa karhan wa zilaluhum bil-ghuduwwi wal-asal) (Ar-Ra'd: 15) yani zameen-o-aasman ki tamam tar makhlooq Allah ke samne sajday karti hai apni khushi se ya jabran aur jagah hai aayat (Awalam yarau ila ma khalaqallahu min shai'in yatafayya'u zilaluhu 'anil-yamini wash-shama'ili sujjadan lillahi wahum dakhirun) (An-Nahl: 48) kya woh nahin dekhte ke tamam makhlooq ke saaye daayein baayein jhuk jhuk kar Allah Ta'ala ko sajda karte hain aur Allah hi ke liye sajda karti hain aasmanon ki sab cheezein aur zameenon ke kul jaandar aur sab farishtay koi bhi takabbur nahin karta sab ke sab apne oopar wale Rabb se darte rehte hain aur jo hukum diye jayen baja late hain, pas mominon ka to zahir batin qalb-o-jism dono Allah Ta'ala ke muti aur us ke farman-bardar hote hain aur kafir bhi Allah ke qabzay mein hai aur jabran Allah ki janib jhuka hua hai us ke tamam farman us par jari rahein aur woh har tarah qudrat-o-mashiyat Allah ke matahat hai koi cheez bhi us ke ghalbay aur qudrat se bahar nahin, is aayat ki tafseer mein ek ghareeb hadith yeh bhi warid hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya aasmanon wale to farishtay hain jo ba-khushi Allah ke farman guzar hain aur zameen wale woh hain jo Islam par paida hue hain yeh bhi ba-shauq tamam Allah ke zer-e-farman hain, aur na-khushi se farman-bardar woh hain jo log musalman mujahideen ke hathon maidan-e-jang mein qaid hote hain aur tauq-o-zanjeer mein jakray hue laye jate hain yeh log jannat ki taraf ghaseetay jate hain aur woh nahin chahte, ek sahih hadith mein hai tere Rabb ko un logon se ta'ajjub hota hai jo zanjeeron aur rassiyon se bandh kar jannat ki taraf khenchay jate hain. Tauba aur Qabooliyat: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain, ek Ansari murtad ho kar mushrikeen mein ja mila, phir pachtane laga aur apni qoum se kehwaya ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft karo ke kya meri tauba qabool ho sakti hai? Unke daryaft karne par yeh aayatein utrin. Uski qoum ne use kehwa bheja, woh phir tauba kar ke naye sire se musalman ho kar hazir ho gaya (Ibn-e-Jarir). Nasai, Hakim aur Ibn-e-Hibban mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai. Imam Hakim ise Sahih-ul-Isnad kehte hain. Musnad-e-Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke Harith bin Suwaid ne Islam qabool kiya, phir qoum mein mil gaya aur Islam se phir gaya. Uske bare mein yeh aayatein utrin. Uski qoum ke ek shakhs ne yeh aayatein use parh kar sunayin to usne kaha, jahan tak mera khayal hai Allah ki qasam tu sacha hai aur Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) to tujh se bahut hi zyada sache hain aur Allah Ta'ala sab suchon se zyada sacha hai. Phir woh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf laut aaye, Islam laye aur bahut achi tarah Islam ko nibhaya.

Bayyinat se murad Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq par hujjaton aur daleelon ka bilkul wazeh ho jana hai. Pas jo log iman laye, Rasool ki haqaniyat maan chuke, daleelein dekh chuke, phir shirk ke andheron mein ja chhupe, yeh log mustahiq-e-hidayat nahin kyunke aankhon ke hote hue andhe pan ko unhon ne pasand kiya. Allah Ta'ala na-insaf logon mein rahbari nahin karta. Unhein Allah lanat karta hai aur uski makhlooq bhi hamesha lanat karti hai. Na to kisi waqt unke azab mein takhfeef hogi na mauqoofi. Phir apna lutf-o-ehsan, rafat-o-rahmat ka bayan farmata hai ke is badtareen jurm ke baad bhi jo meri taraf jhuke aur apne bad-aamal ki islah kar le, main bhi us se darguzar kar leta hoon.

Jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Walaistut-taubatu lillazina ya'malunas-sayyi'ati hatta iza hadara ahadahumul-mautu qala inni tubtul-aana wala-llazina yamutuna wahum kuffarun, ula'ika a'tadna lahum azaban alima) (Surah An-Nisa: 18).
