Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke kuch log musalman hue phir murtad ho gaye phir islam laye phir murtad ho gaye phir apni qaum ke paas aadmi bhej kar poochwaya ke kya ab hamari tauba hai? Unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya is par yeh aayat utri (Bazzar), iski asnaad bahut umdah hain. Phir farmata hai ke kufr par marne walon ki koi neki qabool nahin go usne zameen bhar kar sona Allah ki rah mein kharch kiya ho. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha gaya ke Abdullah bin Jud'an jo bada mehman nawaz, ghulam azaad karne wala aur khana peena dene wala shakhs tha kya use uski yeh neki kaam aayegi? Toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya nahin, usne sari umr mein ek dafa bhi (An-yaghfira li khati'ati yaumad-din) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 82) nahin kaha, yani ae mere Rab meri khataon ko Qayamat wale din bakhsh. Jis tarah uski khairaat namaqbool hai isi tarah fidiya aur muawza bhi, jaise aur jagah hai (Wala yuqbalu minha 'adlun wala tanfa'uha shafa'atun wala hum yunsarun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 123). In se na badla maqbool na inhein sifarish ka nafa aur farmaya (Qul li'ibadiyallazina amanu yuqimus-salata wa yunfiqu mimma razaqnahum sirran wa 'alaniyatan min qabli an-ya'tiya yaumun la bai'un fihi wala khilal) (Surah Ibrahim: 31). Is din na khareed-o-farokht na maut-o-mohabbat aur jagah irshad hai (Innal-lazina kafaru lau anna lahum ma fil-ardi jami'an) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 36).

(Al-Ma'idah: 36) Ya'ni agar kafiron ke paas zameen mein jo kuch hai aur utna hi aur bhi ho phir woh is sab ko Qayamat ke azabon ke badle fidiya dein toh bhi na-maqbool hai. In takleef wale alam-naak azabon ko sehna parega, yahi mazmoon yahan bhi bayan farmaya gaya hai. Ba'az ne iftadi ki waw ko za'id kaha hai lekin waw ko atf ki manna aur woh tafseer karna jo hum ne ki bahut behtar hai, wallahu a'lam. Pas sabit hua ke Allah ke azab se kuffar ko koi cheez nahin chura sakti chahe woh bare nek aur nihayat sakhi hon, go zameen bhar bhar kar sona rah-e-Allah lutayein ya paharon aur teelon ki mitti aur ret, narm zameen aur sakht zameen ki khushki aur tari ke hum-wazan sona azab ke badle dena chahein ya dein. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jahannami se Qayamat ke din kaha jayega ke zameen par jo kuch hai agar tera ho jaye toh kya tu is ko in sazaon ke badle apne fidiye mein de dalega? Woh kahega haan, toh Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hoga ke main ne tujh se ba-nisbat is ke bahut hi kam chaha tha, main ne tujh se us waqt wada liya tha jab tu apne baap Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki peeth mein tha ke mere sath kisi ko shirk na banana lekin tu shirk kiye baghair na raha. Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi dusri sanad ke sath hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek aur hadith mein hai Hazrat Anas bin Malik (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) farmate hain Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Ek aise jannati ko laya jayega jis se Allah Ta'ala farmayega kaho tum ne kaisi jagah payi? Woh jawab dega Allah bahut hi behtar. Allah Ta'ala farmayega achha aur kuch mangna ho toh mango dil mein jo tamanna ho kaho, toh yeh kahega Bari Ta'ala meri sirf yahi tamanna hai aur mera yahi ek sawal hai ke mujhe duniya mein phir bhej diya jaye main teri rah mein jihad karoon aur phir shaheed kiya jaoon, phir zinda ho jaoon phir shaheed kiya jaoon, das martaba aisa hi ho, kyunke woh shahadat ki fazeelat aur shaheed ke martabe dekh chuka hoga. Isi tarah ek jahannami ko bulaya jayega aur is se Allah Ta'ala farmayega: Ae Ibn-e-Adam tu ne apni jagah kaisi payi? Woh kahega Allah bahut hi buri. Allah Ta'ala farmayega kya sari zameen bhar kar sona de kar in azabon se chhootna tujhe pasand hai? Woh kahega haan ae Bari Ta'ala. Is waqt Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala farmayega tu jhoota hai, main ne toh is se bahut hi kam aur bilkul aasaan cheez tujh se talab ki thi lekin tu ne use bhi na kiya, chunancha woh jahannam mein bhej diya jayega. Pas yahan farmaya in ke liye takleef-deh azab hain aur aisa nahin jo in azabon se apne aap ko chura sake ya koi in ki kis tarah madad kar sake (Allah Ta'ala hamein apne azab se nijat de. Ameen).

Jab saans khatam hone ko hon toh tauba qabool nahin hogi. Imaan ke baad phir usi kufr par marne walon ko Parwardigar-e-Aalam dara raha hai ke maut ke waqt tumhari tauba qabool nahin hogi. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Walaistut-taubatu lillazina ya'malunas-sayyi'ati hatta iza hadara ahadahumul-mautu qala inni tubtul-aana wala-llazina yamutuna wahum kuffarun, ula'ika a'tadna lahum azaban alima) (Surah An-Nisa: 18). Aakhir dam tak yani maut ke waqt tak gunahon mein mubtala rehne wale maut ko dekh kar jo tauba karein woh Allah ke haan qabool nahin aur yahi yahan hai ke unki tauba hargiz maqbool na hogi aur yahi log woh hain jo rah-e-haq se bhatak kar batil rah par lag gaye. Sab se zyada pyari cheez aur sadqa: Hazrat Amr bin Maimun farmate hain 'birr' se murad Jannat hai, yani agar tum apni pasand ki cheezein Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein sadqa karte rahoge to tumhein Jannat milegi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) maldar sahabi thay, masjid ke samne hi 'Bi'r-e-Ha' nami aap ka ek bagh tha jis mein kabhi kabhi An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi tashreef le jaya karte thay aur yahan ka khush-zaiqa pani piya karte thay. Jab yeh aayat utri to Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) bargah-e-Nabwi mein hazir ho kar arz karne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah! Mera to sab se zyada pyara maal yahi bagh hai, main aap ko gawah karta hoon ke main ne ise Allah ki rah mein sadqa kiya, Allah Ta'ala mujhe bhalai ata farmaye aur apne paas ise mere liye zakhira kare, aap ko ikhtiyar hai jis tarah chahein ise taqseem kar dein. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bahut hi khush hue aur farmane lage musalmanon ko is se bahut faida pahunchega, tum ise apne qarabat-daron mein taqseem kar do. Chunancha Hazrat Abu Talha (R.A) ne ise apne rishtedaron aur chacha-zad bhaiyon mein baant diya. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) bhi khidmat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein hazir hue aur kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mujhe apne tamam maal mein sab se zyada marghoob maal Khaibar ki zameen ka hissa hai, main ise rah-e-Allah dena chahta hoon, farmaiye kya karoon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ise waqf kar do, asal rok lo aur phal waghera rah-e-Allah kar do. Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain main ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke socha to mujhe koi cheez ek kaneez se zyada pyari na thi. Main ne is londi ko rah-e-Lillah azad kar diya, ab tak bhi mere dil mein is ki aisi mohabbat hai ke agar kisi cheez ko Allah Ta'ala ke naam par de kar phir lota lena jaiz ho to main kam az kam is se nikah kar leta.

Bargah-e-Risalat ﷺ mein Yahudi wafd. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Yahudiyon ki ek jamaat Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aayi aur kehne lagi ke hum aap se chand sawal karna chahte hain jin ke jawab nabiyon ke siwa aur koi nahin. Aap ne farmaya pucho lekin pehle tum log wada karo agar main sahi sahi jawab de doon to tumhein meri nabuwwat ke tasleem kar lene mein koi uzr na hoga. Unhon ne is shart ko manzoor kar liya ke agar aap ne sache jawab diye to hum Islam qabool kar lenge, sath hi unhon ne badi badi qasmein bhi khayin. Phir pucha ke bataiye, Hazrat Israel (A.S) ne kya cheez apne upar haram ki thi? Aurat mard ke pani ki kya kaifiyat hai? Aur kyun kabhi ladka hota hai aur kabhi ladki? Aur Nabi-e-Ummi ki neend kaisi hai? Aur farishton mein se kaunsa farishta us ke paas wahi le kar aata hai? Aap ne farmaya jab Hazrat Israel (A.S) sakht bimar hue to nazr mani ke agar Allah Ta'ala mujhe shifa de ga to main sab se zyada pyari cheez khane peene ki chhod doon ga. Jab shifa-yab ho gaye to oont ka gosht aur doodh chhod diya. Mard ka pani safed rang aur gadha hota hai aur aurat ka pani zardi mail patla hota hai, dono mein se jo upar aa jaye us par aulad nar ya mada hoti hai, aur shakal-o-shabahat mein bhi usi par jati hai. Is Nabi-e-Ummi ﷺ ki neend mein us ki aankhein soti hain lekin dil jagta rehta hai. Mere paas wahi le kar wahi farishta aata hai jo tamam ambiya ke paas bhi aata raha yani Jibraeel (A.S). Bas is par woh cheekh uthe aur kehne lage koi aur farishta aap ka wali hota to humein aap ki nabuwwat tasleem karne mein koi uzr na rehta. Har sawal ke jawab ke waqt aap unhein qasam dete aur un se daryaft farmate aur woh iqrar karte ke haan jawab sahi hai. Inhi ke bare mein aayat (Qul man kana aduwwal-li-Jibraila fa-innahu nazzalahu ala qalbika bi-iznillahi musaddiqal-lima baina yadayhi wa hudan wa bushra lil-mu'minin) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 97) nazil hui. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Israel (A.S) ko irq-un-nisa ki bimari thi aur is mein un ka ek panchwan sawal yeh bhi hai ke yeh ra'ad kya cheez hai? Aap ne farmaya Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke farishton mein se ek farishta jo badalon par muqarrar hai, us ke hath mein aag ka koda hai jis se badalon ko jahan Allah Ta'ala ka hukum ho le jata hai aur yeh garaj ki aawaz usi ki aawaz hai. Jibraeel (A.S) ka naam sun kar yeh kehne lage woh to azab aur jang-o-jidal ka farishta hai aur hamara dushman hai, agar paidawar aur barish ke farishte Hazrat Mikaeel (A.S) aap ke rafeeq hote to hum maan lete. Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki raush par un ki aulad bhi rahi aur woh bhi oont ke gosht se parhez karti rahi. Is aayat ko agli aayat se munasibat ek to yeh hai ke jis tarah Hazrat Israel (A.S) ne apni chahiti cheez Allah ki nazr kar di isi tarah tum bhi kiya karo.

Lekin Yaqub A.S ki shariat mein is ka tariqa yeh tha ke apni pasandida aur marghoob cheez ka naam Allah par tark kar dete thay aur hamari shariat mein yeh tariqa nahin balkay hamain yeh farmaya gaya hai ke hum apni chahat ki cheezain Allah ke naam par kharch kar diya karain, jaise farmaya aayat (Wa aatal maala ala hubbihi zawil qurba wal yatama wal masakeena wabnas sabeel) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 177) aur farmaya aayat (Wa yutimoonat ta'aama ala hubbihi miskeenan wa yateeman wa aseera) (Surah Ad-Dahr: 8) bawajood mohabbat aur chahat ke woh hamari raah mein maal kharch karte aur maskeenon ko khana dete hain, dusri munasibat yeh bhi hai ke pehli aayaton mein nasraniyon ki tardeed thi toh yahan yahudiyon ka radd ho raha hai un ke radd mein Hazrat Isa A.S ki paidaish ka sahih waqia bata kar un ke aqeeday ka radd kiya tha, yahan nusk ka saaf bayan kar ke un ki aulad bhi usay haram jaanti rahi chunancha Taurat mein bhi is ki hurmat nazil hui, isi tarah aur bhi baaz cheezain haram ki gayin yeh naskh nahin toh aur kya hai? Hazrat Adam A.S ki salbi aulad ka aapas mein behan bhai ka nikah ibtida mein jaiz hota tha lekin baad mein haram kar diya, aurton par londiyon se nikah karna shariat-e-Ibrahimi mein mubah tha khud Hazrat Ibrahim A.S, Hazrat Sarah R.A par Hazrat Hajra R.A ko laye, lekin phir Taurat mein is se roka gaya, do behnon se ek saath nikah karna Hazrat Yaqub A.S ke zamana mein jaiz tha balkay khud Hazrat Yaqub A.S ke ghar mein ba-waqt do saggi behnein thin lekin phir Taurat mein yeh haram ho gaya isi ko naskh kehte hain isay woh dekh rahe hain apni kitab mein parh rahe hain lekin phir naskh ka inkaar kar ke Injeel ko aur Hazrat Isa A.S ko nahin maante aur un ke baad Khatam-ul-Mursaleen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath bhi yahi sulook karte hain, toh yahan farmaya ke Taurat ke nazil hone se pehle tamam khanay halal thay siwaye us ke jisay Israel A.S ne apni jaan par haram kar liya tha tum Taurat lao aur parho us mein majood hai, phir us ke bawajood tumhari yeh bohtan baazi aur iftira pardazi ke Allah ne hamare liye hafta hi ke din ko hamesha ke liye eid ka din muqarrar kiya hai aur hum se ahd liya hai ke hum hamesha Taurat hi ke aamil rahein aur kisi aur Nabi ko na maanein yeh kis qadar zulm-o-sitam hai, tumhari yeh baatein aur tumhari yeh raush yaqeenan tumhein zalim-o-jabir thehrati hai. Allah ne sachi khabar de di Ibrahimi deen wahi hai jisay Quran bayan kar raha hai tum is kitab aur is Nabi ki pairwi karo un se aala koi Nabi hai na us se behtar aur zyada wazeh koi aur shariat hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Qul innani hadani rabbi ila siratim mustaqeem) (Surah Al-An'am: 161) ae Nabi tum keh do ke mujhe mere Rab ne muwahhid Ibrahim Hanif ke mazboot deen ki seedhi raah dikha di hai. Aur jagah hai hum ne teri taraf wahi ki ke muwahhid Ibrahim Hanif ke deen ki tabedari kar.

Lekin Yaqub A.S ki shariat mein is ka tariqa yeh tha ke apni pasandida aur marghoob cheez ka naam Allah par tark kar dete thay aur hamari shariat mein yeh tariqa nahin balkay hamain yeh farmaya gaya hai ke hum apni chahat ki cheezain Allah ke naam par kharch kar diya karain, jaise farmaya aayat (Wa aatal maala ala hubbihi zawil qurba wal yatama wal masakeena wabnas sabeel) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 177) aur farmaya aayat (Wa yutimoonat ta'aama ala hubbihi miskeenan wa yateeman wa aseera) (Surah Ad-Dahr: 8) bawajood mohabbat aur chahat ke woh hamari raah mein maal kharch karte aur maskeenon ko khana dete hain, dusri munasibat yeh bhi hai ke pehli aayaton mein nasraniyon ki tardeed thi toh yahan yahudiyon ka radd ho raha hai un ke radd mein Hazrat Isa A.S ki paidaish ka sahih waqia bata kar un ke aqeeday ka radd kiya tha, yahan nusk ka saaf bayan kar ke un ki aulad bhi usay haram jaanti rahi chunancha Taurat mein bhi is ki hurmat nazil hui, isi tarah aur bhi baaz cheezain haram ki gayin yeh naskh nahin toh aur kya hai? Hazrat Adam A.S ki salbi aulad ka aapas mein behan bhai ka nikah ibtida mein jaiz hota tha lekin baad mein haram kar diya, aurton par londiyon se nikah karna shariat-e-Ibrahimi mein mubah tha khud Hazrat Ibrahim A.S, Hazrat Sarah R.A par Hazrat Hajra R.A ko laye, lekin phir Taurat mein is se roka gaya, do behnon se ek saath nikah karna Hazrat Yaqub A.S ke zamana mein jaiz tha balkay khud Hazrat Yaqub A.S ke ghar mein ba-waqt do saggi behnein thin lekin phir Taurat mein yeh haram ho gaya isi ko naskh kehte hain isay woh dekh rahe hain apni kitab mein parh rahe hain lekin phir naskh ka inkaar kar ke Injeel ko aur Hazrat Isa A.S ko nahin maante aur un ke baad Khatam-ul-Mursaleen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath bhi yahi sulook karte hain, toh yahan farmaya ke Taurat ke nazil hone se pehle tamam khanay halal thay siwaye us ke jisay Israel A.S ne apni jaan par haram kar liya tha tum Taurat lao aur parho us mein majood hai, phir us ke bawajood tumhari yeh bohtan baazi aur iftira pardazi ke Allah ne hamare liye hafta hi ke din ko hamesha ke liye eid ka din muqarrar kiya hai aur hum se ahd liya hai ke hum hamesha Taurat hi ke aamil rahein aur kisi aur Nabi ko na maanein yeh kis qadar zulm-o-sitam hai, tumhari yeh baatein aur tumhari yeh raush yaqeenan tumhein zalim-o-jabir thehrati hai. Allah ne sachi khabar de di Ibrahimi deen wahi hai jisay Quran bayan kar raha hai tum is kitab aur is Nabi ki pairwi karo un se aala koi Nabi hai na us se behtar aur zyada wazeh koi aur shariat hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Qul innani hadani rabbi ila siratim mustaqeem) (Surah Al-An'am: 161) ae Nabi tum keh do ke mujhe mere Rab ne muwahhid Ibrahim Hanif ke mazboot deen ki seedhi raah dikha di hai. Aur jagah hai hum ne teri taraf wahi ki ke muwahhid Ibrahim Hanif ke deen ki tabedari kar.

Bargah-e-Risalat ﷺ mein Yahudi wafd. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Yahudiyon ki ek jamaat Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aayi aur kehne lagi ke hum aap se chand sawal karna chahte hain jin ke jawab nabiyon ke siwa aur koi nahin. Aap ne farmaya pucho lekin pehle tum log wada karo agar main sahi sahi jawab de doon to tumhein meri nabuwwat ke tasleem kar lene mein koi uzr na hoga. Unhon ne is shart ko manzoor kar liya ke agar aap ne sache jawab diye to hum Islam qabool kar lenge, sath hi unhon ne badi badi qasmein bhi khayin. Phir pucha ke bataiye, Hazrat Israel (A.S) ne kya cheez apne upar haram ki thi? Aurat mard ke pani ki kya kaifiyat hai? Aur kyun kabhi ladka hota hai aur kabhi ladki? Aur Nabi-e-Ummi ki neend kaisi hai? Aur farishton mein se kaunsa farishta us ke paas wahi le kar aata hai? Aap ne farmaya jab Hazrat Israel (A.S) sakht bimar hue to nazr mani ke agar Allah Ta'ala mujhe shifa de ga to main sab se zyada pyari cheez khane peene ki chhod doon ga. Jab shifa-yab ho gaye to oont ka gosht aur doodh chhod diya. Mard ka pani safed rang aur gadha hota hai aur aurat ka pani zardi mail patla hota hai, dono mein se jo upar aa jaye us par aulad nar ya mada hoti hai, aur shakal-o-shabahat mein bhi usi par jati hai. Is Nabi-e-Ummi ﷺ ki neend mein us ki aankhein soti hain lekin dil jagta rehta hai. Mere paas wahi le kar wahi farishta aata hai jo tamam ambiya ke paas bhi aata raha yani Jibraeel (A.S). Bas is par woh cheekh uthe aur kehne lage koi aur farishta aap ka wali hota to humein aap ki nabuwwat tasleem karne mein koi uzr na rehta. Har sawal ke jawab ke waqt aap unhein qasam dete aur un se daryaft farmate aur woh iqrar karte ke haan jawab sahi hai. Inhi ke bare mein aayat (Qul man kana aduwwal-li-Jibraila fa-innahu nazzalahu ala qalbika bi-iznillahi musaddiqal-lima baina yadayhi wa hudan wa bushra lil-mu'minin) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 97) nazil hui. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Israel (A.S) ko irq-un-nisa ki bimari thi aur is mein un ka ek panchwan sawal yeh bhi hai ke yeh ra'ad kya cheez hai? Aap ne farmaya Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke farishton mein se ek farishta jo badalon par muqarrar hai, us ke hath mein aag ka koda hai jis se badalon ko jahan Allah Ta'ala ka hukum ho le jata hai aur yeh garaj ki aawaz usi ki aawaz hai. Jibraeel (A.S) ka naam sun kar yeh kehne lage woh to azab aur jang-o-jidal ka farishta hai aur hamara dushman hai, agar paidawar aur barish ke farishte Hazrat Mikaeel (A.S) aap ke rafeeq hote to hum maan lete. Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki raush par un ki aulad bhi rahi aur woh bhi oont ke gosht se parhez karti rahi. Is aayat ko agli aayat se munasibat ek to yeh hai ke jis tarah Hazrat Israel (A.S) ne apni chahiti cheez Allah ki nazr kar di isi tarah tum bhi kiya karo.

Aur jagah hai hum ne teri taraf wahi ki ke muwahhid Ibrahim Hanif ke deen ki tabedari kar.

Zikr-e-Baitullah aur ahkamat-e-Hajj yani logon ki ibadat, qurbani, tawaf, namaz, aitikaf waghera ke liye Allah Ta'ala ka ghar hai jis ke bani Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) hain, jin ki tabedari ka dawa Yahood-o-Nasara, mushrikeen aur musalman sab ko hai. Woh Allah ka ghar jo sab se pehle Makkah mein banaya gaya hai, aur bilashuba Khalilullah (A.S) hi Hajj ke pehle munadi karne wale hain, toh phir un par ta'ajjub aur afsos hai jo Millat-e-Hanifi ka dawa karein aur is ghar ka ehtram na karein, Hajj ko yahan na aayein balkeh apne qibla aur Ka'aba alag alag banate phirein. Is Baitullah ki bunyadon mein hi barkat-o-hidayat hai aur tamam jahan walon ke liye hai. Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke sab se pehle kaunsi masjid banayi gayi hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Masjid-e-Haram, poocha phir kaunsi? Farmaya Masjid-e-Baitul Muqaddas, poocha in dono ke darmiyan kitna waqt hai? Farmaya chalis saal, poocha phir kaunsi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jahan kahin namaz ka waqt aa jaye namaz parh liya karo sari zameen masjid hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad-o-Bukhari, Muslim). Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ghar toh pehle bahut se thay lekin khas Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ka ghar sab se pehla yahi hai, kisi shakhs ne aap se poocha ke zameen par pehla ghar yahi bana hai toh aap ne farmaya nahin, han barkaton aur Maqam-e-Ibrahim aur aman wala ghar yahi pehla hai. Baitullah Sharif ke banane ki poori kaifiyat Surah Baqarah ki aayat (Wa 'ahidna ila Ibrahima wa Isma'ila an tahhira baitiya lit-ta'ifina wal-'akifina war-rukka'is-sujud) (Al-Baqarah: 125) ki tafsir mein pehle guzar chuki hai, wahin mulahiza farma lijiye yahan dobara bayan karne ki zaroorat nahin. Suddi kehte hain sab se pehle roo-e-zameen par yahi ghar bana, lekin sahih qaul Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka hi hai aur woh hadith jo Baihaqi mein hai jis mein hai ke Adam-o-Hawa (A.S) ne ba-hukm-e-Ilahi Baitullah banaya aur tawaf kiya aur Allah Ta'ala ne kaha ke tu sab se pehla insan hai aur yeh sab se pehla ghar hai, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Lahia ki riwayat se hai aur woh za'eef rawi hain, mumkin hai yeh Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ka apna qaul ho aur Yarmouk wale din unhein jo do pooray Ahl-e-Kitab ki kitabon ke mile thay unhi mein yeh bhi likha hua ho.

Makkah, Makkah Sharif ka mashhoor naam hai. Chunke bade bade jabir shakhson ki gardanein yahan toot jati thin, har badai wala yahan past hojata tha, is liye ise Makkah kaha gaya aur is liye bhi ke logon ki bheed bhaad yahan hoti hai aur har waqt khacha khach bhara rehta hai aur is liye bhi ke yahan log khalt malt hojate hain, yahan tak ke kabhi auratein aage namaz padhti hoti hain aur mard un ke peeche hote hain jo aur kahin nahin hota. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Fajj" se "Tan'eem" tak Makkah hai, Baitullah se Batha tak Bakkah hai, Baitullah aur masjid ko Bakkah kaha gaya hai. Baitullah aur is aas paas ki jagah ko Bakkah aur baqi shehar ko Makkah bhi kaha gaya hai. Is ke aur bhi bahut se naam hain maslan: Bait-ul-Atiq, Bait-ul-Haram, Balad-ul-Amin, Balad-ul-Mamoon, Umm-e-Rahm, Umm-ul-Qura, Salah, Arsh, Qadis, Muqaddas, Nasibah, Nasissah, Hatimah, Raas, Kautha, Al-Baldah, Al-Bayyinah, Al-Akbah. Is mein zahir nishaniyan hain jo is ki azmat-o-sharafat ki daleel hain aur jin se zahir hai ke Khalilullah (A.S) ki bina yahi hai. Is mein Maqam-e-Ibrahim bhi hai jis par khade ho kar Hazrat Ismail (A.S) se patthar le kar Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) Ka'aba ki deewarein oonchi kar rahe thay. Yeh pehle to Baitullah Sharif ki deewar se laga hua tha lekin Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne apni khilafat ke zamane mein ise zara hata kar mashriq rukh kardiya tha ke poori tarah tawaf ho sake aur jo log tawaf ke baad Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peeche namaz padhte hain un ke liye pareshani aur bheed bhaad na ho. Isi ki taraf namaz padhne ka hukm hua hai aur is ke mutaliq bhi poori tafseer aayat (وَاتَّخِذُوْا مِنْ مَّقَامِ اِبْرٰهٖمَ مُصَلًّى) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 125) ki tafseer mein pehle guzar chuki hai, Falhamdulillah. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Aayat-e-Bayyinat mein se ek Maqam-e-Ibrahim bhi hai, baqi aur bhi hain. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke Khalilullah (A.S) ke qadmon ke nishan jo Maqam-e-Ibrahim par thay, yeh bhi Aayat-e-Bayyinat mein se hain. Kul haram ko aur Hateem ko aur saare arkaan-e-hajj ko bhi Makkah aman wala raha, baap ke qatil ko bhi yahan paate to na chhedte. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Baitullah panah chahne wale ko panah deta hai lekin jagah aur khana peena nahin deta aur jagah hai aayat (اولم یروا انا جعلنا حرما امنا) al-kh, kya yeh nahin dekhte ke hum ne haram ko aman ki jagah banaya aur jagah hai aayat (اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا وَّيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ ۭ اَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ اللّٰهِ يَكْفُرُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 67).

(Al-Ankabut: 67) Hum ne unhein khauf se aman diya, na sirf insaan ke liye aman hai balkay shikar karna, balkay shikar ko bhagana, usay khauf-zada karna, usay us ke thikane ya ghonslay se hatana aur urana bhi mana hai. Is ke darakht katna, yahan ki ghaas ukherna bhi najaiz hai. Is mazmoon ki bohat si hadeesein pooray bast ke sath aayat "Wa ahadna" ilakh, ki tafseer mein Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hain. Musnad Ahmad, Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein hadees hai jisay Imam Tirmidhi ne Hasan Sahih kaha hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makkah ke bazaar Harurah mein kharay ho kar farmaya ke: "Aye Makkah! Tu Allah Ta'ala ko saari zameen se behtar aur pyara hai, agar main zabardasti tujh se na nikala jata to hargiz tujhe na chorta." Aur is aayat ke ek ma'ani yeh bhi hain ke jo is ghar mein dakhil hua woh jahannam se bach gaya. Baihaqi ki ek marfoo hadees mein hai: "Jo Baitullah mein dakhil hua woh neki mein aaya aur buraiyon se door hua, aur gunah bakhsh diya gaya," lekin is ke ek rawi Abdullah bin Tu'mal qawi nahin hain. Aayat ka yeh aakhri hissa Hajj ki farziyat ki daleel hai. Baaz kehte hain aayat (Wa atimmul hajja wal umrata lillahi fa in uhsirtum famastaysara minal hadyi) (Al-Baqarah: 196) wali aayat daleel-e-farziyat hai, lekin pehli baat zyada wazeh hai. Kayi ek ahadees mein warid hai ke Hajj arkaan-e-Islam mein se ek rukn hai, is ki farziyat par musalmanon ka ijma hai, aur yeh baat bhi sabit hai ke umr bhar mein ek martaba istita'at walay musalman par Hajj farz hai. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne khutbay mein farmaya: "Logon! Tum par Allah Ta'ala ne Hajj farz kiya hai, tum Hajj karo." Ek shakhs ne poocha: "Huzoor! Kya har saal?" Aap khamosh rahe, us ne teen martaba yahi sawal kiya, Aap ne farmaya: "Agar main haan keh deta to farz ho jata, phir baja na la saktay. Main jab khamosh rahoon to tum kured kar poocha na karo, tum se aglay log apne ambiya se sawalon ki bharmaar aur nabiyon par ikhtilaf karne ki wajah se halak ho gaye. Mere hukumon ko taqat bhar baja lao aur jis cheez se mana karoon us se ruk jao." (Musnad Ahmad). Sahih Muslim Shareef ki is hadees-e-shareef mein itni zyadati hai ke yeh poochne walay Aqra bin Habis thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab yeh bhi farmaya ke: "Umr mein ek martaba farz hai aur phir nafl." Ek riwayat mein hai ke isi sawal ke baray mein aayat (Ya ayyuhallazina amanu la tas'alu an ashya'a in tubda lakum tasu'kum) (Al-Ma'idah: 101) nazil hui.

(Al-Ma'idah: 101) yani ziyadati-e-sawal se bacho nazil hui (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek aur riwayat mein hai agar main haan kehta toh har saal Hajj wajib hota tum baja na la sakte toh azab nazil hota (Ibn-e-Majah). Haan Hajj mein tamattu karne ka jawaz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek sail ke sawal par hamesha ke liye jaiz farmaya tha, ek aur hadith mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hajjatul-Wida mein Ummahat-ul-Momineen yani apni biwiyon se farmaya tha Hajj ho chuka ab ghar se na nikalna, rahi istita'at aur taqat so woh kabhi toh khud insaan ko baghair kisi zariye ke hoti hai kabhi kisi aur ke waste se jaise ke kutub-e-ahkaam mein is ki tafseel majood hai, Tirmidhi mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke ya Rasool Allah haaji kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya paraganda baalon aur maile kuchile kapron wala. Ek aur ne poocha ya Rasool Allah kaunsa Hajj afzal hai, Aap ne farmaya jis mein qurbaniyan kasrat se ki jayen aur labbaik zyada pukara jaye. Ek aur shakhs ne sawal kiya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sabeel se kya murad hai? Aap ne farmaya tosha bhata khane peene ke laiq saman-e-kharch aur sawari, is hadith ka ek rawi go za'eef hai magar hadith ki mutaba'at aur sanad bahut se sahabiyon se mukhtalif sanadon se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aayat (مَنِ اسْـتَـطَاعَ اِلَيْهِ سَبِيْلًا) (Aal-e-Imran: 97) ki tafseer mein zad-o-rahila yani tosha aur sawari batayi hai. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain farz Hajj jaldi ada kar liya karo na maloom kal kya pesh aaye, Abu Dawood waghera mein hai Hajj ka irada karne wale ko jald apna irada poora kar lena chahiye. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jis ke paas teen sau dirham hon woh taqat wala hai, Ikrama farmate hain murad sehat-e-jismani hai. Phir farmaya jo kufr kare yani farziyat-e-Hajj ka inkar kare, Hazrat Ikrama farmate hain jab yeh aayat utri ke deen-e-Islam ke siwa jo shakhs koi aur deen pasand kare us se qabool na kiya jayega toh Yahoodi kehne lage hum bhi musalman hain, Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir musalmanon par toh Hajj farz hai tum bhi Hajj karo toh woh saaf inkar kar baithe jis par yeh aayat utri ke is ka inkari kafir hai aur Allah Ta'ala tamam jahan walon se be-parwah hai, Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs khane peene aur sawari par qudrat rakhta ho aur itna maal bhi us ke paas ho phir Hajj na kare toh us ki maut Yahoodiyat ya Nasraniyat par hogi. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai Allah ke liye logon par Hajj-e-Baitullah hai jo us ke rasta ki taqat rakhein aur jo kufr kare toh Allah Ta'ala tamam jahan walon se be-parwah hai, is ke rawi par bhi kalam hai, Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) farmate hain taqat rakh kar Hajj na karne wala Yahoodi ho kar marega ya Nasrani ho kar, is ki sanad bilkul sahih hai (Hafiz Abu Bakr Ismaili). Musnad-e-Saeed bin Mansoor mein hai ke Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne farmaya mera maqsad hai ke main logon ko mukhtalif shehron mein bhejoon woh dekhein jo log bawajood maal rakhne ke Hajj na karte hon un par jizya laga dein woh musalman nahin hain woh musalman nahin hain.

Zikr-e-Baitullah aur ahkamat-e-Hajj yani logon ki ibadat, qurbani, tawaf, namaz, aitikaf waghera ke liye Allah Ta'ala ka ghar hai jis ke bani Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) hain, jin ki tabedari ka dawa Yahood-o-Nasara, mushrikeen aur musalman sab ko hai. Woh Allah ka ghar jo sab se pehle Makkah mein banaya gaya hai, aur bilashuba Khalilullah (A.S) hi Hajj ke pehle munadi karne wale hain, toh phir un par ta'ajjub aur afsos hai jo Millat-e-Hanifi ka dawa karein aur is ghar ka ehtram na karein, Hajj ko yahan na aayein balkeh apne qibla aur Ka'aba alag alag banate phirein. Is Baitullah ki bunyadon mein hi barkat-o-hidayat hai aur tamam jahan walon ke liye hai. Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke sab se pehle kaunsi masjid banayi gayi hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Masjid-e-Haram, poocha phir kaunsi? Farmaya Masjid-e-Baitul Muqaddas, poocha in dono ke darmiyan kitna waqt hai? Farmaya chalis saal, poocha phir kaunsi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jahan kahin namaz ka waqt aa jaye namaz parh liya karo sari zameen masjid hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad-o-Bukhari, Muslim). Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ghar toh pehle bahut se thay lekin khas Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ka ghar sab se pehla yahi hai, kisi shakhs ne aap se poocha ke zameen par pehla ghar yahi bana hai toh aap ne farmaya nahin, han barkaton aur Maqam-e-Ibrahim aur aman wala ghar yahi pehla hai. Baitullah Sharif ke banane ki poori kaifiyat Surah Baqarah ki aayat (Wa 'ahidna ila Ibrahima wa Isma'ila an tahhira baitiya lit-ta'ifina wal-'akifina war-rukka'is-sujud) (Al-Baqarah: 125) ki tafsir mein pehle guzar chuki hai, wahin mulahiza farma lijiye yahan dobara bayan karne ki zaroorat nahin. Suddi kehte hain sab se pehle roo-e-zameen par yahi ghar bana, lekin sahih qaul Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka hi hai aur woh hadith jo Baihaqi mein hai jis mein hai ke Adam-o-Hawa (A.S) ne ba-hukm-e-Ilahi Baitullah banaya aur tawaf kiya aur Allah Ta'ala ne kaha ke tu sab se pehla insan hai aur yeh sab se pehla ghar hai, yeh hadith Ibn-e-Lahia ki riwayat se hai aur woh za'eef rawi hain, mumkin hai yeh Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ka apna qaul ho aur Yarmouk wale din unhein jo do pooray Ahl-e-Kitab ki kitabon ke mile thay unhi mein yeh bhi likha hua ho.

Makkah, Makkah Sharif ka mashhoor naam hai. Chunke bade bade jabir shakhson ki gardanein yahan toot jati thin, har badai wala yahan past hojata tha, is liye ise Makkah kaha gaya aur is liye bhi ke logon ki bheed bhaad yahan hoti hai aur har waqt khacha khach bhara rehta hai aur is liye bhi ke yahan log khalt malt hojate hain, yahan tak ke kabhi auratein aage namaz padhti hoti hain aur mard un ke peeche hote hain jo aur kahin nahin hota. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain "Fajj" se "Tan'eem" tak Makkah hai, Baitullah se Batha tak Bakkah hai, Baitullah aur masjid ko Bakkah kaha gaya hai. Baitullah aur is aas paas ki jagah ko Bakkah aur baqi shehar ko Makkah bhi kaha gaya hai. Is ke aur bhi bahut se naam hain maslan: Bait-ul-Atiq, Bait-ul-Haram, Balad-ul-Amin, Balad-ul-Mamoon, Umm-e-Rahm, Umm-ul-Qura, Salah, Arsh, Qadis, Muqaddas, Nasibah, Nasissah, Hatimah, Raas, Kautha, Al-Baldah, Al-Bayyinah, Al-Akbah. Is mein zahir nishaniyan hain jo is ki azmat-o-sharafat ki daleel hain aur jin se zahir hai ke Khalilullah (A.S) ki bina yahi hai. Is mein Maqam-e-Ibrahim bhi hai jis par khade ho kar Hazrat Ismail (A.S) se patthar le kar Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) Ka'aba ki deewarein oonchi kar rahe thay. Yeh pehle to Baitullah Sharif ki deewar se laga hua tha lekin Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne apni khilafat ke zamane mein ise zara hata kar mashriq rukh kardiya tha ke poori tarah tawaf ho sake aur jo log tawaf ke baad Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peeche namaz padhte hain un ke liye pareshani aur bheed bhaad na ho. Isi ki taraf namaz padhne ka hukm hua hai aur is ke mutaliq bhi poori tafseer aayat (وَاتَّخِذُوْا مِنْ مَّقَامِ اِبْرٰهٖمَ مُصَلًّى) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 125) ki tafseer mein pehle guzar chuki hai, Falhamdulillah. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Aayat-e-Bayyinat mein se ek Maqam-e-Ibrahim bhi hai, baqi aur bhi hain. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain ke Khalilullah (A.S) ke qadmon ke nishan jo Maqam-e-Ibrahim par thay, yeh bhi Aayat-e-Bayyinat mein se hain. Kul haram ko aur Hateem ko aur saare arkaan-e-hajj ko bhi Makkah aman wala raha, baap ke qatil ko bhi yahan paate to na chhedte. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Baitullah panah chahne wale ko panah deta hai lekin jagah aur khana peena nahin deta aur jagah hai aayat (اولم یروا انا جعلنا حرما امنا) al-kh, kya yeh nahin dekhte ke hum ne haram ko aman ki jagah banaya aur jagah hai aayat (اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا وَّيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ ۭ اَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ اللّٰهِ يَكْفُرُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 67).

(Al-Ankabut: 67) Hum ne unhein khauf se aman diya, na sirf insaan ke liye aman hai balkay shikar karna, balkay shikar ko bhagana, usay khauf-zada karna, usay us ke thikane ya ghonslay se hatana aur urana bhi mana hai. Is ke darakht katna, yahan ki ghaas ukherna bhi najaiz hai. Is mazmoon ki bohat si hadeesein pooray bast ke sath aayat "Wa ahadna" ilakh, ki tafseer mein Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hain. Musnad Ahmad, Tirmidhi aur Nasai mein hadees hai jisay Imam Tirmidhi ne Hasan Sahih kaha hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makkah ke bazaar Harurah mein kharay ho kar farmaya ke: "Aye Makkah! Tu Allah Ta'ala ko saari zameen se behtar aur pyara hai, agar main zabardasti tujh se na nikala jata to hargiz tujhe na chorta." Aur is aayat ke ek ma'ani yeh bhi hain ke jo is ghar mein dakhil hua woh jahannam se bach gaya. Baihaqi ki ek marfoo hadees mein hai: "Jo Baitullah mein dakhil hua woh neki mein aaya aur buraiyon se door hua, aur gunah bakhsh diya gaya," lekin is ke ek rawi Abdullah bin Tu'mal qawi nahin hain. Aayat ka yeh aakhri hissa Hajj ki farziyat ki daleel hai. Baaz kehte hain aayat (Wa atimmul hajja wal umrata lillahi fa in uhsirtum famastaysara minal hadyi) (Al-Baqarah: 196) wali aayat daleel-e-farziyat hai, lekin pehli baat zyada wazeh hai. Kayi ek ahadees mein warid hai ke Hajj arkaan-e-Islam mein se ek rukn hai, is ki farziyat par musalmanon ka ijma hai, aur yeh baat bhi sabit hai ke umr bhar mein ek martaba istita'at walay musalman par Hajj farz hai. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne khutbay mein farmaya: "Logon! Tum par Allah Ta'ala ne Hajj farz kiya hai, tum Hajj karo." Ek shakhs ne poocha: "Huzoor! Kya har saal?" Aap khamosh rahe, us ne teen martaba yahi sawal kiya, Aap ne farmaya: "Agar main haan keh deta to farz ho jata, phir baja na la saktay. Main jab khamosh rahoon to tum kured kar poocha na karo, tum se aglay log apne ambiya se sawalon ki bharmaar aur nabiyon par ikhtilaf karne ki wajah se halak ho gaye. Mere hukumon ko taqat bhar baja lao aur jis cheez se mana karoon us se ruk jao." (Musnad Ahmad). Sahih Muslim Shareef ki is hadees-e-shareef mein itni zyadati hai ke yeh poochne walay Aqra bin Habis thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jawab yeh bhi farmaya ke: "Umr mein ek martaba farz hai aur phir nafl." Ek riwayat mein hai ke isi sawal ke baray mein aayat (Ya ayyuhallazina amanu la tas'alu an ashya'a in tubda lakum tasu'kum) (Al-Ma'idah: 101) nazil hui.

(Al-Ma'idah: 101) yani ziyadati-e-sawal se bacho nazil hui (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek aur riwayat mein hai agar main haan kehta toh har saal Hajj wajib hota tum baja na la sakte toh azab nazil hota (Ibn-e-Majah). Haan Hajj mein tamattu karne ka jawaz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek sail ke sawal par hamesha ke liye jaiz farmaya tha, ek aur hadith mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hajjatul-Wida mein Ummahat-ul-Momineen yani apni biwiyon se farmaya tha Hajj ho chuka ab ghar se na nikalna, rahi istita'at aur taqat so woh kabhi toh khud insaan ko baghair kisi zariye ke hoti hai kabhi kisi aur ke waste se jaise ke kutub-e-ahkaam mein is ki tafseel majood hai, Tirmidhi mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke ya Rasool Allah haaji kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya paraganda baalon aur maile kuchile kapron wala. Ek aur ne poocha ya Rasool Allah kaunsa Hajj afzal hai, Aap ne farmaya jis mein qurbaniyan kasrat se ki jayen aur labbaik zyada pukara jaye. Ek aur shakhs ne sawal kiya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sabeel se kya murad hai? Aap ne farmaya tosha bhata khane peene ke laiq saman-e-kharch aur sawari, is hadith ka ek rawi go za'eef hai magar hadith ki mutaba'at aur sanad bahut se sahabiyon se mukhtalif sanadon se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aayat (مَنِ اسْـتَـطَاعَ اِلَيْهِ سَبِيْلًا) (Aal-e-Imran: 97) ki tafseer mein zad-o-rahila yani tosha aur sawari batayi hai. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain farz Hajj jaldi ada kar liya karo na maloom kal kya pesh aaye, Abu Dawood waghera mein hai Hajj ka irada karne wale ko jald apna irada poora kar lena chahiye. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jis ke paas teen sau dirham hon woh taqat wala hai, Ikrama farmate hain murad sehat-e-jismani hai. Phir farmaya jo kufr kare yani farziyat-e-Hajj ka inkar kare, Hazrat Ikrama farmate hain jab yeh aayat utri ke deen-e-Islam ke siwa jo shakhs koi aur deen pasand kare us se qabool na kiya jayega toh Yahoodi kehne lage hum bhi musalman hain, Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir musalmanon par toh Hajj farz hai tum bhi Hajj karo toh woh saaf inkar kar baithe jis par yeh aayat utri ke is ka inkari kafir hai aur Allah Ta'ala tamam jahan walon se be-parwah hai, Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs khane peene aur sawari par qudrat rakhta ho aur itna maal bhi us ke paas ho phir Hajj na kare toh us ki maut Yahoodiyat ya Nasraniyat par hogi. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai Allah ke liye logon par Hajj-e-Baitullah hai jo us ke rasta ki taqat rakhein aur jo kufr kare toh Allah Ta'ala tamam jahan walon se be-parwah hai, is ke rawi par bhi kalam hai, Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) farmate hain taqat rakh kar Hajj na karne wala Yahoodi ho kar marega ya Nasrani ho kar, is ki sanad bilkul sahih hai (Hafiz Abu Bakr Ismaili). Musnad-e-Saeed bin Mansoor mein hai ke Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne farmaya mera maqsad hai ke main logon ko mukhtalif shehron mein bhejoon woh dekhein jo log bawajood maal rakhne ke Hajj na karte hon un par jizya laga dein woh musalman nahin hain woh musalman nahin hain.

Kafiron ka anjam: Ahl-e-Kitab ke kafiron ko Allah Ta'ala dhamkata hai jo haq se dushmani karte aur Allah Ta'ala ki ayaton se kufr karte, dusre logon ko bhi pure zor se Islam se rokte the, bawajood ye ke Rasool ki haqaniyat ka unhein yaqeeni ilm tha. Agle ambiya aur rasoolon ki peshgoiyan aur un ki basharatain un ke paas majood thin. Nabi-e-Ummi, Hashmi, Arabi, Makki, Madani, Sayyid-ul-Walad-e-Adam, Khatam-ul-Anbiya, Rasool-e-Rabb-e-Arz-o-Sama (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka zikr un kitabon mein majood tha, phir bhi apni be-imani par bazid the. Is liye un se Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke main khoob dekh raha hoon tum kis tarah mere nabiyon ki takzeeb karte ho aur kis tarah Khatam-ul-Anbiya ko satate ho aur kis tarah mere mukhlis bandon ki raah mein rode atka rahe ho. Main tumhare aamal se ghafil nahin hoon, tamam buraiyon ka badla doonga, us din pakdoonga jis din tumhein koi sifarishi aur madadgar na mile.

Kamyabi ka inhasar kis par hai? Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko Ahl-e-Kitab ke is bad-batin firqa ki itteba karne se rok raha hai kyunke yeh hasid iman ke dushman hain aur Arab ki risalat inhe ek aankh nahin bhati, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wad-kathir) al-kh, yeh log jal bhun rahe hain. Aur tumhein iman se hatana chahte hain, tum in ke khokhlay dabao mein na aa jana, go kufr tum se bahut door hai lekin phir bhi main tumhein aagah kiye deta hoon, Allah Ta'ala ki ayatein din raat tum mein padhi ja rahi hain aur Allah Ta'ala ka sacha Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum mein maujood hai, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ma lakum la tu'minuna billah) tum iman kaise na lao? Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhein tumhare Rab ki taraf bula rahe hain aur tum se ahd bhi liya ja chuka hai. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek roz apne as-hab se poocha: "Tumhare nazdeek sab se bada iman wala kaun hai?" Unhon ne kaha: "Farishtay." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Bhala woh iman kyun na late? Inhein to Allah Ta'ala ki wahi se barah-e-rast talluq hai." Sahaba (R.A) ne kaha: "Phir hum." Farmaya: "Tum iman kyun na late? Tum mein to main khud maujood hoon." Sahaba (R.A) ne kaha: "Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khud hi irshad farmayein." Farmaya: "Ke tamam logon se zyada ajeeb iman wale woh honge jo tumhare baad aayenge, woh kitabon mein likha payenge aur us par iman layenge." (Imam Ibn Kathir (R.H) ne is hadith ki sanadon ka aur is ke mani ka poora bayan Sharh-e-Sahih Bukhari mein kar diya hai, falhamdulillah). Phir farmaya ke bawajood is ke tumhara mazbooti se Allah ke deen ko tham rakhna aur Allah Ta'ala ki pak zaat par poora tawakkul rakhna hi mojib-e-hidayat hai, isi se gumrahi door hoti hai, yahi shiwa-e-raza ka ba'is hai, isi se sahih rasta hasil hota hai aur kamyabi aur murad milti hai.

Allah Ta'ala ki rassi Quran-e-Hakim hai. Allah Ta'ala se poora poora darna yeh hai ke uski ita'at ki jaye, nafarmani na ki jaye, uska zikr kiya jaye aur uski yaad na bhulayi jaye, uska shukr kiya jaye, kufr na kiya jaye. Ba'az riwayaton mein yeh tafsir marfoo' bhi marwi hai lekin theek baat yahi hai ke yeh mauqoof hai yani Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) ka qaul hai, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ka farman hai ke insaan Allah Azza-wa-Jal se darne ka haq nahin baja la sakta jab tak apni zaban ko mehfooz na rakhe. Aksar mufassireen ne kaha hai ke yeh ayat (Fattaqullaha mastata'tum wasma'oo wa atee'oo wa anfiqoo khairal-li-anfusikum, wa may-yooqa shuhha nafsihi fa-ulaika humul-muflihoon) (Surah At-Taghabun: 16) ki ayat se mansookh hai. Is dusri ayat mein farma diya hai ke apni taqat ke mutabiq us se darte raha karo. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain mansookh nahin, balkeh matlab yeh hai ke Allah ki rah mein jihad karte raho, uske kamon mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat ka khayal na karo, adl par jam jao yahan tak ke khud apne nafs par adl ke ahkaam jari karo, apne maa-baap aur apni aulad ke bare mein bhi adl-o-insaf barta karo. Phir farmaya ke Islam par hi marna yani tamam zindagi is par qaim rehna taake maut bhi isi par aaye. Is Rabb-e-Kareem ka usool yahi hai ke insaan apni zindagi jaisi rakhe waisi hi use maut aati hai aur jaisi maut mare usi par Qayamat ke din uthaya jata hai. Wallah Ta'ala, Allah Ta'ala ki napasand maut se hamein apni panah mein rakhe, Ameen. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke log Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf kar rahe the aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) bhi wahan the, unke hath mein lakdi thi, bayan farmane lage ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ayat ki tilawat ki, phir farmaya ke agar Zaqqoom ka ek qatra bhi duniya mein gira diya jaye to duniya walon ki har khane wali cheez kharab ho jaye, koi cheez kha-pee na sakein, phir khayal karo ke un jahannumiyon ka kya haal hoga jin ka khana peena hi yeh Zaqqoom hoga. Aur hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs jahannum se alag hota aur jannat mein jana chahta ho use chahiye ke marte dam tak Allah Ta'ala par aur Aakhirat ke din par iman rakhe aur logon se woh bartao kare jise woh khud apne liye chahta ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Jabir (R.A) farmate hain main ne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani aap ke inteqal ke teen roz pehle suna ke dekho maut ke waqt Allah Ta'ala se nek guman rakhna (Muslim). Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke mera banda mere sath jaisa guman rakhe main uske guman ke paas hi hoon, agar uska mere sath husn-e-zan hai to main uske sath achhai karunga aur agar woh mere sath badgumani karega to main us se isi tarah pesh aaunga (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is hadith ka agla hissa Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai. Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai ke ek bimar Ansari ki bimar pursi ke liye Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef le gaye aur salam kar ke farmane lage ke kaise mizaj hain?

Us ne kaha Alhamdulillah achha hoon, Rabb ki rahmat ka umeedwar hoon aur us ke azabon se dar raha hoon. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya suno aise waqt jis dil mein khauf-o-tama dono hon Allah us ki umeed ki cheez use deta hai aur dar-o-khauf ki cheez se bachata hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Hakim bin Hizam (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se bai'at ki aur kaha ke main khade khade hi karoon, is ka matlab Imam Nasai ne to Sunan-e-Nasai mein baab baandh kar yeh bayan kiya hai ke sajde mein is tarah jaan chahiye, aur yeh ma'ani bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke main musalman hue baghair na maroon, aur yeh bhi matlab bayan kiya gaya hai ke jihad mein peeth dikhata hua na mara jaoon. Phir farmaya baham ittefaq rakho ikhtilaf se bacho. Habl-e-Allah se murad ahd-e-Ilahi hai, jaise "Ala yahbal min Allah" al-kh, mein "Habl" se murad Quran hai. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai ke Quran Allah Kareem ki mazboot rassi hai aur is ki seedhi raah hai, aur riwayat mein hai ke Kitabullah Allah Ta'ala ki aasman se zameen ki taraf latkai hui rassi hai, aur hadith mein hai ke yeh Quran Allah Subhanah ki mazboot rassi hai, yeh zahir noor hai, yeh sarasar shifa dene wala aur nafa bakhsh hai, is par amal karne wale ke liye yeh bachao hai, is ki tabedari karne wale ke liye yeh nijat hai. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain in raston mein to shaitan chal phir rahe hain tum Allah ke raste par aa jao, tum Allah ki rassi ko mazboot thaam lo, woh rassi Quran-e-Kareem hai. Ikhtilaf na karo, phoot na daalo, judai na karo, alaihadgi se bacho. Sahih Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain teen baton se Allah Raheem khush hota hai aur teen baton se na-khush hota hai: ek to yeh ke usi ki ibadat karo us ke sath kisi ko shareek na karo, dusre Allah ki rassi ko ittefaq se pakro, tafraqa na daalo, teesre musalman badshahon ki khair khwahi karo. Fazool bakwas, ziyadati-e-sawaal aur barbadi-e-maal yeh teeno cheezein Rabb ki narazgi ka sabab hain. Bahut si riwayatein aisi bhi hain jin mein hai ke ittefaq ke waqt woh khata se bach jayenge aur bahut si ahadith mein na-ittefaqi se daraya bhi hai. In hidayaat ke bawajood ummat mein ikhtilafat hue aur tehattar (73) firqe ho gaye jin mein se ek nijat pa kar jannati hoga aur jahannam ke azabon se bach rahe ga aur yeh woh log hain jo us par qaim hon jis par Rasool Allah (ﷺ) aur aap (ﷺ) ke as-haab the. Phir apni ne'mat yaad dilai, jahiliyat ke zamane mein Aus-o-Khazraj ke darmiyan badi ladaiyan aur sakht adawat thi, aapas mein barabar jang jaari rehti thi. Jab dono qabile Islam laye to Allah Kareem ke fazl se bilkul ek ho gaye, sab hasad-o-bughz jata raha aur aapas mein bhai bhai ban gaye aur neki aur bhalai ke kamon mein ek dusre ke madadgar aur Allah Ta'ala ke deen mein ek dusre ke sath muttafiq ho gaye, jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Huwallazi ayyadaka binasrihi wa bil-mu'mineen, wa allafa baina quloobihim) (Surah Al-Anfal: 62). Woh Allah jis ne teri ta'eed ki apni madad ke sath aur momino ke sath aur un ke dilon mein ulfat daal di.

Apna dusra ehsan zikr karta hai ke tum aag ke kinare pahunch chuke thay aur tumhara kufr tumhein is mein dhakel deta lekin hum ne tumhein Islam ki taufiq ata farma kar is se bhi alag kar liya, Hunain ki fatah ke baad jab maal-e-ghanimat taqseem karte hue maslahat-e-deeni ke mutabiq Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne baaz logon ko zyada maal diya to kisi shakhs ne kuch aise hi namunasib alfaaz zabaan se nikal diye jis par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jamaat-e-Ansar ko jama kar ke ek khutba padha, is mein yeh bhi farmaya tha ke ae jamaat-e-Ansar kya tum gumrah na thay? Phir Allah Ta'ala ne meri wajah se tumhein hidayat di? Kya tum mutafariq na thay phir Rabb-e-Do-Aalam ne meri wajah se tumhare dilon mein ulfat daal di? Kya tum faqeer na thay Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein meri wajah se ghani kar diya? Har har sawaal ke jawab mein yeh paakbaaz jamaat, yeh Allah wala giroh kehta jata tha ke hum par Allah Ta'ala aur Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ehsan aur bhi bahut se hain aur bahut bade bade hain. Hazrat Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) farmate hain ke jab Aus-o-Khazraj jaise sadiyon ke aapas ke dushmanon ko yun bhai bhai bana hua dekha to yahudiyon ki aankhon mein kanta khatakne laga, unhon ne aadmi muqarrar kiye ke woh un ki mehfilon aur majlis mein jaya karein aur agli ladaiyan aur purani adawatein unhein yaad dilayein, un ke maqtoolon ki yaad taza karayein aur is tarah unhein bhadkayein. Chunancha un ka yeh daao ek martaba chal bhi gaya aur dono qabeelon mein purani aag bhadak uthi yahan tak ke talwarein khinch gayin, theek do jamaatein ho gayin aur wahi jahiliyat ke naare lagne lage, hathiyar sajne lage aur ek dusre ke khoon ke pyase ban gaye aur yeh thehar gaya ke Harra ke maidan mein ja kar un se dil khol kar ladein aur mardangi ke johar dikhayein, pyasi zameen ko apne khoon se sairab karein lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pata chal gaya, aap foran mauqe par tashreef laye aur dono giroh ko thik-thaak kiya aur farmane lage phir jahiliyat ke naare tum lagane lage? Meri maujudgi mein hi tum ne phir jang-o-jidal shuru kar diya? Phir aap ne yahi aayat padh kar sunayi, sab nadim hue aur apni do ghadi pehle ki harkat par afsos karne lage aur aapas mein naye sire se mu'aniqa-o-musafaha kiya aur phir bhaiyon ki tarah gale mil gaye, hathiyar daal diye aur sulah-safayi ho gayi. Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain ke yeh aayat us waqt nazil hui jab Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) par munafiqon ne tohmat lagayi thi aur aap ki baraat nazil hui thi tab ek dusre ke muqable mein tan gaye thay, Fallahu A'alam.

Allah Ta'ala ki rassi Quran-e-Hakim hai. Allah Ta'ala se poora poora darna yeh hai ke uski ita'at ki jaye, nafarmani na ki jaye, uska zikr kiya jaye aur uski yaad na bhulayi jaye, uska shukr kiya jaye, kufr na kiya jaye. Ba'az riwayaton mein yeh tafsir marfoo' bhi marwi hai lekin theek baat yahi hai ke yeh mauqoof hai yani Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) ka qaul hai, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ka farman hai ke insaan Allah Azza-wa-Jal se darne ka haq nahin baja la sakta jab tak apni zaban ko mehfooz na rakhe. Aksar mufassireen ne kaha hai ke yeh ayat (Fattaqullaha mastata'tum wasma'oo wa atee'oo wa anfiqoo khairal-li-anfusikum, wa may-yooqa shuhha nafsihi fa-ulaika humul-muflihoon) (Surah At-Taghabun: 16) ki ayat se mansookh hai. Is dusri ayat mein farma diya hai ke apni taqat ke mutabiq us se darte raha karo. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain mansookh nahin, balkeh matlab yeh hai ke Allah ki rah mein jihad karte raho, uske kamon mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat ka khayal na karo, adl par jam jao yahan tak ke khud apne nafs par adl ke ahkaam jari karo, apne maa-baap aur apni aulad ke bare mein bhi adl-o-insaf barta karo. Phir farmaya ke Islam par hi marna yani tamam zindagi is par qaim rehna taake maut bhi isi par aaye. Is Rabb-e-Kareem ka usool yahi hai ke insaan apni zindagi jaisi rakhe waisi hi use maut aati hai aur jaisi maut mare usi par Qayamat ke din uthaya jata hai. Yaum-e-Aakhirat munafiq aur momin ki pehchan. Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain is jamaat se murad khaas sahaba aur khaas raawiyan-e-hadith hain yani Mujahid aur ulama. Imam Abu Jafar Baqir (R.H) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat ki phir farmaya sabr se murad Quran-o-Hadith ki itteba hai, yaad rahe ke har har mutanaffis par tableegh-e-haq farz hai lekin taham ek jamaat to khaas isi kaam mein mashghool rehni chahiye, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se jo koi kisi burai ko dekhe use haath se dafa kar de agar is ki taqat na ho to zaban se roke agar yeh bhi na kar sakta ho to apne dil se nafrat kare yeh zaeef imaan hai, ek aur riwayat mein is ke baad yeh bhi hai ke is ke baad rai ke daane ke barabar bhi imaan nahin, (Sahih Muslim). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain us zaat ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai tum achhai ka hukum aur buraiyon se mukhalifat karte raho warna anqareeb Allah Ta'ala tum par apna azaab nazil farma de ga phir tum duayein karoge lekin qabool na hongi. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si hadeesein hain jo kisi aur maqam par zikr ki jayengi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Phir farmata hai ke tum sabqa logon ki tarah iftiraq-o-ikhtilaf na karna tum nek baaton ka hukum aur khilaf-e-shara baaton se rokna na chhodna, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Muawiyah bin Abu Sufyan (R.A) hajj ke liye jab Makkah Shareef mein aaye to zohar ki namaz ke baad khade ho kar farmaya ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Ahl-e-Kitab apne deen mein ikhtilaf kar ke behtar giroh ban gaye aur is meri ummat ke tehattar firqe ho jayenge khwahishat-e-nafsani aur khush fehmi mein honge balkay meri ummat mein aise log bhi honge jin ki rag rag mein nafsani khwahishein is tarah ghus jayengi jis tarah kutte ke kaate hue insaan ki ek ek rag aur ek ek jod mein is ka asar pahunch jata hai ae Arab ke logo agar tum hi apne Nabi ki layi hui cheez par qaim na rahoge to aur log to bahut door ho jayenge. Is hadith ki bahut si sanadein hain phir farmaya is din safed chehre aur siyah munh bhi honge. Ibn Abbas ka farman hai ke Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jamaat ke munh safed aur noorani honge magar Ahl-e-Bid'at-o-Munafiqat ke kaale munh honge, Hasan Basri farmate hain yeh kaale munh wale munafiq honge jin se kaha jayega ke tum ne imaan ke baad kufr kyun kiya ab is ka maza chakhlo. Aur safed munh wale Allah Raheem-o-Kareem ki rahmat mein hamesha hamesha rahenge. Hazrat Abu Umamah (R.A) ne jab kharijiyon ke sar Damishq ki masjid ke zeenon par latke hue dekhe to farmane lage yeh jahannam ke kutte hain in se badtar maqtool roo-e-zameen par koi nahin inhe qatl karne wale behtareen mujahideen phir aayat (يَّوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوْهٌ وَّتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوْهٌ) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 106) tilawat farmayi, Abu Ghalib ne kaha ke janab ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yeh suna hai?

Farmaya ek do dafa nahin balkay saat martaba, agar aisa na hota toh main apni zaban se yeh alfaaz nikalta hi nahin. Ibn-e-Marduyah ne yahan Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ki riwayat se ek lambi hadith naqal ki hai jo bahut hi ajeeb hai lekin sandan ghareeb hai. Dunya aur aakhirat ki yeh baatein hum tum par ae Nabi (ﷺ) khol rahe hain. Allah Ta'ala aadil haakim hai, woh zaalim nahin aur har cheez ko aap khoob jaanta hai aur har cheez par qudrat bhi rakhta hai, phir namumkin hai ke woh kisi par zulm kare (jin ke kaalay munh hue woh isi laiq thay). Zameen aur aasman ki kul cheezein uski malkiyat mein hain aur usi ki ghulami mein aur har kaam ka aakhri hukum usi ki taraf hai, mutasarrif aur ba-ikhtiyar hukum dunya aur aakhirat ka maalik wahi hai.
