Sab se behtar shakhs kaun? Aur sab se behtar ummat ka a'izaz kis ko mila? Allah Ta'ala khabar de raha hai ke Ummat-e-Muhammadiya tamam ummaton par behtar hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain tum auron ke haq mein sab se behtar ho to logon ki gardanein pakar pakar kar Islam ki taraf jhukate ho, aur mufassireen bhi yahi farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke tum tamam ummaton se behtar ho aur sab se zyada logon ko nafa pahunchane wale ho. Abu Lahab ki beti Hazrat Durra R.A farmati hain ek martaba kisi ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se poocha aap us waqt mimbar par the ke Huzoor ﷺ kaunsa shakhs behtar hai? Aap ne farmaya sab logon se behtar woh shakhs hai jo sab se zyada qari-e-Quran ho, sab se zyada parhezgar ho, sab se zyada achhaiyon ka hukm karne wala, sab se zyada buraiyon se rokne wala, sab se zyada rishte naate milane wala ho. (Musnad Ahmad). Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh woh Sahaba hain jinhon ne Makkah se Madina ki taraf hijrat ki, sahih baat yeh hai ke yeh aayat saari ummat par mushtamil hai, beshak yeh hadith mein bhi hai ke sab se behtar mera zamana hai phir us ke baad us se mila hua zamana phir us ke baad wala. Ek aur riwayat mein hai aayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنٰكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّسَطًا لِّتَكُوْنُوْا شُهَدَاۗءَ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَيَكُـوْنَ الرَّسُوْلُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيْدًا) (Al-Baqarah: 143) hum ne tumhein behtar ummat banaya hai taake tum logon par gawah bano, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain tum ne agli ummaton ki tadaad sattar tak pahuncha di hai, Allah ke nazdeek tum un sab se behtar aur zyada buzurg ho, yeh mashhoor hadith hai Imam Tirmidhi ne ise Hasan kaha hai. Is ummat ki afzaliyat ki ek bari daleel is ummat ke Nabi ki afzaliyat hai, Aap tamam makhlooq ke sardar tamam rasoolon se zyada ikram-o-izzat wale hain, Aap ki shar' itni kamil aur itni poori hai ke aisi shariat kisi Nabi ko nahin di gayi, to zahir baat hai ke in fazail ko sametne wali ummat bhi sab se a'ala-o-afzal hai, is shariat ka thora sa amal bhi aur ummaton ke zyada amal se behtar-o-afzal hai. Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib R.A farmate hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya main woh woh ne'matein diya gaya hoon jo mujh se pehle koi nahin diya gaya, logon ne poocha woh kya baatein hain? Aap ne farmaya meri madad ra'ab se ki gayi hai, main zameen ki kunjiyaan diya gaya hoon, mera naam Ahmad rakha gaya hai, mere liye mitti paak ki gayi hai, meri ummat sab ummaton se behtar banayi gayi hai (Musnad Ahmad), is hadith ki asnaad Hasan hai. Hazrat Abu Darda R.A farmate hain main ne Abu Al-Qasim ﷺ se suna aap farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Isa A.S se farmaya ke main tumhare baad ek ummat paida karne wala hoon jo rahat par hamd-o-shukr karenge aur museebat par talab-e-sawab aur sabr karenge halanke unhein hilm-o-ilm na hoga, aap ne ta'ajjub se poocha ke baghair bardbari aur door-andeshi aur pukhta ilm ke yeh kaise mumkin hai?

Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne farmaya main unhein apna hilm-o-ilm ata farmaunga, main chahta hoon yahan par ba'az woh hadeesein bhi bayan kar doon jin ka zikr yahan munasib hai suniye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain meri ummat mein se sattar hazar shakhs baghair hisab kitab ke jannat mein jayenge jin ke chehre chaudhween raat ke chand ki tarah roshan honge sab yak rang honge, main ne apne Rabb se guzarish ki ke aye Allah is tadaad mein aur izafa farma Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya har ek ke sath sattar hazar aur bhi, Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) yeh hadees bayan kar ke farmaya karte the ke phir toh is tadaad mein gaon aur dehaton wale balkay badiyanasheen bhi aajayenge (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe mere Rabb ne sattar hazar admiyon ko meri ummat mein se baghair hisab ke jannat mein dakhil hone ki khushkhabri di, Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne yeh sun kar farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch aur ziyadati talab karte aap ne farmaya main ne apne Rabb se sawal kiya toh mujhe khushkhabri mili ke har shakhs ke sath sattar sattar hazar ka wada hua.

Hazrat Umar R.A ne phir guzarish ki ke Allah ke Nabi ﷺ aur kuch bhi mangte? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya manga toh mujhe itni ziyadati aur mili aur phir dono haath phaila kar bataya ke is tarah, rawi-e-hadith kehte hain is tarah jab Allah Ta'ala samete toh Allah Azzawajal hi jaanta hai ke kis qadar makhlooq is mein aayegi (FasubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi) (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Thauban R.A Hims mein bimar ho gaye, Abdullah bin Qurt wahan ke amir thay, woh ayadat ko na aa sake. Ek Kala'i shakhs jab aap ki bimar pursi ke liye gaya toh aap ne us se daryaft kiya ke likhna jaante ho? Us ne kaha haan, farmaya likho: Yeh khat Thauban ki taraf se amir Abdullah bin Qurt ki taraf hai jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ke khadim hain, baad hamd-o-salawat ke wazeh ho ke agar Hazrat Isa A.S ya Hazrat Musa A.S ka koi khadim yahan hota aur bimar padta toh tum ayadat ke liye jaate. Phir kaha yeh khat le jao aur amir ko pahuncha do. Jab yeh khat amir-e-Hims ke paas pahuncha toh ghabra kar uth khade hue aur seedhe yahan tashreef laye. Kuch der baith kar ayadat kar ke jab jaane ka irada kiya toh Hazrat Thauban R.A ne un ki chadar pakad kar roka aur farmaya ek hadith sunte jayen, main ne Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki zaban-e-mubarak se suna hai, aap ﷺ ne farmaya meri ummat mein se sattar hazar shakhs baghair hisab-o-azab ke jannat mein jayenge, har hazar ke sath sattar hazar aur honge (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadith bhi sahih hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud R.A farmate hain ek raat hum khidmat-e-nabwi mein der tak baatein karte rahe, phir subah jab hazir-e-khidmat hue toh Huzoor ﷺ ne irshad farmaya suno aaj raat ambiya apni apni ummat samet mujhe dikhaye gaye, ba'az ambiya ke sath sirf teen shakhs thay, ba'az ke sath mukhtasar sa giroh, ba'az ke sath ek jamaat, kisi ke sath koi bhi na tha. Jab Musa A.S aaye toh un ke sath bahut se log thay, mujhe yeh jamaat pasand aayi, main ne poocha yeh kaun hain? Toh jawab mila ke yeh aap ke bhai Musa A.S hain aur un ke sath Bani Israel hain. Main ne kaha phir meri ummat kahan hai? Jawab mila apni dahini taraf dekho, ab jo dekhta hoon toh beshumar majma hai jis se pahadiyan bhi dhak gayi hain, ab mujh se poocha gaya kaho khush ho? Main ne kaha mere Rab main raazi ho gaya, farmaya gaya suno!

Un ke sath sattar hazar aur hain jo baghair hisab ke jannat mein dakhil honge, ab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum par mere maa baap fida hon agar ho sake to un sattar hazar mein se hi hona agar yeh na ho sake to un mein se ho jo pahariyon ko chupaye hue the agar yeh bhi na ho sake to un mein se hona jo aasman ke kinaron kinaron par the, Hazrat Ukasha bin Mihsan ne khare ho kar kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe un sattar hazar mein se kare aap ne dua ki to ek dusre sahabi ne bhi uth kar yahi guzarish ki to aap ne farmaya tum par Hazrat Ukasha sabqat kar gaye, hum ab aapas mein kehne lage ke shayad yeh sattar hazar log honge jo Islam par hi paida hue hon aur puri umar mein kabhi Allah ke sath shirk kiya hi na ho aap ko jab yeh maloom hua to farmaya yeh woh log hain jo dam jhara nahin karate aag ke daagh nahin lagwate shagoon nahin lete aur apne Rab par pura bharosa rakhte hain (Musnad Ahmad). Ek aur sanad se itni ziyadati is mein aur bhi hai jab main ne apni razamandi zahir ki to mujh se kaha gaya ab apni bayin janib dekho main ne dekha to beshumar majma hai jis ne aasman ke kinaron ko bhi dhak liya hai ek aur riwayat mein hai ke mausam-e-hajj ka yeh waqiya hai aap farmate hain mujhe apni ummat ki yeh kasrat bahut pasand aayi tamam pahariyan aur maidan un se pur the (Musnad Ahmad). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ukasha ke baad khare hone wale ek Ansari the (R.A) (Tabrani). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazar ya saath lakh aadmi jannat mein jayenge jo ek dusre ka haath thame hue honge sab ek sath jannat mein jayenge chamakte hue chaudhwin raat ke chand jaise un ke chehre honge.

(Bukhari, Muslim, Tabrani) Husain bin Abdur-Rahman kehte hain ke Saeed bin Jubair ke paas tha to aap ne daryaft kiya raat ko jo sitara toota tha tum mein se kisi ne dekha tha? Main ne kaha haan Hazrat, main ne dekha tha, yeh na samajhiyega ke main namaz mein tha balkeh mujhe bichhoo ne kaat khaya tha. Hazrat Saeed ne poocha phir tum ne kya kiya? Main ne kaha dam kar diya tha. Kaha kyun? Main ne kaha Hazrat Sha'bi ne Buraidah bin Haseeb ki riwayat se hadith bayan ki hai ke nazar-e-bad aur zehreelay janwaron ka dam jhaara karana hai. Kehne lage khair, jisay jo pohanchay us par amal kare, hamain to Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne sunaya hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Mujh par ummatain pesh ki gayin, kisi Nabi ke sath ek jamaat thi, kisi ke sath ek shakhs aur do shakhs aur kisi Nabi ke sath koi na tha. Ab jo dekha ke ek bari pur-jamaat nazar pari, main samjha yeh to meri ummat hogi, phir maloom hua ke Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki ummat hai. Mujh se kaha gaya aasman ke kinaron ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha to wahan beshumar log thay. Mujh se kaha gaya yeh aap ki ummat hai aur un ke sath sattar hazar aur hain jo be-hisab aur be-azab jannat mein jayenge. Yeh hadith bayan farma kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) to makan par chale gaye aur Sahaba aapas mein kehne lage shayad yeh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Sahabi honge, kisi ne kaha nahin Islam mein paida hone wale aur Islam par hi marne wale honge waghera waghera. Aap tashreef laye aur poocha kya baatein kar rahe ho? Hum ne zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya: Nahin, yeh woh log hain jo na dam jhaara karen na karayen, na daagh lagwayen na shagoon lein balkeh apne Rab par bharosa rakhein. Hazrat Ukasha (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ne dua ki darkhwast ki, aap ne dua ki: Ya Allah! Tu isay in mein se hi bana. Phir dusre shakhs ne bhi yahi kaha, aap ne farmaya Ukasha aagay barh gaye. Yeh hadith Bukhari mein hai lekin is mein dam jhaara nahin karne ka lafz nahin, Sahih Muslim mein yeh lafz bhi hai.

Ek aur mutawwal hadith mein hai ke pehli jamaat toh najaat payegi, unke chehre chaudhween raat ke chand ki tarah roshan honge, unse hisab bhi na liya jayega. Phir unke baad wale sab se zyada roshan sitare jaise chamakdar chehre wale honge (Muslim). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhse mere Rab ka wada hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazaar shakhs baghair hisab-o-azab ke dakhil-e-bahisht honge, har hazaar ke sath sattar hazaar honge aur teen lappain aur mere Rab-e-Azz-o-Jal ki lappon se (Kitab-us-Sunan li-Hafiz Abi Bakr bin Asim). Iski isnad bahut umdah hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke aap se sattar hazaar ki tadaad sun kar Yazeed bin Akhnas ne kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh toh aap ki ummat ki tadaad ke muqable mein bahut hi thode hain, toh aap ne farmaya har hazaar ke sath sattar hazaar hain aur phir Allah ne teen lappain (hatheliyon ka kashkol) bhar kar aur bhi ata farmaye hain, iski isnad bhi hasan hai (Kitab-us-Sunan). Aur ek aur hadith mein hai ke mere Rab ne jo izzat aur jalal wala hai mujhse wada kiya hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazaar ko bila-hisab jannat mein le jayega, phir ek ek hazaar ki shafa'at se sattar sattar hazaar aadmi aur jayenge, phir mera Rab apne dono hathon se teen lappain (dono hathon ki hatheliyon ko mila kar katora banana) bhar kar aur dalega. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne yeh sun kar khush ho kar Allahu Akbar kaha aur farmaya ke unki shafa'at unke baap dadon aur beton aur betiyon aur khandan-o-qabila mein hogi, Allah kare main toh un mein se ho jaun jinhein Allah Ta'ala apni lappon mein bhar kar aakhir mein jannat mein le jayega (Tabrani). Is hadith ki sanad mein bhi koi illat nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Kuraid mein huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek hadith farmayi jis mein jannat mein yeh bhi farmaya yeh sattar hazaar jo bila-hisab jannat mein dakhil kiye jayenge, mera khayal hai ke unke aate aate toh tum apne liye aur apne baal bachon aur biwiyon ke liye jannat mein jagah muqarrar kar chuke honge (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Iski sanad mein shart Muslim par hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah ka wada hai ke meri ummat mein se chaar lakh aadmi jannat mein jayenge. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch aur zyada kijiye, ise sun kar Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Abu Bakr bas karo, Siddiq (R.A) ne jawab diya kyun sahib agar hum sab ke sab jannat mein chale jayenge toh aap ko kya nuqsan hai? Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya agar Allah chahe toh ek hi hath mein sari makhlooq ko jannat mein daal de. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Umar sach kehte hain (Musnad-e-Abdur Razzaq). Isi hadith ki aur sanad se bhi bayan hai us mein tadaad ek lakh aayi hai (Asbahani). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jab sahaba ne sattar hazaar aur phir har ek ke sath sattar hazaar phir Allah ki lapp bhar kar jannati banana suna toh kehne lage phir toh uski badnaseebi mein kya shak reh gaya jo bawajood iske bhi jahannam mein jaye (Abu Laila). Upar wali hadith ek aur sanad se bhi bayan hui hai us mein tadaad teen lakh ki hai, phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya meri ummat ke sare muhajir toh is mein aa hi jayenge phir baqi tadaad a'arabiyon se puri hogi (Muhammad bin Sahl). Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) kehte hain huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne hisab kiya gaya toh jumla tadaad chaar crore nauve hazaar hui. Ek aur hasan hadith Tabrani mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya qasam hai us zaat ki ke jaan Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki uske hath mein hai, tum ek andheri raat ki tarah beshumar ek sath jannat ki taraf badhoge, zameen tum se pur ho jayegi, tamam farishtay pukar uthenge ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath jo jamaat aayi woh tamam nabiyon ki jamaat se bahut zyada hai. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) farmate hain ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna aap ne farmaya sirf meri tabe-dar ummat ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi hogi. Sahaba ne khush ho kar na'ara-e-takbeer buland kiya, phir farmaya ke mujhe toh umeed hai ke tum ahl-e-jannat ka teesra hissa ho jaoge, hum ne phir takbeer kahi, phir farmaya main umeed karta hun ke tum aadhon-aadh ho jao (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur hadith mein hai ke aap ne sahaba se farmaya ke tum raazi nahin ho ke tum tamam jannaton ke chauthayi ho? Hum ne khush ho kar Allah ki badayi bayan ki, phir farmaya ke tum raazi nahin ho ke tamam ahl-e-jannat ki tihayi ho? Hum ne phir takbeer kahi, aap ne farmaya mujhe toh umeed hai ke tum jannatiyon ke aadhon-aadh ho ge (Bukhari, Muslim). Tabrani mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya kehte ho tum jannatiyon ka chauthayi hissa banna chahte ho ke chauthayi jannat tumhare paas ho aur teen aur chauthaiyon mein tamam ummatain hon?

Hum ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool khoob jaanta hai, aap ne farmaya achha tihai hissa ho to? Hum ne kaha yeh bahut hai. Farmaya agar aadhon aadh ho to? Unhon ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ phir to bahut hi zyada hai. Aap ne farmaya suno! Kul ahl-e-jannat ki ek sau bees safein hain jin mein se assi safein sirf is meri ummat ki hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai ke ahl-e-jannat ki ek sau bees safein, un mein assi safein sirf is ummat ki hain. Yeh hadith Tabrani, Tirmidhi waghera mein bhi hai. Tabrani ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jab aayat (Thullatum minal awwaleen 39, wa thullatum minal aakhireen 40) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 39-40) utri to Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya tum ahl-e-jannat ki chauthai ho, phir farmaya balkay thulth ho, phir farmaya balkay nisf ho, phir farmaya do tihai ho. (Ae wasee rahmaton walay aur be-rok na'maton walay Allah! Hum tera be-inteha shukr ada karte hain ke tu ne hamein aisay mu'azzaz-o-muhtaram Rasool ﷺ ki ummat mein paida kiya. Tere sachay Rasool ﷺ ki sachi zabaan se tere is barhay charhay fazl-o-karam ka haal sun kar hum gunahgaron ke munh mein paani bhar aaya. Ae maa baap se zyada meharban Allah! Hamari aas na tor aur hamein bhi un nek hastiyon ke saath jannat mein dakhil farma. Bari Ta'ala teri rahmat ki anginat aur beshumar bandon mein se agar ek qatra bhi hum gunahgaron par baras jaye to hamaray gunahon ko dho daalne aur hamein teri rahmat-o-rizwan ke laiq banane ke liye kaafi hai. Allah! Is paak zikr ke mauqa par hum haath utha kar, daaman phaila kar, aansoo baha kar, ummeedon bharay dil se teri rahmat ka sahara le kar, tere karam ka daaman thaam kar tujh se bheek maangte hain, tu qabool farma aur apni rahmat se hamein bhi apni razamandi ka ghar Jannat-ul-Firdaus ata farma. Ameen Ilahal Haq Ameen). Sahih Bukhari, Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain hum duniya mein sab se aakhir aaye aur jannat mein sab se pehle jayenge aur un ko Kitabullah pehle mili, hamein baad mein mili. Jin baaton mein unhon ne ikhtilaf kiya un mein Allah ne hamein sahih tareeq ki taufeeq di. Jumma ka din bhi aisa hi hai ke Yahood hamaray peechay hain hafta ke din aur Nasrani un ke peechay itwar ke din. Dar Qutni mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jab tak main jannat mein dakhil na ho jaaun, Ambiya par dukhool-e-jannat haram hai aur jab tak meri ummat na dakhil ho, dusri ummaton par dukhool-e-jannat haram hai. Yeh woh hadeesain thin jinhein hum is aayat ke tehat waarid karna chahte thay, falhamdulillah. Ummat ko bhi chahiye ke yahan is aayat mein jitni safein hain un par mazbooti ke saath qaim-o-saabit rahein, yani Amr-e-Bil-Ma'roof aur Nahi-e-Anil-Munkar aur Imaan-e-Billah. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne apne hajj mein is aayat ki tilawat farma kar logon se kaha ke agar tum is aayat ki tareef mein dakhil hona chahte ho to yeh ausaaf bhi apne mein paida karo. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer farmate hain, Ahl-e-Kitab un kaamon ko chor baithay thay jin ki muzammat Kalam-e-Allah ne ki, farmaya aayat (Kaanu la yatana hauna 'an munkarin fa'aluhu, labi'sa ma kaanu yaf'aloon) (5:79).

(Al-Ma'idah: 79) Woh log burai ki baaton se logon ko rokte na the. Chunke mandarija-bala aayat mein imandaron ki tareef-o-tauseef bayan hui to us ke baad Ahl-e-Kitab ki muzammat bayan ho rahi hai, to farmaya ke agar yeh log bhi mere Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par imaan late to unhein bhi yeh fazilatein miltin lekin in mein se kufr-o-fisq aur gunahon par jame hue hain, haan kuch log ba-imaan bhi hain. Phir Allah Ta'ala musalmanon ko basharat deta hai ke tum na ghabrana, Allah tumhein tumhare mukhalifeen par ghalib rakhe ga. Chunancha Khaybar wale din Allah Ta'ala ne unhein zaleel kiya aur un se pehle Banu Qainuqa, Banu Nazeer aur Banu Quraiza ko bhi Allah ne zaleel-o-ruswa kiya. Isi tarah Shaam ke nasrani sahaba ke waqt mein maghloob hue aur mulk-e-Shaam un ke hathon se nikal gaya aur hamesha ke liye musalmanon ke qabze mein aa gaya aur wahan ek haq wali jamaat Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke aane tak haq par qaim rahe gi. Hazrat Isa (A.S) aa kar millat-e-Islam aur shariat-e-Muhammadi ke mutabiq hukm karenge, saleeb todenge, khanzeer ko qatl karenge, jizya qabool na karenge, sirf Islam hi qabool farmayenge. Phir farmaya ke un ke upar zillat aur pasti daal di gayi, haan Allah ki panah ke alawa kahin bhi aman-o-aman aur izzat nahin, yani jizya dena aur muslim badshah ki ita'at karna qabool kar lein aur logon ki panah yani aqd-e-zimma muqarrar ho jaye ya koi musalman aman de de, agarche koi aurat ho ya koi ghulam ho, ulama ka ek qaul yeh bhi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke habl se murad hai jo ghazab ke mustahiq hue aur maskeeni chipka di gayi, un ke kufr aur ambiya ke takabbur, hasad, sarkashi waghera ka badla hai. Isi ba'is un par zillat, pasti aur maskeeni hamesha ke liye daal di gayi, un ki nafarmaniyon aur tajawuz-e-haq ka yeh badla hai, al-iyazu billah. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hadith hai ke Bani Israel ek ek din mein teen teen sau nabiyon ko qatl kar dalte the aur din ke aakhri hissa mein apne apne kamon par bazaron mein lag jate the.

Sab se behtar shakhs kaun? Aur sab se behtar ummat ka a'izaz kis ko mila? Allah Ta'ala khabar de raha hai ke Ummat-e-Muhammadiya tamam ummaton par behtar hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain tum auron ke haq mein sab se behtar ho to logon ki gardanein pakar pakar kar Islam ki taraf jhukate ho, aur mufassireen bhi yahi farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke tum tamam ummaton se behtar ho aur sab se zyada logon ko nafa pahunchane wale ho. Abu Lahab ki beti Hazrat Durra R.A farmati hain ek martaba kisi ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se poocha aap us waqt mimbar par the ke Huzoor ﷺ kaunsa shakhs behtar hai? Aap ne farmaya sab logon se behtar woh shakhs hai jo sab se zyada qari-e-Quran ho, sab se zyada parhezgar ho, sab se zyada achhaiyon ka hukm karne wala, sab se zyada buraiyon se rokne wala, sab se zyada rishte naate milane wala ho. (Musnad Ahmad). Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh woh Sahaba hain jinhon ne Makkah se Madina ki taraf hijrat ki, sahih baat yeh hai ke yeh aayat saari ummat par mushtamil hai, beshak yeh hadith mein bhi hai ke sab se behtar mera zamana hai phir us ke baad us se mila hua zamana phir us ke baad wala. Ek aur riwayat mein hai aayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنٰكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّسَطًا لِّتَكُوْنُوْا شُهَدَاۗءَ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَيَكُـوْنَ الرَّسُوْلُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيْدًا) (Al-Baqarah: 143) hum ne tumhein behtar ummat banaya hai taake tum logon par gawah bano, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain tum ne agli ummaton ki tadaad sattar tak pahuncha di hai, Allah ke nazdeek tum un sab se behtar aur zyada buzurg ho, yeh mashhoor hadith hai Imam Tirmidhi ne ise Hasan kaha hai. Is ummat ki afzaliyat ki ek bari daleel is ummat ke Nabi ki afzaliyat hai, Aap tamam makhlooq ke sardar tamam rasoolon se zyada ikram-o-izzat wale hain, Aap ki shar' itni kamil aur itni poori hai ke aisi shariat kisi Nabi ko nahin di gayi, to zahir baat hai ke in fazail ko sametne wali ummat bhi sab se a'ala-o-afzal hai, is shariat ka thora sa amal bhi aur ummaton ke zyada amal se behtar-o-afzal hai. Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib R.A farmate hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya main woh woh ne'matein diya gaya hoon jo mujh se pehle koi nahin diya gaya, logon ne poocha woh kya baatein hain? Aap ne farmaya meri madad ra'ab se ki gayi hai, main zameen ki kunjiyaan diya gaya hoon, mera naam Ahmad rakha gaya hai, mere liye mitti paak ki gayi hai, meri ummat sab ummaton se behtar banayi gayi hai (Musnad Ahmad), is hadith ki asnaad Hasan hai. Hazrat Abu Darda R.A farmate hain main ne Abu Al-Qasim ﷺ se suna aap farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Isa A.S se farmaya ke main tumhare baad ek ummat paida karne wala hoon jo rahat par hamd-o-shukr karenge aur museebat par talab-e-sawab aur sabr karenge halanke unhein hilm-o-ilm na hoga, aap ne ta'ajjub se poocha ke baghair bardbari aur door-andeshi aur pukhta ilm ke yeh kaise mumkin hai?

Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne farmaya main unhein apna hilm-o-ilm ata farmaunga, main chahta hoon yahan par ba'az woh hadeesein bhi bayan kar doon jin ka zikr yahan munasib hai suniye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain meri ummat mein se sattar hazar shakhs baghair hisab kitab ke jannat mein jayenge jin ke chehre chaudhween raat ke chand ki tarah roshan honge sab yak rang honge, main ne apne Rabb se guzarish ki ke aye Allah is tadaad mein aur izafa farma Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya har ek ke sath sattar hazar aur bhi, Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) yeh hadees bayan kar ke farmaya karte the ke phir toh is tadaad mein gaon aur dehaton wale balkay badiyanasheen bhi aajayenge (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe mere Rabb ne sattar hazar admiyon ko meri ummat mein se baghair hisab ke jannat mein dakhil hone ki khushkhabri di, Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne yeh sun kar farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch aur ziyadati talab karte aap ne farmaya main ne apne Rabb se sawal kiya toh mujhe khushkhabri mili ke har shakhs ke sath sattar sattar hazar ka wada hua.

Hazrat Umar R.A ne phir guzarish ki ke Allah ke Nabi ﷺ aur kuch bhi mangte? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya manga toh mujhe itni ziyadati aur mili aur phir dono haath phaila kar bataya ke is tarah, rawi-e-hadith kehte hain is tarah jab Allah Ta'ala samete toh Allah Azzawajal hi jaanta hai ke kis qadar makhlooq is mein aayegi (FasubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi) (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Thauban R.A Hims mein bimar ho gaye, Abdullah bin Qurt wahan ke amir thay, woh ayadat ko na aa sake. Ek Kala'i shakhs jab aap ki bimar pursi ke liye gaya toh aap ne us se daryaft kiya ke likhna jaante ho? Us ne kaha haan, farmaya likho: Yeh khat Thauban ki taraf se amir Abdullah bin Qurt ki taraf hai jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ke khadim hain, baad hamd-o-salawat ke wazeh ho ke agar Hazrat Isa A.S ya Hazrat Musa A.S ka koi khadim yahan hota aur bimar padta toh tum ayadat ke liye jaate. Phir kaha yeh khat le jao aur amir ko pahuncha do. Jab yeh khat amir-e-Hims ke paas pahuncha toh ghabra kar uth khade hue aur seedhe yahan tashreef laye. Kuch der baith kar ayadat kar ke jab jaane ka irada kiya toh Hazrat Thauban R.A ne un ki chadar pakad kar roka aur farmaya ek hadith sunte jayen, main ne Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki zaban-e-mubarak se suna hai, aap ﷺ ne farmaya meri ummat mein se sattar hazar shakhs baghair hisab-o-azab ke jannat mein jayenge, har hazar ke sath sattar hazar aur honge (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadith bhi sahih hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud R.A farmate hain ek raat hum khidmat-e-nabwi mein der tak baatein karte rahe, phir subah jab hazir-e-khidmat hue toh Huzoor ﷺ ne irshad farmaya suno aaj raat ambiya apni apni ummat samet mujhe dikhaye gaye, ba'az ambiya ke sath sirf teen shakhs thay, ba'az ke sath mukhtasar sa giroh, ba'az ke sath ek jamaat, kisi ke sath koi bhi na tha. Jab Musa A.S aaye toh un ke sath bahut se log thay, mujhe yeh jamaat pasand aayi, main ne poocha yeh kaun hain? Toh jawab mila ke yeh aap ke bhai Musa A.S hain aur un ke sath Bani Israel hain. Main ne kaha phir meri ummat kahan hai? Jawab mila apni dahini taraf dekho, ab jo dekhta hoon toh beshumar majma hai jis se pahadiyan bhi dhak gayi hain, ab mujh se poocha gaya kaho khush ho? Main ne kaha mere Rab main raazi ho gaya, farmaya gaya suno!

Un ke sath sattar hazar aur hain jo baghair hisab ke jannat mein dakhil honge, ab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum par mere maa baap fida hon agar ho sake to un sattar hazar mein se hi hona agar yeh na ho sake to un mein se ho jo pahariyon ko chupaye hue the agar yeh bhi na ho sake to un mein se hona jo aasman ke kinaron kinaron par the, Hazrat Ukasha bin Mihsan ne khare ho kar kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe un sattar hazar mein se kare aap ne dua ki to ek dusre sahabi ne bhi uth kar yahi guzarish ki to aap ne farmaya tum par Hazrat Ukasha sabqat kar gaye, hum ab aapas mein kehne lage ke shayad yeh sattar hazar log honge jo Islam par hi paida hue hon aur puri umar mein kabhi Allah ke sath shirk kiya hi na ho aap ko jab yeh maloom hua to farmaya yeh woh log hain jo dam jhara nahin karate aag ke daagh nahin lagwate shagoon nahin lete aur apne Rab par pura bharosa rakhte hain (Musnad Ahmad). Ek aur sanad se itni ziyadati is mein aur bhi hai jab main ne apni razamandi zahir ki to mujh se kaha gaya ab apni bayin janib dekho main ne dekha to beshumar majma hai jis ne aasman ke kinaron ko bhi dhak liya hai ek aur riwayat mein hai ke mausam-e-hajj ka yeh waqiya hai aap farmate hain mujhe apni ummat ki yeh kasrat bahut pasand aayi tamam pahariyan aur maidan un se pur the (Musnad Ahmad). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ukasha ke baad khare hone wale ek Ansari the (R.A) (Tabrani). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazar ya saath lakh aadmi jannat mein jayenge jo ek dusre ka haath thame hue honge sab ek sath jannat mein jayenge chamakte hue chaudhwin raat ke chand jaise un ke chehre honge.

(Bukhari, Muslim, Tabrani) Husain bin Abdur-Rahman kehte hain ke Saeed bin Jubair ke paas tha to aap ne daryaft kiya raat ko jo sitara toota tha tum mein se kisi ne dekha tha? Main ne kaha haan Hazrat, main ne dekha tha, yeh na samajhiyega ke main namaz mein tha balkeh mujhe bichhoo ne kaat khaya tha. Hazrat Saeed ne poocha phir tum ne kya kiya? Main ne kaha dam kar diya tha. Kaha kyun? Main ne kaha Hazrat Sha'bi ne Buraidah bin Haseeb ki riwayat se hadith bayan ki hai ke nazar-e-bad aur zehreelay janwaron ka dam jhaara karana hai. Kehne lage khair, jisay jo pohanchay us par amal kare, hamain to Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne sunaya hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Mujh par ummatain pesh ki gayin, kisi Nabi ke sath ek jamaat thi, kisi ke sath ek shakhs aur do shakhs aur kisi Nabi ke sath koi na tha. Ab jo dekha ke ek bari pur-jamaat nazar pari, main samjha yeh to meri ummat hogi, phir maloom hua ke Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki ummat hai. Mujh se kaha gaya aasman ke kinaron ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha to wahan beshumar log thay. Mujh se kaha gaya yeh aap ki ummat hai aur un ke sath sattar hazar aur hain jo be-hisab aur be-azab jannat mein jayenge. Yeh hadith bayan farma kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) to makan par chale gaye aur Sahaba aapas mein kehne lage shayad yeh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Sahabi honge, kisi ne kaha nahin Islam mein paida hone wale aur Islam par hi marne wale honge waghera waghera. Aap tashreef laye aur poocha kya baatein kar rahe ho? Hum ne zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya: Nahin, yeh woh log hain jo na dam jhaara karen na karayen, na daagh lagwayen na shagoon lein balkeh apne Rab par bharosa rakhein. Hazrat Ukasha (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ne dua ki darkhwast ki, aap ne dua ki: Ya Allah! Tu isay in mein se hi bana. Phir dusre shakhs ne bhi yahi kaha, aap ne farmaya Ukasha aagay barh gaye. Yeh hadith Bukhari mein hai lekin is mein dam jhaara nahin karne ka lafz nahin, Sahih Muslim mein yeh lafz bhi hai.

Ek aur mutawwal hadith mein hai ke pehli jamaat toh najaat payegi, unke chehre chaudhween raat ke chand ki tarah roshan honge, unse hisab bhi na liya jayega. Phir unke baad wale sab se zyada roshan sitare jaise chamakdar chehre wale honge (Muslim). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhse mere Rab ka wada hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazaar shakhs baghair hisab-o-azab ke dakhil-e-bahisht honge, har hazaar ke sath sattar hazaar honge aur teen lappain aur mere Rab-e-Azz-o-Jal ki lappon se (Kitab-us-Sunan li-Hafiz Abi Bakr bin Asim). Iski isnad bahut umdah hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke aap se sattar hazaar ki tadaad sun kar Yazeed bin Akhnas ne kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh toh aap ki ummat ki tadaad ke muqable mein bahut hi thode hain, toh aap ne farmaya har hazaar ke sath sattar hazaar hain aur phir Allah ne teen lappain (hatheliyon ka kashkol) bhar kar aur bhi ata farmaye hain, iski isnad bhi hasan hai (Kitab-us-Sunan). Aur ek aur hadith mein hai ke mere Rab ne jo izzat aur jalal wala hai mujhse wada kiya hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazaar ko bila-hisab jannat mein le jayega, phir ek ek hazaar ki shafa'at se sattar sattar hazaar aadmi aur jayenge, phir mera Rab apne dono hathon se teen lappain (dono hathon ki hatheliyon ko mila kar katora banana) bhar kar aur dalega. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne yeh sun kar khush ho kar Allahu Akbar kaha aur farmaya ke unki shafa'at unke baap dadon aur beton aur betiyon aur khandan-o-qabila mein hogi, Allah kare main toh un mein se ho jaun jinhein Allah Ta'ala apni lappon mein bhar kar aakhir mein jannat mein le jayega (Tabrani). Is hadith ki sanad mein bhi koi illat nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Kuraid mein huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek hadith farmayi jis mein jannat mein yeh bhi farmaya yeh sattar hazaar jo bila-hisab jannat mein dakhil kiye jayenge, mera khayal hai ke unke aate aate toh tum apne liye aur apne baal bachon aur biwiyon ke liye jannat mein jagah muqarrar kar chuke honge (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Iski sanad mein shart Muslim par hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah ka wada hai ke meri ummat mein se chaar lakh aadmi jannat mein jayenge. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch aur zyada kijiye, ise sun kar Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Abu Bakr bas karo, Siddiq (R.A) ne jawab diya kyun sahib agar hum sab ke sab jannat mein chale jayenge toh aap ko kya nuqsan hai? Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya agar Allah chahe toh ek hi hath mein sari makhlooq ko jannat mein daal de. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Umar sach kehte hain (Musnad-e-Abdur Razzaq). Isi hadith ki aur sanad se bhi bayan hai us mein tadaad ek lakh aayi hai (Asbahani). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jab sahaba ne sattar hazaar aur phir har ek ke sath sattar hazaar phir Allah ki lapp bhar kar jannati banana suna toh kehne lage phir toh uski badnaseebi mein kya shak reh gaya jo bawajood iske bhi jahannam mein jaye (Abu Laila). Upar wali hadith ek aur sanad se bhi bayan hui hai us mein tadaad teen lakh ki hai, phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya meri ummat ke sare muhajir toh is mein aa hi jayenge phir baqi tadaad a'arabiyon se puri hogi (Muhammad bin Sahl). Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) kehte hain huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne hisab kiya gaya toh jumla tadaad chaar crore nauve hazaar hui. Ek aur hasan hadith Tabrani mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya qasam hai us zaat ki ke jaan Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki uske hath mein hai, tum ek andheri raat ki tarah beshumar ek sath jannat ki taraf badhoge, zameen tum se pur ho jayegi, tamam farishtay pukar uthenge ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath jo jamaat aayi woh tamam nabiyon ki jamaat se bahut zyada hai. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) farmate hain ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna aap ne farmaya sirf meri tabe-dar ummat ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi hogi. Sahaba ne khush ho kar na'ara-e-takbeer buland kiya, phir farmaya ke mujhe toh umeed hai ke tum ahl-e-jannat ka teesra hissa ho jaoge, hum ne phir takbeer kahi, phir farmaya main umeed karta hun ke tum aadhon-aadh ho jao (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur hadith mein hai ke aap ne sahaba se farmaya ke tum raazi nahin ho ke tum tamam jannaton ke chauthayi ho? Hum ne khush ho kar Allah ki badayi bayan ki, phir farmaya ke tum raazi nahin ho ke tamam ahl-e-jannat ki tihayi ho? Hum ne phir takbeer kahi, aap ne farmaya mujhe toh umeed hai ke tum jannatiyon ke aadhon-aadh ho ge (Bukhari, Muslim). Tabrani mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya kehte ho tum jannatiyon ka chauthayi hissa banna chahte ho ke chauthayi jannat tumhare paas ho aur teen aur chauthaiyon mein tamam ummatain hon?

Hum ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool khoob jaanta hai, aap ne farmaya achha tihai hissa ho to? Hum ne kaha yeh bahut hai. Farmaya agar aadhon aadh ho to? Unhon ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ phir to bahut hi zyada hai. Aap ne farmaya suno! Kul ahl-e-jannat ki ek sau bees safein hain jin mein se assi safein sirf is meri ummat ki hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai ke ahl-e-jannat ki ek sau bees safein, un mein assi safein sirf is ummat ki hain. Yeh hadith Tabrani, Tirmidhi waghera mein bhi hai. Tabrani ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jab aayat (Thullatum minal awwaleen 39, wa thullatum minal aakhireen 40) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 39-40) utri to Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya tum ahl-e-jannat ki chauthai ho, phir farmaya balkay thulth ho, phir farmaya balkay nisf ho, phir farmaya do tihai ho. (Ae wasee rahmaton walay aur be-rok na'maton walay Allah! Hum tera be-inteha shukr ada karte hain ke tu ne hamein aisay mu'azzaz-o-muhtaram Rasool ﷺ ki ummat mein paida kiya. Tere sachay Rasool ﷺ ki sachi zabaan se tere is barhay charhay fazl-o-karam ka haal sun kar hum gunahgaron ke munh mein paani bhar aaya. Ae maa baap se zyada meharban Allah! Hamari aas na tor aur hamein bhi un nek hastiyon ke saath jannat mein dakhil farma. Bari Ta'ala teri rahmat ki anginat aur beshumar bandon mein se agar ek qatra bhi hum gunahgaron par baras jaye to hamaray gunahon ko dho daalne aur hamein teri rahmat-o-rizwan ke laiq banane ke liye kaafi hai. Allah! Is paak zikr ke mauqa par hum haath utha kar, daaman phaila kar, aansoo baha kar, ummeedon bharay dil se teri rahmat ka sahara le kar, tere karam ka daaman thaam kar tujh se bheek maangte hain, tu qabool farma aur apni rahmat se hamein bhi apni razamandi ka ghar Jannat-ul-Firdaus ata farma. Ameen Ilahal Haq Ameen). Sahih Bukhari, Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain hum duniya mein sab se aakhir aaye aur jannat mein sab se pehle jayenge aur un ko Kitabullah pehle mili, hamein baad mein mili. Jin baaton mein unhon ne ikhtilaf kiya un mein Allah ne hamein sahih tareeq ki taufeeq di. Jumma ka din bhi aisa hi hai ke Yahood hamaray peechay hain hafta ke din aur Nasrani un ke peechay itwar ke din. Dar Qutni mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jab tak main jannat mein dakhil na ho jaaun, Ambiya par dukhool-e-jannat haram hai aur jab tak meri ummat na dakhil ho, dusri ummaton par dukhool-e-jannat haram hai. Yeh woh hadeesain thin jinhein hum is aayat ke tehat waarid karna chahte thay, falhamdulillah. Ummat ko bhi chahiye ke yahan is aayat mein jitni safein hain un par mazbooti ke saath qaim-o-saabit rahein, yani Amr-e-Bil-Ma'roof aur Nahi-e-Anil-Munkar aur Imaan-e-Billah. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne apne hajj mein is aayat ki tilawat farma kar logon se kaha ke agar tum is aayat ki tareef mein dakhil hona chahte ho to yeh ausaaf bhi apne mein paida karo. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer farmate hain, Ahl-e-Kitab un kaamon ko chor baithay thay jin ki muzammat Kalam-e-Allah ne ki, farmaya aayat (Kaanu la yatana hauna 'an munkarin fa'aluhu, labi'sa ma kaanu yaf'aloon) (5:79).

(Al-Ma'idah: 79) Woh log burai ki baaton se logon ko rokte na the. Chunke mandarija-bala aayat mein imandaron ki tareef-o-tauseef bayan hui to us ke baad Ahl-e-Kitab ki muzammat bayan ho rahi hai, to farmaya ke agar yeh log bhi mere Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par imaan late to unhein bhi yeh fazilatein miltin lekin in mein se kufr-o-fisq aur gunahon par jame hue hain, haan kuch log ba-imaan bhi hain. Phir Allah Ta'ala musalmanon ko basharat deta hai ke tum na ghabrana, Allah tumhein tumhare mukhalifeen par ghalib rakhe ga. Chunancha Khaybar wale din Allah Ta'ala ne unhein zaleel kiya aur un se pehle Banu Qainuqa, Banu Nazeer aur Banu Quraiza ko bhi Allah ne zaleel-o-ruswa kiya. Isi tarah Shaam ke nasrani sahaba ke waqt mein maghloob hue aur mulk-e-Shaam un ke hathon se nikal gaya aur hamesha ke liye musalmanon ke qabze mein aa gaya aur wahan ek haq wali jamaat Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke aane tak haq par qaim rahe gi. Hazrat Isa (A.S) aa kar millat-e-Islam aur shariat-e-Muhammadi ke mutabiq hukm karenge, saleeb todenge, khanzeer ko qatl karenge, jizya qabool na karenge, sirf Islam hi qabool farmayenge. Phir farmaya ke un ke upar zillat aur pasti daal di gayi, haan Allah ki panah ke alawa kahin bhi aman-o-aman aur izzat nahin, yani jizya dena aur muslim badshah ki ita'at karna qabool kar lein aur logon ki panah yani aqd-e-zimma muqarrar ho jaye ya koi musalman aman de de, agarche koi aurat ho ya koi ghulam ho, ulama ka ek qaul yeh bhi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke habl se murad hai jo ghazab ke mustahiq hue aur maskeeni chipka di gayi, un ke kufr aur ambiya ke takabbur, hasad, sarkashi waghera ka badla hai. Isi ba'is un par zillat, pasti aur maskeeni hamesha ke liye daal di gayi, un ki nafarmaniyon aur tajawuz-e-haq ka yeh badla hai, al-iyazu billah. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hadith hai ke Bani Israel ek ek din mein teen teen sau nabiyon ko qatl kar dalte the aur din ke aakhri hissa mein apne apne kamon par bazaron mein lag jate the.

Sab se behtar shakhs kaun? Aur sab se behtar ummat ka a'izaz kis ko mila? Allah Ta'ala khabar de raha hai ke Ummat-e-Muhammadiya tamam ummaton par behtar hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain tum auron ke haq mein sab se behtar ho to logon ki gardanein pakar pakar kar Islam ki taraf jhukate ho, aur mufassireen bhi yahi farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke tum tamam ummaton se behtar ho aur sab se zyada logon ko nafa pahunchane wale ho. Abu Lahab ki beti Hazrat Durra R.A farmati hain ek martaba kisi ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se poocha aap us waqt mimbar par the ke Huzoor ﷺ kaunsa shakhs behtar hai? Aap ne farmaya sab logon se behtar woh shakhs hai jo sab se zyada qari-e-Quran ho, sab se zyada parhezgar ho, sab se zyada achhaiyon ka hukm karne wala, sab se zyada buraiyon se rokne wala, sab se zyada rishte naate milane wala ho. (Musnad Ahmad). Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh woh Sahaba hain jinhon ne Makkah se Madina ki taraf hijrat ki, sahih baat yeh hai ke yeh aayat saari ummat par mushtamil hai, beshak yeh hadith mein bhi hai ke sab se behtar mera zamana hai phir us ke baad us se mila hua zamana phir us ke baad wala. Ek aur riwayat mein hai aayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنٰكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّسَطًا لِّتَكُوْنُوْا شُهَدَاۗءَ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَيَكُـوْنَ الرَّسُوْلُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيْدًا) (Al-Baqarah: 143) hum ne tumhein behtar ummat banaya hai taake tum logon par gawah bano, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain tum ne agli ummaton ki tadaad sattar tak pahuncha di hai, Allah ke nazdeek tum un sab se behtar aur zyada buzurg ho, yeh mashhoor hadith hai Imam Tirmidhi ne ise Hasan kaha hai. Is ummat ki afzaliyat ki ek bari daleel is ummat ke Nabi ki afzaliyat hai, Aap tamam makhlooq ke sardar tamam rasoolon se zyada ikram-o-izzat wale hain, Aap ki shar' itni kamil aur itni poori hai ke aisi shariat kisi Nabi ko nahin di gayi, to zahir baat hai ke in fazail ko sametne wali ummat bhi sab se a'ala-o-afzal hai, is shariat ka thora sa amal bhi aur ummaton ke zyada amal se behtar-o-afzal hai. Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib R.A farmate hain ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya main woh woh ne'matein diya gaya hoon jo mujh se pehle koi nahin diya gaya, logon ne poocha woh kya baatein hain? Aap ne farmaya meri madad ra'ab se ki gayi hai, main zameen ki kunjiyaan diya gaya hoon, mera naam Ahmad rakha gaya hai, mere liye mitti paak ki gayi hai, meri ummat sab ummaton se behtar banayi gayi hai (Musnad Ahmad), is hadith ki asnaad Hasan hai. Hazrat Abu Darda R.A farmate hain main ne Abu Al-Qasim ﷺ se suna aap farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Isa A.S se farmaya ke main tumhare baad ek ummat paida karne wala hoon jo rahat par hamd-o-shukr karenge aur museebat par talab-e-sawab aur sabr karenge halanke unhein hilm-o-ilm na hoga, aap ne ta'ajjub se poocha ke baghair bardbari aur door-andeshi aur pukhta ilm ke yeh kaise mumkin hai?

Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne farmaya main unhein apna hilm-o-ilm ata farmaunga, main chahta hoon yahan par ba'az woh hadeesein bhi bayan kar doon jin ka zikr yahan munasib hai suniye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain meri ummat mein se sattar hazar shakhs baghair hisab kitab ke jannat mein jayenge jin ke chehre chaudhween raat ke chand ki tarah roshan honge sab yak rang honge, main ne apne Rabb se guzarish ki ke aye Allah is tadaad mein aur izafa farma Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya har ek ke sath sattar hazar aur bhi, Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) yeh hadees bayan kar ke farmaya karte the ke phir toh is tadaad mein gaon aur dehaton wale balkay badiyanasheen bhi aajayenge (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe mere Rabb ne sattar hazar admiyon ko meri ummat mein se baghair hisab ke jannat mein dakhil hone ki khushkhabri di, Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne yeh sun kar farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch aur ziyadati talab karte aap ne farmaya main ne apne Rabb se sawal kiya toh mujhe khushkhabri mili ke har shakhs ke sath sattar sattar hazar ka wada hua.

Hazrat Umar R.A ne phir guzarish ki ke Allah ke Nabi ﷺ aur kuch bhi mangte? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya manga toh mujhe itni ziyadati aur mili aur phir dono haath phaila kar bataya ke is tarah, rawi-e-hadith kehte hain is tarah jab Allah Ta'ala samete toh Allah Azzawajal hi jaanta hai ke kis qadar makhlooq is mein aayegi (FasubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi) (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Thauban R.A Hims mein bimar ho gaye, Abdullah bin Qurt wahan ke amir thay, woh ayadat ko na aa sake. Ek Kala'i shakhs jab aap ki bimar pursi ke liye gaya toh aap ne us se daryaft kiya ke likhna jaante ho? Us ne kaha haan, farmaya likho: Yeh khat Thauban ki taraf se amir Abdullah bin Qurt ki taraf hai jo Rasool Allah ﷺ ke khadim hain, baad hamd-o-salawat ke wazeh ho ke agar Hazrat Isa A.S ya Hazrat Musa A.S ka koi khadim yahan hota aur bimar padta toh tum ayadat ke liye jaate. Phir kaha yeh khat le jao aur amir ko pahuncha do. Jab yeh khat amir-e-Hims ke paas pahuncha toh ghabra kar uth khade hue aur seedhe yahan tashreef laye. Kuch der baith kar ayadat kar ke jab jaane ka irada kiya toh Hazrat Thauban R.A ne un ki chadar pakad kar roka aur farmaya ek hadith sunte jayen, main ne Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki zaban-e-mubarak se suna hai, aap ﷺ ne farmaya meri ummat mein se sattar hazar shakhs baghair hisab-o-azab ke jannat mein jayenge, har hazar ke sath sattar hazar aur honge (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadith bhi sahih hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud R.A farmate hain ek raat hum khidmat-e-nabwi mein der tak baatein karte rahe, phir subah jab hazir-e-khidmat hue toh Huzoor ﷺ ne irshad farmaya suno aaj raat ambiya apni apni ummat samet mujhe dikhaye gaye, ba'az ambiya ke sath sirf teen shakhs thay, ba'az ke sath mukhtasar sa giroh, ba'az ke sath ek jamaat, kisi ke sath koi bhi na tha. Jab Musa A.S aaye toh un ke sath bahut se log thay, mujhe yeh jamaat pasand aayi, main ne poocha yeh kaun hain? Toh jawab mila ke yeh aap ke bhai Musa A.S hain aur un ke sath Bani Israel hain. Main ne kaha phir meri ummat kahan hai? Jawab mila apni dahini taraf dekho, ab jo dekhta hoon toh beshumar majma hai jis se pahadiyan bhi dhak gayi hain, ab mujh se poocha gaya kaho khush ho? Main ne kaha mere Rab main raazi ho gaya, farmaya gaya suno!

Un ke sath sattar hazar aur hain jo baghair hisab ke jannat mein dakhil honge, ab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum par mere maa baap fida hon agar ho sake to un sattar hazar mein se hi hona agar yeh na ho sake to un mein se ho jo pahariyon ko chupaye hue the agar yeh bhi na ho sake to un mein se hona jo aasman ke kinaron kinaron par the, Hazrat Ukasha bin Mihsan ne khare ho kar kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe un sattar hazar mein se kare aap ne dua ki to ek dusre sahabi ne bhi uth kar yahi guzarish ki to aap ne farmaya tum par Hazrat Ukasha sabqat kar gaye, hum ab aapas mein kehne lage ke shayad yeh sattar hazar log honge jo Islam par hi paida hue hon aur puri umar mein kabhi Allah ke sath shirk kiya hi na ho aap ko jab yeh maloom hua to farmaya yeh woh log hain jo dam jhara nahin karate aag ke daagh nahin lagwate shagoon nahin lete aur apne Rab par pura bharosa rakhte hain (Musnad Ahmad). Ek aur sanad se itni ziyadati is mein aur bhi hai jab main ne apni razamandi zahir ki to mujh se kaha gaya ab apni bayin janib dekho main ne dekha to beshumar majma hai jis ne aasman ke kinaron ko bhi dhak liya hai ek aur riwayat mein hai ke mausam-e-hajj ka yeh waqiya hai aap farmate hain mujhe apni ummat ki yeh kasrat bahut pasand aayi tamam pahariyan aur maidan un se pur the (Musnad Ahmad). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ukasha ke baad khare hone wale ek Ansari the (R.A) (Tabrani). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazar ya saath lakh aadmi jannat mein jayenge jo ek dusre ka haath thame hue honge sab ek sath jannat mein jayenge chamakte hue chaudhwin raat ke chand jaise un ke chehre honge.

(Bukhari, Muslim, Tabrani) Husain bin Abdur-Rahman kehte hain ke Saeed bin Jubair ke paas tha to aap ne daryaft kiya raat ko jo sitara toota tha tum mein se kisi ne dekha tha? Main ne kaha haan Hazrat, main ne dekha tha, yeh na samajhiyega ke main namaz mein tha balkeh mujhe bichhoo ne kaat khaya tha. Hazrat Saeed ne poocha phir tum ne kya kiya? Main ne kaha dam kar diya tha. Kaha kyun? Main ne kaha Hazrat Sha'bi ne Buraidah bin Haseeb ki riwayat se hadith bayan ki hai ke nazar-e-bad aur zehreelay janwaron ka dam jhaara karana hai. Kehne lage khair, jisay jo pohanchay us par amal kare, hamain to Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne sunaya hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Mujh par ummatain pesh ki gayin, kisi Nabi ke sath ek jamaat thi, kisi ke sath ek shakhs aur do shakhs aur kisi Nabi ke sath koi na tha. Ab jo dekha ke ek bari pur-jamaat nazar pari, main samjha yeh to meri ummat hogi, phir maloom hua ke Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki ummat hai. Mujh se kaha gaya aasman ke kinaron ki taraf dekho, main ne dekha to wahan beshumar log thay. Mujh se kaha gaya yeh aap ki ummat hai aur un ke sath sattar hazar aur hain jo be-hisab aur be-azab jannat mein jayenge. Yeh hadith bayan farma kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) to makan par chale gaye aur Sahaba aapas mein kehne lage shayad yeh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Sahabi honge, kisi ne kaha nahin Islam mein paida hone wale aur Islam par hi marne wale honge waghera waghera. Aap tashreef laye aur poocha kya baatein kar rahe ho? Hum ne zikr kiya to aap ne farmaya: Nahin, yeh woh log hain jo na dam jhaara karen na karayen, na daagh lagwayen na shagoon lein balkeh apne Rab par bharosa rakhein. Hazrat Ukasha (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ne dua ki darkhwast ki, aap ne dua ki: Ya Allah! Tu isay in mein se hi bana. Phir dusre shakhs ne bhi yahi kaha, aap ne farmaya Ukasha aagay barh gaye. Yeh hadith Bukhari mein hai lekin is mein dam jhaara nahin karne ka lafz nahin, Sahih Muslim mein yeh lafz bhi hai.

Ek aur mutawwal hadith mein hai ke pehli jamaat toh najaat payegi, unke chehre chaudhween raat ke chand ki tarah roshan honge, unse hisab bhi na liya jayega. Phir unke baad wale sab se zyada roshan sitare jaise chamakdar chehre wale honge (Muslim). Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhse mere Rab ka wada hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazaar shakhs baghair hisab-o-azab ke dakhil-e-bahisht honge, har hazaar ke sath sattar hazaar honge aur teen lappain aur mere Rab-e-Azz-o-Jal ki lappon se (Kitab-us-Sunan li-Hafiz Abi Bakr bin Asim). Iski isnad bahut umdah hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke aap se sattar hazaar ki tadaad sun kar Yazeed bin Akhnas ne kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh toh aap ki ummat ki tadaad ke muqable mein bahut hi thode hain, toh aap ne farmaya har hazaar ke sath sattar hazaar hain aur phir Allah ne teen lappain (hatheliyon ka kashkol) bhar kar aur bhi ata farmaye hain, iski isnad bhi hasan hai (Kitab-us-Sunan). Aur ek aur hadith mein hai ke mere Rab ne jo izzat aur jalal wala hai mujhse wada kiya hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazaar ko bila-hisab jannat mein le jayega, phir ek ek hazaar ki shafa'at se sattar sattar hazaar aadmi aur jayenge, phir mera Rab apne dono hathon se teen lappain (dono hathon ki hatheliyon ko mila kar katora banana) bhar kar aur dalega. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne yeh sun kar khush ho kar Allahu Akbar kaha aur farmaya ke unki shafa'at unke baap dadon aur beton aur betiyon aur khandan-o-qabila mein hogi, Allah kare main toh un mein se ho jaun jinhein Allah Ta'ala apni lappon mein bhar kar aakhir mein jannat mein le jayega (Tabrani). Is hadith ki sanad mein bhi koi illat nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Kuraid mein huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek hadith farmayi jis mein jannat mein yeh bhi farmaya yeh sattar hazaar jo bila-hisab jannat mein dakhil kiye jayenge, mera khayal hai ke unke aate aate toh tum apne liye aur apne baal bachon aur biwiyon ke liye jannat mein jagah muqarrar kar chuke honge (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Iski sanad mein shart Muslim par hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah ka wada hai ke meri ummat mein se chaar lakh aadmi jannat mein jayenge. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch aur zyada kijiye, ise sun kar Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya Abu Bakr bas karo, Siddiq (R.A) ne jawab diya kyun sahib agar hum sab ke sab jannat mein chale jayenge toh aap ko kya nuqsan hai? Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya agar Allah chahe toh ek hi hath mein sari makhlooq ko jannat mein daal de. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Umar sach kehte hain (Musnad-e-Abdur Razzaq). Isi hadith ki aur sanad se bhi bayan hai us mein tadaad ek lakh aayi hai (Asbahani). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jab sahaba ne sattar hazaar aur phir har ek ke sath sattar hazaar phir Allah ki lapp bhar kar jannati banana suna toh kehne lage phir toh uski badnaseebi mein kya shak reh gaya jo bawajood iske bhi jahannam mein jaye (Abu Laila). Upar wali hadith ek aur sanad se bhi bayan hui hai us mein tadaad teen lakh ki hai, phir Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya meri ummat ke sare muhajir toh is mein aa hi jayenge phir baqi tadaad a'arabiyon se puri hogi (Muhammad bin Sahl). Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) kehte hain huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne hisab kiya gaya toh jumla tadaad chaar crore nauve hazaar hui. Ek aur hasan hadith Tabrani mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya qasam hai us zaat ki ke jaan Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki uske hath mein hai, tum ek andheri raat ki tarah beshumar ek sath jannat ki taraf badhoge, zameen tum se pur ho jayegi, tamam farishtay pukar uthenge ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath jo jamaat aayi woh tamam nabiyon ki jamaat se bahut zyada hai. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) farmate hain ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna aap ne farmaya sirf meri tabe-dar ummat ahl-e-jannat ki chauthayi hogi. Sahaba ne khush ho kar na'ara-e-takbeer buland kiya, phir farmaya ke mujhe toh umeed hai ke tum ahl-e-jannat ka teesra hissa ho jaoge, hum ne phir takbeer kahi, phir farmaya main umeed karta hun ke tum aadhon-aadh ho jao (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aur hadith mein hai ke aap ne sahaba se farmaya ke tum raazi nahin ho ke tum tamam jannaton ke chauthayi ho? Hum ne khush ho kar Allah ki badayi bayan ki, phir farmaya ke tum raazi nahin ho ke tamam ahl-e-jannat ki tihayi ho? Hum ne phir takbeer kahi, aap ne farmaya mujhe toh umeed hai ke tum jannatiyon ke aadhon-aadh ho ge (Bukhari, Muslim). Tabrani mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya kehte ho tum jannatiyon ka chauthayi hissa banna chahte ho ke chauthayi jannat tumhare paas ho aur teen aur chauthaiyon mein tamam ummatain hon?

Hum ne kaha Allah aur us ka Rasool khoob jaanta hai, aap ne farmaya achha tihai hissa ho to? Hum ne kaha yeh bahut hai. Farmaya agar aadhon aadh ho to? Unhon ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ phir to bahut hi zyada hai. Aap ne farmaya suno! Kul ahl-e-jannat ki ek sau bees safein hain jin mein se assi safein sirf is meri ummat ki hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai ke ahl-e-jannat ki ek sau bees safein, un mein assi safein sirf is ummat ki hain. Yeh hadith Tabrani, Tirmidhi waghera mein bhi hai. Tabrani ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jab aayat (Thullatum minal awwaleen 39, wa thullatum minal aakhireen 40) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 39-40) utri to Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya tum ahl-e-jannat ki chauthai ho, phir farmaya balkay thulth ho, phir farmaya balkay nisf ho, phir farmaya do tihai ho. (Ae wasee rahmaton walay aur be-rok na'maton walay Allah! Hum tera be-inteha shukr ada karte hain ke tu ne hamein aisay mu'azzaz-o-muhtaram Rasool ﷺ ki ummat mein paida kiya. Tere sachay Rasool ﷺ ki sachi zabaan se tere is barhay charhay fazl-o-karam ka haal sun kar hum gunahgaron ke munh mein paani bhar aaya. Ae maa baap se zyada meharban Allah! Hamari aas na tor aur hamein bhi un nek hastiyon ke saath jannat mein dakhil farma. Bari Ta'ala teri rahmat ki anginat aur beshumar bandon mein se agar ek qatra bhi hum gunahgaron par baras jaye to hamaray gunahon ko dho daalne aur hamein teri rahmat-o-rizwan ke laiq banane ke liye kaafi hai. Allah! Is paak zikr ke mauqa par hum haath utha kar, daaman phaila kar, aansoo baha kar, ummeedon bharay dil se teri rahmat ka sahara le kar, tere karam ka daaman thaam kar tujh se bheek maangte hain, tu qabool farma aur apni rahmat se hamein bhi apni razamandi ka ghar Jannat-ul-Firdaus ata farma. Ameen Ilahal Haq Ameen). Sahih Bukhari, Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain hum duniya mein sab se aakhir aaye aur jannat mein sab se pehle jayenge aur un ko Kitabullah pehle mili, hamein baad mein mili. Jin baaton mein unhon ne ikhtilaf kiya un mein Allah ne hamein sahih tareeq ki taufeeq di. Jumma ka din bhi aisa hi hai ke Yahood hamaray peechay hain hafta ke din aur Nasrani un ke peechay itwar ke din. Dar Qutni mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jab tak main jannat mein dakhil na ho jaaun, Ambiya par dukhool-e-jannat haram hai aur jab tak meri ummat na dakhil ho, dusri ummaton par dukhool-e-jannat haram hai. Yeh woh hadeesain thin jinhein hum is aayat ke tehat waarid karna chahte thay, falhamdulillah. Ummat ko bhi chahiye ke yahan is aayat mein jitni safein hain un par mazbooti ke saath qaim-o-saabit rahein, yani Amr-e-Bil-Ma'roof aur Nahi-e-Anil-Munkar aur Imaan-e-Billah. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne apne hajj mein is aayat ki tilawat farma kar logon se kaha ke agar tum is aayat ki tareef mein dakhil hona chahte ho to yeh ausaaf bhi apne mein paida karo. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer farmate hain, Ahl-e-Kitab un kaamon ko chor baithay thay jin ki muzammat Kalam-e-Allah ne ki, farmaya aayat (Kaanu la yatana hauna 'an munkarin fa'aluhu, labi'sa ma kaanu yaf'aloon) (5:79).

(Al-Ma'idah: 79) Woh log burai ki baaton se logon ko rokte na the. Chunke mandarija-bala aayat mein imandaron ki tareef-o-tauseef bayan hui to us ke baad Ahl-e-Kitab ki muzammat bayan ho rahi hai, to farmaya ke agar yeh log bhi mere Nabi-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par imaan late to unhein bhi yeh fazilatein miltin lekin in mein se kufr-o-fisq aur gunahon par jame hue hain, haan kuch log ba-imaan bhi hain. Phir Allah Ta'ala musalmanon ko basharat deta hai ke tum na ghabrana, Allah tumhein tumhare mukhalifeen par ghalib rakhe ga. Chunancha Khaybar wale din Allah Ta'ala ne unhein zaleel kiya aur un se pehle Banu Qainuqa, Banu Nazeer aur Banu Quraiza ko bhi Allah ne zaleel-o-ruswa kiya. Isi tarah Shaam ke nasrani sahaba ke waqt mein maghloob hue aur mulk-e-Shaam un ke hathon se nikal gaya aur hamesha ke liye musalmanon ke qabze mein aa gaya aur wahan ek haq wali jamaat Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke aane tak haq par qaim rahe gi. Hazrat Isa (A.S) aa kar millat-e-Islam aur shariat-e-Muhammadi ke mutabiq hukm karenge, saleeb todenge, khanzeer ko qatl karenge, jizya qabool na karenge, sirf Islam hi qabool farmayenge. Phir farmaya ke un ke upar zillat aur pasti daal di gayi, haan Allah ki panah ke alawa kahin bhi aman-o-aman aur izzat nahin, yani jizya dena aur muslim badshah ki ita'at karna qabool kar lein aur logon ki panah yani aqd-e-zimma muqarrar ho jaye ya koi musalman aman de de, agarche koi aurat ho ya koi ghulam ho, ulama ka ek qaul yeh bhi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke habl se murad hai jo ghazab ke mustahiq hue aur maskeeni chipka di gayi, un ke kufr aur ambiya ke takabbur, hasad, sarkashi waghera ka badla hai. Isi ba'is un par zillat, pasti aur maskeeni hamesha ke liye daal di gayi, un ki nafarmaniyon aur tajawuz-e-haq ka yeh badla hai, al-iyazu billah. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hadith hai ke Bani Israel ek ek din mein teen teen sau nabiyon ko qatl kar dalte the aur din ke aakhri hissa mein apne apne kamon par bazaron mein lag jate the.

Zulm nahin saza. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain Ahl-e-Kitab aur Ashab-e-Muhammad (ﷺ) barabar nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Isha ki namaz mein ek martaba der laga di, phir jab aaye to jo Ashab-e-muntazir thay un se farmaya kisi deen wala is waqt tak Allah ka zikr nahin kar raha magar sirf tum hi Allah ke zikr mein ho, is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Lekin aksar mufassireen ka qaul hai ke Ahl-e-Kitab ke ulama maslan Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam, Hazrat Asad bin Ubaid, Hazrat Sa'laba bin Shu'ba waghera ke bare mein yeh aayat aayi ke yeh log un Ahl-e-Kitab mein shamil nahin jin ki muzammat pehle guzri, balkay yeh ba-imaan jamaat Amr-e-Ilahi par qaim Shariat-e-Muhammadiya ki tabe hai. Istiqamat-o-yaqeen is mein hai, yeh pakbaz log raton ke waqt tahajjud ki namaz mein bhi Allah ke kalam ki tilawat karte rehte hain, Allah par, Qayamat par imaan rakhte hain aur logon ko bhi inhi baton ka hukum karte hain, un ke khilaf se rokte hain, nek kamon mein pesh-pesh raha karte hain. Ab Allah Ta'ala inhein khitab ata farmata hai ke yeh saleh log hain aur surat ke aakhir mein bhi farmaya aayat (Wa inna min ahlil kitabi lamay yu'minu billahi wa ma unzila ilaikum wa ma unzila ilaihim khashi'ina lillah) (Surah Al-Imran: 199). Ba'az Ahl-e-Kitab Allah Ta'ala par, is Quran par aur Taurat-o-Injeel par bhi imaan rakhte hain, Allah Ta'ala se darte rehte hain. Yahan bhi farmaya ke un ke yeh nek aamal zaya na hon balkay pura badla milega, tamam parhezgar log Allah ki nazron mein hain, woh kisi ke achhe amal ko barbad nahin karta. Wahan in bedeen logon ko Allah ke yahan na maal nafa de ga na aulad, yeh to jahannami hain. 'Sar' ke ma'ani sakht sardi ke hain jo kheton ko jala deti hai, garz jis tarah kisi ki tayyar kheti par barf pade aur woh jal kar khakistar ho jaye, nafa chhor asal bhi gharat ho jaye aur ummeedon par pani phir jaye, isi tarah yeh kuffar hain. Jo kuch yeh kharch karte hain us ka nek badla to kahan aur azaab hoga. Yeh Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se zulm nahin balkay yeh un ki bad-aamaliyon ki saza hai.

Kafir aur munafiq musalman ke dost nahin, unhein apna hum-raaz na banao. Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko kafiron aur munafiqon ki dosti aur hum-raaz hone se rokta hai ke yeh toh tumhare dushman hain. In ki chakni chupri baton mein khush na ho jana aur un ke makr ke phande mein phans na jana, warna mauqa pa kar yeh tumhein sakht zarar pahunchayenge aur apni batini adawat nikalenge. Tum unhein apna raaz-dar hargiz na samajhna, raaz ki baatein un ke kanon tak hargiz na pahunchana. Bitana kehte hain insaan ke raaz-dar dost ko. Aur 'min doonikum' se murad jis khalifa ko muqarrar kiya, us ke liye do bitana muqarrar kiye; ek toh bhalai ki baat samjhane wala aur us par raghbat dene wala, aur dusra burai ki rehbari karne wala aur us par amada karne wala. Bas Allah jise bachaye wahi bach sakta hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se kaha gaya ke yahan par Hira ka ek shakhs bada achha likhne wala aur bahut achhe hafiza wala hai, aap use apna muharrir aur munshi muqarrar kar lein. Aap ne farmaya is ka matlab yeh hoga ke ghair-momin ko bitana bana lunga jo Allah ne mana kiya hai. Is waqiye ko aur is aayat ko samne rakh kar zehen is natije par pahunchta hai ke zimmi kuffar ko bhi aise kamon mein na lagana chahiye, aisa na ho ke woh mukhalifeen ko musalmanon ke posheeda iradon se waqif kar de aur un ke dushmanon ko un se hoshiyar kar de, kyunke un ki toh chahat hi musalmanon ko neecha dikhane ki hoti hai. Azhar bin Rashid kehte hain ke log Hazrat Anas (R.A) se hadeesein sunte the, agar kisi hadees ka matlab samajh mein na aata toh Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) se ja kar matlab hal kar lete the. Ek din Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne yeh hadees bayan ki ke mushrikon ki aag se roshni talab na karo aur apni angoothi mein Arabi naqsh na karo. Unhon ne aa kar Hasan Basri (R.H) se is ki tashreeh daryaft ki toh aap ne farmaya ke pichle jumle ka toh yeh matlab hai ke angoothi par Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) na khudwao aur pehle jumle ka yeh matlab hai ke mushrikon se apne kamon mein mashwara na lo. Dekho Kitabullah mein bhi hai ke imandaro apne siwa dusron ko hum-raaz na banao, lekin Hasan Basri (R.H) ki yeh tashreeh qabil-e-ghaur hai. Hadees ka theek matlab ghaliban yeh hai ke Muhammad Rasoolullah Arabi khat mein apni angoothiyon par naqsh na karao, chunancha aur hadees mein saaf mumanat majood hai. Yeh is liye tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mohar ke sath mushabahat na ho aur awwal jumle ka matlab yeh hai ke mushrikon ki basti ke paas na raho, us ke pados se door raho, un ke shehron se hijrat kar jao. Jaise Abu Dawood mein hai ke musalmanon aur mushrikon ke darmiyan ki ladai ki aag ko kya tum nahin dekhte? Aur hadees mein hai jo mushrikon se mel-jol kare ya un ke sath rahe base, woh bhi unhi jaisa hai. Phir farmaya un ki baton se bhi un ki adawat tapak rahi hai, un ke chehron se bhi qiyafa-shanas un ki batini khabasaton ko maloom kar sakta hai. Phir jo un ke dilon mein tabah-kun shararatein hain woh toh tum se makhfi hain lekin hum ne toh saaf saaf bayan kar diya hai. Aaqil log aise makkaron ki makkari mein nahin aate. Phir farmaya dekho kitni kamzori ki baat hai ke tum un se mohabbat rakho aur woh tumhein na chahein, tumhara imaan kul kitab par ho aur yeh shak-shuba mein hi pade hue hain. Un ki kitab ko tum toh mano lekin yeh tumhari kitab ka inkar karein, toh chahiye toh yeh tha ke tum khud unhein kadi nazron se dekhte lekin bar-khilaf is ke yeh tumhari adawat ki aag mein jal rahe hain.

Samna hojaye toh apni imandari ki dastan bayan karne baith jate hain lekin jab zara alag hote hain toh gaiz-o-gazab se jalan aur hasad se apni ungliyan chabate hain. Pas musalmanon ko bhi in ki zahardari se dhoka nahin khana chahiye. Yeh chahe jalte bhunte rahein lekin Allah Ta'ala Islam aur musalmanon ko taraqqi deta rahega, musalman din raat har haisiyat mein barhte hi rahenge go woh mare gusse ke mar jayen. Allah in ke dilon ke bhedon se bakhoobi waqif hai, in ke tamam mansubon par khaak paregi, yeh apni shararaton mein kamyab na ho sakenge, apni chahat ke khilaf musalmanon ki din dugni taraqqi dekhenge aur aakhirat mein bhi inhe ne'maton wali jannat hasil karte dekhenge. Barkhilaf in ke yeh khud yahan bhi ruswa honge aur wahan bhi jahannam ka indhan banenge. In ki shiddat-e-adawat ki yeh kitni bari daleel hai ke jahan tumhein koi nafa pahunchta hai yeh kaleja masosne lagte hain aur agar (Allah na kare) tumhein koi nuqsan pahunch gaya toh in ki bachhein khil jati hain, baghlein bajane aur khushiyan manane lagte hain. Agar Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se mominon ki madad hui, yeh kuffar par ghalib aaye, inhe ghanimat ka maal mila, yeh tadaad mein barh gaye toh woh jal bujhe aur agar musalmanon par tangi aa gayi ya dushmanon mein ghir gaye toh in ke han eid manayi jane lagi. Ab Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko khitab kar ke farmata hai ke in shariron ki shararat aur in badbakhton ke makr se agar nijat chahte ho toh sabr-o-taqwa aur tawakkul karo. Allah Azza-wa-Jal khud tumhare dushmanon ko gher lega, kisi bhalai ke hasil karne, kisi burai se bachne ki kisi mein taqat nahin, jo Allah Ta'ala chahta hai hota hai aur jo nahin chahta nahin ho sakta, jo is par tawakkul kare use woh kafi hai. Isi munasibat se ab Jang-e-Uhud ka zikr shuru hota hai jis par musalmanon ke sabr-o-tahamul ka bayan hai aur jis mein Allah Ta'ala ki aazmaish ka poora naqsha hai aur jis mein momin-o-munafiq ki zahiri tameez hai, suniye irshad hota hai.

Allah in ke dilon ke bhedon se bakhoobi waqif hai, in ke tamam mansubon par khaak paregi, yeh apni shararaton mein kamyab na ho sakenge, apni chahat ke khilaf musalmanon ki din dugni taraqqi dekhenge aur aakhirat mein bhi inhe ne'maton wali jannat hasil karte dekhenge. Barkhilaf in ke yeh khud yahan bhi ruswa honge aur wahan bhi jahannam ka indhan banenge. In ki shiddat-e-adawat ki yeh kitni bari daleel hai ke jahan tumhein koi nafa pahunchta hai yeh kaleja masosne lagte hain aur agar (Allah na kare) tumhein koi nuqsan pahunch gaya toh in ki bachhein khil jati hain, baghlein bajane aur khushiyan manane lagte hain. Agar Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se mominon ki madad hui, yeh kuffar par ghalib aaye, inhe ghanimat ka maal mila, yeh tadaad mein barh gaye toh woh jal bujhe aur agar musalmanon par tangi aa gayi ya dushmanon mein ghir gaye toh in ke han eid manayi jane lagi. Ab Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko khitab kar ke farmata hai ke in shariron ki shararat aur in badbakhton ke makr se agar nijat chahte ho toh sabr-o-taqwa aur tawakkul karo. Allah Azza-wa-Jal khud tumhare dushmanon ko gher lega, kisi bhalai ke hasil karne, kisi burai se bachne ki kisi mein taqat nahin, jo Allah Ta'ala chahta hai hota hai aur jo nahin chahta nahin ho sakta, jo is par tawakkul kare use woh kafi hai. Isi munasibat se ab Jang-e-Uhud ka zikr shuru hota hai jis par musalmanon ke sabr-o-tahamul ka bayan hai aur jis mein Allah Ta'ala ki aazmaish ka poora naqsha hai aur jis mein momin-o-munafiq ki zahiri tameez hai, suniye irshad hota hai.

Kafir aur munafiq musalman ke dost nahin, unhein apna hum-raaz na banao. Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko kafiron aur munafiqon ki dosti aur hum-raaz hone se rokta hai ke yeh toh tumhare dushman hain. In ki chakni chupri baton mein khush na ho jana aur un ke makr ke phande mein phans na jana, warna mauqa pa kar yeh tumhein sakht zarar pahunchayenge aur apni batini adawat nikalenge. Tum unhein apna raaz-dar hargiz na samajhna, raaz ki baatein un ke kanon tak hargiz na pahunchana. Bitana kehte hain insaan ke raaz-dar dost ko. Aur 'min doonikum' se murad jis khalifa ko muqarrar kiya, us ke liye do bitana muqarrar kiye; ek toh bhalai ki baat samjhane wala aur us par raghbat dene wala, aur dusra burai ki rehbari karne wala aur us par amada karne wala. Bas Allah jise bachaye wahi bach sakta hai. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se kaha gaya ke yahan par Hira ka ek shakhs bada achha likhne wala aur bahut achhe hafiza wala hai, aap use apna muharrir aur munshi muqarrar kar lein. Aap ne farmaya is ka matlab yeh hoga ke ghair-momin ko bitana bana lunga jo Allah ne mana kiya hai. Is waqiye ko aur is aayat ko samne rakh kar zehen is natije par pahunchta hai ke zimmi kuffar ko bhi aise kamon mein na lagana chahiye, aisa na ho ke woh mukhalifeen ko musalmanon ke posheeda iradon se waqif kar de aur un ke dushmanon ko un se hoshiyar kar de, kyunke un ki toh chahat hi musalmanon ko neecha dikhane ki hoti hai. Azhar bin Rashid kehte hain ke log Hazrat Anas (R.A) se hadeesein sunte the, agar kisi hadees ka matlab samajh mein na aata toh Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) se ja kar matlab hal kar lete the. Ek din Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne yeh hadees bayan ki ke mushrikon ki aag se roshni talab na karo aur apni angoothi mein Arabi naqsh na karo. Unhon ne aa kar Hasan Basri (R.H) se is ki tashreeh daryaft ki toh aap ne farmaya ke pichle jumle ka toh yeh matlab hai ke angoothi par Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) na khudwao aur pehle jumle ka yeh matlab hai ke mushrikon se apne kamon mein mashwara na lo. Dekho Kitabullah mein bhi hai ke imandaro apne siwa dusron ko hum-raaz na banao, lekin Hasan Basri (R.H) ki yeh tashreeh qabil-e-ghaur hai. Hadees ka theek matlab ghaliban yeh hai ke Muhammad Rasoolullah Arabi khat mein apni angoothiyon par naqsh na karao, chunancha aur hadees mein saaf mumanat majood hai. Yeh is liye tha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mohar ke sath mushabahat na ho aur awwal jumle ka matlab yeh hai ke mushrikon ki basti ke paas na raho, us ke pados se door raho, un ke shehron se hijrat kar jao. Jaise Abu Dawood mein hai ke musalmanon aur mushrikon ke darmiyan ki ladai ki aag ko kya tum nahin dekhte? Aur hadees mein hai jo mushrikon se mel-jol kare ya un ke sath rahe base, woh bhi unhi jaisa hai. Phir farmaya un ki baton se bhi un ki adawat tapak rahi hai, un ke chehron se bhi qiyafa-shanas un ki batini khabasaton ko maloom kar sakta hai. Phir jo un ke dilon mein tabah-kun shararatein hain woh toh tum se makhfi hain lekin hum ne toh saaf saaf bayan kar diya hai. Aaqil log aise makkaron ki makkari mein nahin aate. Phir farmaya dekho kitni kamzori ki baat hai ke tum un se mohabbat rakho aur woh tumhein na chahein, tumhara imaan kul kitab par ho aur yeh shak-shuba mein hi pade hue hain. Un ki kitab ko tum toh mano lekin yeh tumhari kitab ka inkar karein, toh chahiye toh yeh tha ke tum khud unhein kadi nazron se dekhte lekin bar-khilaf is ke yeh tumhari adawat ki aag mein jal rahe hain.

Samna hojaye toh apni imandari ki dastan bayan karne baith jate hain lekin jab zara alag hote hain toh gaiz-o-gazab se jalan aur hasad se apni ungliyan chabate hain.
