Ghazwa-e-Uhud ki iftad: Yeh Uhud ke waqia ka zikr hai. Ba'az mufassireen ne ise Jang-e-Khandaq ka qissa bhi kaha hai lekin theek yeh hai ke waqia Jang-e-Uhud ka hai jo san 3 Hijri 11 Shawwal baroz hafta pesh aaya tha. Jang-e-Badr mein mushrikeen ko kamil shikast hui thi, unke sardar maut ke ghaat utre the. Ab uska badla lene ke liye mushrikeen ne bari bhari tayari ki thi. Woh tijarati maal jo Badr wali larai ke mauqa par dusre raaste se bach kar aa gaya tha, woh sab is larai ke liye rok rakha tha aur charon taraf se logon ko jama karke teen hazar ka ek lashkar-e-jarrar tayar kiya aur poore saaz-o-samaan ke sath Madina par charhai ki.

Idhar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Jumma ki namaz ke baad Malik bin Amr ke janaze ki namaz parhai jo qabila Bani-un-Najjar mein se the. Phir logon se mashwara kiya ke unki mudafiat ki kya surat tumhare nazdeek behtar hai? To Abdullah bin Ubay ne kaha ke hamain Madina se bahar na nikalna chahiye, agar woh aaye aur thehre to goya hamare jail khane mein aa gaye, ruke aur khare rahen aur agar Madina mein ghuse to ek taraf se hamare bahaduron ki talwaren hongi, dusri janib teer-andazon ke be-panah teer honge, phir upar se aurton aur bachon ki sang-bari hogi aur agar yunhi laut gaye to barbadi aur khasare ke sath lautenge.

Lekin iske bar-khilaf ba'az sahaba jo Jang-e-Badr mein shareek na ho sake the, unki raye thi ke Madina ke bahar maidan mein ja kar khoob dil khol kar unka muqabla karna chahiye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ghar mein tashreef le gaye aur hathiyar laga kar bahar aaye. Un sahaba ko ab khayal hua ke kahin hum ne Allah ke Nabi ki khilaf-e-mansha to maidan ki larai par zor nahin diya, is liye yeh kehne lage ke Huzoor (ﷺ) agar yahin thehar kar larne ka irada ho to yunhi kijiye, hamari janib se koi israr nahin. Aap ne farmaya Allah ke Nabi ko laiq nahin ke woh hathiyar pehan kar utare, ab to main na lautunga jab tak ke woh na jaye jo Allah Azza-wa-Jal ko manzoor ho. Chunancha ek hazar ka lashkar le kar aap Madina Shareef se nikal khare hue. Shaut par pahunch kar is munafiq Abdullah bin Ubay ne dagha-bazi ki aur apni teen sau ki jamaat ko le kar wapas mur gaya. Yeh log kehne lage hum jante hain ke larai to hone ki nahin, khwah-makhwah zehmat kyun uthayen?

Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ki koi parwah na ki aur sirf saat sau Sahaba-e-Kiram ko le kar maidan mein utre aur hukum diya ke jab tak main na kahoon ladai shuru na karna. Pachas teer-andaz sahabiyon ko alag kar ke un ka ameer Hazrat Abdullah bin Jubair (R.A) ko banaya aur un se farma diya ke pahadi par chadh jao aur is baat ka khayal rakho ke dushman peeche se hamla-awar na ho. Dekho hum ghalib aa jayen ya (Allah na kare) maghloob ho jayen tum hargiz apni jagah se na hatna. Yeh intezamat kar ke khud aap bhi tayyar ho gaye, dohari zirah pehni, Hazrat Mus'ab bin Umair (R.A) ko jhanda diya. Aaj chand ladke bhi lashkar-e-Muhammadi mein nazar aate thay, yeh chhote sipahi bhi janbazi ke liye hama-tan musta'id thay. Ba'az aur bachon ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sath liya tha, unhein Jang-e-Khandaq ke lashkar mein bharti kiya gaya, Jang-e-Khandaq is ke do saal baad hui thi. Quraish ka lashkar bade thath se muqable par aa datta, yeh teen hazar sipahiyon ka groh tha. Un ke sath do sau kotal ghode thay jinhein mauqe par kaam aane ke liye sath rakha tha. Un ke dahine hisse par Khalid bin Waleed tha aur bayen hisse par Ikrama bin Abu Jahl tha (yeh dono sardar baad mein musalman ho gaye thay R.A). Un ka jhanda-bardar qabila Banu Abd-ud-Dar tha. Phir ladai shuru hui jis ke tafseeli waqiyat inhi aayaton ki mauqa-ba-mauqa tafseer ke sath aate rahenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Al-gharaz is aayat mein isi ka bayan ho raha hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madina Sharif se nikle aur logon ko ladai ke muqable ki jagah muqarrar karne lage, maimana-o-maisara lashkar ka muqarrar kiya. Allah Ta'ala tamam baton ko sunne wala aur sab ke dilon ke bhed janne wala hai. Riwayaton mein yeh aa chuka hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Jumma ke din Madina Sharif se ladai ke liye nikle aur Quran farmata hai subh hi subh tum lashkariyon ki jagah muqarrar karte thay, to matlab yeh hai ke Jumma ke din to ja kar padao daal diya, baqi karwai hafta ki subh shuru hui. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain hamare bare mein yani Banu Harisa aur Banu Salma ke bare mein yeh aayat nazil hui hai ke tumhare do grohon ne buzdili ka irada kiya tha, go is mein hamari ek kamzori ka bayan hai lekin hum apne haq mein is aayat ko bahut behtar jante hain kyunke is mein yeh bhi farma diya gaya hai ke Allah un dono ka wali hai. Phir farmaya ke dekho main ne Badr wale din bhi tumhein ghalib kiya halanke tum sab hi kam aur be-sar-o-saman thay. Badr ki ladai san 2 Hijri 17 Ramazan baroz Jumma hui thi.

Usi ka naam Yaum-ul-Furqan rakha gaya. Is din Islam aur Ahl-e-Islam ki izzat mili, shirk barbad hua, mahal-e-shirk veeran hua. Halankeh is din musalman sirf teen sau tera (313) thay, un ke paas sirf do ghore thay, faqat sattar (70) oont thay, baqi sab paidal thay. Hathiyar bhi itnay kam thay keh goya na thay aur dushman ki tadaad is din teen guna thi, ek hazar mein kuch hi kam thay. Har ek zirah-e-baktar lagaye huay, zaroorat se zyada wafir hathiyar, umda umda, kafi se zyada maldari, ghore nishan-zada jin ko sonay ke zevar pehnaye gaye thay. Is mauqa par Allah ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko izzat aur ghalba diya, halaat ke baray mein zahir-o-batin wahi ki, apne Nabi aur aap ke sathiyon ko surkh-ru kiya aur shaitan aur us ke lashkariyon ko zaleel-o-khwar kiya. Ab apne momin bandon aur jannati lashkariyon ko is aayat mein yeh ehsan yaad dilata hai keh tumhari tadaad ki kami aur zahiri asbab ki ghair maujoodgi ke bawajood tum hi ko ghalib rakha, taake tum maloom kar lo keh ghalba zahiri asbab par mauqoof nahin. Isi liye dusri aayat mein saaf farma diya keh jang-e-Hunain mein tum ne zahiri asbab par nazar dali aur apni zyadati dekh kar khush huay, lekin is zyadati-e-tadaad aur asbab ki maujoodgi ne tumhein kuch faida na diya.

Hazrat Iyad Ash'ari (R.A) farmatay hain keh jang-e-Yarmouk mein hamaray paanch sardar thay: Hazrat Abu Ubaidah (R.A), Hazrat Yazid bin Abu Sufyan (R.A), Hazrat Ibn Hasna (R.A), Hazrat Khalid bin Walid (R.A) aur Hazrat Iyad (R.A), aur Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka hukum tha keh larai ke waqt Hazrat Abu Ubaidah (R.A) sardar honge. Is larai mein hamain charon taraf se shikast ke aasar nazar aanay lagay to hum ne khalifa-e-waqt ko khat likha keh hamain maut ne gher rakha hai, imdad kijiye. Farooq (R.A) ka maktoob-e-girami hamari guzarish ke jawab mein aaya jis mein tehreer tha keh tumhara talab-e-imdad ka khat pohancha, main tumhein ek aisi zaat batata hoon jo sab se zyada madadgar aur sab se zyada mazboot lashkar wali hai, woh zaat Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki hai jis ne apne banday aur Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki madad Badr walay din ki thi. Badri lashkar to tum se bohat hi kam tha, mera yeh khat parhte hi jihad shuru kar do aur ab mujhay kuch na likhna na kuch poochna. Is khat se hamari jurratain barh gayin, himmatain buland ho gayin, phir hum ne jam kar larna shuru kiya. Alhamdulillah dushman ko shikast hui aur woh bhagay, hum ne barah (12) meel tak un ka ta'aqub kiya, bohat sa maal-e-ghaneemat hamain mila jo hum ne aapas mein baant liya. Phir Hazrat Abu Ubaidah (R.A) kehnay lagay meray sath dor kaun lagaye ga? Ek naujawan ne kaha agar aap naraz na hon to main hazir hoon, chunancha dorne mein woh aagay nikal gaye, main ne dekha un ki dono zulfain hawa mein ur rahi thin aur woh us naujawan ke peechay ghora doraye chalay ja rahay thay.

Badr bin Narain ek shakhs tha, us ke naam se ek kunwan mashhoor tha aur is maidan ka jis mein yeh kunwan tha, yahi naam ho gaya tha. Badr ki jang bhi isi naam se mashhoor ho gayi. Yeh jagah Makkah aur Madinah ke darmiyan hai. Phir farmaya keh Allah se dartay raha karo taake shukr ki taufeeq milay aur ita'at-guzari kar sako.

Halankeh is din musalman sirf teen sau tera (313) thay, un ke paas sirf do ghore thay, faqat sattar (70) oont thay, baqi sab paidal thay. Hathiyar bhi itnay kam thay keh goya na thay aur dushman ki tadaad is din teen guna thi, ek hazar mein kuch hi kam thay. Har ek zirah-e-baktar lagaye huay, zaroorat se zyada wafir hathiyar, umda umda, kafi se zyada maldari, ghore nishan-zada jin ko sonay ke zevar pehnaye gaye thay. Is mauqa par Allah ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko izzat aur ghalba diya, halaat ke baray mein zahir-o-batin wahi ki, apne Nabi aur aap ke sathiyon ko surkh-ru kiya aur shaitan aur us ke lashkariyon ko zaleel-o-khwar kiya. Ab apne momin bandon aur jannati lashkariyon ko is aayat mein yeh ehsan yaad dilata hai keh tumhari tadaad ki kami aur zahiri asbab ki ghair maujoodgi ke bawajood tum hi ko ghalib rakha, taake tum maloom kar lo keh ghalba zahiri asbab par mauqoof nahin. Isi liye dusri aayat mein saaf farma diya keh jang-e-Hunain mein tum ne zahiri asbab par nazar dali aur apni zyadati dekh kar khush huay, lekin is zyadati-e-tadaad aur asbab ki maujoodgi ne tumhein kuch faida na diya.

Hazrat Iyad Ash'ari (R.A) farmatay hain keh jang-e-Yarmouk mein hamaray paanch sardar thay: Hazrat Abu Ubaidah (R.A), Hazrat Yazid bin Abu Sufyan (R.A), Hazrat Ibn Hasna (R.A), Hazrat Khalid bin Walid (R.A) aur Hazrat Iyad (R.A), aur Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka hukum tha keh larai ke waqt Hazrat Abu Ubaidah (R.A) sardar honge. Is larai mein hamain charon taraf se shikast ke aasar nazar aanay lagay to hum ne khalifa-e-waqt ko khat likha keh hamain maut ne gher rakha hai, imdad kijiye. Farooq (R.A) ka maktoob-e-girami hamari guzarish ke jawab mein aaya jis mein tehreer tha keh tumhara talab-e-imdad ka khat pohancha, main tumhein ek aisi zaat batata hoon jo sab se zyada madadgar aur sab se zyada mazboot lashkar wali hai, woh zaat Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki hai jis ne apne banday aur Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki madad Badr walay din ki thi. Badri lashkar to tum se bohat hi kam tha, mera yeh khat parhte hi jihad shuru kar do aur ab mujhay kuch na likhna na kuch poochna. Is khat se hamari jurratain barh gayin, himmatain buland ho gayin, phir hum ne jam kar larna shuru kiya. Alhamdulillah dushman ko shikast hui aur woh bhagay, hum ne barah (12) meel tak un ka ta'aqub kiya, bohat sa maal-e-ghaneemat hamain mila jo hum ne aapas mein baant liya. Phir Hazrat Abu Ubaidah (R.A) kehnay lagay meray sath dor kaun lagaye ga? Ek naujawan ne kaha agar aap naraz na hon to main hazir hoon, chunancha dorne mein woh aagay nikal gaye, main ne dekha un ki dono zulfain hawa mein ur rahi thin aur woh us naujawan ke peechay ghora doraye chalay ja rahay thay.

Badr bin Narain ek shakhs tha, us ke naam se ek kunwan mashhoor tha aur is maidan ka jis mein yeh kunwan tha, yahi naam ho gaya tha. Badr ki jang bhi isi naam se mashhoor ho gayi. Yeh jagah Makkah aur Madinah ke darmiyan hai. Phir farmaya keh Allah se dartay raha karo taake shukr ki taufeeq milay aur ita'at-guzari kar sako.

Ghazwa-e-Uhud ki iftad: Yeh Uhud ke waqia ka zikr hai. Ba'az mufassireen ne ise Jang-e-Khandaq ka qissa bhi kaha hai lekin theek yeh hai ke waqia Jang-e-Uhud ka hai jo san 3 Hijri 11 Shawwal baroz hafta pesh aaya tha. Jang-e-Badr mein mushrikeen ko kamil shikast hui thi, unke sardar maut ke ghaat utre the. Ab uska badla lene ke liye mushrikeen ne bari bhari tayari ki thi. Woh tijarati maal jo Badr wali larai ke mauqa par dusre raaste se bach kar aa gaya tha, woh sab is larai ke liye rok rakha tha aur charon taraf se logon ko jama karke teen hazar ka ek lashkar-e-jarrar tayar kiya aur poore saaz-o-samaan ke sath Madina par charhai ki.

Idhar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Jumma ki namaz ke baad Malik bin Amr ke janaze ki namaz parhai jo qabila Bani-un-Najjar mein se the. Phir logon se mashwara kiya ke unki mudafiat ki kya surat tumhare nazdeek behtar hai? To Abdullah bin Ubay ne kaha ke hamain Madina se bahar na nikalna chahiye, agar woh aaye aur thehre to goya hamare jail khane mein aa gaye, ruke aur khare rahen aur agar Madina mein ghuse to ek taraf se hamare bahaduron ki talwaren hongi, dusri janib teer-andazon ke be-panah teer honge, phir upar se aurton aur bachon ki sang-bari hogi aur agar yunhi laut gaye to barbadi aur khasare ke sath lautenge.

Lekin iske bar-khilaf ba'az sahaba jo Jang-e-Badr mein shareek na ho sake the, unki raye thi ke Madina ke bahar maidan mein ja kar khoob dil khol kar unka muqabla karna chahiye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ghar mein tashreef le gaye aur hathiyar laga kar bahar aaye. Un sahaba ko ab khayal hua ke kahin hum ne Allah ke Nabi ki khilaf-e-mansha to maidan ki larai par zor nahin diya, is liye yeh kehne lage ke Huzoor (ﷺ) agar yahin thehar kar larne ka irada ho to yunhi kijiye, hamari janib se koi israr nahin. Aap ne farmaya Allah ke Nabi ko laiq nahin ke woh hathiyar pehan kar utare, ab to main na lautunga jab tak ke woh na jaye jo Allah Azza-wa-Jal ko manzoor ho. Chunancha ek hazar ka lashkar le kar aap Madina Shareef se nikal khare hue. Shaut par pahunch kar is munafiq Abdullah bin Ubay ne dagha-bazi ki aur apni teen sau ki jamaat ko le kar wapas mur gaya. Yeh log kehne lage hum jante hain ke larai to hone ki nahin, khwah-makhwah zehmat kyun uthayen?

Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ki koi parwah na ki aur sirf saat sau Sahaba-e-Kiram ko le kar maidan mein utre aur hukum diya ke jab tak main na kahoon ladai shuru na karna. Pachas teer-andaz sahabiyon ko alag kar ke un ka ameer Hazrat Abdullah bin Jubair (R.A) ko banaya aur un se farma diya ke pahadi par chadh jao aur is baat ka khayal rakho ke dushman peeche se hamla-awar na ho. Dekho hum ghalib aa jayen ya (Allah na kare) maghloob ho jayen tum hargiz apni jagah se na hatna. Yeh intezamat kar ke khud aap bhi tayyar ho gaye, dohari zirah pehni, Hazrat Mus'ab bin Umair (R.A) ko jhanda diya. Aaj chand ladke bhi lashkar-e-Muhammadi mein nazar aate thay, yeh chhote sipahi bhi janbazi ke liye hama-tan musta'id thay. Ba'az aur bachon ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sath liya tha, unhein Jang-e-Khandaq ke lashkar mein bharti kiya gaya, Jang-e-Khandaq is ke do saal baad hui thi. Quraish ka lashkar bade thath se muqable par aa datta, yeh teen hazar sipahiyon ka groh tha. Un ke sath do sau kotal ghode thay jinhein mauqe par kaam aane ke liye sath rakha tha. Un ke dahine hisse par Khalid bin Waleed tha aur bayen hisse par Ikrama bin Abu Jahl tha (yeh dono sardar baad mein musalman ho gaye thay R.A). Un ka jhanda-bardar qabila Banu Abd-ud-Dar tha. Phir ladai shuru hui jis ke tafseeli waqiyat inhi aayaton ki mauqa-ba-mauqa tafseer ke sath aate rahenge Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Al-gharaz is aayat mein isi ka bayan ho raha hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madina Sharif se nikle aur logon ko ladai ke muqable ki jagah muqarrar karne lage, maimana-o-maisara lashkar ka muqarrar kiya. Allah Ta'ala tamam baton ko sunne wala aur sab ke dilon ke bhed janne wala hai. Riwayaton mein yeh aa chuka hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Jumma ke din Madina Sharif se ladai ke liye nikle aur Quran farmata hai subh hi subh tum lashkariyon ki jagah muqarrar karte thay, to matlab yeh hai ke Jumma ke din to ja kar padao daal diya, baqi karwai hafta ki subh shuru hui. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain hamare bare mein yani Banu Harisa aur Banu Salma ke bare mein yeh aayat nazil hui hai ke tumhare do grohon ne buzdili ka irada kiya tha, go is mein hamari ek kamzori ka bayan hai lekin hum apne haq mein is aayat ko bahut behtar jante hain kyunke is mein yeh bhi farma diya gaya hai ke Allah un dono ka wali hai. Phir farmaya ke dekho main ne Badr wale din bhi tumhein ghalib kiya halanke tum sab hi kam aur be-sar-o-saman thay. Badr ki ladai san 2 Hijri 17 Ramazan baroz Jumma hui thi.

Ghazwa-e-Badr aur Ta'id-e-Ilahi. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh tasalliyan dena ba'az toh kehte hain Badr wale din tha. Hasan Basri, Aamir Sha'abi, Rabi' bin Anas waghera ka yahi qaul hai, Ibn-e-Jarir ka bhi isi se ittefaq hai. Aamir Sha'abi ka qaul hai ke musalmanon ko yeh khabar mili thi ke Kurz bin Jabir mushrikon ki imdad mein aayega, is par is imdad ka wa'ada hua tha lekin na woh nahin aaya aur na hi yeh gaye. Rabi' bin Anas farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon ki madad ke liye pehle toh ek hazaar farishte bheje, phir teen hazaar ho gaye, phir paanch hazaar. Yahan is aayat mein teen hazaar aur paanch hazaar se madad karne ka wa'ada hai aur Badr ke waqiye ke bayan ke waqt ek hazaar farishton ki imdad ka wa'ada hai. Farmaya aayat (Anni mumiddukum bi-alfin minal-malaikati murdifin) (Al-Anfal: 9) aur tatbiq dono aayaton mein yahi hai kyunke murdifin ka lafz maujood hai, pas pehle ek hazaar utre phir un ke baad teen hazaar poore hue, aakhir paanch hazaar ho gaye. Bazahir yahi maloom hota hai ke yeh wa'ada jang-e-Badr ke liye tha na ke jang-e-Uhud ke liye. Ba'az kehte hain jang-e-Uhud ke mauqe par wa'ada hua tha, Mujahid, Ikrimah, Zahhak, Zuhri, Musa bin Uqbah waghera ka yahi qaul hai lekin woh kehte hain ke chunke musalman maidan chhod kar hat gaye is liye yeh farishte nazil na hue, kyunke aayat (Wa-in tasbiru wa-tattaqu la yadurrukum kaiduhum shai'an) (Aal-e-Imran: 120) saath hi farmaya tha yani agar tum sabr karo aur taqwa karo. Faur ke ma'ani wajah aur ghazab ke hain, musawwimin ke ma'ani alamat wale. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain farishton ki nishani Badr wale din safed rang ke libas ki thi aur un ke ghodon ki nishani mathe ki safedi thi. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain un ki nishani surkh thi. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain gardan ke baalon aur dum ka nishan tha aur yahi nishan aap ke lashkariyon ka tha yani soof ka. Makhool kehte hain farishton ki nishani un ki pagriyan thin jo siyah rang ke amame the aur Hunain wale din surkh rang amame the. Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain Badr ke ilawa farishte kabhi jang mein shamil nahin hue aur safed rang amamon ki alamat thi, yeh sirf madad ke liye aur ta'adad badhane ke liye the na ke ladai ke liye. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh farishton ka nazil karna aur tumhein is ki khabar dena sirf tumhari khushi, diljui aur itminan ke liye hai warna Allah ko qudrat hai ke un ko utare baghair balkeh baghair tumhare lade bhi tumhein ghalib kar de. Madad usi ki taraf se hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa-lau yasha'ullahu lantasara minhum wa-lakin liyabluwa ba'dakum bi-ba'd) (Muhammad: 4). Agar Allah chahta toh un se khud hi badla le leta lekin woh har ek ko aazma raha hai. Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein jo qatl kiye jayen un ke a'amal akaarat nahin hote, Allah unhein raah dikhayega, un ke a'amal sanwar dega aur unhein jannat mein le jayega jis ki ta'reef woh kar chuka hai, woh izzat wala hai aur apne har kaam mein hikmat rakhta hai.

Yeh Jihad ka hukm bhi tarah tarah ki hikmaton par mabni hai is se kuffar halak honge ya zaleel honge ya namurad wapas ho jayenge. Is ke baad bayan hota hai ke duniya aur aakhirat ke kul umoor Allah Ta'ala ke haath mein hain, ae Nabi (ﷺ) tumhein kisi amr ka ikhtiyar nahin jaise farmaya aayat (Fa-innama 'alaikal-balaghu wa 'alainal-hisab) (Ar-Ra'd: 40) tumhara zimma sirf tableegh hai hisab to tumhare zimma hai aur jagah hai aayat (Laisa 'alaika hudahum) al-kh, un ki hidayat tumhare zimma nahin Allah jise chahe hidayat de aur aayat (Innaka la tahdee man ahbabta wa lakinnal-laha yahdee man yasha'u) (Al-Qasas: 56) to jise chahe hidayat nahin kar sakta balkeh Allah jise chahe hidayat karta hai, pas mere bandon mein tujhe koi ikhtiyar nahin jo hukm pahunche use auron ko pahuncha de tere zimma yahi hai mumkin hai Allah unhein tauba ki taufeeq de aur burai ke baad woh bhalai karne lagein aur Allah Raheem un ki tauba qabool farma le ya mumkin hai ke unhein un ke kufro gunah ki bina par azab kare to yeh zalim is ke bhi mustahiq hain, Sahih Bukhari mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) subah ki namaz mein jab dusri rakat ke ruku se sar uthate aur dua (Sami'allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal-hamd) keh lete to kuffar par bad-dua karte ke ae Allah falan falan par lanat kar is ke bare mein yeh aayat utri (Laisa laka minal-amri shay'un aw yatooba 'alaihim aw yu'azzibahum fa-innahum zalimoon) (Aal-e-Imran: 128) nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein un kafiron ke naam bhi aaye hain maslan Harith bin Hisham, Suhail bin Amr, Safwan bin Umayyah aur isi mein hai ke bil-aakhir un ko hidayat naseeb hui aur yeh musalman ho gaye, ek riwayat mein hai ke chaar admiyon par yeh bad-dua thi jis se rok diye gaye. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) jab kisi par bad-dua karna ya kisi ke haq mein nek dua karna chahte to ruku ke baad Sami'allahu aur Rabbana parh kar dua mangte kabhi kehte ae Allah Waleed bin Waleed, Salamah bin Hisham, Ayyash bin Abu Rabee'ah aur kamzor mominon ko kuffar se nijat de ae Allah qabeela-e-Mudar par apni pakar aur apna azab nazil farma aur un par aisi qahat-sali bhej jaisi Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke zamana mein thi yeh dua ba-awaz-e-buland hua karti thi aur ba'az martaba subah ki namaz ke qunoot mein yun bhi kehte ke ae Allah falan falan par lanat bhej aur Arab ke ba'az qabeelon ke naam lete the aur riwayat mein hai ke jang-e-Uhud mein jab aap ke dandan-e-mubarak shaheed hue chehra zakhmi hua khoon behne laga to zaban se nikal gaya ke woh qaum kaise falah payegi jis ne apne Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath yeh kiya halankeh Nabi (ﷺ) Allah Khaliq-e-Kul ki taraf se unhein bulata tha us waqt yeh aayat (Laisa laka minal-amri shay'un aw yatooba 'alaihim aw yu'azzibahum fa-innahum zalimoon) (Aal-e-Imran: 128) nazil hui.

Aal-e-Imran: 128 nazil hui, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ghazway mein ek garh mein gir pare thay aur khoon bohat nikal gaya tha. Kuch toh is za'af ki wajah se aur kuch is wajah se ke dohari zirah pehne hue thay uth na sake. Hazrat Huzaifa ke maula Hazrat Salim (R.A) pohanche aur chehre par se khoon poncha. Jab afaqa hua toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh farmaya aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Phir farmata hai ke zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez usi ki hai, sab us ke ghulam hain. Jise chahe bakhshe, jise chahe azab kare. Mutasarrif wahi hai, jo chahe hukum kare, koi us par pursish nahin kar sakta. Woh Ghafoor aur Raheem hai.

Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) jab kisi par bad-dua karna ya kisi ke haq mein nek dua karna chahte to ruku ke baad Sami'allahu aur Rabbana parh kar dua mangte kabhi kehte ae Allah Waleed bin Waleed, Salamah bin Hisham, Ayyash bin Abu Rabee'ah aur kamzor mominon ko kuffar se nijat de ae Allah qabeela-e-Mudar par apni pakar aur apna azab nazil farma aur un par aisi qahat-sali bhej jaisi Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke zamana mein thi yeh dua ba-awaz-e-buland hua karti thi aur ba'az martaba subah ki namaz ke qunoot mein yun bhi kehte ke ae Allah falan falan par lanat bhej aur Arab ke ba'az qabeelon ke naam lete the aur riwayat mein hai ke jang-e-Uhud mein jab aap ke dandan-e-mubarak shaheed hue chehra zakhmi hua khoon behne laga to zaban se nikal gaya ke woh qaum kaise falah payegi jis ne apne Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath yeh kiya halankeh Nabi (ﷺ) Allah Khaliq-e-Kul ki taraf se unhein bulata tha us waqt yeh aayat (Laisa laka minal-amri shay'un aw yatooba 'alaihim aw yu'azzibahum fa-innahum zalimoon) (Aal-e-Imran: 128) nazil hui.

Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh farishton ka nazil karna aur tumhein is ki khabar dena sirf tumhari khushi, diljui aur itminan ke liye hai warna Allah ko qudrat hai ke un ko utare baghair balkeh baghair tumhare lade bhi tumhein ghalib kar de. Madad usi ki taraf se hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa-lau yasha'ullahu lantasara minhum wa-lakin liyabluwa ba'dakum bi-ba'd) (Muhammad: 4). Agar Allah chahta toh un se khud hi badla le leta lekin woh har ek ko aazma raha hai. Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein jo qatl kiye jayen un ke a'amal akaarat nahin hote, Allah unhein raah dikhayega, un ke a'amal sanwar dega aur unhein jannat mein le jayega jis ki ta'reef woh kar chuka hai, woh izzat wala hai aur apne har kaam mein hikmat rakhta hai.

Yeh Jihad ka hukm bhi tarah tarah ki hikmaton par mabni hai is se kuffar halak honge ya zaleel honge ya namurad wapas ho jayenge. Is ke baad bayan hota hai ke duniya aur aakhirat ke kul umoor Allah Ta'ala ke haath mein hain, ae Nabi (ﷺ) tumhein kisi amr ka ikhtiyar nahin jaise farmaya aayat (Fa-innama 'alaikal-balaghu wa 'alainal-hisab) (Ar-Ra'd: 40) tumhara zimma sirf tableegh hai hisab to tumhare zimma hai aur jagah hai aayat (Laisa 'alaika hudahum) al-kh, un ki hidayat tumhare zimma nahin Allah jise chahe hidayat de aur aayat (Innaka la tahdee man ahbabta wa lakinnal-laha yahdee man yasha'u) (Al-Qasas: 56) to jise chahe hidayat nahin kar sakta balkeh Allah jise chahe hidayat karta hai, pas mere bandon mein tujhe koi ikhtiyar nahin jo hukm pahunche use auron ko pahuncha de tere zimma yahi hai mumkin hai Allah unhein tauba ki taufeeq de aur burai ke baad woh bhalai karne lagein aur Allah Raheem un ki tauba qabool farma le ya mumkin hai ke unhein un ke kufro gunah ki bina par azab kare to yeh zalim is ke bhi mustahiq hain, Sahih Bukhari mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) subah ki namaz mein jab dusri rakat ke ruku se sar uthate aur dua (Sami'allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal-hamd) keh lete to kuffar par bad-dua karte ke ae Allah falan falan par lanat kar is ke bare mein yeh aayat utri (Laisa laka minal-amri shay'un aw yatooba 'alaihim aw yu'azzibahum fa-innahum zalimoon) (Aal-e-Imran: 128) nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein un kafiron ke naam bhi aaye hain maslan Harith bin Hisham, Suhail bin Amr, Safwan bin Umayyah aur isi mein hai ke bil-aakhir un ko hidayat naseeb hui aur yeh musalman ho gaye, ek riwayat mein hai ke chaar admiyon par yeh bad-dua thi jis se rok diye gaye. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) jab kisi par bad-dua karna ya kisi ke haq mein nek dua karna chahte to ruku ke baad Sami'allahu aur Rabbana parh kar dua mangte kabhi kehte ae Allah Waleed bin Waleed, Salamah bin Hisham, Ayyash bin Abu Rabee'ah aur kamzor mominon ko kuffar se nijat de ae Allah qabeela-e-Mudar par apni pakar aur apna azab nazil farma aur un par aisi qahat-sali bhej jaisi Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke zamana mein thi yeh dua ba-awaz-e-buland hua karti thi aur ba'az martaba subah ki namaz ke qunoot mein yun bhi kehte ke ae Allah falan falan par lanat bhej aur Arab ke ba'az qabeelon ke naam lete the aur riwayat mein hai ke jang-e-Uhud mein jab aap ke dandan-e-mubarak shaheed hue chehra zakhmi hua khoon behne laga to zaban se nikal gaya ke woh qaum kaise falah payegi jis ne apne Nabi (ﷺ) ke sath yeh kiya halankeh Nabi (ﷺ) Allah Khaliq-e-Kul ki taraf se unhein bulata tha us waqt yeh aayat (Laisa laka minal-amri shay'un aw yatooba 'alaihim aw yu'azzibahum fa-innahum zalimoon) (Aal-e-Imran: 128) nazil hui.

Aal-e-Imran: 128 nazil hui, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ghazway mein ek garh mein gir pare thay aur khoon bohat nikal gaya tha. Kuch toh is za'af ki wajah se aur kuch is wajah se ke dohari zirah pehne hue thay uth na sake. Hazrat Huzaifa ke maula Hazrat Salim (R.A) pohanche aur chehre par se khoon poncha. Jab afaqa hua toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh farmaya aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Phir farmata hai ke zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez usi ki hai, sab us ke ghulam hain. Jise chahe bakhshe, jise chahe azab kare. Mutasarrif wahi hai, jo chahe hukum kare, koi us par pursish nahin kar sakta. Woh Ghafoor aur Raheem hai.

Ghazwa-e-Badr aur Ta'id-e-Ilahi. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh tasalliyan dena ba'az toh kehte hain Badr wale din tha. Hasan Basri, Aamir Sha'abi, Rabi' bin Anas waghera ka yahi qaul hai, Ibn-e-Jarir ka bhi isi se ittefaq hai. Aamir Sha'abi ka qaul hai ke musalmanon ko yeh khabar mili thi ke Kurz bin Jabir mushrikon ki imdad mein aayega, is par is imdad ka wa'ada hua tha lekin na woh nahin aaya aur na hi yeh gaye. Rabi' bin Anas farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne musalmanon ki madad ke liye pehle toh ek hazaar farishte bheje, phir teen hazaar ho gaye, phir paanch hazaar. Yahan is aayat mein teen hazaar aur paanch hazaar se madad karne ka wa'ada hai aur Badr ke waqiye ke bayan ke waqt ek hazaar farishton ki imdad ka wa'ada hai. Farmaya aayat (Anni mumiddukum bi-alfin minal-malaikati murdifin) (Al-Anfal: 9) aur tatbiq dono aayaton mein yahi hai kyunke murdifin ka lafz maujood hai, pas pehle ek hazaar utre phir un ke baad teen hazaar poore hue, aakhir paanch hazaar ho gaye. Bazahir yahi maloom hota hai ke yeh wa'ada jang-e-Badr ke liye tha na ke jang-e-Uhud ke liye. Ba'az kehte hain jang-e-Uhud ke mauqe par wa'ada hua tha, Mujahid, Ikrimah, Zahhak, Zuhri, Musa bin Uqbah waghera ka yahi qaul hai lekin woh kehte hain ke chunke musalman maidan chhod kar hat gaye is liye yeh farishte nazil na hue, kyunke aayat (Wa-in tasbiru wa-tattaqu la yadurrukum kaiduhum shai'an) (Aal-e-Imran: 120) saath hi farmaya tha yani agar tum sabr karo aur taqwa karo. Faur ke ma'ani wajah aur ghazab ke hain, musawwimin ke ma'ani alamat wale. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain farishton ki nishani Badr wale din safed rang ke libas ki thi aur un ke ghodon ki nishani mathe ki safedi thi. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain un ki nishani surkh thi. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain gardan ke baalon aur dum ka nishan tha aur yahi nishan aap ke lashkariyon ka tha yani soof ka. Makhool kehte hain farishton ki nishani un ki pagriyan thin jo siyah rang ke amame the aur Hunain wale din surkh rang amame the. Jab afaqa hua toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh farmaya aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Phir farmata hai ke zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez usi ki hai, sab us ke ghulam hain. Jise chahe bakhshe, jise chahe azab kare. Mutasarrif wahi hai, jo chahe hukum kare, koi us par pursish nahin kar sakta. Woh Ghafoor aur Raheem hai.

Sood khor jahannami hai aur gussa shaitan ki den hai is se bacho. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko soodi len-den se aur sood khori se rok raha hai, Ahl-e-Jahiliyat soodi qarza dete thay muddat muqarrar hoti thi agar is muddat par rupiya wasool na hota to muddat barha kar sood par sood barha diya karte thay isi tarah sood dar sood mila kar asal raqam kayi guna barh jati, Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko is tarah na-haq logon ke maal ghasab karne se rok raha hai aur taqwe ka hukum de kar is par nijat ka wada kar raha hai, phir aag se darata hai aur apne azabon se dhamkata hai phir apni aur apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at par amada karta hai aur is par raham-o-karam ka wada deta hai phir sa'adat-e-darain ke husool ke liye nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karne ko farmata hai aur jannat ki tareef karta hai, chorayi ko bayan kar ke lambayi ka andaza sunne walon par hi chora jata hai jis tarah jannati farsh ki tareef karte hue farmaya aayat (Muttaki'ina 'ala furushim-bata'inuha min istabraq) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 54) yani is ka astar naram resham ka hai to matlab yeh hai ke jab astar aisa hai to abray ka kya thikana hai isi tarah yahan bhi bayan ho raha hai ke jab arz saton aasmanon aur satwin zameenon ke barabar hai to tool kitna bara hoga aur ba'az ne kaha hai ke arz-o-tool yani lambayi chorayi dono barabar hai kyunke jannat misl-e-qubba ke Arsh ke neeche hai aur jo cheez qubba-numa ho ya mustadeer ho is ka arz-o-tool yaksan hota hai. Ek sahih hadith mein hai jab tum Allah se jannat mango to Firdous ka sawal karo woh sab se unchi aur sab se achi jannat hai isi jannat se sab nahrein jaari hoti hain aur isi ki chhat Allah Ta'ala Rahman-ur-Rahim ka Arsh hai, Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke Heraclius ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein bator-e-aitraz ke ek sawal likh bheja ke aap mujhe is jannat ki dawat de rahe hain jis ki chorayi aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai to yeh farmayiye ke phir jahannam kahan gayi? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ya'la bin Murrah ki mulaqat Homs mein hui thi kehte hain us waqt yeh bohat hi borha ho gaya tha kehne laga jab main ne yeh khat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko diya to aap ne apni bayin taraf ke ek sahabi ko diya main ne logon se poocha un ka kya naam hai? Logon ne kaha yeh Hazrat Mu'awiyah hain (R.A). Hazrat Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi sawal hua tha to aap ne farmaya tha ke din ke waqt raat aur raat ke waqt din kahan jata hai? Yahoodi yeh jawab sun kar khasiyane ho kar kehne lage ke yeh Torah se ma'akhuz kiya hoga, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se bhi yeh jawab marwi hai, ek marfoo hadith mein hai kisi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha to aap ne jawab mein farmaya jab har cheez par raat aa jati hai to din kahan jata hai?

Us ne kaha jahan Allah chahe, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya isi tarah Jahannam bhi jahan chahe (Bazzar). Is jumla ke do ma'ani hote hain, ek toh yeh ke raat ke waqt hum go din ko nahin dekh sakte lekin taham din ka kisi jagah hona namumkin nahin, isi tarah go Jannat ka arz itna hi hai lekin phir bhi Jahannam ke wajood se inkar nahin ho sakta jahan Allah chahe woh bhi hai, dusre ma'ani yeh ke jab din ek taraf charhne laga raat dusri janib hoti hai isi tarah Jannat A'ala Illiyeen mein hai aur Dozakh Asfal-us-Safileen mein toh koi nafi ka imkan hi na raha, Wallahu A'alam. Phir Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Jannat ka wasf bayan farmata hai ke woh sakhti mein aur aasani mein, khushi mein aur ghami mein, tandurusti mein aur bimari mein, garz har haal mein rah-e-Allah apna maal kharch karte rehte hain jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Allazeena yunfiquna amwalahum bil-laili wan-nahari sirran wa 'alaniyatan falahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wala khaufun 'alaihim wala hum yahzanun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 274) yani woh log din raat chhupe khule kharch karte rehte hain, koi amr unhein Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at se baaz nahin rakh sakta, us ki makhlooq par us ke hukm se ehsan karte rehte hain. Yeh gusse ko pee jaane wale aur logon ki buraiyon se darguzar karne wale hain. (Kazm) ke ma'ani chhupane ke bhi hain yani apne gusse ka izhar bhi nahin karte. Ba'az riwayaton mein hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Agar gusse ke waqt tujhe yaad rakhunga yani halakat ke waqt tujhe halakat se bacha lunga (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Jo shakhs apna gussa rok le Allah Ta'ala us par se apne azab hata leta hai aur jo bhi apni zaban (khilaf-e-shar'a baton se) rok le Allah Ta'ala us ki parda poshi karega aur jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki taraf ma'azrat le jaye Allah Ta'ala us ka uzr qabool farmata hai (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad mein bhi ikhtilaf hai. Aur hadith-e-shareef mein hai, Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehlwan woh nahin jo kisi ko pachhar de balkeh haqiqatan pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne nafs par qabu rakhe (Ahmad). Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Tum mein se koi aisa hai jise apne waris ka maal apne maal se zyada mehboob ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) koi nahin. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Main toh dekhta hoon ke tum apne maal se zyada apne waris ka maal chahte ho, is liye ke tumhara maal toh darhaqiqat woh hai jo tum rah-e-Allah apni zindagi mein kharch kar do aur jo chhor kar jao woh tumhara maal nahin balkeh tumhare warison ka maal hai, toh tumhara rah-e-Allah kam kharch karna aur jama zyada karna yeh daleel hai is amr ki ke tum apne maal se apne warison ke maal ko zyada aziz rakhte ho. Phir farmaya: Tum pehlwan kise jaante ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) use jise koi gira na sake. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Nahin balkeh haqiqatan zor-dar pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne jazbat par pura qabu rakhe. Phir farmaya: Be-aulad kise kehte ho?

Logon ne kaha jis ki aulad na ho, farmaya nahin balkeh fi-al-waqai be-aulad woh hai jis ke samne us ki koi aulad mari na ho (Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya ke jante ho muflis kangal kaun hai? Logon ne kaha jis ke paas maal na ho, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh woh jis ne apna maal apni zindagi mein rah-e-Allah na diya ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Haritha bin Qudama Sa'adi (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi mein arz karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe koi nafa ki baat kahiye jo mukhtasar ho taake main yaad bhi rakh sakoon, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, us ne phir poocha, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir yahi jawab diya, kai kai martaba yahi kaha (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Kisi shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhe kuch wasiyat kijiye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, woh kehte hain main ne jo gaur kiya to maloom hua ke tamam buraiyon ka markaz ghussa hi hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko ghussa aaya to Aap (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) baith gaye aur phir lait gaye, un se poocha gaya yeh kya?

Toh farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap farmate thay jisay gussa aaye woh khara ho toh baith jaye agar us se bhi gussa na jaye toh lait jaye (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aik aur riwayat mein hai ke Urwah bin Muhammad ko gussa charha aap wuzu karne baith gaye aur farmane lage main ne apne ustadon se yeh hadith suni hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke gussa shaitan ki taraf se hai aur shaitan aag se paida hua hai aur aag bujhane wali cheez pani hai pas tum gussa ke waqt wuzu karne baith jao. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh irshad hai ke jo shakhs kisi tang dast ko mohlat de ya apna qarz usay maaf kar de Allah Ta'ala usay jahannam se azaad kar deta hai. Logo suno jannat ke aamal sakht aur mushkil hain aur jahannam ke kaam aasaan aur sahal hain. Nek bakht wohi hai jo fitnon se bach jaye. Kisi ghont ka peena Allah ko aisa pasand nahin jitna gussa ke ghont ka pee jana, aisay shakhs ke dil mein imaan rach jata hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs apna gussa utaarne ki taqat rakhte hue phir bhi zabt kar le Allah Ta'ala us ka dil aman-o-aman se pur kar deta hai. Jo shakhs bawajood majood hone ke shohrat ke kapray ko tawazo ki wajah se chor de usay Allah Ta'ala karamat aur izzat ka hulla qayamat ke din pehnaye ga aur jo kisi ka sar chupaye Allah Ta'ala usay qayamat ke din badshahat ka taaj pehnaye ga (Abu Dawood). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs bawajood qudrat ke apna gussa zabt kar le usay Allah Ta'ala tamam makhlooq ke samne bula kar ikhtiyar de ga ke jis hoor ko chahe pasand kar le (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is mazmoon ki aur bhi hadeesain hain, pas aayat ka matlab yeh hua ke woh apne gussa mein aape se bahar nahin hote logon ko un ki taraf se burai nahin pohanchti balkay apne jazbaat ko dabaye rakhte hain aur Allah se dar kar sawab ki umeed par mamla supurd-e-Allah karte hain, logon se darguzar karte hain zalimon ke zulm ka badla abhi nahin lete isi ko ehsan kehte hain aur in mohsin bandon se Allah mohabbat rakhta hai. Hadith mein hai Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain teen baton par main qasam khata hoon: aik toh yeh ke sadqa se maal nahin ghat-ta, dusre yeh ke afw-o-darguzar karne se insaan ki izzat barhti hai, teesre yeh ke tawazo, farotni aur aajizi karne wale ko Allah Ta'ala buland martaba ata karta hai. Mustadrak ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahe ke us ki bunyad buland ho aur us ke darjay barhein toh usay zalimon se darguzar karna chahiye aur na dene walon ko dena chahiye aur torne walon se jorna chahiye aur hadith mein hai qayamat ke din aik pukare ga ke ae logo darguzar karne walo apne Rabb ke paas aao aur apna ajr lo. Musalmanon ki khataon ke maaf karne wale jannati log hain. Phir farmaya yeh log gunah ke baad foran zikr-e-Allah aur istighfar karte hain.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Jab koi shakhs gunah karta hai, phir Allah Rahman-o-Raheem ke samne hazir ho kar kehta hai ke Parwardigar! mujh se gunah ho gaya, toh maaf farma. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mere bande se go gunah ho gaya lekin is ka iman hai ke is ka Rabb gunah par pakar bhi karta hai aur agar chahe toh maaf bhi farma deta hai, main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho toh farma deta hai: Main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho jata hai, yeh phir tauba karta hai, Allah Ta'ala phir bakhshta hai. Chauthi martaba phir gunah kar baithta hai, phir tauba karta hai toh Allah Ta'ala maaf farma kar kehta hai: Ab mera banda jo chahe kare (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain: Hum ne ek martaba Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Jab hum aap ko dekhte hain toh hamare dilon mein riqqat tari ho jati hai aur hum Allah wale ban jate hain, lekin jab aap ke paas se chale jate hain toh woh halat nahin rehti, aurton bachon mein phans jate hain, ghar baar ke dhandon mein lag jate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya.

Agar tumhari halat yahi har waqt rehti toh phir farishtay tum se musafaha karte aur tumhari mulaqat ko tumhare ghar par aate, suno agar tum gunah na karo toh Allah tumhein yahan se hata de aur dusri qoum ko le aaye jo gunah kare phir bakhshish mange aur Allah unhein bakhshe. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh farmate ke jannat ki bunyadein kis tarah ustawar hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek eent sone ki toh ek chandi ki hai, is ka gara mushk-e-khalis hai, is ke kankar lulu aur yaqoot hain, is ki mitti zafran hai, jannatiyon ki ne'matein kabhi khatam na hongi, un ki zindagi hamesha ki hogi, un ke kapray purane nahin honge, jawani kabhi nahin dhale gi aur teen ashkhas ki dua kabhi rad nahin hoti: adil badshah ki dua, iftari ke waqt rozay-dar ki dua aur mazloom ki dua badalon se uthayi jati hai aur is ke liye aasmanon ke darwazay khol diye jate hain aur Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai mujhe meri izzat ki qasam main teri zaroor madad karunga agarche kuch waqt ke baad ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs koi gunah kare phir wuzu kar ke do rakat namaz ada kare aur apne gunah ki maafi chahe toh ae Allah Azzawajal us ke gunah maaf farma deta hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim mein riwayat Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se jo shakhs kamil wuzu kar ke dua (Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluhu) parhay us ke liye jannat ke aathon darwazay khul jate hain jis se chahe andar chala jaye. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) sunnat ke mutabiq wuzu karte hain phir farmate hain main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh jaisa wuzu kare phir do rakat namaz ada kare jis mein apne dil se baatein na kare toh Allah Ta'ala us ke tamam gunah maaf farma deta hai (Bukhari, Muslim). Pas yeh hadith ko Hazrat Usman (R.A) se, is se agli riwayat Hazrat Umar (R.A) se aur is se agli riwayat Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se aur is se teesri riwayat ko Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se Hazrat Ali (R.A) riwayat karte hain toh Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ki wasee maghfirat aur us ki be-inteha meherbani ki khabar Sayyid-ul-Awwaleen wal-Akhireen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani aap ke charon bar-haq khulafa ki ma'rifat hamein pahunchi. Aao is mauqa par hum gunahgar bhi haath uthayen aur apne meharban Raheem-o-Kareem Allah ke samne apne gunahon ka iqrar kar ke us se maafi talab karein. Allah Ta'ala ae maa baap se zyada meharban! Ae afw-o-darguzar karne wale! Aur kisi bhikari ko apne dar se khali na pherne wale! Tu hum khata-karon ki siyah-kariyon se bhi darguzar farma aur hamare kul gunah maaf farma de.

(Mutarjim) Yehi woh mubarak aayat hai ke jab yeh nazil hui toh Iblees rone laga (Musnad Abdur Razzaq). Istighfar aur La Ilaha Illallah: Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain La Ilaha Illallah kasrat se parha karo aur istighfar par mudawamat karo. Iblees gunahon se logon ko halak karna chahta hai aur uski apni halakat La Ilaha Illallah aur istighfar se hai, yeh hadith dekh kar Iblees ne logon ko khwahish parasti par daal diya pas woh apne aap ko rah-e-rast par jante hain halankeh halakat mein hote hain lekin is hadith ke do rawi za'eef hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Iblees ne kaha ae Rab mujhe teri izzat ki qasam main Bani Adam ko unke aakhri dam tak behkata rahoonga, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya mujhe mere jalal aur meri izzat ki qasam jab tak woh mujhse bakhshish mangte rahenge main bhi unhein bakhshta rahoonga. Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhse gunah ho gaya aap ne farmaya phir istighfar kar, usne kaha mujhse aur gunah hua farmaya istighfar kiye ja, yahan tak ke Shaitan thak jaye phir farmaya gunah ko bakhshna Allah hi ke ikhtiyar mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas ek qaidi aaya aur kehne laga ya Allah main teri taraf tauba karta hoon Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf tauba nahin karta (ya'ni Allah main teri hi bakhshish chahta hoon) aap ne farmaya isne haq haqdar ko pahunchaya. Israr karne se murad yeh hai ke ma'asiyat par baghair tauba kiye ar nahin jate agar kayi martaba gunah ho jaye toh kayi martaba istighfar karte hain, Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain woh israr karne wala aur arne wala nahin jo istighfar karta rehta hai agarche (bilfarz) us se ek din mein sattar martaba bhi gunah ho jaye. Phir farmaya ke woh jante hon ya'ni is baat ko ke Allah tauba qabool karne wala hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Alam ya'lamu annallaha huwal yaqbalut taubata an ibadihi wa ya'khuzus sadaqati wa annallaha huwat tawwabur raheem) (Surah At-Taubah: 104) kya yeh nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai aur jagah hai aayat (Wa man ya'mal su'an au yazlim nafsahu summa yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha ghafooran raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) jo shakhs koi bura kaam kare ya gunah kar ke apni jaan par zulm kare phir Allah Ta'ala se bakhshish talab kare toh woh dekh lega ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal bakhshish karne wala meharban hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimbar par bayan farmaya logo tum auron par raham karo Allah tum par raham karega, logo tum dusron ki khatayen maaf karo Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunahon ko bakhshega, baatein banane walon ki halakat hai, gunah par jam jane walon ki halakat hai. Phir farmaya in kamon ke badle unki jaza maghfirat hai aur tarah tarah ki behti nehron wali jannat hai jis mein woh hamesha rahenge, yeh bare achhe a'maal hain.

Sood khor jahannami hai aur gussa shaitan ki den hai is se bacho. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko soodi len-den se aur sood khori se rok raha hai, Ahl-e-Jahiliyat soodi qarza dete thay muddat muqarrar hoti thi agar is muddat par rupiya wasool na hota to muddat barha kar sood par sood barha diya karte thay isi tarah sood dar sood mila kar asal raqam kayi guna barh jati, Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko is tarah na-haq logon ke maal ghasab karne se rok raha hai aur taqwe ka hukum de kar is par nijat ka wada kar raha hai, phir aag se darata hai aur apne azabon se dhamkata hai phir apni aur apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at par amada karta hai aur is par raham-o-karam ka wada deta hai phir sa'adat-e-darain ke husool ke liye nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karne ko farmata hai aur jannat ki tareef karta hai, chorayi ko bayan kar ke lambayi ka andaza sunne walon par hi chora jata hai jis tarah jannati farsh ki tareef karte hue farmaya aayat (Muttaki'ina 'ala furushim-bata'inuha min istabraq) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 54) yani is ka astar naram resham ka hai to matlab yeh hai ke jab astar aisa hai to abray ka kya thikana hai isi tarah yahan bhi bayan ho raha hai ke jab arz saton aasmanon aur satwin zameenon ke barabar hai to tool kitna bara hoga aur ba'az ne kaha hai ke arz-o-tool yani lambayi chorayi dono barabar hai kyunke jannat misl-e-qubba ke Arsh ke neeche hai aur jo cheez qubba-numa ho ya mustadeer ho is ka arz-o-tool yaksan hota hai. Ek sahih hadith mein hai jab tum Allah se jannat mango to Firdous ka sawal karo woh sab se unchi aur sab se achi jannat hai isi jannat se sab nahrein jaari hoti hain aur isi ki chhat Allah Ta'ala Rahman-ur-Rahim ka Arsh hai, Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke Heraclius ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein bator-e-aitraz ke ek sawal likh bheja ke aap mujhe is jannat ki dawat de rahe hain jis ki chorayi aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai to yeh farmayiye ke phir jahannam kahan gayi? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ya'la bin Murrah ki mulaqat Homs mein hui thi kehte hain us waqt yeh bohat hi borha ho gaya tha kehne laga jab main ne yeh khat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko diya to aap ne apni bayin taraf ke ek sahabi ko diya main ne logon se poocha un ka kya naam hai? Logon ne kaha yeh Hazrat Mu'awiyah hain (R.A). Hazrat Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi sawal hua tha to aap ne farmaya tha ke din ke waqt raat aur raat ke waqt din kahan jata hai? Yahoodi yeh jawab sun kar khasiyane ho kar kehne lage ke yeh Torah se ma'akhuz kiya hoga, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se bhi yeh jawab marwi hai, ek marfoo hadith mein hai kisi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha to aap ne jawab mein farmaya jab har cheez par raat aa jati hai to din kahan jata hai?

Us ne kaha jahan Allah chahe, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya isi tarah Jahannam bhi jahan chahe (Bazzar). Is jumla ke do ma'ani hote hain, ek toh yeh ke raat ke waqt hum go din ko nahin dekh sakte lekin taham din ka kisi jagah hona namumkin nahin, isi tarah go Jannat ka arz itna hi hai lekin phir bhi Jahannam ke wajood se inkar nahin ho sakta jahan Allah chahe woh bhi hai, dusre ma'ani yeh ke jab din ek taraf charhne laga raat dusri janib hoti hai isi tarah Jannat A'ala Illiyeen mein hai aur Dozakh Asfal-us-Safileen mein toh koi nafi ka imkan hi na raha, Wallahu A'alam. Phir Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Jannat ka wasf bayan farmata hai ke woh sakhti mein aur aasani mein, khushi mein aur ghami mein, tandurusti mein aur bimari mein, garz har haal mein rah-e-Allah apna maal kharch karte rehte hain jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Allazeena yunfiquna amwalahum bil-laili wan-nahari sirran wa 'alaniyatan falahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wala khaufun 'alaihim wala hum yahzanun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 274) yani woh log din raat chhupe khule kharch karte rehte hain, koi amr unhein Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at se baaz nahin rakh sakta, us ki makhlooq par us ke hukm se ehsan karte rehte hain. Yeh gusse ko pee jaane wale aur logon ki buraiyon se darguzar karne wale hain. (Kazm) ke ma'ani chhupane ke bhi hain yani apne gusse ka izhar bhi nahin karte. Ba'az riwayaton mein hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Agar gusse ke waqt tujhe yaad rakhunga yani halakat ke waqt tujhe halakat se bacha lunga (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Jo shakhs apna gussa rok le Allah Ta'ala us par se apne azab hata leta hai aur jo bhi apni zaban (khilaf-e-shar'a baton se) rok le Allah Ta'ala us ki parda poshi karega aur jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki taraf ma'azrat le jaye Allah Ta'ala us ka uzr qabool farmata hai (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad mein bhi ikhtilaf hai. Aur hadith-e-shareef mein hai, Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehlwan woh nahin jo kisi ko pachhar de balkeh haqiqatan pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne nafs par qabu rakhe (Ahmad). Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Tum mein se koi aisa hai jise apne waris ka maal apne maal se zyada mehboob ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) koi nahin. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Main toh dekhta hoon ke tum apne maal se zyada apne waris ka maal chahte ho, is liye ke tumhara maal toh darhaqiqat woh hai jo tum rah-e-Allah apni zindagi mein kharch kar do aur jo chhor kar jao woh tumhara maal nahin balkeh tumhare warison ka maal hai, toh tumhara rah-e-Allah kam kharch karna aur jama zyada karna yeh daleel hai is amr ki ke tum apne maal se apne warison ke maal ko zyada aziz rakhte ho. Phir farmaya: Tum pehlwan kise jaante ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) use jise koi gira na sake. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Nahin balkeh haqiqatan zor-dar pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne jazbat par pura qabu rakhe. Phir farmaya: Be-aulad kise kehte ho?

Logon ne kaha jis ki aulad na ho, farmaya nahin balkeh fi-al-waqai be-aulad woh hai jis ke samne us ki koi aulad mari na ho (Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya ke jante ho muflis kangal kaun hai? Logon ne kaha jis ke paas maal na ho, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh woh jis ne apna maal apni zindagi mein rah-e-Allah na diya ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Haritha bin Qudama Sa'adi (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi mein arz karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe koi nafa ki baat kahiye jo mukhtasar ho taake main yaad bhi rakh sakoon, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, us ne phir poocha, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir yahi jawab diya, kai kai martaba yahi kaha (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Kisi shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhe kuch wasiyat kijiye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, woh kehte hain main ne jo gaur kiya to maloom hua ke tamam buraiyon ka markaz ghussa hi hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko ghussa aaya to Aap (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) baith gaye aur phir lait gaye, un se poocha gaya yeh kya?

Toh farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap farmate thay jisay gussa aaye woh khara ho toh baith jaye agar us se bhi gussa na jaye toh lait jaye (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aik aur riwayat mein hai ke Urwah bin Muhammad ko gussa charha aap wuzu karne baith gaye aur farmane lage main ne apne ustadon se yeh hadith suni hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke gussa shaitan ki taraf se hai aur shaitan aag se paida hua hai aur aag bujhane wali cheez pani hai pas tum gussa ke waqt wuzu karne baith jao. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh irshad hai ke jo shakhs kisi tang dast ko mohlat de ya apna qarz usay maaf kar de Allah Ta'ala usay jahannam se azaad kar deta hai. Logo suno jannat ke aamal sakht aur mushkil hain aur jahannam ke kaam aasaan aur sahal hain. Nek bakht wohi hai jo fitnon se bach jaye. Kisi ghont ka peena Allah ko aisa pasand nahin jitna gussa ke ghont ka pee jana, aisay shakhs ke dil mein imaan rach jata hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs apna gussa utaarne ki taqat rakhte hue phir bhi zabt kar le Allah Ta'ala us ka dil aman-o-aman se pur kar deta hai. Jo shakhs bawajood majood hone ke shohrat ke kapray ko tawazo ki wajah se chor de usay Allah Ta'ala karamat aur izzat ka hulla qayamat ke din pehnaye ga aur jo kisi ka sar chupaye Allah Ta'ala usay qayamat ke din badshahat ka taaj pehnaye ga (Abu Dawood). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs bawajood qudrat ke apna gussa zabt kar le usay Allah Ta'ala tamam makhlooq ke samne bula kar ikhtiyar de ga ke jis hoor ko chahe pasand kar le (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is mazmoon ki aur bhi hadeesain hain, pas aayat ka matlab yeh hua ke woh apne gussa mein aape se bahar nahin hote logon ko un ki taraf se burai nahin pohanchti balkay apne jazbaat ko dabaye rakhte hain aur Allah se dar kar sawab ki umeed par mamla supurd-e-Allah karte hain, logon se darguzar karte hain zalimon ke zulm ka badla abhi nahin lete isi ko ehsan kehte hain aur in mohsin bandon se Allah mohabbat rakhta hai. Hadith mein hai Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain teen baton par main qasam khata hoon: aik toh yeh ke sadqa se maal nahin ghat-ta, dusre yeh ke afw-o-darguzar karne se insaan ki izzat barhti hai, teesre yeh ke tawazo, farotni aur aajizi karne wale ko Allah Ta'ala buland martaba ata karta hai. Mustadrak ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahe ke us ki bunyad buland ho aur us ke darjay barhein toh usay zalimon se darguzar karna chahiye aur na dene walon ko dena chahiye aur torne walon se jorna chahiye aur hadith mein hai qayamat ke din aik pukare ga ke ae logo darguzar karne walo apne Rabb ke paas aao aur apna ajr lo. Musalmanon ki khataon ke maaf karne wale jannati log hain. Phir farmaya yeh log gunah ke baad foran zikr-e-Allah aur istighfar karte hain.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Jab koi shakhs gunah karta hai, phir Allah Rahman-o-Raheem ke samne hazir ho kar kehta hai ke Parwardigar! mujh se gunah ho gaya, toh maaf farma. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mere bande se go gunah ho gaya lekin is ka iman hai ke is ka Rabb gunah par pakar bhi karta hai aur agar chahe toh maaf bhi farma deta hai, main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho toh farma deta hai: Main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho jata hai, yeh phir tauba karta hai, Allah Ta'ala phir bakhshta hai. Chauthi martaba phir gunah kar baithta hai, phir tauba karta hai toh Allah Ta'ala maaf farma kar kehta hai: Ab mera banda jo chahe kare (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain: Hum ne ek martaba Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Jab hum aap ko dekhte hain toh hamare dilon mein riqqat tari ho jati hai aur hum Allah wale ban jate hain, lekin jab aap ke paas se chale jate hain toh woh halat nahin rehti, aurton bachon mein phans jate hain, ghar baar ke dhandon mein lag jate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya.

Agar tumhari halat yahi har waqt rehti toh phir farishtay tum se musafaha karte aur tumhari mulaqat ko tumhare ghar par aate, suno agar tum gunah na karo toh Allah tumhein yahan se hata de aur dusri qoum ko le aaye jo gunah kare phir bakhshish mange aur Allah unhein bakhshe. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh farmate ke jannat ki bunyadein kis tarah ustawar hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek eent sone ki toh ek chandi ki hai, is ka gara mushk-e-khalis hai, is ke kankar lulu aur yaqoot hain, is ki mitti zafran hai, jannatiyon ki ne'matein kabhi khatam na hongi, un ki zindagi hamesha ki hogi, un ke kapray purane nahin honge, jawani kabhi nahin dhale gi aur teen ashkhas ki dua kabhi rad nahin hoti: adil badshah ki dua, iftari ke waqt rozay-dar ki dua aur mazloom ki dua badalon se uthayi jati hai aur is ke liye aasmanon ke darwazay khol diye jate hain aur Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai mujhe meri izzat ki qasam main teri zaroor madad karunga agarche kuch waqt ke baad ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs koi gunah kare phir wuzu kar ke do rakat namaz ada kare aur apne gunah ki maafi chahe toh ae Allah Azzawajal us ke gunah maaf farma deta hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim mein riwayat Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se jo shakhs kamil wuzu kar ke dua (Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluhu) parhay us ke liye jannat ke aathon darwazay khul jate hain jis se chahe andar chala jaye. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) sunnat ke mutabiq wuzu karte hain phir farmate hain main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh jaisa wuzu kare phir do rakat namaz ada kare jis mein apne dil se baatein na kare toh Allah Ta'ala us ke tamam gunah maaf farma deta hai (Bukhari, Muslim). Pas yeh hadith ko Hazrat Usman (R.A) se, is se agli riwayat Hazrat Umar (R.A) se aur is se agli riwayat Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se aur is se teesri riwayat ko Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se Hazrat Ali (R.A) riwayat karte hain toh Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ki wasee maghfirat aur us ki be-inteha meherbani ki khabar Sayyid-ul-Awwaleen wal-Akhireen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani aap ke charon bar-haq khulafa ki ma'rifat hamein pahunchi. Aao is mauqa par hum gunahgar bhi haath uthayen aur apne meharban Raheem-o-Kareem Allah ke samne apne gunahon ka iqrar kar ke us se maafi talab karein. Allah Ta'ala ae maa baap se zyada meharban! Ae afw-o-darguzar karne wale! Aur kisi bhikari ko apne dar se khali na pherne wale! Tu hum khata-karon ki siyah-kariyon se bhi darguzar farma aur hamare kul gunah maaf farma de.

(Mutarjim) Yehi woh mubarak aayat hai ke jab yeh nazil hui toh Iblees rone laga (Musnad Abdur Razzaq). Istighfar aur La Ilaha Illallah: Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain La Ilaha Illallah kasrat se parha karo aur istighfar par mudawamat karo. Iblees gunahon se logon ko halak karna chahta hai aur uski apni halakat La Ilaha Illallah aur istighfar se hai, yeh hadith dekh kar Iblees ne logon ko khwahish parasti par daal diya pas woh apne aap ko rah-e-rast par jante hain halankeh halakat mein hote hain lekin is hadith ke do rawi za'eef hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Iblees ne kaha ae Rab mujhe teri izzat ki qasam main Bani Adam ko unke aakhri dam tak behkata rahoonga, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya mujhe mere jalal aur meri izzat ki qasam jab tak woh mujhse bakhshish mangte rahenge main bhi unhein bakhshta rahoonga. Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhse gunah ho gaya aap ne farmaya phir istighfar kar, usne kaha mujhse aur gunah hua farmaya istighfar kiye ja, yahan tak ke Shaitan thak jaye phir farmaya gunah ko bakhshna Allah hi ke ikhtiyar mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas ek qaidi aaya aur kehne laga ya Allah main teri taraf tauba karta hoon Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf tauba nahin karta (ya'ni Allah main teri hi bakhshish chahta hoon) aap ne farmaya isne haq haqdar ko pahunchaya. Israr karne se murad yeh hai ke ma'asiyat par baghair tauba kiye ar nahin jate agar kayi martaba gunah ho jaye toh kayi martaba istighfar karte hain, Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain woh israr karne wala aur arne wala nahin jo istighfar karta rehta hai agarche (bilfarz) us se ek din mein sattar martaba bhi gunah ho jaye. Phir farmaya ke woh jante hon ya'ni is baat ko ke Allah tauba qabool karne wala hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Alam ya'lamu annallaha huwal yaqbalut taubata an ibadihi wa ya'khuzus sadaqati wa annallaha huwat tawwabur raheem) (Surah At-Taubah: 104) kya yeh nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai aur jagah hai aayat (Wa man ya'mal su'an au yazlim nafsahu summa yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha ghafooran raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) jo shakhs koi bura kaam kare ya gunah kar ke apni jaan par zulm kare phir Allah Ta'ala se bakhshish talab kare toh woh dekh lega ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal bakhshish karne wala meharban hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimbar par bayan farmaya logo tum auron par raham karo Allah tum par raham karega, logo tum dusron ki khatayen maaf karo Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunahon ko bakhshega, baatein banane walon ki halakat hai, gunah par jam jane walon ki halakat hai. Phir farmaya in kamon ke badle unki jaza maghfirat hai aur tarah tarah ki behti nehron wali jannat hai jis mein woh hamesha rahenge, yeh bare achhe a'maal hain.

Sood khor jahannami hai aur gussa shaitan ki den hai is se bacho. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko soodi len-den se aur sood khori se rok raha hai, Ahl-e-Jahiliyat soodi qarza dete thay muddat muqarrar hoti thi agar is muddat par rupiya wasool na hota to muddat barha kar sood par sood barha diya karte thay isi tarah sood dar sood mila kar asal raqam kayi guna barh jati, Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko is tarah na-haq logon ke maal ghasab karne se rok raha hai aur taqwe ka hukum de kar is par nijat ka wada kar raha hai, phir aag se darata hai aur apne azabon se dhamkata hai phir apni aur apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at par amada karta hai aur is par raham-o-karam ka wada deta hai phir sa'adat-e-darain ke husool ke liye nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karne ko farmata hai aur jannat ki tareef karta hai, chorayi ko bayan kar ke lambayi ka andaza sunne walon par hi chora jata hai jis tarah jannati farsh ki tareef karte hue farmaya aayat (Muttaki'ina 'ala furushim-bata'inuha min istabraq) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 54) yani is ka astar naram resham ka hai to matlab yeh hai ke jab astar aisa hai to abray ka kya thikana hai isi tarah yahan bhi bayan ho raha hai ke jab arz saton aasmanon aur satwin zameenon ke barabar hai to tool kitna bara hoga aur ba'az ne kaha hai ke arz-o-tool yani lambayi chorayi dono barabar hai kyunke jannat misl-e-qubba ke Arsh ke neeche hai aur jo cheez qubba-numa ho ya mustadeer ho is ka arz-o-tool yaksan hota hai. Ek sahih hadith mein hai jab tum Allah se jannat mango to Firdous ka sawal karo woh sab se unchi aur sab se achi jannat hai isi jannat se sab nahrein jaari hoti hain aur isi ki chhat Allah Ta'ala Rahman-ur-Rahim ka Arsh hai, Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke Heraclius ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein bator-e-aitraz ke ek sawal likh bheja ke aap mujhe is jannat ki dawat de rahe hain jis ki chorayi aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai to yeh farmayiye ke phir jahannam kahan gayi? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ya'la bin Murrah ki mulaqat Homs mein hui thi kehte hain us waqt yeh bohat hi borha ho gaya tha kehne laga jab main ne yeh khat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko diya to aap ne apni bayin taraf ke ek sahabi ko diya main ne logon se poocha un ka kya naam hai? Logon ne kaha yeh Hazrat Mu'awiyah hain (R.A). Hazrat Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi sawal hua tha to aap ne farmaya tha ke din ke waqt raat aur raat ke waqt din kahan jata hai? Yahoodi yeh jawab sun kar khasiyane ho kar kehne lage ke yeh Torah se ma'akhuz kiya hoga, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se bhi yeh jawab marwi hai, ek marfoo hadith mein hai kisi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha to aap ne jawab mein farmaya jab har cheez par raat aa jati hai to din kahan jata hai?

Us ne kaha jahan Allah chahe, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya isi tarah Jahannam bhi jahan chahe (Bazzar). Is jumla ke do ma'ani hote hain, ek toh yeh ke raat ke waqt hum go din ko nahin dekh sakte lekin taham din ka kisi jagah hona namumkin nahin, isi tarah go Jannat ka arz itna hi hai lekin phir bhi Jahannam ke wajood se inkar nahin ho sakta jahan Allah chahe woh bhi hai, dusre ma'ani yeh ke jab din ek taraf charhne laga raat dusri janib hoti hai isi tarah Jannat A'ala Illiyeen mein hai aur Dozakh Asfal-us-Safileen mein toh koi nafi ka imkan hi na raha, Wallahu A'alam. Phir Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Jannat ka wasf bayan farmata hai ke woh sakhti mein aur aasani mein, khushi mein aur ghami mein, tandurusti mein aur bimari mein, garz har haal mein rah-e-Allah apna maal kharch karte rehte hain jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Allazeena yunfiquna amwalahum bil-laili wan-nahari sirran wa 'alaniyatan falahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wala khaufun 'alaihim wala hum yahzanun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 274) yani woh log din raat chhupe khule kharch karte rehte hain, koi amr unhein Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at se baaz nahin rakh sakta, us ki makhlooq par us ke hukm se ehsan karte rehte hain. Yeh gusse ko pee jaane wale aur logon ki buraiyon se darguzar karne wale hain. (Kazm) ke ma'ani chhupane ke bhi hain yani apne gusse ka izhar bhi nahin karte. Ba'az riwayaton mein hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Agar gusse ke waqt tujhe yaad rakhunga yani halakat ke waqt tujhe halakat se bacha lunga (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Jo shakhs apna gussa rok le Allah Ta'ala us par se apne azab hata leta hai aur jo bhi apni zaban (khilaf-e-shar'a baton se) rok le Allah Ta'ala us ki parda poshi karega aur jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki taraf ma'azrat le jaye Allah Ta'ala us ka uzr qabool farmata hai (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad mein bhi ikhtilaf hai. Aur hadith-e-shareef mein hai, Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehlwan woh nahin jo kisi ko pachhar de balkeh haqiqatan pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne nafs par qabu rakhe (Ahmad). Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Tum mein se koi aisa hai jise apne waris ka maal apne maal se zyada mehboob ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) koi nahin. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Main toh dekhta hoon ke tum apne maal se zyada apne waris ka maal chahte ho, is liye ke tumhara maal toh darhaqiqat woh hai jo tum rah-e-Allah apni zindagi mein kharch kar do aur jo chhor kar jao woh tumhara maal nahin balkeh tumhare warison ka maal hai, toh tumhara rah-e-Allah kam kharch karna aur jama zyada karna yeh daleel hai is amr ki ke tum apne maal se apne warison ke maal ko zyada aziz rakhte ho. Phir farmaya: Tum pehlwan kise jaante ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) use jise koi gira na sake. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Nahin balkeh haqiqatan zor-dar pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne jazbat par pura qabu rakhe. Phir farmaya: Be-aulad kise kehte ho?

Logon ne kaha jis ki aulad na ho, farmaya nahin balkeh fi-al-waqai be-aulad woh hai jis ke samne us ki koi aulad mari na ho (Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya ke jante ho muflis kangal kaun hai? Logon ne kaha jis ke paas maal na ho, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh woh jis ne apna maal apni zindagi mein rah-e-Allah na diya ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Haritha bin Qudama Sa'adi (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi mein arz karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe koi nafa ki baat kahiye jo mukhtasar ho taake main yaad bhi rakh sakoon, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, us ne phir poocha, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir yahi jawab diya, kai kai martaba yahi kaha (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Kisi shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhe kuch wasiyat kijiye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, woh kehte hain main ne jo gaur kiya to maloom hua ke tamam buraiyon ka markaz ghussa hi hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko ghussa aaya to Aap (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) baith gaye aur phir lait gaye, un se poocha gaya yeh kya?

Toh farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap farmate thay jisay gussa aaye woh khara ho toh baith jaye agar us se bhi gussa na jaye toh lait jaye (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aik aur riwayat mein hai ke Urwah bin Muhammad ko gussa charha aap wuzu karne baith gaye aur farmane lage main ne apne ustadon se yeh hadith suni hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke gussa shaitan ki taraf se hai aur shaitan aag se paida hua hai aur aag bujhane wali cheez pani hai pas tum gussa ke waqt wuzu karne baith jao. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh irshad hai ke jo shakhs kisi tang dast ko mohlat de ya apna qarz usay maaf kar de Allah Ta'ala usay jahannam se azaad kar deta hai. Logo suno jannat ke aamal sakht aur mushkil hain aur jahannam ke kaam aasaan aur sahal hain. Nek bakht wohi hai jo fitnon se bach jaye. Kisi ghont ka peena Allah ko aisa pasand nahin jitna gussa ke ghont ka pee jana, aisay shakhs ke dil mein imaan rach jata hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs apna gussa utaarne ki taqat rakhte hue phir bhi zabt kar le Allah Ta'ala us ka dil aman-o-aman se pur kar deta hai. Jo shakhs bawajood majood hone ke shohrat ke kapray ko tawazo ki wajah se chor de usay Allah Ta'ala karamat aur izzat ka hulla qayamat ke din pehnaye ga aur jo kisi ka sar chupaye Allah Ta'ala usay qayamat ke din badshahat ka taaj pehnaye ga (Abu Dawood). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs bawajood qudrat ke apna gussa zabt kar le usay Allah Ta'ala tamam makhlooq ke samne bula kar ikhtiyar de ga ke jis hoor ko chahe pasand kar le (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is mazmoon ki aur bhi hadeesain hain, pas aayat ka matlab yeh hua ke woh apne gussa mein aape se bahar nahin hote logon ko un ki taraf se burai nahin pohanchti balkay apne jazbaat ko dabaye rakhte hain aur Allah se dar kar sawab ki umeed par mamla supurd-e-Allah karte hain, logon se darguzar karte hain zalimon ke zulm ka badla abhi nahin lete isi ko ehsan kehte hain aur in mohsin bandon se Allah mohabbat rakhta hai. Hadith mein hai Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain teen baton par main qasam khata hoon: aik toh yeh ke sadqa se maal nahin ghat-ta, dusre yeh ke afw-o-darguzar karne se insaan ki izzat barhti hai, teesre yeh ke tawazo, farotni aur aajizi karne wale ko Allah Ta'ala buland martaba ata karta hai. Mustadrak ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahe ke us ki bunyad buland ho aur us ke darjay barhein toh usay zalimon se darguzar karna chahiye aur na dene walon ko dena chahiye aur torne walon se jorna chahiye aur hadith mein hai qayamat ke din aik pukare ga ke ae logo darguzar karne walo apne Rabb ke paas aao aur apna ajr lo. Musalmanon ki khataon ke maaf karne wale jannati log hain. Phir farmaya yeh log gunah ke baad foran zikr-e-Allah aur istighfar karte hain.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Jab koi shakhs gunah karta hai, phir Allah Rahman-o-Raheem ke samne hazir ho kar kehta hai ke Parwardigar! mujh se gunah ho gaya, toh maaf farma. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mere bande se go gunah ho gaya lekin is ka iman hai ke is ka Rabb gunah par pakar bhi karta hai aur agar chahe toh maaf bhi farma deta hai, main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho toh farma deta hai: Main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho jata hai, yeh phir tauba karta hai, Allah Ta'ala phir bakhshta hai. Chauthi martaba phir gunah kar baithta hai, phir tauba karta hai toh Allah Ta'ala maaf farma kar kehta hai: Ab mera banda jo chahe kare (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain: Hum ne ek martaba Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Jab hum aap ko dekhte hain toh hamare dilon mein riqqat tari ho jati hai aur hum Allah wale ban jate hain, lekin jab aap ke paas se chale jate hain toh woh halat nahin rehti, aurton bachon mein phans jate hain, ghar baar ke dhandon mein lag jate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya.
