Sahih Muslim mein riwayat Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se jo shakhs kamil wuzu kar ke dua (Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluhu) parhay us ke liye jannat ke aathon darwazay khul jate hain jis se chahe andar chala jaye. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) sunnat ke mutabiq wuzu karte hain phir farmate hain main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh jaisa wuzu kare phir do rakat namaz ada kare jis mein apne dil se baatein na kare toh Allah Ta'ala us ke tamam gunah maaf farma deta hai (Bukhari, Muslim). Pas yeh hadith ko Hazrat Usman (R.A) se, is se agli riwayat Hazrat Umar (R.A) se aur is se agli riwayat Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se aur is se teesri riwayat ko Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se Hazrat Ali (R.A) riwayat karte hain toh Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ki wasee maghfirat aur us ki be-inteha meherbani ki khabar Sayyid-ul-Awwaleen wal-Akhireen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani aap ke charon bar-haq khulafa ki ma'rifat hamein pahunchi. Aao is mauqa par hum gunahgar bhi haath uthayen aur apne meharban Raheem-o-Kareem Allah ke samne apne gunahon ka iqrar kar ke us se maafi talab karein. Allah Ta'ala ae maa baap se zyada meharban! Ae afw-o-darguzar karne wale! Aur kisi bhikari ko apne dar se khali na pherne wale! Tu hum khata-karon ki siyah-kariyon se bhi darguzar farma aur hamare kul gunah maaf farma de.

(Mutarjim) Yehi woh mubarak aayat hai ke jab yeh nazil hui toh Iblees rone laga (Musnad Abdur Razzaq). Istighfar aur La Ilaha Illallah: Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain La Ilaha Illallah kasrat se parha karo aur istighfar par mudawamat karo. Iblees gunahon se logon ko halak karna chahta hai aur uski apni halakat La Ilaha Illallah aur istighfar se hai, yeh hadith dekh kar Iblees ne logon ko khwahish parasti par daal diya pas woh apne aap ko rah-e-rast par jante hain halankeh halakat mein hote hain lekin is hadith ke do rawi za'eef hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Iblees ne kaha ae Rab mujhe teri izzat ki qasam main Bani Adam ko unke aakhri dam tak behkata rahoonga, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya mujhe mere jalal aur meri izzat ki qasam jab tak woh mujhse bakhshish mangte rahenge main bhi unhein bakhshta rahoonga. Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhse gunah ho gaya aap ne farmaya phir istighfar kar, usne kaha mujhse aur gunah hua farmaya istighfar kiye ja, yahan tak ke Shaitan thak jaye phir farmaya gunah ko bakhshna Allah hi ke ikhtiyar mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas ek qaidi aaya aur kehne laga ya Allah main teri taraf tauba karta hoon Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf tauba nahin karta (ya'ni Allah main teri hi bakhshish chahta hoon) aap ne farmaya isne haq haqdar ko pahunchaya. Israr karne se murad yeh hai ke ma'asiyat par baghair tauba kiye ar nahin jate agar kayi martaba gunah ho jaye toh kayi martaba istighfar karte hain, Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain woh israr karne wala aur arne wala nahin jo istighfar karta rehta hai agarche (bilfarz) us se ek din mein sattar martaba bhi gunah ho jaye. Phir farmaya ke woh jante hon ya'ni is baat ko ke Allah tauba qabool karne wala hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Alam ya'lamu annallaha huwal yaqbalut taubata an ibadihi wa ya'khuzus sadaqati wa annallaha huwat tawwabur raheem) (Surah At-Taubah: 104) kya yeh nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai aur jagah hai aayat (Wa man ya'mal su'an au yazlim nafsahu summa yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha ghafooran raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) jo shakhs koi bura kaam kare ya gunah kar ke apni jaan par zulm kare phir Allah Ta'ala se bakhshish talab kare toh woh dekh lega ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal bakhshish karne wala meharban hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimbar par bayan farmaya logo tum auron par raham karo Allah tum par raham karega, logo tum dusron ki khatayen maaf karo Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunahon ko bakhshega, baatein banane walon ki halakat hai, gunah par jam jane walon ki halakat hai. Phir farmaya in kamon ke badle unki jaza maghfirat hai aur tarah tarah ki behti nehron wali jannat hai jis mein woh hamesha rahenge, yeh bare achhe a'maal hain.

Sood khor jahannami hai aur gussa shaitan ki den hai is se bacho. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko soodi len-den se aur sood khori se rok raha hai, Ahl-e-Jahiliyat soodi qarza dete thay muddat muqarrar hoti thi agar is muddat par rupiya wasool na hota to muddat barha kar sood par sood barha diya karte thay isi tarah sood dar sood mila kar asal raqam kayi guna barh jati, Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko is tarah na-haq logon ke maal ghasab karne se rok raha hai aur taqwe ka hukum de kar is par nijat ka wada kar raha hai, phir aag se darata hai aur apne azabon se dhamkata hai phir apni aur apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at par amada karta hai aur is par raham-o-karam ka wada deta hai phir sa'adat-e-darain ke husool ke liye nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karne ko farmata hai aur jannat ki tareef karta hai, chorayi ko bayan kar ke lambayi ka andaza sunne walon par hi chora jata hai jis tarah jannati farsh ki tareef karte hue farmaya aayat (Muttaki'ina 'ala furushim-bata'inuha min istabraq) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 54) yani is ka astar naram resham ka hai to matlab yeh hai ke jab astar aisa hai to abray ka kya thikana hai isi tarah yahan bhi bayan ho raha hai ke jab arz saton aasmanon aur satwin zameenon ke barabar hai to tool kitna bara hoga aur ba'az ne kaha hai ke arz-o-tool yani lambayi chorayi dono barabar hai kyunke jannat misl-e-qubba ke Arsh ke neeche hai aur jo cheez qubba-numa ho ya mustadeer ho is ka arz-o-tool yaksan hota hai. Ek sahih hadith mein hai jab tum Allah se jannat mango to Firdous ka sawal karo woh sab se unchi aur sab se achi jannat hai isi jannat se sab nahrein jaari hoti hain aur isi ki chhat Allah Ta'ala Rahman-ur-Rahim ka Arsh hai, Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke Heraclius ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein bator-e-aitraz ke ek sawal likh bheja ke aap mujhe is jannat ki dawat de rahe hain jis ki chorayi aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai to yeh farmayiye ke phir jahannam kahan gayi? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ya'la bin Murrah ki mulaqat Homs mein hui thi kehte hain us waqt yeh bohat hi borha ho gaya tha kehne laga jab main ne yeh khat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko diya to aap ne apni bayin taraf ke ek sahabi ko diya main ne logon se poocha un ka kya naam hai? Logon ne kaha yeh Hazrat Mu'awiyah hain (R.A). Hazrat Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi sawal hua tha to aap ne farmaya tha ke din ke waqt raat aur raat ke waqt din kahan jata hai? Yahoodi yeh jawab sun kar khasiyane ho kar kehne lage ke yeh Torah se ma'akhuz kiya hoga, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se bhi yeh jawab marwi hai, ek marfoo hadith mein hai kisi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha to aap ne jawab mein farmaya jab har cheez par raat aa jati hai to din kahan jata hai?

Us ne kaha jahan Allah chahe, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya isi tarah Jahannam bhi jahan chahe (Bazzar). Is jumla ke do ma'ani hote hain, ek toh yeh ke raat ke waqt hum go din ko nahin dekh sakte lekin taham din ka kisi jagah hona namumkin nahin, isi tarah go Jannat ka arz itna hi hai lekin phir bhi Jahannam ke wajood se inkar nahin ho sakta jahan Allah chahe woh bhi hai, dusre ma'ani yeh ke jab din ek taraf charhne laga raat dusri janib hoti hai isi tarah Jannat A'ala Illiyeen mein hai aur Dozakh Asfal-us-Safileen mein toh koi nafi ka imkan hi na raha, Wallahu A'alam. Phir Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Jannat ka wasf bayan farmata hai ke woh sakhti mein aur aasani mein, khushi mein aur ghami mein, tandurusti mein aur bimari mein, garz har haal mein rah-e-Allah apna maal kharch karte rehte hain jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Allazeena yunfiquna amwalahum bil-laili wan-nahari sirran wa 'alaniyatan falahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wala khaufun 'alaihim wala hum yahzanun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 274) yani woh log din raat chhupe khule kharch karte rehte hain, koi amr unhein Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at se baaz nahin rakh sakta, us ki makhlooq par us ke hukm se ehsan karte rehte hain. Yeh gusse ko pee jaane wale aur logon ki buraiyon se darguzar karne wale hain. (Kazm) ke ma'ani chhupane ke bhi hain yani apne gusse ka izhar bhi nahin karte. Ba'az riwayaton mein hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Agar gusse ke waqt tujhe yaad rakhunga yani halakat ke waqt tujhe halakat se bacha lunga (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Jo shakhs apna gussa rok le Allah Ta'ala us par se apne azab hata leta hai aur jo bhi apni zaban (khilaf-e-shar'a baton se) rok le Allah Ta'ala us ki parda poshi karega aur jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki taraf ma'azrat le jaye Allah Ta'ala us ka uzr qabool farmata hai (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad mein bhi ikhtilaf hai. Aur hadith-e-shareef mein hai, Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehlwan woh nahin jo kisi ko pachhar de balkeh haqiqatan pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne nafs par qabu rakhe (Ahmad). Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Tum mein se koi aisa hai jise apne waris ka maal apne maal se zyada mehboob ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) koi nahin. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Main toh dekhta hoon ke tum apne maal se zyada apne waris ka maal chahte ho, is liye ke tumhara maal toh darhaqiqat woh hai jo tum rah-e-Allah apni zindagi mein kharch kar do aur jo chhor kar jao woh tumhara maal nahin balkeh tumhare warison ka maal hai, toh tumhara rah-e-Allah kam kharch karna aur jama zyada karna yeh daleel hai is amr ki ke tum apne maal se apne warison ke maal ko zyada aziz rakhte ho. Phir farmaya: Tum pehlwan kise jaante ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) use jise koi gira na sake. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Nahin balkeh haqiqatan zor-dar pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne jazbat par pura qabu rakhe. Phir farmaya: Be-aulad kise kehte ho?

Logon ne kaha jis ki aulad na ho, farmaya nahin balkeh fi-al-waqai be-aulad woh hai jis ke samne us ki koi aulad mari na ho (Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya ke jante ho muflis kangal kaun hai? Logon ne kaha jis ke paas maal na ho, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh woh jis ne apna maal apni zindagi mein rah-e-Allah na diya ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Haritha bin Qudama Sa'adi (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi mein arz karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe koi nafa ki baat kahiye jo mukhtasar ho taake main yaad bhi rakh sakoon, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, us ne phir poocha, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir yahi jawab diya, kai kai martaba yahi kaha (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Kisi shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhe kuch wasiyat kijiye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, woh kehte hain main ne jo gaur kiya to maloom hua ke tamam buraiyon ka markaz ghussa hi hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko ghussa aaya to Aap (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) baith gaye aur phir lait gaye, un se poocha gaya yeh kya?

Toh farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap farmate thay jisay gussa aaye woh khara ho toh baith jaye agar us se bhi gussa na jaye toh lait jaye (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aik aur riwayat mein hai ke Urwah bin Muhammad ko gussa charha aap wuzu karne baith gaye aur farmane lage main ne apne ustadon se yeh hadith suni hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke gussa shaitan ki taraf se hai aur shaitan aag se paida hua hai aur aag bujhane wali cheez pani hai pas tum gussa ke waqt wuzu karne baith jao. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh irshad hai ke jo shakhs kisi tang dast ko mohlat de ya apna qarz usay maaf kar de Allah Ta'ala usay jahannam se azaad kar deta hai. Logo suno jannat ke aamal sakht aur mushkil hain aur jahannam ke kaam aasaan aur sahal hain. Nek bakht wohi hai jo fitnon se bach jaye. Kisi ghont ka peena Allah ko aisa pasand nahin jitna gussa ke ghont ka pee jana, aisay shakhs ke dil mein imaan rach jata hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs apna gussa utaarne ki taqat rakhte hue phir bhi zabt kar le Allah Ta'ala us ka dil aman-o-aman se pur kar deta hai. Jo shakhs bawajood majood hone ke shohrat ke kapray ko tawazo ki wajah se chor de usay Allah Ta'ala karamat aur izzat ka hulla qayamat ke din pehnaye ga aur jo kisi ka sar chupaye Allah Ta'ala usay qayamat ke din badshahat ka taaj pehnaye ga (Abu Dawood). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs bawajood qudrat ke apna gussa zabt kar le usay Allah Ta'ala tamam makhlooq ke samne bula kar ikhtiyar de ga ke jis hoor ko chahe pasand kar le (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is mazmoon ki aur bhi hadeesain hain, pas aayat ka matlab yeh hua ke woh apne gussa mein aape se bahar nahin hote logon ko un ki taraf se burai nahin pohanchti balkay apne jazbaat ko dabaye rakhte hain aur Allah se dar kar sawab ki umeed par mamla supurd-e-Allah karte hain, logon se darguzar karte hain zalimon ke zulm ka badla abhi nahin lete isi ko ehsan kehte hain aur in mohsin bandon se Allah mohabbat rakhta hai. Hadith mein hai Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain teen baton par main qasam khata hoon: aik toh yeh ke sadqa se maal nahin ghat-ta, dusre yeh ke afw-o-darguzar karne se insaan ki izzat barhti hai, teesre yeh ke tawazo, farotni aur aajizi karne wale ko Allah Ta'ala buland martaba ata karta hai. Mustadrak ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahe ke us ki bunyad buland ho aur us ke darjay barhein toh usay zalimon se darguzar karna chahiye aur na dene walon ko dena chahiye aur torne walon se jorna chahiye aur hadith mein hai qayamat ke din aik pukare ga ke ae logo darguzar karne walo apne Rabb ke paas aao aur apna ajr lo. Musalmanon ki khataon ke maaf karne wale jannati log hain. Phir farmaya yeh log gunah ke baad foran zikr-e-Allah aur istighfar karte hain.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Jab koi shakhs gunah karta hai, phir Allah Rahman-o-Raheem ke samne hazir ho kar kehta hai ke Parwardigar! mujh se gunah ho gaya, toh maaf farma. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mere bande se go gunah ho gaya lekin is ka iman hai ke is ka Rabb gunah par pakar bhi karta hai aur agar chahe toh maaf bhi farma deta hai, main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho toh farma deta hai: Main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho jata hai, yeh phir tauba karta hai, Allah Ta'ala phir bakhshta hai. Chauthi martaba phir gunah kar baithta hai, phir tauba karta hai toh Allah Ta'ala maaf farma kar kehta hai: Ab mera banda jo chahe kare (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain: Hum ne ek martaba Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Jab hum aap ko dekhte hain toh hamare dilon mein riqqat tari ho jati hai aur hum Allah wale ban jate hain, lekin jab aap ke paas se chale jate hain toh woh halat nahin rehti, aurton bachon mein phans jate hain, ghar baar ke dhandon mein lag jate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya.

Agar tumhari halat yahi har waqt rehti toh phir farishtay tum se musafaha karte aur tumhari mulaqat ko tumhare ghar par aate, suno agar tum gunah na karo toh Allah tumhein yahan se hata de aur dusri qoum ko le aaye jo gunah kare phir bakhshish mange aur Allah unhein bakhshe. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh farmate ke jannat ki bunyadein kis tarah ustawar hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek eent sone ki toh ek chandi ki hai, is ka gara mushk-e-khalis hai, is ke kankar lulu aur yaqoot hain, is ki mitti zafran hai, jannatiyon ki ne'matein kabhi khatam na hongi, un ki zindagi hamesha ki hogi, un ke kapray purane nahin honge, jawani kabhi nahin dhale gi aur teen ashkhas ki dua kabhi rad nahin hoti: adil badshah ki dua, iftari ke waqt rozay-dar ki dua aur mazloom ki dua badalon se uthayi jati hai aur is ke liye aasmanon ke darwazay khol diye jate hain aur Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai mujhe meri izzat ki qasam main teri zaroor madad karunga agarche kuch waqt ke baad ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs koi gunah kare phir wuzu kar ke do rakat namaz ada kare aur apne gunah ki maafi chahe toh ae Allah Azzawajal us ke gunah maaf farma deta hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim mein riwayat Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se jo shakhs kamil wuzu kar ke dua (Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluhu) parhay us ke liye jannat ke aathon darwazay khul jate hain jis se chahe andar chala jaye. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) sunnat ke mutabiq wuzu karte hain phir farmate hain main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh jaisa wuzu kare phir do rakat namaz ada kare jis mein apne dil se baatein na kare toh Allah Ta'ala us ke tamam gunah maaf farma deta hai (Bukhari, Muslim). Pas yeh hadith ko Hazrat Usman (R.A) se, is se agli riwayat Hazrat Umar (R.A) se aur is se agli riwayat Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se aur is se teesri riwayat ko Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se Hazrat Ali (R.A) riwayat karte hain toh Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ki wasee maghfirat aur us ki be-inteha meherbani ki khabar Sayyid-ul-Awwaleen wal-Akhireen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani aap ke charon bar-haq khulafa ki ma'rifat hamein pahunchi. Aao is mauqa par hum gunahgar bhi haath uthayen aur apne meharban Raheem-o-Kareem Allah ke samne apne gunahon ka iqrar kar ke us se maafi talab karein. Allah Ta'ala ae maa baap se zyada meharban! Ae afw-o-darguzar karne wale! Aur kisi bhikari ko apne dar se khali na pherne wale! Tu hum khata-karon ki siyah-kariyon se bhi darguzar farma aur hamare kul gunah maaf farma de.

Iblees gunahon se logon ko halak karna chahta hai aur uski apni halakat La Ilaha Illallah aur istighfar se hai, yeh hadith dekh kar Iblees ne logon ko khwahish parasti par daal diya pas woh apne aap ko rah-e-rast par jante hain halankeh halakat mein hote hain lekin is hadith ke do rawi za'eef hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Iblees ne kaha ae Rab mujhe teri izzat ki qasam main Bani Adam ko unke aakhri dam tak behkata rahoonga, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya mujhe mere jalal aur meri izzat ki qasam jab tak woh mujhse bakhshish mangte rahenge main bhi unhein bakhshta rahoonga. Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhse gunah ho gaya aap ne farmaya phir istighfar kar, usne kaha mujhse aur gunah hua farmaya istighfar kiye ja, yahan tak ke Shaitan thak jaye phir farmaya gunah ko bakhshna Allah hi ke ikhtiyar mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas ek qaidi aaya aur kehne laga ya Allah main teri taraf tauba karta hoon Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf tauba nahin karta (ya'ni Allah main teri hi bakhshish chahta hoon) aap ne farmaya isne haq haqdar ko pahunchaya. Israr karne se murad yeh hai ke ma'asiyat par baghair tauba kiye ar nahin jate agar kayi martaba gunah ho jaye toh kayi martaba istighfar karte hain, Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain woh israr karne wala aur arne wala nahin jo istighfar karta rehta hai agarche (bilfarz) us se ek din mein sattar martaba bhi gunah ho jaye. Phir farmaya ke woh jante hon ya'ni is baat ko ke Allah tauba qabool karne wala hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Alam ya'lamu annallaha huwal yaqbalut taubata an ibadihi wa ya'khuzus sadaqati wa annallaha huwat tawwabur raheem) (Surah At-Taubah: 104) kya yeh nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai aur jagah hai aayat (Wa man ya'mal su'an au yazlim nafsahu summa yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha ghafooran raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) jo shakhs koi bura kaam kare ya gunah kar ke apni jaan par zulm kare phir Allah Ta'ala se bakhshish talab kare toh woh dekh lega ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal bakhshish karne wala meharban hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimbar par bayan farmaya logo tum auron par raham karo Allah tum par raham karega, logo tum dusron ki khatayen maaf karo Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunahon ko bakhshega, baatein banane walon ki halakat hai, gunah par jam jane walon ki halakat hai. Phir farmaya in kamon ke badle unki jaza maghfirat hai aur tarah tarah ki behti nehron wali jannat hai jis mein woh hamesha rahenge, yeh bare achhe a'maal hain.

Sood khor jahannami hai aur gussa shaitan ki den hai is se bacho. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko soodi len-den se aur sood khori se rok raha hai, Ahl-e-Jahiliyat soodi qarza dete thay muddat muqarrar hoti thi agar is muddat par rupiya wasool na hota to muddat barha kar sood par sood barha diya karte thay isi tarah sood dar sood mila kar asal raqam kayi guna barh jati, Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko is tarah na-haq logon ke maal ghasab karne se rok raha hai aur taqwe ka hukum de kar is par nijat ka wada kar raha hai, phir aag se darata hai aur apne azabon se dhamkata hai phir apni aur apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at par amada karta hai aur is par raham-o-karam ka wada deta hai phir sa'adat-e-darain ke husool ke liye nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karne ko farmata hai aur jannat ki tareef karta hai, chorayi ko bayan kar ke lambayi ka andaza sunne walon par hi chora jata hai jis tarah jannati farsh ki tareef karte hue farmaya aayat (Muttaki'ina 'ala furushim-bata'inuha min istabraq) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 54) yani is ka astar naram resham ka hai to matlab yeh hai ke jab astar aisa hai to abray ka kya thikana hai isi tarah yahan bhi bayan ho raha hai ke jab arz saton aasmanon aur satwin zameenon ke barabar hai to tool kitna bara hoga aur ba'az ne kaha hai ke arz-o-tool yani lambayi chorayi dono barabar hai kyunke jannat misl-e-qubba ke Arsh ke neeche hai aur jo cheez qubba-numa ho ya mustadeer ho is ka arz-o-tool yaksan hota hai. Ek sahih hadith mein hai jab tum Allah se jannat mango to Firdous ka sawal karo woh sab se unchi aur sab se achi jannat hai isi jannat se sab nahrein jaari hoti hain aur isi ki chhat Allah Ta'ala Rahman-ur-Rahim ka Arsh hai, Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke Heraclius ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein bator-e-aitraz ke ek sawal likh bheja ke aap mujhe is jannat ki dawat de rahe hain jis ki chorayi aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai to yeh farmayiye ke phir jahannam kahan gayi? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ya'la bin Murrah ki mulaqat Homs mein hui thi kehte hain us waqt yeh bohat hi borha ho gaya tha kehne laga jab main ne yeh khat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko diya to aap ne apni bayin taraf ke ek sahabi ko diya main ne logon se poocha un ka kya naam hai? Logon ne kaha yeh Hazrat Mu'awiyah hain (R.A). Hazrat Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi sawal hua tha to aap ne farmaya tha ke din ke waqt raat aur raat ke waqt din kahan jata hai? Yahoodi yeh jawab sun kar khasiyane ho kar kehne lage ke yeh Torah se ma'akhuz kiya hoga, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se bhi yeh jawab marwi hai, ek marfoo hadith mein hai kisi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha to aap ne jawab mein farmaya jab har cheez par raat aa jati hai to din kahan jata hai?

Us ne kaha jahan Allah chahe, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya isi tarah Jahannam bhi jahan chahe (Bazzar). Is jumla ke do ma'ani hote hain, ek toh yeh ke raat ke waqt hum go din ko nahin dekh sakte lekin taham din ka kisi jagah hona namumkin nahin, isi tarah go Jannat ka arz itna hi hai lekin phir bhi Jahannam ke wajood se inkar nahin ho sakta jahan Allah chahe woh bhi hai, dusre ma'ani yeh ke jab din ek taraf charhne laga raat dusri janib hoti hai isi tarah Jannat A'ala Illiyeen mein hai aur Dozakh Asfal-us-Safileen mein toh koi nafi ka imkan hi na raha, Wallahu A'alam. Phir Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Jannat ka wasf bayan farmata hai ke woh sakhti mein aur aasani mein, khushi mein aur ghami mein, tandurusti mein aur bimari mein, garz har haal mein rah-e-Allah apna maal kharch karte rehte hain jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Allazeena yunfiquna amwalahum bil-laili wan-nahari sirran wa 'alaniyatan falahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wala khaufun 'alaihim wala hum yahzanun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 274) yani woh log din raat chhupe khule kharch karte rehte hain, koi amr unhein Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at se baaz nahin rakh sakta, us ki makhlooq par us ke hukm se ehsan karte rehte hain. Yeh gusse ko pee jaane wale aur logon ki buraiyon se darguzar karne wale hain. (Kazm) ke ma'ani chhupane ke bhi hain yani apne gusse ka izhar bhi nahin karte. Ba'az riwayaton mein hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Agar gusse ke waqt tujhe yaad rakhunga yani halakat ke waqt tujhe halakat se bacha lunga (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Jo shakhs apna gussa rok le Allah Ta'ala us par se apne azab hata leta hai aur jo bhi apni zaban (khilaf-e-shar'a baton se) rok le Allah Ta'ala us ki parda poshi karega aur jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki taraf ma'azrat le jaye Allah Ta'ala us ka uzr qabool farmata hai (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad mein bhi ikhtilaf hai. Aur hadith-e-shareef mein hai, Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehlwan woh nahin jo kisi ko pachhar de balkeh haqiqatan pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne nafs par qabu rakhe (Ahmad). Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Tum mein se koi aisa hai jise apne waris ka maal apne maal se zyada mehboob ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) koi nahin. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Main toh dekhta hoon ke tum apne maal se zyada apne waris ka maal chahte ho, is liye ke tumhara maal toh darhaqiqat woh hai jo tum rah-e-Allah apni zindagi mein kharch kar do aur jo chhor kar jao woh tumhara maal nahin balkeh tumhare warison ka maal hai, toh tumhara rah-e-Allah kam kharch karna aur jama zyada karna yeh daleel hai is amr ki ke tum apne maal se apne warison ke maal ko zyada aziz rakhte ho. Phir farmaya: Tum pehlwan kise jaante ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) use jise koi gira na sake. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Nahin balkeh haqiqatan zor-dar pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne jazbat par pura qabu rakhe. Phir farmaya: Be-aulad kise kehte ho?

Logon ne kaha jis ki aulad na ho, farmaya nahin balkeh fi-al-waqai be-aulad woh hai jis ke samne us ki koi aulad mari na ho (Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya ke jante ho muflis kangal kaun hai? Logon ne kaha jis ke paas maal na ho, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh woh jis ne apna maal apni zindagi mein rah-e-Allah na diya ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Haritha bin Qudama Sa'adi (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi mein arz karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe koi nafa ki baat kahiye jo mukhtasar ho taake main yaad bhi rakh sakoon, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, us ne phir poocha, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir yahi jawab diya, kai kai martaba yahi kaha (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Kisi shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhe kuch wasiyat kijiye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, woh kehte hain main ne jo gaur kiya to maloom hua ke tamam buraiyon ka markaz ghussa hi hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko ghussa aaya to Aap (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) baith gaye aur phir lait gaye, un se poocha gaya yeh kya?

Toh farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap farmate thay jisay gussa aaye woh khara ho toh baith jaye agar us se bhi gussa na jaye toh lait jaye (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aik aur riwayat mein hai ke Urwah bin Muhammad ko gussa charha aap wuzu karne baith gaye aur farmane lage main ne apne ustadon se yeh hadith suni hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke gussa shaitan ki taraf se hai aur shaitan aag se paida hua hai aur aag bujhane wali cheez pani hai pas tum gussa ke waqt wuzu karne baith jao. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh irshad hai ke jo shakhs kisi tang dast ko mohlat de ya apna qarz usay maaf kar de Allah Ta'ala usay jahannam se azaad kar deta hai. Logo suno jannat ke aamal sakht aur mushkil hain aur jahannam ke kaam aasaan aur sahal hain. Nek bakht wohi hai jo fitnon se bach jaye. Kisi ghont ka peena Allah ko aisa pasand nahin jitna gussa ke ghont ka pee jana, aisay shakhs ke dil mein imaan rach jata hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs apna gussa utaarne ki taqat rakhte hue phir bhi zabt kar le Allah Ta'ala us ka dil aman-o-aman se pur kar deta hai. Jo shakhs bawajood majood hone ke shohrat ke kapray ko tawazo ki wajah se chor de usay Allah Ta'ala karamat aur izzat ka hulla qayamat ke din pehnaye ga aur jo kisi ka sar chupaye Allah Ta'ala usay qayamat ke din badshahat ka taaj pehnaye ga (Abu Dawood). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs bawajood qudrat ke apna gussa zabt kar le usay Allah Ta'ala tamam makhlooq ke samne bula kar ikhtiyar de ga ke jis hoor ko chahe pasand kar le (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is mazmoon ki aur bhi hadeesain hain, pas aayat ka matlab yeh hua ke woh apne gussa mein aape se bahar nahin hote logon ko un ki taraf se burai nahin pohanchti balkay apne jazbaat ko dabaye rakhte hain aur Allah se dar kar sawab ki umeed par mamla supurd-e-Allah karte hain, logon se darguzar karte hain zalimon ke zulm ka badla abhi nahin lete isi ko ehsan kehte hain aur in mohsin bandon se Allah mohabbat rakhta hai. Hadith mein hai Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain teen baton par main qasam khata hoon: aik toh yeh ke sadqa se maal nahin ghat-ta, dusre yeh ke afw-o-darguzar karne se insaan ki izzat barhti hai, teesre yeh ke tawazo, farotni aur aajizi karne wale ko Allah Ta'ala buland martaba ata karta hai. Mustadrak ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahe ke us ki bunyad buland ho aur us ke darjay barhein toh usay zalimon se darguzar karna chahiye aur na dene walon ko dena chahiye aur torne walon se jorna chahiye aur hadith mein hai qayamat ke din aik pukare ga ke ae logo darguzar karne walo apne Rabb ke paas aao aur apna ajr lo. Musalmanon ki khataon ke maaf karne wale jannati log hain. Phir farmaya yeh log gunah ke baad foran zikr-e-Allah aur istighfar karte hain.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Jab koi shakhs gunah karta hai, phir Allah Rahman-o-Raheem ke samne hazir ho kar kehta hai ke Parwardigar! mujh se gunah ho gaya, toh maaf farma. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mere bande se go gunah ho gaya lekin is ka iman hai ke is ka Rabb gunah par pakar bhi karta hai aur agar chahe toh maaf bhi farma deta hai, main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho toh farma deta hai: Main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho jata hai, yeh phir tauba karta hai, Allah Ta'ala phir bakhshta hai. Chauthi martaba phir gunah kar baithta hai, phir tauba karta hai toh Allah Ta'ala maaf farma kar kehta hai: Ab mera banda jo chahe kare (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain: Hum ne ek martaba Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Jab hum aap ko dekhte hain toh hamare dilon mein riqqat tari ho jati hai aur hum Allah wale ban jate hain, lekin jab aap ke paas se chale jate hain toh woh halat nahin rehti, aurton bachon mein phans jate hain, ghar baar ke dhandon mein lag jate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya.

Agar tumhari halat yahi har waqt rehti toh phir farishtay tum se musafaha karte aur tumhari mulaqat ko tumhare ghar par aate, suno agar tum gunah na karo toh Allah tumhein yahan se hata de aur dusri qoum ko le aaye jo gunah kare phir bakhshish mange aur Allah unhein bakhshe. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh farmate ke jannat ki bunyadein kis tarah ustawar hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek eent sone ki toh ek chandi ki hai, is ka gara mushk-e-khalis hai, is ke kankar lulu aur yaqoot hain, is ki mitti zafran hai, jannatiyon ki ne'matein kabhi khatam na hongi, un ki zindagi hamesha ki hogi, un ke kapray purane nahin honge, jawani kabhi nahin dhale gi aur teen ashkhas ki dua kabhi rad nahin hoti: adil badshah ki dua, iftari ke waqt rozay-dar ki dua aur mazloom ki dua badalon se uthayi jati hai aur is ke liye aasmanon ke darwazay khol diye jate hain aur Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai mujhe meri izzat ki qasam main teri zaroor madad karunga agarche kuch waqt ke baad ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs koi gunah kare phir wuzu kar ke do rakat namaz ada kare aur apne gunah ki maafi chahe toh ae Allah Azzawajal us ke gunah maaf farma deta hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim mein riwayat Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se jo shakhs kamil wuzu kar ke dua (Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluhu) parhay us ke liye jannat ke aathon darwazay khul jate hain jis se chahe andar chala jaye. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) sunnat ke mutabiq wuzu karte hain phir farmate hain main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh jaisa wuzu kare phir do rakat namaz ada kare jis mein apne dil se baatein na kare toh Allah Ta'ala us ke tamam gunah maaf farma deta hai (Bukhari, Muslim). Pas yeh hadith ko Hazrat Usman (R.A) se, is se agli riwayat Hazrat Umar (R.A) se aur is se agli riwayat Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se aur is se teesri riwayat ko Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se Hazrat Ali (R.A) riwayat karte hain toh Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ki wasee maghfirat aur us ki be-inteha meherbani ki khabar Sayyid-ul-Awwaleen wal-Akhireen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani aap ke charon bar-haq khulafa ki ma'rifat hamein pahunchi. Aao is mauqa par hum gunahgar bhi haath uthayen aur apne meharban Raheem-o-Kareem Allah ke samne apne gunahon ka iqrar kar ke us se maafi talab karein. Allah Ta'ala ae maa baap se zyada meharban! Ae afw-o-darguzar karne wale! Aur kisi bhikari ko apne dar se khali na pherne wale! Tu hum khata-karon ki siyah-kariyon se bhi darguzar farma aur hamare kul gunah maaf farma de.

(Mutarjim) Yehi woh mubarak aayat hai ke jab yeh nazil hui toh Iblees rone laga (Musnad Abdur Razzaq). Istighfar aur La Ilaha Illallah: Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain La Ilaha Illallah kasrat se parha karo aur istighfar par mudawamat karo. Iblees gunahon se logon ko halak karna chahta hai aur uski apni halakat La Ilaha Illallah aur istighfar se hai, yeh hadith dekh kar Iblees ne logon ko khwahish parasti par daal diya pas woh apne aap ko rah-e-rast par jante hain halankeh halakat mein hote hain lekin is hadith ke do rawi za'eef hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Iblees ne kaha ae Rab mujhe teri izzat ki qasam main Bani Adam ko unke aakhri dam tak behkata rahoonga, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya mujhe mere jalal aur meri izzat ki qasam jab tak woh mujhse bakhshish mangte rahenge main bhi unhein bakhshta rahoonga. Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhse gunah ho gaya aap ne farmaya phir istighfar kar, usne kaha mujhse aur gunah hua farmaya istighfar kiye ja, yahan tak ke Shaitan thak jaye phir farmaya gunah ko bakhshna Allah hi ke ikhtiyar mein hai. Phir farmaya in kamon ke badle unki jaza maghfirat hai aur tarah tarah ki behti nehron wali jannat hai jis mein woh hamesha rahenge, yeh bare achhe a'maal hain.

Sood khor jahannami hai aur gussa shaitan ki den hai is se bacho. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko soodi len-den se aur sood khori se rok raha hai, Ahl-e-Jahiliyat soodi qarza dete thay muddat muqarrar hoti thi agar is muddat par rupiya wasool na hota to muddat barha kar sood par sood barha diya karte thay isi tarah sood dar sood mila kar asal raqam kayi guna barh jati, Allah Ta'ala imandaron ko is tarah na-haq logon ke maal ghasab karne se rok raha hai aur taqwe ka hukum de kar is par nijat ka wada kar raha hai, phir aag se darata hai aur apne azabon se dhamkata hai phir apni aur apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at par amada karta hai aur is par raham-o-karam ka wada deta hai phir sa'adat-e-darain ke husool ke liye nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karne ko farmata hai aur jannat ki tareef karta hai, chorayi ko bayan kar ke lambayi ka andaza sunne walon par hi chora jata hai jis tarah jannati farsh ki tareef karte hue farmaya aayat (Muttaki'ina 'ala furushim-bata'inuha min istabraq) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 54) yani is ka astar naram resham ka hai to matlab yeh hai ke jab astar aisa hai to abray ka kya thikana hai isi tarah yahan bhi bayan ho raha hai ke jab arz saton aasmanon aur satwin zameenon ke barabar hai to tool kitna bara hoga aur ba'az ne kaha hai ke arz-o-tool yani lambayi chorayi dono barabar hai kyunke jannat misl-e-qubba ke Arsh ke neeche hai aur jo cheez qubba-numa ho ya mustadeer ho is ka arz-o-tool yaksan hota hai. Ek sahih hadith mein hai jab tum Allah se jannat mango to Firdous ka sawal karo woh sab se unchi aur sab se achi jannat hai isi jannat se sab nahrein jaari hoti hain aur isi ki chhat Allah Ta'ala Rahman-ur-Rahim ka Arsh hai, Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke Heraclius ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein bator-e-aitraz ke ek sawal likh bheja ke aap mujhe is jannat ki dawat de rahe hain jis ki chorayi aasman-o-zameen ke barabar hai to yeh farmayiye ke phir jahannam kahan gayi? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ya'la bin Murrah ki mulaqat Homs mein hui thi kehte hain us waqt yeh bohat hi borha ho gaya tha kehne laga jab main ne yeh khat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko diya to aap ne apni bayin taraf ke ek sahabi ko diya main ne logon se poocha un ka kya naam hai? Logon ne kaha yeh Hazrat Mu'awiyah hain (R.A). Hazrat Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi sawal hua tha to aap ne farmaya tha ke din ke waqt raat aur raat ke waqt din kahan jata hai? Yahoodi yeh jawab sun kar khasiyane ho kar kehne lage ke yeh Torah se ma'akhuz kiya hoga, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se bhi yeh jawab marwi hai, ek marfoo hadith mein hai kisi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha to aap ne jawab mein farmaya jab har cheez par raat aa jati hai to din kahan jata hai?

Us ne kaha jahan Allah chahe, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya isi tarah Jahannam bhi jahan chahe (Bazzar). Is jumla ke do ma'ani hote hain, ek toh yeh ke raat ke waqt hum go din ko nahin dekh sakte lekin taham din ka kisi jagah hona namumkin nahin, isi tarah go Jannat ka arz itna hi hai lekin phir bhi Jahannam ke wajood se inkar nahin ho sakta jahan Allah chahe woh bhi hai, dusre ma'ani yeh ke jab din ek taraf charhne laga raat dusri janib hoti hai isi tarah Jannat A'ala Illiyeen mein hai aur Dozakh Asfal-us-Safileen mein toh koi nafi ka imkan hi na raha, Wallahu A'alam. Phir Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Jannat ka wasf bayan farmata hai ke woh sakhti mein aur aasani mein, khushi mein aur ghami mein, tandurusti mein aur bimari mein, garz har haal mein rah-e-Allah apna maal kharch karte rehte hain jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Allazeena yunfiquna amwalahum bil-laili wan-nahari sirran wa 'alaniyatan falahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wala khaufun 'alaihim wala hum yahzanun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 274) yani woh log din raat chhupe khule kharch karte rehte hain, koi amr unhein Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at se baaz nahin rakh sakta, us ki makhlooq par us ke hukm se ehsan karte rehte hain. Yeh gusse ko pee jaane wale aur logon ki buraiyon se darguzar karne wale hain. (Kazm) ke ma'ani chhupane ke bhi hain yani apne gusse ka izhar bhi nahin karte. Ba'az riwayaton mein hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Agar gusse ke waqt tujhe yaad rakhunga yani halakat ke waqt tujhe halakat se bacha lunga (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Jo shakhs apna gussa rok le Allah Ta'ala us par se apne azab hata leta hai aur jo bhi apni zaban (khilaf-e-shar'a baton se) rok le Allah Ta'ala us ki parda poshi karega aur jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki taraf ma'azrat le jaye Allah Ta'ala us ka uzr qabool farmata hai (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad mein bhi ikhtilaf hai. Aur hadith-e-shareef mein hai, Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehlwan woh nahin jo kisi ko pachhar de balkeh haqiqatan pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne nafs par qabu rakhe (Ahmad). Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Tum mein se koi aisa hai jise apne waris ka maal apne maal se zyada mehboob ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) koi nahin. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Main toh dekhta hoon ke tum apne maal se zyada apne waris ka maal chahte ho, is liye ke tumhara maal toh darhaqiqat woh hai jo tum rah-e-Allah apni zindagi mein kharch kar do aur jo chhor kar jao woh tumhara maal nahin balkeh tumhare warison ka maal hai, toh tumhara rah-e-Allah kam kharch karna aur jama zyada karna yeh daleel hai is amr ki ke tum apne maal se apne warison ke maal ko zyada aziz rakhte ho. Phir farmaya: Tum pehlwan kise jaante ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) use jise koi gira na sake. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Nahin balkeh haqiqatan zor-dar pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne jazbat par pura qabu rakhe. Phir farmaya: Be-aulad kise kehte ho?

Logon ne kaha jis ki aulad na ho, farmaya nahin balkeh fi-al-waqai be-aulad woh hai jis ke samne us ki koi aulad mari na ho (Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya ke jante ho muflis kangal kaun hai? Logon ne kaha jis ke paas maal na ho, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh woh jis ne apna maal apni zindagi mein rah-e-Allah na diya ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Haritha bin Qudama Sa'adi (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi mein arz karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe koi nafa ki baat kahiye jo mukhtasar ho taake main yaad bhi rakh sakoon, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, us ne phir poocha, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir yahi jawab diya, kai kai martaba yahi kaha (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Kisi shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhe kuch wasiyat kijiye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, woh kehte hain main ne jo gaur kiya to maloom hua ke tamam buraiyon ka markaz ghussa hi hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko ghussa aaya to Aap (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) baith gaye aur phir lait gaye, un se poocha gaya yeh kya?

Toh farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap farmate thay jisay gussa aaye woh khara ho toh baith jaye agar us se bhi gussa na jaye toh lait jaye (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aik aur riwayat mein hai ke Urwah bin Muhammad ko gussa charha aap wuzu karne baith gaye aur farmane lage main ne apne ustadon se yeh hadith suni hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke gussa shaitan ki taraf se hai aur shaitan aag se paida hua hai aur aag bujhane wali cheez pani hai pas tum gussa ke waqt wuzu karne baith jao. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh irshad hai ke jo shakhs kisi tang dast ko mohlat de ya apna qarz usay maaf kar de Allah Ta'ala usay jahannam se azaad kar deta hai. Logo suno jannat ke aamal sakht aur mushkil hain aur jahannam ke kaam aasaan aur sahal hain. Nek bakht wohi hai jo fitnon se bach jaye. Kisi ghont ka peena Allah ko aisa pasand nahin jitna gussa ke ghont ka pee jana, aisay shakhs ke dil mein imaan rach jata hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs apna gussa utaarne ki taqat rakhte hue phir bhi zabt kar le Allah Ta'ala us ka dil aman-o-aman se pur kar deta hai. Jo shakhs bawajood majood hone ke shohrat ke kapray ko tawazo ki wajah se chor de usay Allah Ta'ala karamat aur izzat ka hulla qayamat ke din pehnaye ga aur jo kisi ka sar chupaye Allah Ta'ala usay qayamat ke din badshahat ka taaj pehnaye ga (Abu Dawood). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs bawajood qudrat ke apna gussa zabt kar le usay Allah Ta'ala tamam makhlooq ke samne bula kar ikhtiyar de ga ke jis hoor ko chahe pasand kar le (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is mazmoon ki aur bhi hadeesain hain, pas aayat ka matlab yeh hua ke woh apne gussa mein aape se bahar nahin hote logon ko un ki taraf se burai nahin pohanchti balkay apne jazbaat ko dabaye rakhte hain aur Allah se dar kar sawab ki umeed par mamla supurd-e-Allah karte hain, logon se darguzar karte hain zalimon ke zulm ka badla abhi nahin lete isi ko ehsan kehte hain aur in mohsin bandon se Allah mohabbat rakhta hai. Hadith mein hai Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain teen baton par main qasam khata hoon: aik toh yeh ke sadqa se maal nahin ghat-ta, dusre yeh ke afw-o-darguzar karne se insaan ki izzat barhti hai, teesre yeh ke tawazo, farotni aur aajizi karne wale ko Allah Ta'ala buland martaba ata karta hai. Mustadrak ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahe ke us ki bunyad buland ho aur us ke darjay barhein toh usay zalimon se darguzar karna chahiye aur na dene walon ko dena chahiye aur torne walon se jorna chahiye aur hadith mein hai qayamat ke din aik pukare ga ke ae logo darguzar karne walo apne Rabb ke paas aao aur apna ajr lo. Musalmanon ki khataon ke maaf karne wale jannati log hain. Phir farmaya yeh log gunah ke baad foran zikr-e-Allah aur istighfar karte hain.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Jab koi shakhs gunah karta hai, phir Allah Rahman-o-Raheem ke samne hazir ho kar kehta hai ke Parwardigar! mujh se gunah ho gaya, toh maaf farma. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mere bande se go gunah ho gaya lekin is ka iman hai ke is ka Rabb gunah par pakar bhi karta hai aur agar chahe toh maaf bhi farma deta hai, main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho toh farma deta hai: Main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho jata hai, yeh phir tauba karta hai, Allah Ta'ala phir bakhshta hai. Chauthi martaba phir gunah kar baithta hai, phir tauba karta hai toh Allah Ta'ala maaf farma kar kehta hai: Ab mera banda jo chahe kare (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain: Hum ne ek martaba Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Jab hum aap ko dekhte hain toh hamare dilon mein riqqat tari ho jati hai aur hum Allah wale ban jate hain, lekin jab aap ke paas se chale jate hain toh woh halat nahin rehti, aurton bachon mein phans jate hain, ghar baar ke dhandon mein lag jate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya.

Agar tumhari halat yahi har waqt rehti toh phir farishtay tum se musafaha karte aur tumhari mulaqat ko tumhare ghar par aate, suno agar tum gunah na karo toh Allah tumhein yahan se hata de aur dusri qoum ko le aaye jo gunah kare phir bakhshish mange aur Allah unhein bakhshe. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh farmate ke jannat ki bunyadein kis tarah ustawar hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek eent sone ki toh ek chandi ki hai, is ka gara mushk-e-khalis hai, is ke kankar lulu aur yaqoot hain, is ki mitti zafran hai, jannatiyon ki ne'matein kabhi khatam na hongi, un ki zindagi hamesha ki hogi, un ke kapray purane nahin honge, jawani kabhi nahin dhale gi aur teen ashkhas ki dua kabhi rad nahin hoti: adil badshah ki dua, iftari ke waqt rozay-dar ki dua aur mazloom ki dua badalon se uthayi jati hai aur is ke liye aasmanon ke darwazay khol diye jate hain aur Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai mujhe meri izzat ki qasam main teri zaroor madad karunga agarche kuch waqt ke baad ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs koi gunah kare phir wuzu kar ke do rakat namaz ada kare aur apne gunah ki maafi chahe toh ae Allah Azzawajal us ke gunah maaf farma deta hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim mein riwayat Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se jo shakhs kamil wuzu kar ke dua (Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluhu) parhay us ke liye jannat ke aathon darwazay khul jate hain jis se chahe andar chala jaye. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) sunnat ke mutabiq wuzu karte hain phir farmate hain main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh jaisa wuzu kare phir do rakat namaz ada kare jis mein apne dil se baatein na kare toh Allah Ta'ala us ke tamam gunah maaf farma deta hai (Bukhari, Muslim). Pas yeh hadith ko Hazrat Usman (R.A) se, is se agli riwayat Hazrat Umar (R.A) se aur is se agli riwayat Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se aur is se teesri riwayat ko Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se Hazrat Ali (R.A) riwayat karte hain toh Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ki wasee maghfirat aur us ki be-inteha meherbani ki khabar Sayyid-ul-Awwaleen wal-Akhireen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani aap ke charon bar-haq khulafa ki ma'rifat hamein pahunchi. Aao is mauqa par hum gunahgar bhi haath uthayen aur apne meharban Raheem-o-Kareem Allah ke samne apne gunahon ka iqrar kar ke us se maafi talab karein. Allah Ta'ala ae maa baap se zyada meharban! Ae afw-o-darguzar karne wale! Aur kisi bhikari ko apne dar se khali na pherne wale! Tu hum khata-karon ki siyah-kariyon se bhi darguzar farma aur hamare kul gunah maaf farma de.

(Mutarjim) Yehi woh mubarak aayat hai ke jab yeh nazil hui toh Iblees rone laga (Musnad Abdur Razzaq). Istighfar aur La Ilaha Illallah: Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain La Ilaha Illallah kasrat se parha karo aur istighfar par mudawamat karo. Iblees gunahon se logon ko halak karna chahta hai aur uski apni halakat La Ilaha Illallah aur istighfar se hai, yeh hadith dekh kar Iblees ne logon ko khwahish parasti par daal diya pas woh apne aap ko rah-e-rast par jante hain halankeh halakat mein hote hain lekin is hadith ke do rawi za'eef hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Iblees ne kaha ae Rab mujhe teri izzat ki qasam main Bani Adam ko unke aakhri dam tak behkata rahoonga, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya mujhe mere jalal aur meri izzat ki qasam jab tak woh mujhse bakhshish mangte rahenge main bhi unhein bakhshta rahoonga. Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhse gunah ho gaya aap ne farmaya phir istighfar kar, usne kaha mujhse aur gunah hua farmaya istighfar kiye ja, yahan tak ke Shaitan thak jaye phir farmaya gunah ko bakhshna Allah hi ke ikhtiyar mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas ek qaidi aaya aur kehne laga ya Allah main teri taraf tauba karta hoon Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf tauba nahin karta (ya'ni Allah main teri hi bakhshish chahta hoon) aap ne farmaya isne haq haqdar ko pahunchaya. Israr karne se murad yeh hai ke ma'asiyat par baghair tauba kiye ar nahin jate agar kayi martaba gunah ho jaye toh kayi martaba istighfar karte hain, Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain woh israr karne wala aur arne wala nahin jo istighfar karta rehta hai agarche (bilfarz) us se ek din mein sattar martaba bhi gunah ho jaye. Phir farmaya ke woh jante hon ya'ni is baat ko ke Allah tauba qabool karne wala hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Alam ya'lamu annallaha huwal yaqbalut taubata an ibadihi wa ya'khuzus sadaqati wa annallaha huwat tawwabur raheem) (Surah At-Taubah: 104) kya yeh nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai aur jagah hai aayat (Wa man ya'mal su'an au yazlim nafsahu summa yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha ghafooran raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) jo shakhs koi bura kaam kare ya gunah kar ke apni jaan par zulm kare phir Allah Ta'ala se bakhshish talab kare toh woh dekh lega ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal bakhshish karne wala meharban hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimbar par bayan farmaya logo tum auron par raham karo Allah tum par raham karega, logo tum dusron ki khatayen maaf karo Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunahon ko bakhshega, baatein banane walon ki halakat hai, gunah par jam jane walon ki halakat hai. Phir farmaya in kamon ke badle unki jaza maghfirat hai aur tarah tarah ki behti nehron wali jannat hai jis mein woh hamesha rahenge, yeh bare achhe a'maal hain.

Logon ne kaha yeh Hazrat Mu'awiyah hain (R.A). Hazrat Umar (R.A) se bhi yahi sawal hua tha to aap ne farmaya tha ke din ke waqt raat aur raat ke waqt din kahan jata hai? Yahoodi yeh jawab sun kar khasiyane ho kar kehne lage ke yeh Torah se ma'akhuz kiya hoga, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se bhi yeh jawab marwi hai, ek marfoo hadith mein hai kisi ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha to aap ne jawab mein farmaya jab har cheez par raat aa jati hai to din kahan jata hai?

Us ne kaha jahan Allah chahe, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya isi tarah Jahannam bhi jahan chahe (Bazzar). Is jumla ke do ma'ani hote hain, ek toh yeh ke raat ke waqt hum go din ko nahin dekh sakte lekin taham din ka kisi jagah hona namumkin nahin, isi tarah go Jannat ka arz itna hi hai lekin phir bhi Jahannam ke wajood se inkar nahin ho sakta jahan Allah chahe woh bhi hai, dusre ma'ani yeh ke jab din ek taraf charhne laga raat dusri janib hoti hai isi tarah Jannat A'ala Illiyeen mein hai aur Dozakh Asfal-us-Safileen mein toh koi nafi ka imkan hi na raha, Wallahu A'alam. Phir Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Jannat ka wasf bayan farmata hai ke woh sakhti mein aur aasani mein, khushi mein aur ghami mein, tandurusti mein aur bimari mein, garz har haal mein rah-e-Allah apna maal kharch karte rehte hain jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Allazeena yunfiquna amwalahum bil-laili wan-nahari sirran wa 'alaniyatan falahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wala khaufun 'alaihim wala hum yahzanun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 274) yani woh log din raat chhupe khule kharch karte rehte hain, koi amr unhein Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at se baaz nahin rakh sakta, us ki makhlooq par us ke hukm se ehsan karte rehte hain. Yeh gusse ko pee jaane wale aur logon ki buraiyon se darguzar karne wale hain. (Kazm) ke ma'ani chhupane ke bhi hain yani apne gusse ka izhar bhi nahin karte. Ba'az riwayaton mein hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Agar gusse ke waqt tujhe yaad rakhunga yani halakat ke waqt tujhe halakat se bacha lunga (Ibn Abi Hatim). Aur hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Jo shakhs apna gussa rok le Allah Ta'ala us par se apne azab hata leta hai aur jo bhi apni zaban (khilaf-e-shar'a baton se) rok le Allah Ta'ala us ki parda poshi karega aur jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki taraf ma'azrat le jaye Allah Ta'ala us ka uzr qabool farmata hai (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur is ki sanad mein bhi ikhtilaf hai. Aur hadith-e-shareef mein hai, Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain: Pehlwan woh nahin jo kisi ko pachhar de balkeh haqiqatan pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne nafs par qabu rakhe (Ahmad). Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Tum mein se koi aisa hai jise apne waris ka maal apne maal se zyada mehboob ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) koi nahin. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Main toh dekhta hoon ke tum apne maal se zyada apne waris ka maal chahte ho, is liye ke tumhara maal toh darhaqiqat woh hai jo tum rah-e-Allah apni zindagi mein kharch kar do aur jo chhor kar jao woh tumhara maal nahin balkeh tumhare warison ka maal hai, toh tumhara rah-e-Allah kam kharch karna aur jama zyada karna yeh daleel hai is amr ki ke tum apne maal se apne warison ke maal ko zyada aziz rakhte ho. Phir farmaya: Tum pehlwan kise jaante ho? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) use jise koi gira na sake. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Nahin balkeh haqiqatan zor-dar pehlwan woh hai jo gusse ke waqt apne jazbat par pura qabu rakhe. Phir farmaya: Be-aulad kise kehte ho?

Logon ne kaha jis ki aulad na ho, farmaya nahin balkeh fi-al-waqai be-aulad woh hai jis ke samne us ki koi aulad mari na ho (Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya ke jante ho muflis kangal kaun hai? Logon ne kaha jis ke paas maal na ho, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya balkeh woh jis ne apna maal apni zindagi mein rah-e-Allah na diya ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Haritha bin Qudama Sa'adi (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi mein arz karte hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe koi nafa ki baat kahiye jo mukhtasar ho taake main yaad bhi rakh sakoon, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, us ne phir poocha, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir yahi jawab diya, kai kai martaba yahi kaha (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Kisi shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhe kuch wasiyat kijiye, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ghussa na kar, woh kehte hain main ne jo gaur kiya to maloom hua ke tamam buraiyon ka markaz ghussa hi hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko ghussa aaya to Aap (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) baith gaye aur phir lait gaye, un se poocha gaya yeh kya?

Toh farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap farmate thay jisay gussa aaye woh khara ho toh baith jaye agar us se bhi gussa na jaye toh lait jaye (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aik aur riwayat mein hai ke Urwah bin Muhammad ko gussa charha aap wuzu karne baith gaye aur farmane lage main ne apne ustadon se yeh hadith suni hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke gussa shaitan ki taraf se hai aur shaitan aag se paida hua hai aur aag bujhane wali cheez pani hai pas tum gussa ke waqt wuzu karne baith jao. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh irshad hai ke jo shakhs kisi tang dast ko mohlat de ya apna qarz usay maaf kar de Allah Ta'ala usay jahannam se azaad kar deta hai. Logo suno jannat ke aamal sakht aur mushkil hain aur jahannam ke kaam aasaan aur sahal hain. Nek bakht wohi hai jo fitnon se bach jaye. Kisi ghont ka peena Allah ko aisa pasand nahin jitna gussa ke ghont ka pee jana, aisay shakhs ke dil mein imaan rach jata hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs apna gussa utaarne ki taqat rakhte hue phir bhi zabt kar le Allah Ta'ala us ka dil aman-o-aman se pur kar deta hai. Jo shakhs bawajood majood hone ke shohrat ke kapray ko tawazo ki wajah se chor de usay Allah Ta'ala karamat aur izzat ka hulla qayamat ke din pehnaye ga aur jo kisi ka sar chupaye Allah Ta'ala usay qayamat ke din badshahat ka taaj pehnaye ga (Abu Dawood). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs bawajood qudrat ke apna gussa zabt kar le usay Allah Ta'ala tamam makhlooq ke samne bula kar ikhtiyar de ga ke jis hoor ko chahe pasand kar le (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Is mazmoon ki aur bhi hadeesain hain, pas aayat ka matlab yeh hua ke woh apne gussa mein aape se bahar nahin hote logon ko un ki taraf se burai nahin pohanchti balkay apne jazbaat ko dabaye rakhte hain aur Allah se dar kar sawab ki umeed par mamla supurd-e-Allah karte hain, logon se darguzar karte hain zalimon ke zulm ka badla abhi nahin lete isi ko ehsan kehte hain aur in mohsin bandon se Allah mohabbat rakhta hai. Hadith mein hai Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain teen baton par main qasam khata hoon: aik toh yeh ke sadqa se maal nahin ghat-ta, dusre yeh ke afw-o-darguzar karne se insaan ki izzat barhti hai, teesre yeh ke tawazo, farotni aur aajizi karne wale ko Allah Ta'ala buland martaba ata karta hai. Mustadrak ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahe ke us ki bunyad buland ho aur us ke darjay barhein toh usay zalimon se darguzar karna chahiye aur na dene walon ko dena chahiye aur torne walon se jorna chahiye aur hadith mein hai qayamat ke din aik pukare ga ke ae logo darguzar karne walo apne Rabb ke paas aao aur apna ajr lo. Musalmanon ki khataon ke maaf karne wale jannati log hain. Phir farmaya yeh log gunah ke baad foran zikr-e-Allah aur istighfar karte hain.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh riwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Jab koi shakhs gunah karta hai, phir Allah Rahman-o-Raheem ke samne hazir ho kar kehta hai ke Parwardigar! mujh se gunah ho gaya, toh maaf farma. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Mere bande se go gunah ho gaya lekin is ka iman hai ke is ka Rabb gunah par pakar bhi karta hai aur agar chahe toh maaf bhi farma deta hai, main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho toh farma deta hai: Main ne apne bande ka gunah maaf farmaya. Is se phir gunah ho jata hai, yeh phir tauba karta hai, Allah Ta'ala phir bakhshta hai. Chauthi martaba phir gunah kar baithta hai, phir tauba karta hai toh Allah Ta'ala maaf farma kar kehta hai: Ab mera banda jo chahe kare (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) farmate hain: Hum ne ek martaba Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Jab hum aap ko dekhte hain toh hamare dilon mein riqqat tari ho jati hai aur hum Allah wale ban jate hain, lekin jab aap ke paas se chale jate hain toh woh halat nahin rehti, aurton bachon mein phans jate hain, ghar baar ke dhandon mein lag jate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya.

Agar tumhari halat yahi har waqt rehti toh phir farishtay tum se musafaha karte aur tumhari mulaqat ko tumhare ghar par aate, suno agar tum gunah na karo toh Allah tumhein yahan se hata de aur dusri qoum ko le aaye jo gunah kare phir bakhshish mange aur Allah unhein bakhshe. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh farmate ke jannat ki bunyadein kis tarah ustawar hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek eent sone ki toh ek chandi ki hai, is ka gara mushk-e-khalis hai, is ke kankar lulu aur yaqoot hain, is ki mitti zafran hai, jannatiyon ki ne'matein kabhi khatam na hongi, un ki zindagi hamesha ki hogi, un ke kapray purane nahin honge, jawani kabhi nahin dhale gi aur teen ashkhas ki dua kabhi rad nahin hoti: adil badshah ki dua, iftari ke waqt rozay-dar ki dua aur mazloom ki dua badalon se uthayi jati hai aur is ke liye aasmanon ke darwazay khol diye jate hain aur Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai mujhe meri izzat ki qasam main teri zaroor madad karunga agarche kuch waqt ke baad ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) farmate hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs koi gunah kare phir wuzu kar ke do rakat namaz ada kare aur apne gunah ki maafi chahe toh ae Allah Azzawajal us ke gunah maaf farma deta hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim mein riwayat Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se marwi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tum mein se jo shakhs kamil wuzu kar ke dua (Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluhu) parhay us ke liye jannat ke aathon darwazay khul jate hain jis se chahe andar chala jaye. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) sunnat ke mutabiq wuzu karte hain phir farmate hain main ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs mujh jaisa wuzu kare phir do rakat namaz ada kare jis mein apne dil se baatein na kare toh Allah Ta'ala us ke tamam gunah maaf farma deta hai (Bukhari, Muslim). Pas yeh hadith ko Hazrat Usman (R.A) se, is se agli riwayat Hazrat Umar (R.A) se aur is se agli riwayat Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se aur is se teesri riwayat ko Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) se Hazrat Ali (R.A) riwayat karte hain toh Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ki wasee maghfirat aur us ki be-inteha meherbani ki khabar Sayyid-ul-Awwaleen wal-Akhireen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani aap ke charon bar-haq khulafa ki ma'rifat hamein pahunchi. Aao is mauqa par hum gunahgar bhi haath uthayen aur apne meharban Raheem-o-Kareem Allah ke samne apne gunahon ka iqrar kar ke us se maafi talab karein. Allah Ta'ala ae maa baap se zyada meharban! Ae afw-o-darguzar karne wale! Aur kisi bhikari ko apne dar se khali na pherne wale! Tu hum khata-karon ki siyah-kariyon se bhi darguzar farma aur hamare kul gunah maaf farma de.

(Mutarjim) Yehi woh mubarak aayat hai ke jab yeh nazil hui toh Iblees rone laga (Musnad Abdur Razzaq). Istighfar aur La Ilaha Illallah: Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain La Ilaha Illallah kasrat se parha karo aur istighfar par mudawamat karo. Iblees gunahon se logon ko halak karna chahta hai aur uski apni halakat La Ilaha Illallah aur istighfar se hai, yeh hadith dekh kar Iblees ne logon ko khwahish parasti par daal diya pas woh apne aap ko rah-e-rast par jante hain halankeh halakat mein hote hain lekin is hadith ke do rawi za'eef hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Iblees ne kaha ae Rab mujhe teri izzat ki qasam main Bani Adam ko unke aakhri dam tak behkata rahoonga, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya mujhe mere jalal aur meri izzat ki qasam jab tak woh mujhse bakhshish mangte rahenge main bhi unhein bakhshta rahoonga. Musnad Bazzar mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha mujhse gunah ho gaya aap ne farmaya phir istighfar kar, usne kaha mujhse aur gunah hua farmaya istighfar kiye ja, yahan tak ke Shaitan thak jaye phir farmaya gunah ko bakhshna Allah hi ke ikhtiyar mein hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas ek qaidi aaya aur kehne laga ya Allah main teri taraf tauba karta hoon Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf tauba nahin karta (ya'ni Allah main teri hi bakhshish chahta hoon) aap ne farmaya isne haq haqdar ko pahunchaya. Israr karne se murad yeh hai ke ma'asiyat par baghair tauba kiye ar nahin jate agar kayi martaba gunah ho jaye toh kayi martaba istighfar karte hain, Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain woh israr karne wala aur arne wala nahin jo istighfar karta rehta hai agarche (bilfarz) us se ek din mein sattar martaba bhi gunah ho jaye. Phir farmaya ke woh jante hon ya'ni is baat ko ke Allah tauba qabool karne wala hai jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Alam ya'lamu annallaha huwal yaqbalut taubata an ibadihi wa ya'khuzus sadaqati wa annallaha huwat tawwabur raheem) (Surah At-Taubah: 104) kya yeh nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai aur jagah hai aayat (Wa man ya'mal su'an au yazlim nafsahu summa yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha ghafooran raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110) jo shakhs koi bura kaam kare ya gunah kar ke apni jaan par zulm kare phir Allah Ta'ala se bakhshish talab kare toh woh dekh lega ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal bakhshish karne wala meharban hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimbar par bayan farmaya logo tum auron par raham karo Allah tum par raham karega, logo tum dusron ki khatayen maaf karo Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunahon ko bakhshega, baatein banane walon ki halakat hai, gunah par jam jane walon ki halakat hai. Phir farmaya in kamon ke badle unki jaza maghfirat hai aur tarah tarah ki behti nehron wali jannat hai jis mein woh hamesha rahenge, yeh bare achhe a'maal hain.

Shahadat aur Basharat: Chunke Uhud wale din sattar musalman sahabi shaheed hue thay to Allah Ta'ala musalmanon ko dhars deta hai ke is se pehle bhi deendar log maal-o-jaan ka nuqsan uthate rahe lekin bil-akhir ghalba unhi ka hua tum agle waqiyat par ek nigah daal lo to yeh raaz tum par khul jayega. Is Quran mein logon ke liye agli ummaton ka bayan bhi hai aur yeh hidayat-o-wa'z bhi hai. Ya'ni tumhare dilon ki hidayat aur tumhein burai bhulai se aagah karne wala yahi Quran hai, musalmanon ko yeh waqiyat yaad dila kar phir mazeed tasalli ke taur par farmaya ke tum is jang ke nataij dekh kar bad-dil na ho jana na maghmoom ban kar baith rehna fath-o-nusrat ghalba aur buland-o-bala maqam bil-akhir momino tumhare liye hi hai. Agar tumhein zakhm lage hain tumhare aadmi shaheed hue to is se pehle tumhare dushman bhi to qatl ho chuke hain woh bhi to zakhm khorda hain yeh to chadhti dhalti chhaon hai haan bhala woh hai jo anjam-e-kaar ghalib rahe aur yeh hum ne tumhare liye likh diya hai. Yeh ba'az martaba shikast bil-khusoos is jang-e-Uhud ki is liye thi ke hum sabiron ka aur ghair-sabiron ka imtehan kar lein aur jo muddat se shahadat ki aarzoo rakhte thay unhein kamyab banayein ke woh apna jaan-o-maal hamari raah mein kharch karein, Allah Ta'ala zalimon ko pasand nahin karta. Yeh jumla-e-mo'tariza bayan kar ke farmaya yeh is liye bhi ke iman walon ke gunah agar hon to door ho jayein aur un ke darajat badhein aur is mein kafiron ka mitana bhi hai kyunke woh ghalib ho kar utar aayenge sarkashi aur takabbur mein aur badhenge aur yahi un ki halakat aur barbadi ka sabab banega aur phir mar khap jayenge in sakhtiyon aur zalzalon aur in aazmaishon ke baghair koi jannat mein nahin ja sakta jaise Surah Al-Baqarah mein hai ke kya tum jante ho ke tum se pehle logon ki jaisi aazmaish hui aisi tumhari na ho aur tum jannat mein chale jao yeh nahin hoga aur jagah hai aayat (اَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ اَنْ يُّتْرَكُوْٓا اَنْ يَّقُوْلُوْٓا اٰمَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُوْنَ) (Al-Ankabut: 2) kya logon ne yeh guman kar rakha hai ke hum sirf un ke is qaul par ke hum iman laye unhein chhod denge aur unki aazmaish na ki jayegi?

Yahan bhi yahi farman hai ke jab tak sabr karne wale maloom na ho jayen yani duniya mein hi zuhoor mein na aa jayen tab tak jannat nahin mil sakti. Phir farmaya ke tum is se pehle to aise mauqa ki aarzoo mein the ke tum apna sabr, apni bahaduri aur mazbooti aur istiqamat Allah Ta'ala ko dikhao, Allah ki raah mein shahadat pao, lo ab hum ne tumhein yeh mauqa diya tum bhi apni sabit qadmi aur ulu-ul-azmi dikhao. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai dushman ki mulaqat ki aarzoo na karo, Allah Ta'ala se aafiyat talab karo aur jab maidan parh jaye phir lohay ki laat ki tarah jam jao aur sabr ke sath sabit qadam raho aur jaan lo ke jannat talwaron ke saye talay hai. Phir farmaya ke tum ne apni aankhon se is manzar ko dekh liya ke neze tanay hue hain, talwarein khinch rahi hain, bhalay uchal rahe hain, teer baras rahe hain, ghamsan ka ran parha hua hai aur idhar udhar lashein gir rahi hain.

Shahadat aur Basharat: Chunke Uhud wale din sattar musalman sahabi shaheed hue thay to Allah Ta'ala musalmanon ko dhars deta hai ke is se pehle bhi deendar log maal-o-jaan ka nuqsan uthate rahe lekin bil-akhir ghalba unhi ka hua tum agle waqiyat par ek nigah daal lo to yeh raaz tum par khul jayega. Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki wafat ka mughalta aur Ghazwa-e-Uhud. Maidan-e-Uhud mein Musalmanon ko shikast bhi hui aur un ke ba'az qatl bhi kiye gaye. Us din Shaitan ne yeh bhi mashhoor kar diya ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi shaheed ho gaye aur Ibn-e-Qami'ah kafir ne mushrikon mein ja kar yeh khabar ura di ke main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl kar ke aaya hoon aur dar-asal woh afwah be-asl thi aur us shakhs ka yeh qaul bhi ghalat tha. Us ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par hamla toh kiya tha lekin us se sirf Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka chehra qadray zakhmi ho gaya tha aur koi baat na thi. Is ghalat baat ki shohrat ne Musalmanon ke dilon ko chhota kar diya, un ke qadam ukhad gaye aur larai se bad-dil ho kar bhaag kharay hue. Isi baare mein yeh aayat nazil hui ke aglay ambiya ki tarah yeh bhi ek Nabi hain, ho sakta hai ke maidan mein qatl kar diye jayen lekin kuch Allah ka deen nahin jata rahe ga. Ek riwayat mein hai ke ek Muhajir ne dekha ke ek Ansari jang-e-Uhud mein zakhmon se choor zameen par gira para hai aur khaak-o-khoon mein loot raha hai. Us se kaha ke aap ko bhi maloom hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) qatl kar diye gaye? Us ne kaha agar yeh sahi hai toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh apna kaam kar gaye, ab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke deen par se tum sab bhi qurban ho jao. Isi ke baare mein yeh aayat utri. Phir farmaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka qatl ya inteqal aisi cheez nahin ke tum Allah Ta'ala ke deen se pichlay paon palat jao aur aisa karne wale Allah ka kuch na bigarenge. Allah Ta'ala inhi logon ko jazaye khair de ga jo us ki ita'at par jam jayen aur us ke deen ki madad mein lag jayen aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabe'dari mein mazboot ho jayen khwah Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) zinda hon ya na hon. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke inteqal ki khabar sun kar Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) jaldi se ghoray par sawar ho kar aaye, masjid mein tashreef le gaye, logon ki halat dekhi bhali aur baghair kuch kahay sunay Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke ghar par aaye. Yahan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par hibra ki chadar orha di gayi thi. Aap ne chadar ka kona chehra-e-mubarak par se hata kar be-sakhta bosa le liya aur rotay hue farmanay lage, mere maa baap aap par fida hon, Allah ki qasam Allah Ta'ala aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par do martaba maut na laye ga, jo maut aap par likh di gayi thi woh aap ko aa chuki. Is ke baad aap phir masjid mein aaye aur dekha ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) khutba suna rahe hain, un se farmaya ke khamosh ho jao. Unhein chup kara kar aap ne logon se farmaya ke jo shakhs Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ibadat karta tha woh jaan le ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mar gaye aur jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karta tha woh khush rahe ke Allah Ta'ala zinda hai us par maut nahin aati.

Phir aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi logon ko aisa maloom hone laga goya yeh aayat ab utri hai phir toh har shakhs ki zaban par yeh aayat charh gayi aur logon ne yaqeen kar liya ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) faut ho gaye. Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ki zabani is aayat ki tilawat sun kar Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke toh goya qadmon talle se zameen nikal gayi, unhein bhi yaqeen ho gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is jahan-e-fani ko chor kar chal base. Hazrat Ali (R.A) Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zindagi hi mein farmate thay ke na hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maut par murtad hon na aap ki shahadat par, Allah ki qasam agar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) qatl kiye jayen toh hum bhi us deen par mar miten jis par aap shaheed huye, Allah ki qasam main aap ka bhai hoon, aap ka wali hoon, aap ka chacha zaad bhai hoon aur aap ka waris hoon, mujh se zyada haqdar aap ka aur kaun hoga. Phir irshad hota hai ke har shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke hukum se aur apni muddat poori kar ke hi marta hai, jaise aur jagah hai: "Wa ma yu'ammaru min mu'ammariw wa la yunqasu min 'umurihi illa fi kitab" (na koi umar diya jata hai na umar ghatayi jati hai magar sab Kitabullah mein majood hai). Aur jagah hai: (Huwal lazi khalaqakum min teenin summa qada ajala) (Surah Al-An'am: 2) "Jis Allah ne tumhein mitti se paida kiya phir waqt poora kiya aur ajal muqarrar ki". Is aayat mein buzdil logon ko shuja'at ki raghbat dilayi gayi hai aur Allah ki rah ke jihad ka shauq dilaya ja raha hai aur bataya ja raha hai ke jo mardangi ki wajah se kuch umar ghat nahin jati aur peeche hatne ki wajah se umar barh nahin jati. Maut toh apne waqt par aa kar hi rahegi khwah shuja'at aur bahaduri barto khwah namardi aur buzdili dikhao. Hujr bin Adi (R.A) jab dushmanan-e-deen ke muqable mein jate hain aur darya-e-Dajla beech mein aa jata hai aur lashkar-e-Islam thithak kar khara ho jata hai toh aap is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmate hain ke koi bhi be-ajal nahin marta, aao isi Dajla mein ghore daal do, yeh farma kar aap apna ghora darya mein daal dete hain, aap ki dekha dekhi aur log bhi apne ghoron ko pani mein daal dete hain. Dushman ka khoon khushk ho jata hai aur us par haibat tari ho jati hai. Woh kehne lagte hain ke yeh toh deewane aadmi hain, yeh toh pani ki maujon se bhi nahin darte, bhago bhago, chunancha sab ke sab bhaag khare huye.

Phir irshad hota hai ke jis ka amal sirf duniya ke liye ho to us mein se jitna us ke muqaddar mein hota hai mil jata hai lekin aakhirat mein woh khaali haath reh jata hai aur jis ka maqsad aakhirat talbi ho use aakhirat to milti hi hai lekin duniya mein bhi apne muqaddar ka pa leta hai jaise aur jagah farmaya: Man kana yureedu harsal aakhirati (Surah Ash-Shura: 20), aakhirat ki kheti ke chahne wale ko hum ziyadati ke saath dete hain aur duniya ki kheti ke chahne wale ko hum go duniya de dein lekin aakhirat mein us ka koi hissa nahin. Aur jagah hai: Man kana yureedul aajilata (Surah Bani Israel: 18), jo shakhs sirf duniya talab hi ho hum un mein se jise chahein jis qadar chahein duniya de dete hain phir woh jahannami ban jata hai aur zillat-o-ruswai ke saath mein jata hai aur jo aakhirat ka khwahan ho aur koshan bhi ho aur ba-imaan bhi ho un ki koshish Allah Ta'ala ke haan mashkoor hai. Isi liye yahan bhi farmaya ke hum shukr-guzaron ko achha badla de dete hain. Phir Allah Ta'ala Uhud ke mujahideen ko khitab karta hua farmata hai ke is se pehle bhi bahut se Nabi apni jamaton ko saath le kar dushmanan-e-deen se lade bhide aur woh tumhari tarah Allah ki raah mein takleefen bhi pahunchaye gaye lekin phir bhi mazboot dil aur sabir-o-shakir rahe, na sust hue na himmat haari aur is sabr ke badle unhon ne Allah Kareem ki mohabbat mol le li. Ek yeh ma'ani bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke ae mujahideen-e-Uhud! Tum yeh sun kar ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shaheed hue kyun himmat haar baithe? Aur kufr ke muqable mein kyun dab gaye? Halankeh tum se agle log apne ambiya ki shahadat ko dekh kar bhi na dabe na peeche hate balkeh aur tezi ke saath lade, yeh itni badi museebat bhi un ke qadam na dagmaga saki aur un ke dil chhote na kar saki, phir tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ki khabar sun kar itne baude kyun ho gaye? Ribbiyoon ke bahut se ma'ani aate hain maslan ulama-e-abrar, muttaqi, aabid, zahid, tabe-e-farman waghera waghera. Pas Quran-e-Kareem un ki is museebat ke waqt dua ko naqal karta hai phir farmata hai ke unhein duniya ka sawab nusrat-o-madad, zafar-o-iqbal mila aur aakhirat ki bhalai aur achhai bhi isi ke saath jama hui, yeh mohsin log Allah ke chehite bande hain.
