Halankeh tum se agle log apne ambiya ki shahadat ko dekh kar bhi na dabe na peeche hate balkeh aur tezi ke saath lade, yeh itni badi museebat bhi un ke qadam na dagmaga saki aur un ke dil chhote na kar saki, phir tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shahadat ki khabar sun kar itne baude kyun ho gaye? Ribbiyoon ke bahut se ma'ani aate hain maslan ulama-e-abrar, muttaqi, aabid, zahid, tabe-e-farman waghera waghera. Pas Quran-e-Kareem un ki is museebat ke waqt dua ko naqal karta hai phir farmata hai ke unhein duniya ka sawab nusrat-o-madad, zafar-o-iqbal mila aur aakhirat ki bhalai aur achhai bhi isi ke saath jama hui, yeh mohsin log Allah ke chehite bande hain.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki wafat ka mughalta aur Ghazwa-e-Uhud. Maidan-e-Uhud mein Musalmanon ko shikast bhi hui aur un ke ba'az qatl bhi kiye gaye. Is ghalat baat ki shohrat ne Musalmanon ke dilon ko chhota kar diya, un ke qadam ukhad gaye aur larai se bad-dil ho kar bhaag kharay hue. Us ne kaha agar yeh sahi hai toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh apna kaam kar gaye, ab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke deen par se tum sab bhi qurban ho jao. Isi ke baare mein yeh aayat utri. Phir farmaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka qatl ya inteqal aisi cheez nahin ke tum Allah Ta'ala ke deen se pichlay paon palat jao aur aisa karne wale Allah ka kuch na bigarenge. Yahan Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par hibra ki chadar orha di gayi thi. Kafir aur munafiqon ke irade aur Ghazwa-e-Uhud ka phir andohnaak tazkira. Allah Ta'ala apne imandar bandon ko kafiron aur munafiqon ki baton ke manne se rok raha hai aur bata raha hai ke agar in ki mani to duniya aur aakhirat ki zillat tum par aayegi. Unki chahat to yahi hai ke tumhein Deen-e-Islam se hata dein. Phir farmata hai mujh hi ko apna wali aur madadgar jaano, mujh hi se dosti karo, mujh hi par bharosa karo, mujh hi se madad chaho. Phir farmaya ke in shareeron ke dilon mein un ke kufr ke sabab dar-o-khauf daal doonga. Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: Mujhe paanch baatein di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle kisi Nabi ko nahin di gayin; meri madad mahina bhar ki raah tak ra'ab se ki gayi hai, mere liye zameen masjid aur us ki mitti wuzu ki paak cheez banayi gayi, mere liye ghanimat ke maal halal kiye gaye aur mujhe shafa'at di gayi aur har Nabi apni apni qoum ki taraf se makhsoos bheja jata tha aur meri ba'asat meri nabuwwat tamam duniya ke liye aam hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai aap farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne tamam nabiyon par aur ba'az riwayaton mein hai tamam ummaton par mujhe chaar fazilatein ata farmayi hain: Mujhe tamam duniya ki taraf Rasool bana kar bheja gaya, mere aur meri ummat ke liye tamam zameen masjid aur paak banayi gayi, mere ummati ko jahan namaz ka waqt aa jaye wahin us ki masjid aur us ka wuzu hai, mera dushman mujh se mahina bhar ki raah par ho wahin se Allah Ta'ala us ka dil ra'ab se pur kar deta hai aur woh kanpne lagta hai aur mere liye ghanimat ke maal halal kiye gaye aur riwayat mein hai ke main madad kiya gaya hoon mere ra'ab se har dushman par. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai mujhe paanch cheezein di gayin, main har surkh-o-safaid ki taraf bheja gaya, mere liye tamam zameen wuzu aur masjid banayi gayi, mere liye ghanimaton ke maal halal kiye gaye jo mere pehle kisi ke halal na the aur meri madad mahina bhar ki raah tak ra'ab se ki gayi aur mujhe shafa'at di gayi, tamam ambiya ne shafa'at maang li lekin main ne apni shafa'at ko apni ummat ke logon ke liye jinhon ne Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho bacha rakhi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne Abu Sufyan ke dil mein ra'ab daal diya aur woh ladai se laut gaya. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne apna wa'ada sacha kar dikhaya aur tumhari madad ki, is se bhi yeh istidlal ho sakta hai ke yeh wa'ada Uhud ke din ka tha, teen hazaar dushman ka lashkar tha taham muqable par aate hi un ke qadam ukhad gaye aur musalmanon ko fath hasil hui lekin phir teer-andazon ki nafarmani ki wajah se aur ba'az hazrat ki past-himati ki bina par woh wa'ada jo mashroot tha ruk gaya, pas farmata hai ke tum unhein apne hathon se kaat-te the.

Shuru din mein hi Allah ne tumhein un par ghalib kar diya lekin tum ne phir buzdili dikhayi aur Nabi (ﷺ) ki nafarmani ki, un ki batayi hui jagah se hat gaye aur aapas mein ikhtilaf karne lage halankeh Allah Azzawajal ne tumhein tumhari pasand ki cheez fatah dikha di thi yani musalman saaf taur par ghalib aa gaye thay, maal-e-ghaneemat aankhon ke samne majood tha, kuffar peeth pher kar bhaag kharay huye thay. Tum mein se baaz ne dunya talbi ki aur kuffar ki hazeemat ko dekh kar Nabi (ﷺ) ke farman ka khayal na kar ke maal-e-ghaneemat ki taraf lapkay, go baaz aur nek aakhirat talab bhi thay lekin is nafarmani waghera ki bina par kuffar ki phir ban aayi aur ek martaba tumhari poori aazmaish ho gayi, ghalib ho kar maghloob ho gaye, fatah ke baad shikast ho gayi lekin phir bhi Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare is jurm ko maaf farma diya kyunke woh jaanta hai ke bazahir tum un se tadaad mein aur asbaab mein kam thay. Khata ka maaf hona bhi 'Afa Ankum' mein dakhil hai aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke kuch yunhi si goshmali kar ke kuch buzurgon ki shahadat ke baad us ne apni aazmaish ko utha liya aur baqi walon ko maaf farma diya, Allah Ta'ala ba-imaan logon par fazl-o-karam, lutf-o-raham hi karta hai.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki madad jaisi Uhad mein hui hai kahin nahin hui, isi ke bare mein irshad-e-bari hai ke Allah ne tum se apna wada sacha kar dikhaya lekin phir tumhare kartooton se mamla bar-aks ho gaya. Baaz logon ne dunya talbi kar ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki nafarmani ki yani baaz teer-andazon ne jinhein Huzoor (ﷺ) ne pahar ke darray par khara kiya tha aur farma diya tha ke tum yahan se dushmanon ki nigahbani karo, woh tumhari peeth ki taraf se na aa jayen, agar tum haar dekho bhi apni jagah se na hatna aur agar tum har tarah ghalib aa gaye toh bhi tum ghaneemat jama karne ke liye bhi apni jagah ko na chorna. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ghalib aa gaye toh teer-andazon ne hukm-e-adooli ki aur woh apni jagah ko chor kar musalmanon mein aa milay aur maal-e-ghaneemat jama karna shuru kar diya, safon ka koi khayal na raha, darray ko khali pa kar mushrikon ne bhagna band kiya aur gaur-o-fikr kar ke us jagah hamla kar diya. Chand musalmanon ki peeth ke peeche se un ki be-khabari mein is zor ka hamla kiya ke musalmanon ke qadam na jam sakay aur shuru din ki fatah ab shikast se badal gayi aur yeh mashhoor ho gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) bhi shaheed ho gaye aur larayi ke rang ne musalmanon ko is baat ka yaqeen bhi dila diya. Thori der baad jabkeh musalmanon ki nazrein chehra-e-mubarak par parin toh woh apni sab kuft aur sari museebat bhool gaye aur khushi ke maaray Huzoor (ﷺ) ki taraf lapkay, aap idhar aa rahe thay aur farmate thay ke Allah Ta'ala ka sakht ghazab nazil ho un logon par jinhon ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke chehre ko khoon-aalooda kar diya, unhein koi haq na tha ke is tarah hum par ghalib reh jayen. Thori der mein hum ne suna ke Abu Sufyan pahar ke neeche khara hua keh raha tha 'A'al Hubal, A'al Hubal' (Hubal but ka bol bala ho), Abu Bakr kahan hai? Umar kahan hai? Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ) ise jawab doon?

Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ijazat di toh Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne uske jawab mein farmaya: Allahu A'la wa Ajal, Allahu A'la wa Ajal, Allah bahut buland hai aur jalal-o-izzat wala hai, Allah bahut buland aur jalal-o-izzat wala hai. Woh poochne laga batao Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kahan hain? Abu Bakr (R.A) kahan hain? Umar (R.A) kahan hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Yeh hain Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur yeh hain Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) aur yeh hoon main Umar Farooq (R.A). Abu Sufyan kehne laga: Yeh Badr ka badla hai, yunhi dhoop chhaon ulti palti rehti hai, ladai ki misal kunwein ke dol ki si hai. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya: Barabari ka mamla hargiz nahin, tumhare maqtool toh jahannam mein gaye aur hamare shaheed jannat mein pahunche. Abu Sufyan kehne laga: Agar yunhi ho toh yaqeenan hum nuqsan aur ghate mein rahe. Suno! Tumhare maqtoolin mein ba'az naak kaan kate log bhi tum paoge, goya hamare sardaron ki raye se nahin hua lekin hamain kuch bura bhi nahin maloom hua. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur yeh qissa bhi ajeeb hai, yeh Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki mursalat se hai aur woh ya unke walid jang-e-Uhud mein majood na the. Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim aur Baihaqi fi Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein bhi yeh marwi hai aur sahih ahadith mein iske ba'az hisson ke shawahid bhi hain ki Uhud wale din auratein musalmanon ke peeche thin jo zakhmiyon ki dekh bhaal karti thin, toh poori tarah yaqeen tha ki aaj ke din hum mein koi ek bhi talib-e-dunya nahin, balkeh us waqt agar mujhe is baat par qasam khulwai jati toh kha leta, lekin Quran mein yeh ayat utri (Min-kum man yureedud-dunya) yani tum mein se ba'az talib-e-dunya bhi hain. Jab sahaba se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hukum ke khilaf aap ki nafarmani sarzad hui toh unke qadam ukhad gaye, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath sirf saat Ansari aur do Muhajir baqi reh gaye. Jab mushrikeen ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko gher liya toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmane lage: Allah Ta'ala us shakhs par raham kare jo inhein hataye. Toh ek Ansari uth khade hue aur is jam-e-ghafeer ke muqabil tan-tanha dad-e-shuja'at dene lage yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye. Phir kuffar ne hamla kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi farmaya, ek Ansari tayyar ho gaye aur is be-jigri se lade ke unhein aage na badhne diya lekin bil-akhir yeh bhi shaheed ho gaye, yahan tak ke saaton sahaba Allah ke haan pahunch gaye, Allah un se khush ho. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Muhajireen se farmaya: Afsos! Hum ne apne sathiyon se munsifana mamla na kiya. Ab Abu Sufyan ne haank lagai ki A'al-e-Hubal, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Kaho Allahu A'la wa Ajal. Abu Sufyan ne kaha: (Lanal-Uzza wa la Uzza lakum) hamara Uzza but hai, tumhari koi Uzza nahin. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Kaho Allahu Maulana wal-kafiroona la maula lahum, Allah hamara Maula hai aur kafiron ka koi Maula nahin. Abu Sufyan kehne laga: Aaj ke din Badr ke din ka badla hai, koi din hamara aur koi din tumhara, yeh toh hathon-hath ka sauda hai, ek ke badle ek hai.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hargiz barabari nahin, hamare shuhada zinda hain wahan rizq diye jate hain aur tumhare maqtool jahannam mein azab kiye ja rahe hain. Phir Abu Sufyan bola tumhare maqtool mein tum dekhoge ke baaz ke kaan naak waghera kaat liye gaye hain lekin main ne na yeh kaha na use roka na use main ne pasand kiya na mujhe yeh bhala maloom hua na bura. Ab jo dekha to maloom hua ke Hazrat Hamza (R.A) ka pait chaak kar diya gaya tha aur Hinda ne unka kaleja le kar chabaya tha lekin nigal na saki to ugal diya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya namumkin tha ke us ke pait mein Hamza ka zara sa gosht bhi chala jaye, Allah Ta'ala Hamza ke kisi uzw-e-badan ko jahannam mein le jana nahin chahta. Chunancha Hamza ke janaze ko apne samne rakh kar namaz-e-janaza ada ki, phir ek Ansari ka janaza laya gaya woh Hazrat Hamza ke pehlu mein rakha gaya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir namaz-e-janaza padhi, Ansari ka janaza utha liya gaya lekin Hazrat Hamza ka janaza wahin raha, isi tarah sattar shakhs laye gaye aur Hazrat Hamza ki sattar dafa janaze ki namaz padhi gayi (Musnad). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Bara (R.A) se marwi hai ke Uhud wale din mushrikon se hamari mudbher hui, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne teer-andazon ki ek jamaat ko alag jama diya aur unka sardar Hazrat Abdullah bin Jubair (R.A) ko banaya aur farma diya ke agar tum hamain un par ghalib aaya hua dekho to bhi yahan se na hatna aur woh hum par ghalib aa jayen to bhi tum apni jagah na chhodna. Ladai shuru hote hi Allah ke fazl se mushrikon ke qadam peeche hatne lage yahan tak ke aurtain bhi tehband ooncha kar kar ke pahadon mein idhar daudne lagin. Ab teer-andaz groh ghanimat ghanimat kehta hua neeche utar aaya, un ke ameer ne unhain harchand samjhaya lekin kisi ne un ki na suni, bas ab mushrikeen musalmanon ki peeth ki taraf se aan pade aur sattar buzurg shaheed ho gaye. Abu Sufyan ek teele par chadh kar kehne laga kya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hayat hain? Kya Abu Bakr (R.A) maujood hain? Kya Umar (R.A) zinda hain? Lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman se sahaba khush rahe to woh khushi ke mare uchhal pada aur kehne laga yeh sab hamari talwaron ke ghaat utar gaye agar zinda hote to zaroor jawab dete. Ek Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko taab-e-zabt na rahi, farmane lage, ae Allah ke dushman tu jhoota hai, bihamdillah hum sab maujood hain aur teri tabahi aur barbadi karne wale zinda hain. Phir woh baatein huin jo oopar bayan ho chuki hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jang-e-Uhud mein mushrikon ko hazimat hui aur Iblees ne aawaz lagayi ae Allah ke bando! Apne peeche ki khabar lo, agli jamaatein pichli jamaaton par toot padin. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne dekha ke musalmanon ki talwaren un ke walid Hazrat Yaman (R.A) par baras rahi hain, harchand kehte rahe ke ae Allah ke bando!

Yeh mere baap Yaman hain magar kaun sunta tha woh yunhi shaheed hogaye lekin Hazrat Huzaifa ne kuch na kaha balkay farmaya Allah tumhein maaf kare, Hazrat Huzaifa ki yeh bhalai unke aakhri dam tak un mein rahi, Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai Hazrat Zubair bin Awwam farmate hain main ne khud dekha ke mushrik musalmanon ke awwal hamlay mein hi bhaag kharay hue yahan tak ke un ki auratein Hinda waghera tehmed uthaye tez tez daur rahi thin lekin us ke baad jab teer-andazon ne markaz chora aur kuffar ne simat kar peechay ki taraf se hum par hamla kardiya udhar kisi ne aawaz lagayi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shaheed hogaye phir mamla bar-aks hogaya warna hum mushrikeen ke alam-bardaron tak pahunch chuke thay aur jhanda us ke haath se gir para tha lekin Umrah bin Alqama Harithiya aurat ne usay thaam liya aur Quraish ka majma phir yahan jama hogaya, Hazrat Anas bin Malik ke chacha Hazrat Anas bin Nadr (R.A) yeh rang dekh Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Talha waghera ke paas aate hain aur farmate hain tum ne kyun himmatein chor dein? Woh jawab dete hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh shaheed hogaye. Hazrat Anas ne farmaya phir tum jee kar kya karoge? Yeh kaha aur mushrikeen mein ghusay phir larte rahe yahan tak ke Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat se ja mile (R.A), yeh Badr wale din jihad mein nahin pahunch sake thay toh ahd kiya tha ke aayinda agar koi mauqa aaya toh main dikha dunga chunancha is jang mein woh maujood thay jab musalmanon mein khalbuli machi toh unhon ne kaha Allah main musalmanon ke is kaam se mazoor hoon aur mushrikon ke is kaam se bari hoon phir apni talwar le kar aagay barh gaye raah mein Hazrat Saad bin Muaz se mile aur kehne lage kahan ja rahe ho? Mujhe toh jannat ki khushbu ki liptain Uhud pahar se chali aa rahi hain chunancha mushrikon mein ghus gaye aur bari be-jigri se lare yahan tak ke shahadat hasil ki assi se zyada teer-o-talwar ke zakhm badan par aaye thay pehchanay na jate thay ungli ko dekh kar pehchanay gaye (R.A), Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke ek haaji ne Baitullah Shareef mein ek majlis dekh kar poocha ke yeh kaun log hain? Logon ne kaha Quraishi hain poocha un ke sheikh kaun hain? Jawab mila Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) hain, ab woh aaya aur kehne laga main kuch daryaft karna chahta hoon Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya poocho us ne kaha aap ko is Baitullah ki hurmat ki qasam kya aap ko ilm hai ke (Hazrat) Usman bin Affan Uhud wale din bhaag gaye thay? Aap ne jawab diya haan. Kaha kya aap ko maloom hai ke woh Badr wale din bhi hazir nahin hue thay? Farmaya haan, kaha kya aap jante hain ke woh Bai'at-e-Rizwan mein bhi shareek nahin hue thay?

Farmaya yeh bhi theek hai, ab usne (khush hokar) takbeer kahi, Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya idhar aa, ab main tujhe pooray waqiyat sunaoon, Uhud ke din ka bhagna toh Allah Ta'ala ne maaf farma diya, Badr ke din ki ghair haziri ke baais yeh hua ke aap ke ghar mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sahibzadi thin aur woh us waqt sakht bimar thin toh khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un se farmaya tha ke tum na aao Madina mein hi raho tumhein Allah Ta'ala is jang mein hazir hone ka ajar de ga aur ghanimat mein bhi tumhara hissa hai, Bai'at-e-Rizwan ka waqia yeh hai ke unhein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makka walon ke paas apna paigham de kar Hazrat Usman ko bheja tha is liye ke Makka mein jo izzat unhein hasil thi kisi aur ko utni na thi unke tashreef le jaane ke baad yeh bai'at li gayi toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apna dahina hath khara kar ke kaha yeh Usman ka hath hai phir apne dusre hath par rakha (goya bai'at ki) phir us shakhs se kaha ab jao aur ise sath le jao phir farmaya aayat (Au tas'adoona) al-kh yani tum apne dushman se bhag kar pahar charh rahe thay aur maaray khauf-o-dehshat ke dusri janib tawajjah bhi nahin karte thay Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bhi tum ne wahin chor diya tha woh tumhein aawazein de rahe thay aur samjha rahe thay ke bhago nahin laut aao, Hazrat Suddi farmate hain mushrikeen ke is khufiya aur pur-zor aur achanak hamla se musalmanon ke qadam ukharr gaye kuch toh Madina ki taraf laut aaye kuch pahar ki choti par charh gaye Allah ke Nabi aawazein dete rahe ke Allah ke bando meri taraf aao Allah ke bando meri taraf aao, is waqia ka bayan is aayat mein hai, Abdullah bin Zahri shair ne is waqia ko nazm mein bhi ada kiya hai, An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us waqt sirf barah aadmiyon ke sath reh gaye thay Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek taweel hadith mein bhi in tamam waqiyat ka zikr hai, Dalail-un-Nabuwwat mein hai ke jab hazimat hui tab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath sirf gyarah shakhs reh gaye aur ek Hazrat Talha bin Ubaidullah thay, aap pahar par charhne lage lekin mushrikeen ne aaghera aap ne apne sathiyon ki taraf mutawajjah ho kar farmaya koi hai jo in se muqabla kare, Hazrat Talha ne is aawaz par foran labbaik kaha aur tayyar ho gaye lekin aap ne farmaya tum abhi thehar jao ab ek Ansari tayyar hue aur woh un se larnay lage yahan tak ke shaheed hue isi tarah sab ke sab ek ek kar ke shaheed ho gaye aur ab sirf Hazrat Talha reh gaye goya yeh buzurg har martaba tayyar ho jate thay lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) unhein rok liya karte thay aakhir yeh muqabla par aaye aur is tarah jam kar lare ke un sab ki larai ek taraf aur yeh ek taraf is larai mein un ki ungliyan kat gayin toh zaban se hiss nikal gaya aap ne farmaya agar tum Bismillah keh dete ya Allah ka naam lete toh tumhein farishtay utha lete aur aasman ki bulandi ki taraf le charhte aur log dekhte rehte ab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne sahaba ke majmay mein pahunch chuke thin.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Qais bin Hazim farmate hain main ne dekha Hazrat Talha ka woh haath jise unhon ne dhaal banaya tha shul ho gaya tha, Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas farmate hain mere paas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni tarkash se Uhud wale din tamam teer phaila diye aur farmaya tujh par mere maa baap fida hon le mushrikeen ko maar, aap utha utha kar dete jate the aur main taak taak kar mushrikeen ko maarta jata tha, us din main ne do shakhson ko dekha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke daayein baayein the aur sakht tareen jang kar rahe the, main ne na to us se pehle kabhi unhein dekha tha na us ke baad, yeh dono Hazrat Jibraeel aur Hazrat Mikaeel (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) the. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jo buzurg Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath bhagdar ke baad the aur ek ek ho kar shaheed huye the unhein aap farmate jate the ke koi hai jo inhein roke aur jannat mein jaye mera rafeeq hai.

Ubayy bin Khalaf ne Makkah mein qasam khayi thi ke main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl karunga, jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is ka ilm hua to aap ne farmaya woh to nahin balkay main Insha'Allah use qatl karunga. Uhud wale din yeh khabeeth sar-ta-pa lohay mein gharq zarah-e-baktar lagaye huye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf barha aur yeh kehta aata tha ke agar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bach gaye to main apne tayin halak kar dalunga. Idhar se Hazrat Mus'ab bin Umair is nahanjaar ki taraf barhe lekin aap shaheed ho gaye, ab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ki taraf barhe, us ka sara jism lohay mein chupa hua tha sirf zara si peshani nazar aa rahi thi, aap ne apna neza taak kar wahin lagaya jo theek nishane par baitha aur yeh tewra kar ghore par se gira, go is zakhm se khoon bhi na nikla tha lekin us ki yeh halat thi ke bilbila raha tha. Logon ne use utha liya lashkar mein le gaye aur tashaffi dene lage ke aisa koi kaari zakhm nahin laga kyun is qadar namardi karta hai? Aakhir un ke ta'anon se majboor ho kar us ne kaha main ne suna hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai main Ubayy ko qatl karunga, sach mano ab main kabhi nahin bach sakta, tum is par na jao ke mujhe zara si kharash hi aayi hai, Allah ki qasam jis ke qabze mein meri jaan hai agar kul ahl-e-Zi-ul-Majaz ko itna zakhm is haath se lag jata to sab halak ho jate. Pas yunhi tarpte tarpte aur balkte balkte is jahannami ki halakat hui aur mar kar jahannam raseed hua.

Maghazi Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke jab yeh shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne hua to sahaba ne us ke muqable ki khwahish ki lekin aap ne unhein rok diya aur farmaya ise aane do, jab woh qareeb aa gaya to aap ne Hazrat Harith bin Samma se neza le kar us par hamla kiya, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke haath mein neza dekhte hi woh kaanp utha, hum ne usi waqt samajh liya ke us ki khair nahin, aap ne us ki gardan par waar kiya aur woh larkhara kar ghore par se gira. Hazrat Ibn Umar ka (khwab mein) dehshat-naak sholay uthte huye dekhna aur dekhna ke ek shakhs ko zanjeeron mein jakre huye is aag mein ghasita ja raha hai aur woh pyas pyas kar raha hai aur dusra shakhs kehta hai ise pani na dena yeh paighambar ke haath ka mara hua hai, yeh Ubayy bin Khalaf hai.

Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai aap apne samne ke chaar danton ki taraf jinhein mushrikeen ne Uhud wale din shaheed kiya tha ishara kar ke farma rahe the Allah ka sakht-tar ghazab un logon par hai jinhon ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath yeh kiya aur us par bhi Allah Ta'ala ka ghazab hai jise Allah ka Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ki raah mein qatl kare, aur riwayat mein yeh lafz hain ke jin logon ne Allah Ta'ala ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka chehra zakhmi kiya. Utba bin Abi Waqqas ke haath se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh zakhm laga tha, samne ke chaar daant toot gaye the, rukhsaar par zakhm aaya tha aur hont par bhi. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas farmaya karte the mujhe jis qadar is shakhs ki hirs thi kisi aur ke qatl ki na thi.

Yeh shakhs bada bad-khulq tha aur sari qoum se is ki dushmani thi. Is ki burai mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman kafi hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko zakhmi karne wale par Allah sakht ghazabnak hai. Abdur Razzaq mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ke liye bad-dua ki ke Aye Allah! Saal bhar mein yeh halak ho jaye aur kufr par is ki maut ho, chunancha yahi hua aur yeh bad-bakht kafir mara aur jahannum wasil hua.

Ek Muhajir ka bayan hai ke charon taraf se Uhud wale din Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par teeron ki barish ho rahi thi lekin Allah ki qudrat se woh sab pher diye jate thay. Abdullah bin Shahab Zuhri ne us din qasam kha kar kaha ke mujhe Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dikha do, woh aaj mere hath se bach nahin sakta, agar woh nijat pa gaya to meri nijat nahin. Ab woh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf lapka aur bilkul aap ke paas aa gaya, us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath koi na tha lekin Allah Ta'ala ne is ki aankhon par parda daal diya, use Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nazar hi na aaye. Jab woh namurad palta to Safwan ne use ta'ana zani ki, us ne kaha Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se mehfooz hain, hamare hath nahin lagne ke. Suno! Hum char shakhson ne un ke qatl ka pukhta mashwara kiya tha aur aapas mein ahd-o-paiman kiye thay, hum ne har-chand chaha lekin kamyabi na hui. Waqidi kehte hain lekin sabit shuda baat yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki peshani ko zakhmi karne wala Ibn-e-Qami'ah aur hont aur danton par sadma pahunchane wala Utbah bin Abi Waqqas tha.

Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha R.A ka bayan hai ke mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A jab Uhud ka zikr farmate to saaf kehte ke is din ki tamam-tar fazilat ka sehra Hazrat Talha R.A ke sar hai. Main jab laut kar aaya to main ne dekha ke ek shakhs Huzoor ﷺ ki himayat mein jaan tikaye lad raha hai. Main ne kaha Allah kare yeh Talha ho. Ab jo qareeb aa kar dekha to Talha hi the R.A. Main ne kaha Alhamdulillah meri hi qoum ka ek shakhs hai. Mere aur mushrikon ke darmiyan ek shakhs tha jo mushrikeen mein khada hua tha lekin uske be-panah hamle mushrikon ki himmat tod rahe the. Gaur se dekha to woh Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah R.A the. Ab jo main ne baghaur Huzoor ﷺ ki taraf dekha to Aap ﷺ ke samne ke daant toot gaye hain, chehra zakhmi ho raha hai aur peshani mein zirah ki do kadiyan khub gayi hain. Main Aap ﷺ ki taraf lapka lekin Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Abu Talha ki khabar lo. Main ne chaha ke Huzoor ﷺ ke chehre mein se woh dono kadiyan nikaloon lekin Hazrat Abu Ubaidah R.A ne mujhe qasam de kar rok diya aur khud qareeb aaye aur haath se nikalne mein zyada takleef mehsoos kar ke daanton se pakad kar ek ko nikal liya lekin is mein unka daant bhi toot gaya. Main ne ab phir chaha ke dusri mein nikal loon lekin Hazrat Abu Ubaidah R.A ne phir qasam di to main ruk gaya, unhon ne phir dusri kadi nikali, ab ki martaba bhi unke daant toote. Is se farigh ho kar hum Hazrat Talha R.A ki taraf mutawajja hue, hum ne dekha ke sattar se zyada zakhm unhein lag chuke hain, ungliyan kat gayi hain, hum ne phir unki bhi khabar li. Huzoor ﷺ ke zakhm ka khoon Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ne choosa taake khoon tham jaye, phir un se kaha gaya ke kulli kar daalo lekin unhon ne kaha Allah ki qasam main kulli na karunga, phir maidan-e-jang mein chale gaye. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya agar koi shakhs Jannati shakhs ko dekhna chahta ho to inhein dekh le, chunancha yeh isi maidan mein shaheed hue. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ka chehra zakhmi hua, samne ke daant toote, sar ka khud toot gaya. Hazrat Fatima R.A khoon dhoti thin aur Hazrat Ali R.A dhaal mein paani laa laa kar daalte jaate the. Jab dekha ke khoon kisi tarah thamta hi nahin to Hazrat Fatima R.A ne boriya jala kar uski raakh zakhm par rakh di jis se khoon band hua. Phir farmata hai, tumhein gham par gham pahuncha. (Bi-ghammin) ka ba-ma'ni mein 'ala' ke hai jaise aayat (Fi juzoo-in-nakhli) mein 'fi' ma'ni mein 'ala' ke hai. Ek gham to shikast ka tha jabke yeh mashhoor ho gaya ke (Allah na kare) Huzoor ﷺ ki jaan par ban aayi, dusra gham mushrikon ko pahad ke oopar ghalib aa kar chadh jaane ka jabke Huzoor ﷺ farmate the yeh bulandi ke laiq na the. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf R.A farmate hain ek gham shikast ka, dusra gham Huzoor ﷺ ke qatl ki khabar ka aur yeh gham pehle gham se zyada tha. Isi tarah yeh bhi hai ke ek gham to ghaneemat ka haath mein aa kar nikal jaane ka tha, dusra shikast hone ka, isi tarah ek apne bhaiyon ke qatl ka gham, dusra Huzoor ﷺ ki nisbat aisi manhoos khabar ka gham.

Phir farmata hai jo ghanimat aur fath-mandi tumhare hath se gayi aur jo zakhm-o-shahadat mili us par gham na khao, Allah Subhanuhu wa Ta'ala jo bulandi aur jalal wala hai woh tumhare a'maal se khabardar hai.

Kafir aur munafiqon ke irade aur Ghazwa-e-Uhud ka phir andohnaak tazkira. Allah Ta'ala apne imandar bandon ko kafiron aur munafiqon ki baton ke manne se rok raha hai aur bata raha hai ke agar in ki mani to duniya aur aakhirat ki zillat tum par aayegi. Unki chahat to yahi hai ke tumhein Deen-e-Islam se hata dein. Phir farmata hai mujh hi ko apna wali aur madadgar jaano, mujh hi se dosti karo, mujh hi par bharosa karo, mujh hi se madad chaho. Phir farmaya ke in shareeron ke dilon mein un ke kufr ke sabab dar-o-khauf daal doonga. Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: Mujhe paanch baatein di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle kisi Nabi ko nahin di gayin; meri madad mahina bhar ki raah tak ra'ab se ki gayi hai, mere liye zameen masjid aur us ki mitti wuzu ki paak cheez banayi gayi, mere liye ghanimat ke maal halal kiye gaye aur mujhe shafa'at di gayi aur har Nabi apni apni qoum ki taraf se makhsoos bheja jata tha aur meri ba'asat meri nabuwwat tamam duniya ke liye aam hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai aap farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne tamam nabiyon par aur ba'az riwayaton mein hai tamam ummaton par mujhe chaar fazilatein ata farmayi hain: Mujhe tamam duniya ki taraf Rasool bana kar bheja gaya, mere aur meri ummat ke liye tamam zameen masjid aur paak banayi gayi, mere ummati ko jahan namaz ka waqt aa jaye wahin us ki masjid aur us ka wuzu hai, mera dushman mujh se mahina bhar ki raah par ho wahin se Allah Ta'ala us ka dil ra'ab se pur kar deta hai aur woh kanpne lagta hai aur mere liye ghanimat ke maal halal kiye gaye aur riwayat mein hai ke main madad kiya gaya hoon mere ra'ab se har dushman par. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai mujhe paanch cheezein di gayin, main har surkh-o-safaid ki taraf bheja gaya, mere liye tamam zameen wuzu aur masjid banayi gayi, mere liye ghanimaton ke maal halal kiye gaye jo mere pehle kisi ke halal na the aur meri madad mahina bhar ki raah tak ra'ab se ki gayi aur mujhe shafa'at di gayi, tamam ambiya ne shafa'at maang li lekin main ne apni shafa'at ko apni ummat ke logon ke liye jinhon ne Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho bacha rakhi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne Abu Sufyan ke dil mein ra'ab daal diya aur woh ladai se laut gaya. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne apna wa'ada sacha kar dikhaya aur tumhari madad ki, is se bhi yeh istidlal ho sakta hai ke yeh wa'ada Uhud ke din ka tha, teen hazaar dushman ka lashkar tha taham muqable par aate hi un ke qadam ukhad gaye aur musalmanon ko fath hasil hui lekin phir teer-andazon ki nafarmani ki wajah se aur ba'az hazrat ki past-himati ki bina par woh wa'ada jo mashroot tha ruk gaya, pas farmata hai ke tum unhein apne hathon se kaat-te the.

Shuru din mein hi Allah ne tumhein un par ghalib kar diya lekin tum ne phir buzdili dikhayi aur Nabi (ﷺ) ki nafarmani ki, un ki batayi hui jagah se hat gaye aur aapas mein ikhtilaf karne lage halankeh Allah Azzawajal ne tumhein tumhari pasand ki cheez fatah dikha di thi yani musalman saaf taur par ghalib aa gaye thay, maal-e-ghaneemat aankhon ke samne majood tha, kuffar peeth pher kar bhaag kharay huye thay. Tum mein se baaz ne dunya talbi ki aur kuffar ki hazeemat ko dekh kar Nabi (ﷺ) ke farman ka khayal na kar ke maal-e-ghaneemat ki taraf lapkay, go baaz aur nek aakhirat talab bhi thay lekin is nafarmani waghera ki bina par kuffar ki phir ban aayi aur ek martaba tumhari poori aazmaish ho gayi, ghalib ho kar maghloob ho gaye, fatah ke baad shikast ho gayi lekin phir bhi Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare is jurm ko maaf farma diya kyunke woh jaanta hai ke bazahir tum un se tadaad mein aur asbaab mein kam thay. Khata ka maaf hona bhi 'Afa Ankum' mein dakhil hai aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke kuch yunhi si goshmali kar ke kuch buzurgon ki shahadat ke baad us ne apni aazmaish ko utha liya aur baqi walon ko maaf farma diya, Allah Ta'ala ba-imaan logon par fazl-o-karam, lutf-o-raham hi karta hai.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki madad jaisi Uhad mein hui hai kahin nahin hui, isi ke bare mein irshad-e-bari hai ke Allah ne tum se apna wada sacha kar dikhaya lekin phir tumhare kartooton se mamla bar-aks ho gaya. Baaz logon ne dunya talbi kar ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki nafarmani ki yani baaz teer-andazon ne jinhein Huzoor (ﷺ) ne pahar ke darray par khara kiya tha aur farma diya tha ke tum yahan se dushmanon ki nigahbani karo, woh tumhari peeth ki taraf se na aa jayen, agar tum haar dekho bhi apni jagah se na hatna aur agar tum har tarah ghalib aa gaye toh bhi tum ghaneemat jama karne ke liye bhi apni jagah ko na chorna. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ghalib aa gaye toh teer-andazon ne hukm-e-adooli ki aur woh apni jagah ko chor kar musalmanon mein aa milay aur maal-e-ghaneemat jama karna shuru kar diya, safon ka koi khayal na raha, darray ko khali pa kar mushrikon ne bhagna band kiya aur gaur-o-fikr kar ke us jagah hamla kar diya. Chand musalmanon ki peeth ke peeche se un ki be-khabari mein is zor ka hamla kiya ke musalmanon ke qadam na jam sakay aur shuru din ki fatah ab shikast se badal gayi aur yeh mashhoor ho gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) bhi shaheed ho gaye aur larayi ke rang ne musalmanon ko is baat ka yaqeen bhi dila diya. Thori der baad jabkeh musalmanon ki nazrein chehra-e-mubarak par parin toh woh apni sab kuft aur sari museebat bhool gaye aur khushi ke maaray Huzoor (ﷺ) ki taraf lapkay, aap idhar aa rahe thay aur farmate thay ke Allah Ta'ala ka sakht ghazab nazil ho un logon par jinhon ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke chehre ko khoon-aalooda kar diya, unhein koi haq na tha ke is tarah hum par ghalib reh jayen. Thori der mein hum ne suna ke Abu Sufyan pahar ke neeche khara hua keh raha tha 'A'al Hubal, A'al Hubal' (Hubal but ka bol bala ho), Abu Bakr kahan hai? Umar kahan hai? Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ) ise jawab doon?

Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ijazat di toh Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne uske jawab mein farmaya: Allahu A'la wa Ajal, Allahu A'la wa Ajal, Allah bahut buland hai aur jalal-o-izzat wala hai, Allah bahut buland aur jalal-o-izzat wala hai. Woh poochne laga batao Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kahan hain? Abu Bakr (R.A) kahan hain? Umar (R.A) kahan hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Yeh hain Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur yeh hain Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) aur yeh hoon main Umar Farooq (R.A). Abu Sufyan kehne laga: Yeh Badr ka badla hai, yunhi dhoop chhaon ulti palti rehti hai, ladai ki misal kunwein ke dol ki si hai. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya: Barabari ka mamla hargiz nahin, tumhare maqtool toh jahannam mein gaye aur hamare shaheed jannat mein pahunche. Abu Sufyan kehne laga: Agar yunhi ho toh yaqeenan hum nuqsan aur ghate mein rahe. Suno! Tumhare maqtoolin mein ba'az naak kaan kate log bhi tum paoge, goya hamare sardaron ki raye se nahin hua lekin hamain kuch bura bhi nahin maloom hua. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur yeh qissa bhi ajeeb hai, yeh Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki mursalat se hai aur woh ya unke walid jang-e-Uhud mein majood na the. Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim aur Baihaqi fi Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein bhi yeh marwi hai aur sahih ahadith mein iske ba'az hisson ke shawahid bhi hain ki Uhud wale din auratein musalmanon ke peeche thin jo zakhmiyon ki dekh bhaal karti thin, toh poori tarah yaqeen tha ki aaj ke din hum mein koi ek bhi talib-e-dunya nahin, balkeh us waqt agar mujhe is baat par qasam khulwai jati toh kha leta, lekin Quran mein yeh ayat utri (Min-kum man yureedud-dunya) yani tum mein se ba'az talib-e-dunya bhi hain. Jab sahaba se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hukum ke khilaf aap ki nafarmani sarzad hui toh unke qadam ukhad gaye, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath sirf saat Ansari aur do Muhajir baqi reh gaye. Jab mushrikeen ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko gher liya toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmane lage: Allah Ta'ala us shakhs par raham kare jo inhein hataye. Toh ek Ansari uth khade hue aur is jam-e-ghafeer ke muqabil tan-tanha dad-e-shuja'at dene lage yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye. Phir kuffar ne hamla kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi farmaya, ek Ansari tayyar ho gaye aur is be-jigri se lade ke unhein aage na badhne diya lekin bil-akhir yeh bhi shaheed ho gaye, yahan tak ke saaton sahaba Allah ke haan pahunch gaye, Allah un se khush ho. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Muhajireen se farmaya: Afsos! Hum ne apne sathiyon se munsifana mamla na kiya. Ab Abu Sufyan ne haank lagai ki A'al-e-Hubal, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Kaho Allahu A'la wa Ajal. Abu Sufyan ne kaha: (Lanal-Uzza wa la Uzza lakum) hamara Uzza but hai, tumhari koi Uzza nahin. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Kaho Allahu Maulana wal-kafiroona la maula lahum, Allah hamara Maula hai aur kafiron ka koi Maula nahin. Abu Sufyan kehne laga: Aaj ke din Badr ke din ka badla hai, koi din hamara aur koi din tumhara, yeh toh hathon-hath ka sauda hai, ek ke badle ek hai.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hargiz barabari nahin, hamare shuhada zinda hain wahan rizq diye jate hain aur tumhare maqtool jahannam mein azab kiye ja rahe hain. Phir Abu Sufyan bola tumhare maqtool mein tum dekhoge ke baaz ke kaan naak waghera kaat liye gaye hain lekin main ne na yeh kaha na use roka na use main ne pasand kiya na mujhe yeh bhala maloom hua na bura. Ab jo dekha to maloom hua ke Hazrat Hamza (R.A) ka pait chaak kar diya gaya tha aur Hinda ne unka kaleja le kar chabaya tha lekin nigal na saki to ugal diya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya namumkin tha ke us ke pait mein Hamza ka zara sa gosht bhi chala jaye, Allah Ta'ala Hamza ke kisi uzw-e-badan ko jahannam mein le jana nahin chahta. Chunancha Hamza ke janaze ko apne samne rakh kar namaz-e-janaza ada ki, phir ek Ansari ka janaza laya gaya woh Hazrat Hamza ke pehlu mein rakha gaya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir namaz-e-janaza padhi, Ansari ka janaza utha liya gaya lekin Hazrat Hamza ka janaza wahin raha, isi tarah sattar shakhs laye gaye aur Hazrat Hamza ki sattar dafa janaze ki namaz padhi gayi (Musnad). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Bara (R.A) se marwi hai ke Uhud wale din mushrikon se hamari mudbher hui, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne teer-andazon ki ek jamaat ko alag jama diya aur unka sardar Hazrat Abdullah bin Jubair (R.A) ko banaya aur farma diya ke agar tum hamain un par ghalib aaya hua dekho to bhi yahan se na hatna aur woh hum par ghalib aa jayen to bhi tum apni jagah na chhodna. Ladai shuru hote hi Allah ke fazl se mushrikon ke qadam peeche hatne lage yahan tak ke aurtain bhi tehband ooncha kar kar ke pahadon mein idhar daudne lagin. Ab teer-andaz groh ghanimat ghanimat kehta hua neeche utar aaya, un ke ameer ne unhain harchand samjhaya lekin kisi ne un ki na suni, bas ab mushrikeen musalmanon ki peeth ki taraf se aan pade aur sattar buzurg shaheed ho gaye. Abu Sufyan ek teele par chadh kar kehne laga kya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hayat hain? Kya Abu Bakr (R.A) maujood hain? Kya Umar (R.A) zinda hain? Lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman se sahaba khush rahe to woh khushi ke mare uchhal pada aur kehne laga yeh sab hamari talwaron ke ghaat utar gaye agar zinda hote to zaroor jawab dete. Ek Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko taab-e-zabt na rahi, farmane lage, ae Allah ke dushman tu jhoota hai, bihamdillah hum sab maujood hain aur teri tabahi aur barbadi karne wale zinda hain. Phir woh baatein huin jo oopar bayan ho chuki hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jang-e-Uhud mein mushrikon ko hazimat hui aur Iblees ne aawaz lagayi ae Allah ke bando! Apne peeche ki khabar lo, agli jamaatein pichli jamaaton par toot padin. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne dekha ke musalmanon ki talwaren un ke walid Hazrat Yaman (R.A) par baras rahi hain, harchand kehte rahe ke ae Allah ke bando!

Yeh mere baap Yaman hain magar kaun sunta tha woh yunhi shaheed hogaye lekin Hazrat Huzaifa ne kuch na kaha balkay farmaya Allah tumhein maaf kare, Hazrat Huzaifa ki yeh bhalai unke aakhri dam tak un mein rahi, Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai Hazrat Zubair bin Awwam farmate hain main ne khud dekha ke mushrik musalmanon ke awwal hamlay mein hi bhaag kharay hue yahan tak ke un ki auratein Hinda waghera tehmed uthaye tez tez daur rahi thin lekin us ke baad jab teer-andazon ne markaz chora aur kuffar ne simat kar peechay ki taraf se hum par hamla kardiya udhar kisi ne aawaz lagayi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shaheed hogaye phir mamla bar-aks hogaya warna hum mushrikeen ke alam-bardaron tak pahunch chuke thay aur jhanda us ke haath se gir para tha lekin Umrah bin Alqama Harithiya aurat ne usay thaam liya aur Quraish ka majma phir yahan jama hogaya, Hazrat Anas bin Malik ke chacha Hazrat Anas bin Nadr (R.A) yeh rang dekh Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Talha waghera ke paas aate hain aur farmate hain tum ne kyun himmatein chor dein? Woh jawab dete hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh shaheed hogaye. Hazrat Anas ne farmaya phir tum jee kar kya karoge? Yeh kaha aur mushrikeen mein ghusay phir larte rahe yahan tak ke Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat se ja mile (R.A), yeh Badr wale din jihad mein nahin pahunch sake thay toh ahd kiya tha ke aayinda agar koi mauqa aaya toh main dikha dunga chunancha is jang mein woh maujood thay jab musalmanon mein khalbuli machi toh unhon ne kaha Allah main musalmanon ke is kaam se mazoor hoon aur mushrikon ke is kaam se bari hoon phir apni talwar le kar aagay barh gaye raah mein Hazrat Saad bin Muaz se mile aur kehne lage kahan ja rahe ho? Mujhe toh jannat ki khushbu ki liptain Uhud pahar se chali aa rahi hain chunancha mushrikon mein ghus gaye aur bari be-jigri se lare yahan tak ke shahadat hasil ki assi se zyada teer-o-talwar ke zakhm badan par aaye thay pehchanay na jate thay ungli ko dekh kar pehchanay gaye (R.A), Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke ek haaji ne Baitullah Shareef mein ek majlis dekh kar poocha ke yeh kaun log hain? Logon ne kaha Quraishi hain poocha un ke sheikh kaun hain? Jawab mila Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) hain, ab woh aaya aur kehne laga main kuch daryaft karna chahta hoon Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya poocho us ne kaha aap ko is Baitullah ki hurmat ki qasam kya aap ko ilm hai ke (Hazrat) Usman bin Affan Uhud wale din bhaag gaye thay? Aap ne jawab diya haan. Kaha kya aap ko maloom hai ke woh Badr wale din bhi hazir nahin hue thay? Farmaya haan, kaha kya aap jante hain ke woh Bai'at-e-Rizwan mein bhi shareek nahin hue thay?

Farmaya yeh bhi theek hai, ab usne (khush hokar) takbeer kahi, Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya idhar aa, ab main tujhe pooray waqiyat sunaoon, Uhud ke din ka bhagna toh Allah Ta'ala ne maaf farma diya, Badr ke din ki ghair haziri ke baais yeh hua ke aap ke ghar mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sahibzadi thin aur woh us waqt sakht bimar thin toh khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un se farmaya tha ke tum na aao Madina mein hi raho tumhein Allah Ta'ala is jang mein hazir hone ka ajar de ga aur ghanimat mein bhi tumhara hissa hai, Bai'at-e-Rizwan ka waqia yeh hai ke unhein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makka walon ke paas apna paigham de kar Hazrat Usman ko bheja tha is liye ke Makka mein jo izzat unhein hasil thi kisi aur ko utni na thi unke tashreef le jaane ke baad yeh bai'at li gayi toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apna dahina hath khara kar ke kaha yeh Usman ka hath hai phir apne dusre hath par rakha (goya bai'at ki) phir us shakhs se kaha ab jao aur ise sath le jao phir farmaya aayat (Au tas'adoona) al-kh yani tum apne dushman se bhag kar pahar charh rahe thay aur maaray khauf-o-dehshat ke dusri janib tawajjah bhi nahin karte thay Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bhi tum ne wahin chor diya tha woh tumhein aawazein de rahe thay aur samjha rahe thay ke bhago nahin laut aao, Hazrat Suddi farmate hain mushrikeen ke is khufiya aur pur-zor aur achanak hamla se musalmanon ke qadam ukharr gaye kuch toh Madina ki taraf laut aaye kuch pahar ki choti par charh gaye Allah ke Nabi aawazein dete rahe ke Allah ke bando meri taraf aao Allah ke bando meri taraf aao, is waqia ka bayan is aayat mein hai, Abdullah bin Zahri shair ne is waqia ko nazm mein bhi ada kiya hai, An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us waqt sirf barah aadmiyon ke sath reh gaye thay Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek taweel hadith mein bhi in tamam waqiyat ka zikr hai, Dalail-un-Nabuwwat mein hai ke jab hazimat hui tab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath sirf gyarah shakhs reh gaye aur ek Hazrat Talha bin Ubaidullah thay, aap pahar par charhne lage lekin mushrikeen ne aaghera aap ne apne sathiyon ki taraf mutawajjah ho kar farmaya koi hai jo in se muqabla kare, Hazrat Talha ne is aawaz par foran labbaik kaha aur tayyar ho gaye lekin aap ne farmaya tum abhi thehar jao ab ek Ansari tayyar hue aur woh un se larnay lage yahan tak ke shaheed hue isi tarah sab ke sab ek ek kar ke shaheed ho gaye aur ab sirf Hazrat Talha reh gaye goya yeh buzurg har martaba tayyar ho jate thay lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) unhein rok liya karte thay aakhir yeh muqabla par aaye aur is tarah jam kar lare ke un sab ki larai ek taraf aur yeh ek taraf is larai mein un ki ungliyan kat gayin toh zaban se hiss nikal gaya aap ne farmaya agar tum Bismillah keh dete ya Allah ka naam lete toh tumhein farishtay utha lete aur aasman ki bulandi ki taraf le charhte aur log dekhte rehte ab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne sahaba ke majmay mein pahunch chuke thin.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Qais bin Hazim farmate hain main ne dekha Hazrat Talha ka woh haath jise unhon ne dhaal banaya tha shul ho gaya tha, Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas farmate hain mere paas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni tarkash se Uhud wale din tamam teer phaila diye aur farmaya tujh par mere maa baap fida hon le mushrikeen ko maar, aap utha utha kar dete jate the aur main taak taak kar mushrikeen ko maarta jata tha, us din main ne do shakhson ko dekha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke daayein baayein the aur sakht tareen jang kar rahe the, main ne na to us se pehle kabhi unhein dekha tha na us ke baad, yeh dono Hazrat Jibraeel aur Hazrat Mikaeel (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) the. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jo buzurg Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath bhagdar ke baad the aur ek ek ho kar shaheed huye the unhein aap farmate jate the ke koi hai jo inhein roke aur jannat mein jaye mera rafeeq hai.

Ubayy bin Khalaf ne Makkah mein qasam khayi thi ke main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl karunga, jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is ka ilm hua to aap ne farmaya woh to nahin balkay main Insha'Allah use qatl karunga. Uhud wale din yeh khabeeth sar-ta-pa lohay mein gharq zarah-e-baktar lagaye huye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf barha aur yeh kehta aata tha ke agar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bach gaye to main apne tayin halak kar dalunga. Idhar se Hazrat Mus'ab bin Umair is nahanjaar ki taraf barhe lekin aap shaheed ho gaye, ab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ki taraf barhe, us ka sara jism lohay mein chupa hua tha sirf zara si peshani nazar aa rahi thi, aap ne apna neza taak kar wahin lagaya jo theek nishane par baitha aur yeh tewra kar ghore par se gira, go is zakhm se khoon bhi na nikla tha lekin us ki yeh halat thi ke bilbila raha tha. Logon ne use utha liya lashkar mein le gaye aur tashaffi dene lage ke aisa koi kaari zakhm nahin laga kyun is qadar namardi karta hai? Aakhir un ke ta'anon se majboor ho kar us ne kaha main ne suna hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai main Ubayy ko qatl karunga, sach mano ab main kabhi nahin bach sakta, tum is par na jao ke mujhe zara si kharash hi aayi hai, Allah ki qasam jis ke qabze mein meri jaan hai agar kul ahl-e-Zi-ul-Majaz ko itna zakhm is haath se lag jata to sab halak ho jate. Pas yunhi tarpte tarpte aur balkte balkte is jahannami ki halakat hui aur mar kar jahannam raseed hua.

Maghazi Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke jab yeh shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne hua to sahaba ne us ke muqable ki khwahish ki lekin aap ne unhein rok diya aur farmaya ise aane do, jab woh qareeb aa gaya to aap ne Hazrat Harith bin Samma se neza le kar us par hamla kiya, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke haath mein neza dekhte hi woh kaanp utha, hum ne usi waqt samajh liya ke us ki khair nahin, aap ne us ki gardan par waar kiya aur woh larkhara kar ghore par se gira. Hazrat Ibn Umar ka (khwab mein) dehshat-naak sholay uthte huye dekhna aur dekhna ke ek shakhs ko zanjeeron mein jakre huye is aag mein ghasita ja raha hai aur woh pyas pyas kar raha hai aur dusra shakhs kehta hai ise pani na dena yeh paighambar ke haath ka mara hua hai, yeh Ubayy bin Khalaf hai.

Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai aap apne samne ke chaar danton ki taraf jinhein mushrikeen ne Uhud wale din shaheed kiya tha ishara kar ke farma rahe the Allah ka sakht-tar ghazab un logon par hai jinhon ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath yeh kiya aur us par bhi Allah Ta'ala ka ghazab hai jise Allah ka Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ki raah mein qatl kare, aur riwayat mein yeh lafz hain ke jin logon ne Allah Ta'ala ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka chehra zakhmi kiya. Utba bin Abi Waqqas ke haath se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh zakhm laga tha, samne ke chaar daant toot gaye the, rukhsaar par zakhm aaya tha aur hont par bhi. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas farmaya karte the mujhe jis qadar is shakhs ki hirs thi kisi aur ke qatl ki na thi.

Yeh shakhs bada bad-khulq tha aur sari qoum se is ki dushmani thi. Is ki burai mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman kafi hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko zakhmi karne wale par Allah sakht ghazabnak hai. Abdur Razzaq mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ke liye bad-dua ki ke Aye Allah! Saal bhar mein yeh halak ho jaye aur kufr par is ki maut ho, chunancha yahi hua aur yeh bad-bakht kafir mara aur jahannum wasil hua.

Ek Muhajir ka bayan hai ke charon taraf se Uhud wale din Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par teeron ki barish ho rahi thi lekin Allah ki qudrat se woh sab pher diye jate thay. Abdullah bin Shahab Zuhri ne us din qasam kha kar kaha ke mujhe Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dikha do, woh aaj mere hath se bach nahin sakta, agar woh nijat pa gaya to meri nijat nahin. Ab woh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf lapka aur bilkul aap ke paas aa gaya, us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath koi na tha lekin Allah Ta'ala ne is ki aankhon par parda daal diya, use Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nazar hi na aaye. Jab woh namurad palta to Safwan ne use ta'ana zani ki, us ne kaha Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se mehfooz hain, hamare hath nahin lagne ke. Suno! Hum char shakhson ne un ke qatl ka pukhta mashwara kiya tha aur aapas mein ahd-o-paiman kiye thay, hum ne har-chand chaha lekin kamyabi na hui. Waqidi kehte hain lekin sabit shuda baat yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki peshani ko zakhmi karne wala Ibn-e-Qami'ah aur hont aur danton par sadma pahunchane wala Utbah bin Abi Waqqas tha.

Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha R.A ka bayan hai ke mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A jab Uhud ka zikr farmate to saaf kehte ke is din ki tamam-tar fazilat ka sehra Hazrat Talha R.A ke sar hai. Main jab laut kar aaya to main ne dekha ke ek shakhs Huzoor ﷺ ki himayat mein jaan tikaye lad raha hai. Main ne kaha Allah kare yeh Talha ho. Ab jo qareeb aa kar dekha to Talha hi the R.A. Main ne kaha Alhamdulillah meri hi qoum ka ek shakhs hai. Mere aur mushrikon ke darmiyan ek shakhs tha jo mushrikeen mein khada hua tha lekin uske be-panah hamle mushrikon ki himmat tod rahe the. Gaur se dekha to woh Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah R.A the. Ab jo main ne baghaur Huzoor ﷺ ki taraf dekha to Aap ﷺ ke samne ke daant toot gaye hain, chehra zakhmi ho raha hai aur peshani mein zirah ki do kadiyan khub gayi hain. Main Aap ﷺ ki taraf lapka lekin Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Abu Talha ki khabar lo. Main ne chaha ke Huzoor ﷺ ke chehre mein se woh dono kadiyan nikaloon lekin Hazrat Abu Ubaidah R.A ne mujhe qasam de kar rok diya aur khud qareeb aaye aur haath se nikalne mein zyada takleef mehsoos kar ke daanton se pakad kar ek ko nikal liya lekin is mein unka daant bhi toot gaya. Main ne ab phir chaha ke dusri mein nikal loon lekin Hazrat Abu Ubaidah R.A ne phir qasam di to main ruk gaya, unhon ne phir dusri kadi nikali, ab ki martaba bhi unke daant toote. Is se farigh ho kar hum Hazrat Talha R.A ki taraf mutawajja hue, hum ne dekha ke sattar se zyada zakhm unhein lag chuke hain, ungliyan kat gayi hain, hum ne phir unki bhi khabar li. Huzoor ﷺ ke zakhm ka khoon Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ne choosa taake khoon tham jaye, phir un se kaha gaya ke kulli kar daalo lekin unhon ne kaha Allah ki qasam main kulli na karunga, phir maidan-e-jang mein chale gaye. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya agar koi shakhs Jannati shakhs ko dekhna chahta ho to inhein dekh le, chunancha yeh isi maidan mein shaheed hue. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ka chehra zakhmi hua, samne ke daant toote, sar ka khud toot gaya. Hazrat Fatima R.A khoon dhoti thin aur Hazrat Ali R.A dhaal mein paani laa laa kar daalte jaate the. Jab dekha ke khoon kisi tarah thamta hi nahin to Hazrat Fatima R.A ne boriya jala kar uski raakh zakhm par rakh di jis se khoon band hua. Phir farmata hai, tumhein gham par gham pahuncha. (Bi-ghammin) ka ba-ma'ni mein 'ala' ke hai jaise aayat (Fi juzoo-in-nakhli) mein 'fi' ma'ni mein 'ala' ke hai. Ek gham to shikast ka tha jabke yeh mashhoor ho gaya ke (Allah na kare) Huzoor ﷺ ki jaan par ban aayi, dusra gham mushrikon ko pahad ke oopar ghalib aa kar chadh jaane ka jabke Huzoor ﷺ farmate the yeh bulandi ke laiq na the. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf R.A farmate hain ek gham shikast ka, dusra gham Huzoor ﷺ ke qatl ki khabar ka aur yeh gham pehle gham se zyada tha. Isi tarah yeh bhi hai ke ek gham to ghaneemat ka haath mein aa kar nikal jaane ka tha, dusra shikast hone ka, isi tarah ek apne bhaiyon ke qatl ka gham, dusra Huzoor ﷺ ki nisbat aisi manhoos khabar ka gham.

Phir farmata hai jo ghanimat aur fath-mandi tumhare hath se gayi aur jo zakhm-o-shahadat mili us par gham na khao, Allah Subhanuhu wa Ta'ala jo bulandi aur jalal wala hai woh tumhare a'maal se khabardar hai.

Kafir aur munafiqon ke irade aur Ghazwa-e-Uhud ka phir andohnaak tazkira. Allah Ta'ala apne imandar bandon ko kafiron aur munafiqon ki baton ke manne se rok raha hai aur bata raha hai ke agar in ki mani to duniya aur aakhirat ki zillat tum par aayegi. Unki chahat to yahi hai ke tumhein Deen-e-Islam se hata dein. Phir farmata hai mujh hi ko apna wali aur madadgar jaano, mujh hi se dosti karo, mujh hi par bharosa karo, mujh hi se madad chaho. Phir farmaya ke in shareeron ke dilon mein un ke kufr ke sabab dar-o-khauf daal doonga. Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: Mujhe paanch baatein di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle kisi Nabi ko nahin di gayin; meri madad mahina bhar ki raah tak ra'ab se ki gayi hai, mere liye zameen masjid aur us ki mitti wuzu ki paak cheez banayi gayi, mere liye ghanimat ke maal halal kiye gaye aur mujhe shafa'at di gayi aur har Nabi apni apni qoum ki taraf se makhsoos bheja jata tha aur meri ba'asat meri nabuwwat tamam duniya ke liye aam hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai aap farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne tamam nabiyon par aur ba'az riwayaton mein hai tamam ummaton par mujhe chaar fazilatein ata farmayi hain: Mujhe tamam duniya ki taraf Rasool bana kar bheja gaya, mere aur meri ummat ke liye tamam zameen masjid aur paak banayi gayi, mere ummati ko jahan namaz ka waqt aa jaye wahin us ki masjid aur us ka wuzu hai, mera dushman mujh se mahina bhar ki raah par ho wahin se Allah Ta'ala us ka dil ra'ab se pur kar deta hai aur woh kanpne lagta hai aur mere liye ghanimat ke maal halal kiye gaye aur riwayat mein hai ke main madad kiya gaya hoon mere ra'ab se har dushman par. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai mujhe paanch cheezein di gayin, main har surkh-o-safaid ki taraf bheja gaya, mere liye tamam zameen wuzu aur masjid banayi gayi, mere liye ghanimaton ke maal halal kiye gaye jo mere pehle kisi ke halal na the aur meri madad mahina bhar ki raah tak ra'ab se ki gayi aur mujhe shafa'at di gayi, tamam ambiya ne shafa'at maang li lekin main ne apni shafa'at ko apni ummat ke logon ke liye jinhon ne Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho bacha rakhi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne Abu Sufyan ke dil mein ra'ab daal diya aur woh ladai se laut gaya. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne apna wa'ada sacha kar dikhaya aur tumhari madad ki, is se bhi yeh istidlal ho sakta hai ke yeh wa'ada Uhud ke din ka tha, teen hazaar dushman ka lashkar tha taham muqable par aate hi un ke qadam ukhad gaye aur musalmanon ko fath hasil hui lekin phir teer-andazon ki nafarmani ki wajah se aur ba'az hazrat ki past-himati ki bina par woh wa'ada jo mashroot tha ruk gaya, pas farmata hai ke tum unhein apne hathon se kaat-te the.

Shuru din mein hi Allah ne tumhein un par ghalib kar diya lekin tum ne phir buzdili dikhayi aur Nabi (ﷺ) ki nafarmani ki, un ki batayi hui jagah se hat gaye aur aapas mein ikhtilaf karne lage halankeh Allah Azzawajal ne tumhein tumhari pasand ki cheez fatah dikha di thi yani musalman saaf taur par ghalib aa gaye thay, maal-e-ghaneemat aankhon ke samne majood tha, kuffar peeth pher kar bhaag kharay huye thay. Tum mein se baaz ne dunya talbi ki aur kuffar ki hazeemat ko dekh kar Nabi (ﷺ) ke farman ka khayal na kar ke maal-e-ghaneemat ki taraf lapkay, go baaz aur nek aakhirat talab bhi thay lekin is nafarmani waghera ki bina par kuffar ki phir ban aayi aur ek martaba tumhari poori aazmaish ho gayi, ghalib ho kar maghloob ho gaye, fatah ke baad shikast ho gayi lekin phir bhi Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare is jurm ko maaf farma diya kyunke woh jaanta hai ke bazahir tum un se tadaad mein aur asbaab mein kam thay. Khata ka maaf hona bhi 'Afa Ankum' mein dakhil hai aur yeh bhi matlab hai ke kuch yunhi si goshmali kar ke kuch buzurgon ki shahadat ke baad us ne apni aazmaish ko utha liya aur baqi walon ko maaf farma diya, Allah Ta'ala ba-imaan logon par fazl-o-karam, lutf-o-raham hi karta hai.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ki madad jaisi Uhad mein hui hai kahin nahin hui, isi ke bare mein irshad-e-bari hai ke Allah ne tum se apna wada sacha kar dikhaya lekin phir tumhare kartooton se mamla bar-aks ho gaya. Baaz logon ne dunya talbi kar ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki nafarmani ki yani baaz teer-andazon ne jinhein Huzoor (ﷺ) ne pahar ke darray par khara kiya tha aur farma diya tha ke tum yahan se dushmanon ki nigahbani karo, woh tumhari peeth ki taraf se na aa jayen, agar tum haar dekho bhi apni jagah se na hatna aur agar tum har tarah ghalib aa gaye toh bhi tum ghaneemat jama karne ke liye bhi apni jagah ko na chorna. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ghalib aa gaye toh teer-andazon ne hukm-e-adooli ki aur woh apni jagah ko chor kar musalmanon mein aa milay aur maal-e-ghaneemat jama karna shuru kar diya, safon ka koi khayal na raha, darray ko khali pa kar mushrikon ne bhagna band kiya aur gaur-o-fikr kar ke us jagah hamla kar diya. Chand musalmanon ki peeth ke peeche se un ki be-khabari mein is zor ka hamla kiya ke musalmanon ke qadam na jam sakay aur shuru din ki fatah ab shikast se badal gayi aur yeh mashhoor ho gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) bhi shaheed ho gaye aur larayi ke rang ne musalmanon ko is baat ka yaqeen bhi dila diya. Thori der baad jabkeh musalmanon ki nazrein chehra-e-mubarak par parin toh woh apni sab kuft aur sari museebat bhool gaye aur khushi ke maaray Huzoor (ﷺ) ki taraf lapkay, aap idhar aa rahe thay aur farmate thay ke Allah Ta'ala ka sakht ghazab nazil ho un logon par jinhon ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke chehre ko khoon-aalooda kar diya, unhein koi haq na tha ke is tarah hum par ghalib reh jayen. Thori der mein hum ne suna ke Abu Sufyan pahar ke neeche khara hua keh raha tha 'A'al Hubal, A'al Hubal' (Hubal but ka bol bala ho), Abu Bakr kahan hai? Umar kahan hai? Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne poocha Huzoor (ﷺ) ise jawab doon?

Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ijazat di toh Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne uske jawab mein farmaya: Allahu A'la wa Ajal, Allahu A'la wa Ajal, Allah bahut buland hai aur jalal-o-izzat wala hai, Allah bahut buland aur jalal-o-izzat wala hai. Woh poochne laga batao Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kahan hain? Abu Bakr (R.A) kahan hain? Umar (R.A) kahan hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Yeh hain Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur yeh hain Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) aur yeh hoon main Umar Farooq (R.A). Abu Sufyan kehne laga: Yeh Badr ka badla hai, yunhi dhoop chhaon ulti palti rehti hai, ladai ki misal kunwein ke dol ki si hai. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya: Barabari ka mamla hargiz nahin, tumhare maqtool toh jahannam mein gaye aur hamare shaheed jannat mein pahunche. Abu Sufyan kehne laga: Agar yunhi ho toh yaqeenan hum nuqsan aur ghate mein rahe. Suno! Tumhare maqtoolin mein ba'az naak kaan kate log bhi tum paoge, goya hamare sardaron ki raye se nahin hua lekin hamain kuch bura bhi nahin maloom hua. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur yeh qissa bhi ajeeb hai, yeh Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki mursalat se hai aur woh ya unke walid jang-e-Uhud mein majood na the. Mustadrak Hakim mein bhi yeh riwayat majood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim aur Baihaqi fi Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein bhi yeh marwi hai aur sahih ahadith mein iske ba'az hisson ke shawahid bhi hain ki Uhud wale din auratein musalmanon ke peeche thin jo zakhmiyon ki dekh bhaal karti thin, toh poori tarah yaqeen tha ki aaj ke din hum mein koi ek bhi talib-e-dunya nahin, balkeh us waqt agar mujhe is baat par qasam khulwai jati toh kha leta, lekin Quran mein yeh ayat utri (Min-kum man yureedud-dunya) yani tum mein se ba'az talib-e-dunya bhi hain. Jab sahaba se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hukum ke khilaf aap ki nafarmani sarzad hui toh unke qadam ukhad gaye, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath sirf saat Ansari aur do Muhajir baqi reh gaye. Jab mushrikeen ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko gher liya toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmane lage: Allah Ta'ala us shakhs par raham kare jo inhein hataye. Toh ek Ansari uth khade hue aur is jam-e-ghafeer ke muqabil tan-tanha dad-e-shuja'at dene lage yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye. Phir kuffar ne hamla kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi farmaya, ek Ansari tayyar ho gaye aur is be-jigri se lade ke unhein aage na badhne diya lekin bil-akhir yeh bhi shaheed ho gaye, yahan tak ke saaton sahaba Allah ke haan pahunch gaye, Allah un se khush ho. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Muhajireen se farmaya: Afsos! Hum ne apne sathiyon se munsifana mamla na kiya. Ab Abu Sufyan ne haank lagai ki A'al-e-Hubal, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Kaho Allahu A'la wa Ajal. Abu Sufyan ne kaha: (Lanal-Uzza wa la Uzza lakum) hamara Uzza but hai, tumhari koi Uzza nahin. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Kaho Allahu Maulana wal-kafiroona la maula lahum, Allah hamara Maula hai aur kafiron ka koi Maula nahin. Abu Sufyan kehne laga: Aaj ke din Badr ke din ka badla hai, koi din hamara aur koi din tumhara, yeh toh hathon-hath ka sauda hai, ek ke badle ek hai.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hargiz barabari nahin, hamare shuhada zinda hain wahan rizq diye jate hain aur tumhare maqtool jahannam mein azab kiye ja rahe hain. Phir Abu Sufyan bola tumhare maqtool mein tum dekhoge ke baaz ke kaan naak waghera kaat liye gaye hain lekin main ne na yeh kaha na use roka na use main ne pasand kiya na mujhe yeh bhala maloom hua na bura. Ab jo dekha to maloom hua ke Hazrat Hamza (R.A) ka pait chaak kar diya gaya tha aur Hinda ne unka kaleja le kar chabaya tha lekin nigal na saki to ugal diya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya namumkin tha ke us ke pait mein Hamza ka zara sa gosht bhi chala jaye, Allah Ta'ala Hamza ke kisi uzw-e-badan ko jahannam mein le jana nahin chahta. Chunancha Hamza ke janaze ko apne samne rakh kar namaz-e-janaza ada ki, phir ek Ansari ka janaza laya gaya woh Hazrat Hamza ke pehlu mein rakha gaya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir namaz-e-janaza padhi, Ansari ka janaza utha liya gaya lekin Hazrat Hamza ka janaza wahin raha, isi tarah sattar shakhs laye gaye aur Hazrat Hamza ki sattar dafa janaze ki namaz padhi gayi (Musnad). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Bara (R.A) se marwi hai ke Uhud wale din mushrikon se hamari mudbher hui, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne teer-andazon ki ek jamaat ko alag jama diya aur unka sardar Hazrat Abdullah bin Jubair (R.A) ko banaya aur farma diya ke agar tum hamain un par ghalib aaya hua dekho to bhi yahan se na hatna aur woh hum par ghalib aa jayen to bhi tum apni jagah na chhodna. Ladai shuru hote hi Allah ke fazl se mushrikon ke qadam peeche hatne lage yahan tak ke aurtain bhi tehband ooncha kar kar ke pahadon mein idhar daudne lagin. Ab teer-andaz groh ghanimat ghanimat kehta hua neeche utar aaya, un ke ameer ne unhain harchand samjhaya lekin kisi ne un ki na suni, bas ab mushrikeen musalmanon ki peeth ki taraf se aan pade aur sattar buzurg shaheed ho gaye. Abu Sufyan ek teele par chadh kar kehne laga kya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hayat hain? Kya Abu Bakr (R.A) maujood hain? Kya Umar (R.A) zinda hain? Lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman se sahaba khush rahe to woh khushi ke mare uchhal pada aur kehne laga yeh sab hamari talwaron ke ghaat utar gaye agar zinda hote to zaroor jawab dete. Ek Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko taab-e-zabt na rahi, farmane lage, ae Allah ke dushman tu jhoota hai, bihamdillah hum sab maujood hain aur teri tabahi aur barbadi karne wale zinda hain. Phir woh baatein huin jo oopar bayan ho chuki hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jang-e-Uhud mein mushrikon ko hazimat hui aur Iblees ne aawaz lagayi ae Allah ke bando! Apne peeche ki khabar lo, agli jamaatein pichli jamaaton par toot padin. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne dekha ke musalmanon ki talwaren un ke walid Hazrat Yaman (R.A) par baras rahi hain, harchand kehte rahe ke ae Allah ke bando!

Yeh mere baap Yaman hain magar kaun sunta tha woh yunhi shaheed hogaye lekin Hazrat Huzaifa ne kuch na kaha balkay farmaya Allah tumhein maaf kare, Hazrat Huzaifa ki yeh bhalai unke aakhri dam tak un mein rahi, Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai Hazrat Zubair bin Awwam farmate hain main ne khud dekha ke mushrik musalmanon ke awwal hamlay mein hi bhaag kharay hue yahan tak ke un ki auratein Hinda waghera tehmed uthaye tez tez daur rahi thin lekin us ke baad jab teer-andazon ne markaz chora aur kuffar ne simat kar peechay ki taraf se hum par hamla kardiya udhar kisi ne aawaz lagayi ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) shaheed hogaye phir mamla bar-aks hogaya warna hum mushrikeen ke alam-bardaron tak pahunch chuke thay aur jhanda us ke haath se gir para tha lekin Umrah bin Alqama Harithiya aurat ne usay thaam liya aur Quraish ka majma phir yahan jama hogaya, Hazrat Anas bin Malik ke chacha Hazrat Anas bin Nadr (R.A) yeh rang dekh Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Talha waghera ke paas aate hain aur farmate hain tum ne kyun himmatein chor dein? Woh jawab dete hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toh shaheed hogaye. Hazrat Anas ne farmaya phir tum jee kar kya karoge? Yeh kaha aur mushrikeen mein ghusay phir larte rahe yahan tak ke Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat se ja mile (R.A), yeh Badr wale din jihad mein nahin pahunch sake thay toh ahd kiya tha ke aayinda agar koi mauqa aaya toh main dikha dunga chunancha is jang mein woh maujood thay jab musalmanon mein khalbuli machi toh unhon ne kaha Allah main musalmanon ke is kaam se mazoor hoon aur mushrikon ke is kaam se bari hoon phir apni talwar le kar aagay barh gaye raah mein Hazrat Saad bin Muaz se mile aur kehne lage kahan ja rahe ho? Mujhe toh jannat ki khushbu ki liptain Uhud pahar se chali aa rahi hain chunancha mushrikon mein ghus gaye aur bari be-jigri se lare yahan tak ke shahadat hasil ki assi se zyada teer-o-talwar ke zakhm badan par aaye thay pehchanay na jate thay ungli ko dekh kar pehchanay gaye (R.A), Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke ek haaji ne Baitullah Shareef mein ek majlis dekh kar poocha ke yeh kaun log hain? Logon ne kaha Quraishi hain poocha un ke sheikh kaun hain? Jawab mila Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) hain, ab woh aaya aur kehne laga main kuch daryaft karna chahta hoon Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya poocho us ne kaha aap ko is Baitullah ki hurmat ki qasam kya aap ko ilm hai ke (Hazrat) Usman bin Affan Uhud wale din bhaag gaye thay? Aap ne jawab diya haan. Kaha kya aap ko maloom hai ke woh Badr wale din bhi hazir nahin hue thay? Farmaya haan, kaha kya aap jante hain ke woh Bai'at-e-Rizwan mein bhi shareek nahin hue thay?

Farmaya yeh bhi theek hai, ab usne (khush hokar) takbeer kahi, Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya idhar aa, ab main tujhe pooray waqiyat sunaoon, Uhud ke din ka bhagna toh Allah Ta'ala ne maaf farma diya, Badr ke din ki ghair haziri ke baais yeh hua ke aap ke ghar mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sahibzadi thin aur woh us waqt sakht bimar thin toh khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un se farmaya tha ke tum na aao Madina mein hi raho tumhein Allah Ta'ala is jang mein hazir hone ka ajar de ga aur ghanimat mein bhi tumhara hissa hai, Bai'at-e-Rizwan ka waqia yeh hai ke unhein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makka walon ke paas apna paigham de kar Hazrat Usman ko bheja tha is liye ke Makka mein jo izzat unhein hasil thi kisi aur ko utni na thi unke tashreef le jaane ke baad yeh bai'at li gayi toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apna dahina hath khara kar ke kaha yeh Usman ka hath hai phir apne dusre hath par rakha (goya bai'at ki) phir us shakhs se kaha ab jao aur ise sath le jao phir farmaya aayat (Au tas'adoona) al-kh yani tum apne dushman se bhag kar pahar charh rahe thay aur maaray khauf-o-dehshat ke dusri janib tawajjah bhi nahin karte thay Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bhi tum ne wahin chor diya tha woh tumhein aawazein de rahe thay aur samjha rahe thay ke bhago nahin laut aao, Hazrat Suddi farmate hain mushrikeen ke is khufiya aur pur-zor aur achanak hamla se musalmanon ke qadam ukharr gaye kuch toh Madina ki taraf laut aaye kuch pahar ki choti par charh gaye Allah ke Nabi aawazein dete rahe ke Allah ke bando meri taraf aao Allah ke bando meri taraf aao, is waqia ka bayan is aayat mein hai, Abdullah bin Zahri shair ne is waqia ko nazm mein bhi ada kiya hai, An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us waqt sirf barah aadmiyon ke sath reh gaye thay Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek taweel hadith mein bhi in tamam waqiyat ka zikr hai, Dalail-un-Nabuwwat mein hai ke jab hazimat hui tab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath sirf gyarah shakhs reh gaye aur ek Hazrat Talha bin Ubaidullah thay, aap pahar par charhne lage lekin mushrikeen ne aaghera aap ne apne sathiyon ki taraf mutawajjah ho kar farmaya koi hai jo in se muqabla kare, Hazrat Talha ne is aawaz par foran labbaik kaha aur tayyar ho gaye lekin aap ne farmaya tum abhi thehar jao ab ek Ansari tayyar hue aur woh un se larnay lage yahan tak ke shaheed hue isi tarah sab ke sab ek ek kar ke shaheed ho gaye aur ab sirf Hazrat Talha reh gaye goya yeh buzurg har martaba tayyar ho jate thay lekin Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) unhein rok liya karte thay aakhir yeh muqabla par aaye aur is tarah jam kar lare ke un sab ki larai ek taraf aur yeh ek taraf is larai mein un ki ungliyan kat gayin toh zaban se hiss nikal gaya aap ne farmaya agar tum Bismillah keh dete ya Allah ka naam lete toh tumhein farishtay utha lete aur aasman ki bulandi ki taraf le charhte aur log dekhte rehte ab Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne sahaba ke majmay mein pahunch chuke thin.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Qais bin Hazim farmate hain main ne dekha Hazrat Talha ka woh haath jise unhon ne dhaal banaya tha shul ho gaya tha, Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas farmate hain mere paas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni tarkash se Uhud wale din tamam teer phaila diye aur farmaya tujh par mere maa baap fida hon le mushrikeen ko maar, aap utha utha kar dete jate the aur main taak taak kar mushrikeen ko maarta jata tha, us din main ne do shakhson ko dekha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke daayein baayein the aur sakht tareen jang kar rahe the, main ne na to us se pehle kabhi unhein dekha tha na us ke baad, yeh dono Hazrat Jibraeel aur Hazrat Mikaeel (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) the. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jo buzurg Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath bhagdar ke baad the aur ek ek ho kar shaheed huye the unhein aap farmate jate the ke koi hai jo inhein roke aur jannat mein jaye mera rafeeq hai.

Ubayy bin Khalaf ne Makkah mein qasam khayi thi ke main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl karunga, jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is ka ilm hua to aap ne farmaya woh to nahin balkay main Insha'Allah use qatl karunga. Uhud wale din yeh khabeeth sar-ta-pa lohay mein gharq zarah-e-baktar lagaye huye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf barha aur yeh kehta aata tha ke agar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bach gaye to main apne tayin halak kar dalunga. Idhar se Hazrat Mus'ab bin Umair is nahanjaar ki taraf barhe lekin aap shaheed ho gaye, ab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ki taraf barhe, us ka sara jism lohay mein chupa hua tha sirf zara si peshani nazar aa rahi thi, aap ne apna neza taak kar wahin lagaya jo theek nishane par baitha aur yeh tewra kar ghore par se gira, go is zakhm se khoon bhi na nikla tha lekin us ki yeh halat thi ke bilbila raha tha. Logon ne use utha liya lashkar mein le gaye aur tashaffi dene lage ke aisa koi kaari zakhm nahin laga kyun is qadar namardi karta hai? Aakhir un ke ta'anon se majboor ho kar us ne kaha main ne suna hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai main Ubayy ko qatl karunga, sach mano ab main kabhi nahin bach sakta, tum is par na jao ke mujhe zara si kharash hi aayi hai, Allah ki qasam jis ke qabze mein meri jaan hai agar kul ahl-e-Zi-ul-Majaz ko itna zakhm is haath se lag jata to sab halak ho jate. Pas yunhi tarpte tarpte aur balkte balkte is jahannami ki halakat hui aur mar kar jahannam raseed hua.

Maghazi Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke jab yeh shakhs Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne hua to sahaba ne us ke muqable ki khwahish ki lekin aap ne unhein rok diya aur farmaya ise aane do, jab woh qareeb aa gaya to aap ne Hazrat Harith bin Samma se neza le kar us par hamla kiya, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke haath mein neza dekhte hi woh kaanp utha, hum ne usi waqt samajh liya ke us ki khair nahin, aap ne us ki gardan par waar kiya aur woh larkhara kar ghore par se gira. Hazrat Ibn Umar ka (khwab mein) dehshat-naak sholay uthte huye dekhna aur dekhna ke ek shakhs ko zanjeeron mein jakre huye is aag mein ghasita ja raha hai aur woh pyas pyas kar raha hai aur dusra shakhs kehta hai ise pani na dena yeh paighambar ke haath ka mara hua hai, yeh Ubayy bin Khalaf hai.

Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai aap apne samne ke chaar danton ki taraf jinhein mushrikeen ne Uhud wale din shaheed kiya tha ishara kar ke farma rahe the Allah ka sakht-tar ghazab un logon par hai jinhon ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath yeh kiya aur us par bhi Allah Ta'ala ka ghazab hai jise Allah ka Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah ki raah mein qatl kare, aur riwayat mein yeh lafz hain ke jin logon ne Allah Ta'ala ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka chehra zakhmi kiya. Utba bin Abi Waqqas ke haath se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh zakhm laga tha, samne ke chaar daant toot gaye the, rukhsaar par zakhm aaya tha aur hont par bhi. Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas farmaya karte the mujhe jis qadar is shakhs ki hirs thi kisi aur ke qatl ki na thi.

Yeh shakhs bada bad-khulq tha aur sari qoum se is ki dushmani thi. Is ki burai mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman kafi hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko zakhmi karne wale par Allah sakht ghazabnak hai. Abdur Razzaq mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is ke liye bad-dua ki ke Aye Allah! Saal bhar mein yeh halak ho jaye aur kufr par is ki maut ho, chunancha yahi hua aur yeh bad-bakht kafir mara aur jahannum wasil hua.

Ek Muhajir ka bayan hai ke charon taraf se Uhud wale din Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par teeron ki barish ho rahi thi lekin Allah ki qudrat se woh sab pher diye jate thay. Abdullah bin Shahab Zuhri ne us din qasam kha kar kaha ke mujhe Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dikha do, woh aaj mere hath se bach nahin sakta, agar woh nijat pa gaya to meri nijat nahin. Ab woh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf lapka aur bilkul aap ke paas aa gaya, us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath koi na tha lekin Allah Ta'ala ne is ki aankhon par parda daal diya, use Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nazar hi na aaye. Jab woh namurad palta to Safwan ne use ta'ana zani ki, us ne kaha Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se mehfooz hain, hamare hath nahin lagne ke. Suno! Hum char shakhson ne un ke qatl ka pukhta mashwara kiya tha aur aapas mein ahd-o-paiman kiye thay, hum ne har-chand chaha lekin kamyabi na hui. Waqidi kehte hain lekin sabit shuda baat yeh hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki peshani ko zakhmi karne wala Ibn-e-Qami'ah aur hont aur danton par sadma pahunchane wala Utbah bin Abi Waqqas tha.

Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha R.A ka bayan hai ke mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A jab Uhud ka zikr farmate to saaf kehte ke is din ki tamam-tar fazilat ka sehra Hazrat Talha R.A ke sar hai. Main jab laut kar aaya to main ne dekha ke ek shakhs Huzoor ﷺ ki himayat mein jaan tikaye lad raha hai. Main ne kaha Allah kare yeh Talha ho. Ab jo qareeb aa kar dekha to Talha hi the R.A. Main ne kaha Alhamdulillah meri hi qoum ka ek shakhs hai. Mere aur mushrikon ke darmiyan ek shakhs tha jo mushrikeen mein khada hua tha lekin uske be-panah hamle mushrikon ki himmat tod rahe the. Gaur se dekha to woh Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah R.A the. Ab jo main ne baghaur Huzoor ﷺ ki taraf dekha to Aap ﷺ ke samne ke daant toot gaye hain, chehra zakhmi ho raha hai aur peshani mein zirah ki do kadiyan khub gayi hain. Main Aap ﷺ ki taraf lapka lekin Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Abu Talha ki khabar lo. Main ne chaha ke Huzoor ﷺ ke chehre mein se woh dono kadiyan nikaloon lekin Hazrat Abu Ubaidah R.A ne mujhe qasam de kar rok diya aur khud qareeb aaye aur haath se nikalne mein zyada takleef mehsoos kar ke daanton se pakad kar ek ko nikal liya lekin is mein unka daant bhi toot gaya. Main ne ab phir chaha ke dusri mein nikal loon lekin Hazrat Abu Ubaidah R.A ne phir qasam di to main ruk gaya, unhon ne phir dusri kadi nikali, ab ki martaba bhi unke daant toote. Is se farigh ho kar hum Hazrat Talha R.A ki taraf mutawajja hue, hum ne dekha ke sattar se zyada zakhm unhein lag chuke hain, ungliyan kat gayi hain, hum ne phir unki bhi khabar li. Huzoor ﷺ ke zakhm ka khoon Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri R.A ne choosa taake khoon tham jaye, phir un se kaha gaya ke kulli kar daalo lekin unhon ne kaha Allah ki qasam main kulli na karunga, phir maidan-e-jang mein chale gaye. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya agar koi shakhs Jannati shakhs ko dekhna chahta ho to inhein dekh le, chunancha yeh isi maidan mein shaheed hue. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ka chehra zakhmi hua, samne ke daant toote, sar ka khud toot gaya. Hazrat Fatima R.A khoon dhoti thin aur Hazrat Ali R.A dhaal mein paani laa laa kar daalte jaate the.
