kaha Aap (ﷺ) ne jo is tarah farmaya, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan ab bhi suno hum koi kaam sonpein use chahiye ke thoda bahut sab kuch laye jo use diya jaye woh le le aur jis se rok diya jaye ruk jaye, yeh hadith Muslim aur Abu Dawood mein bhi hai Hazrat Rafi' farmate hain ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) umooman namaz-e-Asr ke baad Banu Abdul Ash-hal ke haan tashreef le jate the aur taqreeban Maghrib tak wahin majlis rehti thi ek din Maghrib ke waqt wahan se wapas chale waqt tang tha tez tez chal rahe the Baqi mein aa kar farmane lage taf hai tujhe taf hai tujhe main samjha Aap (ﷺ) mujhe farma rahe hain chunancha main apne kapde theek thaak karne laga aur peeche reh gaya balkay yeh qabr falan shakhs ki hai ise main ne qabeelay ki taraf aamil bana kar bheja tha us ne ek chadar le li woh chadar ab aag ban kar us ke oopar bhadak rahi hai.

(Musnad-e-Ahmad) Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (R.A) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) maal-e-ghaneemat ke oont ki peeth ke chand baal lete phir farmate mera bhi is mein wahi haq hai jo tum mein se kisi ek ka, khayanat se bacho khayanat karne wale ki ruswai Qayamat ke din hogi sui dhage tak pahuncha do aur is se haqeer cheez bhi Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein nazdeek walon aur door walon se jihad karo, watan mein bhi aur safar mein bhi jihad Jannat ke darwazon mein se ek darwaza hai jihad ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala mushkilat se aur ranj-o-gham se nijat deta hai, Allah ki haddein nazdeek-o-door walon mein jaari karo Allah ke bare mein kisi malamat karne ki malamat tumhein na roke (Musnad-e-Ahmad) is hadith ka baaz hissa Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi marwi hai, Hazrat Abu Masood Ansari (R.A) farmate hain ke mujhe jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aamil bana kar bhejna chaha to farmaya ae Abu Masood jao aisa na ho ke main tumhein Qayamat ke din is haal mein paoon ke tumhari peeth par oont ho jo aawaz nikal raha ho jise tum ne khayanat se le liya ho, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) phir to main nahin jata aap ne farmaya achha main tumhein zabardasti bhejta bhi nahin (Abu Dawood) Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain agar koi patthar Jahannam mein dala jaye to sattar saal tak chalta rahe lekin teh ko nahin pahunchta khayanat ki cheez ko isi tarah Jahannam mein phenk diya jaye ga, phir khayanat wale se kaha jaye ga ja ise le aa, yahi ma'ani hain Allah ke is farman ke aayat (Wa man yagh-lul ya'ti bima ghalla yaumal qiyamah). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Khaibar ki jang wale din Sahaba-e-Kiram aane lage aur kehne lage falan shaheed hai falan shaheed hai jab ek shakhs ki nisbat yeh kaha to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hargiz nahin main ne use Jahannam mein dekha hai kyunke us ne ghaneemat ke maal ki ek chadar khayanat karli thi phir aap ne farmaya ae Umar bin Khattab tum jao aur logon mein munadi kardo ke Jannat mein sirf imandar hi jayenge chunancha main chala aur sab mein yeh nida kardi, yeh hadith Muslim aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain, Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek din Hazrat Umar ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Anees se sadaqat ke bare mein tazkira karte hue farmaya ke tum ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman nahin suna? ke aap ne sadaqat mein khayanat karne wale ki nisbat farmaya is mein jo shakhs oont ya bakri le le woh Qayamat wale din use uthaye hue aayega.

Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya haan yeh riwayat Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai, Ibn-e-Jarir mein Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubadah se marwi hai ke unhein sadaqat wasool karne ke liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bhejna chaha aur farmaya ae Sa'ad aisa na ho ke Qayamat ke din tu bilbilate oont ko utha kar laye to Hazrat Sa'ad kehne lage ke na main is ohday ko loon aur na aisa hone ka ehtemal rahe chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is kaam se unhein maaf rakha, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Muslim bin Abdul Malik ke sath Room ki jang mein Hazrat Salim bin Abdullah bhi thay ek shakhs ke asbab mein kuch khayanat ka maal bhi nikla sardar-e-lashkar ne Hazrat Salim se us ke bare mein fatwa poocha to aap ne farmaya mujh se mere baap Abdullah ne aur un se un ke baap Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne bayan kiya hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ke asbab mein tum chori ka maal pao use jala do, rawi kehta hai mera khayal hai yeh bhi farmaya aur use saza do, chunancha jab us ka maal bazaar mein nikala to us mein ek Quran Sharif bhi tha Hazrat Salim se phir us ki babat poocha gaya aap ne farmaya ise bech do aur us ki qeemat sadaqa kar do, yeh hadith Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, Imam Ali bin Madini aur Imam Bukhari waghera farmate hain yeh hadith munkar hai, Imam Darqutni farmate hain sahih yeh hai ke yeh Hazrat Salim ka apna fatwa hai, Hazrat Imam Ahmad aur un ke sathiyon ka qaul bhi yahi hai, Hazrat Hasan bhi yahi kehte hain Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain us ka asbab jala diya jaye aur use mamlook ki had se kam mara jaye aur us ka hissa na diya jaye, Abu Hanifa, Malik, Shaf'i aur jamhoor ka mazhab us ke barkhilaf hai yeh kehte hain us ka asbab na jalaya jaye balkay us ke misl use tazeer yani saza di jaye, Imam Bukhari farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khain ke janazay ki namaz se inkar kar diya aur us ka asbab nahin jalaya, Wallahu A'alam, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Quran Sharifon ke jab taghayyur ka hukum kiya gaya to Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmane lage tum mein se jis se ho sakay woh ise chhupa kar rakh le kyunke jo shakhs jis cheez ko chhupa kar rakh le ga usi ko le kar Qayamat ke roz aaye ga, phir farmane lage main ne sattar dafa Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani parha hai pas kya main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki parhayi hui qirat ko chhor doon? Imam Waki' bhi apni tafsir mein ise laye hain, Abu Dawood mein hai ke An-Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aadat-e-mubaraka thi ke jab maal-e-ghanimat aata to aap Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ko hukum dete ek martaba ek shakhs us ke baad baalon ka ek guchha le kar aaya aur kehne laga Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas yeh reh gaya tha aap ne farmaya kya tu ne Hazrat Bilal ki munadi suni thi? Jo teen martaba hui thi us ne kaha haan farmaya phir tu us waqt kyun na laya? Us ne uzr bayan kiya aap ne farmaya ab main hargiz na loonga tu hi ise le kar Qayamat ke din aana.

Allah do aalam phir farmata hai ke Allah ki shar'a par chal kar Allah Ta'ala ki razamandi ke mustahiq hone wale, us ke sawabon ko hasil karne wale, us ke azabon se bachne wale aur woh log jo Allah ke gazab ke mustahiq hue aur jo mar kar jahannam mein thikana payenge, kya yeh dono barabar ho sakte hain? Quran-e-Kareem mein dusri jagah hai ke Allah ki baton ko haq manne wala aur us se andha rehne wala barabar nahin, isi tarah farman hai ke jin se Allah ka achha wada ho chuka hai aur jo use pane wala hai woh aur duniya ka nafa hasil karne wala barabar nahin. Phir farmata hai ke bhalai aur burai wale mukhtalif darjon par hain, woh jannat ke darjon mein hain aur yeh jahannam ke tabqon mein, jaisa ke dusri jagah hai aayat (وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوْا) (Al-An'am: 132) har ek ke liye un ke a'maal ke mutabiq darajat hain. Phir farmaya Allah un ke a'maal dekh raha hai aur anqareeb un sab ko pura badla dega, na neki mari jayegi aur na badi badhai jayegi balki amal ke mutabiq hi jaza-saza hogi. Phir farmata hai ke mominon par Allah ka bada ehsan hai ke unhi ki jins se un mein apna paighambar bheja taake yeh us se baat-cheet kar sakein, puch-guch kar sakein, sath baith uth sakein aur puri tarah nafa hasil kar sakein, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوْٓا اِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَّوَدَّةً وَّرَحْمَةً) (Ar-Rum: 21) yahan bhi yahi matlab hai ke tumhari jins se tumhare jode us ne paida kiye aur jagah hai aayat (قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوْحٰٓى اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَآ اِلٰــهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيْمُوْٓا اِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوْهُ ۭ وَوَيْلٌ لِّـلْمُشْرِكِيْنَ) (Fussilat: 6) keh de ke main to tum jaisa hi insan hoon, meri taraf wahi ki jati hai ke tum sab ka mabood ek hi hai, aur farman hai aayat (وَمَآ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ اِلَّآ اِنَّهُمْ لَيَاْكُلُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُوْنَ فِي الْاَسْوَاقِ) (Al-Furqan: 20) yani tujh se pehle bhi hum ne mardon ko wahi ki thi jo bastiyon ke rehne wale the aur irshad hai aayat (يٰمَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ اَلَمْ يَاْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنْكُمْ يَقُصُّوْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِيْ وَيُنْذِرُوْنَكُمْ لِقَاۗءَ يَوْمِكُمْ ھٰذَا) (Al-An'am: 130) yani ae jino aur insano kya tumhare paas tum mein se hi rasool nahin aaye the? Al-garaz yeh pura ehsan hai ke makhlooq ki taraf unhi mein se rasool bheje gaye taake woh paas baith uth kar baar-baar sawal-jawab kar ke puri tarah deen seekh lein, pas Allah Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai ke woh Allah ki aayatein yani Quran-e-Kareem unhein padhata hai aur achhi baton ka hukum de kar aur buraiyon se rok kar un ki janon ki pakeezgi karta hai aur shirk-o-jahiliyat ki napaki ke asraat se zail karta hai aur unhein kitab aur sunnat sikhata hai.

Is Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aane se pehle toh yeh saaf bhatke hue thay, zahir burai aur poori jahalat mein thay.

Uswa-e-Hasna ke maalik Nabi Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi par aur Musalmanon par apna ehsan jatata hai ke Nabi ke manne walon aur unki nafarmani se bachne walon ke liye Allah ne Nabi ke dil ko narm kardiya hai. Agar uski rahmat na hoti toh itni narmi aur aasani na hoti. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain 'ma' silah hai jo marifa ke sath Arab mila diya karte hain, jaise aayat (فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِمْ مِّيْثَاقَهُمْ) (Surah An-Nisa: 155) mein aur nakira ke sath bhi mila dete hain jaise aayat (عما قلیل) mein, isi tarah yahan hai, yani Allah ki rahmat se toh unke liye narm dil hua hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain yeh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke akhlaq hain jin par aap ki ba'sat hui hai. Yeh aayat theek us aayat jaisi hai aayat (لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ) al-kh, yani tumhare paas tum hi mein se ek Rasool aaye jis par tumhari mushaqqat garan guzarti hai, jo tumhari bhalai ke harees hain, jo mominon par shafqat aur raham karne wale hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu Umamah Bahili (R.A) ka hath pakad kar farmaya, "Aye Abu Umamah! Ba'z momin woh hain jin ke liye mera dil tadap uthta hai." (Fazzan) se murad yahan sakht kalam hai, kyunke is ke baad (Ghaleez-ul-Qalb) ka lafz hai, yani sakht dil. Farman hai ke Nabi-e-Akram! Tum sakht kalam aur sakht dil hote toh yeh log tumhare paas se muntashir ho jate aur tumhein chhod dete, lekin Allah Ta'ala ne unhein aap ke jaan-nisar-o-shaida banadiya hai aur aap ko bhi unke liye mohabbat aur narmi ata farmayi hai, aur taake unke dil aap se lage rahein. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) farmate hain, "Main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifat ko agli kitabon mein bhi pata hoon ke aap sakht kalam, sakht dil, bazaron mein shor machane wale aur burai ka badla lene wale nahin, balkeh darguzar karne wale aur maafi dene wale hain." Tirmidhi ki ek ghareeb hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain, "Logon ki aao-bhagat, khair-khwahi aur chashm-poshi ka mujhe Allah ki janib se isi tarah ka hukm kiya gaya hai jis tarah faraiz ki pabandi ka." Chunancha is aayat mein bhi farman hai, toh un se darguzar kar, unke liye istighfar kar, aur kamon ka mashwara un se liya kar. Isi liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke logon ko khush karne ke liye apne kamon mein un se mashwara kiya karte the, jaise ke Badr wale din qafle ki taraf badhne ke liye mashwara liya aur Sahaba (R.A) ne kaha ke agar aap samundar ke kinare par khada kar ke hamein farmayenge ke is mein kood pado aur is paar niklo toh hum sartabi na karenge aur agar hamein Bark-ul-Ghimad tak le jana chahein toh bhi hum aap ke sath hain. Hum woh nahin ke Musa (A.S) ke sahabiyon ki tarah keh dein ke tu aur tera Rab lad le hum toh yahan baithe hain, balkeh hum toh aap ke dayein bayein safein bandh kar jam kar dushmanon ka muqabla karenge. Isi tarah aap ne is baat ka mashwara bhi liya ke manzil kahan ho?

Aur Munzir bin Amr ne mashwara diya ke in logon se aage barh kar in ke samne ho, isi tarah Uhad ke mauqe par bhi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mashwara kiya ke aaya Madina mein reh kar ladein ya bahar niklein aur jamhoor ki raye yahi hui ke bahar maidan mein ja kar larna chahiye chunancha Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi kiya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Jang-e-Ahzab ke mauqe par bhi apne as-haab se mashwara kiya ke Madina ke phalon ki paidawar ka tihai hissa dene ka wada kar ke mukhalifeen se musalahat kar li jaye? To Hazrat Saad bin Ubada aur Hazrat Saad bin Mu'az (R.A) ne is ka inkar kiya aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mere is mashware ko qabool kar liya aur musalahat chor di, isi tarah Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hudaibiya wale din is amr ka mashwara kiya ke aaya mushrikeen ke gharon par dhawa bol dein? To Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne farmaya hum kisi se larnay nahin aaye hamara irada sirf umray ka hai chunancha isay bhi Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne manzoor farma liya, isi tarah jab munafiqeen ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwi sahiba Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) par tohmat lagayi to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ae musalmano mujhe mashwara do ke in logon ka main kya karoon jo mere ghar walon ko badnaam kar rahe hain. Allah ki qasam mere ghar walon mein koi burai nahin aur jis shakhs ke sath tohmat laga rahe hain wallah mere nazdeek to woh bhi bhala aadmi hai aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa (R.A) ki judai ke liye Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Usama se mashwara liya, gharz larai ke kamon mein aur deegar umoor mein bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sahaba se mashwara kiya karte thay, is mein ulama ka ikhtilaf hai ke yeh mashwaray ka hukum Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bator-e-wajoob ke diya tha ya ikhtiyari amr tha taake logon ke dil khush rahein, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is aayat mein Hazrat Abu Bakr aur Umar (R.A) se mashwara karne ka hukum hai (Hakim) yeh dono Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hawari aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke wazeer thay aur musalmanon ke baap hain (Kalbi). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in dono buzurgon se farmaya agar tumhari donon ki kisi amr mein ek raye ho jaye to main tumhare khilaf kabhi na karoon ga, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hota hai ke azm ke kya ma'ani hain to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jab aqalmand logon se mashwara kiya jaye phir in ki maan lena (Ibn-e-Marduyah). Ibn-e-Majah mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman bhi marwi hai ke jis se mashwara kiya jaye woh ameen hai, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasai waghera mein bhi yeh riwayat hai, Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) isay Hasan kehte hain, aur riwayat mein hai ke jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se mashwara le to usay chahiye bhali baat ka mashwara de (Ibn-e-Majah). Phir farmaya jab tum kisi kaam ka mashwara kar chuko phir is ke karne ka pukhta irada ho jaye to ab Allah Ta'ala par bharosa karo Allah Ta'ala bharosa karne walon ko dost rakhta hai. Phir dusri aayat ka irshad bilkul isi tarah ka hai jo pehle guzra hai ke aayat (Wa ma-n-nasru illa min indillahil Azizil Hakim) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 126) yani madad sirf Allah hi ki taraf se hai jo ghalib hai aur hikmaton wala hai, phir hukum deta hai ke mominon ko tawakkul aur bharosa zaat-e-bari par hi hona chahiye.

Phir farmata hai Nabi ko laiq nahin ke woh khayanat kare, Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain Badr ke din ek surkh rang chadar nahin milti thi toh logon ne kaha shayad Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne le li ho, is par yeh aayat utri (Tirmidhi). Aur riwayat mein hai ke munafiqon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par kisi cheez ki tohmat lagayi thi jis par aayat (Wa ma kana) utri. Pas sabit hua ke Allah ke Rasool, Rasoolon ke sardar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) har qisam ki khayanat se, beja taraf-dari se mubarra aur munazzah hain, khwah woh maal ki taqseem ho ya amanat ki adaigi ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Nabi janib-dari nahin kar sakta ke ba'az lashkariyon ko de aur ba'az ko unka hissa na pahunchaye. Is aayat ki yeh tafseer bhi ki gayi hai ke yeh nahin ho sakta ke Nabi Allah ki nazil karda kisi cheez ko chupa le aur ummat tak na pahunchaye.

Yaghul ke ma'ani aur khain: Yaghul ko "Ye" ke pesh se bhi padha gaya hai toh ma'ani yeh honge ke Nabi ki zaat aisi nahin ke unke paas wale unki khayanat karein. Chunancha Hazrat Qatada R.H aur Hazrat Rabi R.H se marwi hai ke Badr ke din aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke as-haab ne maal-e-ghaneemat mein se taqseem se pehle kuch le liya tha, is par yeh aayat utri (Ibn-e-Jareer). Phir khain logon ko daraya jata hai aur sakht azaab ki khabar di jati hai. Ahadith mein bhi iski babat kuch sakht wa'eed hai. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke sab se bada khayanat karne wala woh shakhs hai jo padosi ke khet ki zameen ya uske ghar ki zameen daba le, agar ek haath zameen bhi na-haq apni taraf kar le ga toh saaton zameenon ka tauq use pehnaya jaye ga. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai jise hum haakim banaye agar uska ghar na ho toh woh ghar bana sakta hai, biwi na ho toh kar sakta hai, iske siwa agar kuch aur le ga toh khain hoga. Yeh hadith Abu Dawood mein bhi deegar alfaaz se manqool hai, Ibn-e-Jareer ki hadith mein hai.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain main tum mein se us shakhs ko pehchanta hoon jo chilati hui bakri ko uthaye hue Qayamat ke din aayega aur mera naam le le kar mujhe pukarega, main keh doonga ke main Allah Ta'ala ke paas tujhe kaam nahin aa sakta, main toh pahuncha chuka tha. Ise bhi main pehchanta hoon jo oont ko uthaye hue aayega jo bol raha hoga, yeh bhi kahega ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ) ae Muhammad (ﷺ), main kahoon ga main tere liye Allah ke paas kisi cheez ka maalik nahin hoon, main toh tableegh kar chuka tha. Aur main ise bhi pehchanoon ga jo isi tarah ghore ko lade hue aayega jo hinhina raha hoga, woh bhi mujhe pukarega aur main keh doonga ke main toh pahuncha chuka tha, aaj kuch kaam nahin aa sakta. Aur us shakhs ko bhi main pehchanta hoon jo khalein liye hue hazir hoga aur keh raha ho ya Muhammad (ﷺ) ya Muhammad (ﷺ), main kahoon ga main Allah ke paas kisi nafa ka ikhtiyar nahin rakhta, main tujhe haq-o-batil bata chuka tha. Yeh hadees Sahah-e-Sitta mein nahin, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne qabeela-e-Azd ke ek shakhs ko hakim bana kar bheja jise Ibn-ul-Butaiha kehte thay, yeh jab zakat wasool kar ke aaye toh kehne lage yeh toh tumhara hai aur yeh mujhe tohfe mein mila hai. Nabi (ﷺ) mimbar par khade ho gaye aur farmane lage in logon ko kya ho gaya hai? Hum inhe kisi kaam par bhejte hain toh aa kar kehte hain yeh tumhara aur yeh hamare tohfe ka, yeh apne gharon mein hi baithe rehte phir dekhte ke inhe tohfa diya jata hai ya nahin? Us zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad (ﷺ) ki jaan hai, tum mein se jo koi is mein se koi cheez bhi le le ga woh Qayamat ke din use gardan par uthaye hue layega, oont hai toh chilla raha hoga, gaye hai toh bol rahi hogi, bakri hai toh cheekh rahi hogi. Phir aap ne haath is qadar buland kiye ke baghlon ki safedi hamein nazar aane lagi aur teen martaba farmaya ae Allah kya main ne pahuncha diya?

Musnad-e-Ahmad ki ek za'eef hadith mein hai aise tehseeldaron aur hakimon ko jo tohfay milein woh khayanat hain yeh riwayat sirf Musnad-e-Ahmad mein za'eef hai aur aisa maloom hota hai ke goya agli mutawwal riwayat ka mahasil hai, Tirmidhi mein hai Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) farmate hain mujhe Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Yaman mein bheja jab main chal diya toh Aap (ﷺ) ne mujhe bulwaya jab main wapas aaya toh farmaya main ne tumhein sirf ek baat kehne ke liye bulwaya hai ke meri ijazat ke baghair tum jo kuch loge woh khayanat hai aur har khayin apni khayanat ko liye hue Qayamat ke din aayega bas yahi kehna tha jao apne kaam mein lago, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek roz khade ho kar khayanat ka zikr kiya aur is ke bade bade gunah aur wabaal bayan farma kar hamein daraya phir janwaron ko liye hue Qayamat ke din aane, Huzoor (ﷺ) se faryad rasi ki arz karne aur Aap (ﷺ) ke inkar kar dene ka zikr kiya jo pehle bayan ho chuka hai is mein sone chandi ka zikr bhi hai, yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ) ne farmaya ae logo jise hum aamil banayein aur phir woh hum se ek sui ya us se bhi halki cheez chupaye toh woh khayanat hai jise le kar woh Qayamat ke din hazir hoga, yeh sun kar ek sanwle rang ke Ansari Hazrat Sa'eed bin Ubadah (R.A) khade ho kar kehne lage Huzoor (ﷺ) main toh aamil banne se dastbardar hota hoon, farmaya kyun? kaha Aap (ﷺ) ne jo is tarah farmaya, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan ab bhi suno hum koi kaam sonpein use chahiye ke thoda bahut sab kuch laye jo use diya jaye woh le le aur jis se rok diya jaye ruk jaye, yeh hadith Muslim aur Abu Dawood mein bhi hai Hazrat Rafi' farmate hain ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) umooman namaz-e-Asr ke baad Banu Abdul Ash-hal ke haan tashreef le jate the aur taqreeban Maghrib tak wahin majlis rehti thi ek din Maghrib ke waqt wahan se wapas chale waqt tang tha tez tez chal rahe the Baqi mein aa kar farmane lage taf hai tujhe taf hai tujhe main samjha Aap (ﷺ) mujhe farma rahe hain chunancha main apne kapde theek thaak karne laga aur peeche reh gaya balkay yeh qabr falan shakhs ki hai ise main ne qabeelay ki taraf aamil bana kar bheja tha us ne ek chadar le li woh chadar ab aag ban kar us ke oopar bhadak rahi hai.

(Musnad-e-Ahmad) Hazrat Ubada bin Samit (R.A) farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) maal-e-ghaneemat ke oont ki peeth ke chand baal lete phir farmate mera bhi is mein wahi haq hai jo tum mein se kisi ek ka, khayanat se bacho khayanat karne wale ki ruswai Qayamat ke din hogi sui dhage tak pahuncha do aur is se haqeer cheez bhi Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein nazdeek walon aur door walon se jihad karo, watan mein bhi aur safar mein bhi jihad Jannat ke darwazon mein se ek darwaza hai jihad ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala mushkilat se aur ranj-o-gham se nijat deta hai, Allah ki haddein nazdeek-o-door walon mein jaari karo Allah ke bare mein kisi malamat karne ki malamat tumhein na roke (Musnad-e-Ahmad) is hadith ka baaz hissa Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi marwi hai, Hazrat Abu Masood Ansari (R.A) farmate hain ke mujhe jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aamil bana kar bhejna chaha to farmaya ae Abu Masood jao aisa na ho ke main tumhein Qayamat ke din is haal mein paoon ke tumhari peeth par oont ho jo aawaz nikal raha ho jise tum ne khayanat se le liya ho, main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) phir to main nahin jata aap ne farmaya achha main tumhein zabardasti bhejta bhi nahin (Abu Dawood) Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain agar koi patthar Jahannam mein dala jaye to sattar saal tak chalta rahe lekin teh ko nahin pahunchta khayanat ki cheez ko isi tarah Jahannam mein phenk diya jaye ga, phir khayanat wale se kaha jaye ga ja ise le aa, yahi ma'ani hain Allah ke is farman ke aayat (Wa man yagh-lul ya'ti bima ghalla yaumal qiyamah). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Khaibar ki jang wale din Sahaba-e-Kiram aane lage aur kehne lage falan shaheed hai falan shaheed hai jab ek shakhs ki nisbat yeh kaha to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hargiz nahin main ne use Jahannam mein dekha hai kyunke us ne ghaneemat ke maal ki ek chadar khayanat karli thi phir aap ne farmaya ae Umar bin Khattab tum jao aur logon mein munadi kardo ke Jannat mein sirf imandar hi jayenge chunancha main chala aur sab mein yeh nida kardi, yeh hadith Muslim aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain, Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke ek din Hazrat Umar ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Anees se sadaqat ke bare mein tazkira karte hue farmaya ke tum ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka yeh farman nahin suna? ke aap ne sadaqat mein khayanat karne wale ki nisbat farmaya is mein jo shakhs oont ya bakri le le woh Qayamat wale din use uthaye hue aayega.

Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya haan yeh riwayat Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi hai, Ibn-e-Jarir mein Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubadah se marwi hai ke unhein sadaqat wasool karne ke liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bhejna chaha aur farmaya ae Sa'ad aisa na ho ke Qayamat ke din tu bilbilate oont ko utha kar laye to Hazrat Sa'ad kehne lage ke na main is ohday ko loon aur na aisa hone ka ehtemal rahe chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is kaam se unhein maaf rakha, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Muslim bin Abdul Malik ke sath Room ki jang mein Hazrat Salim bin Abdullah bhi thay ek shakhs ke asbab mein kuch khayanat ka maal bhi nikla sardar-e-lashkar ne Hazrat Salim se us ke bare mein fatwa poocha to aap ne farmaya mujh se mere baap Abdullah ne aur un se un ke baap Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne bayan kiya hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ke asbab mein tum chori ka maal pao use jala do, rawi kehta hai mera khayal hai yeh bhi farmaya aur use saza do, chunancha jab us ka maal bazaar mein nikala to us mein ek Quran Sharif bhi tha Hazrat Salim se phir us ki babat poocha gaya aap ne farmaya ise bech do aur us ki qeemat sadaqa kar do, yeh hadith Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, Imam Ali bin Madini aur Imam Bukhari waghera farmate hain yeh hadith munkar hai, Imam Darqutni farmate hain sahih yeh hai ke yeh Hazrat Salim ka apna fatwa hai, Hazrat Imam Ahmad aur un ke sathiyon ka qaul bhi yahi hai, Hazrat Hasan bhi yahi kehte hain Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain us ka asbab jala diya jaye aur use mamlook ki had se kam mara jaye aur us ka hissa na diya jaye, Abu Hanifa, Malik, Shaf'i aur jamhoor ka mazhab us ke barkhilaf hai yeh kehte hain us ka asbab na jalaya jaye balkay us ke misl use tazeer yani saza di jaye, Imam Bukhari farmate hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne khain ke janazay ki namaz se inkar kar diya aur us ka asbab nahin jalaya, Wallahu A'alam, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Quran Sharifon ke jab taghayyur ka hukum kiya gaya to Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmane lage tum mein se jis se ho sakay woh ise chhupa kar rakh le kyunke jo shakhs jis cheez ko chhupa kar rakh le ga usi ko le kar Qayamat ke roz aaye ga, phir farmane lage main ne sattar dafa Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani parha hai pas kya main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki parhayi hui qirat ko chhor doon? Imam Waki' bhi apni tafsir mein ise laye hain, Abu Dawood mein hai ke An-Hazoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aadat-e-mubaraka thi ke jab maal-e-ghanimat aata to aap Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ko hukum dete ek martaba ek shakhs us ke baad baalon ka ek guchha le kar aaya aur kehne laga Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas yeh reh gaya tha aap ne farmaya kya tu ne Hazrat Bilal ki munadi suni thi? Jo teen martaba hui thi us ne kaha haan farmaya phir tu us waqt kyun na laya? Us ne uzr bayan kiya aap ne farmaya ab main hargiz na loonga tu hi ise le kar Qayamat ke din aana.

Allah do aalam phir farmata hai ke Allah ki shar'a par chal kar Allah Ta'ala ki razamandi ke mustahiq hone wale, us ke sawabon ko hasil karne wale, us ke azabon se bachne wale aur woh log jo Allah ke gazab ke mustahiq hue aur jo mar kar jahannam mein thikana payenge, kya yeh dono barabar ho sakte hain? Quran-e-Kareem mein dusri jagah hai ke Allah ki baton ko haq manne wala aur us se andha rehne wala barabar nahin, isi tarah farman hai ke jin se Allah ka achha wada ho chuka hai aur jo use pane wala hai woh aur duniya ka nafa hasil karne wala barabar nahin. Phir farmata hai ke bhalai aur burai wale mukhtalif darjon par hain, woh jannat ke darjon mein hain aur yeh jahannam ke tabqon mein, jaisa ke dusri jagah hai aayat (وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوْا) (Al-An'am: 132) har ek ke liye un ke a'maal ke mutabiq darajat hain. Phir farmaya Allah un ke a'maal dekh raha hai aur anqareeb un sab ko pura badla dega, na neki mari jayegi aur na badi badhai jayegi balki amal ke mutabiq hi jaza-saza hogi. Phir farmata hai ke mominon par Allah ka bada ehsan hai ke unhi ki jins se un mein apna paighambar bheja taake yeh us se baat-cheet kar sakein, puch-guch kar sakein, sath baith uth sakein aur puri tarah nafa hasil kar sakein, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوْٓا اِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَّوَدَّةً وَّرَحْمَةً) (Ar-Rum: 21) yahan bhi yahi matlab hai ke tumhari jins se tumhare jode us ne paida kiye aur jagah hai aayat (قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوْحٰٓى اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَآ اِلٰــهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيْمُوْٓا اِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوْهُ ۭ وَوَيْلٌ لِّـلْمُشْرِكِيْنَ) (Fussilat: 6) keh de ke main to tum jaisa hi insan hoon, meri taraf wahi ki jati hai ke tum sab ka mabood ek hi hai, aur farman hai aayat (وَمَآ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ اِلَّآ اِنَّهُمْ لَيَاْكُلُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُوْنَ فِي الْاَسْوَاقِ) (Al-Furqan: 20) yani tujh se pehle bhi hum ne mardon ko wahi ki thi jo bastiyon ke rehne wale the aur irshad hai aayat (يٰمَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ اَلَمْ يَاْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنْكُمْ يَقُصُّوْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِيْ وَيُنْذِرُوْنَكُمْ لِقَاۗءَ يَوْمِكُمْ ھٰذَا) (Al-An'am: 130) yani ae jino aur insano kya tumhare paas tum mein se hi rasool nahin aaye the? Al-garaz yeh pura ehsan hai ke makhlooq ki taraf unhi mein se rasool bheje gaye taake woh paas baith uth kar baar-baar sawal-jawab kar ke puri tarah deen seekh lein, pas Allah Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai ke woh Allah ki aayatein yani Quran-e-Kareem unhein padhata hai aur achhi baton ka hukum de kar aur buraiyon se rok kar un ki janon ki pakeezgi karta hai aur shirk-o-jahiliyat ki napaki ke asraat se zail karta hai aur unhein kitab aur sunnat sikhata hai.

Is Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aane se pehle toh yeh saaf bhatke hue thay, zahir burai aur poori jahalat mein thay.

Ghazwat sachay musalman aur munafiq ko benaqab karne ka zariya bhi thay. Yahan jis museebat ka bayan ho raha hai yeh Uhud ki museebat hai jis mein sattar sahaba shaheed huay thay toh musalman kehne lagay ke yeh museebat kaise aa gayi? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai yeh tumhari apni taraf se hai, Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ka bayan hai ke Badr ke din musalmanon ne fidiya le kar jin kuffar ko chhor diya tha us ki saza mein aglay saal un mein se sattar musalman shaheed kiye gaye aur sahaba mein afra-tafri par gayi, Huzoor-e-Risalat Ma'ab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne ke chaar daant toot gaye, aap ke sar-e-mubarak par khud tha woh bhi toota aur chehra-e-mubarak lahu-luhan ho gaya, is ka bayan is aayat-e-mubaraka mein ho raha hai. (Ibn Abi Hatim, Musnad Ahmad bin Hanbal). Hazrat Ali R.A se marwi hai ke Jibraeel A.S Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur farmaya ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap ki qoum ka kuffar ko qaidy bana kar pakar lena Allah Ta'ala ko pasand na aaya, ab unhein do baton mein se ek ke ikhtiyar kar lene ka hukum dijiye ya toh yeh ke in qaidiyon ko maar dalein ya yeh ke in se fidiya wasool kar ke chhor dein magar phir in musalmanon se itni hi tadaad shaheed hogi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko jama kar ke dono batein pesh keen toh unhon ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh log hamaray qabail ke hain hamaray rishtedar bhai hain hum kyun na in se fidiya le kar unhein chhor dein aur is maal se hum taqat-o-quwwat hasil kar ke apne dusray dushmanon se jang karenge aur phir jo hum mein se utnay hi aadmi shaheed honge toh is mein hamari kya burai hai, chunancha jurmana wasool kar ke sattar qaidiyon ko chhor diya aur theek sattar hi ki tadaad musalmanon ki is ke baad Ghazwa-e-Uhud mein shaheed hui (Tirmidhi, Nasai). Pas ek matlab toh yeh hua ke khud tumhari taraf se yeh sab hua yani tum ne Badr ke qaidiyon ko zinda chhorna aur un se jurmana-e-jang wasool karna is shart par manzoor kiya tha ke tumharay bhi utnay hi aadmi shaheed hon, woh shaheed huay. Dusra matlab yeh hai ke tum ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nafarmani ki thi is baais tumhein yeh nuqsan pohancha, teer-andazon ko Rasool-e-Karam (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne hukum diya tha ke woh apni jagah se na hatein lekin woh hat gaye, Allah Ta'ala har cheez par qadir hai jo chahay karay jo irada ho hukum de koi nahin jo us ka hukum taal sakay.

Donon jamaton ki midbher ke din jo nuqsan tumhein pahuncha ke tum dushmanon ke muqable se bhag khade hue, tum mein se ba'az log shaheed bhi hue aur zakhmi bhi hue, yeh sab Allah Ta'ala ki qaza-o-qadar se tha, uski hikmat iski muqtazi thi. Iska ek sabab yeh bhi tha ke sabit qadam ghair mutazalzal iman wale sabir bande bhi maloom ho jayen aur munafiqeen ka haal bhi khul jaye, jaise Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool aur uske sathi jo raste mein hi laut gaye. Ek musalman ne unhein samjhaya bhi ke aao, Allah ki rah mein jihad karo ya kam az kam in hamla-awaron ko to hatao, lekin unhon ne taal diya ke hum to funoon-e-jang se be-khabar hain, agar jante hote to zaroor tumhara sath dete. Yeh bhi madafat mein tha ke woh musalmanon ke sath to rehte jis se musalmanon ki ginti zyada maloom hoti, ya duayen karte rehte ya tayariyan hi karte. Unke jawab ka ek matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke agar hamein maloom hota ke tum sach much dushmanon se ladoge to hum bhi tumhara sath dete, lekin hum jante hain ke ladai hone ki hi nahin. Seerat-e-Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke ek hazar aadmi le kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) maidan-e-Uhud ki janib badhe, aadhe raste mein Abdullah Ubay bin Salool bigad baitha aur kehne laga: Auron ki maan li aur Madina se nikal khade hue aur meri na mani. Allah ki qasam hamein nahin maloom ke hum kis faide ko nazar-andaz rakh kar apni janen dein? Logon kyun janen kho rahe ho? Jis qadar nifaq aur shak-o-shuba wale log the uski aawaz par lag gaye aur tihai lashkar le kar yeh paleed wapas laut gaya. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram (R.A) jo Bani Salma ke bhai the, harchand unhein samjhate rahe ke ae meri qoum! Apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko, apni qoum ko ruswa na karwa, unhein dushmanon ke samne chhod kar peeth na phero, lekin unhon ne bahana bana diya ke hamein maloom hai ke ladai hone hi ki nahin. Jab yeh bechare aajiz aa gaye to farmane lage: Jao tumhein Allah gharat kare Allah ke dushmano! Tumhari koi hajat nahin, Allah apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka madadgar hai. Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi unhein chhod kar aage badh gaye.

Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai ke woh us din ba-nisbat iman ke kufr se bahut hi nazdeek thay, is se maloom hota hai ke insan ke ahwal mukhtalif hain kabhi woh kufr se qareeb jata hai aur kabhi iman ke nazdeek ho jata hai, phir farmaya yeh apne munh se woh baatein banate hain jo un ke dilon mein nahin, jaise un ka yahi kehna ke agar hum jang jante to zaroor tumhara sath dete, halankeh unhein yaqeenan maloom tha ke mushrikeen door daraz se charhai kar ke musalmanon ko neest-o-nabood kar dene ki thaan kar aaye hain woh bade jale-kate hue hain kyunke un ke sardar Badr wale din maidan mein reh gaye thay aur un ke ashraf qatl kar diye gaye thay to ab woh in za'eef musalmanon par toot pade hain aur yaqeenan jang-e-azeem barpa hone wali hai, pas Janab-e-Bari farmata hai un ke dilon ki chupi hui baton ka mujhe bakhoobi ilm hai, yeh woh log hain jo apne bhaiyon ke bare mein kehte hain agar yeh hamara mashwara mante yahin baithe rehte aur jang mein shirkat na karte to hargiz na mare jate, is ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari Jalla Wa 'Ala ka irshad hota hai ke agar yeh theek hai aur tum apni is baat mein sache ho ke baith rehne aur maidan-e-jang mein na nikalne se insan qatl-o-maut se bach jata hai to chahiye ke tum maro hi nahin is liye ke tum to gharon mein baithe ho lekin zahir hai ke ek roz tum bhi chal basoge chahe tum mazboot burjon mein panah-gazein ho jao pas hum to tumhein tab sacha manein ke tum maut ko apni janon se taal do, Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain yeh ayat Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool aur us ke sathiyon ke bare mein utri hai.

Dusra matlab yeh hai ke tum ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nafarmani ki thi is baais tumhein yeh nuqsan pohancha, teer-andazon ko Rasool-e-Karam (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne hukum diya tha ke woh apni jagah se na hatein lekin woh hat gaye, Allah Ta'ala har cheez par qadir hai jo chahay karay jo irada ho hukum de koi nahin jo us ka hukum taal sakay.

Donon jamaton ki midbher ke din jo nuqsan tumhein pahuncha ke tum dushmanon ke muqable se bhag khade hue, tum mein se ba'az log shaheed bhi hue aur zakhmi bhi hue, yeh sab Allah Ta'ala ki qaza-o-qadar se tha, uski hikmat iski muqtazi thi. Iska ek sabab yeh bhi tha ke sabit qadam ghair mutazalzal iman wale sabir bande bhi maloom ho jayen aur munafiqeen ka haal bhi khul jaye, jaise Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool aur uske sathi jo raste mein hi laut gaye. Ek musalman ne unhein samjhaya bhi ke aao, Allah ki rah mein jihad karo ya kam az kam in hamla-awaron ko to hatao, lekin unhon ne taal diya ke hum to funoon-e-jang se be-khabar hain, agar jante hote to zaroor tumhara sath dete. Yeh bhi madafat mein tha ke woh musalmanon ke sath to rehte jis se musalmanon ki ginti zyada maloom hoti, ya duayen karte rehte ya tayariyan hi karte. Unke jawab ka ek matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke agar hamein maloom hota ke tum sach much dushmanon se ladoge to hum bhi tumhara sath dete, lekin hum jante hain ke ladai hone ki hi nahin. Seerat-e-Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke ek hazar aadmi le kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) maidan-e-Uhud ki janib badhe, aadhe raste mein Abdullah Ubay bin Salool bigad baitha aur kehne laga: Auron ki maan li aur Madina se nikal khade hue aur meri na mani. Allah ki qasam hamein nahin maloom ke hum kis faide ko nazar-andaz rakh kar apni janen dein? Logon kyun janen kho rahe ho? Jis qadar nifaq aur shak-o-shuba wale log the uski aawaz par lag gaye aur tihai lashkar le kar yeh paleed wapas laut gaya. Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram (R.A) jo Bani Salma ke bhai the, harchand unhein samjhate rahe ke ae meri qoum! Apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko, apni qoum ko ruswa na karwa, unhein dushmanon ke samne chhod kar peeth na phero, lekin unhon ne bahana bana diya ke hamein maloom hai ke ladai hone hi ki nahin. Jab yeh bechare aajiz aa gaye to farmane lage: Jao tumhein Allah gharat kare Allah ke dushmano! Tumhari koi hajat nahin, Allah apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka madadgar hai. Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi unhein chhod kar aage badh gaye.

Janab-e-Bari irshad farmata hai ke woh us din ba-nisbat iman ke kufr se bahut hi nazdeek thay, is se maloom hota hai ke insan ke ahwal mukhtalif hain kabhi woh kufr se qareeb jata hai aur kabhi iman ke nazdeek ho jata hai, phir farmaya yeh apne munh se woh baatein banate hain jo un ke dilon mein nahin, jaise un ka yahi kehna ke agar hum jang jante to zaroor tumhara sath dete, halankeh unhein yaqeenan maloom tha ke mushrikeen door daraz se charhai kar ke musalmanon ko neest-o-nabood kar dene ki thaan kar aaye hain woh bade jale-kate hue hain kyunke un ke sardar Badr wale din maidan mein reh gaye thay aur un ke ashraf qatl kar diye gaye thay to ab woh in za'eef musalmanon par toot pade hain aur yaqeenan jang-e-azeem barpa hone wali hai, pas Janab-e-Bari farmata hai un ke dilon ki chupi hui baton ka mujhe bakhoobi ilm hai, yeh woh log hain jo apne bhaiyon ke bare mein kehte hain agar yeh hamara mashwara mante yahin baithe rehte aur jang mein shirkat na karte to hargiz na mare jate, is ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari Jalla Wa 'Ala ka irshad hota hai ke agar yeh theek hai aur tum apni is baat mein sache ho ke baith rehne aur maidan-e-jang mein na nikalne se insan qatl-o-maut se bach jata hai to chahiye ke tum maro hi nahin is liye ke tum to gharon mein baithe ho lekin zahir hai ke ek roz tum bhi chal basoge chahe tum mazboot burjon mein panah-gazein ho jao pas hum to tumhein tab sacha manein ke tum maut ko apni janon se taal do, Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain yeh ayat Abdullah bin Ubay bin Salool aur us ke sathiyon ke bare mein utri hai.

Yahan jis museebat ka bayan ho raha hai yeh Uhud ki museebat hai jis mein sattar sahaba shaheed huay thay toh musalman kehne lagay ke yeh museebat kaise aa gayi? Bi'r-e-Ma'una ke shuhada aur Jannat mein un ki tamanna? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke go shaheed fi sabil-illah duniya mein maar dale jate hain lekin aakhirat mein un ki roohein zinda rehti hain aur rizq pati hain, is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Rasool-ullah (ﷺ) ne chalis ya sattar sahabiyon ko Bi'r-e-Ma'una ki taraf bheja tha. Yeh jamaat jab us ghaar tak pahunchi jo us kunwein ke oopar thi to unhon ne wahan parao kiya aur aapas mein kehne lage kaun hai? Jo apni jaan khatra mein daal kar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka kalma un tak pahunchaye. Ek sahabi is ke liye tayyar hue aur un logon ke gharon ke paas aa kar ba-aawaz-e-buland farmaya: "Aye Bi'r-e-Ma'una walo suno! Main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka qasid hoon, meri gawahi hai ke mabood sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ) us ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain." Yeh sunte hi ek kafir apna teer sambhale hue apne ghar se nikla aur is tarah taak kar lagaya ke idhar ki pasli se udhar ki pasli mein aar-paar nikal gaya. Us sahabi ki zaban se besakhta nikla: "Fuztu wa Rabbil Ka'bah" (Ka'be ke Allah ki qasam! Main apni murad ko pahunch gaya). Ab kuffar nishanat tatolte hue us ghaar par ja pahunche aur Aamir bin Tufail ne jo un ka sardar tha, un sab musalmanon ko shaheed kar diya. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke un ke bare mein Quran utra ke hamari janib se hamari qoum ko yeh khabar pahuncha do ke hum apne Rabb se mile, woh hum se raazi ho gaya aur hum us se raazi ho gaye. Hum in aayaton ko barabar padhte rahe, phir ek muddat ke baad yeh mansookh ho kar utha li gayin aur aayat (Wala tahsabanna) il-aakhirihi utri. (Muhammad bin Jareer). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai, Hazrat Masrooq farmate hain hum ne Hazrat Abdullah se is aayat ka matlab poocha to Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya: Hum ne Rasool (ﷺ) se is aayat ka matlab daryaft kiya tha to aap ne farmaya: "Un ki roohein sabz rang parindon ke qalib mein hain. Arsh ki qandeelain un ke liye hain, sari Jannat mein jahan kahin chahein charein chugein aur in qandeeliyon mein aaram karein. Un ki taraf un ke Rabb ne ek martaba nazar ki aur daryaft farmaya: Kuch aur chahte ho? Kehne lage: Aye Allah! Aur kya mangein? Sari Jannat mein se jahan kahin se chahein khayein piyein ikhtiyar hai, phir kya talab karein? Allah Ta'ala ne un se phir yahi poocha, teesri martaba yahi sawal kiya. Jab unhon ne dekha ke baghair kuch mange chara hi nahin to kehne lage: Aye Rabb! Hum chahte hain ke Tu hamari roohon ko jismon ki taraf lauta de, hum phir duniya mein ja kar Teri raah mein jihad karein aur mare jayein. Ab maloom ho gaya ke unhein kisi aur cheez ki haajat nahin to un se poochna chhod diya ke kya chahte ho?"

Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo log mar jayen aur Allah ke yahan behtari payen woh hargiz duniya mein aana pasand nahin karte magar shaheed ke woh tamanna karta hai ke duniya mein dobara lautaya jaye aur dobara rah-e-Allah mein shaheed ho kyunke shahadat ke darajat ko woh dekh raha hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se farmaya ae Jabir tumhein maloom bhi hai? Ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare walid ko zinda kiya aur un se kaha ae mere bande mang kya mangta hai? To kaha ae Allah duniya mein phir bhej taake main dobara teri rah mein mara jaun, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya yeh to main faisla kar chuka hun ke koi yahan dobara lautaya nahin jayega, un ka naam Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram Ansari tha Allah Ta'ala un se razamand ho, Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Hazrat Jabir farmate hain mere baap ki shahadat ke baad main rone laga aur abba ke munh se kapda hata hata kar baar baar un ke chehre ko dekh raha tha. Sahaba mujhe mana karte the lekin Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) khamosh the phir Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya Jabir ro mat jab tak tere walid ko uthaya nahin gaya farishte apne paron se us par saya kiye hue hain, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya jab tumhare bhai Uhad wale din shaheed kiye gaye to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne un ki ruhein sabz parindon ke qalib mein daal dein jo Jannati darakhton ke phal khayen aur Jannati nehron ka pani piyen aur Arsh ke saye tale wahan latakti hui qandeelon mein aaram-o-rahat hasil karein jab khane peene rehne sehne ki yeh behtareen ne'matein unhein milin to kehne lage kaash ke hamare bhaiyon ko jo duniya mein hain hamari in ne'maton ki khabar mil jati taake woh jihad se munh na pherein aur Allah ki rah ki ladaiyon se thak kar na baith rahein Allah Ta'ala ne un se farmaya tum be-fikr raho main yeh khabar un tak pahuncha deta hun chunancha yeh ayatein nazil farmayin, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hazrat Hamza (R.A) aur aap ke sathiyon ke bare mein ayatein utrin (Mustadrak Hakim) yeh bhi mufassireen ne farmaya hai ke Uhad ke shaheedon ke bare mein yeh ayatein nazil huin. Abu Bakr bin Marduyah mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne mujhe dekha aur farmane lage Jabir kya baat hai ke tum mujhe ghamgeen nazar aate ho? Main ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah mere walid shaheed ho gaye jin par baar-e-qarz bahut hai aur mere chhote chhote behan bhai bahut hain aap ne farmaya sun main tujhe bataun jis kisi se Allah ne kalam kiya parde ke peeche se kalam kiya lekin tere baap se aamne samne baat cheet ki farmaya mujh se mang jo mange ga dunga tere baap ne kaha Allah Azzawajal main tujh se yeh mangta hun ke tu mujhe duniya mein dobara bheje aur main teri rah mein dusri martaba shaheed kiya jaun, Rabb-e-Azzawajal ne farmaya yeh baat to main pehle hi muqarrar kar chuka hun ke koi bhi laut kar dobara duniya mein nahin jayega.

Kehne lage phir ae Allah mere baad walon ko in maratib ki khabar pahuncha di jaye chunancha Allah Ta'ala ne aayat (Wala tahsabanna) al-kh, farmayi, Baihaqi mein itna aur zyada hai ke Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya main toh ae Allah teri ibadat ka haq bhi ada nahin kar saka, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai shaheed log jannat ke darwaze par nahar ke kinare sabz gumbad mein hain, subh-o-sham unhein jannat ki ne'matein pahunch jati hain, dono ahadees mein tatbeeq yeh hai ke ba'az shuhada woh hain jin ki roohein parindon ke qalib mein hain aur ba'az woh hain jin ka thikana yeh gumbad hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke woh jannat mein se phirte phirate yahan jama hote hon aur phir yeh khane yahin khilaye jate hon wallahu a'lam, yahan par woh hadees bhi warid karna bilkul bar-mahal hoga jis mein har momin ke liye yahi basharat hai chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya momin ki rooh ek parind mein hai jo jannat ke darakhton ke phal khati phirti hai yahan tak ke qayamat wale din jabke Allah Ta'ala sab ko khara kare toh use bhi us ke jism ki taraf lauta de ga, is hadees ke rawiyon mein teen jaleel-ul-qadr imam hain jo un char imamon mein se hain jin ke mazahib mane ja rahe hain, ek toh Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal R.H aap is hadees ko riwayat karte hain, Imam Muhammad bin Idris Shafi'i R.H se un ke ustad hain Hazrat Imam Malik bin Anas R.A pas Imam Ahmad, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Malik teenon zabardast peshwa is hadees ke rawi hain. Pas is hadees se sabit hua ke imandaron ki rooh jannati parind ki shakal mein jannat mein rehti hai aur shaheedon ki roohein jaise ke pehle guzar chuka hai sabz rang ke parindon ke qalib mein rehti hain yeh roohein misl sitaron ke hain jo aam momineen ki roohon ko yeh martaba hasil nahin, yeh apne taur par aap hi udti hain, Allah Ta'ala se jo bohat bada meharban aur zabardast ehsanon wala hai hamari dua hai ke woh hamein apne fazl-o-karam se iman-o-islam par maut de, Ameen.

Phir farmaya ke yeh shaheed jin jin nematon aur aasayishon mein hain un se behad masroor aur bahut hi khush hain aur unhein yeh bhi khushi aur rahat hai ke un ke bhai band jo un ke baad rah-e-Allah mein shaheed honge aur un ke paas aayenge unhein aayinda ka kuch khauf na hoga aur apne peeche chhori hui cheezon par unhein hasrat bhi na hogi, Allah hamein bhi jannat naseeb kare, Hazrat Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke woh khush hain ke un ke kayi aur bhai band bhi jo jihad mein lage hue hain woh bhi shaheed ho kar un ki nematon mein un ke shareek-e-haal honge aur Allah ke sawab se fayda uthayenge, Hazrat Suddi farmate hain shaheed ko ek kitab di jati hai ke falaan din tere paas falaan aayega aur falaan din falaan aayega pas jis tarah duniya wale apni kisi ghair hazir ke aane ki khabar sun kar khush hote hain isi tarah yeh shuhada un shaheedon ki aane ki khabar se masroor hote hain, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke jab shaheed jannat mein gaye aur wahan apni manzilein aur rahmatein dekhein to kehne lage kaash ke is ka ilm hamare un bhaiyon ko bhi hota jo ab tak duniya mein hi hain taake woh jawan mardi se jaan tor kar jihad karte aur un jaghon mein ja ghuste jahan se zinda aane ki umeed na hoti to woh bhi hamari in nematon mein hissa daar bante pas Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko un ke is haal ki khabar pahuncha di aur Allah Ta'ala ne un se keh diya ke main ne tumhari khabar tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko de di hai is se woh bahut hi masroor-o-mahfooz hue, Bukhari Muslim mein Bir-e-Ma'una walon ka qissa bayan ho chuka hai jo sattar shakhs Ansari Sahabi thay aur ek hi din subah ke waqt ko bedardi se kuffar ne teh-e-tegh kiya tha jin qatilon ke haq mein ek mah namaz ki qunoot mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bad-dua ki thi aur jin par laanat bheji thi jin ke bare mein Quran ki yeh aayat utri thi ke hamari qoum ko hamari khabar pahunchao ke hum apne Rab se mile woh hum se raazi hua aur hum us se raazi ho gaye, woh Allah ki nemat-o-fazl ko dekh dekh kar masroor hain, Hazrat Abdur Rahman farmate hain yeh aayat (Yastabshiroon) tamam imandaron ke haq mein hai khwah shaheed hon khwah ghair. Bahut kam aise mauqe hain ke Allah Ta'ala apne nabiyon ki fazeelat aur un ke sawabon ka zikr na ho. Phir un sachay momineen ka bayan tareef ke sath ho raha hai. Jinhon ne Hamra-ul-Asad wale din hukm-e-Rasool par bawajood zakhmon se choor hone ke jihad par kamar kas li thi, mushrikeen ne musalmanon ko museebatein pahunchayin aur apne gharon ki taraf wapas chal diye.

Lekin phir unhein is ka khayal aaya ke mauqa achha tha, musalman haar chuke thay, zakhmi ho gaye thay, un ke bahadur shaheed ho chuke thay, agar hum aur jam kar ladte to faisla hi ho jata. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ka yeh irada maloom kar ke musalmanon ko tayyar karne lage ke mere sath chalo, hum in mushrikeen ke peeche jayen taake un par ra'ab tari ho aur yeh jaan lein ke musalman abhi kamzor nahin hue. Uhud mein jo log majood thay sirf unhi ko sath chalne ka hukum mila, haan sirf Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) ko un ke ilawa bhi sath liya. Is aawaz par bhi musalmanon ne labbaik kahi, bawajood yeh ke zakhmon mein choor aur khoon mein sharabor thay lekin Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at ke liye kamar basta ho gaye. Hazrat Ikrama (R.A) ka bayan hai ke jab mushrikeen Uhud se laute to raste mein sochne lage ke na to tum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl kiya, na musalmanon ki aurton ko pakda, afsos tum ne kuch na kiya, wapas lauto. Jab yeh khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pahunchi to aap ne musalmanon ko tayyari ka hukum diya, yeh tayyar ho gaye aur mushrikeen ke ta'aqub mein chal pade yahan tak ke Hamra-ul-Asad tak ya "Bi'r Abi Ainiyah" tak pahunch gaye. Mushrikeen ke dil ra'ab-o-khauf se bhar gaye aur yeh keh kar Makkah ki taraf chal diye ke agle saal dekha jayega. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi wapas Madina tashreef laye, yeh bhi bil-istiqlal ek alag ladai gini jati hai, isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Uhud ki ladai pandrah Shawwal baroz hafta hui thi, solahwein tareekh baroz itwar munadi-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne nida di ke logo dushman ke ta'aqub mein chalo aur wahi log chalein jo kal maidan mein thay. Is aawaz par Hazrat Jabir (R.A) hazir hue aur arz karne lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kal ki ladai mein main na tha is liye ke mere walid Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne mujh se kaha bete tumhare sath yeh chhoti chhoti behnein hain, ise to na main pasand karoon aur na tu ke inhein yahan tanha chhod kar dono hi chal dein, ek jayega aur ek yahan rahega.

Mujh se yeh nahin ho sakta ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ham-rikab tum jao aur main baitha rahoon, is liye meri khwahish hai ke tum apni behnon ke paas raho aur main jata hoon. Is wajah se main toh wahan raha aur mere walid aap ke sath aaye. Ab meri ain tamanna hai ke aaj mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main aap ke sath chaloon. Chunancha aap ne ijazat di. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka safar is gharz se tha ke dushman dehal jaye aur peeche aata hua dekh kar samajh le ke in mein bahut kuch quwwat hai aur hamare muqable se yeh aajiz nahin. Qabeela Banu Abdul Ash-hal ke ek sahabi ka bayan hai ke Ghazwa-e-Uhud mein hum dono bhai shamil thay aur sakht zakhmi ho kar hum lautay thay. Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke munadi ne dushman ke peeche jaane ki nida di toh hum dono bhaiyon ne aapas mein kaha ke afsos! Na hamare paas sawari hai ke us par sawar ho kar Allah ke Nabi ke sath jayen, na zakhmon ke maaray jism mein itni taqat hai ke paidal sath ho len. Afsos ke yeh ghazwa hamare hath se nikal jayega, hamare beshumar gehre zakhm hamein aaj jaane se rok denge. Lekin phir hum ne himmat bandhi. Mujhe apne bhai ki nisbat zara halkay zakhm thay, jab mere bhai bilkul aajiz aa jatay, qadam na uthta toh main unhein joon-ton kar ke utha leta, jab thak jata utaar deta, yunhi joon-ton kar ke hum lashkar-gah tak pahunch hi gaye. (R.A) (Seerat-e-Ibn Ishaq). Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne Hazrat Urwa se kaha: Ae bhanjay! Tere dono baap unhi logon mein se hain jin ke bare mein aayat (Allazeena istajabu lillahi war-rasooli mim ba'di ma asabahumul qarhu lillazeena ahsanu minhum wattaqau ajrun azeem) (Surah Al-Imran: 172) aayat utri hai. Yani Hazrat Zubair aur Hazrat Siddiq (R.A), jabke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Uhud ki jang mein nuqsan pahuncha aur mushrikeen aagay chalay toh aap ko khayal hua ke kahin yeh phir wapas na lautain, lehaza aap ne farmaya: Koi hai jo in ke peeche jaye? Is par sattar shakhs is kaam ke liye musta'id ho gaye jin mein ek Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) thay, dusre Hazrat Zubair (R.A) thay. Yeh riwayat aur bahut si asnaad se bahut si kitabon mein hai. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se farmaya ke tere dono baap un logon mein se hain, lekin yeh marfoo' bayan karna mehez khata hai, is liye bhi ke is ki asnaad mein siqa rawiyon ka ikhtilaf hai jo Hazrat Ayesha ke baap dada mein se nahin. Sahih yeh hai ke yeh baat Hazrat Ayesha ne apne bhanjay Hazrat Asma bint-e-Abi Bakr ke ladke Urwa se kahi hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka bayan hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Abu Sufyan ke dil mein ra'ab daal diya aur bawajood-e-ke woh Uhud ki ladai mein qadray kamyab ho gaya tha lekin taham Makkah ki taraf chal diya. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Abu Sufyan tumhein nuqsan pahuncha kar laut gaya hai.

Allah Ta'ala ne us ke dil ko mar'oob kar diya hai, Uhud ki ladai Shawwal mein hui thi aur tajir log Zi-Qa'dah mein Madina aate thay aur Badr-e-Sughra mein apne dere har saal is maah mein dala karte thay is dafa bhi is waqia ke baad log aaye musalman apne zakhmon mein choor thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se apni takaleef bayan karte thay aur sakht sadma mein thay. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is baat par aamada kiya ke woh aap ke saath chalein aur farmaya ke yeh log ab kooch kar jayenge aur phir Hajj ko aayenge aur phir agle saal tak yeh taqat unhein hasil nahin hogi lekin shaitan ne apne doston ko dhamkana aur behkana shuru kar diya aur kehne laga ke in logon ne tumhare istisal ke liye lashkar tayyar kar liye hain jis bina par log dheele pad gaye aap ne farmaya suno khwah tum mein se ek bhi na chale main tan-tanha jaunga phir aap ke raghbat dilane par Hazrat Abu Bakr, Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Usman, Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Zubair, Hazrat Sa'ad, Hazrat Talha, Hazrat Abdur-Rahman bin Auf, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood, Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman, Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah wagaira sattar sahaba aap ke zer-e-rikab chalne par aamada hue (R.A), yeh mubarak lashkar Abu Sufyan ki justuju mein Badr-e-Sughra tak pahunch gaya inhi ki is fazeelat aur jaan-bazi ka zikr is mubarak aayat mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is safar mein Madina se aath meel Hamra-ul-Asad tak pahunch gaye. Madina mein apna naib aap ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Um-e-Maktum (R.A) ko banaya tha.

Wahan Aap ne peer, mangal, budh tak qayam kiya phir Madina laut aaye, asna-e-qayam mein qabeela-e-Khuza'a ka sardar Ma'bad Khuza'i yahan se nikla tha yeh khud mushrik tha lekin is pooray qabeelay se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sulh-o-safai thi. Is qabeela ke mushrik, momin sab Aap ke khair khwah thay. Is ne kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sathiyon ko jo takleef pahunchi us par hamain sakht ranj hai, Allah Ta'ala Aap ko kamyabi ki khushi naseeb farmaye. Hamra-e-Asad par Aap pahunchay magar is se pehlay Abu Sufyan chal diya tha, go us ne aur us ke sathiyon ne wapas aanay ka irada kiya tha ke jab hum un par ghalib aa gaye, unhain qatl kiya, mara peeta, zakhmi kiya phir adhoora kaam kyun chhorein? Wapas ja kar sab ko teh-e-tegh kar dein. Yeh mashwaray ho hi rahay thay ke Ma'bad Khuza'i wahan pahuncha. Abu Sufyan ne us se poocha kaho kya khabrein hain? Us ne kaha Aanhuzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ma'a sahaba ke tum logon ke ta'aqub mein aa rahay hain, woh log sakht gussay mein hain, jo pehlay larai mein shareek na thay woh bhi shamil ho gaye hain, sab ke tewar badlay huay hain aur bharpoor taqat ke sath hamla-awar ho rahay hain, main ne to aisa lashkar kabhi dekha nahin. Yeh sun kar Abu Sufyan ke hathon ke totay ur gaye aur kehne laga achha hi hua jo tum se mulaqat ho gayi warna hum to khud un ki taraf jaanay ke liye tayyar thay. Ma'bad ne kaha hargiz yeh irada na karo aur meri baat ka kya hai, ghaliban tum yahan se kooch karnay se pehlay hi lashkar-e-Islam ke ghoron ko dekh logay, main un ke lashkar, un ke gussay, un ki tayari aur ulul-azmi ka haal bayan nahin kar sakta, main to tum se saaf kehta hoon ke bhago aur apni janain bachao, mere paas aisay alfaaz nahin jin se main musalmanon ke gaiz-o-ghazab aur tahawwur-o-shuja'at aur sakhti aur pukhtagi ka bayan kar sakoon, pas mukhtasar yeh hai ke jaan ki khair manatay ho to foran yahan se kooch karo. Abu Sufyan aur us ke sathiyon ke chhakkay chhoot gaye aur unhon ne yahan se Makka ki raah li. Qabeela-e-Abdul Qais ke aadmi jo karobar ki gharz se Madina ja rahay thay un se Abu Sufyan ne kaha ke tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh khabar pahuncha dena ke hum ne unhain teh-e-tegh kar denay ke liye lashkar jama kar liye hain aur hum wapas lautnay ke iraday mein hain, agar tum ne yeh paigham pahuncha diya to hum tumhain Souq-e-Ukaz mein bohat sari kishmish dein ge. Chunancha un logon ne Hamra-e-Asad mein aa kar bator-e-daraway ke namak mirch laga kar yeh wehshat-asar khabar sunayi lekin sahaba ne nihayat istiqlaal aur pamardi se jawab diya ke hamain Allah kaafi hai aur wohi behtareen karsaaz hai. Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne un ke liye aik pathar ka nishan muqarrar kar rakha hai agar yeh lautain ge to wahan pahunch kar is tarah mit jayain ge jaise guzashta kal ka din. Ba'az logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke yeh aayat Badr ke baray mein nazil hui hai lekin sahih-tar yahi hai ke Hamra-e-Asad ke baray mein nazil hui.

Matlab yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke dushmanon ne unhein pazmurda dil karne ke liye dushmanon ke saaz-o-samaan aur un ki kasrat-o-buhtat se daraya lekin woh sabr ke pahar sabit hue, un ke ghair mutazalzal yaqeen mein kuch farq na aaya balkeh woh tawakkul mein aur barh gaye aur Allah ki taraf nazrein kar ke us se imdad talab ki. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke aayat (Hasbunallahu) ilakh, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne aag mein parte waqt parha tha aur Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us waqt jab ke kafiron ke tiddi dal lashkar se logon ne Aap (ﷺ) ko khauf zada karna chaha us waqt parha. Ta'ajjub ki baat hai ke Imam Hakim ne is riwayat ko rad kar ke farmaya hai ke yeh Bukhari Muslim mein nahin. Bukhari ki ek riwayat mein hai ke Uhud ke mauqe par jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ko kuffar ke lashkaron ki khabar di gayi to Aap (ﷺ) ne yahi kalma farmaya aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke sardar ke mat-hat jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek chota sa lashkar rawana kiya aur raah mein Khuza'a ke ek a'arabi ne yeh khabar sunayi to Aap (ﷺ) ne yeh farmaya tha. Ibn Marduyah ki hadith mein hai Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain jab tum par koi bahut bada kaam aa pare to tum aayat (Hasbunallahu) aakhir tak parho. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke do shakhson ke darmiyan Huzoor (ﷺ) ne faisla kiya to jis ke khilaf faisla sadir hua tha us ne yahi kalma parha, Aap (ﷺ) ne use wapas bula kar farmaya buzdili aur susti par Allah ki malamat hoti hai, danayi, door-andeshi aur aqalmandi kiya karo, phir kisi amr mein phans jao to yahi parh liya karo. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai kis tarah be-fikr aur farigh ho kar aaram paun halankeh sahib-e-soor ne soor munh mein le rakha hai aur peshani jhukaye hukm-e-Allah ka muntazir hai ke kab hukm hua aur woh soor phoonk de, Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) hum kya parhein? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya aayat (Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil) (Alallahi tawakkalna) parho. Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Zainab (R.A) aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne fakhr se farmaya mera nikah khud Allah ne kar diya hai aur tumhare nikah wali warison ne kiye hain, Siddiqa (R.A) ne farmaya meri bara'at aur pakeezgi ki aayat Allah Ta'ala ne aasman se apne pak kalam mein nazil farmayi hain, Hazrat Zainab (R.A) use maan gayin aur poocha yeh batao tum ne Hazrat Safwan bin Mu'attal (R.A) ki sawari par sawar hote waqt kya parha tha? Siddiqa (R.A) ne farmaya dua (Hasbiyallahu wa ni'mal wakil), yeh sun kar Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne farmaya tum ne imaan walon ka kalma kaha tha. Chanancha is aayat mein bhi Rabb-e-Raheem ka irshad hai ke in tawakkul karne walon ki kifayat Allah Ta'ala ne ki aur un ke sath jo log burayi ka irada rakhte the unhein zillat aur barbadi ke sath paspa kiya, yeh log Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se apne shahron ki taraf baghair kisi nuqsan aur burayi ke laute, dushman apni makkariyon mein nakam raha, un se Allah khush ho gaya kyunke unhon ne us ki khushi ka kaam anjam diya tha, Allah Ta'ala bade fazl-o-karam wala hai.

Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka farman hai ke ne'mat toh yeh thi ke woh salamat rahe aur fazl yeh tha ke Huzoor ﷺ ne tajiron ke ek qafila se maal khareed liya jis mein bahut hi nafa hua aur is kul nafa ko Aap ﷺ ne apne sathiyon mein taqseem farma diya. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke Abu Sufyan ne Huzoor ﷺ se kaha ab wade ki jagah Badr hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya mumkin hai, chunancha wahan pahunche toh yeh darpok aaya hi nahin, wahan bazaar ka din tha, maal khareed liya jo nafa se bika, isi ka naam Ghazwa-e-Badr-e-Sughra hai. Phir farmata hai ke yeh Shaitan tha jo apne doston ke zariye tumhein dhamka raha tha aur geedar bhabkiyan de raha tha, tumhein chahiye ke in se na daro, sirf mera hi khauf dil mein rakho kyunke imandari ki yahi shart hai ke jab koi daraye dhamkaye aur deeni umoor se tumhein baaz rakhna chahe toh musalman Allah par bharosa kare, us ki taraf simat jaye aur yaqeen maane ke kaafi aur nasir wahi hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Alaysallahu bi-kaafin 'abdahu, wa yukhawwifunaka billadhina min dunihi) (Surah Az-Zumar: 36) kya Allah Jalla Shanahu apne bandon ko kaafi nahin? Yeh log tujhe us ke siwa auron se dara rahe hain (yahan tak ke farmaya) tu keh ke mujhe Allah kaafi hai, tawakkul karne walon ko isi par bharosa karna chahiye. Aur jagah farmaya Auliya-e-Shaitan se lado, Shaitan ka makr bada bouda hai. Aur jagah irshad hai yeh shaitani lashkar hai, yaad rakho shaitani lashkar hi ghate aur khasare mein hai. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Kataballahu la-aghlibanna ana wa rusuli, innallaha Qawiyyun 'Aziz) (Surah Al-Mujadilah: 21) Allah Ta'ala likh chuka hai ke ghalba yaqeenan mujhe aur mere rasoolon ko hi hoga, Allah Qawi aur Aziz hai. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Wa layansurannallahu man yansuruhu, innallaha la-Qawiyyun 'Aziz) (Surah Al-Hajj: 40) jo Allah ki madad karega us ki imdad farmaye ga. Aur farman hai aayat (Ya ayyuhalladhina amanu in tansurullaha yansurkum wa yuthabbit aqdamakum) (Surah Muhammad: 7) ae iman walo agar tum Allah ki madad karoge toh Allah tumhari bhi madad karega. Aur aayat mein hai aayat (Inna la-nansuru rusulana walladhina amanu fil-hayatid-dunya wa yawma yaqumul-ashhad) (Surah Ghafir: 51) bil-yaqeen hum apne rasoolon ki aur imandaron ki madad duniya mein bhi karenge aur us din bhi jis din gawah khade honge, jis din zalimon ko uzr-e-ma'zarat nafa na degi, un ke liye la'nat hai aur un ke liye bura ghar hai.

Bi'r-e-Ma'una ke shuhada aur Jannat mein un ki tamanna? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke go shaheed fi sabil-illah duniya mein maar dale jate hain lekin aakhirat mein un ki roohein zinda rehti hain aur rizq pati hain, is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Rasool-ullah (ﷺ) ne chalis ya sattar sahabiyon ko Bi'r-e-Ma'una ki taraf bheja tha. Yeh jamaat jab us ghaar tak pahunchi jo us kunwein ke oopar thi to unhon ne wahan parao kiya aur aapas mein kehne lage kaun hai? Jo apni jaan khatra mein daal kar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka kalma un tak pahunchaye. Ek sahabi is ke liye tayyar hue aur un logon ke gharon ke paas aa kar ba-aawaz-e-buland farmaya: "Aye Bi'r-e-Ma'una walo suno! Main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka qasid hoon, meri gawahi hai ke mabood sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ) us ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain." Yeh sunte hi ek kafir apna teer sambhale hue apne ghar se nikla aur is tarah taak kar lagaya ke idhar ki pasli se udhar ki pasli mein aar-paar nikal gaya. Us sahabi ki zaban se besakhta nikla: "Fuztu wa Rabbil Ka'bah" (Ka'be ke Allah ki qasam! Main apni murad ko pahunch gaya). Ab kuffar nishanat tatolte hue us ghaar par ja pahunche aur Aamir bin Tufail ne jo un ka sardar tha, un sab musalmanon ko shaheed kar diya. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke un ke bare mein Quran utra ke hamari janib se hamari qoum ko yeh khabar pahuncha do ke hum apne Rabb se mile, woh hum se raazi ho gaya aur hum us se raazi ho gaye. Hum in aayaton ko barabar padhte rahe, phir ek muddat ke baad yeh mansookh ho kar utha li gayin aur aayat (Wala tahsabanna) il-aakhirihi utri. (Muhammad bin Jareer). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai, Hazrat Masrooq farmate hain hum ne Hazrat Abdullah se is aayat ka matlab poocha to Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya: Hum ne Rasool (ﷺ) se is aayat ka matlab daryaft kiya tha to aap ne farmaya: "Un ki roohein sabz rang parindon ke qalib mein hain. Arsh ki qandeelain un ke liye hain, sari Jannat mein jahan kahin chahein charein chugein aur in qandeeliyon mein aaram karein. Un ki taraf un ke Rabb ne ek martaba nazar ki aur daryaft farmaya: Kuch aur chahte ho? Kehne lage: Aye Allah! Aur kya mangein? Sari Jannat mein se jahan kahin se chahein khayein piyein ikhtiyar hai, phir kya talab karein? Allah Ta'ala ne un se phir yahi poocha, teesri martaba yahi sawal kiya. Jab unhon ne dekha ke baghair kuch mange chara hi nahin to kehne lage: Aye Rabb! Hum chahte hain ke Tu hamari roohon ko jismon ki taraf lauta de, hum phir duniya mein ja kar Teri raah mein jihad karein aur mare jayein. Ab maloom ho gaya ke unhein kisi aur cheez ki haajat nahin to un se poochna chhod diya ke kya chahte ho?"

Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo log mar jayen aur Allah ke yahan behtari payen woh hargiz duniya mein aana pasand nahin karte magar shaheed ke woh tamanna karta hai ke duniya mein dobara lautaya jaye aur dobara rah-e-Allah mein shaheed ho kyunke shahadat ke darajat ko woh dekh raha hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se farmaya ae Jabir tumhein maloom bhi hai? Ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare walid ko zinda kiya aur un se kaha ae mere bande mang kya mangta hai? To kaha ae Allah duniya mein phir bhej taake main dobara teri rah mein mara jaun, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya yeh to main faisla kar chuka hun ke koi yahan dobara lautaya nahin jayega, un ka naam Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram Ansari tha Allah Ta'ala un se razamand ho, Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Hazrat Jabir farmate hain mere baap ki shahadat ke baad main rone laga aur abba ke munh se kapda hata hata kar baar baar un ke chehre ko dekh raha tha. Sahaba mujhe mana karte the lekin Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) khamosh the phir Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya Jabir ro mat jab tak tere walid ko uthaya nahin gaya farishte apne paron se us par saya kiye hue hain, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya jab tumhare bhai Uhad wale din shaheed kiye gaye to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne un ki ruhein sabz parindon ke qalib mein daal dein jo Jannati darakhton ke phal khayen aur Jannati nehron ka pani piyen aur Arsh ke saye tale wahan latakti hui qandeelon mein aaram-o-rahat hasil karein jab khane peene rehne sehne ki yeh behtareen ne'matein unhein milin to kehne lage kaash ke hamare bhaiyon ko jo duniya mein hain hamari in ne'maton ki khabar mil jati taake woh jihad se munh na pherein aur Allah ki rah ki ladaiyon se thak kar na baith rahein Allah Ta'ala ne un se farmaya tum be-fikr raho main yeh khabar un tak pahuncha deta hun chunancha yeh ayatein nazil farmayin, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hazrat Hamza (R.A) aur aap ke sathiyon ke bare mein ayatein utrin (Mustadrak Hakim) yeh bhi mufassireen ne farmaya hai ke Uhad ke shaheedon ke bare mein yeh ayatein nazil huin. Abu Bakr bin Marduyah mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne mujhe dekha aur farmane lage Jabir kya baat hai ke tum mujhe ghamgeen nazar aate ho? Main ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah mere walid shaheed ho gaye jin par baar-e-qarz bahut hai aur mere chhote chhote behan bhai bahut hain aap ne farmaya sun main tujhe bataun jis kisi se Allah ne kalam kiya parde ke peeche se kalam kiya lekin tere baap se aamne samne baat cheet ki farmaya mujh se mang jo mange ga dunga tere baap ne kaha Allah Azzawajal main tujh se yeh mangta hun ke tu mujhe duniya mein dobara bheje aur main teri rah mein dusri martaba shaheed kiya jaun, Rabb-e-Azzawajal ne farmaya yeh baat to main pehle hi muqarrar kar chuka hun ke koi bhi laut kar dobara duniya mein nahin jayega.

Kehne lage phir ae Allah mere baad walon ko in maratib ki khabar pahuncha di jaye chunancha Allah Ta'ala ne aayat (Wala tahsabanna) al-kh, farmayi, Baihaqi mein itna aur zyada hai ke Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya main toh ae Allah teri ibadat ka haq bhi ada nahin kar saka, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai shaheed log jannat ke darwaze par nahar ke kinare sabz gumbad mein hain, subh-o-sham unhein jannat ki ne'matein pahunch jati hain, dono ahadees mein tatbeeq yeh hai ke ba'az shuhada woh hain jin ki roohein parindon ke qalib mein hain aur ba'az woh hain jin ka thikana yeh gumbad hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke woh jannat mein se phirte phirate yahan jama hote hon aur phir yeh khane yahin khilaye jate hon wallahu a'lam, yahan par woh hadees bhi warid karna bilkul bar-mahal hoga jis mein har momin ke liye yahi basharat hai chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya momin ki rooh ek parind mein hai jo jannat ke darakhton ke phal khati phirti hai yahan tak ke qayamat wale din jabke Allah Ta'ala sab ko khara kare toh use bhi us ke jism ki taraf lauta de ga, is hadees ke rawiyon mein teen jaleel-ul-qadr imam hain jo un char imamon mein se hain jin ke mazahib mane ja rahe hain, ek toh Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal R.H aap is hadees ko riwayat karte hain, Imam Muhammad bin Idris Shafi'i R.H se un ke ustad hain Hazrat Imam Malik bin Anas R.A pas Imam Ahmad, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Malik teenon zabardast peshwa is hadees ke rawi hain. Pas is hadees se sabit hua ke imandaron ki rooh jannati parind ki shakal mein jannat mein rehti hai aur shaheedon ki roohein jaise ke pehle guzar chuka hai sabz rang ke parindon ke qalib mein rehti hain yeh roohein misl sitaron ke hain jo aam momineen ki roohon ko yeh martaba hasil nahin, yeh apne taur par aap hi udti hain, Allah Ta'ala se jo bohat bada meharban aur zabardast ehsanon wala hai hamari dua hai ke woh hamein apne fazl-o-karam se iman-o-islam par maut de, Ameen.

Phir farmaya ke yeh shaheed jin jin nematon aur aasayishon mein hain un se behad masroor aur bahut hi khush hain aur unhein yeh bhi khushi aur rahat hai ke un ke bhai band jo un ke baad rah-e-Allah mein shaheed honge aur un ke paas aayenge unhein aayinda ka kuch khauf na hoga aur apne peeche chhori hui cheezon par unhein hasrat bhi na hogi, Allah hamein bhi jannat naseeb kare, Hazrat Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke woh khush hain ke un ke kayi aur bhai band bhi jo jihad mein lage hue hain woh bhi shaheed ho kar un ki nematon mein un ke shareek-e-haal honge aur Allah ke sawab se fayda uthayenge, Hazrat Suddi farmate hain shaheed ko ek kitab di jati hai ke falaan din tere paas falaan aayega aur falaan din falaan aayega pas jis tarah duniya wale apni kisi ghair hazir ke aane ki khabar sun kar khush hote hain isi tarah yeh shuhada un shaheedon ki aane ki khabar se masroor hote hain, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke jab shaheed jannat mein gaye aur wahan apni manzilein aur rahmatein dekhein to kehne lage kaash ke is ka ilm hamare un bhaiyon ko bhi hota jo ab tak duniya mein hi hain taake woh jawan mardi se jaan tor kar jihad karte aur un jaghon mein ja ghuste jahan se zinda aane ki umeed na hoti to woh bhi hamari in nematon mein hissa daar bante pas Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko un ke is haal ki khabar pahuncha di aur Allah Ta'ala ne un se keh diya ke main ne tumhari khabar tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko de di hai is se woh bahut hi masroor-o-mahfooz hue, Bukhari Muslim mein Bir-e-Ma'una walon ka qissa bayan ho chuka hai jo sattar shakhs Ansari Sahabi thay aur ek hi din subah ke waqt ko bedardi se kuffar ne teh-e-tegh kiya tha jin qatilon ke haq mein ek mah namaz ki qunoot mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bad-dua ki thi aur jin par laanat bheji thi jin ke bare mein Quran ki yeh aayat utri thi ke hamari qoum ko hamari khabar pahunchao ke hum apne Rab se mile woh hum se raazi hua aur hum us se raazi ho gaye, woh Allah ki nemat-o-fazl ko dekh dekh kar masroor hain, Hazrat Abdur Rahman farmate hain yeh aayat (Yastabshiroon) tamam imandaron ke haq mein hai khwah shaheed hon khwah ghair. Bahut kam aise mauqe hain ke Allah Ta'ala apne nabiyon ki fazeelat aur un ke sawabon ka zikr na ho. Phir un sachay momineen ka bayan tareef ke sath ho raha hai. Jinhon ne Hamra-ul-Asad wale din hukm-e-Rasool par bawajood zakhmon se choor hone ke jihad par kamar kas li thi, mushrikeen ne musalmanon ko museebatein pahunchayin aur apne gharon ki taraf wapas chal diye.

Lekin phir unhein is ka khayal aaya ke mauqa achha tha, musalman haar chuke thay, zakhmi ho gaye thay, un ke bahadur shaheed ho chuke thay, agar hum aur jam kar ladte to faisla hi ho jata. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ka yeh irada maloom kar ke musalmanon ko tayyar karne lage ke mere sath chalo, hum in mushrikeen ke peeche jayen taake un par ra'ab tari ho aur yeh jaan lein ke musalman abhi kamzor nahin hue. Uhud mein jo log majood thay sirf unhi ko sath chalne ka hukum mila, haan sirf Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) ko un ke ilawa bhi sath liya. Is aawaz par bhi musalmanon ne labbaik kahi, bawajood yeh ke zakhmon mein choor aur khoon mein sharabor thay lekin Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at ke liye kamar basta ho gaye. Hazrat Ikrama (R.A) ka bayan hai ke jab mushrikeen Uhud se laute to raste mein sochne lage ke na to tum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl kiya, na musalmanon ki aurton ko pakda, afsos tum ne kuch na kiya, wapas lauto. Jab yeh khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pahunchi to aap ne musalmanon ko tayyari ka hukum diya, yeh tayyar ho gaye aur mushrikeen ke ta'aqub mein chal pade yahan tak ke Hamra-ul-Asad tak ya "Bi'r Abi Ainiyah" tak pahunch gaye. Mushrikeen ke dil ra'ab-o-khauf se bhar gaye aur yeh keh kar Makkah ki taraf chal diye ke agle saal dekha jayega. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi wapas Madina tashreef laye, yeh bhi bil-istiqlal ek alag ladai gini jati hai, isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Uhud ki ladai pandrah Shawwal baroz hafta hui thi, solahwein tareekh baroz itwar munadi-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne nida di ke logo dushman ke ta'aqub mein chalo aur wahi log chalein jo kal maidan mein thay. Is aawaz par Hazrat Jabir (R.A) hazir hue aur arz karne lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kal ki ladai mein main na tha is liye ke mere walid Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne mujh se kaha bete tumhare sath yeh chhoti chhoti behnein hain, ise to na main pasand karoon aur na tu ke inhein yahan tanha chhod kar dono hi chal dein, ek jayega aur ek yahan rahega.

Mujh se yeh nahin ho sakta ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ham-rikab tum jao aur main baitha rahoon, is liye meri khwahish hai ke tum apni behnon ke paas raho aur main jata hoon. Is wajah se main toh wahan raha aur mere walid aap ke sath aaye. Ab meri ain tamanna hai ke aaj mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main aap ke sath chaloon. Chunancha aap ne ijazat di. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka safar is gharz se tha ke dushman dehal jaye aur peeche aata hua dekh kar samajh le ke in mein bahut kuch quwwat hai aur hamare muqable se yeh aajiz nahin. Qabeela Banu Abdul Ash-hal ke ek sahabi ka bayan hai ke Ghazwa-e-Uhud mein hum dono bhai shamil thay aur sakht zakhmi ho kar hum lautay thay. Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke munadi ne dushman ke peeche jaane ki nida di toh hum dono bhaiyon ne aapas mein kaha ke afsos! Na hamare paas sawari hai ke us par sawar ho kar Allah ke Nabi ke sath jayen, na zakhmon ke maaray jism mein itni taqat hai ke paidal sath ho len. Afsos ke yeh ghazwa hamare hath se nikal jayega, hamare beshumar gehre zakhm hamein aaj jaane se rok denge. Lekin phir hum ne himmat bandhi. Mujhe apne bhai ki nisbat zara halkay zakhm thay, jab mere bhai bilkul aajiz aa jatay, qadam na uthta toh main unhein joon-ton kar ke utha leta, jab thak jata utaar deta, yunhi joon-ton kar ke hum lashkar-gah tak pahunch hi gaye. (R.A) (Seerat-e-Ibn Ishaq). Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne Hazrat Urwa se kaha: Ae bhanjay! Tere dono baap unhi logon mein se hain jin ke bare mein aayat (Allazeena istajabu lillahi war-rasooli mim ba'di ma asabahumul qarhu lillazeena ahsanu minhum wattaqau ajrun azeem) (Surah Al-Imran: 172) aayat utri hai. Yani Hazrat Zubair aur Hazrat Siddiq (R.A), jabke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Uhud ki jang mein nuqsan pahuncha aur mushrikeen aagay chalay toh aap ko khayal hua ke kahin yeh phir wapas na lautain, lehaza aap ne farmaya: Koi hai jo in ke peeche jaye? Is par sattar shakhs is kaam ke liye musta'id ho gaye jin mein ek Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) thay, dusre Hazrat Zubair (R.A) thay. Yeh riwayat aur bahut si asnaad se bahut si kitabon mein hai.
