Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se farmaya ke tere dono baap un logon mein se hain, lekin yeh marfoo' bayan karna mehez khata hai, is liye bhi ke is ki asnaad mein siqa rawiyon ka ikhtilaf hai jo Hazrat Ayesha ke baap dada mein se nahin. Sahih yeh hai ke yeh baat Hazrat Ayesha ne apne bhanjay Hazrat Asma bint-e-Abi Bakr ke ladke Urwa se kahi hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka bayan hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Abu Sufyan ke dil mein ra'ab daal diya aur bawajood-e-ke woh Uhud ki ladai mein qadray kamyab ho gaya tha lekin taham Makkah ki taraf chal diya. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Abu Sufyan tumhein nuqsan pahuncha kar laut gaya hai.

Allah Ta'ala ne us ke dil ko mar'oob kar diya hai, Uhud ki ladai Shawwal mein hui thi aur tajir log Zi-Qa'dah mein Madina aate thay aur Badr-e-Sughra mein apne dere har saal is maah mein dala karte thay is dafa bhi is waqia ke baad log aaye musalman apne zakhmon mein choor thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se apni takaleef bayan karte thay aur sakht sadma mein thay. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is baat par aamada kiya ke woh aap ke saath chalein aur farmaya ke yeh log ab kooch kar jayenge aur phir Hajj ko aayenge aur phir agle saal tak yeh taqat unhein hasil nahin hogi lekin shaitan ne apne doston ko dhamkana aur behkana shuru kar diya aur kehne laga ke in logon ne tumhare istisal ke liye lashkar tayyar kar liye hain jis bina par log dheele pad gaye aap ne farmaya suno khwah tum mein se ek bhi na chale main tan-tanha jaunga phir aap ke raghbat dilane par Hazrat Abu Bakr, Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Usman, Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Zubair, Hazrat Sa'ad, Hazrat Talha, Hazrat Abdur-Rahman bin Auf, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood, Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman, Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah wagaira sattar sahaba aap ke zer-e-rikab chalne par aamada hue (R.A), yeh mubarak lashkar Abu Sufyan ki justuju mein Badr-e-Sughra tak pahunch gaya inhi ki is fazeelat aur jaan-bazi ka zikr is mubarak aayat mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is safar mein Madina se aath meel Hamra-ul-Asad tak pahunch gaye. Madina mein apna naib aap ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Um-e-Maktum (R.A) ko banaya tha.

Wahan Aap ne peer, mangal, budh tak qayam kiya phir Madina laut aaye, asna-e-qayam mein qabeela-e-Khuza'a ka sardar Ma'bad Khuza'i yahan se nikla tha yeh khud mushrik tha lekin is pooray qabeelay se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sulh-o-safai thi. Is qabeela ke mushrik, momin sab Aap ke khair khwah thay. Is ne kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sathiyon ko jo takleef pahunchi us par hamain sakht ranj hai, Allah Ta'ala Aap ko kamyabi ki khushi naseeb farmaye. Hamra-e-Asad par Aap pahunchay magar is se pehlay Abu Sufyan chal diya tha, go us ne aur us ke sathiyon ne wapas aanay ka irada kiya tha ke jab hum un par ghalib aa gaye, unhain qatl kiya, mara peeta, zakhmi kiya phir adhoora kaam kyun chhorein? Wapas ja kar sab ko teh-e-tegh kar dein. Yeh mashwaray ho hi rahay thay ke Ma'bad Khuza'i wahan pahuncha. Abu Sufyan ne us se poocha kaho kya khabrein hain? Us ne kaha Aanhuzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ma'a sahaba ke tum logon ke ta'aqub mein aa rahay hain, woh log sakht gussay mein hain, jo pehlay larai mein shareek na thay woh bhi shamil ho gaye hain, sab ke tewar badlay huay hain aur bharpoor taqat ke sath hamla-awar ho rahay hain, main ne to aisa lashkar kabhi dekha nahin. Yeh sun kar Abu Sufyan ke hathon ke totay ur gaye aur kehne laga achha hi hua jo tum se mulaqat ho gayi warna hum to khud un ki taraf jaanay ke liye tayyar thay. Ma'bad ne kaha hargiz yeh irada na karo aur meri baat ka kya hai, ghaliban tum yahan se kooch karnay se pehlay hi lashkar-e-Islam ke ghoron ko dekh logay, main un ke lashkar, un ke gussay, un ki tayari aur ulul-azmi ka haal bayan nahin kar sakta, main to tum se saaf kehta hoon ke bhago aur apni janain bachao, mere paas aisay alfaaz nahin jin se main musalmanon ke gaiz-o-ghazab aur tahawwur-o-shuja'at aur sakhti aur pukhtagi ka bayan kar sakoon, pas mukhtasar yeh hai ke jaan ki khair manatay ho to foran yahan se kooch karo. Abu Sufyan aur us ke sathiyon ke chhakkay chhoot gaye aur unhon ne yahan se Makka ki raah li. Qabeela-e-Abdul Qais ke aadmi jo karobar ki gharz se Madina ja rahay thay un se Abu Sufyan ne kaha ke tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh khabar pahuncha dena ke hum ne unhain teh-e-tegh kar denay ke liye lashkar jama kar liye hain aur hum wapas lautnay ke iraday mein hain, agar tum ne yeh paigham pahuncha diya to hum tumhain Souq-e-Ukaz mein bohat sari kishmish dein ge. Chunancha un logon ne Hamra-e-Asad mein aa kar bator-e-daraway ke namak mirch laga kar yeh wehshat-asar khabar sunayi lekin sahaba ne nihayat istiqlaal aur pamardi se jawab diya ke hamain Allah kaafi hai aur wohi behtareen karsaaz hai. Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne un ke liye aik pathar ka nishan muqarrar kar rakha hai agar yeh lautain ge to wahan pahunch kar is tarah mit jayain ge jaise guzashta kal ka din. Ba'az logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke yeh aayat Badr ke baray mein nazil hui hai lekin sahih-tar yahi hai ke Hamra-e-Asad ke baray mein nazil hui.

Matlab yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke dushmanon ne unhein pazmurda dil karne ke liye dushmanon ke saaz-o-samaan aur un ki kasrat-o-buhtat se daraya lekin woh sabr ke pahar sabit hue, un ke ghair mutazalzal yaqeen mein kuch farq na aaya balkeh woh tawakkul mein aur barh gaye aur Allah ki taraf nazrein kar ke us se imdad talab ki. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke aayat (Hasbunallahu) ilakh, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne aag mein parte waqt parha tha aur Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us waqt jab ke kafiron ke tiddi dal lashkar se logon ne Aap (ﷺ) ko khauf zada karna chaha us waqt parha. Ta'ajjub ki baat hai ke Imam Hakim ne is riwayat ko rad kar ke farmaya hai ke yeh Bukhari Muslim mein nahin. Bukhari ki ek riwayat mein hai ke Uhud ke mauqe par jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ko kuffar ke lashkaron ki khabar di gayi to Aap (ﷺ) ne yahi kalma farmaya aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke sardar ke mat-hat jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek chota sa lashkar rawana kiya aur raah mein Khuza'a ke ek a'arabi ne yeh khabar sunayi to Aap (ﷺ) ne yeh farmaya tha. Ibn Marduyah ki hadith mein hai Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain jab tum par koi bahut bada kaam aa pare to tum aayat (Hasbunallahu) aakhir tak parho. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke do shakhson ke darmiyan Huzoor (ﷺ) ne faisla kiya to jis ke khilaf faisla sadir hua tha us ne yahi kalma parha, Aap (ﷺ) ne use wapas bula kar farmaya buzdili aur susti par Allah ki malamat hoti hai, danayi, door-andeshi aur aqalmandi kiya karo, phir kisi amr mein phans jao to yahi parh liya karo. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai kis tarah be-fikr aur farigh ho kar aaram paun halankeh sahib-e-soor ne soor munh mein le rakha hai aur peshani jhukaye hukm-e-Allah ka muntazir hai ke kab hukm hua aur woh soor phoonk de, Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) hum kya parhein? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya aayat (Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil) (Alallahi tawakkalna) parho. Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Zainab (R.A) aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne fakhr se farmaya mera nikah khud Allah ne kar diya hai aur tumhare nikah wali warison ne kiye hain, Siddiqa (R.A) ne farmaya meri bara'at aur pakeezgi ki aayat Allah Ta'ala ne aasman se apne pak kalam mein nazil farmayi hain, Hazrat Zainab (R.A) use maan gayin aur poocha yeh batao tum ne Hazrat Safwan bin Mu'attal (R.A) ki sawari par sawar hote waqt kya parha tha? Siddiqa (R.A) ne farmaya dua (Hasbiyallahu wa ni'mal wakil), yeh sun kar Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne farmaya tum ne imaan walon ka kalma kaha tha. Chanancha is aayat mein bhi Rabb-e-Raheem ka irshad hai ke in tawakkul karne walon ki kifayat Allah Ta'ala ne ki aur un ke sath jo log burayi ka irada rakhte the unhein zillat aur barbadi ke sath paspa kiya, yeh log Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se apne shahron ki taraf baghair kisi nuqsan aur burayi ke laute, dushman apni makkariyon mein nakam raha, un se Allah khush ho gaya kyunke unhon ne us ki khushi ka kaam anjam diya tha, Allah Ta'ala bade fazl-o-karam wala hai.

Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka farman hai ke ne'mat toh yeh thi ke woh salamat rahe aur fazl yeh tha ke Huzoor ﷺ ne tajiron ke ek qafila se maal khareed liya jis mein bahut hi nafa hua aur is kul nafa ko Aap ﷺ ne apne sathiyon mein taqseem farma diya. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke Abu Sufyan ne Huzoor ﷺ se kaha ab wade ki jagah Badr hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya mumkin hai, chunancha wahan pahunche toh yeh darpok aaya hi nahin, wahan bazaar ka din tha, maal khareed liya jo nafa se bika, isi ka naam Ghazwa-e-Badr-e-Sughra hai. Phir farmata hai ke yeh Shaitan tha jo apne doston ke zariye tumhein dhamka raha tha aur geedar bhabkiyan de raha tha, tumhein chahiye ke in se na daro, sirf mera hi khauf dil mein rakho kyunke imandari ki yahi shart hai ke jab koi daraye dhamkaye aur deeni umoor se tumhein baaz rakhna chahe toh musalman Allah par bharosa kare, us ki taraf simat jaye aur yaqeen maane ke kaafi aur nasir wahi hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Alaysallahu bi-kaafin 'abdahu, wa yukhawwifunaka billadhina min dunihi) (Surah Az-Zumar: 36) kya Allah Jalla Shanahu apne bandon ko kaafi nahin? Yeh log tujhe us ke siwa auron se dara rahe hain (yahan tak ke farmaya) tu keh ke mujhe Allah kaafi hai, tawakkul karne walon ko isi par bharosa karna chahiye. Aur jagah farmaya Auliya-e-Shaitan se lado, Shaitan ka makr bada bouda hai. Aur jagah irshad hai yeh shaitani lashkar hai, yaad rakho shaitani lashkar hi ghate aur khasare mein hai. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Kataballahu la-aghlibanna ana wa rusuli, innallaha Qawiyyun 'Aziz) (Surah Al-Mujadilah: 21) Allah Ta'ala likh chuka hai ke ghalba yaqeenan mujhe aur mere rasoolon ko hi hoga, Allah Qawi aur Aziz hai. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Wa layansurannallahu man yansuruhu, innallaha la-Qawiyyun 'Aziz) (Surah Al-Hajj: 40) jo Allah ki madad karega us ki imdad farmaye ga. Aur farman hai aayat (Ya ayyuhalladhina amanu in tansurullaha yansurkum wa yuthabbit aqdamakum) (Surah Muhammad: 7) ae iman walo agar tum Allah ki madad karoge toh Allah tumhari bhi madad karega. Aur aayat mein hai aayat (Inna la-nansuru rusulana walladhina amanu fil-hayatid-dunya wa yawma yaqumul-ashhad) (Surah Ghafir: 51) bil-yaqeen hum apne rasoolon ki aur imandaron ki madad duniya mein bhi karenge aur us din bhi jis din gawah khade honge, jis din zalimon ko uzr-e-ma'zarat nafa na degi, un ke liye la'nat hai aur un ke liye bura ghar hai.

Bi'r-e-Ma'una ke shuhada aur Jannat mein un ki tamanna? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke go shaheed fi sabil-illah duniya mein maar dale jate hain lekin aakhirat mein un ki roohein zinda rehti hain aur rizq pati hain, is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Rasool-ullah (ﷺ) ne chalis ya sattar sahabiyon ko Bi'r-e-Ma'una ki taraf bheja tha. Yeh jamaat jab us ghaar tak pahunchi jo us kunwein ke oopar thi to unhon ne wahan parao kiya aur aapas mein kehne lage kaun hai? Jo apni jaan khatra mein daal kar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka kalma un tak pahunchaye. Ek sahabi is ke liye tayyar hue aur un logon ke gharon ke paas aa kar ba-aawaz-e-buland farmaya: "Aye Bi'r-e-Ma'una walo suno! Main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka qasid hoon, meri gawahi hai ke mabood sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ) us ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain." Yeh sunte hi ek kafir apna teer sambhale hue apne ghar se nikla aur is tarah taak kar lagaya ke idhar ki pasli se udhar ki pasli mein aar-paar nikal gaya. Us sahabi ki zaban se besakhta nikla: "Fuztu wa Rabbil Ka'bah" (Ka'be ke Allah ki qasam! Main apni murad ko pahunch gaya). Ab kuffar nishanat tatolte hue us ghaar par ja pahunche aur Aamir bin Tufail ne jo un ka sardar tha, un sab musalmanon ko shaheed kar diya. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke un ke bare mein Quran utra ke hamari janib se hamari qoum ko yeh khabar pahuncha do ke hum apne Rabb se mile, woh hum se raazi ho gaya aur hum us se raazi ho gaye. Hum in aayaton ko barabar padhte rahe, phir ek muddat ke baad yeh mansookh ho kar utha li gayin aur aayat (Wala tahsabanna) il-aakhirihi utri. (Muhammad bin Jareer). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai, Hazrat Masrooq farmate hain hum ne Hazrat Abdullah se is aayat ka matlab poocha to Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya: Hum ne Rasool (ﷺ) se is aayat ka matlab daryaft kiya tha to aap ne farmaya: "Un ki roohein sabz rang parindon ke qalib mein hain. Arsh ki qandeelain un ke liye hain, sari Jannat mein jahan kahin chahein charein chugein aur in qandeeliyon mein aaram karein. Un ki taraf un ke Rabb ne ek martaba nazar ki aur daryaft farmaya: Kuch aur chahte ho? Kehne lage: Aye Allah! Aur kya mangein? Sari Jannat mein se jahan kahin se chahein khayein piyein ikhtiyar hai, phir kya talab karein? Allah Ta'ala ne un se phir yahi poocha, teesri martaba yahi sawal kiya. Jab unhon ne dekha ke baghair kuch mange chara hi nahin to kehne lage: Aye Rabb! Hum chahte hain ke Tu hamari roohon ko jismon ki taraf lauta de, hum phir duniya mein ja kar Teri raah mein jihad karein aur mare jayein. Ab maloom ho gaya ke unhein kisi aur cheez ki haajat nahin to un se poochna chhod diya ke kya chahte ho?"

Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo log mar jayen aur Allah ke yahan behtari payen woh hargiz duniya mein aana pasand nahin karte magar shaheed ke woh tamanna karta hai ke duniya mein dobara lautaya jaye aur dobara rah-e-Allah mein shaheed ho kyunke shahadat ke darajat ko woh dekh raha hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se farmaya ae Jabir tumhein maloom bhi hai? Ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare walid ko zinda kiya aur un se kaha ae mere bande mang kya mangta hai? To kaha ae Allah duniya mein phir bhej taake main dobara teri rah mein mara jaun, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya yeh to main faisla kar chuka hun ke koi yahan dobara lautaya nahin jayega, un ka naam Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram Ansari tha Allah Ta'ala un se razamand ho, Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Hazrat Jabir farmate hain mere baap ki shahadat ke baad main rone laga aur abba ke munh se kapda hata hata kar baar baar un ke chehre ko dekh raha tha. Sahaba mujhe mana karte the lekin Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) khamosh the phir Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya Jabir ro mat jab tak tere walid ko uthaya nahin gaya farishte apne paron se us par saya kiye hue hain, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya jab tumhare bhai Uhad wale din shaheed kiye gaye to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne un ki ruhein sabz parindon ke qalib mein daal dein jo Jannati darakhton ke phal khayen aur Jannati nehron ka pani piyen aur Arsh ke saye tale wahan latakti hui qandeelon mein aaram-o-rahat hasil karein jab khane peene rehne sehne ki yeh behtareen ne'matein unhein milin to kehne lage kaash ke hamare bhaiyon ko jo duniya mein hain hamari in ne'maton ki khabar mil jati taake woh jihad se munh na pherein aur Allah ki rah ki ladaiyon se thak kar na baith rahein Allah Ta'ala ne un se farmaya tum be-fikr raho main yeh khabar un tak pahuncha deta hun chunancha yeh ayatein nazil farmayin, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hazrat Hamza (R.A) aur aap ke sathiyon ke bare mein ayatein utrin (Mustadrak Hakim) yeh bhi mufassireen ne farmaya hai ke Uhad ke shaheedon ke bare mein yeh ayatein nazil huin. Abu Bakr bin Marduyah mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne mujhe dekha aur farmane lage Jabir kya baat hai ke tum mujhe ghamgeen nazar aate ho? Main ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah mere walid shaheed ho gaye jin par baar-e-qarz bahut hai aur mere chhote chhote behan bhai bahut hain aap ne farmaya sun main tujhe bataun jis kisi se Allah ne kalam kiya parde ke peeche se kalam kiya lekin tere baap se aamne samne baat cheet ki farmaya mujh se mang jo mange ga dunga tere baap ne kaha Allah Azzawajal main tujh se yeh mangta hun ke tu mujhe duniya mein dobara bheje aur main teri rah mein dusri martaba shaheed kiya jaun, Rabb-e-Azzawajal ne farmaya yeh baat to main pehle hi muqarrar kar chuka hun ke koi bhi laut kar dobara duniya mein nahin jayega.

Kehne lage phir ae Allah mere baad walon ko in maratib ki khabar pahuncha di jaye chunancha Allah Ta'ala ne aayat (Wala tahsabanna) al-kh, farmayi, Baihaqi mein itna aur zyada hai ke Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya main toh ae Allah teri ibadat ka haq bhi ada nahin kar saka, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai shaheed log jannat ke darwaze par nahar ke kinare sabz gumbad mein hain, subh-o-sham unhein jannat ki ne'matein pahunch jati hain, dono ahadees mein tatbeeq yeh hai ke ba'az shuhada woh hain jin ki roohein parindon ke qalib mein hain aur ba'az woh hain jin ka thikana yeh gumbad hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke woh jannat mein se phirte phirate yahan jama hote hon aur phir yeh khane yahin khilaye jate hon wallahu a'lam, yahan par woh hadees bhi warid karna bilkul bar-mahal hoga jis mein har momin ke liye yahi basharat hai chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya momin ki rooh ek parind mein hai jo jannat ke darakhton ke phal khati phirti hai yahan tak ke qayamat wale din jabke Allah Ta'ala sab ko khara kare toh use bhi us ke jism ki taraf lauta de ga, is hadees ke rawiyon mein teen jaleel-ul-qadr imam hain jo un char imamon mein se hain jin ke mazahib mane ja rahe hain, ek toh Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal R.H aap is hadees ko riwayat karte hain, Imam Muhammad bin Idris Shafi'i R.H se un ke ustad hain Hazrat Imam Malik bin Anas R.A pas Imam Ahmad, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Malik teenon zabardast peshwa is hadees ke rawi hain. Pas is hadees se sabit hua ke imandaron ki rooh jannati parind ki shakal mein jannat mein rehti hai aur shaheedon ki roohein jaise ke pehle guzar chuka hai sabz rang ke parindon ke qalib mein rehti hain yeh roohein misl sitaron ke hain jo aam momineen ki roohon ko yeh martaba hasil nahin, yeh apne taur par aap hi udti hain, Allah Ta'ala se jo bohat bada meharban aur zabardast ehsanon wala hai hamari dua hai ke woh hamein apne fazl-o-karam se iman-o-islam par maut de, Ameen.

Phir farmaya ke yeh shaheed jin jin nematon aur aasayishon mein hain un se behad masroor aur bahut hi khush hain aur unhein yeh bhi khushi aur rahat hai ke un ke bhai band jo un ke baad rah-e-Allah mein shaheed honge aur un ke paas aayenge unhein aayinda ka kuch khauf na hoga aur apne peeche chhori hui cheezon par unhein hasrat bhi na hogi, Allah hamein bhi jannat naseeb kare, Hazrat Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke woh khush hain ke un ke kayi aur bhai band bhi jo jihad mein lage hue hain woh bhi shaheed ho kar un ki nematon mein un ke shareek-e-haal honge aur Allah ke sawab se fayda uthayenge, Hazrat Suddi farmate hain shaheed ko ek kitab di jati hai ke falaan din tere paas falaan aayega aur falaan din falaan aayega pas jis tarah duniya wale apni kisi ghair hazir ke aane ki khabar sun kar khush hote hain isi tarah yeh shuhada un shaheedon ki aane ki khabar se masroor hote hain, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke jab shaheed jannat mein gaye aur wahan apni manzilein aur rahmatein dekhein to kehne lage kaash ke is ka ilm hamare un bhaiyon ko bhi hota jo ab tak duniya mein hi hain taake woh jawan mardi se jaan tor kar jihad karte aur un jaghon mein ja ghuste jahan se zinda aane ki umeed na hoti to woh bhi hamari in nematon mein hissa daar bante pas Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko un ke is haal ki khabar pahuncha di aur Allah Ta'ala ne un se keh diya ke main ne tumhari khabar tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko de di hai is se woh bahut hi masroor-o-mahfooz hue, Bukhari Muslim mein Bir-e-Ma'una walon ka qissa bayan ho chuka hai jo sattar shakhs Ansari Sahabi thay aur ek hi din subah ke waqt ko bedardi se kuffar ne teh-e-tegh kiya tha jin qatilon ke haq mein ek mah namaz ki qunoot mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bad-dua ki thi aur jin par laanat bheji thi jin ke bare mein Quran ki yeh aayat utri thi ke hamari qoum ko hamari khabar pahunchao ke hum apne Rab se mile woh hum se raazi hua aur hum us se raazi ho gaye, woh Allah ki nemat-o-fazl ko dekh dekh kar masroor hain, Hazrat Abdur Rahman farmate hain yeh aayat (Yastabshiroon) tamam imandaron ke haq mein hai khwah shaheed hon khwah ghair. Bahut kam aise mauqe hain ke Allah Ta'ala apne nabiyon ki fazeelat aur un ke sawabon ka zikr na ho. Phir un sachay momineen ka bayan tareef ke sath ho raha hai. Jinhon ne Hamra-ul-Asad wale din hukm-e-Rasool par bawajood zakhmon se choor hone ke jihad par kamar kas li thi, mushrikeen ne musalmanon ko museebatein pahunchayin aur apne gharon ki taraf wapas chal diye.

Lekin phir unhein is ka khayal aaya ke mauqa achha tha, musalman haar chuke thay, zakhmi ho gaye thay, un ke bahadur shaheed ho chuke thay, agar hum aur jam kar ladte to faisla hi ho jata. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ka yeh irada maloom kar ke musalmanon ko tayyar karne lage ke mere sath chalo, hum in mushrikeen ke peeche jayen taake un par ra'ab tari ho aur yeh jaan lein ke musalman abhi kamzor nahin hue. Uhud mein jo log majood thay sirf unhi ko sath chalne ka hukum mila, haan sirf Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) ko un ke ilawa bhi sath liya. Is aawaz par bhi musalmanon ne labbaik kahi, bawajood yeh ke zakhmon mein choor aur khoon mein sharabor thay lekin Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at ke liye kamar basta ho gaye. Hazrat Ikrama (R.A) ka bayan hai ke jab mushrikeen Uhud se laute to raste mein sochne lage ke na to tum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl kiya, na musalmanon ki aurton ko pakda, afsos tum ne kuch na kiya, wapas lauto. Jab yeh khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pahunchi to aap ne musalmanon ko tayyari ka hukum diya, yeh tayyar ho gaye aur mushrikeen ke ta'aqub mein chal pade yahan tak ke Hamra-ul-Asad tak ya "Bi'r Abi Ainiyah" tak pahunch gaye. Mushrikeen ke dil ra'ab-o-khauf se bhar gaye aur yeh keh kar Makkah ki taraf chal diye ke agle saal dekha jayega. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi wapas Madina tashreef laye, yeh bhi bil-istiqlal ek alag ladai gini jati hai, isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Uhud ki ladai pandrah Shawwal baroz hafta hui thi, solahwein tareekh baroz itwar munadi-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne nida di ke logo dushman ke ta'aqub mein chalo aur wahi log chalein jo kal maidan mein thay. Is aawaz par Hazrat Jabir (R.A) hazir hue aur arz karne lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kal ki ladai mein main na tha is liye ke mere walid Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne mujh se kaha bete tumhare sath yeh chhoti chhoti behnein hain, ise to na main pasand karoon aur na tu ke inhein yahan tanha chhod kar dono hi chal dein, ek jayega aur ek yahan rahega.

Mujh se yeh nahin ho sakta ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ham-rikab tum jao aur main baitha rahoon, is liye meri khwahish hai ke tum apni behnon ke paas raho aur main jata hoon. Is wajah se main toh wahan raha aur mere walid aap ke sath aaye. Ab meri ain tamanna hai ke aaj mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main aap ke sath chaloon. Chunancha aap ne ijazat di. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka safar is gharz se tha ke dushman dehal jaye aur peeche aata hua dekh kar samajh le ke in mein bahut kuch quwwat hai aur hamare muqable se yeh aajiz nahin. Qabeela Banu Abdul Ash-hal ke ek sahabi ka bayan hai ke Ghazwa-e-Uhud mein hum dono bhai shamil thay aur sakht zakhmi ho kar hum lautay thay. Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke munadi ne dushman ke peeche jaane ki nida di toh hum dono bhaiyon ne aapas mein kaha ke afsos! Na hamare paas sawari hai ke us par sawar ho kar Allah ke Nabi ke sath jayen, na zakhmon ke maaray jism mein itni taqat hai ke paidal sath ho len. Afsos ke yeh ghazwa hamare hath se nikal jayega, hamare beshumar gehre zakhm hamein aaj jaane se rok denge. Lekin phir hum ne himmat bandhi. Mujhe apne bhai ki nisbat zara halkay zakhm thay, jab mere bhai bilkul aajiz aa jatay, qadam na uthta toh main unhein joon-ton kar ke utha leta, jab thak jata utaar deta, yunhi joon-ton kar ke hum lashkar-gah tak pahunch hi gaye. (R.A) (Seerat-e-Ibn Ishaq). Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne Hazrat Urwa se kaha: Ae bhanjay! Tere dono baap unhi logon mein se hain jin ke bare mein aayat (Allazeena istajabu lillahi war-rasooli mim ba'di ma asabahumul qarhu lillazeena ahsanu minhum wattaqau ajrun azeem) (Surah Al-Imran: 172) aayat utri hai. Yani Hazrat Zubair aur Hazrat Siddiq (R.A), jabke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Uhud ki jang mein nuqsan pahuncha aur mushrikeen aagay chalay toh aap ko khayal hua ke kahin yeh phir wapas na lautain, lehaza aap ne farmaya: Koi hai jo in ke peeche jaye? Is par sattar shakhs is kaam ke liye musta'id ho gaye jin mein ek Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) thay, dusre Hazrat Zubair (R.A) thay. Yeh riwayat aur bahut si asnaad se bahut si kitabon mein hai. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se farmaya ke tere dono baap un logon mein se hain, lekin yeh marfoo' bayan karna mehez khata hai, is liye bhi ke is ki asnaad mein siqa rawiyon ka ikhtilaf hai jo Hazrat Ayesha ke baap dada mein se nahin. Sahih yeh hai ke yeh baat Hazrat Ayesha ne apne bhanjay Hazrat Asma bint-e-Abi Bakr ke ladke Urwa se kahi hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka bayan hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Abu Sufyan ke dil mein ra'ab daal diya aur bawajood-e-ke woh Uhud ki ladai mein qadray kamyab ho gaya tha lekin taham Makkah ki taraf chal diya. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Abu Sufyan tumhein nuqsan pahuncha kar laut gaya hai.

Allah Ta'ala ne us ke dil ko mar'oob kar diya hai, Uhud ki ladai Shawwal mein hui thi aur tajir log Zi-Qa'dah mein Madina aate thay aur Badr-e-Sughra mein apne dere har saal is maah mein dala karte thay is dafa bhi is waqia ke baad log aaye musalman apne zakhmon mein choor thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se apni takaleef bayan karte thay aur sakht sadma mein thay. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is baat par aamada kiya ke woh aap ke saath chalein aur farmaya ke yeh log ab kooch kar jayenge aur phir Hajj ko aayenge aur phir agle saal tak yeh taqat unhein hasil nahin hogi lekin shaitan ne apne doston ko dhamkana aur behkana shuru kar diya aur kehne laga ke in logon ne tumhare istisal ke liye lashkar tayyar kar liye hain jis bina par log dheele pad gaye aap ne farmaya suno khwah tum mein se ek bhi na chale main tan-tanha jaunga phir aap ke raghbat dilane par Hazrat Abu Bakr, Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Usman, Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Zubair, Hazrat Sa'ad, Hazrat Talha, Hazrat Abdur-Rahman bin Auf, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood, Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman, Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah wagaira sattar sahaba aap ke zer-e-rikab chalne par aamada hue (R.A), yeh mubarak lashkar Abu Sufyan ki justuju mein Badr-e-Sughra tak pahunch gaya inhi ki is fazeelat aur jaan-bazi ka zikr is mubarak aayat mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is safar mein Madina se aath meel Hamra-ul-Asad tak pahunch gaye. Madina mein apna naib aap ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Um-e-Maktum (R.A) ko banaya tha.

Wahan Aap ne peer, mangal, budh tak qayam kiya phir Madina laut aaye, asna-e-qayam mein qabeela-e-Khuza'a ka sardar Ma'bad Khuza'i yahan se nikla tha yeh khud mushrik tha lekin is pooray qabeelay se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sulh-o-safai thi. Is qabeela ke mushrik, momin sab Aap ke khair khwah thay. Is ne kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sathiyon ko jo takleef pahunchi us par hamain sakht ranj hai, Allah Ta'ala Aap ko kamyabi ki khushi naseeb farmaye. Hamra-e-Asad par Aap pahunchay magar is se pehlay Abu Sufyan chal diya tha, go us ne aur us ke sathiyon ne wapas aanay ka irada kiya tha ke jab hum un par ghalib aa gaye, unhain qatl kiya, mara peeta, zakhmi kiya phir adhoora kaam kyun chhorein? Wapas ja kar sab ko teh-e-tegh kar dein. Yeh mashwaray ho hi rahay thay ke Ma'bad Khuza'i wahan pahuncha. Abu Sufyan ne us se poocha kaho kya khabrein hain? Us ne kaha Aanhuzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ma'a sahaba ke tum logon ke ta'aqub mein aa rahay hain, woh log sakht gussay mein hain, jo pehlay larai mein shareek na thay woh bhi shamil ho gaye hain, sab ke tewar badlay huay hain aur bharpoor taqat ke sath hamla-awar ho rahay hain, main ne to aisa lashkar kabhi dekha nahin. Yeh sun kar Abu Sufyan ke hathon ke totay ur gaye aur kehne laga achha hi hua jo tum se mulaqat ho gayi warna hum to khud un ki taraf jaanay ke liye tayyar thay. Ma'bad ne kaha hargiz yeh irada na karo aur meri baat ka kya hai, ghaliban tum yahan se kooch karnay se pehlay hi lashkar-e-Islam ke ghoron ko dekh logay, main un ke lashkar, un ke gussay, un ki tayari aur ulul-azmi ka haal bayan nahin kar sakta, main to tum se saaf kehta hoon ke bhago aur apni janain bachao, mere paas aisay alfaaz nahin jin se main musalmanon ke gaiz-o-ghazab aur tahawwur-o-shuja'at aur sakhti aur pukhtagi ka bayan kar sakoon, pas mukhtasar yeh hai ke jaan ki khair manatay ho to foran yahan se kooch karo. Abu Sufyan aur us ke sathiyon ke chhakkay chhoot gaye aur unhon ne yahan se Makka ki raah li. Qabeela-e-Abdul Qais ke aadmi jo karobar ki gharz se Madina ja rahay thay un se Abu Sufyan ne kaha ke tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh khabar pahuncha dena ke hum ne unhain teh-e-tegh kar denay ke liye lashkar jama kar liye hain aur hum wapas lautnay ke iraday mein hain, agar tum ne yeh paigham pahuncha diya to hum tumhain Souq-e-Ukaz mein bohat sari kishmish dein ge. Chunancha un logon ne Hamra-e-Asad mein aa kar bator-e-daraway ke namak mirch laga kar yeh wehshat-asar khabar sunayi lekin sahaba ne nihayat istiqlaal aur pamardi se jawab diya ke hamain Allah kaafi hai aur wohi behtareen karsaaz hai. Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne un ke liye aik pathar ka nishan muqarrar kar rakha hai agar yeh lautain ge to wahan pahunch kar is tarah mit jayain ge jaise guzashta kal ka din. Ba'az logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke yeh aayat Badr ke baray mein nazil hui hai lekin sahih-tar yahi hai ke Hamra-e-Asad ke baray mein nazil hui.

Matlab yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke dushmanon ne unhein pazmurda dil karne ke liye dushmanon ke saaz-o-samaan aur un ki kasrat-o-buhtat se daraya lekin woh sabr ke pahar sabit hue, un ke ghair mutazalzal yaqeen mein kuch farq na aaya balkeh woh tawakkul mein aur barh gaye aur Allah ki taraf nazrein kar ke us se imdad talab ki. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke aayat (Hasbunallahu) ilakh, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne aag mein parte waqt parha tha aur Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us waqt jab ke kafiron ke tiddi dal lashkar se logon ne Aap (ﷺ) ko khauf zada karna chaha us waqt parha. Ta'ajjub ki baat hai ke Imam Hakim ne is riwayat ko rad kar ke farmaya hai ke yeh Bukhari Muslim mein nahin. Bukhari ki ek riwayat mein hai ke Uhud ke mauqe par jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ko kuffar ke lashkaron ki khabar di gayi to Aap (ﷺ) ne yahi kalma farmaya aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke sardar ke mat-hat jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek chota sa lashkar rawana kiya aur raah mein Khuza'a ke ek a'arabi ne yeh khabar sunayi to Aap (ﷺ) ne yeh farmaya tha. Ibn Marduyah ki hadith mein hai Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain jab tum par koi bahut bada kaam aa pare to tum aayat (Hasbunallahu) aakhir tak parho. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke do shakhson ke darmiyan Huzoor (ﷺ) ne faisla kiya to jis ke khilaf faisla sadir hua tha us ne yahi kalma parha, Aap (ﷺ) ne use wapas bula kar farmaya buzdili aur susti par Allah ki malamat hoti hai, danayi, door-andeshi aur aqalmandi kiya karo, phir kisi amr mein phans jao to yahi parh liya karo. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai kis tarah be-fikr aur farigh ho kar aaram paun halankeh sahib-e-soor ne soor munh mein le rakha hai aur peshani jhukaye hukm-e-Allah ka muntazir hai ke kab hukm hua aur woh soor phoonk de, Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) hum kya parhein? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya aayat (Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil) (Alallahi tawakkalna) parho. Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Zainab (R.A) aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne fakhr se farmaya mera nikah khud Allah ne kar diya hai aur tumhare nikah wali warison ne kiye hain, Siddiqa (R.A) ne farmaya meri bara'at aur pakeezgi ki aayat Allah Ta'ala ne aasman se apne pak kalam mein nazil farmayi hain, Hazrat Zainab (R.A) use maan gayin aur poocha yeh batao tum ne Hazrat Safwan bin Mu'attal (R.A) ki sawari par sawar hote waqt kya parha tha? Siddiqa (R.A) ne farmaya dua (Hasbiyallahu wa ni'mal wakil), yeh sun kar Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne farmaya tum ne imaan walon ka kalma kaha tha. Chanancha is aayat mein bhi Rabb-e-Raheem ka irshad hai ke in tawakkul karne walon ki kifayat Allah Ta'ala ne ki aur un ke sath jo log burayi ka irada rakhte the unhein zillat aur barbadi ke sath paspa kiya, yeh log Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se apne shahron ki taraf baghair kisi nuqsan aur burayi ke laute, dushman apni makkariyon mein nakam raha, un se Allah khush ho gaya kyunke unhon ne us ki khushi ka kaam anjam diya tha, Allah Ta'ala bade fazl-o-karam wala hai.

Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka farman hai ke ne'mat toh yeh thi ke woh salamat rahe aur fazl yeh tha ke Huzoor ﷺ ne tajiron ke ek qafila se maal khareed liya jis mein bahut hi nafa hua aur is kul nafa ko Aap ﷺ ne apne sathiyon mein taqseem farma diya. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke Abu Sufyan ne Huzoor ﷺ se kaha ab wade ki jagah Badr hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya mumkin hai, chunancha wahan pahunche toh yeh darpok aaya hi nahin, wahan bazaar ka din tha, maal khareed liya jo nafa se bika, isi ka naam Ghazwa-e-Badr-e-Sughra hai. Phir farmata hai ke yeh Shaitan tha jo apne doston ke zariye tumhein dhamka raha tha aur geedar bhabkiyan de raha tha, tumhein chahiye ke in se na daro, sirf mera hi khauf dil mein rakho kyunke imandari ki yahi shart hai ke jab koi daraye dhamkaye aur deeni umoor se tumhein baaz rakhna chahe toh musalman Allah par bharosa kare, us ki taraf simat jaye aur yaqeen maane ke kaafi aur nasir wahi hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Alaysallahu bi-kaafin 'abdahu, wa yukhawwifunaka billadhina min dunihi) (Surah Az-Zumar: 36) kya Allah Jalla Shanahu apne bandon ko kaafi nahin? Yeh log tujhe us ke siwa auron se dara rahe hain (yahan tak ke farmaya) tu keh ke mujhe Allah kaafi hai, tawakkul karne walon ko isi par bharosa karna chahiye. Aur jagah farmaya Auliya-e-Shaitan se lado, Shaitan ka makr bada bouda hai. Aur jagah irshad hai yeh shaitani lashkar hai, yaad rakho shaitani lashkar hi ghate aur khasare mein hai. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Kataballahu la-aghlibanna ana wa rusuli, innallaha Qawiyyun 'Aziz) (Surah Al-Mujadilah: 21) Allah Ta'ala likh chuka hai ke ghalba yaqeenan mujhe aur mere rasoolon ko hi hoga, Allah Qawi aur Aziz hai. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Wa layansurannallahu man yansuruhu, innallaha la-Qawiyyun 'Aziz) (Surah Al-Hajj: 40) jo Allah ki madad karega us ki imdad farmaye ga. Aur farman hai aayat (Ya ayyuhalladhina amanu in tansurullaha yansurkum wa yuthabbit aqdamakum) (Surah Muhammad: 7) ae iman walo agar tum Allah ki madad karoge toh Allah tumhari bhi madad karega. Aur aayat mein hai aayat (Inna la-nansuru rusulana walladhina amanu fil-hayatid-dunya wa yawma yaqumul-ashhad) (Surah Ghafir: 51) bil-yaqeen hum apne rasoolon ki aur imandaron ki madad duniya mein bhi karenge aur us din bhi jis din gawah khade honge, jis din zalimon ko uzr-e-ma'zarat nafa na degi, un ke liye la'nat hai aur un ke liye bura ghar hai.

Bi'r-e-Ma'una ke shuhada aur Jannat mein un ki tamanna? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke go shaheed fi sabil-illah duniya mein maar dale jate hain lekin aakhirat mein un ki roohein zinda rehti hain aur rizq pati hain, is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Rasool-ullah (ﷺ) ne chalis ya sattar sahabiyon ko Bi'r-e-Ma'una ki taraf bheja tha. Yeh jamaat jab us ghaar tak pahunchi jo us kunwein ke oopar thi to unhon ne wahan parao kiya aur aapas mein kehne lage kaun hai? Jo apni jaan khatra mein daal kar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka kalma un tak pahunchaye. Ek sahabi is ke liye tayyar hue aur un logon ke gharon ke paas aa kar ba-aawaz-e-buland farmaya: "Aye Bi'r-e-Ma'una walo suno! Main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka qasid hoon, meri gawahi hai ke mabood sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ) us ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain." Yeh sunte hi ek kafir apna teer sambhale hue apne ghar se nikla aur is tarah taak kar lagaya ke idhar ki pasli se udhar ki pasli mein aar-paar nikal gaya. Us sahabi ki zaban se besakhta nikla: "Fuztu wa Rabbil Ka'bah" (Ka'be ke Allah ki qasam! Main apni murad ko pahunch gaya). Ab kuffar nishanat tatolte hue us ghaar par ja pahunche aur Aamir bin Tufail ne jo un ka sardar tha, un sab musalmanon ko shaheed kar diya. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke un ke bare mein Quran utra ke hamari janib se hamari qoum ko yeh khabar pahuncha do ke hum apne Rabb se mile, woh hum se raazi ho gaya aur hum us se raazi ho gaye. Hum in aayaton ko barabar padhte rahe, phir ek muddat ke baad yeh mansookh ho kar utha li gayin aur aayat (Wala tahsabanna) il-aakhirihi utri. (Muhammad bin Jareer). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai, Hazrat Masrooq farmate hain hum ne Hazrat Abdullah se is aayat ka matlab poocha to Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya: Hum ne Rasool (ﷺ) se is aayat ka matlab daryaft kiya tha to aap ne farmaya: "Un ki roohein sabz rang parindon ke qalib mein hain. Arsh ki qandeelain un ke liye hain, sari Jannat mein jahan kahin chahein charein chugein aur in qandeeliyon mein aaram karein. Un ki taraf un ke Rabb ne ek martaba nazar ki aur daryaft farmaya: Kuch aur chahte ho? Kehne lage: Aye Allah! Aur kya mangein? Sari Jannat mein se jahan kahin se chahein khayein piyein ikhtiyar hai, phir kya talab karein? Allah Ta'ala ne un se phir yahi poocha, teesri martaba yahi sawal kiya. Jab unhon ne dekha ke baghair kuch mange chara hi nahin to kehne lage: Aye Rabb! Hum chahte hain ke Tu hamari roohon ko jismon ki taraf lauta de, hum phir duniya mein ja kar Teri raah mein jihad karein aur mare jayein. Ab maloom ho gaya ke unhein kisi aur cheez ki haajat nahin to un se poochna chhod diya ke kya chahte ho?"

Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo log mar jayen aur Allah ke yahan behtari payen woh hargiz duniya mein aana pasand nahin karte magar shaheed ke woh tamanna karta hai ke duniya mein dobara lautaya jaye aur dobara rah-e-Allah mein shaheed ho kyunke shahadat ke darajat ko woh dekh raha hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se farmaya ae Jabir tumhein maloom bhi hai? Ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare walid ko zinda kiya aur un se kaha ae mere bande mang kya mangta hai? To kaha ae Allah duniya mein phir bhej taake main dobara teri rah mein mara jaun, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya yeh to main faisla kar chuka hun ke koi yahan dobara lautaya nahin jayega, un ka naam Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram Ansari tha Allah Ta'ala un se razamand ho, Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Hazrat Jabir farmate hain mere baap ki shahadat ke baad main rone laga aur abba ke munh se kapda hata hata kar baar baar un ke chehre ko dekh raha tha. Sahaba mujhe mana karte the lekin Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) khamosh the phir Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya Jabir ro mat jab tak tere walid ko uthaya nahin gaya farishte apne paron se us par saya kiye hue hain, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya jab tumhare bhai Uhad wale din shaheed kiye gaye to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne un ki ruhein sabz parindon ke qalib mein daal dein jo Jannati darakhton ke phal khayen aur Jannati nehron ka pani piyen aur Arsh ke saye tale wahan latakti hui qandeelon mein aaram-o-rahat hasil karein jab khane peene rehne sehne ki yeh behtareen ne'matein unhein milin to kehne lage kaash ke hamare bhaiyon ko jo duniya mein hain hamari in ne'maton ki khabar mil jati taake woh jihad se munh na pherein aur Allah ki rah ki ladaiyon se thak kar na baith rahein Allah Ta'ala ne un se farmaya tum be-fikr raho main yeh khabar un tak pahuncha deta hun chunancha yeh ayatein nazil farmayin, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hazrat Hamza (R.A) aur aap ke sathiyon ke bare mein ayatein utrin (Mustadrak Hakim) yeh bhi mufassireen ne farmaya hai ke Uhad ke shaheedon ke bare mein yeh ayatein nazil huin. Abu Bakr bin Marduyah mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne mujhe dekha aur farmane lage Jabir kya baat hai ke tum mujhe ghamgeen nazar aate ho? Main ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah mere walid shaheed ho gaye jin par baar-e-qarz bahut hai aur mere chhote chhote behan bhai bahut hain aap ne farmaya sun main tujhe bataun jis kisi se Allah ne kalam kiya parde ke peeche se kalam kiya lekin tere baap se aamne samne baat cheet ki farmaya mujh se mang jo mange ga dunga tere baap ne kaha Allah Azzawajal main tujh se yeh mangta hun ke tu mujhe duniya mein dobara bheje aur main teri rah mein dusri martaba shaheed kiya jaun, Rabb-e-Azzawajal ne farmaya yeh baat to main pehle hi muqarrar kar chuka hun ke koi bhi laut kar dobara duniya mein nahin jayega.

Kehne lage phir ae Allah mere baad walon ko in maratib ki khabar pahuncha di jaye chunancha Allah Ta'ala ne aayat (Wala tahsabanna) al-kh, farmayi, Baihaqi mein itna aur zyada hai ke Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya main toh ae Allah teri ibadat ka haq bhi ada nahin kar saka, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai shaheed log jannat ke darwaze par nahar ke kinare sabz gumbad mein hain, subh-o-sham unhein jannat ki ne'matein pahunch jati hain, dono ahadees mein tatbeeq yeh hai ke ba'az shuhada woh hain jin ki roohein parindon ke qalib mein hain aur ba'az woh hain jin ka thikana yeh gumbad hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke woh jannat mein se phirte phirate yahan jama hote hon aur phir yeh khane yahin khilaye jate hon wallahu a'lam, yahan par woh hadees bhi warid karna bilkul bar-mahal hoga jis mein har momin ke liye yahi basharat hai chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya momin ki rooh ek parind mein hai jo jannat ke darakhton ke phal khati phirti hai yahan tak ke qayamat wale din jabke Allah Ta'ala sab ko khara kare toh use bhi us ke jism ki taraf lauta de ga, is hadees ke rawiyon mein teen jaleel-ul-qadr imam hain jo un char imamon mein se hain jin ke mazahib mane ja rahe hain, ek toh Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal R.H aap is hadees ko riwayat karte hain, Imam Muhammad bin Idris Shafi'i R.H se un ke ustad hain Hazrat Imam Malik bin Anas R.A pas Imam Ahmad, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Malik teenon zabardast peshwa is hadees ke rawi hain. Pas is hadees se sabit hua ke imandaron ki rooh jannati parind ki shakal mein jannat mein rehti hai aur shaheedon ki roohein jaise ke pehle guzar chuka hai sabz rang ke parindon ke qalib mein rehti hain yeh roohein misl sitaron ke hain jo aam momineen ki roohon ko yeh martaba hasil nahin, yeh apne taur par aap hi udti hain, Allah Ta'ala se jo bohat bada meharban aur zabardast ehsanon wala hai hamari dua hai ke woh hamein apne fazl-o-karam se iman-o-islam par maut de, Ameen.

Phir farmaya ke yeh shaheed jin jin nematon aur aasayishon mein hain un se behad masroor aur bahut hi khush hain aur unhein yeh bhi khushi aur rahat hai ke un ke bhai band jo un ke baad rah-e-Allah mein shaheed honge aur un ke paas aayenge unhein aayinda ka kuch khauf na hoga aur apne peeche chhori hui cheezon par unhein hasrat bhi na hogi, Allah hamein bhi jannat naseeb kare, Hazrat Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke woh khush hain ke un ke kayi aur bhai band bhi jo jihad mein lage hue hain woh bhi shaheed ho kar un ki nematon mein un ke shareek-e-haal honge aur Allah ke sawab se fayda uthayenge, Hazrat Suddi farmate hain shaheed ko ek kitab di jati hai ke falaan din tere paas falaan aayega aur falaan din falaan aayega pas jis tarah duniya wale apni kisi ghair hazir ke aane ki khabar sun kar khush hote hain isi tarah yeh shuhada un shaheedon ki aane ki khabar se masroor hote hain, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke jab shaheed jannat mein gaye aur wahan apni manzilein aur rahmatein dekhein to kehne lage kaash ke is ka ilm hamare un bhaiyon ko bhi hota jo ab tak duniya mein hi hain taake woh jawan mardi se jaan tor kar jihad karte aur un jaghon mein ja ghuste jahan se zinda aane ki umeed na hoti to woh bhi hamari in nematon mein hissa daar bante pas Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko un ke is haal ki khabar pahuncha di aur Allah Ta'ala ne un se keh diya ke main ne tumhari khabar tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko de di hai is se woh bahut hi masroor-o-mahfooz hue, Bukhari Muslim mein Bir-e-Ma'una walon ka qissa bayan ho chuka hai jo sattar shakhs Ansari Sahabi thay aur ek hi din subah ke waqt ko bedardi se kuffar ne teh-e-tegh kiya tha jin qatilon ke haq mein ek mah namaz ki qunoot mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bad-dua ki thi aur jin par laanat bheji thi jin ke bare mein Quran ki yeh aayat utri thi ke hamari qoum ko hamari khabar pahunchao ke hum apne Rab se mile woh hum se raazi hua aur hum us se raazi ho gaye, woh Allah ki nemat-o-fazl ko dekh dekh kar masroor hain, Hazrat Abdur Rahman farmate hain yeh aayat (Yastabshiroon) tamam imandaron ke haq mein hai khwah shaheed hon khwah ghair. Bahut kam aise mauqe hain ke Allah Ta'ala apne nabiyon ki fazeelat aur un ke sawabon ka zikr na ho. Phir un sachay momineen ka bayan tareef ke sath ho raha hai. Jinhon ne Hamra-ul-Asad wale din hukm-e-Rasool par bawajood zakhmon se choor hone ke jihad par kamar kas li thi, mushrikeen ne musalmanon ko museebatein pahunchayin aur apne gharon ki taraf wapas chal diye.

Lekin phir unhein is ka khayal aaya ke mauqa achha tha, musalman haar chuke thay, zakhmi ho gaye thay, un ke bahadur shaheed ho chuke thay, agar hum aur jam kar ladte to faisla hi ho jata. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ka yeh irada maloom kar ke musalmanon ko tayyar karne lage ke mere sath chalo, hum in mushrikeen ke peeche jayen taake un par ra'ab tari ho aur yeh jaan lein ke musalman abhi kamzor nahin hue. Uhud mein jo log majood thay sirf unhi ko sath chalne ka hukum mila, haan sirf Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) ko un ke ilawa bhi sath liya. Is aawaz par bhi musalmanon ne labbaik kahi, bawajood yeh ke zakhmon mein choor aur khoon mein sharabor thay lekin Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at ke liye kamar basta ho gaye. Hazrat Ikrama (R.A) ka bayan hai ke jab mushrikeen Uhud se laute to raste mein sochne lage ke na to tum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl kiya, na musalmanon ki aurton ko pakda, afsos tum ne kuch na kiya, wapas lauto. Jab yeh khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pahunchi to aap ne musalmanon ko tayyari ka hukum diya, yeh tayyar ho gaye aur mushrikeen ke ta'aqub mein chal pade yahan tak ke Hamra-ul-Asad tak ya "Bi'r Abi Ainiyah" tak pahunch gaye. Mushrikeen ke dil ra'ab-o-khauf se bhar gaye aur yeh keh kar Makkah ki taraf chal diye ke agle saal dekha jayega. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi wapas Madina tashreef laye, yeh bhi bil-istiqlal ek alag ladai gini jati hai, isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Uhud ki ladai pandrah Shawwal baroz hafta hui thi, solahwein tareekh baroz itwar munadi-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne nida di ke logo dushman ke ta'aqub mein chalo aur wahi log chalein jo kal maidan mein thay. Is aawaz par Hazrat Jabir (R.A) hazir hue aur arz karne lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kal ki ladai mein main na tha is liye ke mere walid Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne mujh se kaha bete tumhare sath yeh chhoti chhoti behnein hain, ise to na main pasand karoon aur na tu ke inhein yahan tanha chhod kar dono hi chal dein, ek jayega aur ek yahan rahega.

Mujh se yeh nahin ho sakta ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ham-rikab tum jao aur main baitha rahoon, is liye meri khwahish hai ke tum apni behnon ke paas raho aur main jata hoon. Is wajah se main toh wahan raha aur mere walid aap ke sath aaye. Ab meri ain tamanna hai ke aaj mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main aap ke sath chaloon. Chunancha aap ne ijazat di. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka safar is gharz se tha ke dushman dehal jaye aur peeche aata hua dekh kar samajh le ke in mein bahut kuch quwwat hai aur hamare muqable se yeh aajiz nahin. Qabeela Banu Abdul Ash-hal ke ek sahabi ka bayan hai ke Ghazwa-e-Uhud mein hum dono bhai shamil thay aur sakht zakhmi ho kar hum lautay thay. Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke munadi ne dushman ke peeche jaane ki nida di toh hum dono bhaiyon ne aapas mein kaha ke afsos! Na hamare paas sawari hai ke us par sawar ho kar Allah ke Nabi ke sath jayen, na zakhmon ke maaray jism mein itni taqat hai ke paidal sath ho len. Afsos ke yeh ghazwa hamare hath se nikal jayega, hamare beshumar gehre zakhm hamein aaj jaane se rok denge. Lekin phir hum ne himmat bandhi. Mujhe apne bhai ki nisbat zara halkay zakhm thay, jab mere bhai bilkul aajiz aa jatay, qadam na uthta toh main unhein joon-ton kar ke utha leta, jab thak jata utaar deta, yunhi joon-ton kar ke hum lashkar-gah tak pahunch hi gaye. (R.A) (Seerat-e-Ibn Ishaq). Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne Hazrat Urwa se kaha: Ae bhanjay! Tere dono baap unhi logon mein se hain jin ke bare mein aayat (Allazeena istajabu lillahi war-rasooli mim ba'di ma asabahumul qarhu lillazeena ahsanu minhum wattaqau ajrun azeem) (Surah Al-Imran: 172) aayat utri hai. Yani Hazrat Zubair aur Hazrat Siddiq (R.A), jabke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Uhud ki jang mein nuqsan pahuncha aur mushrikeen aagay chalay toh aap ko khayal hua ke kahin yeh phir wapas na lautain, lehaza aap ne farmaya: Koi hai jo in ke peeche jaye? Is par sattar shakhs is kaam ke liye musta'id ho gaye jin mein ek Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) thay, dusre Hazrat Zubair (R.A) thay. Yeh riwayat aur bahut si asnaad se bahut si kitabon mein hai. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se farmaya ke tere dono baap un logon mein se hain, lekin yeh marfoo' bayan karna mehez khata hai, is liye bhi ke is ki asnaad mein siqa rawiyon ka ikhtilaf hai jo Hazrat Ayesha ke baap dada mein se nahin. Sahih yeh hai ke yeh baat Hazrat Ayesha ne apne bhanjay Hazrat Asma bint-e-Abi Bakr ke ladke Urwa se kahi hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka bayan hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Abu Sufyan ke dil mein ra'ab daal diya aur bawajood-e-ke woh Uhud ki ladai mein qadray kamyab ho gaya tha lekin taham Makkah ki taraf chal diya. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Abu Sufyan tumhein nuqsan pahuncha kar laut gaya hai.

Allah Ta'ala ne us ke dil ko mar'oob kar diya hai, Uhud ki ladai Shawwal mein hui thi aur tajir log Zi-Qa'dah mein Madina aate thay aur Badr-e-Sughra mein apne dere har saal is maah mein dala karte thay is dafa bhi is waqia ke baad log aaye musalman apne zakhmon mein choor thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se apni takaleef bayan karte thay aur sakht sadma mein thay. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is baat par aamada kiya ke woh aap ke saath chalein aur farmaya ke yeh log ab kooch kar jayenge aur phir Hajj ko aayenge aur phir agle saal tak yeh taqat unhein hasil nahin hogi lekin shaitan ne apne doston ko dhamkana aur behkana shuru kar diya aur kehne laga ke in logon ne tumhare istisal ke liye lashkar tayyar kar liye hain jis bina par log dheele pad gaye aap ne farmaya suno khwah tum mein se ek bhi na chale main tan-tanha jaunga phir aap ke raghbat dilane par Hazrat Abu Bakr, Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Usman, Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Zubair, Hazrat Sa'ad, Hazrat Talha, Hazrat Abdur-Rahman bin Auf, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood, Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman, Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah wagaira sattar sahaba aap ke zer-e-rikab chalne par aamada hue (R.A), yeh mubarak lashkar Abu Sufyan ki justuju mein Badr-e-Sughra tak pahunch gaya inhi ki is fazeelat aur jaan-bazi ka zikr is mubarak aayat mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is safar mein Madina se aath meel Hamra-ul-Asad tak pahunch gaye. Madina mein apna naib aap ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Um-e-Maktum (R.A) ko banaya tha.

Wahan Aap ne peer, mangal, budh tak qayam kiya phir Madina laut aaye, asna-e-qayam mein qabeela-e-Khuza'a ka sardar Ma'bad Khuza'i yahan se nikla tha yeh khud mushrik tha lekin is pooray qabeelay se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sulh-o-safai thi. Is qabeela ke mushrik, momin sab Aap ke khair khwah thay. Is ne kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sathiyon ko jo takleef pahunchi us par hamain sakht ranj hai, Allah Ta'ala Aap ko kamyabi ki khushi naseeb farmaye. Hamra-e-Asad par Aap pahunchay magar is se pehlay Abu Sufyan chal diya tha, go us ne aur us ke sathiyon ne wapas aanay ka irada kiya tha ke jab hum un par ghalib aa gaye, unhain qatl kiya, mara peeta, zakhmi kiya phir adhoora kaam kyun chhorein? Wapas ja kar sab ko teh-e-tegh kar dein. Yeh mashwaray ho hi rahay thay ke Ma'bad Khuza'i wahan pahuncha. Abu Sufyan ne us se poocha kaho kya khabrein hain? Us ne kaha Aanhuzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ma'a sahaba ke tum logon ke ta'aqub mein aa rahay hain, woh log sakht gussay mein hain, jo pehlay larai mein shareek na thay woh bhi shamil ho gaye hain, sab ke tewar badlay huay hain aur bharpoor taqat ke sath hamla-awar ho rahay hain, main ne to aisa lashkar kabhi dekha nahin. Yeh sun kar Abu Sufyan ke hathon ke totay ur gaye aur kehne laga achha hi hua jo tum se mulaqat ho gayi warna hum to khud un ki taraf jaanay ke liye tayyar thay. Ma'bad ne kaha hargiz yeh irada na karo aur meri baat ka kya hai, ghaliban tum yahan se kooch karnay se pehlay hi lashkar-e-Islam ke ghoron ko dekh logay, main un ke lashkar, un ke gussay, un ki tayari aur ulul-azmi ka haal bayan nahin kar sakta, main to tum se saaf kehta hoon ke bhago aur apni janain bachao, mere paas aisay alfaaz nahin jin se main musalmanon ke gaiz-o-ghazab aur tahawwur-o-shuja'at aur sakhti aur pukhtagi ka bayan kar sakoon, pas mukhtasar yeh hai ke jaan ki khair manatay ho to foran yahan se kooch karo. Abu Sufyan aur us ke sathiyon ke chhakkay chhoot gaye aur unhon ne yahan se Makka ki raah li. Qabeela-e-Abdul Qais ke aadmi jo karobar ki gharz se Madina ja rahay thay un se Abu Sufyan ne kaha ke tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh khabar pahuncha dena ke hum ne unhain teh-e-tegh kar denay ke liye lashkar jama kar liye hain aur hum wapas lautnay ke iraday mein hain, agar tum ne yeh paigham pahuncha diya to hum tumhain Souq-e-Ukaz mein bohat sari kishmish dein ge. Chunancha un logon ne Hamra-e-Asad mein aa kar bator-e-daraway ke namak mirch laga kar yeh wehshat-asar khabar sunayi lekin sahaba ne nihayat istiqlaal aur pamardi se jawab diya ke hamain Allah kaafi hai aur wohi behtareen karsaaz hai. Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne un ke liye aik pathar ka nishan muqarrar kar rakha hai agar yeh lautain ge to wahan pahunch kar is tarah mit jayain ge jaise guzashta kal ka din. Ba'az logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke yeh aayat Badr ke baray mein nazil hui hai lekin sahih-tar yahi hai ke Hamra-e-Asad ke baray mein nazil hui.

Matlab yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke dushmanon ne unhein pazmurda dil karne ke liye dushmanon ke saaz-o-samaan aur un ki kasrat-o-buhtat se daraya lekin woh sabr ke pahar sabit hue, un ke ghair mutazalzal yaqeen mein kuch farq na aaya balkeh woh tawakkul mein aur barh gaye aur Allah ki taraf nazrein kar ke us se imdad talab ki. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke aayat (Hasbunallahu) ilakh, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne aag mein parte waqt parha tha aur Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us waqt jab ke kafiron ke tiddi dal lashkar se logon ne Aap (ﷺ) ko khauf zada karna chaha us waqt parha. Ta'ajjub ki baat hai ke Imam Hakim ne is riwayat ko rad kar ke farmaya hai ke yeh Bukhari Muslim mein nahin. Bukhari ki ek riwayat mein hai ke Uhud ke mauqe par jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ko kuffar ke lashkaron ki khabar di gayi to Aap (ﷺ) ne yahi kalma farmaya aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke sardar ke mat-hat jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek chota sa lashkar rawana kiya aur raah mein Khuza'a ke ek a'arabi ne yeh khabar sunayi to Aap (ﷺ) ne yeh farmaya tha. Ibn Marduyah ki hadith mein hai Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain jab tum par koi bahut bada kaam aa pare to tum aayat (Hasbunallahu) aakhir tak parho. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke do shakhson ke darmiyan Huzoor (ﷺ) ne faisla kiya to jis ke khilaf faisla sadir hua tha us ne yahi kalma parha, Aap (ﷺ) ne use wapas bula kar farmaya buzdili aur susti par Allah ki malamat hoti hai, danayi, door-andeshi aur aqalmandi kiya karo, phir kisi amr mein phans jao to yahi parh liya karo. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai kis tarah be-fikr aur farigh ho kar aaram paun halankeh sahib-e-soor ne soor munh mein le rakha hai aur peshani jhukaye hukm-e-Allah ka muntazir hai ke kab hukm hua aur woh soor phoonk de, Sahaba ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) hum kya parhein? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya aayat (Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil) (Alallahi tawakkalna) parho. Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Zainab (R.A) aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se marwi hai ke Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne fakhr se farmaya mera nikah khud Allah ne kar diya hai aur tumhare nikah wali warison ne kiye hain, Siddiqa (R.A) ne farmaya meri bara'at aur pakeezgi ki aayat Allah Ta'ala ne aasman se apne pak kalam mein nazil farmayi hain, Hazrat Zainab (R.A) use maan gayin aur poocha yeh batao tum ne Hazrat Safwan bin Mu'attal (R.A) ki sawari par sawar hote waqt kya parha tha? Siddiqa (R.A) ne farmaya dua (Hasbiyallahu wa ni'mal wakil), yeh sun kar Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ne farmaya tum ne imaan walon ka kalma kaha tha. Chanancha is aayat mein bhi Rabb-e-Raheem ka irshad hai ke in tawakkul karne walon ki kifayat Allah Ta'ala ne ki aur un ke sath jo log burayi ka irada rakhte the unhein zillat aur barbadi ke sath paspa kiya, yeh log Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se apne shahron ki taraf baghair kisi nuqsan aur burayi ke laute, dushman apni makkariyon mein nakam raha, un se Allah khush ho gaya kyunke unhon ne us ki khushi ka kaam anjam diya tha, Allah Ta'ala bade fazl-o-karam wala hai.

Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka farman hai ke ne'mat toh yeh thi ke woh salamat rahe aur fazl yeh tha ke Huzoor ﷺ ne tajiron ke ek qafila se maal khareed liya jis mein bahut hi nafa hua aur is kul nafa ko Aap ﷺ ne apne sathiyon mein taqseem farma diya. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke Abu Sufyan ne Huzoor ﷺ se kaha ab wade ki jagah Badr hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya mumkin hai, chunancha wahan pahunche toh yeh darpok aaya hi nahin, wahan bazaar ka din tha, maal khareed liya jo nafa se bika, isi ka naam Ghazwa-e-Badr-e-Sughra hai. Phir farmata hai ke yeh Shaitan tha jo apne doston ke zariye tumhein dhamka raha tha aur geedar bhabkiyan de raha tha, tumhein chahiye ke in se na daro, sirf mera hi khauf dil mein rakho kyunke imandari ki yahi shart hai ke jab koi daraye dhamkaye aur deeni umoor se tumhein baaz rakhna chahe toh musalman Allah par bharosa kare, us ki taraf simat jaye aur yaqeen maane ke kaafi aur nasir wahi hai, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Alaysallahu bi-kaafin 'abdahu, wa yukhawwifunaka billadhina min dunihi) (Surah Az-Zumar: 36) kya Allah Jalla Shanahu apne bandon ko kaafi nahin? Yeh log tujhe us ke siwa auron se dara rahe hain (yahan tak ke farmaya) tu keh ke mujhe Allah kaafi hai, tawakkul karne walon ko isi par bharosa karna chahiye. Aur jagah farmaya Auliya-e-Shaitan se lado, Shaitan ka makr bada bouda hai. Aur jagah irshad hai yeh shaitani lashkar hai, yaad rakho shaitani lashkar hi ghate aur khasare mein hai. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Kataballahu la-aghlibanna ana wa rusuli, innallaha Qawiyyun 'Aziz) (Surah Al-Mujadilah: 21) Allah Ta'ala likh chuka hai ke ghalba yaqeenan mujhe aur mere rasoolon ko hi hoga, Allah Qawi aur Aziz hai. Aur jagah irshad hai aayat (Wa layansurannallahu man yansuruhu, innallaha la-Qawiyyun 'Aziz) (Surah Al-Hajj: 40) jo Allah ki madad karega us ki imdad farmaye ga. Aur farman hai aayat (Ya ayyuhalladhina amanu in tansurullaha yansurkum wa yuthabbit aqdamakum) (Surah Muhammad: 7) ae iman walo agar tum Allah ki madad karoge toh Allah tumhari bhi madad karega. Aur aayat mein hai aayat (Inna la-nansuru rusulana walladhina amanu fil-hayatid-dunya wa yawma yaqumul-ashhad) (Surah Ghafir: 51) bil-yaqeen hum apne rasoolon ki aur imandaron ki madad duniya mein bhi karenge aur us din bhi jis din gawah khade honge, jis din zalimon ko uzr-e-ma'zarat nafa na degi, un ke liye la'nat hai aur un ke liye bura ghar hai.

Bi'r-e-Ma'una ke shuhada aur Jannat mein un ki tamanna? Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke go shaheed fi sabil-illah duniya mein maar dale jate hain lekin aakhirat mein un ki roohein zinda rehti hain aur rizq pati hain, is aayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Rasool-ullah (ﷺ) ne chalis ya sattar sahabiyon ko Bi'r-e-Ma'una ki taraf bheja tha. Yeh jamaat jab us ghaar tak pahunchi jo us kunwein ke oopar thi to unhon ne wahan parao kiya aur aapas mein kehne lage kaun hai? Jo apni jaan khatra mein daal kar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka kalma un tak pahunchaye. Ek sahabi is ke liye tayyar hue aur un logon ke gharon ke paas aa kar ba-aawaz-e-buland farmaya: "Aye Bi'r-e-Ma'una walo suno! Main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka qasid hoon, meri gawahi hai ke mabood sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ) us ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain." Yeh sunte hi ek kafir apna teer sambhale hue apne ghar se nikla aur is tarah taak kar lagaya ke idhar ki pasli se udhar ki pasli mein aar-paar nikal gaya. Us sahabi ki zaban se besakhta nikla: "Fuztu wa Rabbil Ka'bah" (Ka'be ke Allah ki qasam! Main apni murad ko pahunch gaya). Ab kuffar nishanat tatolte hue us ghaar par ja pahunche aur Aamir bin Tufail ne jo un ka sardar tha, un sab musalmanon ko shaheed kar diya. Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke un ke bare mein Quran utra ke hamari janib se hamari qoum ko yeh khabar pahuncha do ke hum apne Rabb se mile, woh hum se raazi ho gaya aur hum us se raazi ho gaye. Hum in aayaton ko barabar padhte rahe, phir ek muddat ke baad yeh mansookh ho kar utha li gayin aur aayat (Wala tahsabanna) il-aakhirihi utri. (Muhammad bin Jareer). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai, Hazrat Masrooq farmate hain hum ne Hazrat Abdullah se is aayat ka matlab poocha to Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya: Hum ne Rasool (ﷺ) se is aayat ka matlab daryaft kiya tha to aap ne farmaya: "Un ki roohein sabz rang parindon ke qalib mein hain. Arsh ki qandeelain un ke liye hain, sari Jannat mein jahan kahin chahein charein chugein aur in qandeeliyon mein aaram karein. Un ki taraf un ke Rabb ne ek martaba nazar ki aur daryaft farmaya: Kuch aur chahte ho? Kehne lage: Aye Allah! Aur kya mangein? Sari Jannat mein se jahan kahin se chahein khayein piyein ikhtiyar hai, phir kya talab karein? Allah Ta'ala ne un se phir yahi poocha, teesri martaba yahi sawal kiya. Jab unhon ne dekha ke baghair kuch mange chara hi nahin to kehne lage: Aye Rabb! Hum chahte hain ke Tu hamari roohon ko jismon ki taraf lauta de, hum phir duniya mein ja kar Teri raah mein jihad karein aur mare jayein. Ab maloom ho gaya ke unhein kisi aur cheez ki haajat nahin to un se poochna chhod diya ke kya chahte ho?"

Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo log mar jayen aur Allah ke yahan behtari payen woh hargiz duniya mein aana pasand nahin karte magar shaheed ke woh tamanna karta hai ke duniya mein dobara lautaya jaye aur dobara rah-e-Allah mein shaheed ho kyunke shahadat ke darajat ko woh dekh raha hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se farmaya ae Jabir tumhein maloom bhi hai? Ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare walid ko zinda kiya aur un se kaha ae mere bande mang kya mangta hai? To kaha ae Allah duniya mein phir bhej taake main dobara teri rah mein mara jaun, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya yeh to main faisla kar chuka hun ke koi yahan dobara lautaya nahin jayega, un ka naam Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Haram Ansari tha Allah Ta'ala un se razamand ho, Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Hazrat Jabir farmate hain mere baap ki shahadat ke baad main rone laga aur abba ke munh se kapda hata hata kar baar baar un ke chehre ko dekh raha tha. Sahaba mujhe mana karte the lekin Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) khamosh the phir Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya Jabir ro mat jab tak tere walid ko uthaya nahin gaya farishte apne paron se us par saya kiye hue hain, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya jab tumhare bhai Uhad wale din shaheed kiye gaye to Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne un ki ruhein sabz parindon ke qalib mein daal dein jo Jannati darakhton ke phal khayen aur Jannati nehron ka pani piyen aur Arsh ke saye tale wahan latakti hui qandeelon mein aaram-o-rahat hasil karein jab khane peene rehne sehne ki yeh behtareen ne'matein unhein milin to kehne lage kaash ke hamare bhaiyon ko jo duniya mein hain hamari in ne'maton ki khabar mil jati taake woh jihad se munh na pherein aur Allah ki rah ki ladaiyon se thak kar na baith rahein Allah Ta'ala ne un se farmaya tum be-fikr raho main yeh khabar un tak pahuncha deta hun chunancha yeh ayatein nazil farmayin, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hazrat Hamza (R.A) aur aap ke sathiyon ke bare mein ayatein utrin (Mustadrak Hakim) yeh bhi mufassireen ne farmaya hai ke Uhad ke shaheedon ke bare mein yeh ayatein nazil huin. Abu Bakr bin Marduyah mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) se riwayat hai ke Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne mujhe dekha aur farmane lage Jabir kya baat hai ke tum mujhe ghamgeen nazar aate ho? Main ne kaha Ya Rasoolullah mere walid shaheed ho gaye jin par baar-e-qarz bahut hai aur mere chhote chhote behan bhai bahut hain aap ne farmaya sun main tujhe bataun jis kisi se Allah ne kalam kiya parde ke peeche se kalam kiya lekin tere baap se aamne samne baat cheet ki farmaya mujh se mang jo mange ga dunga tere baap ne kaha Allah Azzawajal main tujh se yeh mangta hun ke tu mujhe duniya mein dobara bheje aur main teri rah mein dusri martaba shaheed kiya jaun, Rabb-e-Azzawajal ne farmaya yeh baat to main pehle hi muqarrar kar chuka hun ke koi bhi laut kar dobara duniya mein nahin jayega.

Kehne lage phir ae Allah mere baad walon ko in maratib ki khabar pahuncha di jaye chunancha Allah Ta'ala ne aayat (Wala tahsabanna) al-kh, farmayi, Baihaqi mein itna aur zyada hai ke Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya main toh ae Allah teri ibadat ka haq bhi ada nahin kar saka, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai shaheed log jannat ke darwaze par nahar ke kinare sabz gumbad mein hain, subh-o-sham unhein jannat ki ne'matein pahunch jati hain, dono ahadees mein tatbeeq yeh hai ke ba'az shuhada woh hain jin ki roohein parindon ke qalib mein hain aur ba'az woh hain jin ka thikana yeh gumbad hai aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke woh jannat mein se phirte phirate yahan jama hote hon aur phir yeh khane yahin khilaye jate hon wallahu a'lam, yahan par woh hadees bhi warid karna bilkul bar-mahal hoga jis mein har momin ke liye yahi basharat hai chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya momin ki rooh ek parind mein hai jo jannat ke darakhton ke phal khati phirti hai yahan tak ke qayamat wale din jabke Allah Ta'ala sab ko khara kare toh use bhi us ke jism ki taraf lauta de ga, is hadees ke rawiyon mein teen jaleel-ul-qadr imam hain jo un char imamon mein se hain jin ke mazahib mane ja rahe hain, ek toh Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal R.H aap is hadees ko riwayat karte hain, Imam Muhammad bin Idris Shafi'i R.H se un ke ustad hain Hazrat Imam Malik bin Anas R.A pas Imam Ahmad, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Malik teenon zabardast peshwa is hadees ke rawi hain. Pas is hadees se sabit hua ke imandaron ki rooh jannati parind ki shakal mein jannat mein rehti hai aur shaheedon ki roohein jaise ke pehle guzar chuka hai sabz rang ke parindon ke qalib mein rehti hain yeh roohein misl sitaron ke hain jo aam momineen ki roohon ko yeh martaba hasil nahin, yeh apne taur par aap hi udti hain, Allah Ta'ala se jo bohat bada meharban aur zabardast ehsanon wala hai hamari dua hai ke woh hamein apne fazl-o-karam se iman-o-islam par maut de, Ameen.

Phir farmaya ke yeh shaheed jin jin nematon aur aasayishon mein hain un se behad masroor aur bahut hi khush hain aur unhein yeh bhi khushi aur rahat hai ke un ke bhai band jo un ke baad rah-e-Allah mein shaheed honge aur un ke paas aayenge unhein aayinda ka kuch khauf na hoga aur apne peeche chhori hui cheezon par unhein hasrat bhi na hogi, Allah hamein bhi jannat naseeb kare, Hazrat Muhammad bin Ishaq farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke woh khush hain ke un ke kayi aur bhai band bhi jo jihad mein lage hue hain woh bhi shaheed ho kar un ki nematon mein un ke shareek-e-haal honge aur Allah ke sawab se fayda uthayenge, Hazrat Suddi farmate hain shaheed ko ek kitab di jati hai ke falaan din tere paas falaan aayega aur falaan din falaan aayega pas jis tarah duniya wale apni kisi ghair hazir ke aane ki khabar sun kar khush hote hain isi tarah yeh shuhada un shaheedon ki aane ki khabar se masroor hote hain, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke jab shaheed jannat mein gaye aur wahan apni manzilein aur rahmatein dekhein to kehne lage kaash ke is ka ilm hamare un bhaiyon ko bhi hota jo ab tak duniya mein hi hain taake woh jawan mardi se jaan tor kar jihad karte aur un jaghon mein ja ghuste jahan se zinda aane ki umeed na hoti to woh bhi hamari in nematon mein hissa daar bante pas Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko un ke is haal ki khabar pahuncha di aur Allah Ta'ala ne un se keh diya ke main ne tumhari khabar tumhare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko de di hai is se woh bahut hi masroor-o-mahfooz hue, Bukhari Muslim mein Bir-e-Ma'una walon ka qissa bayan ho chuka hai jo sattar shakhs Ansari Sahabi thay aur ek hi din subah ke waqt ko bedardi se kuffar ne teh-e-tegh kiya tha jin qatilon ke haq mein ek mah namaz ki qunoot mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bad-dua ki thi aur jin par laanat bheji thi jin ke bare mein Quran ki yeh aayat utri thi ke hamari qoum ko hamari khabar pahunchao ke hum apne Rab se mile woh hum se raazi hua aur hum us se raazi ho gaye, woh Allah ki nemat-o-fazl ko dekh dekh kar masroor hain, Hazrat Abdur Rahman farmate hain yeh aayat (Yastabshiroon) tamam imandaron ke haq mein hai khwah shaheed hon khwah ghair. Bahut kam aise mauqe hain ke Allah Ta'ala apne nabiyon ki fazeelat aur un ke sawabon ka zikr na ho. Phir un sachay momineen ka bayan tareef ke sath ho raha hai. Jinhon ne Hamra-ul-Asad wale din hukm-e-Rasool par bawajood zakhmon se choor hone ke jihad par kamar kas li thi, mushrikeen ne musalmanon ko museebatein pahunchayin aur apne gharon ki taraf wapas chal diye.

Lekin phir unhein is ka khayal aaya ke mauqa achha tha, musalman haar chuke thay, zakhmi ho gaye thay, un ke bahadur shaheed ho chuke thay, agar hum aur jam kar ladte to faisla hi ho jata. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ka yeh irada maloom kar ke musalmanon ko tayyar karne lage ke mere sath chalo, hum in mushrikeen ke peeche jayen taake un par ra'ab tari ho aur yeh jaan lein ke musalman abhi kamzor nahin hue. Uhud mein jo log majood thay sirf unhi ko sath chalne ka hukum mila, haan sirf Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) ko un ke ilawa bhi sath liya. Is aawaz par bhi musalmanon ne labbaik kahi, bawajood yeh ke zakhmon mein choor aur khoon mein sharabor thay lekin Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ita'at ke liye kamar basta ho gaye. Hazrat Ikrama (R.A) ka bayan hai ke jab mushrikeen Uhud se laute to raste mein sochne lage ke na to tum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko qatl kiya, na musalmanon ki aurton ko pakda, afsos tum ne kuch na kiya, wapas lauto. Jab yeh khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko pahunchi to aap ne musalmanon ko tayyari ka hukum diya, yeh tayyar ho gaye aur mushrikeen ke ta'aqub mein chal pade yahan tak ke Hamra-ul-Asad tak ya "Bi'r Abi Ainiyah" tak pahunch gaye. Mushrikeen ke dil ra'ab-o-khauf se bhar gaye aur yeh keh kar Makkah ki taraf chal diye ke agle saal dekha jayega. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi wapas Madina tashreef laye, yeh bhi bil-istiqlal ek alag ladai gini jati hai, isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Uhud ki ladai pandrah Shawwal baroz hafta hui thi, solahwein tareekh baroz itwar munadi-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne nida di ke logo dushman ke ta'aqub mein chalo aur wahi log chalein jo kal maidan mein thay. Is aawaz par Hazrat Jabir (R.A) hazir hue aur arz karne lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kal ki ladai mein main na tha is liye ke mere walid Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne mujh se kaha bete tumhare sath yeh chhoti chhoti behnein hain, ise to na main pasand karoon aur na tu ke inhein yahan tanha chhod kar dono hi chal dein, ek jayega aur ek yahan rahega.

Mujh se yeh nahin ho sakta ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ham-rikab tum jao aur main baitha rahoon, is liye meri khwahish hai ke tum apni behnon ke paas raho aur main jata hoon. Is wajah se main toh wahan raha aur mere walid aap ke sath aaye. Ab meri ain tamanna hai ke aaj mujhe ijazat dijiye ke main aap ke sath chaloon. Chunancha aap ne ijazat di. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka safar is gharz se tha ke dushman dehal jaye aur peeche aata hua dekh kar samajh le ke in mein bahut kuch quwwat hai aur hamare muqable se yeh aajiz nahin. Qabeela Banu Abdul Ash-hal ke ek sahabi ka bayan hai ke Ghazwa-e-Uhud mein hum dono bhai shamil thay aur sakht zakhmi ho kar hum lautay thay. Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke munadi ne dushman ke peeche jaane ki nida di toh hum dono bhaiyon ne aapas mein kaha ke afsos! Na hamare paas sawari hai ke us par sawar ho kar Allah ke Nabi ke sath jayen, na zakhmon ke maaray jism mein itni taqat hai ke paidal sath ho len. Afsos ke yeh ghazwa hamare hath se nikal jayega, hamare beshumar gehre zakhm hamein aaj jaane se rok denge. Lekin phir hum ne himmat bandhi. Mujhe apne bhai ki nisbat zara halkay zakhm thay, jab mere bhai bilkul aajiz aa jatay, qadam na uthta toh main unhein joon-ton kar ke utha leta, jab thak jata utaar deta, yunhi joon-ton kar ke hum lashkar-gah tak pahunch hi gaye. (R.A) (Seerat-e-Ibn Ishaq). Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne Hazrat Urwa se kaha: Ae bhanjay! Tere dono baap unhi logon mein se hain jin ke bare mein aayat (Allazeena istajabu lillahi war-rasooli mim ba'di ma asabahumul qarhu lillazeena ahsanu minhum wattaqau ajrun azeem) (Surah Al-Imran: 172) aayat utri hai. Yani Hazrat Zubair aur Hazrat Siddiq (R.A), jabke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Uhud ki jang mein nuqsan pahuncha aur mushrikeen aagay chalay toh aap ko khayal hua ke kahin yeh phir wapas na lautain, lehaza aap ne farmaya: Koi hai jo in ke peeche jaye? Is par sattar shakhs is kaam ke liye musta'id ho gaye jin mein ek Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) thay, dusre Hazrat Zubair (R.A) thay. Yeh riwayat aur bahut si asnaad se bahut si kitabon mein hai. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se farmaya ke tere dono baap un logon mein se hain, lekin yeh marfoo' bayan karna mehez khata hai, is liye bhi ke is ki asnaad mein siqa rawiyon ka ikhtilaf hai jo Hazrat Ayesha ke baap dada mein se nahin. Sahih yeh hai ke yeh baat Hazrat Ayesha ne apne bhanjay Hazrat Asma bint-e-Abi Bakr ke ladke Urwa se kahi hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka bayan hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Abu Sufyan ke dil mein ra'ab daal diya aur bawajood-e-ke woh Uhud ki ladai mein qadray kamyab ho gaya tha lekin taham Makkah ki taraf chal diya. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Abu Sufyan tumhein nuqsan pahuncha kar laut gaya hai.

Allah Ta'ala ne us ke dil ko mar'oob kar diya hai, Uhud ki ladai Shawwal mein hui thi aur tajir log Zi-Qa'dah mein Madina aate thay aur Badr-e-Sughra mein apne dere har saal is maah mein dala karte thay is dafa bhi is waqia ke baad log aaye musalman apne zakhmon mein choor thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se apni takaleef bayan karte thay aur sakht sadma mein thay. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne logon ko is baat par aamada kiya ke woh aap ke saath chalein aur farmaya ke yeh log ab kooch kar jayenge aur phir Hajj ko aayenge aur phir agle saal tak yeh taqat unhein hasil nahin hogi lekin shaitan ne apne doston ko dhamkana aur behkana shuru kar diya aur kehne laga ke in logon ne tumhare istisal ke liye lashkar tayyar kar liye hain jis bina par log dheele pad gaye aap ne farmaya suno khwah tum mein se ek bhi na chale main tan-tanha jaunga phir aap ke raghbat dilane par Hazrat Abu Bakr, Hazrat Umar, Hazrat Usman, Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Zubair, Hazrat Sa'ad, Hazrat Talha, Hazrat Abdur-Rahman bin Auf, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood, Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman, Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah wagaira sattar sahaba aap ke zer-e-rikab chalne par aamada hue (R.A), yeh mubarak lashkar Abu Sufyan ki justuju mein Badr-e-Sughra tak pahunch gaya inhi ki is fazeelat aur jaan-bazi ka zikr is mubarak aayat mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is safar mein Madina se aath meel Hamra-ul-Asad tak pahunch gaye. Madina mein apna naib aap ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Um-e-Maktum (R.A) ko banaya tha.

Wahan Aap ne peer, mangal, budh tak qayam kiya phir Madina laut aaye, asna-e-qayam mein qabeela-e-Khuza'a ka sardar Ma'bad Khuza'i yahan se nikla tha yeh khud mushrik tha lekin is pooray qabeelay se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sulh-o-safai thi. Is qabeela ke mushrik, momin sab Aap ke khair khwah thay. Is ne kaha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sathiyon ko jo takleef pahunchi us par hamain sakht ranj hai, Allah Ta'ala Aap ko kamyabi ki khushi naseeb farmaye. Hamra-e-Asad par Aap pahunchay magar is se pehlay Abu Sufyan chal diya tha, go us ne aur us ke sathiyon ne wapas aanay ka irada kiya tha ke jab hum un par ghalib aa gaye, unhain qatl kiya, mara peeta, zakhmi kiya phir adhoora kaam kyun chhorein? Wapas ja kar sab ko teh-e-tegh kar dein. Yeh mashwaray ho hi rahay thay ke Ma'bad Khuza'i wahan pahuncha. Abu Sufyan ne us se poocha kaho kya khabrein hain? Us ne kaha Aanhuzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ma'a sahaba ke tum logon ke ta'aqub mein aa rahay hain, woh log sakht gussay mein hain, jo pehlay larai mein shareek na thay woh bhi shamil ho gaye hain, sab ke tewar badlay huay hain aur bharpoor taqat ke sath hamla-awar ho rahay hain, main ne to aisa lashkar kabhi dekha nahin. Yeh sun kar Abu Sufyan ke hathon ke totay ur gaye aur kehne laga achha hi hua jo tum se mulaqat ho gayi warna hum to khud un ki taraf jaanay ke liye tayyar thay. Ma'bad ne kaha hargiz yeh irada na karo aur meri baat ka kya hai, ghaliban tum yahan se kooch karnay se pehlay hi lashkar-e-Islam ke ghoron ko dekh logay, main un ke lashkar, un ke gussay, un ki tayari aur ulul-azmi ka haal bayan nahin kar sakta, main to tum se saaf kehta hoon ke bhago aur apni janain bachao, mere paas aisay alfaaz nahin jin se main musalmanon ke gaiz-o-ghazab aur tahawwur-o-shuja'at aur sakhti aur pukhtagi ka bayan kar sakoon, pas mukhtasar yeh hai ke jaan ki khair manatay ho to foran yahan se kooch karo. Abu Sufyan aur us ke sathiyon ke chhakkay chhoot gaye aur unhon ne yahan se Makka ki raah li. Qabeela-e-Abdul Qais ke aadmi jo karobar ki gharz se Madina ja rahay thay un se Abu Sufyan ne kaha ke tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh khabar pahuncha dena ke hum ne unhain teh-e-tegh kar denay ke liye lashkar jama kar liye hain aur hum wapas lautnay ke iraday mein hain, agar tum ne yeh paigham pahuncha diya to hum tumhain Souq-e-Ukaz mein bohat sari kishmish dein ge. Chunancha un logon ne Hamra-e-Asad mein aa kar bator-e-daraway ke namak mirch laga kar yeh wehshat-asar khabar sunayi lekin sahaba ne nihayat istiqlaal aur pamardi se jawab diya ke hamain Allah kaafi hai aur wohi behtareen karsaaz hai. Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne un ke liye aik pathar ka nishan muqarrar kar rakha hai agar yeh lautain ge to wahan pahunch kar is tarah mit jayain ge jaise guzashta kal ka din.
