Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke jab yeh aayat utri ke "Kaun hai jo Allah ko Qarz-e-Hasna de aur woh usey zyada dar zyada kar ke de" to Yahood kehne lage ke aye Nabi! Tumhara Rab faqeer ho gaya hai aur apne bandon se qarz maang raha hai. Is par yeh aayat (Laqad samiallahu qaulallazina qalu innallaha faqirun wa nahnu aghniya) (Surah Al-Imran: 181) nazil hui. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) Yahoodiyon ke madrasay mein gaye, yahan ka bada muallim Fakhass tha aur us ke matehat ek bahut bada aalim Ashya tha, logon ka majma tha aur woh un se mazhabi baatein sun rahe thay. Aap (R.A) ne farmaya: "Fakhass! Allah se dar aur musalman ho ja, Allah ki qasam tujhe khoob maloom hai ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Allah Ta'ala ke sachay Rasool hain, woh us ke paas se haq le kar aaye hain, un ki sifatain Taurat-o-Injeel mein tumhare hathon mein maujood hain." To Fakhass ne jawab mein kaha: "Abu Bakr! Sun, Allah ki qasam Allah hamara mohtaj hai, hum us ke mohtaj nahin, us ki taraf is tarah nahin girgirate jaise woh hamari janib aajizi karta hai, balkay hum to us se be-parwah hain, hum ghani aur tun-gar hain, agar woh ghani hota to hum se qarz talab na karta jaise ke tumhara paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) keh raha hai, hamein to sood se rokta hai aur khud sood deta hai, agar ghani hota to hamein sood kyun deta?" Is par Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ko sakht gussa aaya aur Fakhass ke munh par zor se mara aur farmaya: "Allah ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, agar tum Yahood se muahida na hota to main tujh Allah ke dushman ka sar kaat deta, jao bad-naseebo! Jhutlate hi raho agar sachay ho." Fakhass ne ja kar is ki shikayat Sarkar-e-Muhammadi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein ki. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) se poocha ke ise kyun mara? Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne waqia bayan kiya lekin Fakhass apne qaul se mukar gaya ke main ne to aisa kaha hi nahin. Is bare mein yeh aayat utri. Phir Allah Ta'ala inhe apne azab ki khabar deta hai ke un ka yeh qaul aur sath hi isi jaisa un ka bada gunah yani qatl-e-ambiya hum ne un ke nama-e-aamal mein likh liya hai. Ek taraf un ka Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ki shaan mein be-adabi karna, dusri janib nabiyon ko maar dalna, in kamon ki wajah inhe sakht-tar saza milegi. In ko hum kahenge ke jalne wale azab ka zaiqa chakho, aur un se kaha jayega ke yeh tumhare pehle ke kartoot ka badla hai, yeh keh kar inhe zaleel-o-ruswa kun azab par azab honge, yeh sarasar adl-o-insaf hai aur zahir hai ke Malik apne ghulamon par zulm karne wala nahin hai.

Phir un ke is khayal mein jhoota sabit kiya ja raha hai jo yeh kehte thay ke aasmani kitabein jo pehle nazil huin un mein Allah Ta'ala ne hamein yeh hukum de rakha hai ke jab tak koi Rasool hamein yeh mojiza na dikhaye ke us ki ummat mein se jo shakhs qurbani kare us ki qurbani ko kha jaane ke liye aasman se qudrati aag aaye aur kha jaye, un ki is qaul ke jawab mein irshad hota hai ke phir is mojize wale paighambaron ko jo apne sath dalail aur barahin le kar aaye thay tum ne kyun maar dala? Unhein toh Allah Ta'ala ne yeh mojiza bhi de rakha tha ke har ek qabool shuda qurbani aasmani aag kha jati thi lekin tum ne unhein bhi saccha na jana, un ki bhi mukhalifat aur dushmani ki balkeh unhein qatl kar dala. Is se saaf zahir hai ke tumhein tumhari apni baat ka bhi paas-o-lihaz nahin, lehaza tum haq ke sathi na ho na kisi Nabi ke manne wale ho. Tum yaqeenan jhoote ho. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tasalli deta hai ke un ke jhutlane se aap tang-e-dil aur ghamnak na hon, agle ulul-azm paighambaron ke waqiyat ko apne liye ba'is-e-tasalli banayein ke woh bhi bawajood daleelein zahir kar dene ke aur bawajood apni haqaniyat ko bakhoobi wazeh kar dene ke phir bhi jhutlaye gaye. Zubur se murad aasmani kitabein hain jo un sahifon ki tarah aasman se aayin jo Rasoolon par utari gayi thin aur "Munir" se murad wazeh, jali aur roshan aur chamkili hai.

Maut-o-Hayat aur Youm-e-Hisab. Tamam makhlooq ko aam ittila hai ke har jaandar marne wala hai jaise farmaya aayat (Kullu man 'alaiha fan. Wa yabqa wajhu Rabbika zul-jalali wal-ikram) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 26-27) yani is zameen par jitne hain sab faani hain sirf Rabb ka chehra baqi hai jo buzurgi aur inaam wala hai, pas sirf wahi Allah Wahdahu La Sharika hamesha ki zindagi wala hai jo kabhi fana na hoga, jinn-o-insan kul ke kul marne wale hain isi tarah farishte aur hamilan-e-Arsh bhi mar jayenge aur sirf Allah Wahdahu La Sharika dawam aur baqa wala baqi reh jayega pehle bhi wahi tha aur aakhir bhi wahi rahega, jab sab mar jayenge muddat khatam ho jayegi sulb-e-Adam se jitni aulad hone wali thi ho chuki aur phir sab maut ke ghaat utar gaye makhlooqat ka khatma ho gaya us waqt Allah Ta'ala Qayamat qaim karega aur makhlooq ko un ke kul a'maal ke chote bade chhupe khule saghira kabira sab ki jaza saza milegi kisi par zarra barabar zulm na hoga yahi is ke baad ke jumla mein farmaya ja raha hai, Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke inteqal ke baad hamein aisa mehsoos hua ke goya koi aa raha hai hamein paon ki chaap sunai deti thi lekin koi shakhs dikhai nahin deta tha us ne aa kar kaha ae Ahl-e-Bait tum par salam ho aur Allah ki rahmat-o-barkat, har jaan maut ka maza chakhne wali hai tum sab ko tumhare a'maal ka badla pura pura Qayamat ke din diya jayega. Har musibat ki talafi Allah ke paas hai, har marne wale ka badla hai aur har faut hone wale ka apni gum shuda cheez ko pa lena hai Allah hi par bharosa rakho usi se bhali ummeedein rakho samajh lo ke sach much musibat zada woh shakhs jo sawab se mehroom reh jaye tum par Allah ki taraf se salamti nazil ho aur us ki rahmaten aur barkaten (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka khayal hai ke yeh Khizr (A.S) the haqeeqat yeh hai ke pura kamyab woh insan hai jo Jahannam se nijat pa le aur Jannat mein chala jaye, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Jannat mein ek kore jitni jagah mil jana dunya-o-ma fiha se behtar hai agar tum chaho to parho aayat (Faman zuhziha 'anin-nari wa udkhilal-jannata faqad faz) (Surah Al-Imran: 185) aakhri tukre ke baghair yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein bhi hai aur kuch zyada alfaaz ke sath Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai aur Ibn Marduyah mein bhi Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai jis ki khwahish aag se bach jane aur Jannat mein dakhil ho jane ki ho use chahiye ke marte dam tak Allah par aur Qayamat par iman rakhe aur logon se woh sulook kare jise khud apne liye pasand karta ho, yeh hadith pehle aayat (Wala tamutunna illa wa antum muslimun) (Surah Al-Imran: 102) ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi aur Waki' bin Jarrah ki tafsir mein bhi yahi hadith hai. Is ke baad dunya ki haqarat aur zillat bayan ho rahi hai ke yeh nihayat zaleel faani aur zawal pazeer cheez hai irshad hai aayat (Bal tu'sirunal-hayatad-dunya. Wal-akhiratu khairun wa abqa) (Surah Al-A'la: 16-17).

(Al-A'la: 16) Ya'ni tum toh duniya ki zindagi par rijhe jaate ho halankeh darasal behtari aur baqa wali cheez aakhirat hai, dusri aayat mein hai tumhein jo kuch diya gaya hai yeh toh hayat-e-duniya ka faida hai aur iski behtareen zeenat aur baqi rehne wali toh woh zindagi hai jo Allah ke paas hai, Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai Allah ki qasam duniya aakhirat ke muqabla mein sirf aisi hi hai jaise koi shakhs apni ungli samundar mein dubo le us ungli ke paani ko samundar ke paani ke muqabla mein kya nisbat hai aakhirat ke muqabla mein duniya aisi hi hai, Hazrat Qatada R.H ka irshad hai duniya kya hai ek yunhi dhoke ki jagah hai jise chhod chhaad kar tumhein chal dena hai us Allah ki qasam jiske siwa koi laiq-e-ibadat nahin keh yeh toh anqareeb tum se juda hone wali aur barbad hone wali cheez hai pas tumhein chahiye keh hosh-mandi barto aur yahan Allah ki ita'at karlo aur taqat bhar nekiyan kama lo Allah ki di hui taqat ke baghair koi kaam nahin banta. Aazmaish laazmi hai sabr-o-zabt bhi zaroori phir insani aazmaish ka zikr ho raha hai jaise irshad hai aayat (Walanabluwannakum bishai'im minal khaufi wal ju'i wa naqsim minal amwali wal anfusi wath thamarat, wa bashirish sabireen) (Al-Baqarah: 155) matlab yeh hai keh momin ka imtehan zaroor hota hai kabhi jaani kabhi maali kabhi ahl-e-iyaal mein kabhi aur kisi tarah yeh aazmaish deendari ke andaaz ke mutabiq hoti hai, sakht deendar ki ibtila bhi sakht aur kamzor deen wale ka imtehan bhi kamzor, phir Parwardigar Jalla Shanahu Sahaba-e-Kiram R.A ko khabar deta hai keh Badr se pehle Madina mein tumhein Ahl-e-Kitab se aur mushrikon se dukh dene wali baatein aur sarzanish sunni padegi, phir tasalli deta hua tareeqa sikhata hai keh tum sabr-o-zabt karliya karo aur parhezgari par toh yeh bada bhari kaam hai, Hazrat Usama bin Zaid R.A farmate hain Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke as-haab mushrikeen se aur Ahl-e-Kitab se bahut kuch dargarzar farmaya karte the aur unki ezaon ko bardasht karliya karte the aur Rabb-e-Kareem ke is farman par aamil the yahan tak keh jihad ki aayatein utrein, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is aayat ki tafseer ke mauqa par hai keh Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne gadhe par sawar ho kar Hazrat Usama R.A ko apne peeche bitha kar Hazrat Sa'ad bin Ubada R.A ki ayadat ke liye Banu Haris bin Khazraj ke qabeelay mein tashreef le chale yeh waqea jang-e-Badr se pehle ka hai raasta mein ek makhlut majlis baithi hui mili jis mein musalman bhi the yahudi bhi the.

Mushrikeen bhi thay aur Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool bhi tha, yeh bhi ab tak kufr ke khulay rang mein tha. Musalmanon mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawahah (R.A) bhi thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sawari se gard-o-ghubar jo ura toh Abdullah bin Ubayy Salool ne naak par kapra rakh liya aur kehne laga ghubar na urao. Huzoor (ﷺ) paas pahunch hi chukay thay, sawari se utar aaye, salam kiya aur unhein Islam ki dawat di aur Quran ki chand aayatein sunayin toh Abdullah bol para, "Suniye sahib! Aap ka yeh tareeqa hamein pasand nahin, aap ki baatein haq hi sahi lekin is ki kya wajah ke aap hamari majlison mein aa kar hamein eeza dein? Apne ghar jaiye, jo aap ke paas aaye usay sunaiye." Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abdullah bin Rawahah (R.A) ne farmaya, "Huzoor (ﷺ)! Beshak aap hamari majlison mein tashreef laya karein, hamein toh is ki ain chahat hai." Ab un ki aapas mein khoob jharap hui, ek dusre ko bura bhala kehne laga aur qareeb tha ke kharay ho kar larnay lagein, lekin Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samjhane bujhane se aakhir aman-o-aman ho gaya aur sab khamosh ho gaye. Aap apni sawari par sawar ho kar Hazrat Saad (R.A) ke yahan tashreef le gaye aur wahan ja kar Hazrat Saad (R.A) se farmaya ke Abu Hubab Abdullah bin Ubayy Salool ne aaj toh is tarah kiya. Hazrat Saad (R.A) ne kaha, "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Aap jaane dijiye, maaf kijiye aur darguzar kijiye. Qasam Allah ki jis ne aap par Quran utara, usay aap se is liye behad dushmani hai aur honi chahiye ke yahan ke logon ne usay sardar banana chaha tha, usay chaudrahat ki pagri bandhwane ka faisla ho chuka tha. Idhar Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko apna Nabi-e-Barhaq bana kar bheja, logon ne aap ko Nabi mana, us ki sardari jaati rahi jis ka usay ranj hai. Isi baais yeh apne jalay dil ke phapholay phor raha hai, jo keh diya keh diya, aap isay ahmiyat na dein." Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ) ne darguzar kar liya aur yahi aap ki aadat thi aur aap ke as-haab ki bhi, Yahudiyon se, Mushrikeen se darguzar farmatay, suni ansuni kar diya karte aur is farman par amal karte. Yahi hukm aayat (wa la-tasma'unna) mein hai, jo hukm-e-afw-o-darguzar ka is aayat (wa la-tasma'unna) mein hai. Baad azan aap ko jihad ki ijazat di gayi aur pehla ghazwa Badr ka hua jis mein lashkar-e-kuffar ke sardaran qatl-o-gharat hue. Yeh halat aur shaukat-e-Islam dekh kar ab Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool aur us ke saathi ghabraye, bajuz is ke koi chara-e-kaar unhein nazar na aaya ke bai'at kar lein aur bazahir musalman ho jayen. Pas yeh kulliya qaida yaad rakhna chahiye ke har haq walay par jo neki aur bhalai ka hukm karta rahe aur jo burai aur khilaf-e-shar' kaam se rokta rahe, us par zaroor museebatein aur aafatein aati hain. Usay chahiye ke in tamam takleefon ko jhelay aur Allah ki raah mein sabr-o-zabt se kaam le, isi ki paak zaat par bharosa rakhay, isi se madad talab karta rahe aur apni kamil tawajjuh aur poora ruju isi ki taraf rakhay.

Isi baais yeh apne jalay dil ke phapholay phor raha hai, jo keh diya keh diya, aap isay ahmiyat na dein." Chunancha Huzoor (ﷺ) ne darguzar kar liya aur yahi aap ki aadat thi aur aap ke as-haab ki bhi, Yahudiyon se, Mushrikeen se darguzar farmatay, suni ansuni kar diya karte aur is farman par amal karte. Yahi hukm aayat (wa la-tasma'unna) mein hai, jo hukm-e-afw-o-darguzar ka is aayat (wa la-tasma'unna) mein hai. Baad azan aap ko jihad ki ijazat di gayi aur pehla ghazwa Badr ka hua jis mein lashkar-e-kuffar ke sardaran qatl-o-gharat hue. Yeh halat aur shaukat-e-Islam dekh kar ab Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool aur us ke saathi ghabraye, bajuz is ke koi chara-e-kaar unhein nazar na aaya ke bai'at kar lein aur bazahir musalman ho jayen. Pas yeh kulliya qaida yaad rakhna chahiye ke har haq walay par jo neki aur bhalai ka hukm karta rahe aur jo burai aur khilaf-e-shar' kaam se rokta rahe, us par zaroor museebatein aur aafatein aati hain. Usay chahiye ke in tamam takleefon ko jhelay aur Allah ki raah mein sabr-o-zabt se kaam le, isi ki paak zaat par bharosa rakhay, isi se madad talab karta rahe aur apni kamil tawajjuh aur poora ruju isi ki taraf rakhay.

Badtareen khareed-o-farokht! Allah Ta'ala yahan Ahl-e-Kitab ko daant raha hai ke paighambaron ki wasatat se jo ahd unka Janab-e-Bari se hua tha ke Huzoor-e-Paighambar-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par imaan layenge aur Aap (ﷺ) ke zikr ko aur Aap (ﷺ) ki basharat ki peshgoi ko logon mein phailayenge, unhein Aap (ﷺ) ki tabedari par aamada karenge aur phir jis waqt Aap (ﷺ) aajayein toh dil se Aap (ﷺ) ke tabedar hojayenge, lekin unhon ne is ahd ko chupa liya aur Allah Ta'ala iske zahir karne par jin duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalaiyon ka unse wada kiya tha, unke badle duniya ki thodi si poonji mein ulajh kar reh gaye. Unki yeh khareed-o-farokht bad se badtar hai. Is mein ulama ko tanbeeh hai ke woh unki tarah na karein warna un par bhi wahi saza hogi jo unko mili aur unhein bhi Allah ki woh narazgi uthani padegi jo unhon ne uthai. Ulama-e-Kiram ko chahiye ke unke paas jo nafa dene wala deeni ilm ho jis se log nek amal kar sakte hon, use phailate rahein aur kisi baat ko na chupayein. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai, jis shakhs se ilm ka koi masla poocha jaye aur woh use chupaye toh Qayamat ke din aag ki lagaam pehnaya jayega. Doosri aayat mein riyakaron ki muzammat bayan ho rahi hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai, jo shakhs jhoota dawa kar ke zyada maal kamana chahe use Allah Ta'ala aur kam kar dega. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki doosri hadith mein hai, jo na diya gaya ho uske sath aasoodgi jatane wala do jhoote kapde pehne wale ki misl hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Marwan ne apne darban Rafe se kaha ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ke paas jao aur unse kaho ke agar apne kaam par khush hone aur na kiye hue kaam par tareef pasand karne ke baais Allah ka azab hoga toh hum se koi is se chhutkara nahin pa sakta. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne iske jawab mein farmaya ke tumhein is aayat se kya talluq?

Yeh toh Ahl-e-Kitab ke baare mein hai phir aap ne (Wa iz akhazallahu) se is aayat ke khatm tak tilawat ki aur farmaya ke un se Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kisi cheez ke baare mein sawal kiya tha toh unhon ne is ka kuch aur hi ghalat jawab diya aur bahar nikal kar guman karne lage ke hum ne aap ke sawal ka jawab de diya jis ki wajah se aap ke paas hamari tareef hogi aur sawal ke asli jawab ke chupa lene aur apne jhoote fiqra chal jaane par bhi khush thay, isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai, yeh hadith Bukhari waghera mein bhi hai aur Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) maidan-e-jang mein tashreef le jaate toh munafiqeen apne gharon mein ghuse baithe rehte saath na jaate phir khushiyan manate ke hum ladai se bach gaye ab jab Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wapas laut-te toh yeh baatein banate jhoote sachay uzr pesh karte aur qasmein kha kha kar apne mazoor hone ka aap ko yaqeen dilate aur chahte ke na kiye hue kaam par bhi hamari tareefein hon jis par yeh aayat utri, Tafsir Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Marwan ne Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) se is aayat ke baare mein isi tarah sawal kiya tha jis tarah oopar guzra ke Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se puchwaya toh Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) ne is ka misdaq aur is ka shaan-e-nuzool un munafiqon ko qarar diya jo ghazwa ke waqt baith jaate agar musalmanon ko nuqsan pahuncha toh baghlein bajate agar faida hua toh apna mazoor hona zahir karte aur fath-o-nusrat ki khushi ka izhar karte is par Marwan ne kaha kahan yeh waqia kahan yeh aayat? Toh Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) ne farmaya ke yeh Zaid bin Thabit (R.A) bhi is se waqif hain Marwan ne Hazrat Zaid (R.A) se poocha aap ne bhi is ki tasdeeq ki phir Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) ne oontniyan jo sadqa ki hain chheen lenge bahar nikal kar Hazrat Zaid (R.A) ne kaha meri shahadat par tum meri tareef nahin karte? Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) ne farmaya tum ne sachi shahadat ada kar di toh Hazrat Zaid (R.A) ne farmaya phir main bhi sachi shahadat dene par mustahiq-e-tareef toh hoon Marwan is zamana mein Madina ka ameer tha, dusri riwayat mein hai ke Marwan ka yeh sawal Rafe bin Khadij (R.A) se hi pehle hua tha, is se pehle ki riwayat mein guzar chuka hai ke Marwan ne is aayat ki babat Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se puchwaya tha toh yaad rahe ke in donon mein koi tazad aur nafi ka unsur nahin hum keh sakte hain ke aayat aam hai is mein bhi shamil hai aur is mein bhi, Marwan wali riwayat mein bhi mumkin hai pehle in donon sahibon ne jawab diye phir mazeed tashaffi ke taur par Habr-ul-Ummah Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se bhi Marwan ne bazariya apne aadmi ke sawal kiya ho, Wallahu A'lam, Hazrat Thabit bin Qais Ansari (R.A) khidmat-e-Nabwi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein hazir ho kar arz karte hain ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe toh apni halakat ka bada andesha hai aap ne farmaya kyun?

Jawab diya ek toh is wajah se ke Allah Ta'ala ne is baat se roka hai ke jo na kiya ho us par tareef ko pasand karein aur mera yeh haal hai ke main tareef pasand karta hoon, dusri baat yeh hai ke takabbur se Allah ne roka hai aur main jamaal ko pasand karta hoon, teesre yeh ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aawaz se buland aawaz karna mamnoo hai aur main buland aawaz hoon toh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya tu is baat se khush nahin ke teri zindagi behtareen aur ba-khair ho aur teri maut shahadat ki maut ho aur tu jannati ban jaye, khush ho kar kehne lage kyun nahin Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh toh bahut hi achi baat hai, chunancha yahi hua ke aap ki zindagi intehai achi guzri aur maut shahadat ki naseeb hui, Musailma Kazzab se musalmanon ki jang mein aap ne shahadat payi. Tahsabunahum ko Yahsabunahum parha gaya hai, phir farman hai ke tu unhein azab se nijat paane waale khayal na kar unhein azab zaroor hoga aur woh bhi dard-naak, phir irshad hai ke har cheez ka maalik aur har cheez par qadir Allah Ta'ala hai use koi kaam aajiz nahin kar sakta, pas tum us se darte raho aur us ki mukhalifat na karo, us ke ghazab se bachne ki koshish karo, us ke azabon se apna bachao kar lo, na toh koi us se bada na us se zyada qudrat waala.

Mazahir-e-Kainat Daleel-e-Rabb-e-Zuljalal Dawat-e-Ghor-o-Fikr. Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Quraish Yahudiyon ke paas gaye aur un se poocha ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) tumhare paas kya kya mojizat le kar aaye thay? Unhon ne kaha azdaha ban jaane wali lakri aur chamkila haath, phir Nasraniyon ke paas gaye un se kaha tumhare paas Hazrat Isa (A.S) kya nishaniyan laaye thay? Jawab mila ke madar-zad andhon ko beena kar dena aur korhi ko achha kar dena aur murdon ko zinda kar dena. Ab yeh Quraish Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur Aap (ﷺ) se kaha Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke hamare liye Safa pahar ko sone ka bana de. Aap (ﷺ) ne dua ki jis par yeh aayat (اِنَّ فِيْ خَلْقِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 164) utri, yani nishan-e-qudrat dekhne walon ke liye isi mein bari nishaniyan hain, yeh isi mein ghor-o-fikr karenge to in qudraton wale Allah Ta'ala ke samne jhuk jayenge. Lekin is riwayat mein ek ishkal hai woh yeh ke yeh sawal Makkah Sharif mein hua tha aur yeh aayat Madina Sharif mein nazil hui, Wallahu A'lam. Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke aasman jaisi buland aur wus'at-e-makhlooq aur zameen jaisi past aur sakht aur lambi chori makhlooq, phir aasman mein bari bari nishaniyan maslan chalne phirne wale aur ek jaa thaharne wale sitare aur zameen ki bari bari paidawar maslan pahar, jangal, darakht, ghaas, khetiyan, phal aur mukhtalif qisam ke jaandar, kaanein, alag alag zaiqay wale aur tarah tarah ki khushbuon wale aur mukhtalif khawas wale meway waghera, kya yeh sab aayat-e-qudrat ek soch samajh wale insaan ki rahbari Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki taraf nahin kar saktein? Jo aur nishaniyan dekhne ki zaroorat baqi rahe. Phir din raat ka aana jaana aur un ka kam zyada hona phir barabar ho jana, yeh sab is Aziz-o-Haleem Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki qudrat-e-kamilah ki poori poori nishaniyan hain jo paak nafs wale har cheez ki haqeeqat par nazrein daalne ke aadi hain aur bewaqoofon ki tarah aankh andhay aur kaan ke behray nahin, jin ki halat aur jagah bayan hui hai ke woh aasman aur zameen ki bohat si nishaniyan pairon talay rondte hue guzar jaate hain aur ghor-o-fikr nahin karte, in mein se aksar bawajood Allah Ta'ala ko maanne ke phir bhi shirk se nahin bach sake.

Ab in aqalmandon ki sifatain bayan ho rahi hain ke woh uthte baithte lette Allah ka naam liya karte hain, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Imran bin Husain (R.A) se farmaya khade ho kar namaz padha karo agar taqat na ho to baith kar aur yeh bhi na ho sake to lete lete hi sahi, yani kisi halat mein Allah Azzawajal ke zikr se ghafil mat raho dil mein aur posheeda aur zaban se Allah Ta'ala ka zikr karte raha karo, yeh log aasman aur zameen ki paidaish mein nazrein daudate hain aur un ki hikmaton par gaur karte hain jo us Khaliq-e-Yakta ki azmat-o-qudrat ilm-o-hikmat ikhtiyar-e-rahmat par dalalat karti hain, Hazrat Sheikh Sulaiman Darani (R.H) farmate hain ghar se nikal kar jis cheez par meri nazar padti hai main dekhta hoon ke us mein Allah ki ek sa'at gaur-o-fikr karna raat bhar ke qayam karne se afzal hai, Hazrat Fuzail (R.H) farmate hain ke Hazrat Hasan (R.A) ka qaul hai ke gaur-o-fikr ek noor hai jo tere dil par apna partau dale ga aur basa auqat yeh bait padhte: "Iza al-mar'u kanat lahu fikratun, fa fi kulli shai'in lahu 'ibratun" yani jis insan ko bareek beeni aur soch samajh ki aadat pad gayi use har cheez mein ek ibrat aur aayat nazar aati hai, Hazrat Isa (A.S) farmate hain khush naseeb hai woh shakhs jis ka bolna zikr-e-Allah aur nasihat ho aur us ka chup rehna gaur-o-fikr ho aur us ka dekhna ibrat aur tanbeeh ho, Luqman Hakim ka nasihat aamoz maqoola bhi yaad rahe ke tanhai ki gosha nasheeni jis qadar zyada ho aur usi qadar gaur-o-fikr aur door andeshi ki aadat zyada hoti hai aur jis qadar yeh badh jaye usi qadar raaste insan par woh khul jate hain jo use jannat mein pahuncha denge, Hazrat Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) farmate hain jis qadar muraqba zyada hoga usi qadar samajh boojh tez hogi aur jitni samajh zyada hogi utna ilm naseeb hoga aur jis qadar ilm zyada hoga nek a'amal bhi badhenge, Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ka irshad hai ke Allah Azzawajal ke zikr mein zaban ka chalana bahut achha hai aur Allah ki na'imaton mein gaur-o-fikr afzal ibadat hai, Hazrat Mughees Aswad (R.H) majlis mein baithe hue farmate ke logo qabristan har roz jaya karo taake tumhein anjam ka khayal paida ho phir apne dil mein us manzar ko hazir karo ke tum Allah ke samne khade ho phir ek jamaat ko jahannam mein le jane ka hukm hota hai aur ek jamaat jannat mein jati hai apne dilon ko is haal mein jazb kar do aur apne badan ko bhi wahin hazir jaan lo jahannam ko apne samne dekho us ke hathoron ko us ki aag ke qaid khanon ko apne samne lao itna farmate hi dhaarein maar maar kar rone lagte hain yahan tak ke behosh ho jate hain, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak (R.H) farmate hain ek shakhs ne ek rahib se ek qabristan aur kooda karkat pakhana peshab dalne ki jagah par mulaqat ki aur us se kaha ae banda-e-haq is waqt tere paas do khazane hain ek khazana logon ka yani qabristan aur dusra khazana maal ka yani kooda karkat, peshab pakhana dalne ki jagah.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) khandrat par jaate aur kisi toote phoote darwaze par khade reh kar nihayat hasrat-o-afsos ke sath bharayi hui awaz mein farmate, "Ae ujde hue gharo! Tumhare rehne wale kahan gaye?" Phir khud farmate, "Sab zer-e-zameen chale gaye, sab fana ka jaam pee chuke, sirf Allah Ta'ala ki zaat hi hamesha ki malik-e-baqa hai." Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ka irshad hai, "Do raka'atein jo dil bastagi ke sath ada ki jayen, us tamam namaz se afzal hain jis mein sari raat guzar di lekin dilchaspi na thi." Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain, "Ibn-e-Adam! Apne pet ke teesre hisse mein kha, teesre hisse mein pani pee aur teesra hissa un sanson ke liye chhod jis mein tu akhirat ki baton par, apne anjam par aur apne a'maal par gaur-o-fikr kar sake." Ba'az hakeemon ka qaul hai, "Jo shakhs duniya ki cheezon par ibrat hasil kiye baghair nazar dalta hai, us ghaflat ki wajah se uski dili aankhein kamzor pad jati hain." Hazrat Aamir bin Qais (R.H) farmate hain ke, "Main ne bahut se sahaba se suna hai ke iman ki roshni aur noor gaur-o-fikr aur muraqba mein hai." Maseeh Ibn-e-Maryam Sayyiduna Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka farman hai ke, "Ibn-e-Adam! Ae za'eef insan! Jahan kahin tu ho Allah Ta'ala se darta reh, duniya mein aajizi aur maskeeni ke sath reh, apna ghar masjidon ko bana le, apni aankhon ko rona sikha, apne jism ko sabr ki aadat sikha, apne dil ko gaur-o-fikr karne wala bana, kal ki rozi ki fikr aaj na kar." Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ek martaba majlis mein baithe hue ro diye, logon ne wajah poochhi to aap ne farmaya, "Main ne duniya mein aur uski lazzaton mein aur uski khwahishon mein gaur-o-fikr kiya aur ibrat hasil ki, jab natija par pahuncha to meri umangein khatam ho gayin, haqeeqat yeh hai ke har shakhs ke liye is mein ibrat-o-naseehat hai aur wa'az-o-pand hai." Hussain bin Abdur Rahman ne bhi apne ash'aar mein is mazmoon ko khoob nibhaya hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne un bandon ki madh-o-sana bayan ki jo makhlooqat aur kainat se ibrat hasil karein aur naseehat lein aur un logon ki muzammat bayan ki jo qudrat ki nishaniyon par gaur na karein.

Mominon ki madh mein bayan ho raha hai ke yeh log uthte baithte leitte Allah Subhanahu ka zikr karte hain, zameen-o-aasman ki paidaish mein gaur-o-fikr karte hain aur kehte hain ke ae Allah! Tu ne apni makhlooq ko abas aur bekar nahin banaya balkeh haq ke sath paida kiya hai taake buron ko burai ka badla aur nekon ko nekiyon ka badla ata farmaye. Phir Allah ki pakeezgi bayan karte hain, Tu is se munazza hai ke kisi cheez ko bekar banaye. Ae Khaliq-e-Kainat! Ae adl-o-insaf se kainat ko sajane wale! Ae nuqsan aur aibon se pak zaat! Hamein apni quwwat-o-taqat se un aamal ki taufiq aur hamara rafeeq farma jin se hum tere azabon se nijat pa lein aur teri nematon se mala-maal ho kar jannat mein dakhil ho jayen. Yeh yun bhi kehte hain ke ae Allah! Jise Tu jahannam mein le gaya use Tu ne barbad aur zaleel-o-khwar kar diya, majma-e-hashr ke samne use ruswa kiya, zalimon ka koi madadgar nahin, unhein na koi chura sake, na bacha sake, na tere irade ke darmiyan aa sake. Ae Rabb! Hum ne pukarne wale ki pukar sun li jo imaan aur Islam ki taraf bulata hai, murad is se Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain jo farmate hain ke apne Rabb par imaan lao, hum imaan la chuke aur tabedari baja laye, pas hamare imaan aur farman-bardari ki wajah se hamare gunahon ko maaf farma, un ki parda-poshi kar aur hamari buraiyon ko hum se door kar de aur hamein saleh aur nek logon ke sath mila de. Tu ne hum se jo wade apne nabiyon ki zabani kiye hain unhein poore kar, aur yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke jo wada Tu ne hum se apne rasoolon par imaan lane ka liya tha, lekin pehla mani wazeh hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Asqalan do aroos mein se ek hai, yahin se Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala sattar hazar shuhada uthayenge jo wafd ban kar Allah ke paas jayenge, yahin shahidon ki safein hongi jin ke hathon mein un ke kate hue sar honge, un ki gardan ki ragon se khoon jaari hoga, yeh kehte honge ae Allah! Hum se jo wade apne rasoolon ki marifat Tu ne kiye hain unhein poore kar, hamein Qayamat ke din ruswa na kar, Tu wada-khilafi se pak hai. Allah Ta'ala farmayega mere yeh bande sache hain aur unhein Nehr-e-Baiza mein ghusl karwayenge jis ghusl ke baad pak saaf gore chitte rang ke ho kar niklenge aur saari jannat un ke liye mubah hogi, jahan chahein jayen ayen, jo chahein khayen piyen. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur baaz to kehte hain mauzoo hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Hamein Qayamat ke din tamam logon ke majmay mein ruswa na kar, tere waaday sachay hain, tu ne jo kuch khabrein apne Rasoolon ki zabani pohanchayi hain sab atal hain, Qayamat ka roz zaroor aana hai, pas tu hamein us din ki ruswayi se nijaat de. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmatay hain ke banday par ruswayi, daant-dupat, maar aur sharmindagi is qadar dali jayegi aur is tarah Allah Ta'ala ke samnay khara kar ke usay qail-o-maqool kiya jayega ke woh chahay ga ke kaash mujhe Jahannam mein hi daal diya jata (Abu Ya'la). Is hadith ki sanad bhi ghareeb hai. Ahadith se yeh bhi sabit hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) raat ko Tahajjud ke liye jab uthtay tab Surah Al-Imran ki in das aakhri aayaton ki tilawat farmatay. Chunancha Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain, main ne apni khala Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) ke ghar raat guzari, yeh Umm-ul-Momineen Huzoor (ﷺ) ki biwi sahiba thin. Huzoor (ﷺ) jab aaye to thori der tak aap Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) se baatein karte rahay phir so gaye. Jab aakhri tihayi raat baqi reh gayi to aap uth bethay aur aasman ki taraf nigah kar ke aayat (Inna fi khalqis-samawati) se aakhir-e-surat tak ki aayatein tilawat farmayin, phir kharay huay, miswak ki, wuzu kiya aur gyarah rakat namaz ada ki. Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ki subah ki azan sun kar phir do rakatein subah ki sunnatein parhin, phir masjid mein tashreef la kar logon ko subah ki namaz parhayi. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh riwayat dusri jagah bhi hai ke bistaray ke arz mein to main soya aur lambayi mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) leitin. Aadhi raat ke qareeb kuch pehlay ya kuch baad Huzoor (ﷺ) jaagay, apne hathon se apni aankhein maltay huay in das aayaton ki tilawat ki, phir ek latki hui mashk mein se pani le kar bohat achi tarah kamil wuzu kiya. Main bhi aap ki bayin janib aap ki iqtida mein namaz ke liye khara ho gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apna dahina hath mere sar par rakh kar mere kaan ko pakar kar mujhe ghuma kar apni dayin janib kar liya aur do-do rakat kar ke chhay martaba yani barah rakat parhin, phir Witr parha aur lait gaye yahan tak ke muazzin ne aa kar namaz ki ittila ki. Aap ne kharay ho kar do halki rakatein ada kin aur bahar aa kar subah ki namaz parhayi. Ibn Marduyah ki is hadith mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmatay hain mujhe mere walid Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke tum aaj ki raat Huzoor (ﷺ) ki aal mein guzaro aur aap ki raat ki namaz ki kaifiyat dekho. Raat ko jab sab log Isha ki namaz parh kar chalay gaye main betha raha, jab Huzoor (ﷺ) jaanay lagay to mujhe dekh kar farmaya, "Kaun? Abdullah?"

Main ne kaha ji haan, farmaya kyun ruke hue ho? Main ne kaha walid sahab ka hukum hai ke raat aap ke ghar guzaron, toh farmaya bahut achha, aao. Ghar ja kar farmaya bistar bichhao, taat ka takiya aaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us par sar rakh kar so gaye, yahan tak ke mujhe aap ke kharaton ki aawaz aane lagi. Phir aap jaage aur seedhi tarah baith kar aasman ki taraf dekh kar teen martaba dua (Subhanal Malikil Quddus) padha, phir Surah Al-Imran ke khatma ki yeh aayatein padhin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aayaton ki tilawat ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh dua padhi: (Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nooran, wa fi sam'i nooran, wa fi basari nooran, wa 'an yamini nooran, wa 'an shamali nooran, wa min baini yadayya nooran, wa min khalfi nooran, wa min fawqi nooran, wa min tahti nooran, wa a'zim li nooran yaumal qiyamah) (Ibn Marduyah). Yeh dua ba'az sahih tareeq se bhi marwi hai. Is aayat ki tafsir ke shuru mein Tabrani ke hawalay se jo hadith guzri hai, us se toh yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai, lekin mashhoor is ke khilaf hai, yani yeh ke yeh aayat Madani hai aur is ki daleel mein yeh hadith pesh ho sakti hai jo Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Hazrat Atta, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair, Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke paas aaye, aap ke aur un ke darmiyan parda tha. Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne poocha, Ubaid tum kyun nahin aaya karte? Hazrat Ubaid ne jawab diya, Amma jaan! Sirf is liye ke kisi shayar ka qaul hai: "Zur ghiban tazdad hubba" yani kam kam aao taake mohabbat badhe. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne kaha, ab in baaton ko chhodo, Ummul Momineen! Hum yeh poochne ke liye hazir hue hain ke sab se zyada ajeeb baat jo aap ne An-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dekhi ho, woh hamein batayein. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ro dein aur farmane lagin, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke tamam kaam ajeeb-tar thay, achha ek waqia suno, ek raat meri baari mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas aaye aur mere saath soye, phir mujh se farmane lage, "Ayesha! Main apne Rab ki kuch ibadat karna chahta hoon, mujhe jaane de." Main ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Allah ki qasam main aap ka qurb chahti hoon aur yeh bhi meri chahat hai ke aap Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki ibadat bhi karein. Ab aap khade hue aur ek mashk mein se pani le kar aap ne halka sa wazu kiya aur namaz ke liye khade ho gaye, phir jo rona shuru kiya toh itna roye ke darhi mubarak tar ho gayi, phir sajde mein gaye aur is qadar roye ke zameen tar ho gayi, phir karwat ke bal let gaye aur rote hi rahe yahan tak ke Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ne aa kar namaz ke liye bulaya aur aap ke aansu rawan dekh kar daryaft kiya ke, "Ae Allah ke sachay Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aap kyun ro rahe hain? Allah Ta'ala ne toh aap ke tamam aglay pichlay gunah maaf farma diye hain." Aap ne farmaya, "Bilal! Main kyun na roun? Mujh par aaj ki raat yeh aayat utri hai: (Inna fi khalqis samawati wal ardi wakhtilafil laili wannahar) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 164). Afsos hai us shakhs ke liye jo isay padhe aur phir is mein ghaur-o-tadabbur na kare." Abd bin Humaid ki tafsir mein bhi yeh hadith hai, us mein yeh bhi hai ke jab hum Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas gaye, hum ne salam kiya toh aap ne poocha, "Tum kaun log ho?"

Hum ne apne naam bataye aur aakhir mein yeh bhi hai ke namaz ke baad aap apni dahini karwat par leite, rukhsar tale haath rakha aur rote rahe yahan tak ke aansuon se zameen tar ho gayi aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ke jawab mein aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke kya main shukar guzar banda na banun? Aur aayaton ke nazil hone ke bare mein Azaab-un-Naar tak aap ne tilawat ki, Ibn Marduyah ki ek zaeef sanad wali hadith mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Surah Aal-e-Imran ki aakhir ki das aayatein har raat ko parhte, is riwayat mein Mazahir bin Aslam zaeef hain.

Allah ki ek sa'at gaur-o-fikr karna raat bhar ke qayam karne se afzal hai, Hazrat Fuzail (R.H) farmate hain ke Hazrat Hasan (R.A) ka qaul hai ke gaur-o-fikr ek noor hai jo tere dil par apna partau dale ga aur basa auqat yeh bait padhte: "Iza al-mar'u kanat lahu fikratun, fa fi kulli shai'in lahu 'ibratun" yani jis insan ko bareek beeni aur soch samajh ki aadat pad gayi use har cheez mein ek ibrat aur aayat nazar aati hai, Hazrat Isa (A.S) farmate hain khush naseeb hai woh shakhs jis ka bolna zikr-e-Allah aur nasihat ho aur us ka chup rehna gaur-o-fikr ho aur us ka dekhna ibrat aur tanbeeh ho, Luqman Hakim ka nasihat aamoz maqoola bhi yaad rahe ke tanhai ki gosha nasheeni jis qadar zyada ho aur usi qadar gaur-o-fikr aur door andeshi ki aadat zyada hoti hai aur jis qadar yeh badh jaye usi qadar raaste insan par woh khul jate hain jo use jannat mein pahuncha denge, Hazrat Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) farmate hain jis qadar muraqba zyada hoga usi qadar samajh boojh tez hogi aur jitni samajh zyada hogi utna ilm naseeb hoga aur jis qadar ilm zyada hoga nek a'amal bhi badhenge, Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ka irshad hai ke Allah Azzawajal ke zikr mein zaban ka chalana bahut achha hai aur Allah ki na'imaton mein gaur-o-fikr afzal ibadat hai, Hazrat Mughees Aswad (R.H) majlis mein baithe hue farmate ke logo qabristan har roz jaya karo taake tumhein anjam ka khayal paida ho phir apne dil mein us manzar ko hazir karo ke tum Allah ke samne khade ho phir ek jamaat ko jahannam mein le jane ka hukm hota hai aur ek jamaat jannat mein jati hai apne dilon ko is haal mein jazb kar do aur apne badan ko bhi wahin hazir jaan lo jahannam ko apne samne dekho us ke hathoron ko us ki aag ke qaid khanon ko apne samne lao itna farmate hi dhaarein maar maar kar rone lagte hain yahan tak ke behosh ho jate hain, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak (R.H) farmate hain ek shakhs ne ek rahib se ek qabristan aur kooda karkat pakhana peshab dalne ki jagah par mulaqat ki aur us se kaha ae banda-e-haq is waqt tere paas do khazane hain ek khazana logon ka yani qabristan aur dusra khazana maal ka yani kooda karkat, peshab pakhana dalne ki jagah.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) khandrat par jaate aur kisi toote phoote darwaze par khade reh kar nihayat hasrat-o-afsos ke sath bharayi hui awaz mein farmate, "Ae ujde hue gharo! Tumhare rehne wale kahan gaye?" Phir khud farmate, "Sab zer-e-zameen chale gaye, sab fana ka jaam pee chuke, sirf Allah Ta'ala ki zaat hi hamesha ki malik-e-baqa hai." Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ka irshad hai, "Do raka'atein jo dil bastagi ke sath ada ki jayen, us tamam namaz se afzal hain jis mein sari raat guzar di lekin dilchaspi na thi." Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain, "Ibn-e-Adam! Apne pet ke teesre hisse mein kha, teesre hisse mein pani pee aur teesra hissa un sanson ke liye chhod jis mein tu akhirat ki baton par, apne anjam par aur apne a'maal par gaur-o-fikr kar sake." Ba'az hakeemon ka qaul hai, "Jo shakhs duniya ki cheezon par ibrat hasil kiye baghair nazar dalta hai, us ghaflat ki wajah se uski dili aankhein kamzor pad jati hain." Hazrat Aamir bin Qais (R.H) farmate hain ke, "Main ne bahut se sahaba se suna hai ke iman ki roshni aur noor gaur-o-fikr aur muraqba mein hai." Maseeh Ibn-e-Maryam Sayyiduna Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka farman hai ke, "Ibn-e-Adam! Ae za'eef insan! Jahan kahin tu ho Allah Ta'ala se darta reh, duniya mein aajizi aur maskeeni ke sath reh, apna ghar masjidon ko bana le, apni aankhon ko rona sikha, apne jism ko sabr ki aadat sikha, apne dil ko gaur-o-fikr karne wala bana, kal ki rozi ki fikr aaj na kar." Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ek martaba majlis mein baithe hue ro diye, logon ne wajah poochhi to aap ne farmaya, "Main ne duniya mein aur uski lazzaton mein aur uski khwahishon mein gaur-o-fikr kiya aur ibrat hasil ki, jab natija par pahuncha to meri umangein khatam ho gayin, haqeeqat yeh hai ke har shakhs ke liye is mein ibrat-o-naseehat hai aur wa'az-o-pand hai." Hussain bin Abdur Rahman ne bhi apne ash'aar mein is mazmoon ko khoob nibhaya hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne un bandon ki madh-o-sana bayan ki jo makhlooqat aur kainat se ibrat hasil karein aur naseehat lein aur un logon ki muzammat bayan ki jo qudrat ki nishaniyon par gaur na karein.

Mominon ki madh mein bayan ho raha hai ke yeh log uthte baithte leitte Allah Subhanahu ka zikr karte hain, zameen-o-aasman ki paidaish mein gaur-o-fikr karte hain aur kehte hain ke ae Allah! Tu ne apni makhlooq ko abas aur bekar nahin banaya balkeh haq ke sath paida kiya hai taake buron ko burai ka badla aur nekon ko nekiyon ka badla ata farmaye. Phir Allah ki pakeezgi bayan karte hain, Tu is se munazza hai ke kisi cheez ko bekar banaye. Ae Khaliq-e-Kainat! Ae adl-o-insaf se kainat ko sajane wale! Ae nuqsan aur aibon se pak zaat! Hamein apni quwwat-o-taqat se un aamal ki taufiq aur hamara rafeeq farma jin se hum tere azabon se nijat pa lein aur teri nematon se mala-maal ho kar jannat mein dakhil ho jayen. Yeh yun bhi kehte hain ke ae Allah! Jise Tu jahannam mein le gaya use Tu ne barbad aur zaleel-o-khwar kar diya, majma-e-hashr ke samne use ruswa kiya, zalimon ka koi madadgar nahin, unhein na koi chura sake, na bacha sake, na tere irade ke darmiyan aa sake. Ae Rabb! Hum ne pukarne wale ki pukar sun li jo imaan aur Islam ki taraf bulata hai, murad is se Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain jo farmate hain ke apne Rabb par imaan lao, hum imaan la chuke aur tabedari baja laye, pas hamare imaan aur farman-bardari ki wajah se hamare gunahon ko maaf farma, un ki parda-poshi kar aur hamari buraiyon ko hum se door kar de aur hamein saleh aur nek logon ke sath mila de. Tu ne hum se jo wade apne nabiyon ki zabani kiye hain unhein poore kar, aur yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke jo wada Tu ne hum se apne rasoolon par imaan lane ka liya tha, lekin pehla mani wazeh hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Asqalan do aroos mein se ek hai, yahin se Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala sattar hazar shuhada uthayenge jo wafd ban kar Allah ke paas jayenge, yahin shahidon ki safein hongi jin ke hathon mein un ke kate hue sar honge, un ki gardan ki ragon se khoon jaari hoga, yeh kehte honge ae Allah! Hum se jo wade apne rasoolon ki marifat Tu ne kiye hain unhein poore kar, hamein Qayamat ke din ruswa na kar, Tu wada-khilafi se pak hai. Allah Ta'ala farmayega mere yeh bande sache hain aur unhein Nehr-e-Baiza mein ghusl karwayenge jis ghusl ke baad pak saaf gore chitte rang ke ho kar niklenge aur saari jannat un ke liye mubah hogi, jahan chahein jayen ayen, jo chahein khayen piyen. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur baaz to kehte hain mauzoo hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Hamein Qayamat ke din tamam logon ke majmay mein ruswa na kar, tere waaday sachay hain, tu ne jo kuch khabrein apne Rasoolon ki zabani pohanchayi hain sab atal hain, Qayamat ka roz zaroor aana hai, pas tu hamein us din ki ruswayi se nijaat de. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmatay hain ke banday par ruswayi, daant-dupat, maar aur sharmindagi is qadar dali jayegi aur is tarah Allah Ta'ala ke samnay khara kar ke usay qail-o-maqool kiya jayega ke woh chahay ga ke kaash mujhe Jahannam mein hi daal diya jata (Abu Ya'la). Is hadith ki sanad bhi ghareeb hai. Ahadith se yeh bhi sabit hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) raat ko Tahajjud ke liye jab uthtay tab Surah Al-Imran ki in das aakhri aayaton ki tilawat farmatay. Chunancha Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain, main ne apni khala Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) ke ghar raat guzari, yeh Umm-ul-Momineen Huzoor (ﷺ) ki biwi sahiba thin. Huzoor (ﷺ) jab aaye to thori der tak aap Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) se baatein karte rahay phir so gaye. Jab aakhri tihayi raat baqi reh gayi to aap uth bethay aur aasman ki taraf nigah kar ke aayat (Inna fi khalqis-samawati) se aakhir-e-surat tak ki aayatein tilawat farmayin, phir kharay huay, miswak ki, wuzu kiya aur gyarah rakat namaz ada ki. Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ki subah ki azan sun kar phir do rakatein subah ki sunnatein parhin, phir masjid mein tashreef la kar logon ko subah ki namaz parhayi. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh riwayat dusri jagah bhi hai ke bistaray ke arz mein to main soya aur lambayi mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) leitin. Aadhi raat ke qareeb kuch pehlay ya kuch baad Huzoor (ﷺ) jaagay, apne hathon se apni aankhein maltay huay in das aayaton ki tilawat ki, phir ek latki hui mashk mein se pani le kar bohat achi tarah kamil wuzu kiya. Main bhi aap ki bayin janib aap ki iqtida mein namaz ke liye khara ho gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apna dahina hath mere sar par rakh kar mere kaan ko pakar kar mujhe ghuma kar apni dayin janib kar liya aur do-do rakat kar ke chhay martaba yani barah rakat parhin, phir Witr parha aur lait gaye yahan tak ke muazzin ne aa kar namaz ki ittila ki. Aap ne kharay ho kar do halki rakatein ada kin aur bahar aa kar subah ki namaz parhayi. Ibn Marduyah ki is hadith mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmatay hain mujhe mere walid Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke tum aaj ki raat Huzoor (ﷺ) ki aal mein guzaro aur aap ki raat ki namaz ki kaifiyat dekho. Raat ko jab sab log Isha ki namaz parh kar chalay gaye main betha raha, jab Huzoor (ﷺ) jaanay lagay to mujhe dekh kar farmaya, "Kaun? Abdullah?"

Main ne kaha ji haan, farmaya kyun ruke hue ho? Main ne kaha walid sahab ka hukum hai ke raat aap ke ghar guzaron, toh farmaya bahut achha, aao. Ghar ja kar farmaya bistar bichhao, taat ka takiya aaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us par sar rakh kar so gaye, yahan tak ke mujhe aap ke kharaton ki aawaz aane lagi. Phir aap jaage aur seedhi tarah baith kar aasman ki taraf dekh kar teen martaba dua (Subhanal Malikil Quddus) padha, phir Surah Al-Imran ke khatma ki yeh aayatein padhin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aayaton ki tilawat ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh dua padhi: (Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nooran, wa fi sam'i nooran, wa fi basari nooran, wa 'an yamini nooran, wa 'an shamali nooran, wa min baini yadayya nooran, wa min khalfi nooran, wa min fawqi nooran, wa min tahti nooran, wa a'zim li nooran yaumal qiyamah) (Ibn Marduyah). Yeh dua ba'az sahih tareeq se bhi marwi hai. Is aayat ki tafsir ke shuru mein Tabrani ke hawalay se jo hadith guzri hai, us se toh yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai, lekin mashhoor is ke khilaf hai, yani yeh ke yeh aayat Madani hai aur is ki daleel mein yeh hadith pesh ho sakti hai jo Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Hazrat Atta, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair, Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke paas aaye, aap ke aur un ke darmiyan parda tha. Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne poocha, Ubaid tum kyun nahin aaya karte? Hazrat Ubaid ne jawab diya, Amma jaan! Sirf is liye ke kisi shayar ka qaul hai: "Zur ghiban tazdad hubba" yani kam kam aao taake mohabbat badhe. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne kaha, ab in baaton ko chhodo, Ummul Momineen! Hum yeh poochne ke liye hazir hue hain ke sab se zyada ajeeb baat jo aap ne An-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dekhi ho, woh hamein batayein. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ro dein aur farmane lagin, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke tamam kaam ajeeb-tar thay, achha ek waqia suno, ek raat meri baari mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas aaye aur mere saath soye, phir mujh se farmane lage, "Ayesha! Main apne Rab ki kuch ibadat karna chahta hoon, mujhe jaane de." Main ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Allah ki qasam main aap ka qurb chahti hoon aur yeh bhi meri chahat hai ke aap Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki ibadat bhi karein. Ab aap khade hue aur ek mashk mein se pani le kar aap ne halka sa wazu kiya aur namaz ke liye khade ho gaye, phir jo rona shuru kiya toh itna roye ke darhi mubarak tar ho gayi, phir sajde mein gaye aur is qadar roye ke zameen tar ho gayi, phir karwat ke bal let gaye aur rote hi rahe yahan tak ke Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ne aa kar namaz ke liye bulaya aur aap ke aansu rawan dekh kar daryaft kiya ke, "Ae Allah ke sachay Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aap kyun ro rahe hain? Allah Ta'ala ne toh aap ke tamam aglay pichlay gunah maaf farma diye hain." Aap ne farmaya, "Bilal! Main kyun na roun? Mujh par aaj ki raat yeh aayat utri hai: (Inna fi khalqis samawati wal ardi wakhtilafil laili wannahar) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 164). Afsos hai us shakhs ke liye jo isay padhe aur phir is mein ghaur-o-tadabbur na kare." Abd bin Humaid ki tafsir mein bhi yeh hadith hai, us mein yeh bhi hai ke jab hum Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas gaye, hum ne salam kiya toh aap ne poocha, "Tum kaun log ho?"

Hum ne apne naam bataye aur aakhir mein yeh bhi hai ke namaz ke baad aap apni dahini karwat par leite, rukhsar tale haath rakha aur rote rahe yahan tak ke aansuon se zameen tar ho gayi aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ke jawab mein aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke kya main shukar guzar banda na banun? Aur aayaton ke nazil hone ke bare mein Azaab-un-Naar tak aap ne tilawat ki, Ibn Marduyah ki ek zaeef sanad wali hadith mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Surah Aal-e-Imran ki aakhir ki das aayatein har raat ko parhte, is riwayat mein Mazahir bin Aslam zaeef hain.

Mazahir-e-Kainat Daleel-e-Rabb-e-Zuljalal Dawat-e-Ghor-o-Fikr. Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Quraish Yahudiyon ke paas gaye aur un se poocha ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) tumhare paas kya kya mojizat le kar aaye thay? Unhon ne kaha azdaha ban jaane wali lakri aur chamkila haath, phir Nasraniyon ke paas gaye un se kaha tumhare paas Hazrat Isa (A.S) kya nishaniyan laaye thay? Jawab mila ke madar-zad andhon ko beena kar dena aur korhi ko achha kar dena aur murdon ko zinda kar dena. Ab yeh Quraish Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur Aap (ﷺ) se kaha Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke hamare liye Safa pahar ko sone ka bana de. Aap (ﷺ) ne dua ki jis par yeh aayat (اِنَّ فِيْ خَلْقِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 164) utri, yani nishan-e-qudrat dekhne walon ke liye isi mein bari nishaniyan hain, yeh isi mein ghor-o-fikr karenge to in qudraton wale Allah Ta'ala ke samne jhuk jayenge. Lekin is riwayat mein ek ishkal hai woh yeh ke yeh sawal Makkah Sharif mein hua tha aur yeh aayat Madina Sharif mein nazil hui, Wallahu A'lam. Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke aasman jaisi buland aur wus'at-e-makhlooq aur zameen jaisi past aur sakht aur lambi chori makhlooq, phir aasman mein bari bari nishaniyan maslan chalne phirne wale aur ek jaa thaharne wale sitare aur zameen ki bari bari paidawar maslan pahar, jangal, darakht, ghaas, khetiyan, phal aur mukhtalif qisam ke jaandar, kaanein, alag alag zaiqay wale aur tarah tarah ki khushbuon wale aur mukhtalif khawas wale meway waghera, kya yeh sab aayat-e-qudrat ek soch samajh wale insaan ki rahbari Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki taraf nahin kar saktein? Jo aur nishaniyan dekhne ki zaroorat baqi rahe. Phir din raat ka aana jaana aur un ka kam zyada hona phir barabar ho jana, yeh sab is Aziz-o-Haleem Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki qudrat-e-kamilah ki poori poori nishaniyan hain jo paak nafs wale har cheez ki haqeeqat par nazrein daalne ke aadi hain aur bewaqoofon ki tarah aankh andhay aur kaan ke behray nahin, jin ki halat aur jagah bayan hui hai ke woh aasman aur zameen ki bohat si nishaniyan pairon talay rondte hue guzar jaate hain aur ghor-o-fikr nahin karte, in mein se aksar bawajood Allah Ta'ala ko maanne ke phir bhi shirk se nahin bach sake.

Ab in aqalmandon ki sifatain bayan ho rahi hain ke woh uthte baithte lette Allah ka naam liya karte hain, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Imran bin Husain (R.A) se farmaya khade ho kar namaz padha karo agar taqat na ho to baith kar aur yeh bhi na ho sake to lete lete hi sahi, yani kisi halat mein Allah Azzawajal ke zikr se ghafil mat raho dil Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain, "Ibn-e-Adam! Apne pet ke teesre hisse mein kha, teesre hisse mein pani pee aur teesra hissa un sanson ke liye chhod jis mein tu akhirat ki baton par, apne anjam par aur apne a'maal par gaur-o-fikr kar sake." Ba'az hakeemon ka qaul hai, "Jo shakhs duniya ki cheezon par ibrat hasil kiye baghair nazar dalta hai, us ghaflat ki wajah se uski dili aankhein kamzor pad jati hain." Hazrat Aamir bin Qais (R.H) farmate hain ke, "Main ne bahut se sahaba se suna hai ke iman ki roshni aur noor gaur-o-fikr aur muraqba mein hai." Maseeh Ibn-e-Maryam Sayyiduna Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka farman hai ke, "Ibn-e-Adam! Ae za'eef insan! Jahan kahin tu ho Allah Ta'ala se darta reh, duniya mein aajizi aur maskeeni ke sath reh, apna ghar masjidon ko bana le, apni aankhon ko rona sikha, apne jism ko sabr ki aadat sikha, apne dil ko gaur-o-fikr karne wala bana, kal ki rozi ki fikr aaj na kar." Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ek martaba majlis mein baithe hue ro diye, logon ne wajah poochhi to aap ne farmaya, "Main ne duniya mein aur uski lazzaton mein aur uski khwahishon mein gaur-o-fikr kiya aur ibrat hasil ki, jab natija par pahuncha to meri umangein khatam ho gayin, haqeeqat yeh hai ke har shakhs ke liye is mein ibrat-o-naseehat hai aur wa'az-o-pand hai." Hussain bin Abdur Rahman ne bhi apne ash'aar mein is mazmoon ko khoob nibhaya hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne un bandon ki madh-o-sana bayan ki jo makhlooqat aur kainat se ibrat hasil karein aur naseehat lein aur un logon ki muzammat bayan ki jo qudrat ki nishaniyon par gaur na karein.

Mominon ki madh mein bayan ho raha hai ke yeh log uthte baithte leitte Allah Subhanahu ka zikr karte hain, zameen-o-aasman ki paidaish mein gaur-o-fikr karte hain aur kehte hain ke ae Allah! Tu ne apni makhlooq ko abas aur bekar nahin banaya balkeh haq ke sath paida kiya hai taake buron ko burai ka badla aur nekon ko nekiyon ka badla ata farmaye. Phir Allah ki pakeezgi bayan karte hain, Tu is se munazza hai ke kisi cheez ko bekar banaye. Ae Khaliq-e-Kainat! Ae adl-o-insaf se kainat ko sajane wale! Ae nuqsan aur aibon se pak zaat! Hamein apni quwwat-o-taqat se un aamal ki taufiq aur hamara rafeeq farma jin se hum tere azabon se nijat pa lein aur teri nematon se mala-maal ho kar jannat mein dakhil ho jayen. Yeh yun bhi kehte hain ke ae Allah! Jise Tu jahannam mein le gaya use Tu ne barbad aur zaleel-o-khwar kar diya, majma-e-hashr ke samne use ruswa kiya, zalimon ka koi madadgar nahin, unhein na koi chura sake, na bacha sake, na tere irade ke darmiyan aa sake. Ae Rabb! Hum ne pukarne wale ki pukar sun li jo imaan aur Islam ki taraf bulata hai, murad is se Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain jo farmate hain ke apne Rabb par imaan lao, hum imaan la chuke aur tabedari baja laye, pas hamare imaan aur farman-bardari ki wajah se hamare gunahon ko maaf farma, un ki parda-poshi kar aur hamari buraiyon ko hum se door kar de aur hamein saleh aur nek logon ke sath mila de. Tu ne hum se jo wade apne nabiyon ki zabani kiye hain unhein poore kar, aur yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke jo wada Tu ne hum se apne rasoolon par imaan lane ka liya tha, lekin pehla mani wazeh hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Asqalan do aroos mein se ek hai, yahin se Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala sattar hazar shuhada uthayenge jo wafd ban kar Allah ke paas jayenge, yahin shahidon ki safein hongi jin ke hathon mein un ke kate hue sar honge, un ki gardan ki ragon se khoon jaari hoga, yeh kehte honge ae Allah! Hum se jo wade apne rasoolon ki marifat Tu ne kiye hain unhein poore kar, hamein Qayamat ke din ruswa na kar, Tu wada-khilafi se pak hai. Allah Ta'ala farmayega mere yeh bande sache hain aur unhein Nehr-e-Baiza mein ghusl karwayenge jis ghusl ke baad pak saaf gore chitte rang ke ho kar niklenge aur saari jannat un ke liye mubah hogi, jahan chahein jayen ayen, jo chahein khayen piyen. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur baaz to kehte hain mauzoo hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Hamein Qayamat ke din tamam logon ke majmay mein ruswa na kar, tere waaday sachay hain, tu ne jo kuch khabrein apne Rasoolon ki zabani pohanchayi hain sab atal hain, Qayamat ka roz zaroor aana hai, pas tu hamein us din ki ruswayi se nijaat de. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmatay hain ke banday par ruswayi, daant-dupat, maar aur sharmindagi is qadar dali jayegi aur is tarah Allah Ta'ala ke samnay khara kar ke usay qail-o-maqool kiya jayega ke woh chahay ga ke kaash mujhe Jahannam mein hi daal diya jata (Abu Ya'la). Is hadith ki sanad bhi ghareeb hai. Ahadith se yeh bhi sabit hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) raat ko Tahajjud ke liye jab uthtay tab Surah Al-Imran ki in das aakhri aayaton ki tilawat farmatay. Chunancha Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain, main ne apni khala Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) ke ghar raat guzari, yeh Umm-ul-Momineen Huzoor (ﷺ) ki biwi sahiba thin. Huzoor (ﷺ) jab aaye to thori der tak aap Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) se baatein karte rahay phir so gaye. Jab aakhri tihayi raat baqi reh gayi to aap uth bethay aur aasman ki taraf nigah kar ke aayat (Inna fi khalqis-samawati) se aakhir-e-surat tak ki aayatein tilawat farmayin, phir kharay huay, miswak ki, wuzu kiya aur gyarah rakat namaz ada ki. Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ki subah ki azan sun kar phir do rakatein subah ki sunnatein parhin, phir masjid mein tashreef la kar logon ko subah ki namaz parhayi. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh riwayat dusri jagah bhi hai ke bistaray ke arz mein to main soya aur lambayi mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) leitin. Aadhi raat ke qareeb kuch pehlay ya kuch baad Huzoor (ﷺ) jaagay, apne hathon se apni aankhein maltay huay in das aayaton ki tilawat ki, phir ek latki hui mashk mein se pani le kar bohat achi tarah kamil wuzu kiya. Main bhi aap ki bayin janib aap ki iqtida mein namaz ke liye khara ho gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apna dahina hath mere sar par rakh kar mere kaan ko pakar kar mujhe ghuma kar apni dayin janib kar liya aur do-do rakat kar ke chhay martaba yani barah rakat parhin, phir Witr parha aur lait gaye yahan tak ke muazzin ne aa kar namaz ki ittila ki. Aap ne kharay ho kar do halki rakatein ada kin aur bahar aa kar subah ki namaz parhayi. Ibn Marduyah ki is hadith mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmatay hain mujhe mere walid Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke tum aaj ki raat Huzoor (ﷺ) ki aal mein guzaro aur aap ki raat ki namaz ki kaifiyat dekho. Raat ko jab sab log Isha ki namaz parh kar chalay gaye main betha raha, jab Huzoor (ﷺ) jaanay lagay to mujhe dekh kar farmaya, "Kaun? Abdullah?"

Main ne kaha ji haan, farmaya kyun ruke hue ho? Main ne kaha walid sahab ka hukum hai ke raat aap ke ghar guzaron, toh farmaya bahut achha, aao. Ghar ja kar farmaya bistar bichhao, taat ka takiya aaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us par sar rakh kar so gaye, yahan tak ke mujhe aap ke kharaton ki aawaz aane lagi. Phir aap jaage aur seedhi tarah baith kar aasman ki taraf dekh kar teen martaba dua (Subhanal Malikil Quddus) padha, phir Surah Al-Imran ke khatma ki yeh aayatein padhin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aayaton ki tilawat ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh dua padhi: (Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nooran, wa fi sam'i nooran, wa fi basari nooran, wa 'an yamini nooran, wa 'an shamali nooran, wa min baini yadayya nooran, wa min khalfi nooran, wa min fawqi nooran, wa min tahti nooran, wa a'zim li nooran yaumal qiyamah) (Ibn Marduyah). Yeh dua ba'az sahih tareeq se bhi marwi hai. Is aayat ki tafsir ke shuru mein Tabrani ke hawalay se jo hadith guzri hai, us se toh yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai, lekin mashhoor is ke khilaf hai, yani yeh ke yeh aayat Madani hai aur is ki daleel mein yeh hadith pesh ho sakti hai jo Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Hazrat Atta, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair, Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke paas aaye, aap ke aur un ke darmiyan parda tha. Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne poocha, Ubaid tum kyun nahin aaya karte? Hazrat Ubaid ne jawab diya, Amma jaan! Sirf is liye ke kisi shayar ka qaul hai: "Zur ghiban tazdad hubba" yani kam kam aao taake mohabbat badhe. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne kaha, ab in baaton ko chhodo, Ummul Momineen! Hum yeh poochne ke liye hazir hue hain ke sab se zyada ajeeb baat jo aap ne An-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dekhi ho, woh hamein batayein. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ro dein aur farmane lagin, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke tamam kaam ajeeb-tar thay, achha ek waqia suno, ek raat meri baari mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas aaye aur mere saath soye, phir mujh se farmane lage, "Ayesha! Main apne Rab ki kuch ibadat karna chahta hoon, mujhe jaane de." Main ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Allah ki qasam main aap ka qurb chahti hoon aur yeh bhi meri chahat hai ke aap Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki ibadat bhi karein. Ab aap khade hue aur ek mashk mein se pani le kar aap ne halka sa wazu kiya aur namaz ke liye khade ho gaye, phir jo rona shuru kiya toh itna roye ke darhi mubarak tar ho gayi, phir sajde mein gaye aur is qadar roye ke zameen tar ho gayi, phir karwat ke bal let gaye aur rote hi rahe yahan tak ke Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ne aa kar namaz ke liye bulaya aur aap ke aansu rawan dekh kar daryaft kiya ke, "Ae Allah ke sachay Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aap kyun ro rahe hain? Allah Ta'ala ne toh aap ke tamam aglay pichlay gunah maaf farma diye hain." Aap ne farmaya, "Bilal! Main kyun na roun? Mujh par aaj ki raat yeh aayat utri hai: (Inna fi khalqis samawati wal ardi wakhtilafil laili wannahar) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 164). Afsos hai us shakhs ke liye jo isay padhe aur phir is mein ghaur-o-tadabbur na kare." Abd bin Humaid ki tafsir mein bhi yeh hadith hai, us mein yeh bhi hai ke jab hum Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas gaye, hum ne salam kiya toh aap ne poocha, "Tum kaun log ho?"

Hum ne apne naam bataye aur aakhir mein yeh bhi hai ke namaz ke baad aap apni dahini karwat par leite, rukhsar tale haath rakha aur rote rahe yahan tak ke aansuon se zameen tar ho gayi aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ke jawab mein aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke kya main shukar guzar banda na banun? Aur aayaton ke nazil hone ke bare mein Azaab-un-Naar tak aap ne tilawat ki, Ibn Marduyah ki ek zaeef sanad wali hadith mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Surah Aal-e-Imran ki aakhir ki das aayatein har raat ko parhte, is riwayat mein Mazahir bin Aslam zaeef hain.

Mazahir-e-Kainat Daleel-e-Rabb-e-Zuljalal Dawat-e-Ghor-o-Fikr. Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Quraish Yahudiyon ke paas gaye aur un se poocha ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) tumhare paas kya kya mojizat le kar aaye thay? Unhon ne kaha azdaha ban jaane wali lakri aur chamkila haath, phir Nasraniyon ke paas gaye un se kaha tumhare paas Hazrat Isa (A.S) kya nishaniyan laaye thay? Jawab mila ke madar-zad andhon ko beena kar dena aur korhi ko achha kar dena aur murdon ko zinda kar dena. Ab yeh Quraish Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur Aap (ﷺ) se kaha Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke hamare liye Safa pahar ko sone ka bana de. Aap (ﷺ) ne dua ki jis par yeh aayat (اِنَّ فِيْ خَلْقِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 164) utri, yani nishan-e-qudrat dekhne walon ke liye isi mein bari nishaniyan hain, yeh isi mein ghor-o-fikr karenge to in qudraton wale Allah Ta'ala ke samne jhuk jayenge. Lekin is riwayat mein ek ishkal hai woh yeh ke yeh sawal Makkah Sharif mein hua tha aur yeh aayat Madina Sharif mein nazil hui, Wallahu A'lam. Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke aasman jaisi buland aur wus'at-e-makhlooq aur zameen jaisi past aur sakht aur lambi chori makhlooq, phir aasman mein bari bari nishaniyan maslan chalne phirne wale aur ek jaa thaharne wale sitare aur zameen ki bari bari paidawar maslan pahar, jangal, darakht, ghaas, khetiyan, phal aur mukhtalif qisam ke jaandar, kaanein, alag alag zaiqay wale aur tarah tarah ki khushbuon wale aur mukhtalif khawas wale meway waghera, kya yeh sab aayat-e-qudrat ek soch samajh wale insaan ki rahbari Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki taraf nahin kar saktein? Jo aur nishaniyan dekhne ki zaroorat baqi rahe. Phir din raat ka aana jaana aur un ka kam zyada hona phir barabar ho jana, yeh sab is Aziz-o-Haleem Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki qudrat-e-kamilah ki poori poori nishaniyan hain jo paak nafs wale har cheez ki haqeeqat par nazrein daalne ke aadi hain aur bewaqoofon ki tarah aankh andhay aur kaan ke behray nahin, jin ki halat aur jagah bayan hui hai ke woh aasman aur zameen ki bohat si nishaniyan pairon talay rondte hue guzar jaate hain aur ghor-o-fikr nahin karte, in mein se aksar bawajood Allah Ta'ala ko maanne ke phir bhi shirk se nahin bach sake.

Ab in aqalmandon ki sifatain bayan ho rahi hain ke woh uthte baithte lette Allah ka naam liya karte hain, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Imran bin Husain (R.A) se farmaya khade ho kar namaz padha karo agar taqat na ho to baith kar aur yeh bhi na ho sake to lete lete hi sahi, yani kisi halat mein Allah Azzawajal ke zikr se ghafil mat raho dil mein aur posheeda aur zaban se Allah Ta'ala ka zikr karte raha karo, yeh log aasman aur zameen ki paidaish mein nazrein daudate hain aur un ki hikmaton par gaur karte hain jo us Khaliq-e-Yakta ki azmat-o-qudrat ilm-o-hikmat ikhtiyar-e-rahmat par dalalat karti hain, Hazrat Sheikh Sulaiman Darani (R.H) farmate hain ghar se nikal kar jis cheez par meri nazar padti hai main dekhta hoon ke us mein Allah ki ek sa'at gaur-o-fikr karna raat bhar ke qayam karne se afzal hai, Hazrat Fuzail (R.H) farmate hain ke Hazrat Hasan (R.A) ka qaul hai ke gaur-o-fikr ek noor hai jo tere dil par apna partau dale ga aur basa auqat yeh bait padhte: "Iza al-mar'u kanat lahu fikratun, fa fi kulli shai'in lahu 'ibratun" yani jis insan ko bareek beeni aur soch samajh ki aadat pad gayi use har cheez mein ek ibrat aur aayat nazar aati hai, Hazrat Isa (A.S) farmate hain khush naseeb hai woh shakhs jis ka bolna zikr-e-Allah aur nasihat ho aur us ka chup rehna gaur-o-fikr ho aur us ka dekhna ibrat aur tanbeeh ho, Luqman Hakim ka nasihat aamoz maqoola bhi yaad rahe ke tanhai ki gosha nasheeni jis qadar zyada ho aur usi qadar gaur-o-fikr aur door andeshi ki aadat zyada hoti hai aur jis qadar yeh badh jaye usi qadar raaste insan par woh khul jate hain jo use jannat mein pahuncha denge, Hazrat Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) farmate hain jis qadar muraqba zyada hoga usi qadar samajh boojh tez hogi aur jitni samajh zyada hogi utna ilm naseeb hoga aur jis qadar ilm zyada hoga nek a'amal bhi badhenge, Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ka irshad hai ke Allah Azzawajal ke zikr mein zaban ka chalana bahut achha hai aur Allah ki na'imaton mein gaur-o-fikr afzal ibadat hai, Hazrat Mughees Aswad (R.H) majlis mein baithe hue farmate ke logo qabristan har roz jaya karo taake tumhein anjam ka khayal paida ho phir apne dil mein us manzar ko hazir karo ke tum Allah ke samne khade ho phir ek jamaat ko jahannam mein le jane ka hukm hota hai aur ek jamaat jannat mein jati hai apne dilon ko is haal mein jazb kar do aur apne badan ko bhi wahin hazir jaan lo jahannam ko apne samne dekho us ke hathoron ko us ki aag ke qaid khanon ko apne samne lao itna farmate hi dhaarein maar maar kar rone lagte hain yahan tak ke behosh ho jate hain, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak (R.H) farmate hain ek shakhs ne ek rahib se ek qabristan aur kooda karkat pakhana peshab dalne ki jagah par mulaqat ki aur us se kaha ae banda-e-haq is waqt tere paas do khazane hain ek khazana logon ka yani qabristan aur dusra khazana maal ka yani kooda karkat, peshab pakhana dalne ki jagah.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) khandrat par jaate aur kisi toote phoote darwaze par khade reh kar nihayat hasrat-o-afsos ke sath bharayi hui awaz mein farmate, "Ae ujde hue gharo! Tumhare rehne wale kahan gaye?" Phir khud farmate, "Sab zer-e-zameen chale gaye, sab fana ka jaam pee chuke, sirf Allah Ta'ala ki zaat hi hamesha ki malik-e-baqa hai." Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ka irshad hai, "Do raka'atein jo dil bastagi ke sath ada ki jayen, us tamam namaz se afzal hain jis mein sari raat guzar di lekin dilchaspi na thi."
