Hum ne pukarne wale ki pukar sun li jo imaan aur Islam ki taraf bulata hai, murad is se Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain jo farmate hain ke apne Rabb par imaan lao, hum imaan la chuke aur tabedari baja laye, pas hamare imaan aur farman-bardari ki wajah se hamare gunahon ko maaf farma, un ki parda-poshi kar aur hamari buraiyon ko hum se door kar de aur hamein saleh aur nek logon ke sath mila de. Tu ne hum se jo wade apne nabiyon ki zabani kiye hain unhein poore kar, aur yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke jo wada Tu ne hum se apne rasoolon par imaan lane ka liya tha, lekin pehla mani wazeh hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Asqalan do aroos mein se ek hai, yahin se Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala sattar hazar shuhada uthayenge jo wafd ban kar Allah ke paas jayenge, yahin shahidon ki safein hongi jin ke hathon mein un ke kate hue sar honge, un ki gardan ki ragon se khoon jaari hoga, yeh kehte honge ae Allah! Hum se jo wade apne rasoolon ki marifat Tu ne kiye hain unhein poore kar, hamein Qayamat ke din ruswa na kar, Tu wada-khilafi se pak hai. Allah Ta'ala farmayega mere yeh bande sache hain aur unhein Nehr-e-Baiza mein ghusl karwayenge jis ghusl ke baad pak saaf gore chitte rang ke ho kar niklenge aur saari jannat un ke liye mubah hogi, jahan chahein jayen ayen, jo chahein khayen piyen. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur baaz to kehte hain mauzoo hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Hamein Qayamat ke din tamam logon ke majmay mein ruswa na kar, tere waaday sachay hain, tu ne jo kuch khabrein apne Rasoolon ki zabani pohanchayi hain sab atal hain, Qayamat ka roz zaroor aana hai, pas tu hamein us din ki ruswayi se nijaat de. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmatay hain ke banday par ruswayi, daant-dupat, maar aur sharmindagi is qadar dali jayegi aur is tarah Allah Ta'ala ke samnay khara kar ke usay qail-o-maqool kiya jayega ke woh chahay ga ke kaash mujhe Jahannam mein hi daal diya jata (Abu Ya'la). Is hadith ki sanad bhi ghareeb hai. Ahadith se yeh bhi sabit hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) raat ko Tahajjud ke liye jab uthtay tab Surah Al-Imran ki in das aakhri aayaton ki tilawat farmatay. Chunancha Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain, main ne apni khala Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) ke ghar raat guzari, yeh Umm-ul-Momineen Huzoor (ﷺ) ki biwi sahiba thin. Huzoor (ﷺ) jab aaye to thori der tak aap Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) se baatein karte rahay phir so gaye. Jab aakhri tihayi raat baqi reh gayi to aap uth bethay aur aasman ki taraf nigah kar ke aayat (Inna fi khalqis-samawati) se aakhir-e-surat tak ki aayatein tilawat farmayin, phir kharay huay, miswak ki, wuzu kiya aur gyarah rakat namaz ada ki. Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ki subah ki azan sun kar phir do rakatein subah ki sunnatein parhin, phir masjid mein tashreef la kar logon ko subah ki namaz parhayi. Sahih Bukhari mein yeh riwayat dusri jagah bhi hai ke bistaray ke arz mein to main soya aur lambayi mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) aur Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Maimoona (R.A) leitin. Aadhi raat ke qareeb kuch pehlay ya kuch baad Huzoor (ﷺ) jaagay, apne hathon se apni aankhein maltay huay in das aayaton ki tilawat ki, phir ek latki hui mashk mein se pani le kar bohat achi tarah kamil wuzu kiya. Main bhi aap ki bayin janib aap ki iqtida mein namaz ke liye khara ho gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apna dahina hath mere sar par rakh kar mere kaan ko pakar kar mujhe ghuma kar apni dayin janib kar liya aur do-do rakat kar ke chhay martaba yani barah rakat parhin, phir Witr parha aur lait gaye yahan tak ke muazzin ne aa kar namaz ki ittila ki. Aap ne kharay ho kar do halki rakatein ada kin aur bahar aa kar subah ki namaz parhayi. Ibn Marduyah ki is hadith mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmatay hain mujhe mere walid Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke tum aaj ki raat Huzoor (ﷺ) ki aal mein guzaro aur aap ki raat ki namaz ki kaifiyat dekho. Raat ko jab sab log Isha ki namaz parh kar chalay gaye main betha raha, jab Huzoor (ﷺ) jaanay lagay to mujhe dekh kar farmaya, "Kaun? Abdullah?"

Main ne kaha ji haan, farmaya kyun ruke hue ho? Main ne kaha walid sahab ka hukum hai ke raat aap ke ghar guzaron, toh farmaya bahut achha, aao. Ghar ja kar farmaya bistar bichhao, taat ka takiya aaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us par sar rakh kar so gaye, yahan tak ke mujhe aap ke kharaton ki aawaz aane lagi. Phir aap jaage aur seedhi tarah baith kar aasman ki taraf dekh kar teen martaba dua (Subhanal Malikil Quddus) padha, phir Surah Al-Imran ke khatma ki yeh aayatein padhin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aayaton ki tilawat ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh dua padhi: (Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nooran, wa fi sam'i nooran, wa fi basari nooran, wa 'an yamini nooran, wa 'an shamali nooran, wa min baini yadayya nooran, wa min khalfi nooran, wa min fawqi nooran, wa min tahti nooran, wa a'zim li nooran yaumal qiyamah) (Ibn Marduyah). Yeh dua ba'az sahih tareeq se bhi marwi hai. Is aayat ki tafsir ke shuru mein Tabrani ke hawalay se jo hadith guzri hai, us se toh yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai, lekin mashhoor is ke khilaf hai, yani yeh ke yeh aayat Madani hai aur is ki daleel mein yeh hadith pesh ho sakti hai jo Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Hazrat Atta, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair, Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke paas aaye, aap ke aur un ke darmiyan parda tha. Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne poocha, Ubaid tum kyun nahin aaya karte? Hazrat Ubaid ne jawab diya, Amma jaan! Sirf is liye ke kisi shayar ka qaul hai: "Zur ghiban tazdad hubba" yani kam kam aao taake mohabbat badhe. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne kaha, ab in baaton ko chhodo, Ummul Momineen! Hum yeh poochne ke liye hazir hue hain ke sab se zyada ajeeb baat jo aap ne An-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dekhi ho, woh hamein batayein. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ro dein aur farmane lagin, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke tamam kaam ajeeb-tar thay, achha ek waqia suno, ek raat meri baari mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas aaye aur mere saath soye, phir mujh se farmane lage, "Ayesha! Main apne Rab ki kuch ibadat karna chahta hoon, mujhe jaane de." Main ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Allah ki qasam main aap ka qurb chahti hoon aur yeh bhi meri chahat hai ke aap Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki ibadat bhi karein. Ab aap khade hue aur ek mashk mein se pani le kar aap ne halka sa wazu kiya aur namaz ke liye khade ho gaye, phir jo rona shuru kiya toh itna roye ke darhi mubarak tar ho gayi, phir sajde mein gaye aur is qadar roye ke zameen tar ho gayi, phir karwat ke bal let gaye aur rote hi rahe yahan tak ke Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ne aa kar namaz ke liye bulaya aur aap ke aansu rawan dekh kar daryaft kiya ke, "Ae Allah ke sachay Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aap kyun ro rahe hain? Allah Ta'ala ne toh aap ke tamam aglay pichlay gunah maaf farma diye hain." Aap ne farmaya, "Bilal! Main kyun na roun? Mujh par aaj ki raat yeh aayat utri hai: (Inna fi khalqis samawati wal ardi wakhtilafil laili wannahar) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 164). Afsos hai us shakhs ke liye jo isay padhe aur phir is mein ghaur-o-tadabbur na kare." Abd bin Humaid ki tafsir mein bhi yeh hadith hai, us mein yeh bhi hai ke jab hum Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas gaye, hum ne salam kiya toh aap ne poocha, "Tum kaun log ho?"

Hum ne apne naam bataye aur aakhir mein yeh bhi hai ke namaz ke baad aap apni dahini karwat par leite, rukhsar tale haath rakha aur rote rahe yahan tak ke aansuon se zameen tar ho gayi aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ke jawab mein aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke kya main shukar guzar banda na banun? Aur aayaton ke nazil hone ke bare mein Azaab-un-Naar tak aap ne tilawat ki, Ibn Marduyah ki ek zaeef sanad wali hadith mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Surah Aal-e-Imran ki aakhir ki das aayatein har raat ko parhte, is riwayat mein Mazahir bin Aslam zaeef hain.

Mazahir-e-Kainat Daleel-e-Rabb-e-Zuljalal Dawat-e-Ghor-o-Fikr. Tabrani mein hai Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke Quraish Yahudiyon ke paas gaye aur un se poocha ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) tumhare paas kya kya mojizat le kar aaye thay? Unhon ne kaha azdaha ban jaane wali lakri aur chamkila haath, phir Nasraniyon ke paas gaye un se kaha tumhare paas Hazrat Isa (A.S) kya nishaniyan laaye thay? Jawab mila ke madar-zad andhon ko beena kar dena aur korhi ko achha kar dena aur murdon ko zinda kar dena. Ab yeh Quraish Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur Aap (ﷺ) se kaha Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke hamare liye Safa pahar ko sone ka bana de. Aap (ﷺ) ne dua ki jis par yeh aayat (اِنَّ فِيْ خَلْقِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 164) utri, yani nishan-e-qudrat dekhne walon ke liye isi mein bari nishaniyan hain, yeh isi mein ghor-o-fikr karenge to in qudraton wale Allah Ta'ala ke samne jhuk jayenge. Lekin is riwayat mein ek ishkal hai woh yeh ke yeh sawal Makkah Sharif mein hua tha aur yeh aayat Madina Sharif mein nazil hui, Wallahu A'lam. Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke aasman jaisi buland aur wus'at-e-makhlooq aur zameen jaisi past aur sakht aur lambi chori makhlooq, phir aasman mein bari bari nishaniyan maslan chalne phirne wale aur ek jaa thaharne wale sitare aur zameen ki bari bari paidawar maslan pahar, jangal, darakht, ghaas, khetiyan, phal aur mukhtalif qisam ke jaandar, kaanein, alag alag zaiqay wale aur tarah tarah ki khushbuon wale aur mukhtalif khawas wale meway waghera, kya yeh sab aayat-e-qudrat ek soch samajh wale insaan ki rahbari Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki taraf nahin kar saktein? Jo aur nishaniyan dekhne ki zaroorat baqi rahe. Phir din raat ka aana jaana aur un ka kam zyada hona phir barabar ho jana, yeh sab is Aziz-o-Haleem Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki qudrat-e-kamilah ki poori poori nishaniyan hain jo paak nafs wale har cheez ki haqeeqat par nazrein daalne ke aadi hain aur bewaqoofon ki tarah aankh andhay aur kaan ke behray nahin, jin ki halat aur jagah bayan hui hai ke woh aasman aur zameen ki bohat si nishaniyan pairon talay rondte hue guzar jaate hain aur ghor-o-fikr nahin karte, in mein se aksar bawajood Allah Ta'ala ko maanne ke phir bhi shirk se nahin bach sake.

Ab in aqalmandon ki sifatain bayan ho rahi hain ke woh uthte baithte lette Allah ka naam liya karte hain, Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Imran bin Husain (R.A) se farmaya khade ho kar namaz padha karo agar taqat na ho to baith kar aur yeh bhi na ho sake to lete lete hi sahi, yani kisi halat mein Allah Azzawajal ke zikr se ghafil mat raho dil mein aur posheeda aur zaban se Allah Ta'ala ka zikr karte raha karo, yeh log aasman aur zameen ki paidaish mein nazrein daudate hain aur un ki hikmaton par gaur karte hain jo us Khaliq-e-Yakta ki azmat-o-qudrat ilm-o-hikmat ikhtiyar-e-rahmat par dalalat karti hain, Hazrat Sheikh Sulaiman Darani (R.H) farmate hain ghar se nikal kar jis cheez par meri nazar padti hai main dekhta hoon ke us mein Allah ki ek sa'at gaur-o-fikr karna raat bhar ke qayam karne se afzal hai, Hazrat Fuzail (R.H) farmate hain ke Hazrat Hasan (R.A) ka qaul hai ke gaur-o-fikr ek noor hai jo tere dil par apna partau dale ga aur basa auqat yeh bait padhte: "Iza al-mar'u kanat lahu fikratun, fa fi kulli shai'in lahu 'ibratun" yani jis insan ko bareek beeni aur soch samajh ki aadat pad gayi use har cheez mein ek ibrat aur aayat nazar aati hai, Hazrat Isa (A.S) farmate hain khush naseeb hai woh shakhs jis ka bolna zikr-e-Allah aur nasihat ho aur us ka chup rehna gaur-o-fikr ho aur us ka dekhna ibrat aur tanbeeh ho, Luqman Hakim ka nasihat aamoz maqoola bhi yaad rahe ke tanhai ki gosha nasheeni jis qadar zyada ho aur usi qadar gaur-o-fikr aur door andeshi ki aadat zyada hoti hai aur jis qadar yeh badh jaye usi qadar raaste insan par woh khul jate hain jo use jannat mein pahuncha denge, Hazrat Wahb bin Munabbah (R.H) farmate hain jis qadar muraqba zyada hoga usi qadar samajh boojh tez hogi aur jitni samajh zyada hogi utna ilm naseeb hoga aur jis qadar ilm zyada hoga nek a'amal bhi badhenge, Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ka irshad hai ke Allah Azzawajal ke zikr mein zaban ka chalana bahut achha hai aur Allah ki na'imaton mein gaur-o-fikr afzal ibadat hai, Hazrat Mughees Aswad (R.H) majlis mein baithe hue farmate ke logo qabristan har roz jaya karo taake tumhein anjam ka khayal paida ho phir apne dil mein us manzar ko hazir karo ke tum Allah ke samne khade ho phir ek jamaat ko jahannam mein le jane ka hukm hota hai aur ek jamaat jannat mein jati hai apne dilon ko is haal mein jazb kar do aur apne badan ko bhi wahin hazir jaan lo jahannam ko apne samne dekho us ke hathoron ko us ki aag ke qaid khanon ko apne samne lao itna farmate hi dhaarein maar maar kar rone lagte hain yahan tak ke behosh ho jate hain, Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak (R.H) farmate hain ek shakhs ne ek rahib se ek qabristan aur kooda karkat pakhana peshab dalne ki jagah par mulaqat ki aur us se kaha ae banda-e-haq is waqt tere paas do khazane hain ek khazana logon ka yani qabristan aur dusra khazana maal ka yani kooda karkat, peshab pakhana dalne ki jagah.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) khandrat par jaate aur kisi toote phoote darwaze par khade reh kar nihayat hasrat-o-afsos ke sath bharayi hui awaz mein farmate, "Ae ujde hue gharo! Tumhare rehne wale kahan gaye?" Phir khud farmate, "Sab zer-e-zameen chale gaye, sab fana ka jaam pee chuke, sirf Allah Ta'ala ki zaat hi hamesha ki malik-e-baqa hai." Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ka irshad hai, "Do raka'atein jo dil bastagi ke sath ada ki jayen, us tamam namaz se afzal hain jis mein sari raat guzar di lekin dilchaspi na thi." Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain, "Ibn-e-Adam! Apne pet ke teesre hisse mein kha, teesre hisse mein pani pee aur teesra hissa un sanson ke liye chhod jis mein tu akhirat ki baton par, apne anjam par aur apne a'maal par gaur-o-fikr kar sake." Ba'az hakeemon ka qaul hai, "Jo shakhs duniya ki cheezon par ibrat hasil kiye baghair nazar dalta hai, us ghaflat ki wajah se uski dili aankhein kamzor pad jati hain." Hazrat Aamir bin Qais (R.H) farmate hain ke, "Main ne bahut se sahaba se suna hai ke iman ki roshni aur noor gaur-o-fikr aur muraqba mein hai." Maseeh Ibn-e-Maryam Sayyiduna Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka farman hai ke, "Ibn-e-Adam! Ae za'eef insan! Jahan kahin tu ho Allah Ta'ala se darta reh, duniya mein aajizi aur maskeeni ke sath reh, apna ghar masjidon ko bana le, apni aankhon ko rona sikha, apne jism ko sabr ki aadat sikha, apne dil ko gaur-o-fikr karne wala bana, kal ki rozi ki fikr aaj na kar." Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ek martaba majlis mein baithe hue ro diye, logon ne wajah poochhi to aap ne farmaya, "Main ne duniya mein aur uski lazzaton mein aur uski khwahishon mein gaur-o-fikr kiya aur ibrat hasil ki, jab natija par pahuncha to meri umangein khatam ho gayin, haqeeqat yeh hai ke har shakhs ke liye is mein ibrat-o-naseehat hai aur wa'az-o-pand hai." Hussain bin Abdur Rahman ne bhi apne ash'aar mein is mazmoon ko khoob nibhaya hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne un bandon ki madh-o-sana bayan ki jo makhlooqat aur kainat se ibrat hasil karein aur naseehat lein aur un logon ki muzammat bayan ki jo qudrat ki nishaniyon par gaur na karein.

Mominon ki madh mein bayan ho raha hai ke yeh log uthte baithte leitte Allah Subhanahu ka zikr karte hain, zameen-o-aasman ki paidaish mein gaur-o-fikr karte hain aur kehte hain ke ae Allah! Tu ne apni makhlooq ko abas aur bekar nahin banaya balkeh haq ke sath paida kiya hai taake buron ko burai ka badla aur nekon ko nekiyon ka badla ata farmaye. Phir Allah ki pakeezgi bayan karte hain, Tu is se munazza hai ke kisi cheez ko bekar banaye. Ae Khaliq-e-Kainat! Ae adl-o-insaf se kainat ko sajane wale! Ae nuqsan aur aibon se pak zaat! Hamein apni quwwat-o-taqat se un aamal ki taufiq aur hamara rafeeq farma jin se hum tere azabon se nijat pa lein aur teri nematon se mala-maal ho kar jannat mein dakhil ho jayen. Yeh yun bhi kehte hain ke ae Allah! Jise Tu jahannam mein le gaya use Tu ne barbad aur zaleel-o-khwar kar diya, majma-e-hashr ke samne use ruswa kiya, zalimon ka koi madadgar nahin, unhein na koi chura sake, na bacha sake, na tere irade ke darmiyan aa sake. Ae Rabb! Hum ne pukarne wale ki pukar sun li jo imaan aur Islam ki taraf bulata hai, murad is se Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain jo farmate hain ke apne Rabb par imaan lao, hum imaan la chuke aur tabedari baja laye, pas hamare imaan aur farman-bardari ki wajah se hamare gunahon ko maaf farma, un ki parda-poshi kar aur hamari buraiyon ko hum se door kar de aur hamein saleh aur nek logon ke sath mila de. Allah Ta'ala farmayega mere yeh bande sache hain aur unhein Nehr-e-Baiza mein ghusl karwayenge jis ghusl ke baad pak saaf gore chitte rang ke ho kar niklenge aur saari jannat un ke liye mubah hogi, jahan chahein jayen ayen, jo chahein khayen piyen. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai aur baaz to kehte hain mauzoo hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Aadhi raat ke qareeb kuch pehlay ya kuch baad Huzoor (ﷺ) jaagay, apne hathon se apni aankhein maltay huay in das aayaton ki tilawat ki, phir ek latki hui mashk mein se pani le kar bohat achi tarah kamil wuzu kiya. Main bhi aap ki bayin janib aap ki iqtida mein namaz ke liye khara ho gaya. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apna dahina hath mere sar par rakh kar mere kaan ko pakar kar mujhe ghuma kar apni dayin janib kar liya aur do-do rakat kar ke chhay martaba yani barah rakat parhin, phir Witr parha aur lait gaye yahan tak ke muazzin ne aa kar namaz ki ittila ki. Aap ne kharay ho kar do halki rakatein ada kin aur bahar aa kar subah ki namaz parhayi. Ibn Marduyah ki is hadith mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) farmatay hain mujhe mere walid Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke tum aaj ki raat Huzoor (ﷺ) ki aal mein guzaro aur aap ki raat ki namaz ki kaifiyat dekho. Raat ko jab sab log Isha ki namaz parh kar chalay gaye main betha raha, jab Huzoor (ﷺ) jaanay lagay to mujhe dekh kar farmaya, "Kaun? Abdullah?"

Main ne kaha ji haan, farmaya kyun ruke hue ho? Main ne kaha walid sahab ka hukum hai ke raat aap ke ghar guzaron, toh farmaya bahut achha, aao. Ghar ja kar farmaya bistar bichhao, taat ka takiya aaya aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us par sar rakh kar so gaye, yahan tak ke mujhe aap ke kharaton ki aawaz aane lagi. Phir aap jaage aur seedhi tarah baith kar aasman ki taraf dekh kar teen martaba dua (Subhanal Malikil Quddus) padha, phir Surah Al-Imran ke khatma ki yeh aayatein padhin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aayaton ki tilawat ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh dua padhi: (Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nooran, wa fi sam'i nooran, wa fi basari nooran, wa 'an yamini nooran, wa 'an shamali nooran, wa min baini yadayya nooran, wa min khalfi nooran, wa min fawqi nooran, wa min tahti nooran, wa a'zim li nooran yaumal qiyamah) (Ibn Marduyah). Yeh dua ba'az sahih tareeq se bhi marwi hai. Is aayat ki tafsir ke shuru mein Tabrani ke hawalay se jo hadith guzri hai, us se toh yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh aayat Makki hai, lekin mashhoor is ke khilaf hai, yani yeh ke yeh aayat Madani hai aur is ki daleel mein yeh hadith pesh ho sakti hai jo Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Hazrat Atta, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Hazrat Ubaid bin Umair, Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ke paas aaye, aap ke aur un ke darmiyan parda tha. Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne poocha, Ubaid tum kyun nahin aaya karte? Hazrat Ubaid ne jawab diya, Amma jaan! Sirf is liye ke kisi shayar ka qaul hai: "Zur ghiban tazdad hubba" yani kam kam aao taake mohabbat badhe. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne kaha, ab in baaton ko chhodo, Ummul Momineen! Hum yeh poochne ke liye hazir hue hain ke sab se zyada ajeeb baat jo aap ne An-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki dekhi ho, woh hamein batayein. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ro dein aur farmane lagin, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke tamam kaam ajeeb-tar thay, achha ek waqia suno, ek raat meri baari mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mere paas aaye aur mere saath soye, phir mujh se farmane lage, "Ayesha! Main apne Rab ki kuch ibadat karna chahta hoon, mujhe jaane de." Main ne kaha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Allah ki qasam main aap ka qurb chahti hoon aur yeh bhi meri chahat hai ke aap Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki ibadat bhi karein. Ab aap khade hue aur ek mashk mein se pani le kar aap ne halka sa wazu kiya aur namaz ke liye khade ho gaye, phir jo rona shuru kiya toh itna roye ke darhi mubarak tar ho gayi, phir sajde mein gaye aur is qadar roye ke zameen tar ho gayi, phir karwat ke bal let gaye aur rote hi rahe yahan tak ke Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ne aa kar namaz ke liye bulaya aur aap ke aansu rawan dekh kar daryaft kiya ke, "Ae Allah ke sachay Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aap kyun ro rahe hain? Allah Ta'ala ne toh aap ke tamam aglay pichlay gunah maaf farma diye hain." Aap ne farmaya, "Bilal! Main kyun na roun? Mujh par aaj ki raat yeh aayat utri hai: (Inna fi khalqis samawati wal ardi wakhtilafil laili wannahar) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 164). Afsos hai us shakhs ke liye jo isay padhe aur phir is mein ghaur-o-tadabbur na kare." Abd bin Humaid ki tafsir mein bhi yeh hadith hai, us mein yeh bhi hai ke jab hum Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas gaye, hum ne salam kiya toh aap ne poocha, "Tum kaun log ho?"

Hum ne apne naam bataye aur aakhir mein yeh bhi hai ke namaz ke baad aap apni dahini karwat par leite, rukhsar tale haath rakha aur rote rahe yahan tak ke aansuon se zameen tar ho gayi aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) ke jawab mein aap ne yeh bhi farmaya ke kya main shukar guzar banda na banun? Aur aayaton ke nazil hone ke bare mein Azaab-un-Naar tak aap ne tilawat ki, Ibn Marduyah ki ek zaeef sanad wali hadith mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Surah Aal-e-Imran ki aakhir ki das aayatein har raat ko parhte, is riwayat mein Mazahir bin Aslam zaeef hain.

Dua kijiye qabool hogi bashart-e-ke? Yahan istijab ke ma'ani mein ajab ke hain aur yeh Arabi mein barabar marooj hai. Hazrat Um-e-Salma (R.A) ne ek roz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke kya baat hai aurton ki hijrat ka kahin Quran mein Allah Ta'ala ne zikr nahin karta? Is par yeh aayat utri. Ansari ka bayan hai ke aurton mein sab se pehli muhajira aurat jo haudaj mein aayin Hazrat Um-e-Salma (R.A) hi thin. Umm-ul-Momineen (R.A) se yeh bhi marwi hai ke sahib-e-aql aur sahib-e-imaan logon ne jab Allah Ta'ala se duayein mangin jin ka zikr pehle ki aayaton mein tha to Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ne bhi un ki munh mangi murad unhein ata farmayi, isi liye is aayat ko "" se shuru kiya, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (WA-IZA SA-ALAKA IBADI ANNI FA-INNI QARIBUN UJIBU DA'WATAD-DA'I IZA DA'ANI FALYASTAJIBU LI WALYU'MINU BI LA'ALLAHUM YARSHUDUN) (Al-Baqarah: 186) ya'ni mere banday tujh se mere baray mein sawal karein to keh de ke main to un ke bohat hi nazdeek hoon jab koi pukarnay wala mujhe pukarta hai main us ki pukar ko qabool farma leta hoon pas unhein bhi chahiye ke meri maan liya karein aur mujh par imaan rakhein mumkin hai ke woh rushd-o-hidayat pa lein. Phir qabooliyat-e-dua ki tafseer hoti hai aur Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke main kisi aamil ke amal ko ra'yegan nahin karta balkay har ek ko poora poora badla ata farmata hoon khwah mard ho khwah aurat, har ek mere paas sawab mein aur a'maal ke badlay mein yaksan hai, pas jo log shirk ki jagah ko chhorein aur imaan ki jagah aa jayen dar-ul-kufr se hijrat karein bhaiyon, doston, parosiyon aur apnon ko Allah ke naam par tark kar dein, mushrikon ki eza'ein seh seh kar thak kar bhi, aajiz aa kar bhi imaan ko na chhorein balkay apne pyaray watan se munh mor lein jabke logon ka unhon ne koi nuqsan nahin kiya tha jis ke badlay mein unhein sataya jata balkay un ka sirf yeh qasoor tha ke meri raah pe chalnay walay thay sirf meri tauheed ko maan kar duniya ki dushmani mol le li thi, meri raah par chalnay ke ba'is tarah tarah se sataye jatay thay jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Yukhrijunar-Rasoola wa iyyakum an tu'minu billahi Rabbikum) yeh log Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aur tumhein sirf is bina watan se nikal detay hain ke tum Allah Ta'ala par imaan rakhtay ho jo tumhara Rabb hai, aur irshad hai aayat (WAMA NAQAMU MINHUM ILLA AN YU'MINU BILLAHIL-AZIZIL-HAMID) (Al-Burooj: 8) un se dushmani isi wajah se hai ke Allah Aziz-o-Hamid par imaan laye hain. Phir farmata hai unhon ne jihad bhi kiye aur yeh shaheed bhi huye yeh sab se a'ala aur buland martaba hai aisa shakhs Allah ki raah mein jihad karta hai us ki sawari kat jati hai munh khaak-o-khoon mein mil jata hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) agar main sabr ke sath nek niyati se daleri se peechay na hat kar Allah ki raah mein jihad karoon aur phir shaheed kar diya jaoon to kya Allah Ta'ala meri khatayein maaf farma de ga?

Aap ne farmaya haan phir dobara aap ne us se sawal kiya ke zara phir kehna tum ne kya kaha tha? Us ne dobara apna sawal dohra diya aap ne farmaya haan magar qarz maaf na hoga yeh baat Jibraeel (A.S) abhi mujh se keh gaye. Pas yahan farmaya hai ke main un ki khata-kariyan maaf farma doon ga aur unhein un jannaton mein le jaoon ga jin mein charon taraf nehren beh rahi hain jin mein kisi mein doodh hai kisi mein shehad kisi mein sharab kisi mein saaf pani aur woh ne'matein hongi jo na kisi kaan ne sunin na kisi aankh ne dekhein na kisi insani dil mein kabhi khayal guzra. Yeh hai badla Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se zahir hai ke jo sawab us shahanshah-e-aali ki taraf se ho woh kis qadar zabardast aur be-inteha hoga? Jaise kisi shayar ka qaul hai ke agar woh azab kare to woh bhi mohlik aur barbad kar dene wala aur agar inaam de to woh bhi be-hisab qayas se barh kar kyunke us ki zaat be-parwah hai, nek aamal logon ko behtareen badla Allah Ta'ala hi ke paas hai, Hazrat Shaddad bin Aus (R.A) farmate hain logon Allah Ta'ala ki qaza par ghamgeen aur be-sabray na ho jaya karo suno momin par zulm-o-jor nahin hota agar tumhein khushi aur rahat pohanche to Allah Ta'ala ki hamd aur us ka shukr karo aur agar burai pohanche to sabr-o-zabt karo aur neki aur sawab ki tamanna rakho Allah Ta'ala ke paas behtareen badlay aur pakeeza sawab hain.

Duniya ka saman-e-ta'ayyush daleel-e-najat nahin. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke un kafiron ki badmasti ke saman-e-ta'ayyush, un ki rahat-o-aram, un ki khush-hali aur farigh-ul-bali ki taraf ae Nabi (ﷺ) aap nazrein na dalein. Yeh sab anqareeb zail ho jayega aur sirf un ki bada'amaliyan azab ki surat mein un ke liye baqi reh jayengi. Un ki yeh tamam ne'matein akhirat ke muqable mein bilkul hech hain. Isi mazmoon ki bahut si ayatein Quran-e-Kareem mein hain, maslan ayat: (Ma yujadilu fi ayati-l-lahi illa-lladhina kafaru fala yaghrurka taqallubuhum fil-bilad) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 4). Allah ki ayaton mein kafir hi jhagadte hain, un ka shehron mein ghoomna phirna tujhe dhoke mein na dale. Dusri jagah irshad hai ayat: (Inna-lladhina yaftaruna 'ala-l-lahi-l-kadhiba la yuflihun) (Surah An-Nahl: 116). Jo log Allah par jhoot bandhte hain woh falah nahin paate. Duniya mein chahe thoda sa faida utha lein lekin akhir to unhein hamari taraf hi lautna hai, phir hum unhein un ke kufr ki padash mein sakht tar sazayein denge. Irshad hai: Unhein hum thoda sa faida pahuncha kar phir gehre azabon ki taraf be-bas kar denge. Aur jagah hai: Kafiron ko kuch mohlat de de. Aur jagah hai: Kya woh shakhs jo hamare behtareen wadon ko pa lega aur woh jo duniya mein aram se guzar raha hai lekin Qayamat ke din azabon ke liye haziri dene wala hai, barabar ho sakte hain? Chunki kafiron ka dunyawi aur ukhrawi haal bayan hua, is liye sath hi mominon ka zikr ho raha hai ke yeh muttaqi giroh Qayamat ke din nehron wali behishton mein hoga. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai, Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) farmate hain: Unhein Abrar is liye kaha jata hai ke yeh maa-baap ke sath aur aulad ke sath nek sulook karte the. Jis tarah tere maa-baap ka tujh par haq hai, isi tarah teri aulad ka tujh par haq hai. Yehi riwayat Hazrat Ibn-e-Amr (R.A) se mauqoofan bhi marwi hai aur mauqoof hona hi zyada theek nazar aata hai, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain: Abrar woh hain jo kisi ko eza na dein. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) farmate hain: Har shakhs ke liye, khwah nek ho khwah bad, maut achi cheez hai. Agar nek hai to jo kuch us ke liye Allah ke paas hai woh bahut hi behtar hai, aur agar bad hai to Allah ke azab aur us ke gunah jo us ki zindagi mein badh rahe the, ab un ka badhna khatam hua. Pehle ki daleel ayat: (Wa ma 'inda-l-lahi khairu-lil-abrar) (Surah Al-Imran: 198) hai aur dusri ki daleel ayat: (Wa la yahsabanna-lladhina kafaru annama numli lahum khairu-li-anfusihim innama numli lahum liyazdadu ithman wa lahum 'adhabum-muhin) (Surah Al-Imran: 178) hai. Yani kafir hamari dheel dene ko apne haq mein behtar na khayal karein, yeh dheel un ke gunahon mein izafa kar rahi hai aur un ke liye ruswa kun azab hain. Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) se bhi yehi marwi hai.

Iman walon aur mujahideen ke qabil-e-rashk a'zaz. Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Kitab ke us firqe ki tareef karta hai jo poore iman wala hai, Quran-e-Kareem ko bhi manta hai aur apne Nabi ki kitab par bhi iman rakhta hai. Allah Ta'ala ka dar dil mein rakh kar Allah Ta'ala ke farmanon ki baja-awari mein nihayat tundahi ke sath mashghool hai, Rab ke samne aajizi aur girya-o-zari karta rehta hai. Paighambar-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke jo pak ausaf aur saaf nishaniyan un ki kitabon mein hain, use duniya ke badle chupata nahin balkeh har ek ko batata hai aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ko maan lene ki raghbat dilata hai. Aisi jamaat Allah Ta'ala ke paas ajar payegi, khwah woh yahudiyon ki ho khwah nasraniyon ki. Surah Qasas mein yeh mazmoon is tarah bayan hua hai, ayat: (Alladhina atainahumul-kitaba ya'rifunahu kama ya'rifuna abna'ahum, alladhina khasiru anfusahum fahum la yu'minun) (Surah Al-An'am: 20). Jinhein hum ne is se pehle kitab de rakhi hai woh is par bhi iman late hain aur jab yeh kitab un ke samne padhi jati hai to saaf keh dete hain ke hum is par iman laye, yeh barhaq kitab hamare Rab ki hai, hum to pehle se hi ise mante the. Inhein unke sabr ka dohra ajar diya jayega aur jagah hai jinhein hum ne kitab di aur jo ise sahih taur par padhte hain woh to is Quran par bhi fauran iman late hain. Aur jagah irshad hai, ayat: (Wa min qawmi Musa ummatun yahduna bil-haqqi wa bihi ya'dilun) (Surah Al-A'raf: 159). Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki qaum mein se bhi ek jamaat haq ki hidayat karne wali aur haq ke sath adl karne wali hai. Dusre maqam par bayan hai, ayat: (Laisu sawa'an, min ahlil-kitabi ummatun qa'imatun yatluna ayatillahi ana'al-laili wahum yasjudun) (Surah Al-Imran: 113). Ya'ni Ahl-e-Kitab sab yaksan nahin, un mein ek jamaat raton ke waqt bhi Allah ki kitab padhne wali hai aur sajde karne wali. Aur jagah hai, ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum kaho ke logon tum iman lao ya na lao, jinhein pehle se ilm diya gaya hai jab un ke samne is Kalam-e-Majeed ki ayatein tilawat ki jati hain to woh apne chehron ke bal sajde mein gir padte hain aur kehte hain ke hamara Rab pak hai, yaqeenan us ka wada sacha hai aur sacha ho kar rehne wala hai. Yeh log rote hue munh ke bal girte hain aur khushu-o-khuzu mein badh jate hain. Yeh sifatein yahudiyon mein payi gayin, go bahut kam log aise the maslan Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) aur Aap (R.A) hi jaise. Aur jagah hai, ayat: (Latajidanna asaddan-nasi adawatan lilladhina amanut-yahuda walladhina ashraku) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 82).

(Al-Ma'idah: 82) Isay Khalideena Feeha aakhir aayat tak, matlab yeh hai ke imaan walon se adawat aur dushmani rakhne mein sab se zyada barhay huay Yahood hain aur mushrik aur imaan walon se mohabbat rakhne mein pesh pesh Nasrani hain, ab farmata hai aisay log Allah Ta'ala ke haan ajar-e-azeem ke mustahiq hain, hadees mein yeh bhi aa chuka hai ke Hazrat Ja'far bin Abu Talib ne jab Surah Maryam ki tilawat Shah-e-Najashi ke darbar mein badshah, arakeen-e-saltanat aur ulama-e-Nasara ke samne ki aur is mein aap par riqqat tari hui to sab hazireen-e-darbar ma' badshah ro diye aur is qadar mutasir huay ke rotay rotay un ki darhiyan tar ho gayin, Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke Najashi ke inteqal ki khabar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne as-haab ko di aur farmaya ke tumhara bhai Habsha mein inteqal kar gaya hai aur us ke janazay ki namaz ada karo aur maidan mein ja kar sahaba ki safein murattab kar ke aap ne un ke janazay ki namaz ada ki. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke jab Najashi faut huay to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya apne bhai ke liye istighfar karo to ba'az logon ne kaha dekhiye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamein is Nasrani ke liye istighfar karne ka hukum dete hain jo Habsha mein mara hai is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Goya us ke musalman hone ki shahadat Quran-e-Kareem ne di, Ibn Jareer mein hai ke un ki maut ki khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne di ke tumhara bhai As-hama inteqal kar gaya hai phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bahar niklay aur jis tarah janazay ki namaz parhate thay isi tarah chaar takbeeron se namaz-e-janaza parhayi is par munafiqon ne woh aitraz kiya aur yeh aayat utri Abu Dawood mein hai Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain ke Najashi ke inteqal ke baad hum yahi suntay rahay ke un ki qabr par noor dekha jata hai, Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke Najashi ka ek dushman us ki saltanat par hamla-awar hua to muhajireen ne kaha ke aap is se muqabla karne ke liye chaliye hum bhi aap ke sath hain aap hamari bahaduri ke johar dekh lenge aur jo husn-e-sulook aap ne hamaray sath kiya hai us ka badla bhi utar jaye ga lekin Najashi (R.H) ne farmaya ke aap logon ki imdad ke sath bachao karne se Allah ki imdad ka bachao behtar hai is baray mein yeh aayat nazil hui.

Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain is se murad Ahl-e-Kitab ke musalman log hain, Hazrat Hasan Basri farmate hain is se murad woh Ahl-e-Kitab hain jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se pehle the, Islam ko pehchante the aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari ka bhi sharaf unhein hasil hua to unhein ajar bhi dohra mila, ek to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se pehle ke iman ka, dusra ajar Aap par iman lane ka. Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) se marvi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya teen qisam ke logon ko dohra ajar milta hai jin mein se ek Ahl-e-Kitab ka woh shakhs hai jo apne Nabi par iman laya aur mujh par iman laya aur baqi do ko bhi zikr kiya. Allah ki ayaton ko thodi qeemat par nahin bechte yani apne paas ilmi baton ko chupate nahin jaise ke un mein se ek razeel jamaat ka shewa tha, balkeh yeh log to ise phailate aur khoob zahir karte hain. Un ka badla un ke Rab ke paas hai, Allah Ta'ala jald hisab lene wala hai yani jald sametne aur gherne aur shumar karne wala hai. Phir farmata hai ke Islam jaise mere pasandeeda deen par jame raho, shiddat aur narmi ke waqt, museebat aur rahat ke waqt, garz kisi haal mein bhi ise na chhodo yahan tak ke dam nikle to isi par nikle aur apne in dushmanon se bhi sabr se kaam lo jo apne deen ko chupate hain. Imam Hasan Basri wagaira ulama-e-salaf ne yahi tafseer bayan farmayi hai. Murabita kehte hain ibadat ki jagah mein hameshangi karne ko aur sabit qadmi se jam jane ko aur kaha gaya hai ek namaz ke baad dusri namaz ke intezar ko, yahi qoum hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A), Sahl bin Haneef (R.A) aur Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka Sahih Muslim Shareef aur Nasai mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain aao main tumhein bataun ke kis cheez se Allah Ta'ala gunahon ko mita deta hai aur darjon ko barhata hai, takleef hote hote bhi kamil wuzu karna, door se chal kar masjidon mein aana, ek namaz ke baad dusri namaz ka intezar karna, yahi ribat hai, yahi murabit hai, yahi Allah Ta'ala ki rah ki musta'idi hai. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Abu Salama se ek din Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne poocha ae mere bhatije jante ho is ayat ka shaan-e-nuzool kya hai? Unhon ne kaha mujhe maloom nahin, Aap ne farmaya suno us waqt koi ghazwa na tha, yeh ayat un logon ke haq mein nazil hui hai jo masjidon ko abad rakhti thi aur namazon ko theek waqt par ada karte the, phir Allah ka zikr karte the, unhein yeh hukum diya jata hai ke tum panchhon namazon par jame raho aur apne nafs ko aur apni khwahish ko roke rakho aur masjidon mein baseera karo aur Allah se darte raho.

Yehi a'maal mujib-e-imaan hain, Ibn-e-Jarir ki hadith mein hai kya main tumhein woh a'maal na bataun jo gunahon ka kaffara ho jate hain? Na-pasandidagi ke waqt kaamil wuzu karna aur ek namaz ke baad dusri namaz ka intezar karna, tumhari musta'idi isi mein honi chahiye aur hadith mein zyada qadam rakh kar chal kar masjid mein aana bhi hai, aur riwayat mein hai ke gunahon ki ma'afi ke sath hi darje bhi in a'maal se barhte rehte hain aur yehi is aayat ka matlab hai lekin yeh hadith bilkul ghareeb hai, Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman farmate hain yahan "Rabitou" se matlab intezar-e-namaz hai, lekin upar bayan ho chuka hai ke yeh farman Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ka hai wallahu a'lam. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke "Rabitou" se murad dushman se jihad karna, islami mulk ki hudood ki nigahbani karna aur dushmanon ko islami shehron mein na ghusne dena hai, is ki targheeb mein bhi bahut si hadithein hain aur is par bhi bare sawab ka wada hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ek din ki yeh tayyari sari duniya se aur jo is mein hai sab se afzal hai, Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ek din raat ki jihad ki tayyari ek mah ke kaamil rozon aur ek mah ki tamam shab-bedari se afzal hai aur isi tayyari ki halat mein maut aa jaye to jitne a'maal-e-saliha karta tha sab ka sawab pahunchta rehta hai aur Allah Ta'ala ke paas se rozi pahunchayi jati hai aur fitnon se aman pata hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai har marne wale ke a'maal khatam ho jate hain magar jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki rah ki tayyari mein ho aur isi halat mein mar jaye uska amal qayamat tak barhta rehta hai aur use fitna-e-qabr se nijat milti hai, Ibn-e-Majah ki riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke qayamat ke din use aman milega, Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai use subh-o-sham jannat se rozi pahunchayi jati hai aur qayamat tak us ke murabit ka ajr milta rehta hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs musalmanon ki sarhad ke kisi kinare par teen din tayyari mein guzare use saal bhar tak ki aur jagah ki is tayyari ka ajr milta hai, Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ne apne mimbar par khutba parhte hue ek martaba farmaya main tumhein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se apni suni hui baat sunata hun main ne ab tak ek khas khayal se ise nahin sunaya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki rah mein ek raat ka pehra ek hazar raton ki ibadat se afzal hai jo tamam raten qayam mein aur tamam din siyam mein guzare jayen.

Dusri riwayat mein is hadith ko ab tak bayan na karne ki wajah Khalifa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh bayan farmayi hai ke mujhe dar tha ke is fazeelat ke hasil karne ke liye kahin tum sab Madina chhod kar maidan-e-jang mein na chal do, ab main suna deta hoon, har shakhs ko ikhtiyar hai ke jo baat apne liye pasand karta hai us ka paband ho jaye. Dusri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke aap ne farmaya ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki baat pahuncha di, logon ne kaha haan, aap ne farmaya ae Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala tu gawah reh. Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Sharjeel bin Samt muhafizat-e-sarhad mein thay aur zamana zyada guzar jane ke baad kuch tang-dil ho rahe thay ke Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) un ke paas pahunche aur farmaya aao main tujhe Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ek hadith sunaoon, aap ne farmaya hai ek din sarhad ki hifazat ek mahina ke siyam-o-qayam se afzal hai aur jo isi halat mein mar jaye woh fitna-e-qabr se mehfooz rehta hai aur us ke aamal qayamat tak jaari rehte hain. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke ek raat Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein pehra dena taake musalman aman se rahein, haan niyat nek ho go woh raat Ramadan ki na ho, ek sau saal ki ibadat se afzal hai jis ke din rozay mein aur jis ki raatein tahajjud mein guzri hon aur ek din ki Rabb-ul-Izzat ki rah mein tayyari taake musalman ba-hifazat rahein talab-e-sawab ki niyat se mah-e-Ramadan ke baghair Allah ke nazdeek ek hazar saal ke rozon aur tahajjud se afzal hai, musalman ba-hifazat rahein talab-e-sawab ki niyat se mah-e-Ramadan ke baghair Allah ke nazdeek ek hazar saal ki buraiyan us ke nama-e-aamal mein nahin likhi jayengi aur nekiyan likhi jayengi aur is murabit ka ajr qayamat tak usay milta rahega, yeh hadith ghareeb hai balkay munkar hai, is ke ek rawi Amr bin Subh muttaham hain. Ibn-e-Majah ki ek aur ghareeb hadith mein hai ke ek raat ki muslim lashkar ki chaukidari ek hazar saal ki raton ke qayam aur dinon ke siyam se afzal hai, har saal ke teen sau saath din aur har din misl ek hazar saal ke, is ke rawi Saeed bin Khalid ko Abu Zur'ah waghera ne aimma ne isay za'eef kaha hai balkay Imam Hakim farmate hain is ki riwayat se mau'za hadithein bhi hain. Ek munqata hadith mein hai lashkar-e-Islam ke chaukidar par Allah Ta'ala ka raham ho (Ibn-e-Majah). Hazrat Sahl bin Hanzala (R.A) farmate hain ke Hunain wale din hum Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath chale, sham ki namaz main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath ada ki, itne mein ek ghoda sawar aaya aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main aage nikal gaya tha aur falan pahad par chadh kar main ne nigah dali to dekha ke qabila Hawazin ke log maidan mein jama ho gaye hain yahan tak ke un ki oontniyan, bakriyan, aurtein aur bachay bhi sath hain, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) muskuraye aur farmaya Insha'Allah yeh sab kal musalmanon ki maal-e-ghaneemat hoga, phir farmaya batao aaj ki raat pehra kaun dega?

Hazrat Anas bin Abu Marsad R.A ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main hazir hoon, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jao sawari le kar aao. Woh apne ghore par sawar ho kar hazir hue, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is ghati par chale jao aur is pahari ki choti par charh jao, khabardar tumhari taraf se un ke sath koi chher-char subh tak na ho. Subh jis waqt namaz ke liye Huzoor (ﷺ) tashreef laye, do sunnatein ada keen aur logon se pucha kaho tumhare pehredar sawar ki to koi aahat nahin suni? Logon ne kaha nahin Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ). Ab takbeer kahi gayi aur Aap (ﷺ) ne namaz shuru ki, Aap (ﷺ) ka khayal usi ghati ki taraf tha. Namaz se salam pherte hi Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya khush ho jao tumhara ghore sawar aa raha hai. Hum ne jhariyon mein jhank kar dekha to thori der mein hamain bhi dikhai de gaye. Aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ) se kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main is wadi ke upar ke hisse par pahunch gaya aur irshad ke mutabiq wahin raat guzari, subh main ne dusri ghati bhi dekh dali lekin wahan bhi koi nahin. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya kya raat ko wahan se tum niche bhi utre thay? Jawab diya nahin, sirf namaz ke liye aur qaza-e-hajat ke liye to niche utra tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum ne apne liye jannat wajib kar li, ab tum is ke baad koi amal na karo to bhi tum par koi harj nahin. (Abu Dawood o Nasai).

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ek ghazwa ke mauqa par ek raat ko hum buland jagah par thay aur sakht sardi thi yahan tak ke log zameen mein garhay khod khod kar apne upar dhalain le le kar paray hue thay. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne is waqt awaz di ke koi hai jo aaj ki raat hamari chaukidari kare aur mujh se behtareen dua le? To ek Ansari khara ho gaya aur kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) main tayyar hoon. Aap (ﷺ) ne use paas bula kar naam daryaft kar ke us ke liye bohat dua ki. Abu Rehana ye duayen sun kar aage barhay aur kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main bhi pehra doon ga, Aap (ﷺ) ne mujhe bhi paas bula liya aur naam puch kar mere liye bhi duayen keen lekin us Ansari Sahabi (R.A) se ye dua kam thi. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is aankh par jahannam ki aanch haram hai jo Allah ke dar se roye aur is aankh par bhi jo rah-e-Allah mein shab-bedari kare.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo shakhs musalmanon ke piche se un ka pehra de apni khushi se baghair sultan ki ujrat o tankhwah ke, woh apni aankhon se bhi jahannam ki aag ko na dekhe ga magar sirf qasam puri hone ke liye jo is aayat mein hai aayat (Wa-in minkum illa wariduha) yani tum sab is par warid ho ge.

Sahih Bukhari mein hai dinar ka banda barbad hua aur kapron ka banda agar maal diya jaye to khush hai aur agar na diya jaye to na-khush hai, yeh bhi barbad hua aur kharab hua agar ise kanta chub jaye to nikalne ki koshish bhi na ki jaye. Khush naseeb hua aur phala khoob phoola woh shakhs jo Allah ki rah mein jihad ke liye apne ghore ki lagam thame hue hai, bikhre hue baal hain aur gard-alood qadam hain. Agar chaukidari par muqarrar kar diya gaya hai to chaukidari kar raha hai aur agar lashkar ke agle hisse mein muqarrar kar diya gaya hai to wohin khush hai. Logon ki nazron mein itna gira para hai ke agar kahin jana chahe to ijazat na mile aur agar kisi ki sifarish kare to qabool na ho.

Alhamdulillah is aayat ke mutaliq khasi hadeesain bayan ho gayin, Allah Ta'ala ke is fazl o karam par hum is ka shukr ada karte hain aur shukr-guzari se rehti duniya tak farigh nahin ho sakte.

Tafsir Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) ne Amir-ul-Momineen Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko maidan-e-jang se ek khat likha aur us mein Rumiyon ki fauj ki kasrat, un ki aalat-e-harb ki halat aur un ki tayariyon ki kaifiyat bayan ki aur likha ke sakht khatray ka mauqa hai, yahan se Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ka jawab gaya jis mein hamd-o-sana ke baad tahrir tha ke kabhi kabhi momin bandon par sakhtiyan bhi aa jati hain lekin Allah Ta'ala un ke baad asaniyan bhej deta hai. Suno ek sakhti do asaniyon par ghalib nahin aa sakti, suno Parwardigar-e-Alam ka farman hai, ayat (Ya Ayyuhallazina Amanusbiru Wasabiru Warabitu) (Surah Al-Imran: 200). Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak (R.H) ne 170 Hijri mein shahar Tarsus mein Hazrat Muhammad bin Ibrahim bin Sakina ko jabke woh un ko wida karne aaye the aur yeh jihad ko ja rahe the, yeh ashaar likhwa kar Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayaz (R.H) ko bhajwaye:

Ya Aabidal Haramaini lau absartana
La'alimta annaka fil ibadati tal'abu
Man kana yakhzabu khaddahu bidumu'ihi
Fanuhuruna bidima'ina tatakhazzabu
Man kana yut'ibu khaylahu fi batilin
Fanukhuyuluna yaumas-sabihata tat'abu
Rihul-abiri lakum wa nahnu abiruna
Rahjus-sanabiki wal ghubarul atyabu
Wa laqad atana min maqali nabiyyina
Qaulun sahihun sadiqun la yakzibu
La yastawi ghubaru khaylillahi fi
Anfi-amri'in wa dukhanu narin tal-habu
Haza kitabullahi yantiqu bainana
Laisash-shahidu bimayyitin la yakzibu

Aye Makkah Madina mein reh kar ibadat karne wale! Agar tu hum mujahideen ko dekh leta to bil-yaqeen tujhe maloom ho jata ke teri ibadat to ek khel hai. Ek woh shakhs hai jis ke aansu us ke rukhsaron ko tar karte hain aur ek hum hain jo apni gardan Allah ki rah mein katwa kar apne khoon mein aap naha lete hain. Ek woh shakhs hai jis ka ghoda batil aur bekar kaam mein thak jata hai aur hamare ghode hamle aur ladai ke din hi thakte hain. Agar kai khushbuen tumhare liye hain aur hamare liye agar kai khushbu ghodon ke tapon ki khak aur pakeeza gard-o-ghubar hai. Yaqeen mano humein Nabi-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh hadith pahunch chuki hai jo sarasar rasti aur durusti wali bilkul sachi hai ke jis kisi ke naak mein is Allah Ta'ala ke lashkar ki gard bhi pahunch gayi us ke naak mein sholay maarne wali Jahannam ki aag ka dhuan bhi na jayega aur lo yeh hai Allah Ta'ala ki pak kitab jo hum mein maujood hai aur saaf keh rahi hai aur sach keh rahi hai ke shaheed murda nahin.

Muhammad bin Ibrahim farmate hain jab main ne Masjid-e-Haram mein pahunch kar Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayaz (R.H) ko yeh ashaar dikhaye to aap padh kar zaar-o-zaar roye aur farmaya Abu Abdur-Rahman ne (Allah Ta'ala ki rahmaten un par hon) sahih aur sach farmaya aur mujhe nasihat-nama mere paas laye, is ke badle mein tumhein ek hadith likhwata hoon woh yeh ke Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek shakhs ne darkhwast ki ke Ya Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe aisa amal bataye jis se main mujahid ka sawab pa loon, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya tujh mein yeh taqat hai ke namaz hi padhta rahe aur thake nahin aur rozay rakhta chala jaye aur kabhi be-roza na rahe? Us ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ki taqat kahan?

Main is se bohat hi za'eef hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar tujh mein itni taqat hoti aur tu aisa kar bhi sakta toh bhi Mujahid fi Sabilillah ke darjay ko na pahunch sakta, toh yeh bhi jaanta hai ke Mujahid ke ghoray ki rassi daraaz ho jaye aur woh idhar udhar char jaye toh is par bhi Mujahid ko nekiyan milti hain. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala hukum deta hai ke Allah se dartay raho aur har haal mein har waqt har maamlay mein Allah ka khauf kiya karo. Janaab-e-Rasool-e-Akram Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko jab Yaman ki taraf bheja toh farmaya: Ae Mu'az! Jahan bhi ho Allah ka khauf dil mein rakh aur agar tujh se koi burai ho jaye toh foran koi neki bhi kar le taake woh burai mit jaye aur logon se khulq-o-murawwat ke saath pesh aaya kar. Phir farmata hai ke yeh charon kaam kar lene se tum apne maqsad mein kaamyab aur ba-muraad ho jaoge, duniya aur aakhirat mein falah-o-najaat pa loge. Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmatay hain matlab yeh hai ke Allah farmata hai tum mera lihaaz rakho, mere khauf se kanptay raho, mujh se dartay raho, mere aur apne maamlay mein muttaqi raho toh kal jabke tum mujh se miloge najaat yafta aur ba-muraad ho jaoge.

Iman walon aur mujahideen ke qabil-e-rashk a'zaz. Allah Ta'ala Ahl-e-Kitab ke us firqe ki tareef karta hai jo poore iman wala hai, Quran-e-Kareem ko bhi manta hai aur apne Nabi ki kitab par bhi iman rakhta hai. Allah Ta'ala ka dar dil mein rakh kar Allah Ta'ala ke farmanon ki baja-awari mein nihayat tundahi ke sath mashghool hai, Rab ke samne aajizi aur girya-o-zari karta rehta hai. Paighambar-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke jo pak ausaf aur saaf nishaniyan un ki kitabon mein hain, use duniya ke badle chupata nahin balkeh har ek ko batata hai aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ko maan lene ki raghbat dilata hai. Aisi jamaat Allah Ta'ala ke paas ajar payegi, khwah woh yahudiyon ki ho khwah nasraniyon ki. Surah Qasas mein yeh mazmoon is tarah bayan hua hai, ayat: (Alladhina atainahumul-kitaba ya'rifunahu kama ya'rifuna abna'ahum, alladhina khasiru anfusahum fahum la yu'minun) (Surah Al-An'am: 20). Jinhein hum ne is se pehle kitab de rakhi hai woh is par bhi iman late hain aur jab yeh kitab un ke samne padhi jati hai to saaf keh dete hain ke hum is par iman laye, yeh barhaq kitab hamare Rab ki hai, hum to pehle se hi ise mante the. Inhein unke sabr ka dohra ajar diya jayega aur jagah hai jinhein hum ne kitab di aur jo ise sahih taur par padhte hain woh to is Quran par bhi fauran iman late hain. Aur jagah irshad hai, ayat: (Wa min qawmi Musa ummatun yahduna bil-haqqi wa bihi ya'dilun) (Surah Al-A'raf: 159). Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki qaum mein se bhi ek jamaat haq ki hidayat karne wali aur haq ke sath adl karne wali hai. Dusre maqam par bayan hai, ayat: (Laisu sawa'an, min ahlil-kitabi ummatun qa'imatun yatluna ayatillahi ana'al-laili wahum yasjudun) (Surah Al-Imran: 113). Ya'ni Ahl-e-Kitab sab yaksan nahin, un mein ek jamaat raton ke waqt bhi Allah ki kitab padhne wali hai aur sajde karne wali. Aur jagah hai, ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum kaho ke logon tum iman lao ya na lao, jinhein pehle se ilm diya gaya hai jab un ke samne is Kalam-e-Majeed ki ayatein tilawat ki jati hain to woh apne chehron ke bal sajde mein gir padte hain aur kehte hain ke hamara Rab pak hai, yaqeenan us ka wada sacha hai aur sacha ho kar rehne wala hai. Yeh log rote hue munh ke bal girte hain aur khushu-o-khuzu mein badh jate hain. Yeh sifatein yahudiyon mein payi gayin, go bahut kam log aise the maslan Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) aur Aap (R.A) hi jaise. Aur jagah hai, ayat: (Latajidanna asaddan-nasi adawatan lilladhina amanut-yahuda walladhina ashraku) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 82).

(Al-Ma'idah: 82) Isay Khalideena Feeha aakhir aayat tak, matlab yeh hai ke imaan walon se adawat aur dushmani rakhne mein sab se zyada barhay huay Yahood hain aur mushrik aur imaan walon se mohabbat rakhne mein pesh pesh Nasrani hain, ab farmata hai aisay log Allah Ta'ala ke haan ajar-e-azeem ke mustahiq hain, hadees mein yeh bhi aa chuka hai ke Hazrat Ja'far bin Abu Talib ne jab Surah Maryam ki tilawat Shah-e-Najashi ke darbar mein badshah, arakeen-e-saltanat aur ulama-e-Nasara ke samne ki aur is mein aap par riqqat tari hui to sab hazireen-e-darbar ma' badshah ro diye aur is qadar mutasir huay ke rotay rotay un ki darhiyan tar ho gayin, Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke Najashi ke inteqal ki khabar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne as-haab ko di aur farmaya ke tumhara bhai Habsha mein inteqal kar gaya hai aur us ke janazay ki namaz ada karo aur maidan mein ja kar sahaba ki safein murattab kar ke aap ne un ke janazay ki namaz ada ki. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke jab Najashi faut huay to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya apne bhai ke liye istighfar karo to ba'az logon ne kaha dekhiye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hamein is Nasrani ke liye istighfar karne ka hukum dete hain jo Habsha mein mara hai is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Goya us ke musalman hone ki shahadat Quran-e-Kareem ne di, Ibn Jareer mein hai ke un ki maut ki khabar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne di ke tumhara bhai As-hama inteqal kar gaya hai phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bahar niklay aur jis tarah janazay ki namaz parhate thay isi tarah chaar takbeeron se namaz-e-janaza parhayi is par munafiqon ne woh aitraz kiya aur yeh aayat utri Abu Dawood mein hai Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain ke Najashi ke inteqal ke baad hum yahi suntay rahay ke un ki qabr par noor dekha jata hai, Mustadrak Hakim mein hai ke Najashi ka ek dushman us ki saltanat par hamla-awar hua to muhajireen ne kaha ke aap is se muqabla karne ke liye chaliye hum bhi aap ke sath hain aap hamari bahaduri ke johar dekh lenge aur jo husn-e-sulook aap ne hamaray sath kiya hai us ka badla bhi utar jaye ga lekin Najashi (R.H) ne farmaya ke aap logon ki imdad ke sath bachao karne se Allah ki imdad ka bachao behtar hai is baray mein yeh aayat nazil hui.

Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain is se murad Ahl-e-Kitab ke musalman log hain, Hazrat Hasan Basri farmate hain is se murad woh Ahl-e-Kitab hain jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se pehle the, Islam ko pehchante the aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tabedari ka bhi sharaf unhein hasil hua to unhein ajar bhi dohra mila, ek to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se pehle ke iman ka, dusra ajar Aap par iman lane ka. Bukhari Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) se marvi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya teen qisam ke logon ko dohra ajar milta hai jin mein se ek Ahl-e-Kitab ka woh shakhs hai jo apne Nabi par iman laya aur mujh par iman laya aur baqi do ko bhi zikr kiya. Allah ki ayaton ko thodi qeemat par nahin bechte yani apne paas ilmi baton ko chupate nahin jaise ke un mein se ek razeel jamaat ka shewa tha, balkeh yeh log to ise phailate aur khoob zahir karte hain. Un ka badla un ke Rab ke paas hai, Allah Ta'ala jald hisab lene wala hai yani jald sametne aur gherne aur shumar karne wala hai. Phir farmata hai ke Islam jaise mere pasandeeda deen par jame raho, shiddat aur narmi ke waqt, museebat aur rahat ke waqt, garz kisi haal mein bhi ise na chhodo yahan tak ke dam nikle to isi par nikle aur apne in dushmanon se bhi sabr se kaam lo jo apne deen ko chupate hain. Imam Hasan Basri wagaira ulama-e-salaf ne yahi tafseer bayan farmayi hai. Murabita kehte hain ibadat ki jagah mein hameshangi karne ko aur sabit qadmi se jam jane ko aur kaha gaya hai ek namaz ke baad dusri namaz ke intezar ko, yahi qoum hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A), Sahl bin Haneef (R.A) aur Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka Sahih Muslim Shareef aur Nasai mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain aao main tumhein bataun ke kis cheez se Allah Ta'ala gunahon ko mita deta hai aur darjon ko barhata hai, takleef hote hote bhi kamil wuzu karna, door se chal kar masjidon mein aana, ek namaz ke baad dusri namaz ka intezar karna, yahi ribat hai, yahi murabit hai, yahi Allah Ta'ala ki rah ki musta'idi hai. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Abu Salama se ek din Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ne poocha ae mere bhatije jante ho is ayat ka shaan-e-nuzool kya hai? Unhon ne kaha mujhe maloom nahin, Aap ne farmaya suno us waqt koi ghazwa na tha, yeh ayat un logon ke haq mein nazil hui hai jo masjidon ko abad rakhti thi aur namazon ko theek waqt par ada karte the, phir Allah ka zikr karte the, unhein yeh hukum diya jata hai ke tum panchhon namazon par jame raho aur apne nafs ko aur apni khwahish ko roke rakho aur masjidon mein baseera karo aur Allah se darte raho.

Yehi a'maal mujib-e-imaan hain, Ibn-e-Jarir ki hadith mein hai kya main tumhein woh a'maal na bataun jo gunahon ka kaffara ho jate hain? Na-pasandidagi ke waqt kaamil wuzu karna aur ek namaz ke baad dusri namaz ka intezar karna, tumhari musta'idi isi mein honi chahiye aur hadith mein zyada qadam rakh kar chal kar masjid mein aana bhi hai, aur riwayat mein hai ke gunahon ki ma'afi ke sath hi darje bhi in a'maal se barhte rehte hain aur yehi is aayat ka matlab hai lekin yeh hadith bilkul ghareeb hai, Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman farmate hain yahan "Rabitou" se matlab intezar-e-namaz hai, lekin upar bayan ho chuka hai ke yeh farman Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ka hai wallahu a'lam. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke "Rabitou" se murad dushman se jihad karna, islami mulk ki hudood ki nigahbani karna aur dushmanon ko islami shehron mein na ghusne dena hai, is ki targheeb mein bhi bahut si hadithein hain aur is par bhi bare sawab ka wada hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ek din ki yeh tayyari sari duniya se aur jo is mein hai sab se afzal hai, Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ek din raat ki jihad ki tayyari ek mah ke kaamil rozon aur ek mah ki tamam shab-bedari se afzal hai aur isi tayyari ki halat mein maut aa jaye to jitne a'maal-e-saliha karta tha sab ka sawab pahunchta rehta hai aur Allah Ta'ala ke paas se rozi pahunchayi jati hai aur fitnon se aman pata hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai har marne wale ke a'maal khatam ho jate hain magar jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ki rah ki tayyari mein ho aur isi halat mein mar jaye uska amal qayamat tak barhta rehta hai aur use fitna-e-qabr se nijat milti hai, Ibn-e-Majah ki riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke qayamat ke din use aman milega, Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai use subh-o-sham jannat se rozi pahunchayi jati hai aur qayamat tak us ke murabit ka ajr milta rehta hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs musalmanon ki sarhad ke kisi kinare par teen din tayyari mein guzare use saal bhar tak ki aur jagah ki is tayyari ka ajr milta hai, Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ne apne mimbar par khutba parhte hue ek martaba farmaya main tumhein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se apni suni hui baat sunata hun main ne ab tak ek khas khayal se ise nahin sunaya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki rah mein ek raat ka pehra ek hazar raton ki ibadat se afzal hai jo tamam raten qayam mein aur tamam din siyam mein guzare jayen.

Dusri riwayat mein is hadith ko ab tak bayan na karne ki wajah Khalifa-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh bayan farmayi hai ke mujhe dar tha ke is fazeelat ke hasil karne ke liye kahin tum sab Madina chhod kar maidan-e-jang mein na chal do, ab main suna deta hoon, har shakhs ko ikhtiyar hai ke jo baat apne liye pasand karta hai us ka paband ho jaye. Dusri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke aap ne farmaya ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki baat pahuncha di, logon ne kaha haan, aap ne farmaya ae Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala tu gawah reh. Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Sharjeel bin Samt muhafizat-e-sarhad mein thay aur zamana zyada guzar jane ke baad kuch tang-dil ho rahe thay ke Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) un ke paas pahunche aur farmaya aao main tujhe Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ek hadith sunaoon, aap ne farmaya hai ek din sarhad ki hifazat ek mahina ke siyam-o-qayam se afzal hai aur jo isi halat mein mar jaye woh fitna-e-qabr se mehfooz rehta hai aur us ke aamal qayamat tak jaari rehte hain. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke ek raat Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein pehra dena taake musalman aman se rahein, haan niyat nek ho go woh raat Ramadan ki na ho, ek sau saal ki ibadat se afzal hai jis ke din rozay mein aur jis ki raatein tahajjud mein guzri hon aur ek din ki Rabb-ul-Izzat ki rah mein tayyari taake musalman ba-hifazat rahein talab-e-sawab ki niyat se mah-e-Ramadan ke baghair Allah ke nazdeek ek hazar saal ke rozon aur tahajjud se afzal hai, musalman ba-hifazat rahein talab-e-sawab ki niyat se mah-e-Ramadan ke baghair Allah ke nazdeek ek hazar saal ki buraiyan us ke nama-e-aamal mein nahin likhi jayengi aur nekiyan likhi jayengi aur is murabit ka ajr qayamat tak usay milta rahega, yeh hadith ghareeb hai balkay munkar hai, is ke ek rawi Amr bin Subh muttaham hain. Ibn-e-Majah ki ek aur ghareeb hadith mein hai ke ek raat ki muslim lashkar ki chaukidari ek hazar saal ki raton ke qayam aur dinon ke siyam se afzal hai, har saal ke teen sau saath din aur har din misl ek hazar saal ke, is ke rawi Saeed bin Khalid ko Abu Zur'ah waghera ne aimma ne isay za'eef kaha hai balkay Imam Hakim farmate hain is ki riwayat se mau'za hadithein bhi hain. Ek munqata hadith mein hai lashkar-e-Islam ke chaukidar par Allah Ta'ala ka raham ho (Ibn-e-Majah). Hazrat Sahl bin Hanzala (R.A) farmate hain ke Hunain wale din hum Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath chale, sham ki namaz main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath ada ki, itne mein ek ghoda sawar aaya aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main aage nikal gaya tha aur falan pahad par chadh kar main ne nigah dali to dekha ke qabila Hawazin ke log maidan mein jama ho gaye hain yahan tak ke un ki oontniyan, bakriyan, aurtein aur bachay bhi sath hain, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) muskuraye aur farmaya Insha'Allah yeh sab kal musalmanon ki maal-e-ghaneemat hoga, phir farmaya batao aaj ki raat pehra kaun dega?

Hazrat Anas bin Abu Marsad R.A ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main hazir hoon, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jao sawari le kar aao. Woh apne ghore par sawar ho kar hazir hue, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is ghati par chale jao aur is pahari ki choti par charh jao, khabardar tumhari taraf se un ke sath koi chher-char subh tak na ho. Subh jis waqt namaz ke liye Huzoor (ﷺ) tashreef laye, do sunnatein ada keen aur logon se pucha kaho tumhare pehredar sawar ki to koi aahat nahin suni? Logon ne kaha nahin Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ). Ab takbeer kahi gayi aur Aap (ﷺ) ne namaz shuru ki, Aap (ﷺ) ka khayal usi ghati ki taraf tha. Namaz se salam pherte hi Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya khush ho jao tumhara ghore sawar aa raha hai. Hum ne jhariyon mein jhank kar dekha to thori der mein hamain bhi dikhai de gaye. Aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ) se kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main is wadi ke upar ke hisse par pahunch gaya aur irshad ke mutabiq wahin raat guzari, subh main ne dusri ghati bhi dekh dali lekin wahan bhi koi nahin. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya kya raat ko wahan se tum niche bhi utre thay? Jawab diya nahin, sirf namaz ke liye aur qaza-e-hajat ke liye to niche utra tha. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum ne apne liye jannat wajib kar li, ab tum is ke baad koi amal na karo to bhi tum par koi harj nahin. (Abu Dawood o Nasai).

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ek ghazwa ke mauqa par ek raat ko hum buland jagah par thay aur sakht sardi thi yahan tak ke log zameen mein garhay khod khod kar apne upar dhalain le le kar paray hue thay. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne is waqt awaz di ke koi hai jo aaj ki raat hamari chaukidari kare aur mujh se behtareen dua le? To ek Ansari khara ho gaya aur kaha Huzoor (ﷺ) main tayyar hoon. Aap (ﷺ) ne use paas bula kar naam daryaft kar ke us ke liye bohat dua ki. Abu Rehana ye duayen sun kar aage barhay aur kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main bhi pehra doon ga, Aap (ﷺ) ne mujhe bhi paas bula liya aur naam puch kar mere liye bhi duayen keen lekin us Ansari Sahabi (R.A) se ye dua kam thi. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is aankh par jahannam ki aanch haram hai jo Allah ke dar se roye aur is aankh par bhi jo rah-e-Allah mein shab-bedari kare.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jo shakhs musalmanon ke piche se un ka pehra de apni khushi se baghair sultan ki ujrat o tankhwah ke, woh apni aankhon se bhi jahannam ki aag ko na dekhe ga magar sirf qasam puri hone ke liye jo is aayat mein hai aayat (Wa-in minkum illa wariduha) yani tum sab is par warid ho ge.

Sahih Bukhari mein hai dinar ka banda barbad hua aur kapron ka banda agar maal diya jaye to khush hai aur agar na diya jaye to na-khush hai, yeh bhi barbad hua aur kharab hua agar ise kanta chub jaye to nikalne ki koshish bhi na ki jaye. Khush naseeb hua aur phala khoob phoola woh shakhs jo Allah ki rah mein jihad ke liye apne ghore ki lagam thame hue hai, bikhre hue baal hain aur gard-alood qadam hain. Agar chaukidari par muqarrar kar diya gaya hai to chaukidari kar raha hai aur agar lashkar ke agle hisse mein muqarrar kar diya gaya hai to wohin khush hai. Logon ki nazron mein itna gira para hai ke agar kahin jana chahe to ijazat na mile aur agar kisi ki sifarish kare to qabool na ho.

Alhamdulillah is aayat ke mutaliq khasi hadeesain bayan ho gayin, Allah Ta'ala ke is fazl o karam par hum is ka shukr ada karte hain aur shukr-guzari se rehti duniya tak farigh nahin ho sakte.

Tafsir Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah (R.A) ne Amir-ul-Momineen Khalifat-ul-Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko maidan-e-jang se ek khat likha aur us mein Rumiyon ki fauj ki kasrat, un ki aalat-e-harb ki halat aur un ki tayariyon ki kaifiyat bayan ki aur likha ke sakht khatray ka mauqa hai, yahan se Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ka jawab gaya jis mein hamd-o-sana ke baad tahrir tha ke kabhi kabhi momin bandon par sakhtiyan bhi aa jati hain lekin Allah Ta'ala un ke baad asaniyan bhej deta hai. Suno ek sakhti do asaniyon par ghalib nahin aa sakti, suno Parwardigar-e-Alam ka farman hai, ayat (Ya Ayyuhallazina Amanusbiru Wasabiru Warabitu) (Surah Al-Imran: 200). Hazrat Abdullah bin Mubarak (R.H) ne 170 Hijri mein shahar Tarsus mein Hazrat Muhammad bin Ibrahim bin Sakina ko jabke woh un ko wida karne aaye the aur yeh jihad ko ja rahe the, yeh ashaar likhwa kar Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayaz (R.H) ko bhajwaye:

Ya Aabidal Haramaini lau absartana
La'alimta annaka fil ibadati tal'abu
Man kana yakhzabu khaddahu bidumu'ihi
Fanuhuruna bidima'ina tatakhazzabu
Man kana yut'ibu khaylahu fi batilin
Fanukhuyuluna yaumas-sabihata tat'abu
Rihul-abiri lakum wa nahnu abiruna
Rahjus-sanabiki wal ghubarul atyabu
Wa laqad atana min maqali nabiyyina
Qaulun sahihun sadiqun la yakzibu
La yastawi ghubaru khaylillahi fi
Anfi-amri'in wa dukhanu narin tal-habu
Haza kitabullahi yantiqu bainana
Laisash-shahidu bimayyitin la yakzibu

Aye Makkah Madina mein reh kar ibadat karne wale! Agar tu hum mujahideen ko dekh leta to bil-yaqeen tujhe maloom ho jata ke teri ibadat to ek khel hai. Ek woh shakhs hai jis ke aansu us ke rukhsaron ko tar karte hain aur ek hum hain jo apni gardan Allah ki rah mein katwa kar apne khoon mein aap naha lete hain. Ek woh shakhs hai jis ka ghoda batil aur bekar kaam mein thak jata hai aur hamare ghode hamle aur ladai ke din hi thakte hain. Agar kai khushbuen tumhare liye hain aur hamare liye agar kai khushbu ghodon ke tapon ki khak aur pakeeza gard-o-ghubar hai. Yaqeen mano humein Nabi-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh hadith pahunch chuki hai jo sarasar rasti aur durusti wali bilkul sachi hai ke jis kisi ke naak mein is Allah Ta'ala ke lashkar ki gard bhi pahunch gayi us ke naak mein sholay maarne wali Jahannam ki aag ka dhuan bhi na jayega aur lo yeh hai Allah Ta'ala ki pak kitab jo hum mein maujood hai aur saaf keh rahi hai aur sach keh rahi hai ke shaheed murda nahin.

Muhammad bin Ibrahim farmate hain jab main ne Masjid-e-Haram mein pahunch kar Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayaz (R.H) ko yeh ashaar dikhaye to aap padh kar zaar-o-zaar roye aur farmaya Abu Abdur-Rahman ne (Allah Ta'ala ki rahmaten un par hon) sahih aur sach farmaya aur mujhe nasihat-nama mere paas laye, is ke badle mein tumhein ek hadith likhwata hoon woh yeh ke Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek shakhs ne darkhwast ki ke Ya Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe aisa amal bataye jis se main mujahid ka sawab pa loon, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya tujh mein yeh taqat hai ke namaz hi padhta rahe aur thake nahin aur rozay rakhta chala jaye aur kabhi be-roza na rahe? Us ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is ki taqat kahan?

Main is se bohat hi za'eef hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar tujh mein itni taqat hoti aur tu aisa kar bhi sakta toh bhi Mujahid fi Sabilillah ke darjay ko na pahunch sakta, toh yeh bhi jaanta hai ke Mujahid ke ghoray ki rassi daraaz ho jaye aur woh idhar udhar char jaye toh is par bhi Mujahid ko nekiyan milti hain. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala hukum deta hai ke Allah se dartay raho aur har haal mein har waqt har maamlay mein Allah ka khauf kiya karo. Janaab-e-Rasool-e-Akram Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ko jab Yaman ki taraf bheja toh farmaya: Ae Mu'az! Jahan bhi ho Allah ka khauf dil mein rakh aur agar tujh se koi burai ho jaye toh foran koi neki bhi kar le taake woh burai mit jaye aur logon se khulq-o-murawwat ke saath pesh aaya kar. Phir farmata hai ke yeh charon kaam kar lene se tum apne maqsad mein kaamyab aur ba-muraad ho jaoge, duniya aur aakhirat mein falah-o-najaat pa loge. Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmatay hain matlab yeh hai ke Allah farmata hai tum mera lihaaz rakho, mere khauf se kanptay raho, mujh se dartay raho, mere aur apne maamlay mein muttaqi raho toh kal jabke tum mujh se miloge najaat yafta aur ba-muraad ho jaoge.
